dṛṣṭāntite prasaṅgāt sarveṣu praiṣeṣu cānuvacaneṣu ca grāhyaḥ, ityādinā śrutena vākyena sāmidhenyanuvacanārthe havirdhāna- |

iha tu yatpadārthālocanāt aviśeṣataḥ pravṛktiḥ, tatpada- balādeva viśeṣe vyavasthāpyate iti pādāntaralam, asya sūkṣmatvāt ānantaryaṃ ca|

bhā-idānīṃ tantrāvāpalakṣaṇaṃ prayogaparimāṇaṃ parimāṇaprajñāt ekādaśe tantrāvāpacintyate |
upadiṣṭatidiṣapadertheva ca ḍavadhāraṇādīnaṃ ca prayogayattā'vadhāraṇamiti taduttarakālamārambhaḥ |
ekaprayogavacanacoditānāṃ saṃhatakāriṇāṃ bahūnāṃ karmaṇāṃ sādhāraṇāṅgāmājmaṅgānuṣṭhānaṃ kiṃ tantreṇa, utāvṛttyā (āvāpena) iti cintā lakṣaṇārthaḥ |

phalatantraṃ padārthatantram anuṣṭhānatantraṃ ceti trividhamapi tantramadhyāyārthaḥ |

na ca atra yatra patnīsaṃyājādau sāmānyataḥ ājyadravyakatvaṃ prāptam, tatra lāghavāt dhruvātāmātravidhirastviti vācyam |

tathātve'pi darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇapaṭhitacaturgṛhītavidhinā ājyabhāgādāviva upāṃśuyāje'pi sāmānyāt ājya- dravyasya prāptatvāt tatprakṛtitvena dhruvavidhānopapatteḥ, patnī- saṃyājādau ājyasyātyayājyasya vācanikatvāt |
na caivaṃ prakaraṇādeva dhruvājyasya upāṃśuyājādyarthatvasiddhe; 'sarvasmai vai' iti vākyārthasyakyāpattiḥ, prakaraṇāt ayajñe'pyapi alaṅkaraṇādiṣu tasyā''jyaśrutiphalakatvena sārthakyāt |
ata evātra yajñodeśena etacchabdārthabhūtadhruvājyasyaiva vidhiḥ, tattātparyagrāhakaṃ ca 'dhruvāyāmājyam' iti padam |

ātmani sādhaneṣu ca noccastvena asya saṃbandha iti |
anyasyāṃ satyām uccastvena asya saṃbandho bhavediti |
prajāpaterdevatāyā anirvacanaṃ dharmaḥ, turmībhāvaḥ : 'prajā- patiṃ manasā yajet' iti |
'tasmād yatkiñcit prājāpatyaṃ kriyate, upāṃśveva tat kriyate' iti |
anuvādasvarūpatvāt arthavāda eṣaḥ : 'prajāpatiṃ manasā yajet' ityasya viṣaye |
iha punaḥ upāṃśuyāje tatra śabdasya mṛdutvam |
viṣṇurvā syād hautrāmnānāmāvāsyāyāhaviśca syād, hautrasya tatra darśanāt |
amāvāsyāṃ prakṛtya vaiṣṇavaṃ hautraṃ samāmnā- yate 'idaṃ viṣṇurvi cakrame, pra tadviṣṇuḥ stavate vīryeṇa' iti |
tadevama arthavadvadati, yadi viṣṇurdevatā upāṃśu- yājaḥ |
apivā paurṇamāsyāṃ syāt pradhānaśabdasaṃyogād, guṇatvānmantro yathāpradhānaṃ syāt |
vidhāyakau hi tasya śabdaḥ paurṇamāsyām 'ājyasyaiva no upāṃśu paurṇamāsyāṃ yajan' iti |
taṃ mantrātmānaṃ na śaknoti amāvāsyā- mākraṣṭum |
upāṃśuyāje mantrasya vidhānāt yathopāṃśuyājaḥ, tatra mantraḥ iti gamyate |
upāṃśuyājasya hi mantro vidhīyate, na mantrasya upāṃśuyājaḥ |
āmanantyaṃ ca sāṃnāyyasya puroḍāśena darśa- yatyamāvāsyāvikāre |
katham ? 'ājyabhāgābhyāṃ praṇayaṃ āgneyena puroḍāśena agnīṣomau pradāya saha kummībhiḥ abhikrāman āha' iti āgneyādanānantyaṃ sāṃnāyyasya darśayati, nopāṃśuyājasya |
kutaḥ ? aviśeṣeṇa hi upāṃśuyājaḥ śrūyate, 'upāṃśuyājamanantarā yajati' iti |
yadetat, 'ājyasyaiva nāpuṃśu paurṇamāsyāṃ yajan' iti devatā- vidhānametat paurṇamāsyām |
kiṃ tarhi ? paurṇamāsyāmevopāṃśu- yājaḥ, tatraiva ca viṣṇutvā devatā iti |
katham ? 'ājyasyaiva nāpuṃśu paurṇamāsyāṃ yajan' iti prakṛtya samāmnāyate, 'jāmi vā etadyajñasya kriyate yadanyaśo puroḍāśau, upāṃśuyājamanantarā yajati' iti |
tatraiva cedaṃ vacanam, 'viṣṇurupāṃśu yajño'jāmivāya, prajāpatipāṃśu yajño'jāmivāya, amīṣomāpāṃśu yajñavyājavāmityāya' iti |
katham ? catu- rdaśa paurṇamāsyāmāhutayo hūyante, trayodaśāmāvāsyāyā- miti |
itasyā amāvāsyāyāmati caturdaśāhutayo bhaveyuḥ, trayodaśeti nopapadyate |
tasmāt paurṇamāsyāṃ śraya- māṇaṃ nāmāvāsyāyāṃ bhavet, asaṃnbandhāt |
nahi pradhānaṃ pradhānena, aṅgaṅgena saṃbandhaṃ yātīti |
guṇānāṃ ca parārthatvāt pradhāneṣu pravṛttau vidhiliṅgāni darśayati |
bhāṣyam--guṇānāṃ ca parārthatvāt pradhāneṣu pravṛttau vidhiliṅgāni darśayati |
katham ? 'apyumantāvājyabhāgau yajati' iti, 'ekādaśa prayājān yajati, ekādaśānuyājān' iti |
bhāṣyam--amāvāsyāvikāre ca sākamapyāyīye upāṃśuyājo na śrūyate |
katham ? 'ājyabhāgābhyāṃ praṇayaṃ āgneyena puroḍāśena agnīṣomau pradāya, saha kummībhirabhikrāman āha' iti āgneyādanānantaraṃ sāṃnāyyaṃ darśayati, nopāṃśuyājam |
na tu kāladvaye yāgaḥ : paurṇamāsyāṃ tu vākyataḥ |
' ye tu āśralā- yanāḥ : kālavibhimannanti : parvadvaye'pi upāṃśuyājaḥ, te kathamiva 'trayodaśāmāvāsyāyām' iti liṅgaṃ samartha- yeran |
kālavibhyāve ca paurṇamāsyāvākyena anuvādā- sambhavāt paurṇamāsaśabdenāpi na phale viniyujyate iti prādhānyamupāṃśuyājasya na syāt, ājyabhāgādivat aṅgatā syāt, ityāstāṃ tāvat |
tasmāt paurṇamāsīkālasya vāca- nikatvāt pravānānuvartitvācca devatānāṃ tisṛṇāmapi tatraiva vikalpaḥ |
) 'darśādirvā tasya kāle darśa evānya eva vā |
sa eva kālo yājyāyā utkarṣaḥ pūrṇimādine |
taiśca tulyā- rthatvād vikalpyamānaiḥ vaikalpikya eva devatāḥ prāpyante |
vā.2|4|140pṛ.495. (tatra 'idaṃ viṣṇuḥ, pra tadviṣṇuḥ' iti vaiṣṇavam |
'prajāpate na tvat, sa veda pumaḥ' iti prājāpatyam |
'āgneyyau dve, agnīṣomā yau atha vām' ityagrīṣomīyam |
soma. 10|8|147. upāṃśuyāja- gataviṣṇudevatākayājyā'nuvākyāyugalasya darśayājyā- kāṇḍāt utkarṣaḥ kartavyo daśa upāṃśuyājābhāvāt |
malpakṣe tu ājyamapi tatrāva- dīyate, iti avakalpyate |
ka punaridaṃ śrūyate ? tadabhidhīyate 'ādityaḥ prāyaṇīyaḥ payasi caruḥ' ityeko yāgaśrauditaḥ |
punastatraivoktam 'ājyasyainaṃ carumabhipūrya ājyabhāgāḥ payādyayaśrato devatā yathyāḥ' iti (arthataḥ śrutyavadāḍo'yam |
) te ca dravyasāmānyāt upāṃśuyājavikārāḥ catvāro'pi yāgāḥ, ādityaśrutaḥ (aditiśrutaḥ :) āgneyavikāraḥ |
tat yadi carorekasya atideśena sviṣṭakṛtaḥ prātaḥ, tataḥ avadyati ityeva syāt (na samavadyati iti) |
yadā tu prakṛtau ājyādapi upāṃśuyājadravyāt sviṣṭakṛt, tadā atrāpi dhrauvājyaḥ, ityubhayoḥ carvyājyayoradāne samavattaśabdaḥ samarthito bhavati |
bhāṣyam-- dhrauve cālye sviṣṭakṛdarthavādo bhavati, 'avadāyāvadāya dhrauvaṃ pratyabhidhārayati |
na hitataḥ paramā- huti yakṣyan bhavati' iti pratyabhighāraṇasya etat prayojanaṃ dadīyata, tataḥ parāmāhuti hoṣyati, iti |
sauviṣṭakṛte avatte tataḥ āhutirnāstīti na pratyabhighāryate |
vā-- 'avadāyāvadāya dhrauvaṃ pratyabhidhārayati, sviṣṭakṛte'vadāya na pratyabhidhārayati' iti dhruvāta eva avadāyeti pratiśabdāt adṛṣṭārthatvāt avagamyate |
yadapi sviṣṭakṛte avadīyate, tathāpi dhruvāta eva, yena tadarthe avate dhruvābhyaḥ pratyabhighāraṇaṃ pratiṣṭhitam |
'na hi tataḥ parāmāhutiḥ' iti hetuvacanāt pūrvārṇa pratyabhi- ghāraṇāni sviṣṭakṛdarthāni iti darśayati |
tataśca 'tatsāmānyāt itareṣu tathātvam' (3|2|23) iti sarvaiḥ śeṣakāryairbhavitavyam |
bhāṣyam-- naivaṃ dhrauvājyāt sviṣṭakṛdidam ava- dātavyamiti |
bhāṣyam-- nanu upāṃśuyājārthaṃ gṛhīte yat dhrauvājyaṃ śiṣṭam, tat śeṣabhūtam |
naitat, sādhāraṇaṃ hi tat upāṃśuyāja anyebhyaśca prayojanebhyaḥ |
yāvat ājyena yavyam, tattat ājyaṃ prayojayati |
yasyasya ājyam, tatastasya evaṃ grahītavyaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ ceti |
darśayati ca 'sarvasmai vā etadyajñāya gṛhyate yat dhrauvājyājyam' iti |
kimato yathevamiti ? yat sādhāraṇamupāṃśuyājāya avattaṃ dhrauvājyājyam, tenānyānyapi prayojanāni, na tu tat pratipādyam, yadi kṛtaprayojanam ākīrṇakaramavatiṣṭhate, tat pratipādayitavyamiti |
ka kiñca yat pratipādayitavyam, tadevaṃ pratipādayitavyam |
yathā yatraikasyā- muttarāyāṃ bahūnāmodanaḥ śruto bhavati, tatraikasmin bhukta- vati, na tasya śiṣṭaṃ bhṛtyabhyaḥ pratipādanīyam, uvāyā- mastīti gamyate |
śrauvasya asaṃyuktotpatteḥ sarvājyakāryārthamādānāt, 'sarvasmai vā etadyajñāya gṛhyate' iti vākyāt |
taittirīyāṇāṃ tu katipayopastaraṇāmighāraṇādikāyakramaṇāt tanmadhye copāṃśuyājasyāpi saṃkīrtanāt tāvatāṃ sādhāraṇaṃ 'upa- stṛṇadhamighārayājyasya yajan' iti vākyādṛśyate |
avaśiṣṭaṃ tu tatasamānabhājyam avaghāryamāṇaṃ na pūrvaśeṣa ityevam akṛtārthatvena pratipattibhavet |
yadā tu sarvaiḥ samānabhāgamiryāyogamuddhṛtvā bhāgā bhavanti, tadā tasya sādhāraṇaguṇatvena pratipattipekṣā bhavati |
tadiha upāṃśu- yājārthe bhāge apanīte, na kaścidapi tadīyaḥ śeṣo
kṛtārthapratipattasyaiva śeṣakāryāṇāṃ na svaya- meva akṛtaprayojanamapi dravyaṃ prayujyate |
yastu samastakāryanirvṛttyuttarakālaṃ sādhāraṇaḥ śeṣo bhaviṣyati, tasya samidhayajurādyaṃ pratipatyantaramā- jñātam |
yadā tu idamapi upastaraṇāmidaiva arthakarma avadhāryate, tadā sutarāṃ śeṣābhāvaḥ |
śakyaṃ tu taittirīya- cākyāpekṣayā utpattau anyasaṃyogāt samidhayajuṣaśca juhotītivadityanena ayaśatvāt pratipattitvamavadhārayitum |
avattatvācca juhvām, tasya ca homasaṃyo- gāt |
juhvāṃ tarhi ājyasya śeṣo bhaviṣyati camasavat |
yathā camaseṣu gṛheṣu ca codanayā iti |
dhruvāyā tāvannāsti śeṣaḥ, upāṃśuyājasya sādhāraṇatvāt ityuktam |
atha kasmānna juhvāṃ yatkiñca tena śeṣakāryam, yathā homārthe camase śeṣaḥ iti |
juhvāmavattaṃ tattvena homaṃ saṃbadadham, tasmānna juhvāṃ śeṣaḥ |
yat kevalaṃupāṃśuyājārthaṃ juhvāmavattaṃ tasyaiva -mahacamaseṣviva somasya- śeṣo bhaviṣyatīti |
kutaḥ ? tasya samastasya 'caturavattaṃ juhoti' iti homasaṃyogāt |
uktaṃ hi etat (2|3|7|8) upadhānārthe carau nānyatra śrutam, anyatra viniyokṣyamiti |
vā-- atha yadukaṃ camasavat satyapi homasaṃyoge śeṣo bhaviṣyatīti |
apica tatra 'aindrāvayaṃ gṛhṇāti' ityevamādīni grahaṇāti na homasaṃyuktāni, ( kintu ) haviḥprakalpanāntyeva |
tatra hi grahacamaseṣu haviḥprakalpanāmātre kṛte yathā na sarvahomaḥ, tathā 'some avacanāccakṣo na vidyate' ityadhikaraṇe vakṣyāmaḥ |
tena codanāvirodhaṃ tatra vakṣyamāṇaṃ pariharatāṃ na sarvahomo bhaviṣyati |
śeṣakāryārthādyadarśanaṃ ca somasyāgre vīhī- tyanuṣaṭkaroti' ityādi, 'sarvataḥ parihāramāśritaṃ bhakṣayati' ityādicamasamasālyā na ca virodhyate, anyathā tadvirodhaḥ syāt |
athavā na tatra asamasta- home sati kā ciccodanā virudhyate ityavirodhāt asarva- homaḥ, iha tu virodhaḥ syāt |
yathā tu bhāṣyakāreṇa pūrvaṃ camasamanu- dāhṛtya 'camasavaditi cet' iti sutramupanyastam, tathā paricodanāsūtrameva homasaṃyogaikāntikatvapradarśanārthe kalpayitvā parihāro vaktavyaḥ |
tatra vacanāntarakṛtatvāt śeṣaḥ syāt, atra 'vacanāntararahitatve sati' iti viśiṣṭasya hetoḥ ayamamicārāt |
athavā 'avatta- tvācca juhvām' ityetadeva tuśabdasya vaśadaṃ kṛtvā pūrvapakṣavādiprayatvasān vyākhyāṇaḥ : camaso dṛṣṭānto dātavyaḥ |
etaduktaṃ bhavati 'avattatvācca juhvāṃ camasavat śeṣo'stu' ( iti ) |
bhāṣyam-- atha yaduktam, 'sarvabhyo havibhyaḥ sama- vadyati' iti |
tasmādye iha śeṣāḥ, tebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ iti |
yathā 'sarve odano bhuktaḥ' 'sarve brāhmaṇā bhuktavantaḥ' iti prakṛtāpekṣaḥ : sarvaśabdaḥ, evamatrāpīti |
vā-- yastu sarvebhyaḥ iti prāpyapekṣaḥ : anuvādaḥ, tatra yādṛśaṃ vayamiha sarvatvaṃ paśyāmaḥ, tādṛśasyaivānuvāda iti manyāmahe |
sarvatraiva ca paramasarveṇa vyavahārābhāvāt adhikṛtapekṣaḥ : sarvaśabdo yujyate, iti na virodhaḥ |
yeṣāṃ śeṣasadbhāvena pratipattikāyādhikāro'sti, ye vā vidyamānatvena prakṛtaśeṣāḥ, tebhyaḥ sarvebhya iti gamyate |
bhāṣyam-- atha yaduktam, prāyaṇīye kevale carau samavattaśabdo nāvakalpate |
yadi na tatra codakena ājyā- dapi sviṣṭakṛdavadānamiti |
asyāpi ājyāt śeṣakārye samavattaśabdo jātiviśeṣāpekṣa upapadyate, odanajātim ājyājjāti cāpekṣya anuvādo hi saḥ |
vā-- pūrvadeva samavattateḥ anuvādatvāt yathāsaṃbhavam ājye'pi iti carau avadīyamāne saukṣmyāt tadavayavasya acikrītitamapi avadānaṃ balāt bhavati |
bhāṣyam-- atha yaduktam, sviṣṭakṛdarthe dhruvāyāma- midhāraṇaṃ darśayatīti |
tasmādayaṃ tasyārthaḥ, na hi tata āhuti yajñan bhavati, iti na rekṣyate |
dhruvāto yadi āhutira- parā honatvā bhavet, na ca pratyamidhāyeta, dhruvā tataḥ kila ricyeta |
vā-- anyaṃ yattu kāraṇaṃ sviṣṭakṛdartheḥ arthavādaḥ ityuktam, tat asamatyakṣe'pi upapadyate eva, arekārya- tvāt |
'sviṣṭakṛte'vadāya' iti tāvat yataḥ tasyā- vadānaṃ bhavati |
yādṛśaṃ vā saṃbhavati, tādṛśam iti gamyate |
sā hi devatā'thadravyāntarādavadāne'pi upastaraṇāmi- ghāraṇopayogitvāt pratyabhidhāraṇamapekṣate eva |
tena prāk sviṣṭakṛtaḥ parastādapi dhrauvopayogo'sti, iti avatte- avatte pratipūrayitavyam |
tataḥ paraṃ tu na kiñcit kāryamiti nāthaḥ : pratipūraṇena |
nahi etat pratipūraṇaṃ pūrvasyāvadānasya saṃskārakam, ahaṇārthatvaprasaṅgāt |
tasmāt antareṇāpi sviṣṭakṛda- yaivaṃ tadadhiraikyātvena upapannaḥ arthavādaḥ |
soma - śeṣakāryāṇi sarvebhyaḥ kartavyāni iti pūrvapādoktasya atrāpavādaḥ : prādhānyena pratipādyate, iti pādāntaratvaṃ ānantarye cetyukte |
sarvapradānādhikaraṇe sāmānyataḥ śeṣasadbhāve ukte tadviśeṣacintanāt pādānta- ratvamānantarye cetyanye |
sūtrārthastu-- ājyādapi śeṣakāryāṇi kartavyāni, teṣāṃviśeṣeṇa sarvapradānaśeṣa- saṃyogāditi |
ato na pratipatyarthaḥ śeṣakāryaṃ tataḥ katham ? |

bhāṭṭa-- upāṃśuyājaprayājāvyabhāgānuyājādidravyāṇāṃ jauhavādānāṃ sviṣṭakṛdādidāni śeṣakāryāṇi kartavyāni, uta na iti cintāyām, 'uttarādhāt sakṛtsaktamavadyati' 'sarvebhyo havibhyaḥ samavadyati' ityādicaneneyaḥ 'vedyāṃ havīṣyāsādayati' itivadajadravyamasādhāraṇa- havirarthatvamiti : kartavyāni |

iti prāpte, yaccāvadepāṃ tattayāgeṣu asādhāraṇaṃ prayājājuyājeṣu jauhavādekadeśarūpam ājyabhāgopāṃśuyājeṣu ca vācanikaṃ dhrauvāpādānakaṃ catu- gṛhītaṃ, tasya tattayajñākhitaprakṣepaviśeṣapratipattisattvāt, 'caturgṛhītaṃ juhoti' iti bhāṣyakārodāhṛtopāṃśuyājā- vāntaraprakaraṇasthavākyādeva tatsattvādā na sāmānyavihita- vidyamānaśeṣopayogisviṣṭakṛdādipratipattigrāhakatā |
ata eva yatra prayājaśeṣābhighāraṇādau viśiṣṭayaiva tadvidhānam, tatra atagatyā avayavavaśatvayoḥ samuccayaḥ |
na ca evamā- śreyasyāpi viśiṣṭaṃ caturgṛhītakathanamasvarūpapratipattividhā- nāt sviṣṭakṛdyadyakaraṇāpattiḥ, tatra bhakṣaṇasya kalpyatvena tasyāpi vilambopasthitikatvena tulyatvāt |
nāpi tattva- dāpānabhūtadhrauvājyāt syālyājyādā tatkaraṇam, tayoḥ 'sarvebhya etat' ityādivākyāt yajñādirūpaparihriyamāṇa- kāryavyavasthāpi avayavabhāvena ākīrṇakaratvābhāvāt |

na ca, ākīrṇakaratvābhāve'pi, ājye'pi ājye'pi madhye eva pratipattiḥ, tatrāgre syālyājyasya piṣṭalepapalīkaraṇādī upayogasattve'pi vacanādeva patnīsaṃyājādyavaśeṣasyaiva pratipattṛpattāvapi prakṛte tādṛśavacanābhāvena sādhāraṇa-
na ca sarvakāryānte kramaṃ bādhitvā'pi prayojanavaśena tatkaraṇam, samidhayajurādi- viśiṣṭapratipattyantaravidhānena tatra tadaprāpteḥ |
patnīsaṃyāje upāṃśuyāje ca 'upāṃśu yajati' iti vihitamupāṃśutvaṃ sākṣādyāge asaṃbhavāt tadaṅgabhūteṣu avi- śeṣāt sarveṣu niveśate |
saṃkarṣa. 4|3|15. 'upāṃśuyājamantarā yajati' iti yajati padaṃ vidhāyakam, na tu anuvādakaṃ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ |

vi. 2|2|4. 'upāṃśuyājamantarā yajati' iti sūtreṇa (10|8|15|47) havirviśeṣāśrayeṇa upāṃśu- yāje dravyānniyamaṃ pūrvapakṣayitvā 'śrauvādvā sarvayogāt ' (48) ityanena avihitadravyakeṣu dhrauvavidhiḥ vakṣyate |
su. pṛ. 722. ¤ upāṃśuyājamantarāyajatīti havirliṅgaśruti- tvāt yathākāmī pratīyate |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ : 'upāṃśuyājamantarā yajati' iti śrūyate, tatra havirliṅgaśrutitvāt, havirviśeṣasya kiñcit liṅgaṃ na śrūyate |
nanu 'ājyasya nau upāṃśu paurṇamāsyāṃ yajan' iti śravaṇāt ājyaṃ havirviśeṣṭuṃ śakyam |
satyam, tathāpi kīdṛśam ājyam iti na jñāyate |
yathā kāmayate tathā, yat kiñcidājyaṃ pratīyate |
upāṃśuyājaḥ : dhrauvāt dhrauvādyaṃ vidyamānāt ājyāt pratīyate na yataḥkuta- ścit |
'sarvasmai vā etadyajñāya gṛhyate yad dhrauvāmājyam' iti sarvaireva yāgaiḥ dhrauvājyasya saṃyogāt saṃyogasya śruttatvāt |
cajoḥ ku ghiṇṇya- toriti kutvena bhavitavyam |
su. pṛ. 746. upāṃśuyājasattvam amāvāsyāyāmapi sāṃkhyayana- śākhā'nurodhena |

ratna. 12|2|7|22. upāṃśuyājāpreyavikṛtyoḥ : ājyavārhaspatyayoḥ bārhaspatyaupadhadharmāḥ codakatvāt ājyadharmebhyaḥ pūrva kartavyāḥ, na tu prayogavidhicoditāṅgapradhānapratyāsatnu- grahāt mukhyakrameṇa ājyadharmāṇāṃ prathamam anuṣṭhānam adhrakalpayāmya |
upāṃśuyājasya- nirvāpāt pūrvam āgnīpomīyapuroḍāśanirvāpaḥ kāryaḥ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ mukhyakramasya pāṭhakramāt durbalatvāt |
bhā. 5|1|18|19. upāṃśuyājādau yājyā'nuvākyāsūktākādimantra- kalpyo devatāvidhiḥ vidhiyuktavākyāntarakalpanāt |
bhāṣyam-- 'jāmi vā etadyajñasya kriyate yadanyau puroḍāśau, upāṃśuyājamantarā yajati' |
tatra saṃdehaḥ 'upāṃśuyājamantarā yajati' iti kiṃ viṣṇvādiguṇānāṃ prakṛtānāṃ yāgānāṃ samudāyasya vācakaḥ, athavā apūrvasya yāgasyeti |
nāmasaṃbaddho hi viśiṣṭe yāgaḥ śrūyate upāṃśuyājasaṃjñakaḥ |
na ca dravyadevate rūpam, prakṛtāśca upāṃśuguṇāḥ yāgā vidyante |
nanu upāṃśuguṇaṃ yāgāntaram upāṃśutvena rūpeṇa rūpavat vidhīyate |
(uttaram--) naivajātīyakaḥ śabdaḥ upāṃśuviśiṣṭaṃ yāgaṃ śaknoti vaktum |
'cajoḥ ku ghiṇṇyatoḥ' (casya jasya ca kutvaṃ syāt iti ṇyati ca pratyaye pare |
athāpi nāmasaṃbandhaṃ yajatisāmānyameva, tathāpi anupadiṣṭadevatādravyaṃ na yāgāntaraṃ pratipadyate |
nanu evaṃ sati prakṛtānāmapi avācakaḥ prāpnoti |
(uttaram--) mā bhūt upāṃśuyāja- śabdaḥ, yajatiśabdo bhaviṣyati |
tathā sati upāṃśuyāja- śabdo'pi anuvādāttvāt anājñatve'pi na doṣaḥ |
tatra 'upāṃśuyājamantarā yajati' iti tāvat sakalaḥ prāgukto nyāyo'sti |
tatra yadidaṃ yāgāntaraṃ kalpyate, tataḥ prāptaṃ rūpājñānam adṛṣṭāntarakalpanāṃ ca |
' yathoktama- mupasaṃhārāt jāmbupanyāsasya, ajamitāyāśca eka- viṣayatvāt ete eva viṣayo gamyate |
nahi antarāla- vākye tādarthyavādo vidhirvā spaṣṭo dṛśyate |
samudāyā- nuvādaprayojanaṃ ca kathaṃ nāma 'upāṃśu paurṇamāsyāṃ yajan' ityatra ekīkṛtānāṃ kālasaṃbandhe sati sarveṣāṃ
sarvathā yena yāgāntarāt vyavacchinno yāgo nirūpyate, tadeva rūpam |
śakyate ca upāṃśutvena ayaṃ vyavacchinna- rūpaḥ |
yadi hi avayavadharmatvena guṇavidhiyaṃ kalpyeta, tato yājaśabdasya ghajantatvāt akṛtakṛtyasya asādhutvaṃ syāt |
nanu evaṃ sati iti nāmadheyatve'pi avaśyam 'tasyaiva cānyāśāstram' ityevam 'viṣṇurupāṃśu yaṣṭavyaḥ' ityādibhi- vihitam, tadguṇayogamātrasya prasiddhitvāt |
tat pariharati mā bhūt upāṃśuyāja- śabdaḥ, yajatiśabdo bhaviṣyati iti |
viṣṇo hi atyantāmnāyatvena kāryam, nāmadheye tu yajiprāptānuvāda- rūpeṇa pravartamāne kiñcitsāryānugame'pi avirodhaḥ |
bhāṣyam-- karmāntarasya vācakaḥ syāt upāṃśuyājaṃ yajatīti |
na cet prakṛtā vidyante, kasya samudāyaṃ vakṣyati |
nanu idānī- mevoktaṃ viṣṇvādiguṇāḥ prakṛtā yāgā vidyante iti |
nahi te vidhīyate 'viṣṇurupāṃśu yaṣṭavyaḥ' ityeva- mādāya |
apica yāgasya viṣṇvādinā ca saṃbandho'tra gamyate vākye, na ca yāgasya vidhānam |
nanu ca 'upāṃśuyājamantarā yajati' ityatrāpi antaḥ- rāsaṃbandho'vagamyate |
katham ? 'jāmi vā etadyajñasya kriyate' ityevamupakramam etadvākyam ajāmivāya ityevamantam |
tena saṃbadhyamānaṃ na vākyā- ntaraṃ bhavitumarhati |
tasmāt 'viṣṇurupāṃśu yaṣṭavyaḥ' ityevamādayo na vidheyaḥ, kiṃ tarhi, arthavādāḥ |
jāmitādoṣa uktaḥ, taṃ vibhajitum 'upāṃśuyājamanatarā yajati' iti vihitam|
kathaṃ tena bhipajityate? tasmin kriyamāṇe jñāyate eva, yathā viṣṇuparyaṣṭayaḥ prajāpatirmī- pomo veti|
tenājāmitā'rthavādaṃ vakṣyāmīti viṣṇvādi saṃnyo'nūdyate, na tu antarālasaṃnyasya anyat prayojanamasti ato vidhānāt|
kathaṃ viṣṇvādayo yaṣṭavyā ityavagamyate? yaṣṭavyān ayaṣṭavyān vā viṣṇvādīn upāṃśuyājābhidhāya saṃkīrtayati iti gamyate|
tatra ke cit tāvadāhuḥ prāptā eveti|
yadyapi aprāptiḥ, tathāpi upāṃśusāmā- nyāt prajāpatirdevatā viṣṇuśruti anuvādādeva, upāṃśu- dharmāṇī hi viṣṇuprajāpatī|
tasmāt 'yat kiñcit prājāpatyaṃ yathe kriyate, tatpāṃḍaveva kriyate' ityevamā
' vācya- vācakatve avadhārite paścāt vidhividheyatvam anuṣṭhāna- vādakatvaṃ vā kalpyate |
tatra ubhayorapi vācyavācaka- sambandhaḥ sādhāraṇaḥ; iti tadvato guṇādoṣāvapi sādhāraṇau |
tena naiko bodho bhavati (anyatarāvadhāraṇaṃ na bhavati ityarthaḥ) |
syādetat anuvādātvam avācakasyāpi kathañcit dṛṣṭaṃ na vidhitvam iti |
mamāpi hi 'yajinā vihite yāge yāja ityanuvādakam |
vihitaṃ nahya- pāṃśutvaṃ śāstreṇānyena kena cit |
na 'upāṃśu paurṇamāsyām' ityanena kālavidhivyāptena, anekavidha- śakteḥ |
jāmitvā- panayanaṃ ca sarvaprakāraṃ dravyataḥ (ājyavidhānāt) svarataḥ (madhyamasvaratvāt) devatātva (viṣṇuprajāpati- pakṣe) |
jñāyate eva yathā viṣṇuryajñavyaḥ, prajāpatiḥ, agnīṣomau vā iti |
yāge codite avaśyambhāvinyāṃ devatāyām aniyamaprasaktau ke cit viṣṇuprajāpatyoḥ prādhānya- prasiddhyā vaicitryapradarśanārthe saṃkīrtitāḥ |
tena yadyapi paramārthena na yajyāḥ, tathāpi stutiparatvāt upādānaṃ guṇa- vādena kathañcit ucyate |
anudāharaṇāt asphuṭam evamabhidhāya nahi kiñcit asādhyaṃ syāt |
na ca tasmin sati daśame 'tacca devatāya syāt' (10|8|16|9 ke.) ityādi vicārya 'viṣṇurvā syāt tannāmnāt' (53 ke.) ityādinā mānvavarṇikatvaṃ jaiminirāśrayiṣyati |
'yadyapi aprāptiḥ' iti ca ihāpi svayameva āśāhkā darśitā |
yadyukkam upāṃśudharmatvāt prāpno 'tasmāt yat kiñcit prājāpatyam' iti (āpāya ākṣepyam), tadapyayuktam, vacanavyativiparyāsāt |
nahi evaṃ vacanam 'yadupāṃśu tat prājāpatyam' iti tarhi ' yat prājāpatyam,
'yadi hi tau agnīṣomau abrūtām, tataḥ asmākaṃ kim' iti hi vijānanto yajamānāḥ 'na vayaṃ devatayā pravartitaḥ' iti kalpayeyuḥ |
kālavidhiratvācca na devatā'pi anena śakyā vidhātum |
devatāparatve vā kālavidhiparityāgāt paurṇamāsīśabdenāpi nānyatra, iti paurṇamāsaśabdena agrahaṇāt asati pradhānatve aṅgatva- prasaṅgaḥ |
sūtrakāreṇa ca daśame amāvāsyāyāmupāṃśuyāja- manicchatā etadeva paurṇamāsīkālavidhitvena upanyastam |
(śāstrā'ntare iti bhāṣyaṃ tāvat samādhātumārabhate-) atra samādhiḥ |
upāṃśuyājakrame hi vaiṣṇavaprājā- patyāgnīṣomīyāṇi yājyāpuro'nuvākyāyugalāni āmmā- yante |
taiśca tulyārthatvāt vikalpyamānaiḥ vaikalpya eva devatāḥ prāpyante |
āścaryavede'pi tu kadistyeva yājyā- 'nuvākyā''mmānaṃ hotrarūpeṇa iti tadabhiprāyaṃ vā śāstrā- ntaravacanam |
anyā hi devatā ānīyamānā ātmīyaṃ dharmam uccairdhvaṃ jaghyāt, paradharmamupāṃśu prāpnuyāt iti viruddham |
' tāvanmātramīpomāvājyasyaiva nā'pāṃśu paurṇamāsyāṃ yajan ' iti kālasaṃbandhatātparya- grahadvārā phalasaṃbandhasiddhīrvā |
anyathā hi agnīṣoma- devatyasya kālasaṃbandhatāt phalasaṃbandhaḥ syāt |
iti prāpte, upakramopasaṃhārayoḥ ekaviṣayatvenaikavākyapratītare tatrapratyayāntavākyaiḥ karmavidhiḥ |
ata eva ' tatrapratyayāntairdevatāmātravidhiḥ antarālavākya- syakarmaṇi ' ityapāstam |
śāstrābhedena vaiṣṇavāprājāpatyāgnīṣomīyā''nuvākyā yugalānām etvāgrakrame samāmnātānāṃ vikalpena tat- devatākatvasyopapatteḥ |
tasya ca ' tāvanmātrām ' ityanena kālasaṃbandhatāt phalasaṃbandhaḥ |
bhavati 'dhūmavān vaheḥ' ityatra dhūmatvāvacchinnavyāpakaṃ tatsādhanavaheḥ adhyāpakaṃ ārdrandhanam |
'sa śyāmo mitratanayatvāt' ityatra mitratanayatvāvacchinnaśyāmatvavyāpakaṃ śākapākajatvaṃ mitratanayatvāvyāpakam |
vāyuḥ cākṣuṣaḥ pratyakṣasparśāśrayatvāt ityatra dravyatvāvacchinnacākṣuṣatvavyāpakaṃ udbhūtarūpavattvaṃ tadavacchinnahetoḥ adhyāpakaṃ ca |
evam 'dhvaṃso vināśī janyatvāt' ityatra bhāvatvaṃ janyatvāvacchinnasādhyavyāpakaṃ sādhanādhyāpakaṃ ca |
evaṃ yatra tādṛśo dharmo nāsti, tatra sādhyādhikaraṇatadanadhikaraṇayānyataratvarūpadhamo bodhyaḥ iti |
ayaṃ ca svavyabhicāreṇa sādhane sādhyavyabhicārajñāpanena vyāptigrahapratibandhakaḥ |
saṃdigdhapakṣetaratvaṃ tu nopādhiḥ saṃpradāyāt iti ce citta |
vahninā dhūmasādhane ārdrandhanabhāvaṃ tada- bhāvaḥ sādhyate |
ittham 'karakā pṛthivī kaṭhinasaṃyoga- vattvāt' ityatra sādhanavyāpakatvamapi anuṣṇāśītasparśavattvam upādhiḥ iti āhuḥ |

su. pṛ. 1197. upāyicodanāni, āsanacodanāni ca santrāṇi |
ci. 8|2|5. upāharaṇaṃ somasya jyotiṣṭome mānavasaiva kurvanti, na pṛthak vāso gṛhṇanti |
vi. 10|6|20. upāharaṇaṃ somasya pṛthak kṛtvā grahaṇam |
ahargaṇe somaṃ krītvā sarvameva havirdhānaśakṭe sthāpayanti |
pratyahaṃ ca tat taduparyanyataṃ somaṃ samudāyāt pṛthakkṛtya gṛhṇanti |
soma. 10|6|20. upāharaṇavāsaḥ ahargaṇe mānavavāso bhinnam, tatrāpi pratyahaṃ pṛthakpṛthak |
bhā. 2|2|12|27 pṛ. 557. ubhayataḥ pāśā rajjuḥ iti nyāyaḥ |
'spaśa vācanasparśino : ' iti bhauvādikasya 'spaśa grahaṇasaṃkṣepaṇayoḥ' iti caurādikasya vā svāśā iti rūpametat tāvantam iti jñeyam |
'saiaupabhayataḥ pāśā rajjurbhavati ' iti 'haluṅabhyāmbo dīrghāt sutisyapṛktaṃ hal' iti sūtrabhāṣyaikatayoruktam |
'ubhayataḥ pāśā rajjuḥ ' iti sakārarahita-pāśetiṭādyanta-rūpaṃ tu aśuddhameva pūrvoktabhāṣyavirodhāt |
(idaṃ tu ayuktam, pāśaśabdasya puṃstve'pi ubhayataḥ pāśā iti bahuvrīhiṇā rajjuviśeṣaṇatvena sāmāsikapadasya strīliṅgattvopapatteḥ |
yathā mṛgādidandhanārtham ubhayatra kṛtāyāṃ pāśāyāṃ rajjo praviṣṭo mṛgādiḥ kutaścidapi mārgāt gantuṃ na śaknoti tadat |
bhā. 6|7|3|4. ubhayatodatāṃ dānaṃ pratigraho vikrayaśca anācāraḥ udīcyānām |
vā. 1|3|1|3 pṛ. 204. ubhayapānāt pṛṣadājye dadhno'pi syādupa-lakṣaṇam, nigameṣu pātanasyopalakṣaṇatvāt |
tatra nirdeśaḥ kathaṃ kartavya iti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |

pṛṣadājye haviṣi sati nigameṣu dadhno'pi ājyasyāpi ca upalakṣaṇaṃ syāt 'dadhyājyapā-nāvaha' iti vaktavyamisyaiḥ ? kutaḥ ? ubhayapānāt ubhayoḥ dadhyājyayoḥ devatoddeśena tyajyamānatvena ubhayoḥ pānāt, pātanasya ca prakṛtau upalakṣaṇatvāt |
tasmāt dadhyājyapān iti vaktavyam iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
yajñapatitvat yathā prakṛtau iḍāyām ' ya imaṃ yajñamān ye ca yajñapati vardhan' ityatra yajñapatiḥ manuṣyāṇāṃ hotṛṇāṃ pradānārthaḥ, na svārthe kīyante ityadhikaraṇena prayujyate tadvat |
tasmāt devānājyapān ityeva vaktavyam, na dadhyājyapān iti |
dadhno'pi upalakṣaṇaṃ syāt dadhyājyapān iti vaktavyam |
dadhnaḥ saṃskāraśabdatvāt pṛṣadājyaṃ nāma pṛṣatāsaṃskāraviśiṣṭam ājyam |
dadhnaḥ upalakṣaṇaṃ syāt iti punaḥ pūrvapakṣa āha |
'pṛṣadājyaṃ gṛhṇāti, dravyaṃ vā idaṃ sarpiṣaiva dadhi ca' iti ājyena tulyatayā dadhi abhihitam |
'devānājyapānāvaha iti vaktavyam, na tu 'devān dadhyājyapānāvaha' iti |
yattu 'pṛṣadājyaṃ gṛhṇāti, dravyaṃ vā idaṃ sarpiṣaiva dadhi ca'
iti vacanāt tulyaṃ dadhi ājyena pradhānabhūtam iti |
grahaṇe hi tat tulyamājyena, na yāge |
yāgo hi citreṇa ājyena śrūyate 'pṛṣadājyena yajati' iti |
asyāḥ śruteḥ ājyapradhānatvāt dadhno guṇatvam, na pradhānatvam |
5|16|61, ubhayasāmke saṃsavādikṛtau bṛhadrathaṃtarayoḥ pṛṣṭastotre eva samuccaya niveśaḥ |
saṃsavaḥ gosavaḥ apacitiḥ iti ubhayasāmanaḥ kratavaḥ |
prakṛtau bṛhadrmā rathaṃtaradharmāśca vidyamānā iha codakena prāpyante |
tatra kim ubhayasāmni kratau ubhaya- dharmāḥ kartavyāḥ, uta vyavasthā iti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
ubhayasāmni bṛhadrathaṃtarabhayasāmake saṃsavādau kratau ca evaṃ pūrvādhikaraṇoktakaṇvarayaṃtare iva ubhayadharmāḥ syuḥ |
ekārthā- patteḥ ubhayorapi bṛhadrathaṃtarayoḥ ekasmin‌narthe pṛṣṭhakārye āpatteḥ prāptatvāt |
saṃsavagosavādau ubhayasāmni kratau bṛhadrathaṃtarayobhayo- dharmāḥ kartavyā iti pūrvapakṣaṃ vaśabdena vyāvartyan- siddhāntamāha |
na bṛhadrathaṃtarayoḥ saṃhatayoḥ ubhaye dharmāḥ kartavyāḥ; kintu rathaṃtare rathaṃtaradharmāḥ, bṛhati bṛhaddharmāḥ iti vyavasthā syāt |
dharmāṇāṃ svārthatvāt rathaṃtaradharmāṇāṃ rathaṃtarārthatvāt, bṛhaddharmāṇāṃ ca bṛhadarthatvāt |
tasmāt rathaṃtare prayujyamāne rathaṃtara- dharmāḥ prayoktavyāḥ, bṛhati ca prayujyamāne bṛhaddharmāḥ |
ke. ubhayasāmni naimittikaṃ vikalpena samatvāt syāt |
saṃsave gosave apacitau ityādiṣu 'ubhe bṛhadrathaṃtare kuryāt' iti śrūyate |
rathaṃtaranimittakaṃ bṛhannimittakaṃ ca pṛthak kāryaṃ śrutam |
'uparavatī rathaṃtarapṛṣṭhasya pratipadaṃ kuyāt, agnivatī bṛhatpṛṣṭhasya' iti |
'upāsame gāyat' ityupavatī, 'prayujo vāco agniyaḥ' ityagniya- vatī |

evaṃ sati ubhayasāmni bṛhadrathaṃtarabhayasāmake saṃsavādikṛtau ubhayatraniyatoḥ pratipadoḥ prāpteḥ samatvāt samuccayasya cāsaṃbhavāt naimittikaṃ bṛhannimittakaṃ rathaṃtaranimittakaṃ ca pratipadagrahaṇaṃ vikalpena syāt iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
mukhyena prathamādhītena rathaṃtareṇa upavatī pratipad niyamyeta |
tasmādubhayasāmni kratau rathaṃtaranimittikā upavatī pratipad grāhyā |
nimittavidhātāt nimittasya rathaṃtarasya bṛhattaśca parasparavidhātāt virodhāt upavatī agniyavatī ca pratipattuṃ grahītuṃ na śakyate |
tasmāt kratuyuktasya kevalapṛṣṭhanimittakasya mantrasya kasya cit karma paṭhanaṃ syāt pratipattvena iti siddhāntaḥ |
saṃsave gosave apacitau iti ubhayasāmni kratau bṛhadrathaṃtarayoḥ vibhāgaḥ syāt viśvajidvat |
yathā viśva- jiti sarvepṛṣṭhe ekaṃ rathaṃtaraṃ pṛṣṭhakāryaṃ niviśate itarāṇi parisāmākāryaṃ, evaṃ saṃsavādau anyatarat pṛṣṭhakāryaṃ niveśanīyam, itarat parisāmākāryaṃ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
kiṃ tarhi pṛṣṭhārthe kārye ubhe api sāmanī syātām |
tadarthatvāt 'ubhe bṛhadrathaṃtare kuryāt' iti vacanasya sāmasvārthatvāt |
ubhayasāmni saṃsavagosavādikṛtau bṛhadrathaṃtarayoḥ ubhayorapi pṛṣṭhakāryaṃ eva liṅgadarśanāt |
'mahāpṛṣṭhī vai bṛhadrathaṃtare nidhanaṃ samāpyate yanamahāpṛṣṭhī sammṛcyate na hyatra vibhramaṃ prabhavam' iti nidhanabheda- vacanāt liṅgāt ekasthānatā avagamyate |
tathā 'pūrvāho vai rathaṃtaram, aparāhno bṛhat' ityaparaṃ liṅgam ekenāhā abhisaṃbandhāt ekasthānatāṃ darśayati |
tasmāt samastayoḥ pṛṣṭhadeśe niveśaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
ke. 6|4|6|22-23. ubhayākāṅkṣālakṣaṇasaṃbandhabhāve hi anyatarā- kāṅkṣālakṣaṇaḥ saṃbandho gṛhyate, na saṃbhave |

yadi tu dravyamātrasambhave karma- vidhimātrāllocanayaiva saṃskāravidhibhya: pūrvameva nīvārāṇāṃ sādhanatvāvagama: iti vibhājyate, tarhi teṣāṃ prokṣaṇādi- dharmaśai: samānavidhānatve'pi 'vrīhīṇāṃ medha' iti mantrasya yavaprayoge iva nīvāraprayoge'pi lopo bhavet, na tu iha: |
yatra nāvayavaghaṭitasāhaśyena pratinidhi:, yathā avaghātapratinidhitayā nakhaviluchanādau tatra sarvathaiva dharmaṇāṃ lopa:, 'adhipavaṇamasi vānaspatyam' ityādi- mantramātralopo vā |
prakṛte tu nīvārapūtikādīnām avayava- ghaṭitasāhaśyena pratinidhitve dravyākhyenaiva sādhanatvāva- gate: saṃskārāṇāmiva vrīhādipadaghaṭitamantrāpi anūhena prāpyavighāta: |
ūha: na samānaprakaraṇe saṃbhavati asati vacane anyathānāmabhidhānāt |
bhā 3|1|28, ūha: na savitrādipadānāṃ nirvāpamantragatānāṃ vikṛtī |

asti tu prakṛtau eka- hāyanī ṛtārthā |
tavedam āmnāyate 'iyaṃ gau:, tayā te krīṇāmi tasyai śatam, tasyai śara:, tasyai dadhi, tasyai mastu, tasyai ātañcanam, tasyai navanītam, tasyai ghṛtam, tasyai āmikṣā, tasyai vājinam' iti |

iti prāptam ? gopadārthaviśeṣameva ūha- vacanaṃ syāt, 'tasyai śatam' ityevādīnāmavikāra: asaṃyogāt śṛtādibhirayai: |
nahi ekahāyanī dugdhe ( dugdhe duhāte duhate ) |

asamavetavacanā hyete, naikahāyanyā bhavanti ekahāyanītvā- deva |
athocyate, kālāntare bhaviṣyantīti, sāṇḍe'pi kālāntare bhavitumarhanti |

soma-- yadyapi sāṇḍe'pi 'tasyai śṛtaṃ tasyai- dadhi' ityevarūpo liṅgoho'syeva, tathāpi kiṃ liṅgavat śṛtādīnāmapi ūha:, uta śṛtādīnāmūha: kintu liṅgamātrasya iti saṃśayo bodhya: |
ata eva bhāṣye 'kiṃ gośabdasya sthāne ūhaṃ kṛtvā avaśiṣṭānāṃ padānāṃ vikāra:, uta sarveśāmūha: ' iti saṃśaya ukta: |
gośabdasya sthāne ityasya gośabdavācakatvacchabdasya sthāne ityartha: |

mastu tasyā ātañcanaṃ tasyai navanītaṃ tasyai ghṛtaṃ tasyā āmikṣā tasyai vājinam' ityehāyīmantre strī- liṅgāṃśe puṃliṅgohastu avivāda eva |

śṛtādipade- ṣvapi kim 'tasya śukam, tasya calam, tasya yuddham, tasya jaya:, tasya dumbhārava:, tasya palāyanam, tasya līlā, tasya bhārodvahanam' ityevam ūhitavyo na veti saṃdehe, 'śṛtam' ityādi 'chinaddhi' ityādipat avaśyādhyāhāryaṃ kriyāpade yadyapi 'asti' iti nādhyāhartuṃ śakyate ekahāyanvavasthāyāṃ śṛtāderabhāvāt, tathāpi 'bhaviṣyati' ityadhyāhartavyam, tataśca bhaviṣyatyā: samavetatvāt vikretrānamarthātvena ca dṛṣṭārthatvāt trivatse'pi vikretrānatihetutrivatsaguṇaprakāśanārthe kartavya evoha: |
iti prāpte, bhaviṣyatyā api maraṇavandhyā- dinā niyatatvābhāvāt 'saṃbhavi' ityevaṃ padaṃ prakṛtau adhyāhāryam, tacca gosātvarka vikretrānamarthe vetyanya- detat |
śakyate hi sāṇḍāt yā gaurjaniṣyate tasyā jāyamānaṃ śṛtādi sāṇḍyamiti vyapadeṣṭum |
ūha: na stotraśastramantrāṇāṃ prākṛtānām agni- ṣṭuti |
idaṃ saṃdihyate yo'yam ūho nāma 'kayānaścitra āmuvat' iti ( kāyā naścitrā āmuvāt iti ) kimayamapi ārṣo nila:, uta puruṣa- praṇīta: iti |
kiṃ prāptam ? etāni ūhasāmāni mantra- bhūtāni brāhmaṇamupadiśanti |
yadi cāyam apuruṣa- buddhipūrvakaṃ vedatulyastata iṣṭa: |
cikīrṣita iti ca śabdo bhavati ! tasmānnityā ūha iti |
bhavataiva hetuṃ varṇayatā asyokto doṣa: ; ūhaścikīrṣita iti |
yaduktam, iṣṭe cikīrṣitaśabdo bhavati, icchāyāṃ hi san vidhīyate iti |
satyam iṣṭaṃ kartum, yadi kriyate, tatkartu- miṣṭaṃ bhavatīti |
bhavati hi vacanam, 'kavatīṣu rathaṃtaraṃ gāyati' iti |
tasmādatideśavacanāt nyāyenaiva gātavyamiti vācanikaṃ prathamaṃ vijñānam |
kiṃ bhavati prayojanam ? nyāya- viruddhamapi pramāṇaṃ yathā pūrva: pakṣa: |
katham ? 'kavatīṣu rathaṃtaraṃ gāyati' iti kavatyavasthāt na kṛtaka: |
yadapi atideśavākyam 'kavatīṣu ratha- taraṃ gāyati' iti, tadapi naiva kṛtakam |
tasmāt ūha- granthe na kiṃcit kṛtakam ( paśyāma: ) |
rathaṃtaragatau kavatīṣu gīyamānāyāṃ puruṣasya gītikṣāṃ prati ya: prathama: prayatna:, sa kṛtaka: |
samāmnāyena ( tāvat ) abhilavyāṃ rathaṃtaragītirdṛṣṭā atideśasāmarthyāttu anyāsu ( kavatīṣu ) kriyate |
yathā prajānāṃ nityānāmapi yadanuṣṭhānaṃ tat kṛtakam, evamihāpi ( kavatīṣu rathaṃtarasthānuṣṭhānaṃ vidhivaśāt puruṣeṇa svayaṃ kriyate, na tu āmnāyasiddham ) |
soma-- sūtrārthastu- sāmāni ūhasāmāni mantra- bhūtāni apāṇi ityeke manyante iti |
' bhāṭṭa-- athavā yo'yamuho nāma granthaviśeṣaḥ sāmagaiḥ paṭhyate, sa kiṃ pauruṣeya utāpauruṣeya iti cintāyām, kartṛsmaraṇābhāvarūpavedāpauruṣeyahetvoḥ api tulyatvāt |
svādhyāyanādhyāyaparipālanasya ca tulyatvāt, ūha iti samākhyāyāśca rūḍhatvenāpi netuṃ śakyatvāt |
itarathā kartṛsmaraṇābhāve'pi samākhyātvena pauruṣeyatvāṅgīkaraṇe kāṭhakādisamākhyayā vedasyāpi pauruṣeyatvāpatteḥ apauruṣeya ūhagranthaḥ |
iti prāpte, 'ūha vitarka' iti smṛtyā tarkaprabhāvavarūpayogenaiva samākhyo- papattau rūḍhatve pramāṇābhāvāt |
ūhagranthe ca yonigranthe yonipyutpannasya sāmno 'yathonyāṃ gāyati, taduttarayo- rgāyati', ityādinā atidiśya nyāyaneocarādī paṭha- nīyasya saukaryārthe pāṭhāt |
asthāpi vedasarvasāmānyān- siddhatayā yonipyutprasaṅgena yonipyuttarādibhāvasya ati- deśāśakyatva ca vaiyarthyāpatteḥ pauruṣeyatvameva |
ata eva balavatpauruṣeyatvāsādhakapramāṇatvābhāvāviśiṣṭakartṛsmaraṇā- māva eva pauruṣeyatvābhāvasādhakaḥ iti nānaikāntikatā |
yadyapi ca tatrasthā ṛcaḥ sāmāni ca svarūpeṇa apau- ruṣeyapye, tathāpi uttarā''diṣu nyāyasiddhādiśeṣasāma- racanāprakāraḥ pauruṣeyaḥ |
mantrādi- smṛtiṣu hi mantrādiṣviśeṣeṇa śrutikalpanā'ye kartṛsmaraṇa- māvaśyakam |
prakṛte tu nyāyamūlakatvāt tadabhāve''pi na vā citta kṣatiḥ |
ata eva samanyāyavirodhe asyā- prāmāṇyam, na tu anyasmṛtivat mūlabhūtaśrutikalpanyā nyāyasyaiva ābhāsīkaraṇam |
' ūhajñānārthamapyatra vyākaraṇam iti vaiyākaraṇāḥ ('rakṣā-ūha-āgama-laghu-asandehāḥ prayojanam' iti
) tatrāha mīmāṃsāvārtikakāraḥ 'ūhārtha- mapi śaṅkāyāṃ na vyākaraṇamarthavat |
yathā uhānullāvibhāgaḥ mīmāṃsāsiddhatvāt na vyākaraṇa- pekṣā, tathā ūhasvarūpamapi lokevedasiddhatvāt ityarthaḥ |

tena liṅgavākyābhyāṃ kṛtapaḍahasya puṃsaḥ saṃskārake avagamyamāne maghṛtatāśane kathaṃ ṣaḍahaphalārthe syātāmiti |
