nāmi-dhāyakatvaṃ mantratve hetuḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? abhimuktaprayogaḥ |
ye abhiyuktairmantrā iti nocyante, na te mantrāḥ |
prayojanaṃ mantre aṣṭe yat prāyaścittam, amantreṣu tatra |
tathā yatra yajamānasya ārṣeyaṃ triyate sa pravaraḥ |
yatra yajamāna-tanuprādīnāṃ nāmagrahaṇaṃ tannāmadheyam, yathā subrahmaṇyāyām
teṣāmapi 'tathodakeṣu' ityasmāllakṣaṇāt mantramadhyapātācca mantraprāptau ucyate, 'svādhyāyye paṭhyamāneṣu yeṣu mantrapadaṃ smṛtam |
te mantrā nābhidhānaṃ hi mantrāṇāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ sthitam ||
kiṃ punarekasmin pade udyamāne samastasyaivamantratvam, ūhitapadamātrasya ceti |
' saṃpradāyakālāvagatatvarūpānnyaṃ cet kena cidapyaṃśena jātaṃ na śakyate mantratvaṃ pratyabhijñātum |
aya ekadeśe'pi tatsadbhāvābhyupagamaḥ, tataḥ sarvatraiva mantradāviśeṣān mantratvaprasaṅgaḥ |

(etadeva prapañcayati-) tataśca yathaiva taddināśā sarva-vavarṇavarttini prāyaścittabhāvaḥ; evaṃ mantracchandoviṣayatvena yāvantaḥ śabdaviśeṣāḥ svaryante, tairai bhavitavyam ityeka-padadavavayohe tanmantratassarvacchandasāpodāreṇa laukika-śabdaprayogaḥ kartavyaḥ iti |
(tasya ūhatve vākyasya na kevalam ūhitavayavamātravarttini nimittāṃśe mantrabhraṃśa-nimittaprāyaścittābhāvaḥ, kintu sarvāvayavavarttini iti ekaṃ tāvat prayojanam |
'śvetavahādīnāṃ ḍas yasyeti vaktavyam' yatra padatvaṃ bhāvi, tatra ṇpinaḥ apavādaḥ ḍas vaktavya ityarthaḥ |
ukthāni ubhayathaiva śaṃsati ukthaśā yajamānaḥ; ukthaśāsau uktha-śāsaḥ |
puro dāśyate dīyate khaṇḍayate iti puroḍāśaḥ |

ityā-dinā yāvantaḥ 'śvetavāḥ ukthaśāḥ puroḍāśaḥ' ityādayo mantra-viṣayatvena, 'hyagnihotraṃ chandoviṣayatvena 'ādityaṃ divo mātariśvā jabhāra' 'imāmagṛbhṇan' ityādayo yāvantaḥ śabdaviśeṣāḥ smaryante, teṣāmabhāvāt 'śvetavāḥ', 'puroḍāśaḥ', 'jabhāra', 'agnin', 'agchan' ityādiḥ laukikaḥ prayogaḥ kāryaḥ |
tvāmyupagamāt vidhiprayojanatvābhāvena ca brāhmaṇatvā- bhāvāt mantraprasaṅge paṭhyamānavedaviṣayatvaṃ dvairāya- niyamasya vaktum idamadhikaraṇam |
soma- taccodakasūtrādāpātaḥ prasaktaṃ mantrala- mapohete iti saṃgatiḥ |
'agnaye juhuṃ nirvapāmi ' ityādimantre sauryādivikṛtiṣu 'sūryāya juhum ' ityevaṃ prakṣipyamāṇaṃ sūryādipadam iha ūhaśabdena vivakṣitam |
tathā 'agnidevo hotā ' iti mantre 'yuvanāśvavat agnīroṣavat agnīrovat ' iti prakṣipyamāṇaṃ yajamānā- peyaṃ pravaraḥ |

subrahmaṇyānigade 'surabhraśarmaṇaḥ putro yajate, somanāthayajñaśarmaṇaḥ pautraḥ yajate, sureśvarayajñaśarmaṇo naptā yajate, mairamadāyāḥ putro yajate ' ityevaṃ prakṣipyamāṇāni yajamānapitrādīnāṃ nāmadheyāni nāmadheyaśabdena vivakṣita- tāni |
ājyasya haviṣo vyantvityeva brūyāt' iti nigamanāt uditatvāttuditahomatat vikalpaḥ |
prakṛte tu 'haviṣa iyu- taramāha' iti vacanāntareṇa vyavasthāpanāt sahaviṣā ahaviṣā ityanayorvidhitvam |
'yājyā yajati' 'vaṣaṭkāreṇa pradīyate' iti vidhivyam ubhayoḥ pradānārthatvāvateḥ ekārthatvāt ṛgjuṣāṇādhikaraṇanyāyāt vikalpaḥ iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
ṛgyajuḥsāmaśabdānāṃ vedeṣu prayogāt 'ṛgbhiḥ prātardivi deva īyate' ityatra ca 'vedairaśūnyaḥ' iti bahuvacanāt ṛkśabdādeḥ spaṣṭaṃ vede prayogāt |
bhāṣyam-- iha ke cit taittirīya adhīyāte, ke cit cātuḥsvaryeṇa |
āha, ye ime cātuḥsvaryeṇa adhīyāte, kiṃ te udāttānudāttasvaritaibhyaḥ adhikam aparaṃ svaraṃ kurvanti ? netyāha |
teṣāmapi ete eva svarāḥ, ye anyeṣām |
kiṃ nu kurvanti ? ekaṃ kharāntaram uktamya adhīyate |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ samuccayaḥ taittarīyādīnām, uta vikalpaḥ |
kiṃ prāptam ? sarvāṅgopasaṃhārāt prayogavacanasya samuccayaḥ iti |
bhāṣyam-- vacanamidaṃ bhavati smṛtyupamitam 'tāno yajñakarmaṇi' iti |
na sākṣāt svaraviśiṣṭayā mantrāṇāṃ karmajñatvocikā śrutirasti, yena tadvirodhe smṛtirvādhikā bhavet, kintu svarādhyayanavidhivupajīvya nyāyavattvāt svaraviśiṣṭānāṃ karmāṅgatvam |
nyāyaśca (sarvaśākhāpratyayāyaḥ : svarasamu- ccayasādhakaḥ ) smṛtito durbalaḥ, iti niṣpannūhaṃ vedānu- mānam |
bahuvrīhau samāse pūrvapadaṃ prakṛtisvaraṃ bhavati, pūrvapade yaḥ svaraḥ sa evāvaśiṣyate, na tu samāsānta- dāttatvam |
yathā 'sthūlapṛṣṭhīm' ityādī pūrvapadasya sthūlaśabdasya antodāttatvalakṣaṇaṃ prakṛtisvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā bahuvrīhi- niścayaḥ |
(1|2|134 yajñakriyāyāṃ mantraḥ ekaśrutiḥ syāt japaśākhaviśeṣagata--okārarūpanyūṅkheṣu sāmni ca na ekaśrutiḥ ) |
evaṃ ca japamantrādityatiriktasya karaṇamantrādirūpeṣu 'agnaye juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi' ityādiṣu ādhvaryavayājamāneṣvapi ādhunikānāṃ yājñikānāṃ cātuḥsvaryeṇa prayoge mūlaṃ mṛgyam |
asmin varṇake sūtre ṛksāmaśabdaḥ cātuḥsvaryādau kathañcinneyaḥ |
vi-- 'taittarīyādi samuccaya vikalpaṃ tāna eva vā |
te hi ka cit udāttānudāttasvaritapracaya- cātuḥsvaryeṇa adhīyātāḥ |
ka cit te eva śākhāntare pracayavarjaṃ taittarīyam |
na ca 'tāno yajñakarmaṇi, ajapantyajña- sāmasu' iti smṛtyā tānasvarasya vihitatvāt ubhaya- bādhaḥ |
śaitānām adhyayanavidhivyāpitānāṃ svarāṇāṃ pāṭhādinā tattatkratupūrvasādhanībhūta mantravṛttitvasya prayatnapramāṇapramitatvena smṛtyā bādhāyogāt |
anyathā 'agnimūrdhā' ityādīnāṃ smṛtyā navamabrāhmaumārcane viniyogāt (yājña. 1|300) kramādinā āgneyādya- jhatvānāpatteḥ |
na caivaṃ navagrahahomāṅgatvanāpattiḥ, sauryā- kāṅkṣayaiva navagrahahomākāṅkṣayaiva vā vākyena viniyogopa-
prakṛte tu śrautasvaravirodhāt tānasmṛteḥ aprāmāṇya- meva |
iti prāpte, śrautasya svarasya adhyayanavidhinā adhyā- pitasya prayojanāpekṣāyām 'yadyacchantyāt, tattat kuryāt' ityupavandhena prakaraṇādisahakṛtamantravṛttipāṭhe na prayojanadvayamavagamyate |
na ca mantrāṇāṃ prayogakāle etra arthasārakatvāt pūrvam arthaviśeṣadhāraṇamāve'pi bādhakābhāvaḥ, vidhivagatasyāpi arthaviśeṣasya prayogakāle mantrapratipādyatvasaṃdehaprayogābhāvāvambhavāpatteḥ |
atastadartha prayogāt bahiraiva mantrārthanirṇayārthe 'bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā pūrvapadam' ityādirūpayogaḥ |
aparaṃ ca pūrvam avadhāritasyāpi arthasya prayogamadhye visaraṇe punarnirṇa- yakatā |
mantroccāraṇadeva ca svaroccāraṇa- siddheḥ na svarānusaṃdhānamātreṇa nirṇāyakatā |
tadevaṃ dvividhaḥ svarasya ṛtūpayogaḥ prakaraṇādinā sidhyet |
tatra ca viśeṣarūpeṇa smṛtyā yajñaprayoge tānasvaravidhā- yikā bādhanāt sāmānyarūpasya prakaraṇādeḥ prayogagrahārtha- nirṇayayogitvaviśaṣayaiva kalpyate |
prayogamadhye visvara- ṇādau tu svarānusaṃdhānameva arthaviśeṣaprasaraṇam |
atra ca tānasya arthaviśeṣopayogābhāvena arthāthatve'pi ekamantra- vṛttitvādeva taittarīyādibādhakatā |
bhāṣyam-- 'ṛcaḥ' ityasti vede, 'ahe budhniya mantraṃ me gopāya |
evaṃjātīyakeṣu mantreṣu, abhiyuktaḥ upadiśanti, 'ṛco'dhīmahe, ṛco'dhyāpāmaḥ, ṛco vartante' iti |
yadi arthavaśenaitaducyate, yatra vṛttavaśena, tatra na prāpnoti, 'agniḥ pūrvairṛṣibhiḥ' iti |
yato nārthe- vaśeneti vṛttādidoṣavaśādapyanyathyam, kiṃ tārha ? anuvāda eṣa pradarśanārtheḥ |
tasmāt yatra pāda- kṛtā vyavasthā, sā ṛgiti |
śabdārthasya vṛddhavyavahāragamyatvāt kṛte'pi lakṣaṇe tanmūlamabhiyuktopadeśameva darśayati |
kriyāpāda- pādānāt, 'agniḥ pūrvaibhiḥ' ityaparyavasite'rthe vṛttavaśena pādavyavasthā |
nanu ca 'agnimīḻe' ityapi samastāyā ṛcaḥ evārthavattvāt naiva pratipādapamarthaḥ paryava- syatīti, na vācyam |
kathaṃ na vācyam 'agnimīḻe purohitam' iti tāvat pratyakṣaṃ sāmānyato dṛśyate |
ṛcaḥ sarvasyāḥ viśiṣṭārthapratipādakatve'pi pratipādam avāntarārthabhedasaṃbhavāt arthavaśena ityuktam |
tadapi na lakṣaṇaśarīrapraviṣṭam, pādavyavasthāmānasyaiva lakṣaṇasaṃbhavāt iti draṣṭavyam |
anena pādavyavasthārūpalakṣaṇe 'mantratve sati' iti viśeṣaṇaṃ sūcitam |
vi-- (ṛksāmayajurlakṣaṇapādādhikaraṇatrayam atraiva- vyākhyātamiti jñeyam ) 'naktaṃmavyajam' lakṣaṇa sāṃkaryāditi śaṅkate |
sāmāni gītitūpā mantrāḥ yajūṃṣi ityukte na kāpi saṃkaraḥ |
bhāṭṭa- mantravādau vyāpakadharmaṃ nirūpite tatprasaṅgā- deva tadantaradharmaḥ 'ṛcaḥ sāmāni yajūṃṣi' iti vedaprayuktaṛgādipadārthaparijñānārthe nirūpyate |
vedāvyabhicārāt ṛgādīnām ṛgādyuktimātreṇa ṛgādirūpavedavyavapattīsiddheḥ tatlakṣaṇārthatve vedokti- ranarthikā |
tasmāt ṛgvahulo vedaḥ ṛgvedaḥ ityevamādi- madhyamapadalopasamāsatvenaiva ṛgvedaśabduktirvyākhyeyā |
bhā.3|1|12, ṛgvedai kṛtsne'pi na prathamā nāma kā cit ṛgasti, tathā uttare iti |
ṛgvedasāmavedābhyāṃ yatkiñcit kāmyaṃ naimittikaṃ vā coyate, tatsarvam uccaiḥ kartavyam |
vā. 3|3|9 pṛ. 812, ṛgvedadāv 'tathaivavedayo dehāḥ proktā ye'pi pṛthak pṛthak |
'yo vai vedeṣu tiṣṭhan vedāntaro yamayati, yo vedān vetti, yaṃ vedā na viduḥ; yasya vedāḥ śarīram, eṣa ta ātmā'ntaryāmya- mṛtaḥḥ' ityupaniṣanprāmāṇyāt |
vi. 4|2|8. 'ṛjīṣamapsu prāsyanti' iti aharṣaṇe sarveṣām ahrṇāṃ yajīṣam, aviśeṣāt tat sarve prāsyate |
ṛjumārgeṇa siddhayato'rthasya cakreṇa sādhanā- 'yoga iti nyāyaḥ |
'jāya- māno vai brāhmaṇastribhirṛṇavā jāyate brahmacaryarbhiṇyo, yajñena devebhyaḥ, prajayā pitṛbhyaḥ |
eṣa vā anyo yaḥ putrī yajvā brahmacārīvāsī' iti śruteḥ |
' yat paśūn dadyāt' iti tu somacamasa- |
sa priyāya sagotrāya brahmaṇe deyaḥ' iti śrutam |
yat tasyā adhi vaṣaṭ karoti iti|
anyenāpi prayujyamānāyā upari hotā vaṣaṭ kariṣyati|
vā-- jyotiṣṭome ṛtugraheṣvayāsu yajamānastamānāṃ yājyāprayogārthaṃ varaṇamāmnātam|
tasyāśca pakṣadvayaṃ vihitam, hote pratyarpaṇaṃ svayaṃ voccāraṇam|
tatra yadā svayaṃ yajati, tadā kiṃ vaṣaṭkāraḥ tannimittaśca bhakṣo'panīyate, neti saṃdehaḥ, nāpanayo vacanātvāt|
yājyāmātrasya hi apanayaṃ śrūyate, na vaṣaṭkāramātrasya|
tasmādyājyā apanaye satyapi hotṛvaraṇaṃ nāpanīyate, tathā bhakṣo'pīti|
nanu ca yadā svayaṃ yajate, tadā naivāpanayo bhavati 'yajamānasya yājyā' iti vacanāt|
ata evaṃ vicārayitavyam, kiṃ yājyā'panaye yajamānāt bhakṣo'panīyate, neti|
' (pūrvapakṣanyāyo'yam) hotrasamākhyāyā hi prāk 'yajamānasya yājyā' iti hi ato vacanāt sarve hotuḥ prāpitam|
tatra vacanena yājyāmātraṃ yajamānasaṃbandhi kṛtam, vaṣaṭkārādayastu hotṛsadṛśatvā eva|
yadi punaḥ yajamānādapanaya iti vyākhyāyeta, tatastasya yājyāmātraṃ prāpitaṃ sat apanayeti iti vaṣaṭkārādiprāptyābhāvāt apanayāśaṅkava na syāt|
tasmāt 'yajamānasya yājyā' ityanena yājyāmātrapanāt vaṣaṭkārasya ca yājyātaḥ atyantayatiraketa aṅgāṅgibhāvābhāvāt yajamānasya prayujyamānāyā upari hotā vaṣaṭkṛtya bhakṣayet|
vaṣaṭkāranimitto hi bhakṣaḥ, na yājyānimitta ityapanayataḥ|
evaṃ hi śrūyate 'yājyāyā adhi vaṣaṭ karoti'|
nanu etaduktaṃ yajamānenāpi prayujyamānāyā adhi hotā vaṣaṭ karoti iti|
anavānatā yaṣṭavyam, vaṣaṭkāreṇa yāgaḥ kriyate na yājyāmātreṇa|
anyaścet vaṣaṭ kuryāt, avānātaṃ yajamānaḥ, na ca yajeta|
yaṣṭavye cāsau codyate, na yājyāmātravacane, 'svayaṃ niṣadha yajati' iti sāṅgasya niṣadhayāge vidhānāt|
vā-- yadi 'yajamānasya yājyā' ityetāvanamātrameva śrūyeta, tataḥ kadācit nāpanīyata bhakṣaḥ|
iha tvevaṃ śrūyate 'svayaṃ niṣadha yajati' iti|
vaṣaṭkāreṇa ca haviḥpradānārthatvādijyate, na kevalayā yājyā|
tathā 'anavānaṃ yajati' iti yājyātaḥ ārabhya yāvadyajateḥ arthaḥ samāpyate tāvat na avānitavyam|
tasmādya yājyā tatra vaṣaṭkārabhakṣavāpi iti antareṇāpi ekatvam adbhāvāt cāpanayo vijñāyate|
bhāṣyam-- atha yaduktam, yathā pravaro nāpanīyate evaṃ bhakṣo'pīti|
aṣṭe cāvasare anuṣṭhīyamāno yajamānasya viguṇaḥ syāt|
ayodhyeta, yacchakyaṃ taccodakena prāpitam, yajña śakyaṃ na tavyāpitamiti|
prakṛtirayam; apūrvaśāstra vidhānaṃ yādṛśamuktam, tādṛśaṃ yadi śakyate kartavyam|
yadi na śakyate, yatra śakyate tatraiva kāryam|
tasmāt pravarasya anapāyo yuktaḥ, na bhakṣasyeti|
tannāma nimittapanāt apanayīte, yat apanituṃ śakyate anyatra ca yojayitum|
na ca pravarasya yājyā'panayavelāyāṃ hotṛpanayanaṃ śakyam, nāpi yajamāne atikrāntakālasya karaṇāt saguṇaṃ varaṇam|
ādau bhāṣyaṃ tāvat ākṣipata-- ) idaṃ tviha vaktavyam|
kimiti tatra pravarāpanayo na śakyate, yadā sarvaivakalpikāni ādita eva anyatarataḥ avadhārya prayoga ārabhyate|
śakyaṃ hi pravaravelāyāmeva niścetum, kiṃ yajamāno yājyā vakṣyati, uta hoteti|
tathā niścite ca anyatarasya varaṇaṃ kariṣyate|

yadi hi etat yājyāvacanam ukkamaviṣṇuyāgavat ('vaiśvadevaṃ caraṃ nirvapet bhrātṛvyavān, taṃ barhiṣadaṃ kṛtvā śāmyā spayena ca vyūhet idamahamamuṃ cāmuṃ ca vyūhāmi iti, yaṃ dviṣyāt taṃ dhyāyet, yadagho'vamṛyet yat spaye āśvidhyet, tad viṣṇave ukramāyāvadyati' iti vākyena ayocamadarnaspayā-śleṣayornimitte vidhīyamānorukramaviṣṇuyāgavat 10|1|1 tṛtīyavarṇake dra0) naimittikaṃ bhavet, tataḥ prāk nimittopajananāt anavaghṛtasadbhāvaṃ sat na kārayedapi pravaraṇam|
nityaṃ caitacchaknoti prathamameva sānusāri varaṇaṃ niyantum|
na kiñcidetadarthe pṛthakvaraṇam, yasya apanayaḥ āśaṅkyeta|
śakyaṃ hi yājyāsahasrārthamapi tantreṇa ekameva varaṇaṃ kartumahati ca|
ataḥ samasajyotiṣṭomaprayogārthaṃ prathamameva vṛte sati kriyate iti, agrahyamāṇaviśeṣatvāt tantram|
yadi yajamānasya adhāvasaraṃ kriyamāṇaṃ viguṇaṃ bhavatīti, tadapi 'guṇalope ca mukhyasya' (10|1|2|164) ityanena viṣṭam|
na ca tatra prakṛtikṛtyoḥ kaścit prayogaviśeṣo bhavati|
yadi yathāśrutameva prakṛtau kartavyamiti, tat sarvaśaktyadhikaraṇena (6|1|2|18-20) viruddhaṃ śakyameva yathākālaṃ saṃpādayitumityuktam|
ata evaṃ sūtraṃ netavyam, kāraṇāntareṇa etatsannidhimaṅgīkṛtya nānyasyāpanaye anyasyāpanayaḥ|
tena yajamāno'pi yadi vakṣyati yadi ca preṣyati, tathāpi itarathai bhavitavyameva pravaraṇeṇa|
etāvatā tu vaiṣamyam, yadasau na vaṣaṭkāra-bhakṣavat etadyājyānusāraṃ pratipadyate iti|
vaṣaṭkārasya yājyāto bhinnatvāpanīyate' iti prāpte, brūmaḥ|
avānyāda yajamāno'to vaṣaṭ kuryāt sa netaraḥ (hotā)|
soma-- ṛtvijāṃ madhye sāṅge ukte, anantaraṃ svāminā bhakṣacintā iti peṭikābhedaḥ|
tasmāt yathā ekāprāsaktapuruṣājñānamātreṇa anuṣṭhānaśāstrasya caritārthyam, evamapi yājyā'panayamātreṇa 'yajamānasya yājyā' iti śāstrasya caritārthyāt na bhakṣapanayaḥ|
nanu yadā yajamāno yājyāmāha tadā'yaṃ vicāraḥ|
yajamānasya ca yājyāprayogatvaṃ na 'gajamānasya yājyā' ityetadvacanalabhyam, 'tadvacanaprāptyājñā-saṃbandhasya 'so'bhipreyati hotaretayaja' ityanena pratyarpitatvāt|
tasmāt 'svayaṃ vā niṣadha yajati' iti vākyasya yājyāmātraprayārthakalpanāmeva pūrvapakṣopapāditam, na tu 'yajamānasya yājyā' iti vākyasya tatpratipādanam, iti caitadevam|

'svayaṃ vā niṣadha yajati' iti vākyamanyaprāptaṃ yājyā'saṃrvaṃ na svaṃ prāpayati, kiṃtu 'yajamānasya yājyā' ityanena prāptaḥ eva yajamānasya yājyā'saṃbandhaḥ 'so'bhipreyati hotaretayaja' ityanena apoditaḥ 'svayaṃ vā niṣadha yajati' ityanena punaḥ pade pratiprasūte|
pratiprasavaśca prāthamika-prāptyanusārī iti prathamaṃ yājyā'saṃbandhaprāptyasa 'yajamānasya yājyā' iti vākyasya yājyāmātrapanārthatva-pratipādanasya pūrvapakṣopayogasaṃbhavāt|
yājyā'panayena yājyā'rthacaraṇalakṣaṇaḥ pravaro nāpanīta: tadvat makṣo'pi iti|

ṛtuyājavyāvaraṇasya tantreṇa sakala- yājyopakāratvāt ekasyāṃ yājyāyāṃ hoturupanītāyāṃ tadarthaṃ yajamānasya varaṇasyāvaśyabhāve'pi yājyā'ntarārthaṃ hoturapi varaṇasya avaśyakartavyatvāt na tasya hoturapanayaḥ iti pravaravaiṣamyaṃ siddhānte bodhyam |
' (ataḥ yājyā saha vaṣaṭkṛtiḥ apaiti, tathā adane somabhakṣaṇaṃ hotṛḥ sakāśāt apaiti) |
bhāṭṭa— jyotiṣṭome ṛtuyājasya hotṛpravacanānmātāsu anyā yājyā hoturapanīya yajamānasya vikalpena vidhīyate 'yajamānasya yājyā, so'mipreṣyati hotaretadyajeti, svayaṃ vā niṣadya yajati' iti |
sa eva kartā, uta hotā vā iti cintā- yām, ṣaṣṭhīśrutyā yajamānasya yājyāmātraṃ śrutaṃ na vaṣaṭ- kāraḥ, tasya 'yājyāyā adhi vaṣaṭ karoti' iti vacanena yājyāto medāt |
ataśca vaṣaṭkāre samākhyānimitto hotaiva iti tannimitto bhakṣasyāsyeva |
yattu 'svayaṃ vā' iti vacanam, tat na tāvat yāgakartṛtvavidhāyakam, tasya pradhānavākyādeva siddheḥ |

ataḥ ādyavākyena yajamānasya yājyāyāṃ vihitāyāṃ dvitīyena preṣakatvavidhānāt praiṣārthakartṛttvānupapattareva yājyā- 'rthavikalpaprāpteḥ, yāgakartṛtvasya ca yājyāprayogoktamātre- ṇāpyupapatteḥ tṛtīyamevada: |
'niścaya' ityapi yājyāyāṃ niṣaṇṇatvasya sāmānyavidhitaḥ eva prāptatvādanuvādaḥ |
iti prāpte, ākhyātaśravaṇāt vāśabdānupapatteśca tṛtīyameva vidhāyakam, ādyaṃ tu arthavādaḥ |

ataśca yājyā''ntena vaṣaṭkāreṇaiva mukhyayāgakartṛtvāt vaṣaṭkāro'pi tasyaiva, yājyāvaṣaṭkārayoḥ samānakartṛttvasya anavānasya ca bādhāpekṣayā vaṣaṭkāraṃ hotṛkartṛkatvamātrasyaiva ekasya samākhyāpramāṇakasya bādhītitvāt |
saṃkarṣa. 2|3|13. ṛtuyājyāyāḥ prātaḥsavane eva nottarayoḥ savanayoḥ |
ṛtugrahe 'hotā yasmindraṃ hotāt' ityādīn 'hotaryanaṃ' ityantān praiṣānāmnāya 'praiṣeṇa yajanti' ityāmnātam |

tatrāpi yathāsamāmnātasya mantratvena pradānākhyāyoryejāmahabhāgayoḥ ṛtuyāgantyabhāgayoreva yojanayā prayoge prāpte, hotā yakṣdautaryajeyajñayorana- nvitatvena tāvanmūlya tasyāne tayoryogena prayogaḥ |
saṃkarṣa. 2|4|125. ṛtuyājavyāvaraṇasya aṣṭārthasya anuṣṭhānaṃ dvādaśāho satre |
bhā. 10|2|16|2. ṛtuyājavyāvaraṇahiraṇyadānayoḥ aṣṭārthayoḥ satre na bādhaḥ |
tatra saṃśayaḥ kiṃ dharmamātraṃ kāryam, neti |
kiṃ prāptam ? svayaṃ- kartṛkatvāt satrasya varaṇaṃ dānaṃ ca nivartate ityuktam (10| 2|10) na cānyat vacanamasti kartavyamiti |
yadi varaṇaṃ dānaṃ vā na bhavati ānatartham, tatra svaryakartake'pi na virodhamupaiti |
ṛtuyājyā''vathavaiḥ 'indraṃ hotāt sarjadeva ā pṛthivyāḥ' ityādibhiḥ yat
' ṛtuyājyā ca itirvairaṇaṃ ca te dve |
bhāṭṭa— satre varaṇabharayordṛṣṭārthatvāt lope abhihite yat prakṛtāvadṛṣṭārtham ṛtuyājyāvaraṇam ātreyāya dānaṃ ca, tat satre kāryameveti prayudāharaṇamātram |

tadapi ca 'vaiśvāmitro hotā' ityādiviśeṣavihitāriktaṛtvikṣu, ātreyatvavidhi- kalpanāyā tadāntyathairuktavidhiklpānirapekṣadānanaiva nirākāṅkṣayāmānau vidhikalpatasāpekṣadānasya janakatvena anvayāyogāt |
na ca pakṣaprāptātreyatvavijñānārthameva tadvidhupapatternātreyavidhivikalpaṃ mamāpīti vācyam |
'hiraṇyamantardhāya' juhoti ityādi upayuktahiraṇyaprati- patyarthatvenāpi dānasya dṛṣṭārthopapattau tādṛśaṛtvigā- natyarthatve eva pramāṇābhāvāt |
ata eva nātrātreyīnyāyena (3|2|8) devaśasasaṃpannaṛtvigātreyasya grahaṇam, ātreyasya apūrvasādhanatā''vacchedāttvena aklṛpteḥ tanyāyābhāvāt |
' (manuḥ 1|130 medhāpātaḥ :) 'yathartuṣṭuliṅgāni nānā- rūpāṇi dṛśyante tānitānyeva, tathā bhāvā yugādiṣu |
eva ṛtavaḥ taireva liṅgairviśiṣṭā āvartante tathā sṛṣṭāvapi |
) vā. 1|2|1|10 pṛ. 126. ṛtvik iti saṃjñāyāḥ yadyapi pravṛttinimittam ṛtau yajanam, tathāpi raumyasyādhvarasya satadaśa ṛtvijaḥ iti camasādhvaryuṇāṃ na ṛtviktvam |
abhihotre 'abhihotrasya yajñakratorekaḥ eva ṛtvik' iti niyamavidhiḥ |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ agnyādhanāne vihyamantrāḥ 'mamāme varco vihveṣvastu vayaṃ tvendhānāstanuvaṃ puṣema |
evaṃ karaṇeṣu mantreṣu uktaṃ phalam ṛtvik svasyaiva āśāsīta na svāminaḥ |
kutaḥ ? arthavatvāt 'mamāme varcaḥ' iti mantra- gatamamaśabdasya adhvaryuṇā svaphalaśāsane eva saphalatvāt |
tasmāt karaṇamantroktaṃ phalaṃ karaṇamantrapāṭhakasya ṛtvijaḥ eva iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
' mama varcaḥ astu ' ityapi yajamānasya varcaḥ |
' yāṃ vai kāṃ ca ṛtvija āśiyāmāsyate yajamānasyaiva sā ' iti arthavādaḥ phalasya yajamānārthatāṃ darśayati |
ityasmāt liṅgadarśanāt ṛtvik yajamānasyaiva phala- māśaṃsita na svasya iti siddham |
8|1|11|18, ṛtvijaḥ ekasmin prayoge prayuktāḥ prayogāntare te eva grāhyāḥ anye vā icchayā |
bhāṣyam - tatra taiḥ parikīrteḥ kartṛṣu aniyamena kartṛparimāṇaṃ syāt |
na kartṛ-parimāṇe viśeṣaḥ kaścidāmnāyate, arthena tatparimāṇaṃ yāvaddvirau itikartavyatā nirvartate, tāvato brūte |
vā - ekasya dvayorvā upādāne parikrayaḥ śakyaḥ kartu-mityaniyamaḥ |
athavā phalasamanakartṛkatve sāmānyādhi-karaṇyamidameva samastasya prayogasya prāpte, yantrā-meva atrādhiyā parikrayavidhiśakyaḥ, tadeva bādhi-tavyam |
sa caikena kartrā yatkiñcitkurvatā utpannaḥ iti nānekaṃ bādhitavyamiti |
bhāṣyam - yāvanti kartṛnāmadheyāni karmāṇi śrūyante, tāvanto varīyatavyā midyante |
tāni nāmadheyaśravaṇāt ' tān puroḍāśadhurvyaṃ bhajati ' , ' pratiprasthātā manthinaṃ juhoti ', ' neṣṭā patnīmayudānayati ', ' ubhetā camasā-nunnayati ' iti |

tathā ' prastotā prastoti ', ' udgāto-drāyati ', ' pratihartā pratiharati ', ' subrahmaṇyaḥ subrahma-ṇyāmāha ', ' hotā prātaranuvākamanubrūte ', ' maitrāvaruṇaḥ preṣyati cānu cā''ha ', ' acchāvāko yajati ', ' grāva-stut āvastotrīyāmāha ' |
tena te avaśyametāni yathāśrutāni kartuṃ varīyatavyāḥ |
yo'pi vākyena nopadiṣṭaḥ, sa samākhyāyā gamyate |
cotpattisaṃyogāt ' iti caiṣa nyāyo yathā karmabhedaṃ bodhayituṃ samarthaḥ, tathā kartṛbhedampi yāvatsamākhyaṃ kartāra upādātavyāḥ |
bhāṣyam - evaṃ cet pratijñāyate, etāvato brūṇīte iti |
yoṣaḥ tatkarma kariṣyatīti saṃkalpyate, sasa tatcchabdābhidheyo bhavati |
na ca lokādavagatā iti upādivat kāryatvāt pari-cchidyante |
tataśca pātrākādivat tattadautrādi karma kurvan hautrādibhirabhidhāsyate ityameva |
utpādyamāneṣu puruṣeṣu nāmadheyāni bhidyante ' brahmāṇaṃ vṛṇīte ', ' hotāraṃ vṛṇīte ', ' udgātāraṃ vṛṇīte ', ' adhvaryuṃ vṛṇīte ' ityevādi |
na vede tāvanto varīyatavyā iti brūyāt, anarthakameva syāt |
tasmāt ṣoḍaśa kartāro varīyatavyāḥ, tāvatkartṛkaḥ somaḥ syāt |
vā - yadi hi karmaviniyogavelāyāmetaduttarakālaṃ vā etāḥ samākhyāḥ śrūyeran, evaṃ sati na bhidyurapi |
na ca tadānīṃ nimittāntaraṃ dṛśyate, yatkṛtaḥ samākhyābhedo bhavet |
varaṇānyapi caitāni ' ekastvaṃ punaḥśrutiḥ ' ityevam, ' guṇaśrutpasaṃyoge ' ityevaṃ yāvacchruti bhidyante |
tadedāca upādeyānām ṛtvijamāpi tatparimāṇa eva bhedaḥ |
samākhyānāmapi ca prāgatupalabdherakālaṃ ca siddhavat vyavahārāt varaṇanimittaiva gamyate |
utpattivākyaśeṣavattvādyathāvikalpasaṃbhavaśca na śakyaṃ tenaiva varaṇena triyamāṇāntaraṃ saṃtrayam |
sarvāṇi ca tāni aindra-vāyavādigrahaṇavat aparyāyavidhāyinā prayogavacane gṛhyante |
yasu bhāṣyakāreṇa uktam, tasmādeṣāṃ varaṇe saṃkīrtanaṃ na vidhiḥ ityādi, tadavihitavaraṇamaprāpyatvāt ayuktam |
na caitāvato vākyāṃśaiḥ kalpitavākyatvasya suvataropāya-pracalyamasaṃkhyāmātraprayayanaṃ phalaṃ bhavitumarhati |
tena varaṇavidhineva anuśiṣṭādīni pratyayaśiṣya saṃkhyā setyetītyeva samarthayitavyam |
soma - sūtrārthastu -- tatra kartṛttvasadbhāve sati yāvadeṃdriya prayogakārya nirvartyante, tatra tāvantaḥ iti kāryataḥ kartṛṇāṃ parimāṇaṃ syāt, na tu etāvantaḥ iti niyamaḥ, viśeṣaṇamatvāt iti |
aviśodhā, dasti vākyārthe tāvanta eva hi |
bhāṭṭa - te kiyantaḥ ityapekṣāyāṃ tattatkarmaṇi adhvaryudisaṃjñāpuraskāreṇa tattatkarmavidhānāt yāvantāṃ yatra vidhānaṃ tāvantaḥ eva tatra jñeyāḥ |
ata āgnīdhre eke evādhvaryuḥ, darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ catvāraḥ, cāturmāsyeṣu pañca, some ṣaḍviṃśatiḥ |
na ca parikrayapakṣāde-kopādānādavasthe tasyaiva pañcakatvādidattatkarma-karaṇanimittāḥ tāvataḥ saṃjñā bhaviṣyantīti vācyam |
saṃjñānāṃ karmakaraṇatva pūrvameva ' adhvaryuṃ vṛṇīte ' ityādinā prayuktatvena karmakaraṇanimittatvābhāvāt |

apitu tatta-dvaraṇanimittatvaṃ tattadvaraṇajanyatattadānimittakatvaṃ vā uktavidhānatijanyādhvaryusāvayaviśeṣanimittakatvaṃ vā, kṛte'pi varaṇe ' ahamadhvaryuḥ syām ' ityadhvaryusāvābhāve adhvaryu-śabdāprayogāt |
vastutastu adhvaryusāvāpi niścayarūpasya kṣaṇikatvāt tajjanyābhimānaviśeṣa eva nimittam, tasya ca satre satva evātratvena varaṇabhāve'pi icchātaḥ eva sattvādyadhvaryusāvāpattiḥ |
prakṛtau'pi ' hotā abrūtaḥ sāmidhenīranavāha ' iti varaṇān pūrvaṃ hotṛśabdaprayogopa-pattiḥ |

na ca evamapi ekasyaiva tattadabhimānopapatteḥ kartṛbhede pramāṇābhāvaḥ, ' adhvaryuṃ vṛṇīte ' ' brahmāṇaṃ vṛṇīte ' iti tattadvidhivihitavaraṇānāmabhyāsena bhinnānāṃ saṃskārya-bhedaṃ vinā anupapatteḥ |
apravṛttasya puruṣasya pravartana-phalakamabhyarthanaṃ hi varaṇam, na ca tadekasmin puruṣe anekaṃ saṃbhavati |
bhinnānāṃ ca saṃskāryāṇāṃ tattatkriyāsu bhinnāstveva viniyogāt vikalpaśaṅkā |
evaṃ ca ṛtvijaḥ vṛṇīte ' ityayamapi na varaṇavidhiḥ |
tathāle ' ṛtvijaḥ ' iti bahulānuvādānupapatteḥ, api tu ṛtvijaḥ satkārakavaraṇamātrānuvādaḥ ṛtvijaḥ mmāṇāṃ taduttaravrāpyathaḥ, tattaddharmavidhānārthaśca |
ato yāvanti laukikāni mantravanti vā varaṇāni, tāvantaḥ
nyāmohitaśca yajamānaḥ śraddhānatayā tathaiva pratipadya tebhyaḥ bhṛtinirdeśaviśeṣeṇa varaṇenaiva upādeyāḥ iti niyamaḥ |
bhā. 12|1|15| 32. ṛtvijaḥ ye ṛtau yajanti, ye cādhvaryavādikaṃ kurvanti |
ke ca te ? ye tatsamarthāḥ, sāmarthyarahitānā- madhikārāt |
vā. 3|7|123 pṛ. 1097. ṛtvijo ghṛṇīte' iti upattavākyam |
dup. 11|3|12. ṛtvijaḥ dyene sarve eva lohitoṣṇīṣā lohitavasanāḥ pravaranti, na kevalam udgātāraḥ eva |
vājapeye ca hiraṇya- mālinaḥ, na kevalamadhvaryavaḥ eva |
sadasyaśca camasā- dhvaryavo daśa ca, na te ṛtvijaḥ |
bhāṣyam-- etaduktam 'sadasya ṛtvijaḥ' iti, te ca brahmaṇyaḥ |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kimeṣāṃ sadasyaḥ saptadaśaḥ, uta gṛhapatiḥ |
kutaḥ ? karmasāmānyāt, yajñe kartāraḥ ṛtvijo bhavanti |
yaduktam 'taṃ samāmananti tasya camasāmananti varaṇaṃ ca tasmāt sadasyaḥ saptadaśaḥ' iti |
brahmaṇa- meva te samāmananti, varaṇamapi camasaśca brahmaṇa eva |
vā -- dīkṣādakṣiṇavākyayoḥ ṣoḍaśānāṃ saṃkīrtanāt tāvataḥ avadhāritāḥ |
tatra camasā- dhvaryūṇāṃ tulyakalpatvāt anyatarāvāraṇapramāṇaṃ nāsti, iti sadasyasyajamānayoranyataraḥ saṃdihyate |
tatra karmakaratva- sāmānyāt sadasyagrahaṇaprasaktau abhidhīyate 'svāmisapta- daśāḥ syuḥ' iti |
kathaṃ punaḥ pūrvatra ṛtuyajanakarma- nimittatvam anabhyupagamya adhunā tanmāmānyāt svāminaḥ ṛtviktvaṃ abhidhīyate ? 'sadasyaṃ vṛṇīte' iti ca utpattisaṃyogāt adhvaryādivat bhedaḥ |
na ca brahmaṇo avayavaprasiddhiḥ saṃbhavati, samudāyaprasiddhyā bādhitatvāt |
na ca brahmaṇaḥ punarvaraṇaṃ vidhātumamuvadituṃ vā śakyam, adhvaryādiṣvapi evameva prasaṅgāt |
sarveṣu ca upahavā- diṣu brahmamantryatirekeṇa asya mantraḥ paṭhyate |
na ca camasaśabde'pi brahmaṇaḥ saṃkīrtanaṃ sadasyaśabdena upayujyate |
sāmarthyāsthitena ca upadraṣṭā sadasyena avaśyaṃ bhavitavyam |
so''pi ca pratyavekṣaṇāt ṛtau yajati iti śakyate vaktum |
na ca brahmā sadasyaśabdenocyate, ṛtuyajane sati varaṇena ṛtviktvaniyamāt |
dakṣiṇābhāgasaṃbandhadikṣā- vākyayośca asaṃkīrtanāt 'ṛtvik' iti nocyate (sadasyaḥ) yathā satyapi varaṇe ṛtuyajanasaṃbandhe ca kāraṇadvayāsaṃbhavāt camasādhvaryavaḥ ṛtvijo noktāḥ |
svāminastu yadyapi ca varaṇaṃ nāsti, tathāpi anyat sarvamasti iti yuktam ṛtviktvam |
yat sadasyo''pi pratyavekṣaṇāt yajatīti, vacanasāmarthyādeva agnī mriyate, na tu kaścit padārthaḥ tadhīnaḥ, yenāsya vyapadeśaḥ syāt |
nāma kaścit padārthaḥ, yena asya ṛtviviśeṣaḥ kena cit pramāṇena niyamyeta |
yatta bhāṣyakāreṇa kiñcit sadasyanirākaraṇaparam uktam, tat ṛtviktvanirākaraṇa- parasya atirasavacanam ityupekṣaṇīyam |
soma-- samadaśanirdhāraṇe ke cideva ṛtvijo na sarve ityasyārthasyāsthiratvāt tasminkaraṇārthe saptadaśasya nirdhāraṇāta hetuhetumadbhāvaḥ saṃgatiḥ |
na hi yāgeopayukta- padārthakaraṇamātram ṛtayajanaṃ lomavikrayādiṣu ati- prasaṅgāt, kintu kṛtvakaraṇaṃ kṛtākṛtapratyavekṣaṇaṃ ca ṛtvaṅgave'pi kṛtvanupayuktatvāt na yajanam |
sadasye, kurute ṛtvijāso svāmini tat tvataḥ |

iti prāpte, sadasyakartavyapadārthā- śravaṇāt, varaṇasya sakṛnyāyena viniyogabhaṅgaṃ kalpayitvā ahaṣṭārthatvāvagateḥ, sadasyasya pākṣikatvena saptadaśaśruteḥ pākṣikatvāt, satre dīkṣā''samānāṃ sadasyaḥ svāmyeva saptadaśaḥ |
karmakaratve''pi vā na patnī samadaśatva- janakībhūtā, apekṣābuddhau liṅgavairuppyāṅgīkāre pramāṇā- bhāvāt |
(loke tu mahāvaraṇakāle yajamāna eva tān vṛṇīte |
) 3|7|10|25. ṛtvigbhyo dakṣiṇā dadāti ' atra uddeśyagataṃ bahutvamavivakṣitam ityeke |
yasya yāvān bhāgaḥ ābhajati svayameva yajamānena vibhajya tasya tāvān kalpayitavyaḥ na tu parigrahā |
bhāṣyam-- kimeṣa evotsargaḥ, sarve samākhyātaṃ samākhyātapuruṣaiḥ kartavyamiti |
yayopadeśaḥ, 'tasmānmaitrā- varuṇaḥ preṣyati cānu cā''sa ha' iti |
vā -- viśeṣasamākhyā''pi viśeṣaśrutideva śīghra- tarapravṛtterbādhikā bhavati |
bhāṣyam-- 'yatra hotuḥ prātaranuvākamanuvat upaśṛṇuyāt' iti hautre prātaranuvāke samākhyāyā prāptaṃ hotāraṃ darśayati |
tathedamapi liṅgaṃ bhavati, 'udgītha udgātām, ṛcaḥ punarukthaśaṃsinām, pratigaro''- dhvaryūṇām' iti samākhyākṛtaṃ bhedaṃ darśayati |
etadvā adhvaryoḥ svam, yadāśrāvati' iti samākhyākṛtaṃ niyamaṃ darśayati |
soma-- prābhākarairidaṃ sūtraṃ sāmānyasamākhyāyāḥ vacanaviśeṣasamākhyābhyāṃ bādhasya vyutpādanāyaivādhikāraṇā- ntaratvena vyākhyātam |
samākhyāyā vacanā- pekṣayā, sāmānyasya viśeṣapekṣayā ca durbalatvasya anyatra siddhatvena pūrvapakṣānunmeṣāt |
sūtrātthastu - tasya 'tatsaṃtogāt karmaṇāṃ vyavasthā syāt saṃyogasyaivārthavatvāt' iti pūrvasūtre prastutasya adhvaryādipuruṣasaṃyogasya adhvaryādisāmākhyānasya iti yāvat |
bhāṭṭa -- ayaṃ ca utsargaḥ vacanāt 'yajamānasya yājyā' ityādidāt, viśeṣaśāstrasya ca potrīyaṃ neṣṭrīyaṃ yājamānam ityādidā apoyate |
na caivaṃ tādṛśaviṣaye sāmānyaśāstrasyāyāḥ nirvadhiyatvāpatyā ānarthakyapratihata- nyāyena vikalpāpattiḥ, yathādyakṣiprayoge potrādīnāmaśaktau saviṣayalopapatteḥ |

vastutastu hautrādisamākhyāyāḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyasyatvena ṛgvedavihitakarmatvamupa- lakṣaṇīkṛtyaiva tattvadārtheṣu hautrādividhāyakatvam, niruktasaṃbandhena agnīṣomīyaprākālvṛttivamupalakṣaṇīkṛtya upāṃśutvavidhāyakatvam 'yatkiñcit prācīnam' ityasya |
ataśca tadeva keṣu cit padārtheṣu tadabhāve'pi na kṣatiḥ |
ata eva dakṣiṇāhitaphāmyādau yajamānasyaiva kartṛtve'pi samākhyāyāḥ na cidanupapattiḥ |
ṛtvijāṃ varaṇam ṛtupeyeṣu ṛtupeyaiva, yeṣāṃ śālāyāṃ tathā āmnātam|
sane tu sarveṣāṃ yajamānatvāt krayāsaṃbhavācca varaṇam|
ṛtvijāṃ varaṇaṃ jyotiṣṭome ānamanārthe dṛṣṭa- prayojanam|
ṛtvijāṃ varaṇaṃ dakṣai paṣo vaṣaṭkartṛṇāmeva ṛtvijām, na sarveṣām|
ṛtvijāṃ varaṇaṃ sarveṣāṃ laukikyā eva vācā, na tu hotṛmaitrāvaruṇayaurvaidikyā|

kāryāṇi ca kāni cidevam, 'purovaryurvibhajati' 'pratiprasthātā magninaṃ juhoti' 'neṣṭā patnīmudānayati' 'unnetā camaśānunnayati' 'prastotā prastoti' 'udgātā- drāyati' 'pratihartā pratiharati' 'subrahmaṇyaḥ subrahmaṇyā- māhayati' 'hotā prātaranuvākamanubrūte' 'maitrāvaruṇaḥ preṣyati' 'acchāvāko grāvastutī' 'grāvastutī grāvastutī- yānvāha' ityādi|
ṛtvijāṃ samāsa āmnātaḥ kuṇḍapāyināmayane 'yo hotā so'dhvaryuḥ' ityādi|
yo maitrāvaruṇaḥ sa brahmā, sa pratihartā|
yaḥ prastotā sa brāhmaṇācchaṃsī sa grāvastut|
ṛtvijāṃ sāmradasyaṃ yajamānena, na tu sadasyena|
yajamāno hi tyāgarūpāṃ kriyāṃ karoti iti ṛtviktvaṃ tasyopapadyate|
ṛtvigācāryo nāticaritavyau iti tu puruṣadharmaḥ, na karmadharmaḥ|
yadi tāvat śāstrīyeṇa parikrayeṇa labhyate, tato'syeva yaja- mānasya kartṛtvam|
atha na labhyate, tato laukikaḥ upāyaḥ iti|
vā. 3|8|12. ṛtvigāmi karmopayogi karaṇamantrakādyaṃ phalaṃ saṃtāpābhāvādvā|
vi. 10|6|15. brahmavādikaraṇayogyeva eva ṛtau yajatsu ṛtviktvaṃ na sarveṣu ṛtau eva yajatsu bhavati na tu bhavatyeva|
saṃbhavati ca prakṛtānāmapi āgneyyāṃ vāhuniyamanayena stotradvārā jyotiṣṭomāpūrva- saṃrvacasāsaṃbhave'pi kāryāntaradvārā saḥ|
āgneyyāṃ stotrādau viniyoge'pi pārthakyena jyotiṣṭomaprakaraṇe pāṭhādeva tāvat apūrvasaṃbandhāvagamaḥ|
ayameva ca brahmaudanaprāśane (caturo brāhmaṇān bhojayet ityādī) ṛtviktvaniyamakanyāyaḥ|
bhā. 3|8|18. ṛtvigdānaṃ dharmamātraṃ syād dadāti- sāmarthyāt|
tadānaṃ kiṃ dharmamātraṃ parikrayārthe veti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha|
ṛtvigdānam ṛtvigbhyo dakṣiṇāyāḥ dānaṃ dharmamātraṃ kevalaṃ dharmārtham adṛṣṭārthaṃ syāt|
maitrāvatīyayāṃ sahasraṃ dakṣiṇā śrutā alpe karmaṇi mahatī|
ṛtapeye ca kevalaṃ soma- camasaḥ śrutaḥ mahati karmaṇi alpā|
ka cit daṇḍaḥ, upanahau, śuṣkā itiḥ (carmapātram) iti dakṣiṇā
tasmāt dharmamātraṃ dānam iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ|
sā dakṣiṇā na dharmamātraṃ kintu parikrayārthe syāt|
karmasaṃyogāt karmaṇā saha kartṛtvena saṃyogamabhipretya dakṣiṇā śrutā|
ṛtau yajanti iti yāgakartṛtvena ṛtvikśabdasya pravṛttiḥ|
lokavat yathā loke kāṣṭhādyaharaṇe'pi yadīyate tat asyaikīrtate'pi parikraye ānamanārthameva bhavati|
tasmāt yajñe'pi parikrayārthe dakṣiṇādānam iti siddhāntaḥ|
ka cit karmanyūnādhikyavicāramatvāpi adhikanyūnadakṣiṇādānaṃ daṇḍaḥ, śuṣkā itiḥ, ityādikṣiṇā ca vacanavatvāt bhaviṣyati|
'dakṣiṇāyuktā vahanti ṛtvijaḥ' iti dakṣiṇāyuktāt vacanāt liṅgācca yajñe ṛtvikparikrayārthe dakṣiṇādānaṃ na dharmārtham iti|
ṛtvik darśaudī karmaṇi parikrayāt anyena sāmā- dinā upāyena nānyeta utsargaḥ|
karmaṇaḥ parārthaḥ tvāt, parārthe hi karma kartavyam, tacca nāntareṇa parikrayaṃ paraḥ parārthe karoti|
helantaramāha 'dīkṣitamadīkṣitā dakṣiṇāparikrītā ṛtvijo yājayanti' iti parikrītavacanāt ṛtvijāṃ parikrītavacanāt liṅgāt yajñe dakṣiṇādānaṃ parikrayārtha- miti gamyate|
'yajño vai devatānāṃ na samabhavat, taṃ bhūtvā samābhavayan, yad dhṛtiṃ vanute, yajñasya bhūtyai, dvādaśa rātrīrdikṣito bhūtiṃ vandita' iti|
yajñārthe yat bhikṣitam ṛtvijaḥ parikratum anyaṃ ca yajñārthe sādhayitum, tasminnetad bhūtivacanaṃ bhavati|
'yathā vai dāruhāro naiṣkartṛko niṣkarttanabhṛtaḥ karmayoge vartate, evaṃ vā ete yajñasya ṛtvijaḥ' iti naiṣkartṛkena ṛtvijāṃ saṃstavāt śrutaḥ|
yathā dāruhāraḥ kāṣṭhahārakaḥ niṣkarttanena vṛkṣacchedenādharyeṇa dravyaṃ bhṛtaḥ|
san karmayoge vṛkṣacchedādau vartate, tathā ṛtvijaḥ iti parikrayārthe dānaṃ darśayati|
iti yajñe ṛtvigbhyo dakṣiṇādānaṃ parikrayārtham iti siddhāntaḥ|
evaṃ hi āmnāyate 'ṛtvigbhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dadāti' iti|
aryiṣṭhe'ye dadātīti, tato brahmaṇe, tato'dhvarye cāmubhai ceti ke cideva viśiṣṭāḥ śrūyante|
evaṃ ye śrūyante, te tāva- ṛtvijaḥ|
vā-- prakṛtānāṃ yekecitsadaśa iti prāpte abhi- dhīyate|
tacca dakṣiṇā- dānamakvāgataṃ śradādīnāṃ dṛśyate, na camasādhvaryūṇām|
yadyapi saddhitvikatvam anuṣṭhānaṃ na śakyamupasaṃhartu- miti buddhirbhavati, tathāpi satasadṛśavyapekṣitaviśeṣāya- sthānam, tadevetra vedena siddhavat āśritam|
ataḥ asmākameva paricchedo bhavati, nūnameta ṛtvijaḥ iti|
bhāṣyam- 'ya ṛtvijaste yajamānāḥ' ityevamabhidhāya brahmādīnāṃ dīkṣākramapare ca vākye dīkṣāṃ darśayati |
'adhvaryugṛhapatiṃ dīkṣayitvā brahmāṇaṃ dīkṣayati, tata udgātāram, tato hotāram |
tatastaṃ prati- prasthātā dīkṣayitvā'dhvaryuṃ dīkṣayati, brāhmaṇācchaṃsinaṃ brahmaṇaḥ, prastotāramudgātaḥ, maitrāvaruṇaṃ hotuḥ |
tatastaṃ neṣṭā dīkṣayitvā tṛtīyino dīkṣayati, āgnīdhraṃ brahmaṇaḥ, pratihartāramudgātaḥ, acchāvākaṃ hotuḥ |
tatastamṛjetā dīkṣa- yitvā pādino dīkṣayati, potāraṃ brahmaṇaḥ, subrahmaṇyamudgātaḥ, āvastutaṃ hotuḥ |
vā- 'ya ṛtvijaste yajamānāḥ' iti yajamānaliṅga- śabdo samānaviṣayo niyamya yajamānasaṃskāraṃ dīkṣāṃ brahmā- diṣu kramāthamanuvadan eteṣu tau dvāvapi iti darśayati |
tasmāt brahmādyadhikaraṇayogyebhyaiva ṛtau yajantya ṛtviktvaṃ na sarveṣu, tadviṣayameva ca ṛtujananaṃ śabdasya pravṛtti- nimittam |

yathā dhyāyaśabdaḥ sāmivenīṣu nipātyamānaḥ (pā0 3|1| 129) tāsyeva ityavadhāraṇāt nānyaಾಸu dhīyamānāsvapi dhyāyāśabdavācyatvaṃ bhavati ityavadhāryate, tathaiva ṛtāveva yajasu bhavati, na tu bhavatyeva, ityavadhārayitavyam |
soma- prayogabhedena sarveṣāmṛtviktvāt pūrvoktaḥ sarveṣām ṛtviktvābhāvaḥ asiddhaḥ iti pratyavakṣānāt (ākṣepa-) saṃgatiḥ |

sūtrārthastu - 'ṛtvigbhyo dakṣiṇā dadāti, agnīdhe dadāti, brahmaṇa dadāti' ityevaṃ dakṣiṇābhiḥ sahānnāte 'agnīdhe dadāti, brahmaṇa ṛlije' iti paryavasānāt sāmānādhikaraṇyalakṣaṇo yaḥ ṛtvikśabdarūpabhṛtisaṃyogaḥ, tasmāt agnīdhraprabhṛtīnāmeva ṛtviktvam iti niyamaḥ syāt iti |
' ādyo, na dakṣiṇādāne dīkṣāyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ |
' dīkṣāvākye nirdiṣṭā adhvaryuprabhṛtayaḥ ṛtvijaḥ ṣoḍaśa, na tu camasādhvaryavaḥ iti niyamo draṣṭavyaḥ |
bhāṭṭa-- ke te saptadaśa ityapekṣāyām 'ṛtvigbhyo dakṣiṇā dadāti' ityupakramya agnīdhe dadāti ityā- dinā ṣoḍaśānāmeva kīrtanāt teṣāmeva ṛtviktvam |
ata eva satre yajamānāmeva ṛtviktvāt teṣāmeva yajamānasahitānāṃ dīkṣāśravaṇam |
' ṛtviknyāyena patyupādāne svāmivacanapalī- yajamānaśabdānupapatteḥ tayoḥ kartṛtvaṃ nyāsajavṛtti |
bindu- 6|1|4. ṛtviknyāyasya svarūpam - 'ṛtvijo hi parikrītāḥ karma kurvanti, parantu na teṣāṃ yāgakartṛtvaṃ nāma' |
yajate'sau yajamānaḥ, yajñasaṃyogāt patnītvaṃ pāṇigrāha 'patyuno yajñasaṃyoge' ityanena |
ke. ṛtvikpadasya yogarūḍhyā keṣāṃ cideva etannāma |
vā. 3|1|138. ṛtvikphalaṃ dakṣiṇātmakaṃ vinā'pi taiḥ (saṃskāraiḥ) upalabhyate |
vā. 3|1|14. ṛtviktvasādhanādhikaraṇe 'brahmaṇaṃ vṛṇīte' iti vacanaṃ bhāṣyakṛtā udāhṛtam |
bhā. 3|1|16|13. ṛtvikśabdaḥ yāgīyasarvakarmakareṇa na pravartate, kintu saptadaśaiva |
bhāṣyam- ye ete puruṣā jyotiṣṭome śrūyante, te kiṃ sarve ete ṛtvijaḥ, uta ke cidepāmiti |
ye ca ṛtau yajanti, te ṛtvijaḥ |
na kaścit viśeṣa āśrīyate, ime eva ṛtau yajanti iti ṛtvijaḥ, ime neti |
nanu parisaṃkhyā śrūyate 'saumya- syādhvarasya saptadaśa ṛtvijaḥ' iti |
parisaṃkhyāyāṃ bahavo doṣāḥ santi, iti avyutpavādo'yaṃ bhaviṣyati |
vā- ṛtvikśabdo hi nipātyamāna eva (pā0 3|1|9) upapadātpratyayasambandhitairvartate, ṛtau yajanti iti ṛtvijaḥ |
etasmāt cet kāraṇāt ṛtvijo bhavanti, hanta sarveṣāṃ tat aviśiṣṭamiti tadanusāram ṛtviktvamapi sarveṣāmeva prāptam |
ataḥ catvāraḥ pañca ṣaṭ saptadaśa ityādayaḥ avayavā api etasya mahantaḥ ityevaṃ stotum avyutpavādaḥ |
evaṃ hi śrūyate 'saumyasyādhvarasya saptadaśa saptadaśa ṛtvijaḥ' |
sa eṣa na vidhiḥ bahurāṇāṃ prāptānāṃ, nānuvādaḥ prayojanābhāvāt, na cet parisaṃkhyā'pi pārthakyelpanā prāptabādhaḥ |
svārthahāna- madoṣaḥ prāptatvāt, pāryakalpanā ca (na ityanuvartate) pratyayāt |
(tena) saptadaśabhiḥ ṛtvikśabdasya saṃgrahaḥ punaḥ prakāśyate, adhikaiśca na prakāśyate, tatra vijñāyate etat |
ṛtvikśabdasya puruṣe saṃbandhe punaḥ prakāśyamāne saptadaśabhiḥ abhyadhikāḥ varṇitāḥ iti gamyate |
tatra kiṃ saptadaśabhiḥ saṃbandho vivakṣitaḥ, kiṃ vā adhikānāṃ varjanamiti |
saptadaśasaṃbandhasya aprayojakatvāt adhikānāṃ varjanaṃ vivakṣitamiti gamyate |
tadyathā 'na maiṣa putraḥ ' putrakāryaṃ na pravartate ityarthaḥ |
evaṃ yo'yam arthāt saptadaśamyaḥ adhikānāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ pratīyate, sa kāryaviṣayo na svarūpaviṣayaḥ, iti draṣṭavyam |
varaṇaṃ tu śabdapravṛttinimittatvāt anugrāhyam, iti cet, asmin pakṣe karmayogādeva śabdaprayogasiddheḥ |
itarastu svarūpaprāptiṣedhāt tannimittaṃ kāryamapi duṣpratiṣedham, iti katham ṛtau yajatāṃ teṣām ṛtvikatvaṃ na syāt ityāha |
siddhāntāvādī tu tattvena uttaraṃ vivakṣamāṇaḥ ' evaṃ tarhi dvividho'yam ' ityādi prakramate |
yadi eṣa yaugikaḥ syāt, tato na kutaścinnivartate |
te yeṣāṃ na staḥ, na te satyapi kriyāyoge tacchabdavācyā bhaviṣyanti |
te ca varaṇabharaṇe saptadaśānāmeva yajamānena kriyete |
sthānadvāreṇa ṛtuyajananimittatvaṃ gamyamānaṃ sat parityaktuṃ tridoṣatvāpateḥ |
3|7|16|33 pṛ. 1097. ṛtvik- ata eva ca varaṇameva tannyāyameva vā ṛtvikpadapravṛtti- |
avidyamāna: śabdadoṣa: yasmin prayojane tat aśabdadoṣam |
eka: śabda: vidhāyaka: yeṣāṃ pradhānānāma aṅgānāmapi sarveṣāṃ tāni ekaśandāni, teṣāṃ bhāva: ekaśandhyam |
‘darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ’ ityeka: śabda: upadeśaka: pradhānānāṃ samidādīnāṃ ca prayogasya |
tatki dvitīyā'ntatadanupā- sthāpitasya yajati yajatītyasya pañcadhā'bhyastasya ānarthakya- |
yato 'viṣṇuṃ yajati' mayuktamiti pratyuccāraṇamedhameda eveti vācyam |
tena pañcadhā'bhyastena yajatiśabdena ekameva samidyāga- adṛṣṭārthatvenaiva upapattiḥ |
bhāvanārūpam upāṃśuyājabhāvanārūpaṃ vā karma pratipādyate dhākhyanaiva siddhāntavat saminnāmāvacchinne karmaṇi vihite |
bhavedevaṃ yadi pratyabhijñāna- taditaraiḥ tadanuvādena tanūnapādādidevatāmidhānāt artha- |
mātram anuvādātkāraṇaṃ bhavet, kiṃ tarhi ? anuvādākāṅkṣā- vattvaṃ bhaviṣyati |
nāyoṃ vidhau bhāvanāmaiva dhātvarthānuraṃ karoti vidhātī- tvena samiddhasya nāmadheyatvāt |
yadā tu upapadyārthaṃ lipyate, tadā viśiṣṭavidhi- vihitatanūnapādādidevatābhiḥ durbalamāntravarṇikadevatātva |
gaurabhiyā dhātvarthe parityajya upapadyārthameva vidhātuman- eveti vācyam |
tatra vidhiyogyopapadyārthatā sayāṃ dhātvartha- jñāmāvacchiñyagānuvādena tanūnapādādidevatāvidhānāt |
tāṃ cākāṅkṣāṃ dhātvarthaprabhīpsā ' na nimittaṃ vidhirapavādyate' |
yadi tu vidhiyogyopapadyārthaprāptiṃ bhavati, nāpi māntravarṇikasamiddhadevatātvāt |
na cātra vidhi- na pātayati iti tanūnapāt) ityādimantrāḥ kramapaṭhitāḥ |
tathāhi, vidheyatā pratyekaṃ mithyante eva, tatra tanūnapādādivākye'pi |
dravyatvena vā ? devatātvena vā ? na ca tanūnapādādirūpaṃ māntravarṇikadevatāprāptinimittanāmāvacchinnakarmavidhānameva |
guṇavidhānaṃ tu kutaḥ ? syādevaṃ yadi yajatītyatra |
'viṣṇuṃ yajati' prakṛtakarmapratyāsannatvena ca karmatve sati tathāvidheya- |
tvāt yadi guṇamapi na vidadhyāt, vākyamanarthakameva |
tena māntravarṇikī prāptiṃ upekṣya prakṛte samidyāge |
ato'tra prativākyamabhyasto vidhiḥ guṇānā- vaikalpikadevatāvidhānārthatvameva uttareśāmiti |
taduktam athavā kharvaiva samidādivākyaiḥ upāṃśuyāje eva |
na ca vihitasya vidhānaṃ narthakyam, uttareṣāṃ samidādidevatāprakāśanena artha- |
yatra vā viṣṇvādayo devatāḥ santi, tatroktena |
vartamānapadāpekṣayā vidhamyāsa eva nāstīti vakta- arthavattvaṃ bhaviṣyati |
'varma vā etadyajñasya kriyate, yatprayājānūyājā yajatiśabdeḥ kimakamapūrvaṃ codayati' iti bhāṣyameva neyam, |
saṃjñena yajñamanāya ātmabhyābhibhūtyai' ityarthavāda- ekamapāṃśuyājavākyam apūrvaṃ codayati anugṛhṇātītyarthaḥ |
saṃjñena pañcamakāravidhirnirṇīyate, vidhitulorekaviṣaya- na ca vācyam "tajñitena caturthyā vā mantravarṇana |
yattu 'guṇo vā nāmadheyaṃ vā samidādipadaṃ veṣyate |
'samidho yajati' 'tanūnapātaṃ yajati' 'iḍo yajati' yajeta paśukāmaḥ' ityatra, tatra prakṛtasyaiva jyotiṣṭomasya |
'barhiryajati' 'svāhākāraṃ yajati' iti pañcakṛtvaḥ yajiśabdenānanya paśuphale vidhānenāpi vidhyākhyātābhyāsa- |
sā evaṃ nāmāvaruddhe nāmāntarasya praveśāsaṃbhavāt tatra nāmadheyameva |
yaduktam, tasminneva punaḥśrutena yajatiśabdena vidhī- karmāntaramantareṇa asaṃbhavaḥ |
yamāne aviśeṣāt viśeṣābhāvāt punaḥśravaṇam anarthakaṃ bhedakatve siddhe nāmadheyamiti tadviṣameva vyavasthitam, |
sārthakāya tu pratyabhyāsam adṛṣṭabhedaḥ na tu agrataḥ |
'ekasyaivaṃ punaḥśrutirviśeṣaṇārthakaṃ hi syāt' iti caivaṃ sati yathā abhyāsāt bhedaḥ, tathā 'samidho yajati' |
'ekasyaivaṃ punaḥśrutiḥ' (2121212) ityanena nyāyena bhinatti yathā 'tisra āhutīrjuhoti' 'dvādaśa dvādaśa |
hotā adhvaryuḥ ityādayaḥ samākhyāstu ekasyāpi karmabhedāt tattadbhinnakarmakaraṇāt upapadyeran |
ke. satyam ( ṛtvikṣu śramitā ) saṃkhyā- vivṛddhirgamyate , na tu utpadyamāneṣu |
yā tu anupapattisteṣu gamyate , tatra 'ekasya karmabhedāt' ityeva- mavaklṛpte |
hotrādisamākhyā ca tasyaiva ( yajamānasyaiva ) tattatkarmaṇasya 'ekasya karmabhedāt' ityanena nyāyena bhaviṣyati iti manyate ( pūrvapakṣī ) |
śamitṛśabdasya karmayoganimittatvena 'ekasya karmabhedāt' (3|1|123) iti nyāyāt prakṛteṣu ṛtvikṣu brāhmaṇeṣu upapatteḥ abrāhmaṇasya śamitṛtvaprāptyabhāvaḥ |
atha yat paraṃ kāraṇamuktaṃ pūrvapakṣiṇā 'nemapiṣṭaṃ bhavati' iti dvidevatye peṣaṇaṃ darśayati, 'ardhe piṣṭaṃ bhavati, ardhamapiṣṭaṃ dvidevatyāya' iti devatārthame darśayati iti |
paraṃ parastāt uktaṃ dvitīyaṃ kāraṇaṃ vacanaṃ bhavati, aprāpte peṣaṇe vidhāyakaṃ vacanamidaṃ bhavati |
sati pakṣāntare anekārtha- vidhiḥ pakṣāntarāśrayaṇena parihriyate |
asati punaḥ pakṣā- ntare uccāraṇārthasya prasaṅgaparijihīrṣayā anekārthaṃ vākyam abhyupagantavyaṃ bhavati |
tasmāt na dvidevatye peṣaṇam iti siddhāntaḥ |
ekasminnekasaṃyogāt ( 3|2|139 ) iti puṣpavigrahavicāre praśnandena sāpekṣapuṣpadevatyasya aindrāpauṣṇādeścorgrahaṇaṃ ( neti ) vakṣyati |
su. pṛ. 647. ekasminnekasaṃyogāt ' ityadhikaraṇaṃ ' pūṣādhi- karaṇam ' iti vindau draṣṭavyam |
sūtrārthastu, sarveṣām ekakapālānāṃ vaiśvadaivikaḥ ekakapālaḥ prakṛtirbhavati |
evaṃ sati āgrayaṇe dyāvā- pṛthivyasya ekakapālasya yaḥ sarvahomaḥ yā ca aparyāptiḥ, tayordarśanaṃ vaiśvadaivikasya dharmasyaivānuvādaḥ, nāpūrvo dharmaḥ |
tasmāt āgrayaṇe sarvahomāparvāptidarśanāt vaiśvadaivika eva prakṛtiḥ |
saumike avabhṛthe ca vāruṇasya eka- kapālasya sakṛt dvayadānasya vacanaṃ bhavati |
vacanatvāt pradhānahome sakṛdvayadānam, sviṣṭakṛt ca punaḥ sakṛda- dānam, iti dviḥ sakṛdvayadānaṃ bhavati iti viśeṣaḥ |
tasmāt avabhṛthe sakṛt dvayadānasya ‘ekakapālasya dvirava- yati’ iti vacanāt vaiśvadaivikaikakapālasya prakṛtive'pi na virodhaḥ |
tataśca vaiśvadaivika ekakapāla eva sarveṣām ekakapālānāṃ prakṛtiḥ |

tathāpi vāruṇaprāptāsikeṣu yo viśeṣaḥ : ‘hiraṇmayaḥ śamīmayo vā sucaḥ’ iti tavyāpyarthe vāruṇaprāptāsikasya ekakapālasya dharmāṇāṃ sākamedhīyaka- kapāle atideśaḥ, na sākṣāt vaiśvadaivikaikakapāla- dharmāṇām iti siddhāntaḥ |
‘ekakapālānāṃ vaiśvadaivikaḥ prakṛtiḥ’ ityādi- karaṇanyāyasya ( 7|1|5|23 ) svarūpam ‘anyalabhyaṃ na vidhīyate’ iti |
etacca ‘ādye (sākamedhasya- pañcasaṃkhyeya atideśavidherasti iti pakṣe ) etadadhikaraṇa- nyāyasya anyalabhyasya abhāvāt’ iti bhāṭṭagranthāt ( 7|1|6 ) jñāyate |
varuṇapraghāseṣu ca kāya ekakapālaḥ āmnātaḥ, aindrāgno dvādaśakapālaśca |
atha sākamedheṣu vaiśvakarmaṇaikakapālam aindrāgmekādaśakapālaṃ cāmnāya ‘etadbrāhmaṇa aindrāgnaḥ, etadbrāhmaṇa ekakapālaḥ; yadbrāhmaṇa itaraśca’ iti |
ekakapālaśca aindrāgnaśca tāvevau tadvat syātām, yadvat pañcasaṃkhyeyāṇi |
tathā ca atrāpi savidhivikasya sārthavādakasya sarvasya kaṇṭhātideśaḥ |
ekakartṛkopāyanatve sati vedavākyatvam artha- vādasya parakṛtitvam |
asti ca prakṛtau havirabhimarśanadvayam ‘caturhotrā paurṇamāsīmabhimṛśeta, pañcahotrā amāvāsyāyām’ iti |
veyāṃ haviṣi āsādite ‘pṛthivī hotā’ ityādinā caturhotrasaṃjñakena mantreṇa adhvaryuḥ paurṇamāsyām abhi- mṛśati |
amāvāsyāyāge tu ‘agni- rhotā’ ityādinā pañcahotrasaṃjñakena mantreṇa abhimṛśati |
atha sauryau paurṇamāsyāṃ prayujyate tadā caturhotrā abhimṛśyaḥ |
yadā ca amāvāsyāyāṃ sauryaḥ prayujyate tadā pañcahotrā abhimṛśyaḥ; kiṃvā ubhayatra mantravikalpaḥ iti vicāre-mantrayorbhavya vyavasthā iti utsūtre pūrvapakṣe siddhāntamāha |
ekakarmaṇi ekasmin saurye karmaṇi abhi- marśanamantrayoḥ vikalpaḥ syāt |
hi yasmāt codanaikatvāt ‘saurye caruṃ nirvapata’ iti codanāyā ekatvāt karmaṇaḥ ekatvāt abhimarśanamantrayoḥ vibhāgaḥ; samuccayaḥ prāpnoti |
( atra paurṇamāsyāṃ sauryayāgaprayoge caturhotraivābhi- marśanam, amāvāsyāyāṃ sauryayāgaprayoge tu pañcahotraivābhi- marśanam iti mantrayorvyavasthaiva viniyogaḥ |
sāmānyastu vikalpa eva bhavati, vyavasthitavikalpaḥ iti tu viśeṣaḥ iti yuktamutpaśyāmaḥ |
‘ekakarmaṇi vikalpo vibhāgo hi codanaikatvāt ’ ityaṣṭamādhikaraṇanyāyena vikṛtau sāyaṃ prātarhomayoḥ abhisūryayoḥ vikalpena prāpte |
su. pṛ. 788, prakṛtau viśeṣābhāve'pi karmabhede sati, ‘ ekakarmaṇi 0 ’ iti nyāyena ekasya aindravāyavādi- vākyavihitasya yāgasya vikṛtau vikalpena vidhyantāti- deśāt vikalpena ekasya dharmāḥ |
kāryāḥ sakṛt yāgaḥ, karmaikye yathāprakṛti iti viśeṣaḥ |
ekakarmaṇi ekasmin karmaṇi bahūnāṃ guṇānāṃ śiṣṭa- tvāt vihitatvāt sarvakarma sarveṣāṃ karma anuṣṭhānaṃ syāt |
yathā ādhāre ‘ṛjumāghārayati’ ‘saṃtatamāghārayati’ ‘ prāñcamāghārayati’ iti vidhānāt ṛjutva-saṃtatatva- prāktvānāṃ samuccayaḥ, evamanyatrāpi iti siddhāntaḥ |
‘ekakarmaṇi śiṣṭatvāt ’ ityatra ādhāre ṛjulordhva- svadīrghatvasaṃtatatvānāṃ samuccayaḥ uktaḥ |
ekatantratvaṃ tantriṇām ekadeśakālakartṛttve ekavākyoditānāṃ bhavati yathā darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ; yathā ca citrāyāmiṣṭau |
yāni tu nānāvākyaiḥ środitāni, teṣu tantrasya bhedaḥ syāt |
ekato dvau, anyataḥ ekaṃ dvyāmuṣyāṇāṃ ārṣeyavaram |
‘ ekatra ubhayam ’ itirīyā viśiṣṭavaiśiṣṭyajñāne viśeṣaṇatā''vacchedakaprakārakaniścayasya hetutvābhāvaḥ |
ekatra guṇasyāpi anyatra prādhānyaṃ na viruddham |
devatāyāḥ paśuṃ prati guṇatve'pi paśupuroḍāśaṃ prati prādhānyāt |
‘ ekatra dvayam ’ iti nyāyena ṣaṭsaṃkhyāyāśrutaḥ- saṃkhyāyāśca karmānvayame'ṅgīkāre medāṅgīkāre karmadaśā- pattiḥ; ṣaṭtriṃśadrātre ‘baḍahā bhavanti, catvāro bhavanti ’ ityatra |
bhāṭṭa. 8|1|3, prakṛtau deśādivācye deśavat aṅgapradhānasāhityasyāpi ‘ ekatra dvayam ’ iti nyāyena pradhānaprayoge vaiśiṣṭyāṅgīkāreṇa sakalaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭa- prayogavidhānāt |
ekatra nirṇītaḥ śākhārtho'nyatrāpi tathā iti nyāyaḥ |
yatra samatavikadeṣu nānāvidhavāditeṣu ekatra prabalayuktiśāstrapramāṇasiddhasammatamena svamataviruddhadiśataṃ nirastaṃ cet, taddhanye sarve nirastā śeṣā iti |
ekasaṃkhyāyāḥ trisaṃkhyāyāśca vyati- pañcavidhānāt ekatrikanāmakaḥ kaścit kraturbhavati |
sa ca evaṃ śrūyate ‘atha ekatrikaḥ : tasya ekasyāṃ vahiṣpavamānaṃ tisṛṣu hotṛrājyam, ekasyāṃ maitrāvaruṇasya tisṛṣu brāhmaṇācchaṃsinaḥ, ekasyāmacchāvākasya, tisṛṣu mādhyaṃdinaḥ pavamānaḥ ’ iti |
vi. 10|1|2, ekatrike kratau āce tuce gānam |
ekatrike kratau ekasyā eva ṛcaḥ trirabhyāsena trikastomaṣṭomam ||
bhāṣyam-- asti ekatrikaḥ kratuḥ : ‘atha eka- trikaḥ : tasyaikāyāṃ vahiṣpavamānam, tisṛṣu hotṛrājyam |
ekasyā- macchāvākasya, tisṛṣu mādhyaṃdinaḥ pavamānaḥ ’ iti |
teṣu saṃśayaḥ kiṃ tuce geyāni, uta ekasyāmṛci iti |
kiṃ prāptam ? trikaḥ stomaḥ : tuce syāt purisāmasu |
stomasya hi tatra āvṛttidharmatā bhavati, vacanaprāmāṇyāt |
idaṃ bhavati vacanam 'āvṛttaṃ dhūrṣu stuvate' 'punarāvṛtte pṛṣṭhairupatiṣṭhate' iti |
sūtrārthastu- dhuryaṃ dhūrgānasaṃpāyastotramadhye yat trikastomam, tat tuceṣu syāt iti |
' bhāṭṭa-- prakṛtau kāni cit dhūrgānasaṃpāyāni stotrāṇi, kāni cit tadasaṃpadyāni |

tadiha ekatri ke trikastomadhūrgānasaṃpāyastotreṣu kiṃ vibhinnasu tisṛṣu ṛkṣu gānam, utaikasyāḥ eva ṛcaḥ abhyāsena trikastomaktā saṃpāyā iti cintāyām, tucagānaprāpi- codakānugrahāya vibhinnasveva tisṛṣu gānam |
na ca ekatrikaprakaraṇe 'āvṛttaṃ dhūrṣu stuvate' iti vacanena ekasyā evarco abhyāsavidhānāt tadbhāva iti vācyam |
tathāhi, na tāvadanena stomamātreṇa āvṛttividhiḥ, adhūrgāna- saṃpāye'pi tadāpatteḥ |
dhūrṣu ityasya viśeṣaṇatve viśiṣṭo- deśāpatteḥ, stotroddeśena abhyāsavidhī tasyaivāvṛttiprasaṅgena ekasyā eva ṛcaḥ āvṛttau pramāṇābhāvācca |
ato dhūrgāne evāvṛttisaṃbandhaḥ 'stuvīta' ityasya anuvādatvamaṅgīkṛtya vidheyaḥ |
tasya ca tucagānaprāptodakādeva siddheḥ asya vākyasyānuvādatvāt vibhinnasveva tisṛṣu geyam |
iti prāpte, samastavākyavaiyarthyāpatteḥ anena dhūrṣu nimitta- bhūtāsu stotroddeśenaiva āvṛttirvidhīyate, saptamyā nimitta- tvokteḥ |
kratugatabhedasyaiva nimittatvat uddeśyabhūta- stotrāṅgasyaiva dhūrgānasya nimittatvāt na stotrāntare āvṛttiprasaṅgaḥ |
ata eva lakṣaṇaprasaṅgena ājyalaptṛptvādinā uddeśyabhāvāt na sakalasvāvṛttiprasaṅgaḥ |
guṇasaṃkīrtanātmakastotratvecca ṛgāvṛttintareṇā'nupapatteḥ ekasyā evarcaḥ abhyāsena trikastomaktā saṃpāyā, tena trikastomake dhūrṣu tṛca- gānasya pṛthakatvaniveśitvameva bādhyam |
' ❖ ekatri ke kratau māghyadine pavamāne gānārthe nikhila ādyatṛca eva grāhyaḥ, na tu trayāṇāṃ tṛcānām ādyāḥ tisraḥ ṛcaḥ |
❖ ekatri ke tucādiṣu māghyadine, chandasāṃ śrutibhūtatvāt |
asti ekatrikaḥ kratuḥ 'athaiṣa ekatrikaḥ, tasya ekasyāṃ bahiṣpavamānam, tisṛṣu hotṛrājyam |
asmin ekatrike kratau māghyadine pavamāne tucādiṣu tṛcānāṃ ādyāsu ṛkṣu stotriyāsu gānaṃ syāt |
chandasāṃ śrutibhūtatvāt, śrutibhūtāni hi gāyatrabṛhatītisṛbho nāma trīṇi chandāṃsi prakṛtau uktāni 'trikcchandā āvāpo māghyadinaḥ pavamānaḥ pañcasāmā' iti |
tānīha codakaprāptāni upasaṃhartuṃ śakyante yadi tucāyāsu gānam |
tasmāt tucā- diṣu gānam iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
ekatri ke nāma kratuviśeṣe māghyadine pavamāne āditaḥ ādya tṛce eva mānam |
tannyāyatvāt, saḥ pūrvādhi- karaṇoktaḥ kapālaviṣayako nyāyaḥ |
yasya māghyadinapavamāna- gānasya tat tanmayyam, tasya bhāvaḥ tannyāyatvaṃ tasmāt |
tasmāt ādye tṛce eva gānam, na tu trayāṇāṃ tṛcānāṃ ādyā''yāsa tisṛṣu ṛkṣu iti siddhāntaḥ |
ekatri ke nāma kratuviśeṣe māghyadine yathā- niveśaṃ yathākramaṃ ādye eva gānaṃ na trayāṇāṃ tṛcānāṃ ādyā''yāsa ṛkṣu |
nanu kramānurodhe svīkṛte 'trikcchandā āvāpo māghyadinaḥ pavamānaḥ' ityuktaḥ 'trikcchandastvavirodha eveti, tatrāha |
trikasya saṃkhyāmātrasya vikāraḥ bādhaḥ syāt, na chandasaḥ na ca kramasya |
tasmāt ādye tṛce eva gānam iti siddhāntaḥ |
3|1|7|14-15. ❖ ekatvasya kārakadvārā kriyā''nyāt yuktā vidheyatā ('grahaṃ' ityatra |
tathā darśa- pūrṇamāsayoḥ 'puroḍāśaṃ paryagni karoti' iti |
tatra kim ekaṃ graham ekasya ayam ekaṃ puroḍāśam iti, kiṃ sarveṣāṃ grahāṇāṃ sarveṣāmeva sarveṣāṃ puroḍāśān iti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
saṃmārjanaṃ tṛṇapacayaḥ paryagni- karaṇaṃ ca ekatvayuktaṃ syāt |
ekasya śrutisaṃyogāt eka- vacanoktasya ekasyaiva śrutisaṃyogāt vidhiryuktā |
'grahaṃ saṃmārṣṭi' iti ekasyaiva grahasya saṃmārjana saṃbandhāt |
grahatvasya lakṣaṇatvāt kṛtsnasya mī. ko. 160 sthāpakatvāt, uddeśyatāvacchedakatvāt iti vā |
mahatva- jātyā dravyaṃ lakṣayitvā saṃmārgādi vidhīyate |
aviśiṣṭaṃ samānaṃ hi yasmāt lakṣaṇaṃ sarvagraheṣu mahatvarūpam |
tasmāt sarve grahāḥ saṃmārṣṭavyāḥ, sarveṣāmeṣāṃ tṛṇānya- paceyāni, sarve puroḍāśāḥ paryagni kartavyāḥ |
nanu tarhi 'paśunā yajeta' ityatrāpi puṃstvamekatvaṃ ca avivakṣitaṃ syāt iti cetnetyāha |
codite vidheyatayā upādeye ekavacanasaṃyogena vihite paśo tu yathāśruti śrutimatantram, śrutemekavacanamanatikramya ekatvaṃ vivakṣitaṃ pratīyeta |

ke. ❖ ekatvayuktamekasya śrutisaṃyogāt iti grahādhikaraṇa- pūrvapakṣasūtre avaghātādīnāṃ śrutisaṃyogāt vyavasthā'- bhyupagame saṃmārgādīnāṃ ekavacanaśrutisaṃyogāt ekasmi- nneva grahādau vyavasthitam itimidhānāt |
bhā. 3|1|7|14 pṛ. 715-16. ❖ ekatvatvādyo vibhaktyarthāḥ, tadā karmadayo viśeṣaṇatveneti |
' (vā. 4|4|13 pṛ. 120) iti vārtikoktena ekatvādidaivalakṣaṇyānupalambhena dravyatvat kārakeṣvapi ekatvādivāntarajātyayogaḥ |
bhā. 8|1|7. ❖ ekadevatākapaśuguṇe daivataiḥ avadānaiḥ devatā- nām, sauviṣṭakṛtaiḥ sauviṣṭakṛtānām, aiḍe'tha aiḍe'nu- samayaḥ vājapeye prājāpatyapaśuṣu |
1|1|124. ekadeśāḥ samudāyāina: samudāya pratyāyya samudāyā- rthān gamayituṃ śaknuvanti yathā gāmyādayaḥ |
bhā. 10| 1|9|34, ekadeśe'pi jātinimittā: (śabdāḥ) dṛṣṭāḥ sarvatra jātinimittā bhavitumarhanti |
' ya eva laukikā śabdāḥ, ta eva vaidikāḥ, ta evāmīṣāmarthāḥ |
' iti sthitatvāt lokaprasiddhapratīte vede yatraikadeśe'pi jātinimittatā labhyate, na tatra punarnimittāntaraśakti- kalpanā sambhavati |

' (vā. 1|4|170 pṛ. 343) iti vahiṃrādhyādhikaraṇavārtikoktanyāyena rājyarahite kṣatriye jātinimittatvenābhyupagatasya śabdasya rājyayoginyapi kṣatriye jātyāyāgāt akṣatriye'pi ca ahastvārthavṛtti- tvena jātyāyāgāsaṃbhavāt nānyekaśatyāpādakaṃ nimittā- ntaraṃ kalpanīyam |
su. pṛ. 90. ekadeśe'pi hūyamāne sarvamidaṃ dravyaṃ devatoddeśena tyajyamānaṃ yāgaṃ sādhayati |
vā. 3|2|17|14, ekadeśe'pi samu- dāyaśabdānām upalabdhiḥ yathā 'grāma āyātaḥ' |
3|3|1|12 pṛ. 803. ekadeśakarma avayavinaṃ na prayukte, vidyamānasya avayavinaḥ ekadeśaḥ upādātavyaḥ iti tatrāpyau bhavati |
(kintu ) sata: ikṣoḥ khaṇḍamupādīta, sato modakāt śakalamupādīteti |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ mukhyānāṃ pradhānānām ekadeśakāla- kartṛtvaṃ tantraṃ syāt |
ekasa pradhānasya yo deśo yau kālau ye ca kartāraḥ, te eva deśakālakartāraḥ |
ekaśabdopadeśāt 'darśapūrṇamāsabhyām' iti ekenaiva śabdena sarveṣāṃ pradhānānāmupadeśāt |
avidhiśret karmaṇāṃ nābhi sambandhaḥ pratīyeta, lakṣaṇāthābhisaṃyogāccodanāvidhitveteṣāṃ prati- pradhānaṃ bhāvaḥ syāt |
avidhiśret yadi deśakālakartṛtvaṃ vidhinaṃ syāt tadā karmaṇām āgneyādīnāṃ pradhānānāṃ pratyekaṃ deśādibhiḥ abhisaṃbaṃdhaḥ sa na pratīyeta |
darśapūrṇamāsaśabdaḥ samudāyāśabdaḥ, āgneyādayastu ṣaṭ samudāyāinaḥ, samudāya- śabdasya ca samudāyeṣu lakṣaṇā |
tathā ca lakṣaṇādyena samudāyibhiḥ deśādīnāṃ abhisaṃyogaḥ saṃbandhaḥ jñāyate |
itareṣāṃ deśādīnāṃ ca codanāvidhiśeṣatvāt pradhānavidhi- śeṣatvāt pradhānaśeṣatvāt iti yāvat, pratipradhānaṃ deśakālakartṝṇāṃ bhāvaḥ syāt |
) yadi tu karmaṇo vidhisambandhaḥ syādeka śabdāt pradhānāthābhisaṃyogāt |
yadi āgneyādeḥ karmaṇaḥ deśa- kālakartṝṇāṃ vidhinā saṃbandhaḥ syāt, tataḥ syāt codanāvidhiśeṣatvam, bhedena ca deśādayaḥ |
kutaḥ ? 1 ekaśabdatvāt āgneyādīnāṃ samastānāṃ darśapūrṇamāsabhyām iti ekena śabdena bodhitatvāt ekaḥ śabdo bodhako yeṣāmāgneyādīnāṃ te ekaśabdāḥ, teṣāṃ bhāvaḥ ekaśabdatvaṃ tasmāt |
pradhānaṃ phalam, pradhānārtheḥ pradhānasādhanārtheḥ āgneyādīnāṃ prayogarūpo vyāpāraḥ, tena deśādīnām abhisaṃyogāt ekaśabdodadhiterāgneyādibhiḥ deśādīnāṃ saṃbandhaḥ |
phalāsādhakena prayogeṇa teṣāṃ saṃbandhasya avagamāt na teṣāṃ codanāvidhiśeṣatvaṃ bhavati |
'ugrāṇi ha vā etāni ghorāṇi havīṃṣi yada- māvāsyāyāṃ saṃbhriyante, āgneyaṃ prathamamandre uttare ' iti anyārthadarśanaṃ sarveṣāṃ pradhānānām ekakālatvaṃ darśayati,
saṃbharaṇasya paurvāparyasya ca samakālatva eva saṃbhavāt |
amāvāsyāyāṃ yāni trīṇi havīṃṣi saṃbhriyante prathamam agnidevatākaḥ puroḍāśaḥ, tata uttare ca dve sāṃnāyyarūpe dadhipayasī indradevatāke iti, tāni ugrāṇi ghorāṇi ca |
agneḥ indrasya ca ugratvāt ghoratvā- cceti śrutyarthaḥ |
kiñca eṣāṃ deśādīnāṃ pradhānatvaṃ pradhānānāmiva śrutiḥ punaḥśrutivat anuvādena pratīyate 'same darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta' ityādi |
karmaśruteḥ 'darśa- pūrṇamāsābhyām' iti karmavācakaśruteḥ parārthatvāt 'darśa- pūrṇamāsābhyām' karabhūtatvām anyat kimapi kāryaṃ kuryāt' ityetadarthatvāt |
ke. ekadeśakālakartṛtvam ityekādaśādhikaraṇe pradhāna- kālatantratā vakṣyate |
yathā 'trikapāle vaiṣṇavaḥ' etāni trīṇi kapālāni aṣṭakapālasya ādimakapālasyaiva dharmavanti |
yathā vā 'ekāṃ sāmi- dhenīmanvāha' iyam ekā pañcadaśasāmidhenīṣu ādimā grāhyā |
yathā vā dvirāvatrirātrādiṣu dvādaśāhasya ādima- nyasya (dvitīyāhāmarasya) dharmīḥ iti |

asyāpavādastu ekatrike ājyastotreṣu (10|1| 2), ekatrike eva dhūgāne (10|1|3) dvirātrādau dvādaśāhasya dvitīyāhāmarasya dvādaśāhasya (10|1|4) agnicayane (10|1|5) āghūnanameṣu vījāvapanamantreṣu ca (1|3|11) |
bhā. 10|1|12-6. 'ekadeśadravyaṃ cotpattau vidyamānasaṃyogāt' iti caturthādhikaraṇe (4|1|12|18) ekadeśadravyasya sataḥ karmaṇaḥ saṃnihitaśeṣasattvāt na dravyaprayojakatvam iti vakṣyate |
puroḍāśānā''dīnāṃ savanīyayāgārthatvāt pūrveṇaiva nyāyena grahaṇaśaryārtham anye puroḍāśapālādayaḥ iti prāpte''mīdhīyate |
'eka- deśadravyaṃ ca' ityanena aprayojakatvalakṣaṇasampatteḥ anyasya ca śakalasyābhāvāt (na aprakṛtagrahaṇamiti) |

vā. 3|8| 18|133 pṛ. 1135, yadā hi dravyadānamātre hute puroḍāśadravyaḥ saroṣāḥ kriyante, tadā 'uttarāghāt sviṣkṛte samavadyati' ityevādicodanābalena 'eka- deśadravyaṃ' saṃyogāt' ityevaṃ sviṣkṛdādīnāṃ aprayoja- katvaṃ bhavati |

3|4|14|37 pṛ. 904. 'ekadeśa- dravyaṃ cotpattau vidyamānasaṃyogāt' (sudhāpāṭhaḥ ) śeṣasadbhāve śeṣakāryeṣu 'vidyamānadeśasaṃyogāt' iti caturthādhikaraṇasiddhāntena śeṣakāryāṇām ekadeśa- prayojakatvam, sarvaprakṣepeṇa śeṣamātraprayogahetutvāt dravyāntarotpādanena śeṣakāryopacaritatvāt |

su. pṛ. 1615. vidyamānasaṃyogāt ye śeṣakāryāṇāṃ dravyā- ntarotpādanaprayojakatvam 'ekadeśadravyaṃ ca' ityetādhikaraṇa- śaṅkāsūtre tasya vidyamānasyaikadeśinaḥ samastasya pradhāna- devatāyai nirdeśāt śeṣakāryārthaṃ anyat dravyam arthāt utpādyam iti sūtrakāro'pi vakṣyati |
pṛ. 1616. 'ekadeśadravyotpattau vidyamānasaṃyogāt' aprayo- jakaḥ (4|1|12|18) iti yaduktaṃ tatrocyate |
tatra kiṃ puroḍāśasya āgneyayāga: sviṣṭa- kṛccobhayaṃ prayojakam, āgneyayāga eva vā prayojaka: iti vicāre siddhāntasūtramidam |
ekadeśadravya: ekadeśa: puroḍāśasya uttarādha: dravyaṃ yasya sa: ekadeśadravya: sviṣṭakṛtyāga: puroḍāśasya na prayojaka: |
vidyamānena avagatya- mānena āgneyayāgārthena puroḍāśena ekadeśadravyakasya sviṣṭakṛta: saṃyogāt |
tathā ca paraprayuktopajīvitvāt sviṣṭakṛdyāga: na prayojaka: iti siddhānta: |
tvacamācchathatāt' ityatra ekadhā ityeṣa śabdaḥ aikyava- canaḥ |
bahīṣu tvakṣu ekīkaraṇam ekadhāśabdo vadati ityasyeyam |
ekadhā iti abhyāsena abhidhānam uccāraṇaṃ syāt |
'ekadhā asya tvacam ācchathatāt' asya paśoḥ tvacam ekadhā ekena prakāreṇa ekena prayatnena chinnāṃ kuru iti tasyārthaḥ |
eka- smin paśau paśudravye tu prayatnadvayaṃ syāt |
tasmāt paśugaṇe 'ekadhaikādanyastvacvaṃ, ekadhaikādhaikadhaiṣāṃ tvacaḥ' ityūhaḥ kartavyaḥ |
adhikāraḥ ekadhāpadasya abhyāsa rūpo vikāro na syāt |
ekadhāśabdaḥ ekasmin kāle ekasmin deśe vā tvacaḥ ekīkuru iyāha |
tasmāt bahīṣu tvakṣu ekīkaraṇam ekadhā- śabdo vadati |
bahūnām ekakarmavat 'ekadhā gāḥ pāyayati' ityatra bahūnāṃ gavām ekakāle pāyan yathā kartuṃ śakyate tadvat |
ekaṃ karma iva ekakarmavat iti vigrahaḥ |
sakṛttvaṃ tvaikadhyaṃ syādekatvāt, tvaco'nabhipretaṃ tatprakṛtitvāt, padeṣvabhyāsena vivaddhābhidhānaṃ syāt |
ekadhāpadasya abhyāso na kartavyaḥ iti yat pūrva- pakṣiṇā |
'ekāle karmaṇi abhidhīyamāne aikyam ekadhātvaṃ nāma sakṛt sāhityaṃ tvacām abhihitaṃ syāt |
tacca prakṛtau tvacaḥ ekatvāt anabhipretaṃ syāt, asaṃbhavāt |
sakṛttvaṃ tvaikadhyaṃ syādekatvāt tvaco'nabhipre- taṃ, tatprakṛtitvāt pareṣvābhyāsena vivaddhā- bhividhānaṃ syāt |
ekakāle karmaṇi abhidhīyamāne sahalaṃ tvacāmabhihitaṃ bhavati |
tat prakṛtau ekasyāṃ tvaci asaṃbhavāt anabhipretam |
tatprakṛtitvā- duttarāsāṃ tatīnāṃ pareṣṣu vardhamāneṣu paśuṣu abhyāsenābhi- dhānaṃ syāt |
tena prākṛtam ekaprayatnasādhyatvaṃ pratyekaṃ tvacām abhidhātum 'ekadhaikā' ityevam abhyasitavyam |
soma - saṃsargiṣu iva avikāraḥ ityucyate : saṃgatiḥ |
pratipaśu ekaprayatnasādhyatvaṃ na labhyate iti tadartham abhyāsa eva svīkartavyaḥ |
sūtrārthastu- ekadhā ityabhyāsenābhidhānaṃ syāt ekasaṃyogāt abhyāsena vinā sarvaviṣayatvātsaṃbhavāt iti |
bhāṭṭa-- tanaiva praiṣe (agnipraiṣe) 'ekadhā'sya tvacamācchathatāt' iti śrutam |
tatra padyantaṃ dvitīyāntaṃ ca paśugaṇe dvivahuvacanāntena ūhitavyam ityavivādam |

ekadhāśabdasya tu avikāraḥ athavā abhyāsātmako bhākta ūhaḥ iti cintāyām, ekadhā- śabdasya ekaprayatnasādhyatve ekadeśakālatve ca laukika- prayogeṇa nānā'rthakatvāvagateḥ prakṛtau ekāvāt tvacaḥ deśataḥ kālato vā sāhityarūpāthāsaṃbhavena tvacaḥ sākalyasaṃpattaye ekaprayatnasādhyatvasya grāhyatve'pi vikṛtau aśrutāyāsakalpane pramāṇabhāvāt ekadhāśabdena arthāntarabhūta deśataḥ kālato vā anekatvacchedanasāhitya- meva śakyā prakāśyate iti avikārāt ūhaḥ |
yadi tu upakārarūpabhāvena padārthānāmatideśāt prakṛtau yasya śabdasya yo'rtho nirṇītaḥ, tasya tadarthaprabhāvenaiva prāpyavamateḥ |
na arthāntaraprakāśanasya prayojanatvakalpanām upapattit iti vibhāvyate, tadā astu ekaprayatna- sādhyatvameva vikṛtau api ekadhāśabdārthaḥ |
tathāpi tu nābhyāsaḥ : sakṛduccaritenaiva ekadhāśabdena sarvasvagataika- prayatnasādhyacchedanakatvasya vaktuṃ śakyatvāt |

yadyapi ca sahitātāṃ sarvāsāṃ tvacām ekaprayatnasādhyacchedanakatvaṃ bādhitam, tathāpi pratipradhānaṃ guṇāvṛtteryuktatvāt, uddeśyānāṃ tvacāṃ sāhityavivakṣaṇācca pratyekameva saṃmārgā- divat tāsu ekaprayatnasādhyacchedanakatvasya anvayasyopa- patteḥ nāyo'bhyāsena |

iti prāpte, prakṛtau yādṛśinirṇayaṃ prati yāhaśapadajñānasya yādṛśasāmagrīsattve phalopadhāyakatā, vikṛtau'pi tādṛśasāmagrīsattve eva tādṛśapadajñānasya tādṛśanirṇayopadhāyakatvaṃ vācyam, itathā prakṛtitvadvāvā- nupapatteḥ |
tadiha prakṛtau ekadhāśabdena sahakāryānataranair- pekṣyeṇaiva tvacvaṃ viśeṣataḥ'vacchedīkṛtya tvagviśeṣa- kaikaprayatnasādhyacchedanakatvaprakārakaḥ paryāptisaṃsargako nirṇayo janitaḥ |
na cāsau vikṛtau sakṛduccaritena ekadhāśabdena sahakāryānataranairpekṣyeṇa saṃbhavati, tasya samuditatvakatvaṃ viśeṣaṇatā'vacchedakatvakṛtvāpi tādṛśabodha- janakatvāt |
ataśca tādṛśabodhe bādhitaviṣayatvaprati- saṃdhānasyāpi uktanītinaye sahakārikāraṇatā vācyā iti adhikasāmagrīkatvāt prakṛtitvadvāvābhāvāt |
yo'pi saha prāpayati so'pi ekadhā pāyayati|
bhā. 10|2|4|17. 'ekadhaikadhā' iti prākṛtasyaiva sakalasya padasya abhyāsātmaka ūho'yaṃ pañcaguṇe|
bāla. pṛ. 127. ekadhopahāre sahatvaṃ brahmabhakṣaṇām, prakṛtau vighaṭatvāt|
śatakṛṣṇale carau śeṣamaśeṣu śrutam ' ekadhā brahmaṇe pariharati' iti|
tatra ekadhā ityanena upahāre upa- haraṇe brahmabhakṣaṇaṃ sahatvaṃ gamyate|
prakṛtau vighaṭatvāt darśapūrṇamāsayo: ime bhakṣā: viddhatā: minne kāle medena dattā: bhavanti|
te iha codakena vihatā eva prāptā:; tatra sahatvavacane ekadhāśabda: avakalpate|
tasmāt śatakṛṣṇale brahmabhakṣā: yugapat parihartavyā iti siddhānta:|
ata eva dvitīyapakṣe pañcāvatte nityasiddhaye vidhiḥ, avadānāṃśa ca haviṣṣvidhadhayartham ekaprasaratābhaṅgaparihārārthe ceti draṣṭavyam |
10|1|18, 'pañcāvattaiva vapā kāryā' iti vacanena ekaprasaratābhaṅgabhayena prākṛtakāryāpannā- dānāntaravidherāvaśyakatvāt |
10|1|2, 'pūṣā adantako hi' ityatra na tāvat bhāgaśabdalakṣitayāgodeśena peṣaṇavidhiḥ ekaprasaratābhaṅgā- patteḥ |
ekaprasaratābhaṅgabhiyā vā pṛṣṭhatāviśiṣṭasyāsya atideśapravṛttiḥ pūrvapravṛttau pṛṣṭhatāmātraphalako vidhiḥ |
10|1|25. ekabhāgavat maitrāvaruṇasya na dvibhāgatvaṃ jyoti- ṣṭome amīpomīye paśau |
(eka eva mantraḥ aṅgatvena karaṇaṃ yeṣāṃ tāni eka- mantrāṇi |
ekasya karmaṇaḥ karaṇabhūto mantraḥ eka eva bhavati ityarthaḥ |
) satyāśrau. 1|1|14. agni- yenubhiḥ (te ā. 3|8) ityekaviṃśatirmantrāḥ saṃbhāra- yajuṃṣi |
samāpte anuvāke (śeṣe ca sati mantrākāṅkṣā- yām ) punarabhyāsaḥ kāryaḥ ekamantrāṇi karmāṇi iti nyāyāt |
satyāśrau. 2|8|19 tatra kahodādiṣu arthāt tarpaṇamidaṃ kāryaḥ |
āśva. gṛ. nārāyaṇavṛttiḥ 3|4|4. 'namo astu sarvebhyaḥ ' ityetatpā (trayāṇāṃ madhye ) ekena sarpaśira upadadhāti (cayane, 'ekamantrāṇi karmāṇi' iti nyāyāt ) |
' itinyāyena aruṇādibhiḥ krameṇāvagatairapi ekastyārūḍhaiḥ yugapadeva krayabhāvanā anvayamanubhavati |
ratna. 6|1|5|22 varṇakaṃ 2. ekasthaisthāni yajñe syuḥ, svādhyāyavat |
rayaṃtaravṛddhadādīni sāmāni yathe ekasthaisthāni syuḥ eksyāmuci gātavyāni, na tuce |
ṛkpūrabdhūḥ pathāmānekṣe' (pā0 5|4|74) ṛc-pura-apa-dhur-pathin etadantasya samāsasya (a anakṣe ) a-pratyayaḥ syāt |
akṣe arthe yā dhūḥ tadantasya tu na |
yathe sāmāni tuce geyāni, na ekarce |
'adhākṣareṇa prathamāyā ṛcaḥ prastauti, dhyādhareṇottarayoḥ' iti liṅgadarśanāt |
nahi tucaṃ vinā prathamāyāḥ uttarayoḥ iti ca nirdeśaḥ saṃbhavati |
'ekaṃ sāma tuce kriyate stotrīyam' ityarthādapūrvako vidhirāpi tatra pramāṇam |
tasmāt sāmāni yathe tuce geyāni iti siddhāntaḥ |
yathā daśame 'rathaghoṣaṇa' ityatra samāhāradvaṃdvaḥ iti pūrvapakṣe padadvaya- lakṣaṇā syāt, tatpakṣe tu pūrvapade evati, sa eva yuktaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
bāla. pṛ. 143. ekavacanamekasmin iti prāyikametat dārādiṣu vyabhicārāt |
bṛhatī. pṛ. 130-121. ekavacanantaḥ kathaṃ punarbahūnāṃ vācako bhaviṣyati ? iti yadi ucyate, samudāyatayā avakalpiṣyate |
bhā. 2|1|3 pṛ.479, bhavati hi bahūnām ekavacanantaḥ śabdaḥ samudāyāpekṣaḥ, yathā yūyam, vanam, kulam, parigad iti |
paurṇamāsī, amāvāsyā iti ca vidvadvākyārthī śabdau |

so'pi ca samānādhi- karaṇyena bhavati samānavibhaktyantānām, vaiyadhikaraṇyena vā kriyākārakūpaḥ śeṣaśeṣibhāvaśca |

' loka mantrāṇeṣu anyamicāri etadeva vākyalakṣaṇam iti sthitam |
vā. 2|1|4|16 pṛ. 445. na anyārtha iti jñānena saṃhitenāpi ekavākyatā bhavati anyasaṃbandhopapattau satyā |
bhā. 3|8|16|11, na ca grāmyāmi sahe ekavākyatā syāt |
yadā ekena ekavākyatā, tadā tena nirākāṅkṣasya na anyenāpi ekavākyatā kalpyate |
1|1|2 pṛ. 1642, na ca buddhau asaṃnihitena ekavākyatā bhavati |
saṃnidhau samāmnāyasya etadeva prayojanam, kathama ubhābhyāṃ padārthābhyāṃ viśiṣṭāṃ buddhim utpādayediti |
tasmād vyavahitena saha naika- vākyatā bhavatīti |
3|1|1|21 pṛ. 734. nahi aṅgāṅkṣitarahitayoḥ ubhayoḥ svatantrayoḥ parasparasaṃbandhayoḥ vidhīyamānayoḥ ekavākyatā bhavati, vacanavyaktibhedāt |
anyā hi pradhānavidheḥ tāvanmātropasaṃhāriṇī vacanavyaktiḥ, anyā ca śruteḥ parāṅbhāvāvānugatatvā |
bhā. 3|4|19, nahi vidhāyakāvidhāyakagatayorviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāveneka- vākyatā, ' chāgasya vapāyāḥ ' iti vapāviśeṣaṇe chāga- śabdaḥ |
' yadi hi vākyaṃ padavat vākyaṃ bhavet, tatastadekatvānu- vartitvā vākyārthasyāpyamyameva kadā cit |

yadā tu pṛthagbhūtaireva padairitaretaranirapekṣaiḥ sveṣu padārtheṣukteṣu tatsaṃsargādeva padavyāpārānapekṣo vākyārthapratyayo bhavati, taddena ca tāvanti padāni ekaṃ vākyam ityavadhāryate, na tadā vākyatadekatvayoḥ vyāpāraṃ paśyāmaḥ |
2|1|14 46 pṛ. 445, pratyakṣeṇa vidhinā yathākathañcit eka- vākyatāyāṃ saṃbhavantyāṃ na parokṣā ekavākyatā yuktā |
bhāṣyam- aya prakṣipyateṣu yajuḥṣu kathamava- gamyate, idamekaṃ yajuriti ? yāvatā padasamūhena ijyate tāvat padasamūha ekaṃ yajuḥ |
kiyatā cejyate ? yāvatā kriyāyā upakāraḥ prakāśyate tāvat vaktavyatvāt vākya- mityucyate |
etasmācca kāraṇadekavākyatā bhavati, tasmādekārthaḥ padasamūho vākyam |
yadi ca vibhajyamānaṃ sākāṅkṣaṃ padaṃ bhavati |
kimudāharaṇam ' devasya tvā savituḥ prasave ' iti |
medaḥ saṃsargo vā vākyārthaḥ iti yacchrūyate, tathāpi ekā- rthatā na syāt |
tasya viśiṣṭasya vācaka etāvān padasamūhaḥ, tat vākyam |
nanvatra ' devasya tvā savituḥ prasave nirvāpāmi' ityekaṃ vākyam, 'aśvinorbāhubhyāṃ nirvāpāmītyupapannaḥ, tato bahūni vākyāni |
yadi guṇabhūto nirvāpāmiti, tadā prati- pradhānaṃ bhavet |
na ca nirvāpo devasya tvā ityevamādī- nāmarthenocyate |
nirvāpe punaḥ pradhāne, dṛṣṭaṃ kāryaṃ nirvāpaprakāśanam |
yathā ca padaṃ padena viśeṣyate, tathoktaṃ tadbhūtānāmiti ( 1 | 1 | 7 25 ) |
tāvad yajuṣma vākyaṃ ca vaktavya- tvābhirūpyate ||
' vacanāhaṃ hi vākyaṃ kāryaṃ samarthaṃ ca tadahaṃ bhavati, na nyūnamadhikaṃ vā, tāvataiva jñeyate |
tacca kīdṛśam iti 'ekārthyaṃ sākāṅkṣāyavaṃ ca' iti lakṣaṇam |
yat tato'dhikam, tat vākyāntaraṃ yajurantaraṃ ca ityuktaṃ bhavati |
evaṃ sarvatra purastāt parastād ekārthatvasamarthapadaparigrahāt asamartha- padavimokena ca bhinnāni yajuṃṣi kalpyante |
tena eka- vākyalakṣaṇoktau ca arthāt yajurbheda-vākyabhedalakṣaṇayoḥ siddhiriti 'etasmāt cet kāraṇāt' ityāha |
'kimudāharaṇam' iti abhidheyavācinam arthaśabdaṃ gṛhītvā lakṣaṇadvayasamāveśāsaṃbhāvanayā pṛcchati |
tathāhi 'ekārthyaṃ padasya syāt sākāṅkṣāyavaṃ na tat |
' padasya hi ākṛtināma eko'rtho bhavet, na tu tadavaya- vānāṃ varṇanāṃ prakṛtipratyayayor vibhāge sākāṅkṣatvam, arthapratyayānaśaktyabhāvāt |
samudāyavatsu padāni vibhāge parasparamākāṅkṣanti, na tu eṣāmekārthyam, pratipadadharmamedāt, samūhe ca pṛthagarthāntaraprasiddheḥ |
ato lakṣyābhāvāt alakṣaṇametat iti (etāvatā 'kimudāharaṇam' iti ākṣepabhāṣyaṃ nyāyyatam |
) prayojanavāciprāpayeṇa (sautram arthapadaṃ prayojanaṃ brūte iti prayojanavāci iti abhiprāyeṇa, prayojanavācitvābhi- prāyeṇa ityarthaḥ :) 'devasya tvā' (bhāṣye) |
yadā padārthavyati- riktaḥ kaścit eko vibhāgo vākyārtho nāsti, tadā tattatpadārthadharmā eva sāmīpyavaśāt teṣāṃ gamyamānau bhedasaṃrgau syātām, ata āha-'tathāpi ekārthatā na syāt' |
' vyacchidapadārthapakṣe sarvavyaktīnāṃ gavādipadenaiva upāttatvāt viṣayadhandeḥ śuklādibhiḥ kṛṣṇādinvacchedamātraṃ vaktavyam |
tatsaṃsargaḥ padārthāntargatatvāt na vākyārtho bhavati, iti tadupasarjanaḥ teṣāṃ bhedo gṛhyate |
sa ca yathā śukla- śabdena gośabdasya kṛṣṇādimyo midyamānatvāt bhavati, evaṃ śuklaśabdasyāpi gośabdena aśvādibhyo nivartitasya bhavati, vyavacchedanānātvāt nāstyetattve pramāṇam |
yadā tu meda- vantaḥ padārthāḥ eva vākyārthaḥ, tadā siddhameva nānātvam |
' ākṛti- padārthapakṣe śuklatvagotvayoḥ svarūpeṇa abhihitayoḥ (vyaktisahitajāteḥ svarūpato bhānam iti paribhāṣā ) saṃnidhānāt itaretarānuñjanam arthasiddhamedaṃ vākyārthaḥ |
sa ca gotve śuklatvasaṃsargaḥ, śuklatve vā gotvasaṃsargaḥ śāmastyena ekaikavyatyupasaṃhārāt upalabhyate iti nānā |
yadyapi kaścit dvipe sa eva ubhayatrāpi saṃsargaḥ iti ekatvaṃ gamyeta, tathāpi bahupade yenayena pradeśena padadvayaṃ saṃsṛjyate, tenatena saṃsargarūpeṇa upalabhyateḥ anekatvam |
' yāvat hi prayojanaikaṃ nāśrīyate, tāvat svatantrāḥ padārthāḥ na ekatāmāpādayituṃ śakyante, iti pṛthageva medasaṃrgau anubhavanti, tasmādapi |
yadyapi ca asakaṃ ākṛtipadārthakatvāt naiva medo vākyārthatvena abhipretaḥ, tathāpi pūrvapakṣavādinā vikalpamātreṇa upa- nyastaḥ |
evaṃ sati eva kaścit padārtheḥ pradhānabhūtaḥ, tadviśeṣaṇatvena itaropadānam iti |
sarveṣāṃ ca taddedāta tatsaṃsargācca eko medaḥ saṃsargo vā ityapi śakyaṃ vaditum |
tasmāt karmasamavāyitvena darśayatvāt aśeṣavastrityādipadārthaviśiṣṭanirvāpaprakāśanāṃ (devasya tvā saviduḥ ityādiḥ ) samastasya padasamūhasya ekaṃ prayojanam iti siddhamudāharaṇam |
parastu nivāpaprādhānyaṃ ajñātavā pṛcchati nanu atra devasya tvā (bhāṣyaṃ) |
