3|16|12 pṛ. 689. ekahāyanīśabdasya krīṇātinā anvayaḥ aruṇāśabdena iti vicāraḥ ; 'aruṇānyāyaḥ' iti māṣpīyādhikaraṇe draṣṭavyaḥ |
ke. ekahāyanyādiśabdāḥ kālaviśeṣayuktadravyavacanāḥ santo vayo lakṣayantaḥ pravartante |
vā. 3|16|12 pṛ. 679. ekākinī pratijñā hi pratijñātaṃ na sādhayet iti nyāyaḥ |
( hetuṃ vyāptiṃ ca vinā kevalā pratijñā pratijñātamarthaṃ sādhayituṃ na śaknoti ityarthaḥ |
atha apareṣu gārhapatye kartavyeṣu patnīsaṃyājeṣu tantraṃ syāt ekābhitvāt |
dakṣiṇavihārasaṃbandhināmuttara- vihārasaṃbandhināṃ ca patnīsaṃyājānāṃ agniḥ eka eva gārhapatyaḥ |
aparāgnerake'pi kartṛbhedāt kartṛbhedāt patnīsaṃyājāḥ nānā bhaveyuḥ : bhinnāḥ |
ke. 'ekādaśa vai paśoravadānāni ' ayaṃ parisaṃkhyā- vyāvartitaviṣayaḥ pratiprasavavidhiḥ : someśvaramatena |
bāla. pṛ. 16. ekādaśabhirdaiḥ iteṣāmajñānāṃ parisaṃkhyā agnīṣomīye paśau |
tatra dakṣiṇato'vasthāpitaḥ ekādaśo yūpaḥ upaśayaḥ nāma |
vi. 7|1|13. ekādaśaḥ ( adhyāyaḥ ) prayogyatāvicārārtha- mārabhyate tantrāvāpena |
ṭupū. 7|1|11 pṛ. 1524. ekādaśe ajñānāṃ pradhānānāṃ ca ekenaiva prayoga- vidhinā vidhānam iti vakṣyate |
bhāṭṭa. 5|1|1. ekādaśapālaḥ mādhyaṃdine savane savanīyaḥ puroḍāśaḥ |
ke. ekādaśapāle aindre auṣadhasya āgneyapuroḍāśasya vidhvantaḥ |
bhā. 8|2|16|26. ekādaśāthe ( adhikaraṇe ) yajirūpakaśabdo- pādānāt āgneyādīnāṃ sāhityaṃ vivakṣitam iti sādhitam |
bāla. pṛ. 168. ekādaśādhyāyārthaḥ : 'upadāttasthā tantrāvāpau tantrasya vistṛtiḥ |
tatra tantralakṣaṇam uktameva ' sādhāraṇaṃ bhavet tantram ' iti |
viśeṣagrahaṇaṃ ca saptadhā 1 phalakāmanātaḥ, 2 nimittataḥ, 3 rūpataḥ, 4 saṃkhyātaḥ, 5 kālataḥ, 6 mantrataḥ, 7 kartṛbhedaiḥ |
tatra cobhayatra pūrvoktaṃ sattvā viśeṣagrahaṇaṃ nāsti ādye svargakāmanāyāḥ, dvitīye karaṇopakārakamānāyāḥ aviśeṣāt |
nahi atra kāmyāgni- hotreṇa nityāgnihotraprasaṅga iva kāmanātau viśeṣagrahaṇa- masti |
na coktatantrodāharaṇadvaye nimittato viśeṣagrahaṇa- masti yathā vaiśyanimittakasādhanadvaye nityapādyadravyasya prasaṅgasiddhau |
na ca tantrodāharaṇadvaye dravyadevatā''khya- rūpato viśeṣagrahaṇamasti, yathā paśuke : 'pṛṣadājyenānu- yājān yajati ' iti pṛṣadājyadravyakairanuyājaiḥ kevalājya-

nāpi pūrvoktatantrodāharaṇadaye saṃkhyātaḥ kālo vā viśeṣa- grahaṇamasti, yathā pāśukeḥ prayājaiḥ 'tiṣṭhantaṃ paśuṃ prayajanti' iti tiṣṭhati paśau apakṛṣyamāṇaiḥ 'ekādaśa prayājān yajati' ityekādaśasaṃkhyākaiśca, pauroḍāśikānāṃ ‘āsanneṣu haviḥṣu prayajanti’ iti havirāsādanottara- kālavihitātāṃ pañcasaṃkhyānāṃ ca ātideśikānāṃ prayājānāṃ prasaṅgasiddhau|

na ca prāguktatantrodāharaṇadaye mantrataḥ kartṛto vā viśeṣagrahaṇamasti, yathā savanīyapaśau maitrā- varuṇakartṛkāt 'abhimanaṃ hotāramaṇītāṃ sutāhutī yaja- mānaḥ' iti agnīṣomīyāt ātideśāt sakṛttvātpraiṣāt tantriṇi savanīyahavirvijñānāṃ maitrāvaruṇarahitānāṃ prasaṅgo- pakāritve|
tasmāt saptathā viśeṣagrahaṇe tantraṃ bhavatīti siddham, saptadhā ca viśeṣagrahaṇe
nahi teṣāmupattyapūrve sākṣāt sādhya- mapi prayojakam, akāryatvāt |
nahi utpattyapūrve kāryam, kintu tena paramāpūrvam |
akāryaṃ ca na prayojakam iti paramāpūrvameva sa-dvārāṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ prayojakam, tadvat kāmā- dhikāre phalamapi apūrvadvāreṇa sādhanaṃ prayukte iti |
yadi hi utpattyapūrvata paramāpūrvamapi svātantryeṇa prayojakaṃ bhavitumakṣam, tat tadeva prayojakasya phalasya dvārābhavet |
tattu svayameva prādhānyena kāryamavyavahitaṃ ca phalapekṣayā prathamapratītaṃ ca kimiti vyavahitaparam apratītaphalaprayukti pratīkṣate ? aupādānikaṃ hi phalasya sādhyatvam |
tena pratipannaniyoga- viśiṣṭaniyojyasaṃbandhādhīnatvāt yuktameva caramaprati- pannatvam |
nanu kāmyeṣu phalakaraṇībhūtasya viṣayatvāt phala- sādhyatvapuraḥ sarameva niyogasādhyatvam |
nūnaṃ bhavān yathā- śakti nirṇaye'pi na samyagālocitapūrvā |
tatra hi niyogasādhyatvanirapekṣasya phalasya karmasādhyatve nirūpyamāṇe apūrvābhidhānaprādhānyādirūpaṇāt pradarśita eva |
tena niyogaḥ svayameva prayukti- sāmarthyāt anyavadhānācca na phalasya karma prayuñjānasya dvārābhavitumarhati, atatprayuktatvāt |

utpattyapūrvāṇāṃ hi svayamakāryatvāt paramāpūrvasiddhayupāyatvena prayuktakārya- tvāni yuktāṃ yat paramāpūrvasya karmaprayojakasya dvāraṃ bhavanti iti paramāpūrve tāvat kāryam, tacca na ṛte avāntarāpūrvebhyaḥ sidhyati iti tānyapi kartavyāni |
tāni ca karmādhīnasiddhīni iti karmāpi kartavyamiti |
anena hi krameṇa apūrve sādhanatānuṣṭhāpakaṃ bhavati |
na ca evaṃ phalakartavyatvādhīna apūrvakartavyatvam, tasya svayameva kāryatvāt |

yacca yasya na prayojakam, tat tadvāreṇa anyasya prayojakaṃ bhavati iti kutaḥ ? etat ? tat siddhaṃ kāmādhikāre'pi vidhereva prayojakatvam, na naimittika- kāmādhikārāyoḥ kaścit prayutkalpanāviśeṣa iti |
yāgasya tatsādhanatā ca kalpyā, prayojakatvaṃ tu samānameva |
tāvat pakṣadvaye'pi phalāpūrveyoḥ, ubhayatra vā apūrvasya aviśiṣṭaiva |
kāmādhikāre tu aprasiddhamapūrvarūpaṃ tasya phalasādhanatvam, yāgasya tatsādhanatvaṃ ca kalpyam, iti viśeṣaḥ |
athāpi nāma kāmādhikāre na prayutkalpanā, tathāpi apūrvarūpaṃ dharmi, tasya ca phalasādhanatvam, yāgasya tatsādhanatā (ca) kalpyā |
tasmāt śrutyabādhāt kalpanālāghavācca naimitti- kalameva yuktam, na kāmādhikāratvamiti |
kathaṃ punaḥ yacchabdādivirahiṇo nimittatvam ? na vayaṃ śrutaṃ nimi- ttatvaṃ brūmaḥ, kintu jañjabhyamānavat kāmanāviśiṣṭasya niyojyatvāt arthāt nimittatvaṃ kāmanayāḥ kalpyate |
' yacchabdo hi uddeśyamātraṃ pratipādayati, na nimittatvam |
anupādeyaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭasya uddeśyasya niyojyatvena gṛhadāhādimataḥ anyāt viśeṣaṇabhūtasya dāhasya ārthikaṃ nimittatvamucyate |
tacca phalakāmasyāpi niyojyasya uddiśyatvāt tatkāmanāyā api aviśiṣṭamiti yuktaṃ nimittatvam |
bahuśaśca yacchabdādi śrūyate 'yaḥ prajākāmaḥ paśukāmaḥ syāt' 'yadi kāmayeta varṣukaḥ parjanyaḥ syāt' ityādiṣu, iti na nimittatvapara- tve kaścit viśeṣaḥ |
nanu nityāni darśapūrṇamāsādikarmāṇi, na tāni naimittikāni bhavituṃ prabhavanti |
yadi tāvat niyamena kriyeran tato naimittikavidhānārthakyam |
atha tadaṃśena nimitte sati anuṣṭhānam, tato yāvajjīvavidhe- rārthakyam |
yadi hi ubhayapakṣasādhāraṇaṃ vākyaṃ syāt, tataḥ asmin pakṣe arthavattvaṃ samāśrīyeta |
atra tu śrutya- bādhanādiyuktidakadamyakena nimittatvameva avadhīyate |
yadi tathā sati ānarthakyamanyatarasya bhavati bhavatu, nahi ānarthakyaṃ nāma śrutipramāṇavarge antarbhavati |
āvṛttirhi prayogasya dākṣāyaṇayajñavat arthavattvāstu, na tu arthāntarakalpanā śakyate kartum |
athavā naimittike'nuṣṭhānasya yāva- jīvakālatvāt yāvajjīvavākyena lakṣaṇayā vidhīyate |
sā hi laukikī, liṅśabdasya tu arthāntarakalpanā ihaiva |

āśrīyatāṃ vā sūtra- bhāṣyārūḍhaṃ vārtikakārīyaṃ darśanam 'yāgādyavacchinnā bhāvanā vidhupatā puruṣāmilaṣitabhābhyāpekṣiṇī vākyena svargādikaṃ bhāvayatyā svīkaroti na nimittatā, tasya anepekṣitatvāt' iti |

tatra hi yāgādeḥ karaṇatvaṃ kalpitāpūrvadvāreṇa saṃbhavati, kāṣṭhakarṣaṇādīnāmiva jvalana- vilepanādidvāreṇa vrīhipākādisādhanatvam, āgneyādi- ṣaṭkasyeva utpattyapūrvadvāreṇa paramāpūrvasādhanatvam, abhya- goraṇādervā śataśātanādisādhanatvam |
' bhavatu vā darśapūrṇamāsādiṣu yāvajjīvaśruti- sadbhāvāt phalaparatvam |
yeṣu tu sauryādiṣu nityaśruti- rnāsti, tatra kim ānarthakyaparihārāya phalaparatvamaṅgī- kriyate ? athāyamabhiprāyaḥ 'darśādāveva vācya- tvamapūrvetyāvadhāritam |

' yāvajjīva- śrutyanarthakyaparihārameva tāvat 'darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svarga- kāmo yajeta' ityādiṣu phalaparatve kāmaśabdasyādhārite sati atatsādhane kāminaḥ kāryavāgamānupapatteḥ, karmaṇaśca kṣaṇabhaṅgurasya tatsādhanabhāvāsaṃbhavāt tadatiriktameva sthāsnu kāryaṃ liṅśabdaḥ pratipādayati ityavagate 'sauryādiṣu liṅśruteḥ karmaṇi tadatirikte vā pakṣapātābhāvāt kāma- svabhāvāmbhārthe phalaparatvameva yuktamiti |

' yadyapi liṅśabdasya loke kriyāyāṃ prayogāt, darśapūrṇamāsādi- vākyeṣu ca apūrve prayogāt ubhayānugatakāryasāmānya- vācinaḥ kriyā'tirikta'pi kāryaviśeṣe nāsti abhidhānanyāyāt, tathāpi sāmānyasya viśeṣāpekṣayāyāṃ samānapadopādānalakṣaṇayā śrutyā prakṛtyupāyo bhāvārtha eva viśeṣatvena saṃbadhyamāno na padāntaropāsanīyoya- viśeṣaṇībhūtakāmanāsvābhāvyālliṅvaśena nivārayituṃ śakyate |
ucaran eva hi pratyayaḥ svārthe sāmānyamapi prakṛtyarthānurūpameva abhidhatte |
yathoktam 'prātipadikā- duccarantī dvitīyā (yādi) vibhaktiḥ prātipadikārtho viśeṣakaḥ : ityāha ( iti bhā. 11|1|726 pṛ. 99 ) |
'te kila manyante 'apūrva- syābhidheyatve kriyā lākṣaṇikī bhavet |

' yadā hi phalakāminiyojyasambhabhiyāhārāt kriyā'tiriktamapūrve liṅyabhidheyamāsthitam, tadā na kriyāyā api tadabhidheyatvaṃ sukalpam, anekārthatvasya anyāvyatvāt, kriyāpratītau ca lakṣaṇayā'pi upapatteḥ |
apūrvakāryatā hi kriyākāryatvāvinābhūtā śabdenāvagatā tadupasthāpayati iti nābhiyetvasaṃbhavaḥ |
na ca sauryādiṣu lakṣaṇā- kāraṇamasti ityapūrvameva tattadarthairliṅādibhiḥ abhidhīyate |
ato na yuktaḥ kāmanāsvabhāvaṅgena nimittaparatvā- bhyupagamaḥ ( iti |
tat dūyati - ) idaṃ tu teṣāmabhi- mānamātramiti prāmāṇikā na śraddadhati |
' na tāvat laukikāḥ 'gāmānaya' ityādiṣu liṅaḥ ( liṅa- thaiva loṭaḥ ) lakṣaṇayā śruti manyante, kintu mukhyata- yaiva |
tatra yadi kriyākāryaṃ mukhyayā vṛttyā abhidhīyamāne śakyatvakalpanā āpatet, tato lākṣaṇikatvamabhyupa- gamyeta, na tvetadasti, ekayaiva kāryamātrāmidhānaśaktyā ubhayatra mukhyatvopapatteḥ |
anekārthatvaṃ hi anekāśakti- kalpanādoṣāt anyārthaṃ na svarūpeṇa, mā duṣi nānā- vidhinityākāmyāprakṛtatvānnityādiṣvavadhāryatāṃ tadabhidheyatvam |
ato yathā teṣāṃ kāryatvarūpopalakṣaṇayogyāt tadabhidheyatvaṃ bhavati, evaṃ kriyāyā api tapasvintyāḥ tadyogāt tada- bhidheyatvaṃ bhaviṣyati |
hi prakṛtyāpatte tasya kartavyatārūpaṃ viśeṣaṇameva liṅgā pratipādayitavyam |
apūrve tu nānyena kena cit prāptam, iti liṅaiva kartavyatāviśiṣṭaṃ tatsvarūpamabhidhātavyam iti naikaprakārasaṃbhavaḥ |
yadi viśiṣṭābhidhāyī, tataḥ apūrvameva na kriyāmabhidhāsyāt |
atha viśeṣaṇābhidhāyī, tataḥ kriyā- meva, nāpūrvam abhidhayaditi |
sa yadā kriyāparo bhavati, tadā tatsvarūpasya prakṛtita eva prāptatvāt viśeṣaṇaparo bhavati |
tadyathā 'daṇḍī preṣānanvāha' iti viśiṣṭābhidhāyī api daṇḍiśabdo viśeṣaṇaparo bhavatyapi na lakṣaṇayā |
tathā kāryavacanaḥ śabdo'pi yadā kriyāyāṃ prayujyate, tadā kāryatvarūpaviśeṣaṇaparatvaṃ śrutivṛttaḥ san pratipadyate, naitāvatā lakṣaṇā bhavati ityumayatrāpi mukhyameva |
yastu vadati, 'nanu evaṃ sati kāmādhikāre'pi samānapadopāttatvātḥ evābhidheyaḥ syāt ityapūrvābhidhāna- munsīdet |
tena yadeva kāminiyojyasaṃbandhāt apūrvābhi- dhāyākatvamavagatam, tadā tannirvārhyaṃ kriyāyā lākṣaṇika- tvamapyavasthitam' iti |
sa evamanuśāsitavyaḥ, hanta kiṃ nāśrauṣīḥ 'yo hi pāṣāṇān bhakṣayati, īśvara- sya mudraśaktyo bhavanti' iti (bhā. 10|13|18) |
yo hi niyojyasaṃbandhāt liṅaśabdaṃ kriyārūpakāryaviśeṣa- vā cinam avagatamapi tat uddiśya apūrvaṃ nayati, sa kathaṃ sāmānyavācinamapūrve netuṃ na kṣameta |
tasmāt karta- vyatāsāmānyāvācī san api yatra phalakāmasya niyojya- tvam, tatra tadalena apūrvamabhidhatte, anyatra tu samāna- padopādānāt kriyām |
tena sāmānyavācitvāt liṅa- śabdasya yathā apūrvāṇāṃ tathogāt tadabhidheyatvam, evaṃ kriyāyā api kiṃ nopagamyate |
tatra etat syāt 'kṛtyadedyatā kartavyatā liṅabhidheyā upalakṣaṇam, sarvāṇi cāpūrvāṇi tadupaitāni iti yuktaṃ yat tairabhidhīyante iti |
kriyā- yāstu phalodeśādaprakṛtitvāt tasmikā kartavyatā iti kartavyatābhedāt nābhiyeyatvasaṃbhavaḥ' iti |
yadyapi laukikānāṃ gavānayanādīnāṃ na svātantryena kartavyatā avagatā, tathāpi vede sauryādi- yāgānāṃ tādṛśasyaiva kartavyatā bhaviṣyati |
svatantrakāryābhi- dhāyī hi liṅaśabdo yajinā samabhivyāhṛtaḥ, tameva tādṛśaṃ pratipādayati |
'na laukikakriyāyāḥ tādṛśī kartavyatā avagatapūrvā' iti cet, na |
lokānavagatā'pi vedā- deva tasya tādṛśī kartavyatā avagamyate iti cet, kriyāyāmapi tulyam |
nanu pratyakṣaviruddhā duḥkharūpāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ kathamāgamenāpi śakyate kartavyatā pratipā- yitum |
niyogamā vā (katham) bhagavadbhimānān-naika- raso yaḥ, tasya kartavyatā na pramāṇāntaraviruddhā syāt |
so''pi bahudravyavyayaprayāsasādhyo duḥkhākara eva na cetana- vyāpārasya uddeśyatāmanubhavitumarhati |
yathā tu tasya nityanirapekṣāmāmnāyāt kartavyatā, tathā kriyāyā api bhaviṣyati |
api ca niyogasya sukhaduḥkhaprāptiparihāravyatiriktasya kriyāvat na svātantryeṇa kāryatvamupapadyate |
kṛtirhi netanaprayatnarūpā icchāpūrvakatvāt tadarthameva gocarayitu- mahati |
icchā hi sukhaduḥkhaparihāragocaraiva iti sā'pi tadgocaraiva |
ato nāpūrvesya prādhānyamupapadyate iti yathā śaktinirṇaye varṇitam |
kiñca, nānyārthapravṛttakṛti- vyāpyatā''tmikā kriyāyāḥ kartavyatā iti bhavatā śakyate vaktum, icchāghātprasaṅgāt |

'loke hi kriyā- kāryābhidhāyitve liṅādīnāmavagate kriyārūpaviśeṣaṇa- parihāro na vede apūrvaparyantatāmātraṃ kāmapadasamabhi- vyāhārāt avagamyate' iti bhavatāṃ darśanam, tatra yadi anyārthapravṛttakṛtivyāpyatā''tmikākartavyatetyetā kriyā tadarthatvenāvagatā, hantā tarhi vede'pi tadapāparityāgena apūrvaparyantatāmātraṃ kalpanīyam iti apūrvaprādhānyamiṣṭaṃ vyāhantyeti |
svargakāmapadasamabhivyāhāro hi kriyārūpasyaiva viśeṣasya paripanthī, na tu anyopasarjanatvam |
yo hi svatantrakāryābhidhāyī liṅādīnāmivṛtti, sa vaktavyaḥ kimatra te pramāṇamiti |
vyāhārāt anyopasarjanaṃ kriyā'tiriktaṃ kāryaṃ sidhyati' iti, pratibrūyādena na, viparītasādhanatvāditi |
kāmapadasamabhivyāhāro hi anyopasarjanakāryābhidhāne evaṃ pramāṇam, na svātantrye |

sa hi svarge kāmayamānaḥ tatkāmitvena rūpeṇa tadupasarjanaṃ kāryaṃ boddhumalama, ityanena hetunā tatsādhanatvayogakriyāparityāgena tadanukūlāpūrvābhi- dhānaṃ liṅādīnāmupepamete, tat kathaṃ svapramāṇaviruddhaprādhānyā- bhyupagamam |
nanu vastuvṛttyā phalānuguṇamapi na tathā śabdena abhidhātavyam, kimetāvatā svapradhānabhūtamatamabhidhātavyam, nahi prādhānye kaścidapi pramāṇalavaḥ samasti |
apica niyojyapadasaṃbandhādevaṃ kalpayitavyam, yādṛśaṃ kāryarūpaṃ phalakāmī 'mamedaṃ kāryam' iti boddhumalama, tādṛśa- mabhidhātavyam |
sa ca svakāmānuguṇameva boddhumarhati iti tadeva abhidhātavyam ajñāpūrvavat |

yo hi 'prayājādiṣyāpūrve viniyuktaviṣayatayā svatantrī- bhavitumasamartham iti svaśabdena adhikāravākyaniśita- pradhānakāryābhidhānaśaktima'pi lakṣaṇayā anyopasarjanī- bhūtam abhidhīyate' iti vadati, sa katham (hāsyo na syāt ityuttaramenāntaḥ ), kāmādhikāravākyādanyatra aviditapradhānakāryābhidhānasāmarthyena pratyuta lokāvagata- guṇabhūtakāryābhidhānasamarthena kāmapadasamabhivyāhārācca apūrvābhidhānapramāṇatvāt avaśyambhāvāttvena liṅa- śabdena karaṇībhūtaviṣayatayā ca tadeva viniyukta- viṣayatayā pratyudaprādhānyamapūrve pradhānatayaiva lokasvapramāṇa- svaviṣayaviruddham abhidhīyate' iti vadan hāsyo na syāt |
tat ubhayatrāpi guṇabhūtakāryābhidhānaśaktyā ekayaiva mukhyalopapatteḥ na kriyāyāḥ lākṣaṇikatvam |
etena naimittikādhikāre'pi kāmādhikāravyutpatyanu- sārāt anyārthasyaiva apūrvasyābhidhānāt tadupapattaye niyojyavat phalamavaśyaṃ kalpanīyamiti darśitam |

yadyapi niyogasya kṛtyadedyatayā pradhānasya anyādaśī kartavyatā, kriyāyāśca anyoddeśapravṛttakṛtitryāpyatayā guṇabhāvāt anyādaśī kartavyatā, tathāpi ubhayatra yujya- mānasya liṅaśabdasya gośabdasyeva khaṇḍādiṣu prādhānya- guṇabhāvābhyām khaṇḍatvādiviśeṣaṇabhāveneva sarvānugataṃ kāryasamānārthaṃ golamiva vācyaṃ syāt |
anekatra prayuktasya śabdasya sarvatra mukhyalopapattau anyāyā lakṣaṇā |
tadetat kaṣilādhikaraṇe (11|1|8|18) bhagavatā bhāṣyakāreṇa mahatā prabandhena sādhitamapi svasamarthanatamasa- tiraskṛtadṛṣṭibhiḥ nālocitam |

etena 'gāmānaya' ityādiṣu kāryānvito prayogatāt, tathā 'nayāstīre phalāni santi' ityādiṣu siddhārthatve prayogatāt, ubhayānugatākāṅkṣitasaṃnihitayogyārthamātrānvitasvārthā- midhāyitvāt gavādiśabdānāṃ kāryānvitābhidhāyitvaṃ nirastam |

yadi hi anekatra prayujyamānasyāpi śabdasya sarvānugata- sāmānyasadbhāve'pi tadācitvenamabhyupetya vyutpatyavasarāt- gataviśeṣavācitvena anyatra lākṣaṇikī vṛttirupa- gamyeta, tato vṛddhavyavahāre pramāṇena tadābhāsena vā vaktu- buddhyārūḍhe arthe śabdaprayogatā tadāvidhaḥ eva sarva- śabdānāmidheyaḥ syāt, vede cāpauṣeye tadasaṃbhavāt apratipādakatvam, vedasya pauruṣeyaṃ vā balādāpadyate iti aprāmāṇyaṃ syāt |

tathā liṅaśabdasyāpi vyutpatti- sthānābhimata kāmādhikāre phalakāminiyojyaphalānuguṇā- pūrvavācitvaṃ nyupabham iti naimittikābhidhādhikārayorapi vyutpatyanusāreṇa tathāvidhāpūrvābhidhānāt tadanusāreṇa phalaṃ tatkāmī ca niyojyaḥ kalpanīyaḥ iti sarvatra phalādhi- kārakatvaṃ jātedhivat syāt |
tasmāt siddhārthe'pi vedasya prāmāṇyāghātāt 'ānandaṃ brahma' ityādināṃ prāmāṇya- nirākaraṇaṃ nāstikatāmeva phalati, ityalamanena |
tasmānna kriyāyā lākṣaṇikatvam, iti sauryādiṣu liṅaśabdasya kāryasāmānyavācinaḥ samānapadopādānaśrutyā bhāvārthaviṣayatvāt tat mā bādhi iti nimittatvameva kāmanayāḥ bhavanmate syāt |
kriyāyāḥ phalapekṣatvāt tatparatvameva kāmaśabdasya, na nimittaparatvamanepekṣitatvāt ityameva nimittaparatvanirākaraṇahetuḥ, abhyudayamātraṃ tu nityatvam|
bhaṅgurāyā api kriyāyāḥ phalasādhanatvam avāntaravyāpāradvāreṇa prāgeva samarthitam|
bahu eva hi tatrodāharaṇaṃ kāṣṭhādye-yāvagauravādinā iti nātra viśeṣaḥ manaḥ|
phale samāśrite'pi tat phalasya tasya vā|
yajiśca tantra sādhanaṃ trayaṃ vidheḥ tato'dhikam|
atha prayuktikalpanaṃ nimitta eva no phale|
🕮 ekārthastu vikalpena samuccaye hyāvṛttiḥ syāt pradhānasya |
ye tu guṇā ekārthā ekaphalakāḥ, te vikalperan, teṣāṃ vikalpaḥ syāt na samuccayaḥ |
samuccaye hi yasmāt pradhānasya āvṛttiḥ syāt |
tasmāt ekārthānāṃ vikalpaḥ yathā brīhiyavayoḥ yathā vā khādirālādīnām |
ekārthānāmapi na vikalpaḥ kintu brīhiyavādidam abhyasyate |
'saṃsave ume kuryāt' 'gosave ume kuryāt' ityādī sati tu samuccaye abhyāsaśāstratvāt abhyāsaśāstrasya yuktatvāt |
asati tu vikalpa eva ekārthānāṃ yuktaḥ |
'bailyo vā khādire vā pālāśo vā anyeṣāṃ yajñakratūnāṃ yapā bhavanti, athaitasya khādira eva kāryaḥ' iti vājapeye khādirasya niyamaṃ vadan anyatra vikalpavat vikalpayuktamanuṣṭhānaṃ darśayati |
yaduktaṃ (11 sūtre) guṇāntarasya arthavattvāya abhyāsa iti, trocyate |

māsayormīhimiḥ prayogaḥ, caitre kriyamāṇayoḥ yavaiḥ prayogaḥ |

🕮 kathaṃ na (āmiṣāvājinayoḥ) samuccayaḥ ? (uttaram) 'ekārthastu0' iti hi śāstralyatat |
āmiṣāvākye nirapekṣābhiṣā- sādhanakatvena avagate yāge samuccayavidhyayogāt vāja- yogasya copalakṣaṇamātropapatteḥ na vacanāt samuccaya- siddhiḥ |
agniṣṭome 'bṛhat pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati' 'rathaṃtaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati' ityāmnāyate |
pṛṣṭhastotraniṣādanām eko'rthaḥ : bṛhato rathaṃtarasya ca, tasmāccobhayadharmāḥ |
dharmāṇām avibhāgaḥ syāt vibhāgo vyavasthā na syāt |
'noccaigeyam, na calavadeyam' 'rathaṃtare pratyayamāne saṃmīyeta (netre), svahaṃśaṃ prati (svargaskandocāraṇakāle) vīkṣeta' ityādayo rathaṃtara- dharmāḥ |
'uccaigeyam, bṛhati gīyamāne samudraṃ manasā dhyāyet' ityādayo bṛhaddharmāḥ |
nirdeśād 'bṛhat pṛṣṭham' 'rathaṃtaraṃ pṛṣṭham' iti medena nirdeśād |

ityatra, 'rathaṃtare pratyayamāne saṃmīyeta' 'bṛhati pratyayamāne samudraṃ manasā dhyāyet' ityādau pratiniyamanirdeśā'''nupapattyā apūrva- sādhanībhūtaryaṃtaratvādi lakṣaṇapakṣasyāpi āśrayaṇāt na dharmāṇāṃ sārthakyam iti vakṣyate |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ 'idaṃ brahmaṇaḥ idaṃ hotuḥ' ityādinā caturdhākaraṇamāsatāṃ bahūnāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ śeṣeṇa saṃbandhaḥ kartavya iti |
śatakṛṣṇā carī tu sarve bhāgāḥ brahmaṇe eva parihṛtāḥ |
tasmādatra avibhāgaḥ syāt vibhāgaḥ caturdhā- karaṇaṃ na syāt |
manuvatpakṣe tu ekārthatvena- mapi ṛṣyantaraiḥ svīkṛtam |
bhākto hi anyāsu aṣṭamīṣu ekā- ṣṭakāśabdaḥ |
eṣā hi mukhyā yā mādhyāṃ vṛttā |
ekāhāḥ somavikārā gavādayaḥ darśapūrṇamāsābhyāmuccaiḥ syuḥ ; na prāk |
vi. 5|3|144, ekāhe upahavye kratau 'aśvaḥ syāvo rukmalatāṭo dakṣiṇā, sa brahmaṇo deyaḥ' |
ekāhe tu ekatvādeva vibhāgāsaṃbhavāt samaste (sāmanī) 'jyogama- yāvinaḥ ume kuryāt' iti |
vi. 10|3|114, ekāhe viśvajiti paridhānārthā vatsalatvaṃ vihitā |
idam 'atideśaḥ gavāmayana- gata0' iti vindī draṣṭavyam |

🕮 'ete pakṣāḥ punaryo'yā vyatikīrṇāḥ : para- sparam' (vā. 1|3|130 pṛ. 293) iti nyāyena
pravṛttyanupapatteḥ ahaṃpratyayena ca dehe'pi dṛṣṭena sphuṭatayā |
vihitau puroḍāśau punaḥ ' asomayājinaḥ ' tau vidhīyate |
iti, yaṃ śucimeva vidyāḥ iti vaditavye ' yameva vidyāḥ |
agniṣṭomasya eva jyotiṣṭomaḥ parāmṛśyate, na tu |
pṛ. 82. ' eṣa vāva prathamo yajño yajñānām ' atra |
purohitasya ceti dvayordharmānāmnayoḥ eko yajño vihitaḥ |
prathamo yajño yajñānām ' ityatra vākyārtho vicāryate |
atra agniṣṭomasya prāthamyaṃ na vidhīyate nāpi uttareṣāṃ |
prāthamyaṃ pratiṣidhyate, kintu idaṃ vākyam agniṣṭomasya pūrva |
yajeta ' ityatra karmāntaramevadharmakam, na tu guṇāt phalam |
gavādīnāmajñam anena vākyena coyate iti vārtika- |
uktaiva aveṣṭiḥ gṛhyate phalavidhānārtham, na karmāntaram |
guṇasya āgneyasya ca niyamaḥ parasparavyācchedakatvaṃ syāt |
karmyāt, ekaṃ karma ekāyapadaṃ yasmin padasamūhe, tat eka- |
brāhmaṇasya lakṣaṇaṃ ' mantrabhinnatve sati vedabhāgalatvam ' iti |
syāt (3|1|6|12) ekasya śabdasya ekārthitvameva yuktaṃ na |
na ca atideśenaiva tatra tatrātisaṃbhave punastadvidhivaiyarthyamiti vācyam |
na caivaṃ saiva doṣaḥ, niṣādasthapatyadhikaraṇanyāyena kālalakṣaṇapekṣayā tasyā adoṣāt |

vastutastu ati- deśena sarvatra saṃbhavatprāptikāyā ekādaśinyāḥ vihāra- vidhineva ekaikapañcatirupadaśapaśūnāṃ dvādaśasvapi sutāsu parisaṃkhyāsiddhau prāyaṇīyodanīyayoḥ aprāptāyā ekā- daśinyāḥ vidhānena vaiyarthyābhāvaḥ |
ataśca pratipradhānaṃ guṇāvṛtternyāyatvāt prāyaṇīye saṃpūrṇaikādaśinī, udayanīye ca saṃpūrṇā, iti na vibhajya tasyāḥ prayogaḥ |
daśarātre ca naikātiriktānāṃ daśānāṃ paśūnāṃ pañce'pyūhatā, iti teṣāṃ tatra vācaḥ |
iti prāpte, neyamaprāptaparisaṃkhyā, prāyaṇīyo- danīyayoḥ tadvidhinā itarasutāsu tadvidheye nairākāṅkṣyā- pādanāsaṃbhavena tatra tadvidhaye atideśapratibandhakatvāt |
ataśca sarvatra tatrāsau ca cittaddhiḥ svavaiyarthyaparihārā- rtham itaratra tatparisaṃkhyāṃ sūcayatītyevaṃ vidhayā ayaṃ pari- saṃkhyāvidhirabhavet |
na cāsyāpūrvavidhitvam, dvayoḥ paśvayoḥ parasparanirapekṣyeṇa yugapatpravṛttayoḥ pūrvāparye pramāṇābhāvāt |
prāya- ṇīyādau ekasya payorvihāravidhinaiva prāptau daśanāmeva tatra vidhāne ekādaśinapade'nurūpyāpatteḥ |
na caivamādi- dūṣaṇānāṃ kālalakṣaṇā'pekṣayā phalamūlatvam, adhi- karaṇatvāccintyaḥ |
vastutastu, saptamyo'dhikaraṇatvaṃ dvedhā, kālikaṃ daiśikaṃ ca, 'paurṇamāsyām' ityādī kālike'pi prayogāt |
ataśca saptamye kālike adhikaraṇatve kālopādhiva- saṃgena prāyaṇīyodanīyayoranvayāt na kālalakṣaṇā'pi |
ata eva 'janmamātraṃ kālepādhiḥ' iti mate 'ghaṭe kālikasaṃbandhena paṭaḥ' ityatra na lakṣaṇā |
ataśca ekā- daśinānuvādena vidheyakālatvaviśeṣaṇabhūtayoḥ prāyaṇīyo- nīyayoḥ dvaṃdvopattāsāhityasya vivakṣitatvāt militā ekādaśinā dvādaśasutā'ṅgabhūtā api ubhayana kāryaḥ |
evaṃ ca daśarātrāṅgavyāpī caudako'pi na bādhito bhavati |
evaṃ vihārapakṣe'pi 'anvaham' ityanena kālasyaiva vidhānāt sarvasutā'ṅgabhūtaikādaśinī vihvaya kartavyā |
na tu ekaikasutāyāṃ ekaikaḥ paśurdvaṃ- daśapaśuprāpticodakabādhāpatteḥ |
ata eva daśāhāntargataika- sutāmātravikāre ekādaśau prākṛtasthānarūpakālābhāve'pi pakṣadvaye'pi 'guṇalope ca mukhyasya' iti nyāyena (10|2|23|64) sakalaikādaśinīprāptirviruddhā |
prāya- ṇīyodanīyayormelanena ca prāyaṇīye paśū, udayanīye ṣaṭ, ityevaṃrūpam, avaśiṣṭasya antimasya tatraiva kartavyatvāt |
✱ ekādaśinānāṃ samastānāṃ jyotiṣṭome ālabham ! bhā. 10|6|4|6, ✱ ekādaśineṣu paśūṣu upayajñahome aneka- gudānāṃ samuccayaḥ, na vikalpaḥ |
bhāṣyam-- ekādaśineṣu te medana kummādīni syuḥ, saṃdehāt |
yattu saṃdehāditi, arthācciddhaṃ kiñcitkariṣyate, yena viśeṣagrahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati |
ayājyatvād vasānāṃ bhedaḥ syāt, khyāḍyā- pradānatvāt |
na ca vasānāṃ liṅgaṃ kartuṃ śakyam |
apivā pratipattitvāt tantraṃ syāt, svatva- syāśrutibhūtatvāt |
bhāṣyam-- apivā tantraṃ kummī syāt prati- pattitvāt |
atyantasaṃyuktā vasāḥ, tāḥ khyāḍyā'rdhacante eva hutā bhavanti |
nātra śrūyate khyāḍyā'rdhacante hotavyā na parayājyā'rdhacante iti |
tasmāt paratra homo na doṣāya, nāpyudayāya |

tathā ca saumye paśau ekādaśineṣu paśuṣu dvairaśyaṃ samānaṃ dvairaśyam |
ekādaśinā api sutyāyāmeva bhavanti, yadi bhavanti |

' bhāṭṭa-- yatra tu mijadevatākatvam, tatrāpi sajātīyapaśusthale cihnakaraṇena sahaśrapaṇasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt vasāyāḥ saṃsṛṣṭatve'pi tattadyājyā'rdhantikālasya medāt medenaiva vasāhomaḥ |
prakṛtau hi yājyāthatvena kṛtatvāt vasāhomāryātvābhāvena paraprayuktājyā'rdha- cantikālasyaiva paśūnuniṣpannatvapratiyathavasāhomāṅga- tvāvagateḥ |
na ca vasāyāḥ saṃsṛṣṭatvāt sakṛt kṛtenaiva sarvapratipattisiddheḥ kālabhedena gṛhyamāṇaviśeṣatve- 'pi tajjanyoṣakārasya sattvena itareṣu prasaṅgena kāryasiddha- papatternadvirāvṛttiriti vācyam |

saṃsṛṣṭatve'pi sakṛdamedena śeṣasya anapāyāt kṣīranīravivekinyā devatayā tattadyāgīyavasāyā eva tattadyājyā'rdhante grahaṇe yāgāntarīyavasāyāḥ sakṛdamedena hutatvāvajarnīyatayā yāgāntarīyavasāpakṣe'pi tadyāgasamānakālatvathasyaiva tattatpratipattiyā punastadāṣṭrayupapatteḥ |

ataḥ pratipattirūpa- prayojakajanyoṣakārasya dṛṣṭarūpasya śeṣāntarasyenopapatteḥ niyamādṛṣṭopakārasyakasyāpi ca bhāvittavadyāgopatyapūrvaṇaiva nāśāt pratipattikāryyarūpaprayojakastvena āvṛttyaiva karaṇam |
yatra tu pākavaiṣamyāt vijātīyapaśusthale medena śrapaṇam, tatra vasāyāḥ asaṃsṛṣṭatvādāṣṭridaivatāmede spaṣṭaiva |
gavāmayane satre dvādaśāt codakena vyanīkā prāptā |
tatra ca ahyāṃ bhūyastvāt vyanīkāparivṛttiḥ kartavyā |
sā ca vyanīkāpari- vṛttiḥ ekādaśinavat syāt |
yathā gavāmayane eva ekādaśināḥ paśavaḥ daṇḍakalitavat āvartyante tathā vyanīkā api daṇḍakalitavat āvartanīyāḥ |
navāhami- kāryā vyanīkā ekā anuṣṭhitāyām, punaḥ sā tathaiva tenaiva krameṇa anuṣṭhātavyā, evaṃ punaḥ punaḥ |
kṣetrādi- māpate yathā viśiṣṭo daṇḍaḥ saṃpūrṇaḥ punaḥpurāvartyate tadvat |
ahrāṃ navānām apratyakṣasaṃkhyatvāt ahrāṃ saṃkhyā na pratyakṣā |
pratyakṣā saṃkhyā yeṣāṃ tānya- hāni pratyakṣasaṃkhyāni, na tathā iti apratyakṣasaṃkhyāni, tasya bhāvāt |
khasva prathamāyā aindravāyavāgatāḥ yat sthānaṃ prathamamaḥ tasya vivṛddhiḥ kartavyā |
vyanīkāyāḥ hi nava ahāni, teṣu nava agratāḥ krameṇa vihitā dvādaśāhe |
gavāmayane tu sarvāṇi ahāni navadhā vibhajya ekaikasmin viṃśati- dinātmakame bhāge krameṇa ekaikā agratā saṃpādanīyā |
prathame viṃśatidinātmakame bhāge aindravāyavāgatā, dvitī- yāyāṃ viṃśatau śukrāgatā, tṛtīyasyāṃ viṃśatau āgrayaṇā- gratā, caturthau viṃśatau punaḥ aindravāyavāgatā ityevaṃrītyā sthānavivṛddhiḥ |
pṛṣṭhāvṛttau cāgrayasya darśanāt ayakhiśo parivṛttau punaraindravāyavaḥ syāt |
atha siddhānte hetvantaraṃ pūrvapakṣe ca dohamāha |
uttara- smin pakṣasi parivṛttau pratilomena pṛṣṭhāvṛttau pṛṣṭhāgrasya ṣaḍahasya āvṛttau ayakhiśe āgrayasya darśanāt sthāna- vivṛddhyā āvṛttitargate |
daṇḍakalitavat āvṛttau tu punaḥ aindravāyavaḥ syāt, trayastriṃśe aindravāyavaḥ syāt taccā'yuktam |

tathāhi sthānavivṛddhipakṣe gavāmayane ādyorahoḥ yat vācanikam aindravāyavāgratvaṃ tadvirodhābhāvena ādita ārabhyaiva pravartamānā vyanīkā pūrvasmin pakṣasi navadhā vibhakte ( 180÷9 = 20 ) parisamāpyate |
atha prātilomena pravattasya uttarasya pakṣasaḥ prathamabhāgāte trayastriṃśe āgrayaṇāgratā bhavati ( ṣaḍehani ) |
tadeta- duktaṃ pṛṣṭhāvṛttau trayastriṃśe āgrayasya darśanāt iti |
daṇḍakalitavadāvṛttapakṣe tu prātilomena pravattasya uttarasya pakṣasaḥ uttare trayastriṃśe aindravāyavāgratā prāpnoti |
tadittham, pūrvapakṣasi vyanīkā niveśamānā āye dve ahanī varjayitvā bhavati |

pratyakṣāmānāt daṇḍakalitapakṣe tu dvitīye''hani aindravāyavā- gratāyā abhāvāt śiṣṭeṣu ahaḥsu niveśamānāyāḥ ekona- viṃśativāram āvṛttāyāḥ vyanīkāyāḥ ( 180-2=178 = [ 9 ×19 = 171+7 ] ) sapta ahāni śiṣyante |

tato viṣuvān śukrāgraḥ; tataḥ prathamaḥ kharasāmā āgrayaṇāgraḥ; tataḥ dvitīyaḥ kharasāmā aindravāyavāgraḥ; tataḥ tṛtīyaḥ kharasāmā śukrāgraḥ; tato viśvajit āgra- yaṇāgraḥ; tataḥ ṣaḍaha āvṛtaḥ prayujyate |
tasya ādyasya prathamamahaḥ trayastriṃśam, tat aindravāyavāgraṃ prāpnoti |
pūrvapakṣiṇā dṛṣṭāntatayā yaduktam ekādaśinavat iti, tadyuktam |
ekādaśineṣu paśuṣu parivṛttiḥ 'vāpaṇamantaḥ, punaḥparyyeṣu āmeyemeva prathame''hyameta' iti vacanāt syāt |
liṅgasya darśanāt ekādaśināḥ paśavaḥ gavāmayane daṇḍakalitavat āvartante iti 'prāṇā vā ekādaśināḥ, yadekādaśinībhirīḥ ahānyatiricyante paśavo vā' iti |
daṇḍakalita- vadāvṛttau tu nyūnatā atiriktā vā bhavati |
dravyavikāraṃ tu pūrvapadyarthaṃ syāt, tathā vikalpe niyamaḥ, pradhānatvāt |
na caitat śṛtaṃ dadhi ca ka cidupa- yuktam |
tasmāttena jāghanīdravyeṇa dadhitābhyāṃ ca arthakarma syāt, na pratipattiḥ |
soma-- pūrvatra dravyasya ( ekādiśogravyasya ) guṇa- tvāt astu vikalpaḥ |
iha tu jāghanīnāṃ pratipādyatayā samuccayaḥ ityuciteḥ saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu-- dravyavikārāt jāghanyāladravyasya niyamalakṣaṇavikāre'pi prakṛtitvat arthakarmedama, prakṛtitvat vikalpe prāpte niyamārthatvāt, punarvidhānañca niyamasya ca yathāprāpti vakṣyavāditi |
vi-- 'samuccayo jāghanīnāṃ na vā, ''tho gudavat, na tat |
' bhāṭṭa-- paśuguṇe atideśaprāptanīsāyeṣu jāgha- nīnāṃ samuccayau vikalpo vā iti cintāyām, darśa tāvat patnīsaṃyājānāmarthakarmatvāt ājyena saha jāghanyā vikalpena guṇabhāva avivāda eva |

daikṣe'pi ca tathaiva atideśena prāptau punaḥśrūyamāṇaṃ 'jāghanyā patnīsaṃyājaṃ yajati' iti vacanaṃ lāghavāt ājyavyāvṛttiphalaka- jāghanīyamātrameva, na tu patnīsaṃyājānāṃ jāghanīprati- patyarthatvena vidhānārtham, satyapyatra jāghanyāḥ pratipasya- pekṣatve patnīsaṃyājānāmaprākṛtakāryakāritve prasaṅgena prati- patyarthatvakalpanā''nupapatteḥ |

ata eva asya vacanasya niyamamātraparatve'pi prajājaśeṣābhidhāraṇanyāyena pārtha- sārathyuktatadīyā niyamasyaiva jāghanīsaṃskārārthatvakalpanā- mityapi anāśaṅkyam, niyamasyāpi prakṛtau klaptaprayo- janatvāt |
asaduktarītyā patnīsaṃyājānāmeva pratipasya- ntaravidhikalpanā tu anāśaṅkyaiva |

ataścānena vacanena yathāprāptā guṇabhūtayā vivakṣitasaṃskārayā niyama- mātrakaraṇāt upādānalaghavānurodhena pratipatyantarābhāvena upasthitāyāstasyāgye pramāṇabhāvācca prakṛtagrahe'pi paśuguṇe ekasaṃkhyeyā eva vikalpena grahaṇam |
aikādarthyā niyampeta pūrvavatvād vikāro hi ( 8|1|16|8 ) itikartavyatāyāḥ pratyekavikāre sauryādau atideśayogāt 'aikādarthyā0' ityeṣṭamādhi- karaṇasiddhānto majyate |
'uttarādiḥ pūrvāntalakṣaṇam' iti kalpa- sūtrakṛdvacanasya ca 'aikādarthya0vākyatā' iti nyāya- mūlatvāt tasya lakṣaṇasvarūpamucyate ityāha |
nyāyena tu ( kalpa- ) sūtrakāraiḥ āmīyabrāhmaṇaviniyogeṣu etaduktamiti nyāyasya lakṣaṇamucyate |
ke. 'aikṣyavyau vidhutī ye ca te ikṣvayavavāmike |
loke siddhe, tathā vede kāśānāmeva mūlake |
' vā. 1|3|4 pṛ. 222, aikṣyavīśabdasya yadi tāvat vaidikaprayogalaghusamudāya- prasiddhatvena laukikīm avayavaprasiddhaṃ jahāti, tataḥ siddhameva śāstrapravṛttipratipattilakṣaṇam |
'aikṣyavīśabdasya tu samudāyaprasiddheḥ balīyastvenāpi durlalaukikāvayavaprasiddhatvācca kāśamūlakatvameva avasīyate |
'aicchikaḥ dravyavikalpaḥ paśugrahaḥ iti siddhe'pi aya vā ayaṃ vā chāgaḥ iti |
'vaṭe vaiśravaṇaḥ' iti aitihyaṃ na pramiti- karaṇam |
ke. aindraḥ ekādaśapāle rājñaḥ ( kṣatriyasya ) yathe rājasūye |
sa eva ca sadharmakaḥ, anaindrā amarkāḥ, codakena sadharmakāḥ |
aindro rājanyaḥ iti aindraśabdaḥ arthavādaḥ, na guṇavidhiḥ |
mā. 1|4|12|1 23-2, 'aindro vṛṣṇiḥ ṣoḍaśini ālabhyaḥ' ? ( ṛtupaśuḥ savanīyasyeti ) |
tena aindreṣu somaḥ, anaindreṣu soma eva nāsti |
kathaṃ punarjāte aindraḥ somo gṛhyate ceti ? mantravarṇāt |
'indrāya tvā vasumata' ityevamādimantraḥ- aindraṃ somaṃ vadituṃ śaknoti, nānyam |
anyāni tu pradānāni sākāṅkṣāṇi, ato dharmān grahīṣyanti' iti nyāyāt |
'aindramekādaśa- kapālam ṛṣabho dakṣiṇā' aveṣṭiṣu dvitīyā rājasūye |
'aindramekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet' ityādau prākṛtapuroḍāśarmātideśaḥ, na tu sānāyyadharmā- tideśaḥ, devatāsāmānyāt haviḥsāmānyācca balavatvāt |
' atra asati prativacane phalamaihikaṃ sati tu āmuṣmikam |
4|3|12, 'aindramekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet prajākāmaḥ' ityādiḥ kāmyo yāgaḥ kāmanayā kartavyaḥ |
aindre ekādaśakapāle auṣadhasya āgneya- puroḍāśasya vidhvantaḥ |
bhā. 8|1|17|32-34, aindre puroḍāśe sānāyyavidhvantaḥ prāsaḥ āgneyavidhvantena bādhyate |
'aindravāyavaṃ gṛhṇāti' iti indravāyubhyāṃ saṃkalpayati ityetādavukaṃ bhavati |
tatra yāgamantareṇa saṃkalpayati iti etanna yujyate iti yāgaḥ kalpyeta |
aindravāyavasya prahasya kāmasaṃyoge'pi pāṭhaprāpte svasthāne evānuṣṭhānam, na tu sarvāditaḥ |
bhāṣyam -- atha yatra kāmasaṃyoge vacanamaindravāyavasya 'aindravāyavāgrān grahaṇān gṛhṇīyāt yaḥ kāmayeta yathāpūrvaṃ prajāḥ kalperan' iti |
tatra kiṃ sarvāditaḥ pratikarṣaḥ, uta tatrāpi svakramasthasya grahaṇamiti ? kiṃ prāptam ? pūrveṇādhikaraṇena ( 17 ) svakramasthasyeti |
vacanaṃ hi bhavati 'aindravāyavāgrān grahān gṛhṇīyāt, yaḥ kāmayeta yathāpūrvaṃ prajāḥ kalperan' iti, tat sarvāditaḥ pratikarṣe arthavat, agratāyāṃ vidhīya- mānāyām |
bhāṣyam -- na caitadasti, yaduktaṃ sarvāditaḥ prati- karṣaḥ iti |
yaduktaṃ agratā''bhidhānāt āditaḥ pratikarṣaḥ iti, tanna |
śrutirevamanugṛhyate, tvatpakṣe vākyam, śrutiśca vākyāt balīyasī |
atha yaduktam, apravṛttiviśeṣakaraṃ grahaṇavidhau iti, tatra |
eko'tra nityasya kāmasaṃyogaḥ, grahaṇena kāmaṃ sādhayet |
aparo nityasaṃyogaḥ, ye aindravāyavā grahāḥ, tān gṛhṇīyāt iti |
soma-- iha tarhi bhavatu āditaḥ pratikarṣaḥ ityuthānāt ( prayudāharaṇa -- ) saṃgatiḥ |
nanu agratāyāḥ kāmāya vidhāne ' vāgvā eṣā yadaindravāyavo, yadaindravāyavā grahā gṛhyante' iti vacanamanarthakaṃ syāt |
aindravāyavasya grahasya kāma 1314 aindravāyavasya grahasya maitrā
prakaraṇaprāptārthatvena vākyāt kevalaphalārthatvaprāptau pratiprasavāttattva vacanamarthavat iti cet |
pratiprasavārthatvābhāve'pi śukāgramatvādeḥ kāmyaguṇasya dhārā- grahemātrāśritatvalābhasya sannāvena vacanānarthakyā- bhāvāt |
vastutastu, 'vāgvai' ityādivākyasya prati- prasavārthatvaṃ na sambhavati |
vi— 'sarvādī svasya vā sthāne kāmyaḥ syādaindra- vāyavaḥ |

bhāṭṭa— tadavāntaraprakaraṇe eva (jyotiṣṭomādyāntara0) 'aindravāyavāgrān grahaṇ gṛhṇīyāt, yaḥ kāmayeta yathāpūrva prajāḥ kalperan' iti śrutaṃ phalaṃ kimu agratā rūpaguṇa- janyam, uta grahaṇajanyameveti bādhopayogitā cintā- yām, indriyakāmādhikāranyāyena (2|1|11) guṇa- janyameva |
na ca yatra guṇasya godohanādeḥ atyantā- prāptyā vidheyatā, tatra vidheyasyaiva phalasambandhāt indriya- kāmādhikāranyāyaḥ |
yatra tu guṇadhātvarthayoḥ dvayorapi anyataḥ prāptiḥ, tatra bhāvāthīdhikaraṇanyāyena dhātvarthasyaiva phalasambandhaḥ iti vācyam |
tathātve daṇḍo'pi 'dadhnā juhoti' ityanena prāptaḥ phalasambandhavācyaḥ |

na ca tasya vaikalpikatayā pākṣikānuvādāpattibhiyā vidheyatvāvagamāt phalasambandhaḥ, prakṛte'pi aindravāyavāgratvasya bṛhatsāmala- nimittakaśukrāgratvarūpeṇa kāmyamantryanusāreṇa ca pākṣikatvāvagamābhāvāt |
ataśca guṇavācakapadasyaivārtha- hārārthameva dadhyādeḥ phalasambandho vācyaḥ |
sa ca prakṛte'pi tulyaḥ; iti aindravāyavāgratvameva phaloddeśena vidhīyate |
tatra ca aindravāyavāgratvasya vidheyatvāt maitrāvaruṇāpekṣayā tasya pāṭhādeva prāptiḥ avidheyatvāpatteḥ |
avāntaraprakaraṇa bādhitā mahāprakaraṇatvāt sarvagrahāṇāmeva āśrayatvam, aindravāyavasya ca sarvāditāḥ pratikarṣaḥ iti prāpthaḥ |
vastutastu pāṭhādinā ṛtvarthatayā prāptasya aindravāyavāgratvasya lādiratvat phalārthatvo- papatteḥ |
iti prāpte, guṇavācakapadasya 'aindravāyavāgrān grahaṇ' ityasya vidheyatā'vacchedakabhūtayapātrajanyatvalakṣaṇenāpi caritārthatvāt nātra bhāvāthīdhikaraṇa— (2|1|12)
aindravāyavasya grahasya maitrā 1315 aindravāyavasya grahasya maitrā
idameva 'vāgvā eṣa yadaindravāyavaḥ' ityatrāpi guṇavācakapadagrahaṇasya prayojanam |
ata eva guṇa- vācakapadasya yatra naivaṃvidhaprayojanalābhaḥ, tatra dadhyādau guṇaphalasambandha eva |
ataścadhārā dhārāgrahāmeva phala- saṃtrancaḥ; 'aindravāyavāgrān' iti tu pākṣikānuvādāmātram |
ata eva dvitīyapūrvapakṣe naimittikasya śukrāgratvasya bādhaḥ, dvayorviruddhaguṇayoḥ yugapat svasvānasya grahaṇam |
siddhānte tu prajārthagrahaṇānāṃ prayoge'pi naimittika śukrāgratvam, kāmyaṃ ca manthyagratvādi na virudhyate iti prayojanam |
bhāṣyam— jyotiṣṭome śrūyate 'vāg vā aindra- vāyavo, yadaindravāyavā grā grahā gṛhyante, vācamevāvarundhe' iti |
tatra saṃśayaḥ; kim aindravāyavasya sarvāditāḥ pratikarṣaḥ syāt upāṃśvantaryāmābhyāmi pūrvaṃ grahītavyaḥ; uta śukrā- manthyābhyāṃ pūrvaṃ grahaṇamiti |
kiṃ prāptam ? aindravāyavasya sarvāditāḥ pratikarṣaḥ iti |
agratā- 'tra vidhīyate 'aindravāyavāgraṃ gṛhṇāti' iti aindravāya- vam agre kuryādeṣāmiti |
aviśeṣāt sarve eva aindra- vāyavāḥ kartavyāḥ |
yadi āditaḥ pratikarṣo na kriyeta, upāṃśvantaryāmau aindravāyavau na syātām |
āditastu pratikarṣe kriyamāṇe sarve aindravāyavāḥ kṛtā bhavanti |
yadi vidhīyate, yānukrāṃśita prati aindravāyavāgratāyāṃ kṛtaṃ kartavyaṃ syāt |
atha punaḥ anyeṣāṃ grahaṇām aindravāyavāgratā dharma ucyate, tasmāt sarveṣāṃ dharmaḥ kartavyaḥ, iti āditaḥ pratikarṣaḥ syāt |
kathaṃ punaravagamyate sarvamevāyaṃ dharmaḥ iti ? 'aindravāyavān kuryāt' iti nirdeśāt |
'yadi rayaṃtarasāmā 'somaḥ' syāt (tadā) ye aindravāyavā grāḥ samāmnātāḥ teṣāmanenānupūrvyeṇa aindravāyavāditayā dharmā(me) viśeṣeṇa tadgrāṇāṃ prakṛtānāṃ grahaṇaṃ vidhīyate |
sva sthāne ye grahā aindravāyavāgrāḥ, tān prakṛtya grahaṇavidhiḥ, iti na sarvāditāḥ pratikarṣa iti |
bhāṣyam— api ca dhārāsaṃyogo bhavati aindravāyavā- divākye 'anyā avyacchinnayā dhārayā gṛhṇāti' iti |
soma— pūrvatra bahuvrīhibalāt nirapekṣapraṇasādhanatvavat ihāpi bahuvrīhibalādeva sarvagrahadharmalābhaḥ ityucitaḥ saṃgatiḥ |

' bhāṭṭa— upāṃśvantaryāmau jyotiṣṭome adhārāgrahī vidhāya dhārāgrahāṇām aindravāyavamaitrāvaruṇādimaprakrame śrutam 'vāg vā eṣa yadaindravāyavo, yadaindravāyavā grā gṛhyante vācamevānu prayanti' iti |

tadanena kim aindra- vāyavasya pāṭhāt maitrāvaruṇagrahat pūrvamevānuṣṭhānaṃ prāpte upāṃśvantaryāmāt pūrvamapakarṣo vidhīyate, uta neti cintāyām, 'aindravāyavaṃ gṛhṇāti' 'maitrāvaruṇaṃ gṛhṇāti' ityādinā pratyakṣasiddhamiha prāmāṇaṃ grahaṇānāṃ saṃkṣepeṇa punarvidhānayogena anupapatteḥ prakṛtasarvagrahaṇedeśena aindravāyavāprāptaiva anena vidheyā |
ata eva na graheṇa maitrāvaruṇādyā eva grahya ucyante, saṃkoce pramāṇābhāvāt, tadgratāyāḥ pāṭhādeva prāptatvācca |

tataśca bahusāmatve naimittikaśukrāgratva- virodhāt aniveśe'pi rayaṃtarasāmakatve eva niveśo yadyapi nyāyādeva prāptaḥ, tathāpi 'yadi rayaṃtarasāmā' ityanena naimittikatvena vidhīyate, tatprayojanaṃ ca siddhānte iva kaṇvarayaṃtarādī tadaprāptiḥ |
iti prāpte, dhātvarthamātravidhilipsayā grahaṇasyaiva atra vidhīyante nāmatā, grahaṇadeśena tṛtīyavidhiviprakārā- patteḥ |
na ca vihitavidhānayogeyaḥ, yatkārakayadviśeṣaka- vidhī kṛte tatprakārakaviśeṣakavidhivyogo'pi, tasyaiva viśeṣasya dharmāntaraprakārakavidhau bādhakābhāvāt |
'aindra- vāyavaṃ gṛhṇāti' ityādinā hi vijātīyagrahaṇavidhānā tattadgrahaṇānāṃ vidhiḥ; anena tu vakṣyamāṇatadagrahaṇaniṣṭha- vyāpakībhūtavaijātyaprakārakaḥ tattadgrahaṇānāṃ vidhiḥ |
vaijātyaṃ ca etadiśeṣeṇa ādyavidhiviprakārasāsahakṛtasya vidheyatā''vacchedakatvaṃ siddham |

tadapi ca na upāṃśva- ntaryāmādisādhāraṇyena, prakṛtagrahaṇamātre tathānve upāṃśva- ntaryāmottaram etallakṣya vaiyarthyāpatteḥ, aindravāyavāgrā ityasya anuvādānupapatteśca, sāmānyadharmaprakārakavidhi- prayojanānāṃ vakṣyamāṇānām upāṃśvantaryāmāsādhāraṇā- nupapatteśca |
ataśca viśiṣṭa tattadvihitānāmapi aindra- vāyavādigrahaṇānāṃ saṃkṣepeṇa vidhiḥ |
teṣu ca aindravāyavasya prāthamyaṃ pāṭhaprāptam, iti 'aindravāyavāgrāḥ' ityanuvādāt na aindravāyavasya sarvāditāḥ pratikarṣaḥ |
saṃkṣepavidhiprayojanaṃ ca teṣāmeva grahaṇānāṃ viśiṣṭa ākāṅkṣotthāpanadvārā tadavāntaraprakaraṇasiddhiḥ |
tataśca tatpuratvavākyeṣu 'anyā dhārayā gṛhṇāti' ityādiṣu gṛhṇātinā teṣā- mevānuvādāt teṣveva dhārā''didharmavidhiḥ; na tu upāṃśva- ntaryāmopari |
prayojana- nāntaraṃ kāmyagrahaṇavidhau eteṣāmeva 'kāmasaṃyoge' iti (uttarādhikaraṇe) vakṣyate |
grahaṇāśritaguṇaphaleṣu ca eteṣāmeva āśrayatvasiddhiḥ iti ca tantra-

ratnādau tattadākyena vihitānāṃ grahaṇāṃ vakṣyamāṇakāma- vākyena kāmyatvāvagateḥ kṛtyatvasiddhiraiva etadākya- prayojanam ityuktam, tat pramāṇāntareṇa arthādinā saṃbhavatprātikānaṃ tattadgrahaṇāṃ tattadevatāsaṃyogānāṃ ca tattadvidhibhiḥ punarvidhānasya ārādupakārakavidhayā kṛtyatva- tvaphalakatvena paśuvodhikaraṇe (2|1|6) kaustubhe vyavasthāpitatayā upekṣitam |
sarvathā aindravāyavasya sarvā- ditaḥ karaṇābhāvāt na pāṭhavādhaḥ |
jyotiṣṭome 'vāg vā aindravāyavo yadaindravāyatrāṃ grahā gṛhyante vācamevāvarundhe' iti śrūyate |
asya aindra- vāyavasya grahasya āditaḥ sarvāditaḥ upāṃśuvantaryāmābhyā- mapi pūrvaṃ pratikarṣaḥ syāt |
athavā dharmaviśeṣāt taddharmāṇāṃ sve sthāne prakaraṇādapratamucyate |

dharmaviśeṣāt adhyavahitapūrvatvena aindravāyavādirūpasya dharmasya dhārā- grahe eva viśeṣān, taddharmāṇām aindravāyavādivadharma- viśiṣṭāṇāṃ prakaraṇapāṭhakramāt sve sthāne maitrāvaruṇāt dhārāgrahāt anyavadhāne prāk yat aindravāyavasya sthānam, tasmin sve sthāne svīye sthāne agratvam āditvam ucyate, na tu aṃbhaḥ prāk |
taddharmāṇām ityatra saḥ aindravāyavādi- svarūpaḥ dharmo yeṣāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ |
dhārāsaṃyogāt, aindravāya- vādivākye dhārāsaṃyogo bhavati 'aṇyā avyavacchinnā dhārayā gṛhṇāti' iti |
ke. oṃ aindravāyave tu vacanāt pratikarma bhakṣaḥ syāt |
tasya bhakṣaḥ sakṛt vā dvivā iti saṃdehe |
somasaṃskārārthatvāt bhakṣaḥ, sakṛtkaraṇenāpi saṃskārasya siddhatvāt sakṛdbhakṣaḥ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
'dvirendra- vāyavasya bhakṣayati, dvirhatasya vaṣaṭ karoti' iti vacanāt aindravāyave pratikarme karmaṇikarmaṇi vaṣaṭkāre- vaṣaṭkāre nimitte sati bhakṣaḥ syāt |
vārtikaṃ tu ittham- aindravāyave tu sakṛdbhakṣaṇe prāpte vacanāt dvirbhakṣo na pradhānamedinimittaḥ |
evaṃ na sati pūrvādhikaraṇaśeṣeṇa satā somakṣasāāmānya- vicārasāraṇāt na kramakopo bhaviṣyatīti- iti ke. oṃ aindravāyavagrahaḥ : jyotiṣṭome dvirbhakṣaṇīyaḥ |
vi. 3|5|5, aindravāyavagrahaḥ tṛtīyo mantrākāṇḍavidhi- kāṇḍayoḥ, dhārāgraheṣu prathamaḥ |
10|5|177, aindra- vāyavagrahaḥ prātaḥ savane gṛhyate jyotiṣṭome |
aindravāyavagrahasya pratikarṣaḥ : kāmasaṃyoge'pi dhārā- grahebhyaḥ āditaḥ eva, na sarvāditaḥ |
aindravāyave tu vacanāt pratikarma bhakṣaḥ syāt |
bhāṣyam- asti jyotiṣṭomaḥ 'jyotiṣṭomena svargakāmo yajeta' iti |
tatra aindravāyave grahe saṃdehaḥ kiṃ sakṛdbhakṣaṇam, uta dviriti |
vacanamidaṃ bhavati, 'dvirendravāyavasya bhakṣayati, dvirhatasya vaṣaṭkaroti' iti |
vā- 'some'vacanādbhakṣo na vidyate' iti sāmānyena bhakṣavicāraṃ kṛtvā viśeṣavicāro'pi kartavya āsīt |
yattu prathamataḥ kriyate tat pūrvādhikaraṇapāvadatvena śīghrataropasthānāt |
pūrvavadi dravyatvāt sakṛdbhakṣite kṛtaḥ śāstrārtha iti nyāyāt prāpte, vacanāt dvirbhakṣaṇaṃ 'dvirendravāyavasya bhakṣayati' iti |
bhavanti cedaśanyapi adhikaraṇāni, yeṣāṃ nyāyena pūrvapakṣaṃ kṛtvā vacanena siddhānto bhavati |
tatra vaitat kriyate, yatra nyāyena pratipādito vacanāddhāditaḥ, tadabhāvāt samānanyāyeṣūpakariṣyati |
sa cedaṃ nyāyaḥ pūrvādhikaraṇenaiva pradarśita iti mandaphale vicāraḥ |
kiṃ tarhi ? sarvadharmāyāme pratikarme siddha- kṛdidaṃ kartavyaṃ pradhānabhedāt |
tathāhi, siddhavatpradhāna- medamam aindravāyavasaṃskārahetumāha (aindravāyavasaṃskāra- bhūtabhakṣaṇahetumāha ityarthaḥ) |
tasmāt yāvadvaṣaṭkāraṃ śeṣasaṃskāraḥ ityuttare datte dṛṣṭāntamanubhāṣya sūtreṇa parihāro vaktavyaḥ |
aindravāyave tu sakṛdbhakṣaṇe prāpte vacanāt dvirbhakṣaḥ, na pradhānanimittaḥ |

( 'tena hyanaṃ kriyate' ityitavat 'dvirhatasya vaṣaṭ karoti' ityatrāpi vartamānanirdeśāt, vartamānakālikaśca vaṣaṭkāramedasa hetvasaṃbhavāt luṭo bhūtakālalakṣaṇa'ḍavaśyambhāvāt, lakṣaṇāyāśca na vidhī paraḥ śabdārthaḥ |
evaṃ ca sati pūrvādhikaraṇaśeṣeṇa satā somakṣasāmānyavicārasāraṇāt na kramakopo bhaviṣyati iti |
bhāṭṭe tu idaṃ sūtraṃ pūrvādhikaraṇe evāntarmitam |
'aindravāyave tu vacanādeva bhakṣāpattiḥ' iti ca tatroktam |
'sarvataḥ parihāramāśritaṃ bhakṣayati' ityādiṣu aindravāyavanyāyaḥ : eva syāt (pūrvapakṣe |
'vacanāt aindravāyavagrahe dvirbhakṣaḥ' iti tasya nyāyasya svarūpam |
aindravāyavapātre pūrvasiddhapuroḍāśaśakala nidheyaṃ jyotiṣṭome, na tu tadarthaṃ svatantrapuroḍāśasaṃpādanam |
vi. 10|5|123, aindravāyavāgratvaṃ jyotiṣṭome pṛṣṭhastotrasya rathaṃtarasāmatve sati kartavyam 'yadi rathaṃtarasāmā somaḥ syāt aindra- vāyavāgrān grahān gṛhṇīyāt' |
2|3|1, aindravāyavā- gratvaṃ dhārāgraheṣu dvādaśāha vyūḍhe, dvitīye paṣṭhe daśamai- kādaśayośca ahaḥsu prāyaṇīyodayanīyayośca iti ṣaṭsu ahaḥsu |
samuḍhe ca dvitīye pañcame ahame daśame prāyaṇīyodayanīyayośca iti ṣaṭsu ahaḥsu |
aindravāyavādīni yāni prākara- ṇikāni grahaṇāni tāni yathāpāṭhameva vyavasthitāni |
aindravāyavādigrahāṇām agratāvidhī grahaṇaprati- karṣeṇa sādanasyāpi pratikarṣaḥ |
mā. 10|5|2|173-74, aindravāyavādigrahāṇām agratāvidhī grahaṇapratikarṣe'pi pradānasya nāpakarṣaḥ |
10|4|2|3-5, aindra- vāyavādigrahāṇām ātideśikānāṃ bṛhaspatisvādau aupa- deśikaiḥ bārhaspatyādigrahaiḥ samuccayaḥ |
10|4|2|3-5, aindravāyavādigrahāṇām ātideśikānāṃ viśvavati vihitena arkegraheṇa samuccayaḥ |
10|4|2|3-5. aindravāyavādigrahāpekṣayā kāmyāgatāvidhau śukrā- digrahāṇasya pūrvaṃ pratikarṣaḥ |
su. pṛ. 790. aindravāyavā- divākye 'somena yajeta' ityasmin upatiṣṭhamāne nānyajakalpanā |
vā. 12|1|37 pṛ. 120. aindravāyavādyā grahāḥ prātaḥsavane daśa samāmnātāḥ |
bhā. 3|6|9|30. aindraśabdaḥ rājanyastulyarthaḥ 'aindro rājanyaḥ' iti, na guṇavidhiḥ |
vi. 4|4|14. aindrāmaḥ dvādaśakapālaḥ puroḍāśaḥ āgneyagataḥ darśapūrṇamāsayorvikṛtiḥ |
aindrāmam 'indrāgnī rocanā divaḥ, pra carṣaṇībhyaḥ' ityekam, 'indrāgnī navatiṃ puraḥ, athadadhṛvam' iti dvitīyam |
3|6|7|8, 'aindrāmamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet' ityā- dīni vaikṛtāni karmāṇi sadyaḥkālāni na dvyahakālāni |
5|4|1|22-24. aindrāmamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet prajākāmaḥ iti prajākāmeṣṭiḥ darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ karmā- ntaram |
vi. 2|3|12, 'aindrāma0 prajākāmaḥ' ityādeḥ phalam asati prativandhe aihikam |
4|3|12, 'aindrāma0 prajākāmaḥ' ityādiṣu iṣṭiṣu darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ pravṛttiḥ syāt |
10|7|7, 'aindrāmamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet ātruyavān' atra 'indrāgnī navatiṃ' ityādikaṃ yājyānuvākyāyugalam |
jyotiṣṭome aindrāmagrahasomabhakṣaṇamantre indrapītasya iti nyapadeśaḥ syānna vā iti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
aindrāme pīyamāne mantravat bhakṣaṇaṃ syāt indrapītasya iti viśeṣaṇamuccārya syāt |
liṅgabhāvāt dvābhyām indrā- gnibhyāṃ pīte'pi indrapītatvarūpasya liṅgasya bhāvāt satvāt |
ekasmin ekamātrādevatākayāgīśeṣabhakṣaṇe eva indra- pītasya iti mantraḥ, na tu dvidaivate aindrāme |
atra devatā'- ntarāt agni rūpasya devatā'ntarasya satvāt ! vibhāgavat 'āgneyaṃ caturdhā karoti' ityāmnātacaturdhākaraṇavat |
tatra yathā āgneyapadena agniparyantadevatākatvasya taddhitena pratipādanāt vyāsaṃjñyasthitadevatāke agnīṣomīyādau caturdhākaraṇaṃ na pravartate tadvat |
tasmāt aindrāmaśeṣabhakṣaṇamantre indrapītasya iti nohyāmiti siddhāntaḥ |
ke. aindrāme tu liṅgabhāvāt ityadhikaraṇarītyā svīkāraḥ evaṃ pādhātunā lakṣyate (indrapītaśabde) |
kau. 3|2|1|43 (44) pṛ. 306. aindrāme sākamedhīye vāruṇapāthendrāmasya sārthavādavidhikāṇḍasya atideśaḥ |
ke. aindrāmagrahavikṛtitvam āśvinadvikapālasya, 'māptaṃ saptakapālam' ityasya ca vyakṣaradevatāvidhi- sāhacaryāt |
bhā. 7|1|4|22. aindrāmavat- yathā aindrāmapuroḍāśasya agni- saṃbandhe'pi caturdhākaraṇaṃ nāsti, tadvat somāpauṣṇe caro pūṣaṇvanve'pi peṣaṇaṃ nāsti |
ke. 3|1|5|14. aindrāmavat- yathā caturdhākaraṇaṃ miśradevatātvāt aindrāgne na bhavati, tadvat upāṃśuyājyām agnīṣomīyaśabdena na śakyate vaditum, vaiṣṇavatvāderapi saṃbhavāt |
evam aindrāvaiṣṇave aindrāpauṣṇe aindrābārhaspatyādau ca aindrāmavikṛtitvameva ! bāla. pṛ. 120. aindrāmavidhānārthā 'āgneyo'ṣṭākapālo'māvā- syāyāṃ bhavati' iti āgneyapunaḥśrutiḥ |
bhā. 2|3|14 29, aindrāmavaiśvadevayoryājyānupāthena āgne- yaṇe vaiśvadevatantrasya niyamo nāsti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ mantra- vadbhakṣaṇam amantrakaṃ veti |
śakyate hi sa indrapīta iti vyapadeṣṭum |
yasya hi avyavāntaramindraṃ pītam, sa indrapītaḥ |
vā- (anyasahitendradevatyasomabhakṣaṇe uhitamantra- prayogopapatteḥ amantrakatvaṃ pūrvapakṣayojanaṃ sarvānaindrābhyāpa- katvena ākṣipya vyāpakatvoktyartham idamadhikaraṇam |
su. pṛ. 1199.) atha yatra anyasahitaḥ indro devatā, tatra kiṃ indrapītavyapadeśaḥ asti, na iti sandehe astīti brūmaḥ |
sa ca taddhitana anyanirapekṣāmiviṣaya upāttaḥ, iti sāpekṣaṃ na pratipādayati |
atra punaḥ indrapīta iti saṃpradāna- vyāpārī viśeṣaṇam |
sa ca ubhayorapi saṃkalpyamānayoḥ pratyekaṃ kena cidaṃśena vicyate |
yasya ca yāvān vyāpāraḥ, sa tena pātā ityupalabhyate |

( 'yasya hi avayavāntaram' iti bhāṣyaṃ pūrvabhāṣyeṇa asaṃbaddhatvāt utkṛṣṭa vyākhyāya matvā 'tasya indrāgnyām' iti bhāṣyam ādau vyācaṣṭe-) tena aindrāmasya indrāgnyāṃ pīvadhryām ardham indrapītam, ardham agnīpītam iti śakyaṃ vadi- tum |
( 'yasya hi' iti bhāṣyaṃ pūrvamupekṣitaṃ adhunā vyācaṣṭe-) na ca vartamānasya sākṣāt indrapītatvam iti hutāvayavadvāreṇa vyapadeśaḥ |
na ca tasya iyattāniyamaḥ asti 'etāvatā pītena vyapadeśyaḥ' iti |
na cāvayavāntareṇa indrapītena tat pītaṃ bhavati |
indramudriśya yaḥ saṃkalpitaḥ, indro yasya devateti |
yathaiva ca sākāṅkṣasya taddvitīyena asaṃbandhaḥ, evaṃ samāso'pi indrapīteti sākāṅkṣasya nāvakalpate |
āha, nanu tainādhikaraṇena etadatram, kimarthaṃ punardhinyate iti |
yattatra vicāritaṃ siddhameva tat, kathaṃ punarvicāryate naiva sākā- ṅkṣasya devatāsaṃbandha iti |
naiveha devatāsaṃbandha iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ, pānamātrasaṃbandho'traiti |
pānamātrasaṃbandhe yatra dvābhyāṃ pīyate, tatraikena devatāsaṃbandhaḥ, ityuttaraḥ pakṣaḥ |
vā- satyam, yadi devatāvyāpāraḥ pātutvam iha viśeṣaṇaṃ syāt, tataḥ aindrāmoḍapi gṛhyeta |
tasmāt āgneya- caturdhākaraṇavadeva kevalendradevatvaviṣayatvāt, naiva vyapadeśaḥ ubhayadevatyaḥ saṃbhavati iti mantranivṛttiḥ |

yat pūrvavādī 'na devatā- tvamiha viśeṣaṇam, kiṃ tarhi ? saṃpādanagataṃ pāttratvam, tacca pratyekam asti' iti manyate, siddhāntavādī tu mukhyapāttratvā saṃbhavāt devataiva anena lakṣyate ( na pāttratvam ) ityāpādayati |
yadyapi ca mukhyaṃ pāttratvaṃ devatāyāṃ bhavet, tathāpi dravyasya tapītatvam aśakyaṃ vaktum ? 'yo hi tāvaddrutaḥ somaḥ, sa naivamamidhīyate |
' camasa- stho hi indraprītatvena vyapadiśyate, na cāsau indrapītaḥ |
tasmāt avaśyavibha- mānadharmāmidhānāt indrāya saṃkalpitaḥ indrapītaḥ pratyekaḥ |
na ca huta- somagataṃ pītatvaṃ tatra upacarituṃ śakyam, ārambhadharmāvena saṃkalpena abhidhānopapatteḥ |
ekadeśe'pi hi hūyamāne sarvamidaṃ dravyaṃ devatoddeśena tyajyamānaṃ yāgaṃ sādhayati, ato'sau nirvapateriva yajireva atra pitraterarthaḥ |
syādevaṃ yadi pānaṃ syāt tattu nāstīti vakṣyate |
soma-- sūtrārthastu aindrāme'pi liṅgasadbhāvāt mantraḥ syāt iti |
, na pānamaśarīrasya yuktaṃ dānaṃ tu miśrakam |

tyāgasya nyāsajapyavṛttitve'pi pānasya pītapadalakṣitasvīkārasya vā pratyekavṛttitvena ḍisthamātṛvadena vyapadeṣṭuṃ śakya- tvāt, tyāgasya hutahutasamudāyaviṣayatvena bhakṣyamāṇā- hutāvayavamātraviṣayatvāt na pītapadena tyaktatva-
iti prāpte, satyaṃ pītapadena svīkāralakṣaṇā, pānasya navame niṣedhyamāna- tvāt, tyāgasya tvaduktarītyā lakṣayitumaśakyatvācca |
svīkārasya tu devakhādipādavalambhanatayā kalpyamānasya hutatvaviśiṣṭa eva kalpanīyatvāt yuktā lakṣaṇā |
tathāpi tasya lāghavena vyāsajyavṛttitvaḥ eva kalpanāt, pratyeka- vṛttitve pramāṇābhāvāt, caturthakaraṇādhikaraṇaviṣayatvo- papatterna tasya samantrakaṃ bhakṣaṇam |
aindrāmāgnīṣomīyādīnāṃ kevalanyādidevatākaiḥ āgneyādiśabdaiḥ asāmarthyādathagrahaṇaṃ caturthakaraṇendrapītapūṣa- praviṣṭabhāgavicāreṣu |
aindrāmādayo vikṛtayaḥ sājñāḥ paurṇamāsyāmā- vāsyāyāṃ vā kartavyāḥ |
bhā. 5|4|7|24. aindrāmādīni kāmyāni karmāṇi āmnātāni, tenaiva krameṇa tadevatāni kāmya- samākhyāyuktāni yājyāpuro'nuvākyāyuktāni |
tāni tāsveva kāmyāsu iṣṭiṣu yathākramaṃ viniyujyante |
na tu kramamullaṅghya tadevatvakarmamātrārthāni liṅgāni bhavanti |
dhūrtsvāmyādibhiryāśikai: āvartanatatpūrvasaṃdhyo: prakṛtyanu- ṣṭhānanantaraṃ saṃcidine eva vikṛtyanuṣṭhānam, paurṇamāsyādi- śabdānāṃ parvānityakṣaṇavacanatvāt |
ya: parama: saṃnikarṣa:; sā amāvāsyā' iti gobhilasūtrāt |
ataśca saṃni- karṣaviprakarṣaṇāvacchinnāhorātrasyaiva paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyā- padavācyatvāt tasya ca pūrvālhaṇau dvitīyadine eva sattvāt tatraiva vikṛtyanuṣṭhānam |
tadapi na prakṛte: pūrvam, tasyā: dṛṣṭakālatvena vikṛtau prasaṅgasiddhatvāpatte: |
tatra 'somasya vai rājño'rdhamāsasya rātraya: panaya āsan, tāsāmamāvāsyāṃ ca paurṇamāsīṃ ca nopaitat' ityādyarthavādāt, āpāmara- prasiddhai:, jyoti:śāstrādivācya paurṇamāsyādināṃ titha
prādādya mukhya indre vā gauṇe, mukhye'stu pūrvavat |
' bhāṭṭa-- yatra tu gauṇārthe tātparyagrāhakaṃ vacanaṃ vidyate, yathā amo 'kadā cana starīyasi ityanyā gārhapatya- mupatiṣṭhate' ityādī, tatra gauṇe eva gārhapatye viniyogaḥ |
atha 'aindrā' ityupakramasya taddhita- śrutyā mukhyasāmarthyajīvanāt jaghanyadvitīyāyāḥ eva tadanurodhena pratiyogitvena lakṣaṇā gārhapatyasamīpe sthitā iti |
guṇabhūtapratipādike eva yā yajñasādhanatva- sādṛśyāt gauṇyā gṛhapattiyogena vā indraprakāśaka- tvam |
astu vā rūḍhatvāt agnereva dhātuvācyasamīpa- sthiti prati karmatvam, na tu mantrasādhyābhidhānaṃ prati, tasyāśābdatvāt |
‘ saurye caruṃ nirvapedbrahmavarcasakāmaḥ ’ ‘ aindrāmamekādaśa- kapālaṃ nirvapet prajākāmaḥ ’ ‘ citrayā yajeta paśukāmaḥ ’ ‘ vaiśvadevīṃ sāṃkamaṇīṃ nirvaped grāmakāmaḥ ’ |
nahi anantaraṃ nirvṛtte karmaṇi phalamupalabhyate paśvādi |
yacca kālāntare upalabhyate, tasyāpyanyadeva kāraṇamasti pratyakṣam |
tasmādiheṃdriyasaṃśayarādi phala paśusaṃbaṃdhanasamartha paśuphala karmaṇo bhavatītyevaṃ boddhavyam |
na vai saumya rāṣṭra- pratipādanaṃ vedha, amuṣme kāmāya yajñā āhriyante ’ iti janmāntaraphalatāṃ darśayati |
yaḥ paśūn kāmayate sa etena yāgena kurvā- diti nātratadgamyate, iha janmani na saṃbhavatīti |
yat kālāntare anyat kāraṇamiti, naiṣa doṣaḥ |

kāmyapaśukāṇḍe 'dyāvāpṛthivyāṃ dhenumālameta, māṣataṃ vatsam, aindramṛṣabham' iti śrutam|
ete dhenuvatsabhamā ajajātīyā vā gojātīyā vā iti vicāre, siddhānta- māha|
autpattike utpatti: svabhāvata: gopadaṃ vinā- 'pi prācuryeṇa gogatadhānādiguṇābhidhāyake dhenvādi śabde śrūyamāṇe dravyata: codakaprāptājadravyasya vikāra: bādha: syāt|
akāryatvāt pratyakṣaśrutānaṃ dhenvādi śabdānām ajajātīyeṣu lakṣaṇā''śrayaṇasya anyāyatatvāt|
tasmā- diha dhānādiguṇānāṃ gavameva ālambho nājānām|
na punaratra śabdāvagamapūrvako vyavahārastatra autpattikatvaṃ śakyāvagamam|
kartṛparjana- tle'pi matyakṣe pratyayārthabhūtāyā: prādhānyānivṛtte: kartṛprādhānyaniṣṭhātvāpi nautsargikoṃ nyāyo nivartyeta|
kartṛpratyayārthatve tu tasyaiva kartṛprādhānyānivṛttereva autsargikoṃ nyāyo nivartyeta|
svarūpam- yasya udamedhaḥ prasiddhaḥ sa tasyānātmatāpya apalyam audamedhiriti brūte |
yasyodamedhaḥ (prasiddhaḥ) sa tasya pitaram anākhyātamapi udamedhaṃ pratipadyate iti |
tatsambandhasya karma, tatsamba- ndhāśca puruṣāḥ prakṛtyetanānuṣṭhānatvena ca audamedhinyāyena udgātāraḥ ityumātuṃ śakyate |
nanu caiṣa nyāyaḥ avedhya- cikaraṇe nirākṛtaḥ |

vā. 3|5|8|26. draviḍadeśe rājaśabdārthasya kṣatriyasvarūpeṇa vijñātatvāt audamedhinyāyānupapatteḥ na rājakarmatvādirājaśabdā- nyāthā'nupapattilakṣaṇayā arthapattyā rājyasya kartā rājā iti vacanavyaktiḥ kalpanīyā |
su pṛ. 107. 'audumbaro yupo bhavati ūrga vā udumbaraḥ' ityādi vākyam 'somapaurṇaṃ traimālameta paśukamaḥ' iti vaikṛtapaśuprakaraṇe śrutam |
su. pṛ. 71. 'audu- mbaro yupo bhavati, ūrdhvā udumbaraḥ, ūrka paśāvaḥ, ūrjai- vāsmai ūrjaṃ paśūnāpnoti, ūrjau'vadadhai' etādṛśā api arthavādāḥ stāvaka eveti dharme pramāṇam |
bhā. 10|3|1|9168-73, audumbaratvena śrūyamāṇena prākṛtatvādirātvāde- rnivṛttiḥ somāpauṣṇo paśau |
bhāṣyam-- iha ye vidhivijidā arthavādāste udā- haraṇam |
'audumbaro yupo bhavati, ūrdhvā udumbaraḥ, ūrka paśāvaḥ, ūrjaivāsmā ūrjaṃ paśūnāpnoti, ūrjau'va- dadhai' iti |
kimasya vidhiḥ kāryam, uttasyāpi stuti- riti |
ki tāvat prāptam ? vidhivau syādapūrvatvād bādamātraṃ hyanarthakam |
vā - evam ānarthakyapasyānādipratiyogiṣu ( ānarthakyaṃ ca, upākhyānaṃ ca, ādiśabdopārthaṃ adṛṣṭārthatvaṃ ca pratiyogi virodhi yeṣāṃ teṣu |
kutaḥ saṃśayaḥ ? (saṃdehamasamartha caturthā pūrva- pakṣaṃ saṃbhāvayati-) pūrvatra hi svārthānupayogitvena dūra- lakṣitastutigrahaṇam aṅgīkṛtam |
vidhivaśca na kathaṃ cana anya- syāt |
prarocanā punaḥ kathañcit vidhudeśādapi upapadyate ityuktaṃ purastāt |
api ca pradhānaṃ vidhiḥ, aṅgaṃ stutiḥ |
viśeṣeṇa tu phalaṃ prādhyamaprādhānyābhyām ityādi manvānaḥ apūrvatvāt iti vadati, tatpekṣayā ca stutimātram anarthakaṃ manyate |
nanu ca evaṃjātīyakaḥ 'phalavidhiḥ, uta arthavādaḥ' iti vicāraḥ caturthe'pi 'dravyasaṃskārakarmasu' (4|1|1) iti bhaviṣyati, ato neha prastottamya |
tatra cet cittam āhuḥ, anena gatārthatvāt tatraiva paryanuyogo yujyate, na tu idaṃ punaruktamiti (idaṃ samādhānaṃ dūṣayati -) satyamevam, yadi tu tatkālapratīkṣāṃ kaścit parihārā- ntaraṃ labhyate |
ataḥ tatra anvicchema, atha punaḥ ihaiva śakyate vaktum, tathā sati idānīmapi ucyamāne mando doṣa iti |
(apīnaruktye parihāryaṃ caturaḥ prakārānupamyasya dūṣayati -) tatrapare vadanti, tena phalavidhivinirā- karaṇamātram, iha tu arthavattvāya |
arthavādaḥ syāt iti tatra vakṣyati, tat vidhivinirākaraṇamātrameva draṣṭavyam |
ānarthakyaprasaktau pūrvādhikaraṇenaiva ( 1|2|12 ) stutya- thetā sādhitā, tathā ca darśitam 'śobhate'sya mukham' ityādiṣu ( 1|2|15 ) |

kecit punaḥ āhuḥ- yuktam 'vāyurvai kṣepiṣṭhā' ityādīnāṃ stutim, 'ūrjau- 'vadadhai' iti punaḥ yathā phalavidhitvāt prayujyante, tathaiva visaṃvādena stutivādāpi, iti kāmaṃ vidhirbhavatu, yena kālāntaramāvitvena kathañcit visaṃvādo nivartate ityārambhaḥ (asyādhikaraṇasya) |
api ca vede vyaktam avisaṃvādaḥ iti hi abhyupahetuḥ : apunaruktaḥ syāt |
adhikaraṇaśarīre tu tadeva (parṇamayadhikaraṇaśarīrāt abhinnam) visaṃ- vādo'pi ca 'guṇavādastu' ( 1|2|10 ) ityanena na kaścidaparihataḥ |
(prakārāntaraṃ śakyate-) tasmāt 'vidhirvā syāt' ( 1|2|19 ) iti aviśeṣeṇopādānāt, caturthe ca phalaśrutigrahaṇāt |
'iha aśeṣadravyaguṇakriyādi- vidhirūpāḥ, tatra phalavidhirūpā eva udāharaṇam' ityapare |
tathā ca 'vidhiśrānarthakaḥ ka cit' ( 1| 2|23 ), 'prakaraṇe ca saṃbhavanam' (24) iti ca, 'appuyonirvā aśvaḥ, ambhujo vetasaḥ' 'yo vidagdhaḥ' iti codāhiyate |
(nirasyati-) ihāpi tasya tāvat viśeṣaviṣayatvāt idamagatārthaṃ bhavet, anena tu sāmānyataḥ sarvaviṣayavivecanā tat punaruktameva |
(prakārāntaramāśaṅkate-) iti (hetoḥ) vyavasthāyā ke cit udāharanti atra dravyādividhīneva, tatra phalavidhī- naiva |
atra vadāmaḥ; kim adhikaraṇadvayam avaśyakartavyam, yena evamudāharaṇavyavasthā āśrīyate |
nahi udāharaṇabhedāt adhikaraṇaṃ bhidyate, mā bhūt yathā- vyavasthite'pi lādidaudumbaratvabhedāt apaunaruktyam |
nyāyaviṣayatvena tu adhikaraṇatāṃ tadeva eva apauna- ruktye hetuḥ |

dravyādividho'pi na sarvaṃ vicāritāḥ, ke cit tatasiddhisune ( 1|4|12|23 ), ke cit nītātādhikaraṇe ( 3|4|1 ), parakṛtipurākalpa- dvāreṇa anye paṭhe ( 6|1|12 ), 'yaccā stuvate' ityādiḥ ; 'arthakātvādhikaraṇyaḥ' iti navame ( 9|2|8 ), jatilagāvīdhukavidhirūpā daśame ( 10|8|4 ) |
(matā- ntaradvayamāha-) ataśca na punaruktā mahān doṣaḥ ityeva vaktavyam, athavā ekasyaiva nyāyasya ka cit kaścidaṃśaḥ śodhyate iti punarārambhaḥ |
dvitīyamāha-) spaṣṭaṃ vā (ca- sudhāyām ) viṣayanānātvam evaṃ varṇanīyam, sarvavidhi- sarūpāṇāṃ kevalavidhinirākaraṇena arthavādatvamiha siddham |
yastu caturthe punarārambhaḥ, sa arthavādakalpite vidhau phalakāṅkṣāvelāyām anyathopapattim kṛta- prayogavacanāt tadeva saṃnihitataram |
itarathā saṃbandhaḥ tadveṣaśca upakārakatvaṃ kalpanīyam iti rātrisatrapratiṣṭhā''disat phalavidhiviṣaye iti pūrvapakṣāmiprāyaḥ |
kathañcit prayo- janāntare labhyamāne, na ekasyānekārthatā yuktā, tasmāt arthavādatvameva iti siddhāntaḥ |
kratoḥ puruṣasya vā ityādi vicārya ihasiddhena arthavādena upasaṃhāraḥ |
tathā parakṛtipurākalpayoḥ kiṃ tadgotrāṇām, uta sarvapuṃsām iti cintitam |
(atha tṛtīya prakāramāha-) athavā phalavidheva yatra medena stutiphaladāni bhavanti, tadiha udāharaṇam |
yathā atraiva 'ūrjadumbaraḥ ūrka paśāvaḥ' ityevareva stutiḥ, 'ūrjau'va- radadhai' ityanena phalamiti |
yatra punaḥ tāvanmātreṇa phalaṃ vā stutirvā vakṣyati bhavati, te caturthe iti |

(atrāpi aparitoṣāt caturtha prakāramāha-) athavā tatra 'pārthatvāt' ( 4|1|1 ) iti hetudvayapadeśāt prasiddhena ca hetunā vyavahārāt ye vijñātapārthārthāḥ, te udāharaṇaṃ yathā 'yasya parṇamayī juhūḥ' iti |
atra hi avadyaṃ juhun- vādena parṇamayīṃ vidhātavyam, svātantryeṇa phalasaṃbandhā- śakteḥ |
sarvatra hi guṇaḥ phalāya codyamānaḥ : kaṃ cit
tadiha yadi 'parṇamayītvena phalaṃ bhāvayet' iti vacanaṃ mapyeta, 'kimāśritena' (kasyāśritena iti vigrahaḥ) ityapekṣāyāṃ kiṃ saṃbadhyatām ? juhūḥ iti cet na, vākyabhedaprasaṅgāt |
sā'pi na prāk kriyālābhatā naiva nirākāṅkṣī bhavati |
tasmāt anivaheṇāt etadvacanavyaktiparityāgena itarā- śrayaṇam (parṇamayītvena juhūṃ bhāvayet iti) |
tatra na 'juhā juhoti' ityasyāḥ prakaraṇe niśārthaprayojanatvāt vihitajātiviśeṣāyāḥ tadākāṅkṣāyāṃ satyāṃ yāvadeva parṇatvajātiḥ upanītā, tāvat avijñātaprayojanāvasya- tvāt ajñātāṃ pratipadyate |
tataśca nirākāṅkṣī- bhūtāyāḥ tasminneva vākye phalakalpanānimittaṃ nāsti iti yuktamarthavādatvam |
iha punaḥ vaikṛtaprakaraṇe (somāpauṣṇaṃ traitamālameta ityatra) śrayamāṇam audumbara- tvam udāhriyate |
na ca tasya prasiddhaṃ pārārthyam, yena caturthādhikaraṇaviṣayatā bhavet |
katham ? atra hi na tāvat aprāpte rūpe jātividhānaṃ śakyam |
tat kuto jāyatasya tadarthena vidhiḥ; ataḥ phale vidhānam |
yā'pi ca āśrayāpekṣā, sā'pi prākṛtakarmasaṃbandhiodakaprāptayūpagrahaṇāt nivartate iti avijñātaḥ |
tena prāgeva pārārthyāt phalasaṃbandhaprasaktiḥ avaśyaṃ nyāyāntareṇa nirākartavyā iti etadadhikaraṇārambhaḥ |

(uktānāṃ caturṇāṃ paunaruktyaparihāraprakārāṇāṃ madhye prathamopanyastasya ekasyaiva nyāyasya 'ka cit kaścid bodhyate' ityasyaiva abhimattamāha- ) idaṃparaṃ matam, audumbaravākyaṃ juhādivākyaṃ ca ubhayamubhayama udāhaṇam |
sādhyasādhanasaṃbandhasthāvat dvayorapi yogyatvena upāttayoḥ avakalpate, nānyā |

tatra caturthe sādhanasādhanoya- vicāram anādṛtya abhyupetya vā kevalasyāṃśavicāraḥ 'kim īdṛśena kāmaśabdepanvarahitena vartamānaphala- saṃtrandhiābhidhāyinā phalavat śakyate gamayituṃ na vā' iti vicāraḥ |
kevalatādhanāṃśavicāraḥ 'kim īdṛśena vidhivimarśarahitena dravyaguṇakriyāḥ kaṃ cit prati sādhanatvena pratipādyante, na' iti |
yacca yadātmanā pratipāditaṃ bhavati, tat pratiyogiviśeṣāpekṣaṃ sat padāntarāpāttena tena saṃbadhyate |
tatra sādhyam iti avadhṛte, pariśeṣāt avaśiṣṭaṃ sādhanaṃ gamyate, evaṃ sādhanācāreṇa'pi, iti dvāvapi aṃśau svarūpeṇa nirūpayitavyau |
tadiha sādhanāṃśe vicāryamāṇe yo nāma phalāṃśasya saṃsparśaḥ, sa caturthe siddheḥ prasaṅgāt hetutvena iti mantavyam |
tathā yatra sādhanāṃśaparāmarśaḥ, sa iha siddhaḥ, tatra paścād iti apunaruktam |
nanu evaṃ sati vidhudeśacintaneyam iti arthavādādhikaraṇena na saṃbadhyate |
yadi hi asau vidhīyamānatayā pūrveṇa avagataḥ, tato nārthavāda- tvam |
tatra pūrvapakṣāmiprāyaḥ, sarvathā sādhyasaṃnidhāne yat uccaritam, tat ākāṅkṣāvaśeṇa tādūpyeṇa anupāttamāpi sādhanaṃ bhavati, yathaiva yāgena ityuditaṃ saṃbadhyate, tathaiva audumbareṇa iti |

tatra vidhiḥ kiṃ kuryāt ? puruṣaṃ pravarta- yet, sa ca phalārthatayaiva pravṛttaḥ, iti kiṃ vidhinā ? athavā prayogavacanavihitasya phalasaṃbandhamātram anena kriyate, pañcamo vā lakāreṇa vidhāsyati, arthavādaikadeśo vā ityuktemeva |
tasmāt 'ūrjaṃ'vadadhai' iti tādarthya- caturthyaiva evaṃkāmaśabdādapi sphuṭataraṃ phalamupāttam iti tasmin audumbarāvidhiḥ, na tu phalasya vidhānam iti ahītavyam, bhāvādhikaraṇe phalavidhi niṣedhāt |
tasmāt mukhya- vidhisaṃbhave lakṣaṇayā na stutiḥ pratipattavyeti |
bhāṣyam-- iti cet paśyasi stutirnārthikā, na ca śabdena avagamyate iti |
tadyathā 'iyaṃ gauḥ ketavyā devadattīyā, eṣā hi bahukṣīrā svapatyā anaṣṭaprajā ca' iti |
ketavyā ityukte (pravartante, tathāpi ) guṇābhidhānāt pravartantetarāṃ ketāraḥ |
vā-- loke tāvat buddhipūrvakāriṇaḥ puruṣāḥ mātrā- mapi na niyojyanāṃ prayuñjate |
tatra ca ketavyā iti vihite bahukṣīrādibhirguṇaiḥ stutiḥ |
na ca kṣīrādayaḥ phalavidhayaḥ, pratyakṣa- viṣayatvāt |
vaidikeṣu punaryadi vidhiśabdena na prarocyante, natarāmevārthavādena |
api ca vede vyaktamasaṃvādaḥ, 'ūrjaṃ'vadadhai' ityaprasiddhaṃ vacanam |
yasmāt ūrjudumbaraḥ ; tasmāttanmayo yūpaḥ kartavyaḥ ityurjadumbara ityanṛtavacanāt anyadasya anṛtamiti parikalpyeta |
vā-- nāyaṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ, stuteḥ pramāṇāntarāvagatyapekṣa tvāt |
loke tatsaṃbhavā dupapattiḥ; vede tu aviditavāda- tvāt na śraddhīran |
athavā loke eva yadi aviditaṃ kaścit vadet, tadā naiva śraddhīran |
athavā yadyarthopamā, yathā adhi- gatapūrvavacane śraddhate, naivaṃ aviditavāde |
na ca ukti- mātreṇa ete bahukṣīrādayaḥ prarocyante, kiṃ tarhi ? vidita- tvādeva |
vede tu arthavādasatyatvena vidhi jātāśaṅko na pravartate |
athavā yo vidhimukkramya arthavādaṃ prārthayate, nūtanasya vidhau aviśramaḥ |
tatra cedanāśvāsaḥ (yatra codanā'śvāsaḥ, tatra ) arthavāde kutaḥ pratyayaḥ |
vartamāna ūrja'vadadhanena iyaṃ stutiḥ, na ca tadasti, tatra avidyamānabahukṣīrakīrtanavat etat syāt |
svarūpastāvat udumbare annaṃ pakṣadharmeṇa apra- siddham |
anvayaprasiddheḥ hetutvātprasiddhiḥ ! nahi yadyat annaṃ sasa yūpaḥ iti loke vede vā prasiddham |
tasmāt asaṃvādāt varaṃ vidhiraiva, kiṃ stutyā saṃvādāpekṣayā iti |
stutivacanaḥ śabdo nāstīti- cet, iha phalavattvām ānarthakyamiti yo dvitīyo'rthaḥ praśaṃsā nāma, sa gamyate |
nanūktam asaṃvādo vede, nahi ūrjudumbara iti |
kiṃ sādhyam ? yathā annaṃ prīteḥ sādhanam evamidamapi |
śakyate hi tat phalaphalasaṃbadhāt ūrjū iti vaktum |
vā-- 'ūrjudumbaraḥ' ityādi tāvat 'ūrja'- vadadhai' ityasyopapattyā ekavākyabhūtam, na vicchinnaṃ stāvakam |
nahi annamudumbaraḥ ityukte puruṣaṃ prati praśastatā gamyate |
tatra yadyapi tāvat liṅgādiḥ syāt, tathāpi sutarāmarthavādatayā gṛhyītāt |
prakaraṇācca yāgopakāre prayojane labhya- māne, kimityavācakāt phalaṃ kalpayiṣyāmaḥ |
prakaraṇa vākyena bādhyate iti cet, avirodhāt |
yadi hi ekāṃśatvena vākyaprakaraṇe saṃnipatetām, tathā sati bādhaḥ syāt |
iha tu prakaraṇamaudumbaravidhiṃ gṛhṇāti, so'pi 'ūrjudumbaraḥ' ityādibhyāṃ prarocanām |
prarocanā'pi ca vākyaśeṣādupapadya- mānā, nārthavādyā viśudeśādeva kalpitā bhaviṣyati |
anyatra vidhirapi hi tāvat tat kalpayet |
tu svameva duḥsthitaḥ kiṃ prarocanayā kariṣyatīti |
na ca stutyupayuktasya punaḥ phale'pi pratiṣṭhādāviva vyāpāro yujyate |
rātrisatrāṇāṃ hi ananyaparatvāt gurbyapi kalpanā āśrayate |
jātiviśeṣasya ca yogyatayaiva kāṅkṣāt prasiddhaṃ na phalā- rthatā |
yūpacchando'pi ca karmādhiṣṭhākatvena ityupanītamātra- meva gṛhṇāti |
yattu yūpe (po) nirākāṅkṣo jātiṃ pratīti, śaravadvādho bhaviṣyati |
etāvāṃstu viśeṣaḥ, tava puruṣārthatvāt bhinnaviṣayeṇa sattā kathañcit prasaṅgasyamānāśrayatvena, mama tubhayoḥ ṛtvarthatvāt samānaviṣayete |
na cātra jātau phalāya vidhīyamānāyāṃ dadhna iva homaḥ āśrayo manasi viparivartate |
yo hi paśuyāgaḥ prakṛtaḥ, sa tāvadyogyaḥ |
evaṃ ca dadhyuparūpaprāptasya homasya phalasaṃbandhavidhitvāt dadhyuparāgo'pi niyamena sidhyati ityetāvatā saṃbandhadvayasyāpi vākyavidheyatvena |

prakṛte ca yūpasya adṛṣṭarūpasya alaukikatvena loktaḥ tatsaṃbandhāsiddheḥ tadāśrayaṇena phalasaṃbandhamātravidhitvaṃ saṃbhavati, iti yūpaudumbarasaṃbandhasyāpi vidheyatvāvaśyambhā- vāt duṣpariharo vākyabhedaḥ |
iti tanmatānusāriṇaḥ kasya cidupapādanam anuvadati-) kaścittu āha yūpasyā- dṛṣṭatvāt tatsaṃbandho dadhihomasaṃbandhavat na lokto labhyate |
tatastasya phalasaṃbandhasya ca naikasmāt vākyāt siddhiriti |
(takṣaṇādijanyasaṃskāraviśiṣṭasya alaukika- tve'pi viśeṣyāṃśakāṣṭhādviśeṣasya laukikatvāt guṇāśraya- saṃbandho loktaḥ siddho vācyaḥ, anyathā devatoddeśaviśiṣṭa-
karaṇa (-pratipādanena ) vivitvaśaṅkānirākaraṇena prati- ṣṭhānāt audumbarādhikaraṇavat ityuktam |
ke.) su. pṛ. 110, audumbarādhikaraṇa- vārtikokta: (vā. 1|2|22 pṛ. 136 ) aṅgava- tāranyāya: |
ke.) aindrāgnya asomayāgakāle eva prāpta- tvāt āgneyasya ca somayāgakālavidhau somayājina: pratiṣedhāpatte: acyutavākyatvātsarvatanāvatvāpatte: arthavāda: evāyam iti audumbarādhikaraṇasiddham |

(acyutavākyam - 'āgneyo'ṣṭākapālo'māvāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ cācyuto bhavati' iti ) bhāṭṭa. 10|8| 14, yajamāna: prastara: ' ityatra pratyakṣaśrava- ṇāt ' prastaram uttaraṃ barhiṣa: sādayati ' (barhiṣa: uttaraṃ prastaraṃ sādayati ) iti vidhya
śrutāḥ citriṇyādaya iṣṭāḥ lokaṃpuṇyāḥ prāgeva upadheyāḥ, na tu paścāt |

uktaṃ ca - 'pratyagātmatayā tasya prāptatve'pi ca sarvadā |

1|1|3|16|14. kaṇṭhyanaṃ dakṣiṇāprāptikālamāvi vidhīyate 'kṛṣṇaviṣāṇā kaṇṭhyate' ityanena some |
bhāṭṭa.-- 4|2|7. kaṇḍuyanaṃ dīkṣitena kṛṣpa- viṣāṇayā kartavyam, na hastena |
vi. 11|2|16, kaṇḍuyanaṃ yathā- dṛṣṭaprayojanamatvāt, mantrastu sakṛt paṭhanīyaḥ |
kaṇḍu- yanajanituḥkhadhvaṃsasaṃskāreṇa saṃskāryatvāt : ekatvāt, na tu pratyakṣambhyasyamāne'pi kaṇḍuyane mantrābhyāsaḥ |
11 4|2|7. kaṇḍuyanaṃ viṣāṇāyāḥ prayojakam, prāptaṃ tu pratipattiḥ |
jyotiṣṭome kṛṣṇaviṣāṇayā kaṇḍuyane 'kṛṣi susasyā- muskṛṣe' iti mantra uktaḥ |
yadā anekasminnaṅge yugapat kaṇḍūtirupadhate, tadā pratyaṅgaṃ mantrāvṛttiḥ, uta sakṛt prayogaḥ : iti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
kaṇḍuyane kartavye pratyaṅgaṃ aṅge'ṅge karmabhedāt karmaṇaḥ kaṇḍuya- nasya aṅgabhedena bhedāt pratyaṅgaṃ mantrasya āvṛttiḥ syāt |
ekasmin kāle yāvatu aṅgeṣu kaṇḍuyanam upayate, tāvatī ekā codanā syāt |
tāvatsu cāṅgeṣu avāntarabhedena bhinna- syāpi kaṇḍuyanasya aikakarmyam ekakarmataḥ syāt |
ghaṭikā'rdhaghaṭikā- dikālabhedena kaṇḍuyane tu mantrāvṛttiḥ : ke. kaṇḍuyanamantrasya ekakāle aṅgabhedenāpi kaṇḍūtyau sakṛt prayogaḥ : jyotiṣṭome |
bhāṣyam-- jyotiṣṭome kaṇḍuyanārtho mantraḥ 'kṛṣiṣu syāmakṛṣe' ('kṛṣi susasyāmuskṛṣe') iti |
yadā aneka- smin aṅge yugapat kaṇḍūrupayate, tadā cintā kiṃ pratyaṅgaṃ mantrāvṛttiḥ, athavā sakṛdeva prayogaḥ : iti prāptam ? pratyaṅgaṃ mantraḥ : iti |
śāstra- dīpikāyāṃ tu 'kṛṣye tvā susasyāye' iti mantraḥ |
evaṃ yati bhāṣye 'syām akṛṣe' iti vā 'syām akṣaḥ : ' iti vā chedaḥ : iti saṃśayaḥ |
vayaṃ tu mā-pāṭhaḥ : lekhakapramādaḥ iti matvā maitrāyaṇīyapāṭha eva bhāṣyasaṃmata iti manyā- mahe) |
pratiprayogaṃ ca adṛṣṭabhedāt karmanānātvaṃ bhavet, tathā gṛhyeta viśeṣaḥ |
atha punararthyagṛhīte kaṇḍuyane yāvatā upaghnā kaṇḍūrupanīyate tāvaccikīrṣi- tam |
nanu yajñāṅgasya niṣkarṣaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tat saṃskṛtam, ajñāntare punaḥ kartavyam |
kiṃ tarhi ? kaṇḍuyapa- nayanārthaḥ : sā ca kaṇḍūrātmano, na śarīrasya |
tatra na gṛhyate viśeṣaḥ : tasmāt sakṛdeva prayogaḥ |
śā-- ātmānaṃ kaṇḍūduḥkhātkṣitacittam apanīta- kaṇḍūduḥkhaṃ kartuṃ kaṇḍuyanaṃ kriyate |
tena yāvatā duḥkhena anapanītena ātmani duḥkhaṃ bhavati, tāvat sarvamapanetu- mabhisaṃbhrāya kaṇḍuyanamupakramamāṇena prayukto mantraḥ agṛhyamāṇaviśeṣatvāt tantraṃ bhavati |
soma-- saṃskāravaidhaikyāt mantrasya sakṛt prayoge''- pi iha tadedāt (saṃskāryabhedāt ) bhedaḥ, ityucyate : saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrāthaistu- kaṇḍuyane pratyakṣamāvṛttiḥ syāt karmabhedāt iti |
bhāṭṭa.-- kṛṣṇaviṣāṇākaṇḍuyane 'kṛṣyai tvā susasyāye' iti mantraḥ |
yadā tu ekakāle evānekāṅgaviṣayaṃ kaṇḍuyanam, tadā smṛtivicchedā- danāvṛttiḥ |
na ca tadā'pi svāpadayuktvāt nirvāpamantranyāyena (1|4|144) tattadaṅgabhedenāvṛttiḥ, ajñānāmupayuktatvābhāvenāsaṃsakāryatvāt tvāpadena tannirdeśa- nupapatteḥ |
ata eva tattadaṅgabhedena tatsatkaṇḍūmedāt tajanyaduḥkhabhedena tadudhvaṃsarūpakāmabhede'pi na mantrā- vṛttiḥ |
tvāpadirdeśasvātmanaḥ (nirdeśastu ātmanaḥ ) eva kaṇḍujanitacittavikṣepanivṛttidvārā saṃskāryatvāt tasya caikatvena nirvāpasyānānupapatteḥ |
' ityatra sāmānyapratipiddhasya śvetavṛntākasya upasaṃhārarūpaḥ kṛtyarthaḥ : pratiṣedhaḥ |
bhā. 10|4|2143, prastāvo- dgīyapratihāropadravanidhanavataḥ sarvasya sastomasvarakāla- nyāsasya kaṇvarathantaram ityākhyā bhavati |
kaṇvarathantarasya vaiśyastome pṛṣṭhastoma- sādhanatayā vihitasya 'punānaḥ soma dhārayā' iti svayonī eva gānam |
bhāṣyam-- asti vaiśyastomaḥ : 'vaiśyaḥ vaiśyastomena yajeta' iti |
ubhayavikāraḥ : kaṇvarathantaram ityuktam 'aprākṛte tadadhikārād virodhād vyavatiṣṭheran' iti (9|2|16|47) |
tatra saṃśayaḥ : kiṃ rathantaronau bṛhadyono vā aniyamena kaṇvarathaṃtaraṃ geyam, uta rathantarayonau, athavā svayonā- viti |
pṛṣṭhārthe yadetat anyat rathantarāt kaṇvarathaṃtaraṃ śrūyate, tat rathantarayonau syāt |
kutaḥ ? kaṇvarathaṃtare rathantaraśabdaḥ śrūyate, tena gamyate rathantaraviśeṣaḥ kaṇvarathantaramiti |
arthāntare kaṇvarathantaraśabdo bhavet, yadi rathantaradharmāḥ na bhaveyuḥ |
evamihāpi dharmanimittaḥ kaṇvarathaṃtare rathantaraśabdo bhavati, nānyatheti |
prastāva-udgīya- pratihāra-upadrava-nidhanavataḥ sarvasya sastoma-svara-kāla- abhyāsasya kaṇvarathantaram ityākhyā bhavati |
apica arthāntare kaṇvarathaṃtare rathantara- śabdaḥ kalpyaḥ |
dup-- bhāṣyakāreṇa yadidaṃ vyākhyānaṃ kṛtaṃ 'prastāvodīghādau kaṇvarathantaraśabdaḥ' iti, tadayuktam |
'gītiṣu sāmākhyā' (2|1|1|136) iti kaṇva- rathaṃtaraśabdena sāma ucyate, na ṛk |
prakṛtau ca ṛga- kṣarāṇi saṃskṛtavatī rathantaragītiḥ pṛṣṭhasya sādhanabhāvena ava- gatā |
iha tu bṛhadrathaṃtarānuvādena anyat gītayantaraṃ vidhīyate pṛṣṭhasādhanatvena |
tasmāt gītiḥ gītereva kāryaṃ ( akṣarābhivyaktau ) vartate, na ṛkkāryaṃ ( akṣamatvāt ) |
sā ( vikāreṇa ) na bādhiṃtavyā ( sā hi prakṛtau kramakaraṇābhyām ) aṅgabhūtā |
vākyasya tāvat ayamarthaḥ : ( yaduta sāmamātrābhyākaraṇam ) tena śabdastattāvat na ṛco bādhaḥ |
na ca apadārthasāmarthyāt codakaprāsāyā ṛco bādhaḥ' iti pāṭhaḥ |
sa ca na yuktaḥ ] yathā dhenuśabdena chāgādaśansa |
dhenuśabdo ( hi ) godagnya- mantareṇa naiva dhetuḥ prayujyamānaḥ |
( anayā uttarayo- rgītyanupapatteḥ ) na ca gauṇī sā ( gītiḥ ) anyatra prayujyamānā ( pramāṇābhāvāt ) |
kiṃtu vaiśya- stomaprakaraṇe kaṇvarathaṃtarayoḥ paṭhitā uttaragranthe |
tassāt tathā prakaraṇaprāptyā bādhyate ityevaṃ ca vyaktam |
ke-- bṛhato yoniḥ 'tvāmiddhi' iti, rathaṃtarasya yoniḥ 'abhi tvā śūra' iti, kaṇvarathaṃtarasya yo
idaṃ tprākṛtaṃ sāma dvayoḥ kārye vidhīyate |
' tacca dvayopi kārye kurvat dharmānapi dvayoḥ samuccayaṃ gṛhṇāti iti bhāṣyakāraḥ |
soma- prakṛtāviha na samuccayaḥ ityuktānāt pratyudāharaṇasaṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu ( bhāṣyamate )- aprākṛte kaṇvarathaṃtare tadvikāratvāt bṛhadrathaṃtarobhayavikāra- tvāt ubhayasyānāpannatvāt ubhayadharmāḥ syuḥ |
viruddhatvā ye dharmāḥ, te virodhāt samuccayasaṃbhavena vyavasthitirena iti |
vārtikakārapakṣe, vaidyastomasya jyotiṣṭoma- vikāratvāt yathāprakṛti stutidvayavikalpe, taddharmā api vikalpena ' bṛhati uccairgīyam ' ' rathaṃtare nīcaiḥ ', ityādidharmāṇāṃ virodhāt iti |
vi- ' tayordharmāḥ samuccayena vā na vā kaṇvarathaṃtare |
dvisathānatvād bhāṣya ( bhāṣye ) āco virodhād vārtike'ntimaḥ |
' bhāṭṭa- vaiśyastome ' kaṇvarathaṃtaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati ' iti śrutam |
tacca prakṛtau bṛhadrathaṃtarayoreva pṛṣṭhasadasāmānādhi- karaṇyāt pṛṣṭhapadasamānādhikaraṇatvāt vasāhadvayena hotṛḥ pṛṣṭhe eva niviśate, na tu maitrāvaruṇādipṛṣṭheṣu iti tatraiva kaustubhe spaṣṭam |
ataśca bṛhadrathaṃtaravikāratvāt taddharma- prāptirapi pūrvādhikaraṇoktarītyā avivādaiva |

sā ca kiṃ samuccayenobhayadharmaprāptiḥ, uta vikalpeti cintāyām, stotradvayajanakavijātīyasaṃskārasamūhayoḥ prakṛtau tattva- dṛksāmadisādhamībhedena vikalpenopattāvapi vaiśyastome kaṇvarathaṃtaratadāśrayabhūtaṛgādirūpasāmanyaikyena eka- sminneva saptadaśasaṃkhyakasaṃsakārasamūhe tajjanyaguṇābhidhāna- samūhālambhane vā vaijātyādabhimadhyau bādhakābhāvāt prayojakadvayasattvena aviruddhasamīlanavidha
yo lobhāt saṃcinotyārthaṃ sa kadarya iti smṛtaḥ ||
kadalaphalaṃ yathā svajananīṃ kadarlīṃ nāśayati, tathā jñānam ajñānaṃ nāśayati iti |
'kadā cana strīrasi' iti mantraḥ śrutvā gārhapatyopasthāne viniyoktavyaḥ, na tu liṅgena indropasthāne |
yathā suvarṇajanyakuṇḍalasya suvarṇabhinnatvam, tathā brahmarūpakāraṇajanyajagataḥ kāryasya brahmarūpakāraṇabhinnatvamiti |
yathā kandukaḥ karāghātaiḥ patito'pi svabhāvata evotpatati, tathā sādhuvṛttayo manvantīti |
sāhastrī. 990. kapālam ekaṃ yadi nayet dyāvāpṛthivīmeka-kapālaṃ nirvapet, yadi dve nayettām āśvinaṃ dvikapālaṃ nirvapet |
śrapaṇeva prayuktaṃ kapālaṃ tuṣopavāpe'pi pracchāt sidhyati |
vi. 4|11|19. 'bhinnaṃ kapālamapsva prāsya' iti sarvanāśo śrūyate |
'yāvato'śvān pratigṛhṇīyāt tāvato vāruṇāśvān-kapālān nirvapet' iti apratigrahe'pyā vāruṇāśva-kapālāḥ puroḍāśāḥ aśrvasaṃkhyāḥ śrūyante |
yadā te puroḍāśāḥ bahavaḥ syuḥ, tadā kiṃ teṣāṃ śrapaṇaṃ dīrdheṣu kapāleṣu syāt, uta pratipuroḍāśaṃ kapāla-catuṣkamabhedaḥ iti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
tulyasaṃkhyānāṃ puroḍāśānāṃ kapālāni prājāpatyeṣu paśuṣu kumbhīvat tantraṃ syuḥ |
dīrghataradīrghatameṣu catuṣvaiva kapāleṣu anekeṣāṃ puroḍāśānāṃ śrapaṇaṃ syāt |
prakṛtivat yathā prakṛtau darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ pratipuroḍāśaṃ kapālāni bhinnāni bhavanti tadvat codakā-nusārāt |
'yāvatkapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ prathayati' iti puroḍāśasya slīyeṣu kapāleṣu sarveṣu abhiprathanaṃ vihitam |
tasmāt kartavyānāṃ sarveṣāṃ puroḍāśānāṃ slīyeṣu kapāleṣu yathā abhiprathanaṃ syāt ityetadarthaṃ pratipuroḍāśaṃ kapālacatuṣbhedaḥ syāt iti siddhāntaḥ |
vi. 3|15. kapālebhyo vyudṛtya puroḍāśasya vedyām āsādanaṃ kriyate darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ |
bhā. 10|1|2| 58. kapālasya tuṣopavāpaṃ prati śeṣatve'pi tataprayojyatvaṃ nāsti |
vi. 3|12, kapālasya mede saṃrṣave vā prāyaścitta homaviśeṣaḥ |
6|4|4. kapālānām upadhānaṃ saurya carau na kartavyam |
bhā. 10|1|16|54, kapālānāṃ saṃtāpanaṃ prakṛtau asti 'vasūnāṃ rudrāṇāmādityānāṃ bhṛgāṇāmaṅgirasāṃ dharmasya tapasā tadhyadham' iti mantreṇa |
10|1|15|53 (56), kapālānāṃ saṃtāpanaṃ saurya carau na kartavyam |
