'bhoge vā vibhajatu' ityādida- neke, teṣāṃ brīhiyavanyāyena vikalpāt ekanāparasya prasaṅga- siddhi: |
na ca prakāśitasyāpi puna: prakāśanasaṃbhavāt samuccaya: ; prakāśanasya anuṣṭhānatvena sakṛtkramaśastenāpi anuṣṭhānasiddhau prakāśanāntaramupayogatā |
mantrāṇāṃ karṇārthatvānmantrāntena karmādisaṃni- pāta: syāt sarvasya vacanārthatvāt |
bhāṣyam - ye padārthakaraṇā mantrā: , yathā, 'iṣe tveti chinatti', 'devasya tvā savitu: prasave ityādatte' iti |
teṣāṃ mantrāntena karmādisaṃnipāta: , yasmin karmaṇyu- payujyate |
mantreṇopasthita: padārtha: kartavya iti vijñāyate, tadarthasya mantrasya āmnānasāmarthyā- dracanācca |
oṃ karaṇamantraprakāśayaṃ phalaṃ ka vit ṛtvijāmapi, yatra phalaṃ karmārtham |
yatra vā upareveṣu 'tano saha' iti vyapadeśo bhavati |
bhā. 3|8|14|29-30, oṃ karaṇa- mantraprakāśayaṃ phalaṃ yājamānam |
vā. 4|4|1|1 pṛ. 322, oṃ karaṇavibhaktiniyuktānāṃ sakalopayoganyāthā''nupapattyā phalasādhanatā yuktā |
2|2|1|126 pṛ. 550, oṃ karaṇaśabdo yādṛśamarthe bravīti, tādṛśasya prātipadikaṃ vācakameva |
kṛdantena hi kārakaviśiṣṭaṃ dravyameva ucyate, na vibhaktita- vat niṣkṛṣṭā śakti: |
tathā ca 'karaṇam, karaṇena, karaṇāya' iti ca kārakāntayogo dṛśyate |
anyathā hi vibhaktyabhihitenaiva ekena kārakena vaśīkārāt na dravyaṃ kārakāntarayogaṃ pratipadyeta |
karaṇaṃ ca svarthamekaṃ sat svaśaktyudbodhanalakṣaṇam eka- mevopakāram aṅkṛtamapekṣate |
ṭup. 9|1|12 pṛ. 1637, oṃ karaṇānugrāhiṇī itikartavyatā loke dṛṣṭā, sā tathaivehāpi bhavitumarhati |
oṃ karoti: utpattirūpaphalāvicalataṃ tadanukūlavyāpārī yānarūpa: pratyayavat |
evaṃ ca na karotiyatyo: samānārtha- katvam, na vā yatate: sakarmakatvāpatti: anuyogaśca |
maṇi. pṛ. 108, oṃ karoti: kriyamāṇena na kaścit karmaṇā vinā |
' karoteḥ nityaṃ sakarmakatvāt yāvat kriyamāṇaṃ na labhyate, na tāvadarthaḥ paryavasyati |
tatra anvayavyatirekābhyām idamavagatam 'bhavatikriyāḥ kartā karoteḥ karma saṃdhatte' iti |
tathāhi, 'nityaṃ na bhavanaṃ yasya, yasya vā nityabhūtā |
' ya eva hi pravṛttabhavanaḥ saṃbhāvita- bhavano vā anyena prayujyate, sa eva kriyamāṇatvena ava- dhāryate nānyaḥ |
tathā ca na kaścit khapuṣpam ākāśaṃ vā kurvanpalabhyate |
yatrāpi 'pādī kurū' ityādiṣu niṣpa- jñānāṃ karmatvaprayogo dṛśyate, tatrāpi aniṣpannasaṃskārādi- vivakṣayā pādādiśabdaprayogāt anyabhicāraḥ |
satyapi ca karoternarakatve sarvatra gandhanavatkṣepaṇadau kiñcidanu- tpattipādanasāmānyānbhavagamyate |
athavā yadā asya utpādanābhidhāyitvam, tadaiva viśiṣṭākhyātasāmānyādhi- karaṇyaṃ dṛṣṭam
‘svargakāmo yajeta’ iti aviśeṣaśravaṇe'pi agni-vicāritatvena ayogyasya śabdādeḥ kartṛtvā'saṃbhavāt , yogyatvena tairvāṇikaḥ kartā viśeṣeṇa jñāyate |
‘patitaṣaṇḍayoḥ dvijātikarmebhyo hāniḥ’ iti niṣedhāt tadarjitaḥ aprati- ṣiddhatvena jñāyate |
‘rājā rājasūyena yajeta’ iti viśeṣopapadena kṣatriyaḥ kartā jñāyate |
su. pṛ. 246. pratibhede hetubhūtaṃ dānaṃ ya ācarati so'pi pratigrahe kartā iti nyapadiśyate hetukartavye svavyāpārādarā prayojyavyāpārakartṛtvāsattvāt |
parākramaḥ 512. yasya kārakasyāvāntaravyāpāre dhātuḥ prādhānyenāha sa kartā |
vā. 3|4|143 pṛ. 917. yasya vyāpāro dhātunā prādhānyenopādīyate sa kartā |
dhātunā sakalakārakānuyāyi- vyāpārādāne'pi kārakāntaravyāpārasya rājasaṃnidhāne amātyānāmiva niyāmakatvāttyātiḥ |
bhā. 11|2| 10147, kartāraḥ te eva ā antāt syuḥ rāja- sūye |
sati saṃbhave te eva kartāraḥ iti vārti- kam |
ke. 11|4|2|4-7. kartāraḥ tantraṃ vihāradvaye, adhvaryupratiprasthātṛstu vacanāt medaḥ varaṇapradāseṣu |
bhā. 11|2|10144-48, kartāraḥ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ punaḥprayoge te eva anye vā aniyamaḥ |
ṭup. 11|4|127. kartuḥ anamidheyasyaiva viśeṣyatvaviśeṣaṇopapatteḥ apramāṇam (ākhyātāsya-) abhidhānaśaktikalpa- nam |
vā. 3|4|143 pṛ. 921. kartuḥ asādhā- raṇyena saṃkhyā'nyasya vistareṇopapāditatvāt |
su. pṛ. 1447. asaraṇaṃ jīrṇakūpārāmādiścitra cira- kālavyavadhānādupapannam ( sāmagānām ūhagranthavedaṃ kartṛsasmaram ) |
vi. 12|2|1 varṇakaṃ 2. kartuḥ darśapūrṇa- māsiksya vikṛtau sauryādau nātideśaḥ |
bhā. 8|1|13| 20-22. kartuḥ dīkṣāniṣṭhatvalābhastu anuvādbalāt irāpadasyeva nānupanaḥ |
‘cāturmāsyānāṃ yajñakratūnāṃ pañca ṛtvijaḥ’ ‘adhvaryuḥ pratiprasthātā brahmā hotā āgnīdhraśceti |
adhvaryuḥ pratiprasthātā hotā maitrā- varuṇaḥ brahmā āgnīdhraśceti |

‘saumyasyādhvarasya yajñakratoḥ saptadaśa ṛtvijaḥ’ adhvaryuḥ pratiprasthātā neṣṭā unnetā ca, brahmā brāhmaṇācchaṃsī agnīt potā ca, udgātā prastotā pratihartā subrahmaṇyaśca, hotā maitrāvaruṇaḥ acchāvākaḥ grāvastut ca sadasyaśca |
vi. 4|2|9, 3|17. kartuḥ punaḥ aikāntika bhāvanayā upādānaṃ viśeṣarūpeṇa cetyuktam |
vā. 3|4|143 pṛ. 919. kartuḥ phalam iti phalotsarganyāyaḥ |
vi. 6|1|1. kartṛṇāṃ śrutisaṃyogāt (3|4|12 ) iti nyāyena yāvajjīvanakālaḥ kartṛdharmaḥ ityuktam |
bhā. 11|2|10144-48, kartṛṇām aikyam āgneyādīnāṃ pradhānānāṃ darśapūrṇamāsacāturmāsyādau |

‘kartṛṇāṃ śāstragamye'rthe’ iti vārtikokta- nyāyena kartṛtvasya vidheyā'puruṣārthe karmaṇi ātmalābhā- yogāt tādabhyaśrutyarthavatvāya tasya puruṣe samīhitena pradhānabhūtena saṃbandhaḥ padaśrutyā gamyate |
mātrātmakaṃ kartṛtvam, tathāpi tat buddhipūrvakāriṇāṃ phala- saṃkalpamiśram |
vā. 3|4|142 pṛ. 906. kartari tṛtīyā kārakavibhaktirūpā viniyoktrī śrutiḥ yathā ‘brāhmaṇena niṣkāraṇena ṣaḍaṅgo vedo'dhyeyo jñeyaśca’ |
bāla. pṛ. 44, kartari ṣaṣṭhī kārakavibhaktirūpā viniyoktrī śrutiḥ yathā ‘kṛṣṇasya kṛtiḥ’ |

pṛ. 45. ‘kartṛkarmaṇoreva ākhyātāt tātparyaviṣayatayā pratītiḥ tannimittaśca saṃkhyā'nyaḥ, na kārakāntaraṇām’ iti niyame ‘prādhānyavivakṣāhetutvāt tātparyasya, kārakāntarāṇāṃ ca karmavat vastulakṣaṇāsya kartṛtvā śabdalakṣaṇasya prādhānyasya vivakṣitumaśakyatvam’ hetuḥ |
’ abhedavartitvaṃ hi tatpada- sāmānyādhikaraṇyam asaṃdigdhavācakeṣu kudanteṣu ‘paktā devadattaḥ, paca odanaḥ’ ityādiṣu dṛṣṭam |
yatra ca kartṛ- karmavacanatvaṃ nāsti, tatra sāmānādhikaraṇyamahaṃ yathā pākādiśabde |

su. pṛ. 1427. kartṛkarmākhyāte ‘odanaḥ pacyate svayameva’ ityādau odananiṣṭhayoḥ kartṛkarmatvayoḥ vivakṣaṇāt odananiṣṭhakarmatvasamānādhikaraṇaphalayogakaudananiṣṭhakartṛ- sāmānādhikaraṇānākulabhāvanā iti bodhaḥ |
maṇi. pṛ. 114. kartṛ-kāla-deśa-dravya-guṇa-saṃskārāḥ adhvaryuādi-paurṇamāsyādi-'mādi- nnīyādi-śuklādi- avaghātādayaḥ tattadākhyaiḥ niyamena prayujyante |
( tatra adhvaryuādiḥ kartā, paurṇamāsyādiḥ kālaḥ, samādiḥ deśaḥ, nīyādi dravyam, śuklādiḥ guṇaḥ, avaghātādiḥ saṃskāraḥ |
) ke. 4|2|9-123-26. kartṛguṇe tu karmasamavāyād vākyabhedaḥ syāt |
kimidam abhikramaṇaṃ prayāje- ṣveva niviśate, uta kṛtsne prakaraṇe iti vicāre pūrvapakṣa- māha |
tasmin abhi- kramaṇe kartṛguṇe sati ‘abhikrāmaṃ juhoti’ ityatra vākya- bhedaḥ syāt |
karmasamavāyāt karmaṇā juhotinā abhi- kramaṇasya karmaṇaḥ samavāyābhāvāt saṃbandhābhāvāt |
tataśca kartṛdvārā sarvasmin prakaraṇe niveśita abhikramaṇam |

athavā abhikramaṇe kartṛguṇe, ajñānām itikartavyatā- ''kāṅkṣāviraheṇa avāntaraprakaraṇaparyavasthitāpekṣatva- yājahomakramasaṃbandhabhāvāt karmasamavāyāt, tatparakaṇaika- vākyatvābhāvarūpo vākyabhedaḥ syāt iti vārtikānusārī sūtrāthaiḥ |
‘kartṛguṇe abhikramaṇe prayājakarmaṇi asamavāyāt tadvākyaikavākyatā na syāt iti sūtrārthaḥ’ |
‘abhikrāmaṃ juhoti’ iti abhikramaṇaṃ darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe na niviśate |
abhikramaṇena samāsīdati āha- vanīyaṃ kartā, dūrādvā abhiprāyaṃ hastaṃ juhuyāt |
sūtrākṣarārthaḥ-- abhikrāmam ityetat juhotinā ekavākyam ekārthapratipādakaṃ syāt |
hi yasmāt pūrveṇa abhikrāmam ityetāvata padena janyaṃ padārthajñānam asamāptam aparyavasaṃ juhotinā uttareṇa sākāṅkṣa bhavati |
athavā abhikramaṇaṃ prayājabhāvanayā sākāṅkṣam ittha- bhāvākāṅkṣālakṣaṇaprakaraṇayuktameva |
tasmāt tat eka- vākyaṃ prayājabhāvanāyāmeva anvitaṃ syāt |
pūrveṇa pūrva- paṭhitasamānayanavidhinā utthāpitaṃ prayājabhāvanāyāḥ itthaṃbhāvākāṅkṣālakṣaṇaṃ prakaraṇam asamāptam |
kaustubhe tu saṃdeśena abhivyaktikāṅkṣam abhikramaṇa- vākyaṃ prayājavākyaikavākyaṃ syāt |
nahi ādyottejaka- mātreṇa abhivyakteḥ samāptirasti, tasyāḥ antimanātha- tvāt iti sūtraṃ vyākhyeyam-ityuktam |
ke. kartṛguṇe tu karmāsamavāyād vākyabhedaḥ syāt |
ityatra asatyapi lakṣaṇato vākyabhede parasparasambandhābhi- prāyeṇoktam |
vā. 3|6|7|22 pṛ. 1050. kartṛtvaṃ : tulyāni ajñāni pradhānāni ca darśapūrṇa- māsayoḥ |
pradhānaiḥ saha ajñānām ekadeśakālakartṛtvaṃ vakṣyati 'ajñāni tu pradhānatvāt' (11|2|8) ityatra |
'payo vrataṃ brāhmaṇasya, yavāgū rājanyasya, āmiṣaṃ vaiśyasya' iti |
tathā 'bārhadgiraṃ brāhmaṇasya brahmasāma kuryāt, pārtharasaṃ rāja- nyasya, rāyāovājīyaṃ vaiśyasya' iti |
tathā 'yuvaṃ hi sthaḥ svapatī iti dyoryajamānayoḥ pratipadaṃ kuryāt, ete asupramindavaḥ iti bahubhyo yajamānebhyaḥ' iti |
vāla. pṛ. 16-19, kartṛtvaṃ : vācinikaḥ vyavasthita- vikalpo yathā yājamāne vrate 'agre vratapate, vāyo vratapate, āditya vratapate' iti mantratrayasya brāhmaṇā- kartṛkaḥ krameṇa vyavasthā |
ke.) pṛ. 159, kartṛtvaṃ vyavasthāpyaḥ pratiṣedho yathā 'nāyomayājī saṃvaiyet' iti |
tatra, īśvaraprayojyatve anyāste : daṇḍajanya- saṃyogaāśrayatvena kulāle anyāsteśca |
ataḥ dhātvapātta- vyāpārāśrayatvaṃ kartṛtvam iti vaiyākaraṇanayāḥ |
'caitraḥ pacati', 'ghaṭo bhavati' ityādau caitraghaṭādau pākabhavanā''dirūpavyāpārāśrayatvāt lakṣaṇasamanvayaḥ |
vyāpārapadopādānāt na phalāśraye odanādau ati- vyāptiḥ |
'pācyati caitraḥ maitreṇa' ityādī pākasya nijarthasya ca ubhayordhātvarthavyāpāratvāt tadāśrayayo- rubhayorapi kartṛtvopapattiḥ |
parantu caitravṛttyeva tiṅa- pāttam iti saiva tadupapattausambandhaḥ na tu maitrasya |
na caivaṃ 'caitro maitraṃ gamayati' ityatra maitre kartṛtvāpattiḥ, tasminnapi tadvyavahārasattvena iṣṭatvāt |
evaṃ 'sthālī pacati' ityādī sthālīniṣṭhavyāpārasya dhātunā uktatvāt kartṛtvāvirodhaḥ |
'caitro na pacati', 'bhūtale ghaṭo nāsti' ityādī dhātupātta- vyāpārābhāvaāśraye caitrādau avyāpteḥ |
na ca tatra caitra- vṛttiḥ pākaḥ |

abhāvapratiyogī iti, bhūtalabhṛṣṭaniṣṭhā sattā abhāvapratiyoginī ityevaṃ śābdabodhāṅgīkārāt nānyāptiḥ, 'hade vahniāsti' ityādī pratiyogitā'- vacchedakāvacchinnasyapratiyoginaḥ aprasiddhā avyāpyā- patteḥ |

na ca tatra 'vahnivṛttisattā haddvayabhāvapratiyoginī' ityevaṃ śābdabodhāṅgīkārāt tannivāraṇam, tathā'pi 'śuklo ghaṭo bhavati' ityādī śuklaguṇasya bhāvā''śraya- tvena tatra ativyāptiprasaṅgāt, ghaṭe abhyāseśca |
aya tatra viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayoḥ ubhayorbhavanāśrayatvam, tadā 'cakre ghaṭo bhavati' ityādī kasyāpi tadāpattiḥ |

atha yadyātvarthāśrayatvena ca vivakṣitaḥ, sa tatkartā ityu- cyate, cakre ca vivakṣā'bhāvāt nātiprasaṅgaḥ, tadā 'paṭo ghaṭo na' ityādī anyonyābhāvapratiyogini ghaṭādau dhātvarthāśrayatvābhāvāt anyāptiḥ |

na ca tatra bhavatipadādhyāhāre ghaṭapaṭobhavati tādātmyabhavanaṃ bhū- dhātunā lakṣayitvā tādṛśabhavanam abhāvapratiyogi iti śābdabodhāṅgīkārāt arthāta anyonyābhāvopapatteḥ tadātmatvena bhavanasya ca ubhayavṛttitvāt ubhayakartṛtvā- pattiḥ iti vācyam |

etena 'ghaṭo na paṭaḥ' ityatra ghaṭapadaṃ ghaṭapratiyogikānyo- nyābhāvalakṣakam, nañ ca tātparyagrāhakam, anyasya ubhayopi 'śuklo ghaṭaḥ', 'aghaṭaḥ paṭaḥ' itivat pārśvikāmedasaṃbandhamādāya viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvena vā adhyāhṛtakriyāyām, ityapāstam |
tathātve tadeva 'ghaṭo na paṭo' iti prayogānāpatteḥ |
asti cedam 'pacyate caitreṇa', 'pacati caitraḥ' ityādī, caitrasya dhātvarthāva- cchinnakṛtyāśrayatvāt karmalakāre'pi kṛte'kteḥ |
'ghaṭo bhavati' ityādau ākhyātena āśrayatvasya lakṣaṇāt, 'ghaṭo naśyati' ityādī pratiyogitvasya tena lakṣaṇāt tatrāpi lakṣaṇasamanvayaḥ |
avacchinnatvaṃ ca svarūpasaṃbandha- viśeṣaḥ, na tu janakatvāyeva |
'caitraḥ paktaḥ, paktā' ityādī kṛtaiva pākānukūlakṛteḥ liṅgāntrayinyāḥ uktatvāt tasya kartṛtvopapattiḥ |
'caitrasya pākaḥ' ityādidhante vajarthe liṅgāntraye'pi pacidhātunā uktasya lakṣaṇayā pākāva- cchinnavyāpārasya liṅgāntrayatvāt tadāśraye caitre kartṛtvā- virodhaḥ |
ghañā vā lakṣaṇayā kṛteḥ, śaktyā pākāśrayasya bhāvasya ukteḥ pākāvacchinnakṛtisādhyaḥ pākaḥ iti śābdabodhaḥ |
'caitreṇa kṛtaḥ' ityādikamakṛt api dhātunā pākānukūlavyāpāra- syaiva vastutaḥ ukteḥ tadāśrayatvena caitre kartṛtvāvighātaḥ |
evam 'pācyati caitro maitreṇa', ityādāvapi maitrasya dhātūpākānukūlakṛtyāśrayatvāt kartṛtvam |
atra 'pākaṃ kāryati' iti vivaraṇāt kṛtyanukūlavyāpāraḥ : nijarthaḥ |
karmalakārasthale ca phalasya saṃsargavidhayaiva bhānāṅgīkāreṇa padopasthāpyatvābhāvāt na tadāśraye odane ativyāptiḥ |
'viklidyanti taṇḍulāḥ' ityādī ākhyā- tena dhātvarthāśrayatvalakṣaṇatvāt tadvati taṇḍule nānyāptiḥ |
evam 'sthālī pacati' ityādāvapi dhātunā sthālī- niṣṭhatve vyāpārasyeoḥ na kartṛtvavighātaḥ |
karmakartṛ- sthale ca phalasyaiva asmin pade ākhyā
evaṃ ca svasvasaṃbandhā'nvayaḥ kartṛtvaṃ ca ubhayopapannam iti dhyeyam |
evam 'sattā na samavāyena jātivṛttiḥ' ityādiprayogā api lakṣaṇā''dyahārādinā vyākhyāyāḥ, ayogyā vā ityanyatra vistaraḥ |
anyattu sarvaṃ pramāṇāntareṇa labhyam iti dhyeyam |
athavā kṛtyāśrayatvameva mukhyaṃ kartṛtvam, yatnāci- kṛñdhātughaṭitatvāt kartṛśabdasya |

vastutastu 'dharme cāyeṃ ca kāme ca nāticaritavyā tvayeyam' 'patyurno yajñasaṃyoge (pā0 4|1|33)', 'jāyāpatī amīnādacīyātām' ityādipramāṇāntarā- nurodhāt kriyā api yajamānavadeva kartṛtve avagate 'vasante brāhmaṇo'mīnādadhīta' 'yajeta svargakāmaḥ' ityādau ekatvaśravaṇaṃ niṣpādakatvapratyayādhikaraṇanyāyena lakṣa- ṇāyāṃ pramāṇābhāvāt ubhayoḥ vyāsajyavṛtti ekaṃ kartṛtvaṃ gamayati |
apitu pūrvoktakhaṇḍopādhidhyāpakam akhaṇḍopādhirūpaṃ kartṛtvam, tadgatameva ca ekatvādimam ityuktaṃ prāk |
api tu ākhyāta- lakṣyasya akhaṇḍopādhirūpasya kartṛtvasyaiva ākhyāto- pāttakṛtau eva svasamānādhikaraṇaphalaprayojakatvasaṃsargeṇa anvayaḥ ityuktaṃ kaustubhe |
tasya ca 'caitreṇa pacyate' ityatra khanirū- pakāpānukūlatvasaṃsargena nirūpakatvena vā liṅgānvayi- bhāvanāyāmanvayaḥ |
maṇi pṛ. 86, kartṛtvaṃ bhāvanā''sthitaḥ akhaṇḍo- pādhiḥ |
pṛ. 112. kartṛtvaṃ bhoktṛtvaṃ ca sakriyasya syāt, na niṣkriyasya |
ṛju. pṛ. 171. kartṛtvaṃ bhoktṛtvārtham 'śāstraphalaṃ prayoktari' iti nyāyāt
' yadyapi svāmitvena vinā kartṛtvaṃ nopapadyate, tathāpi pramāṇāntaralabhye tasmin ākhyātāṃśairanuṣṭhātavyāṃśamātramabhidhīyate |
tathā ca svāmitvapratipādanārthāḥ tatratatra svargakāmādiśabdāḥ prayuktāḥ |
'svatantraḥ kartā' iti sūtrāt ( pā0 1|4|54 kriyāyāṃ svātantryeṇa vivakṣito'rthaḥ kartā syāt |
sa svatantraḥ trividhaḥ : śuddhaḥ, prayojakaḥ, karmakarteti |
kartṛtvaṃ na tāvat yantrāśrayatvaṃ tadupādānaviṣayakaparokṣajñānacikīrṣā- kṛtitvaṃ vā, 'kūlaṃ pipatiṣati', 'ratho gacchati' ityādau abhāvāt |
yadvāvattarākhyātena yagādya- samabhivyāhṛtena yadvāvattarāśrayatvaṃ dharmavat bodhyate, tadattvaṃ tatkriyākartṛtvam |
'pacyate taṇḍulaḥ' ityādau karmaṇi atiprasaṅgavāraṇāya yagādyasamabhivyāhṛtena iti |
tena 'sthālī pacati' : 'kāṣṭhāni pacanti' ityatra syālīkāṣṭhādāvapi kartṛtvamaviruddham |
'agnihotrasya yajñakratoreka ṛtvik', 'darśapūrṇa- māsayoryajñakratoścatvāra ṛtvijaḥ', 'cāturmāsyānāṃ yajña- kratūnāṃ pañca ṛtvijaḥ' ityādinā kartāra uktāḥ |
eteṣāṃ kartṛdeśakālānāmū ebhirvākyaiḥ acodanaṃ na codanaṃ na vidhānaṃ kriyate, kintu anuvādaḥ kriyate |
agnihotrānuṣṭhāne ekasmin anekasmiṃśca ṛtviji prāpte 'agnihotrasya yajñakratoreka ṛtvik' iti adhyartho- niyama uktaḥ |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ caturṣu adhikeṣu vā ṛtvikṣu aniyamena prāpteṣu 'darśapūrṇamāsayoryajñakrato- ścatvāra ṛtvijaḥ' iti adhyartho'nubrahmaṇāṃ caturṇāṃ niyamaḥ uktaḥ |
'darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ same vipame ca deśe aniyamena prāpte 'same darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta' iti samabhūtasya deśasya niyama uktaḥ |
evaṃ paurṇamāsayāgasya paurṇamāsī anyā vā tithiḥ saṃbhāvyate, tataśca 'paurṇa- māsyāṃ paurṇamāsyā yajeta' ityanena paurṇamāsītithirrūpaḥ kālaḥ niyamena uktaḥ |
tasmāt kartṛdeśakālānāmū vidhirayaṃ nānuvādaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
bhāṣyam- idaṃ śrūyate, 'pañcanakhasya yajñakratoḥ pañca ṛtvijaḥ', 'darśapūrṇamāsayoryajñakratoścatvāra ṛtvijaḥ' : 'agnihotrasya yajñakratoreka ṛtvik' 'saumyādhvarasya yajñakratoḥ saptadaśa ṛtvijaḥ' |
tathā, 'same darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta' 'prācīna- pravaṇe vaiśvadevena yajeta', 'paurṇamāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyā yajeta', 'amāvāsyāyāmamāvāsyā yajeta' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ kartṛdeśakāla vidhīyante, uta anūdyante iti |
kiṃ tāvat prāptam ? kartṛdeśakālānāmū acodanaṃ anuvādaḥ |
duṣ- kartṛsaṃkhyeyā samādayaśca prayogavacanena ākṣitatvān na vidhīyante |
na ca samādi- grahaṇaṃ viṣamādinivartakam, pratiṣedhavacanasya abhāvāt |
anenābhiprāyeṇa''ha - 'upadeśakamevaṃjātīyakaṃ vacanaṃ na pratiṣedhakama' iti ( bhāṣyam ) |
bhāṣyam- ucyate, na caitadasti, anuvāda iti |
prayogāṅgatayā sarve deśāḥ prāpnuvanti, na tu samuccayena |
yadā samo na tadā viṣamaḥ; yadā viṣamo na tadā samaḥ |
yadā prātaḥ, sa patho vidhi prayo- jayati |
tasmāt viṣamasya aprāptiḥ : vidhau sati bhavatīti samo vidhīyate |
duṣ- 'vrīhibhiryajeta' iti darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ śravaṇāt yāvat ākṣepāt aṅgabhāvaḥ, tāvat deśādi sthitam |
yat pakṣe vidhi- mantareṇa prāpnoti, tat śrūyamāṇam aniyatāṃśe praviśat niyamaḥ abhidhīyate |
same ca viṣame vā'pi somenānyena vā yajiḥ |
prāpnoti, tena somādeḥ prāsirna syādapi ka cit |
yasmin pakṣe na somādeḥ prāsirna syādapi ka cit |

’ (niyamaparisaṃkhyayoḥ itaraparirjanā'viśeṣe'pi yatra prayoge samādeḥ prāptiḥ, tatrāpi śāstreṇa akaraṇe vidhyākṣepāt prāpnuvato viṣamādeḥ varjanalāmena prathamo- pasthitatvāt vidheyasamāditayā pratyāsannatvāt bhāva- rūpatvena laghuśarīratvācca aprāptāṃśapūraṇameva phalam |
viṣa- mādinivṛttistu tadaiparītyāt aprāptāṃśapūraṇarūpasya- mānuniṣpāditatvācca na phalam |
parisaṃkhyāyāṃ tu ubhayo- rapi nityaprāptatvena aprāptāṃśapūraṇasya phalatvāt itaraparirjanameva phalam |
evaṃ ca ‘same eva yajeta’ ityekākṣara phalavivaraṇam ayogyavyavacchedārtham, na tu parisaṃkhyāyāmapi anyayogyavyavacchedārtham, iti niyama- parisaṃkhyayoḥ phalabhedāt avarjanīyaḥ |
soma— avabhṛthadeśaprasaṅgata anyasya samādi- deśasya tasamānanyāyasya kālakartṛvrīhisāmāderapi buddhi- viparivartanāt prāptikrī saṅgatiḥ |
sūtrātsthastu— kartrā- dīnām acodanam anuvāda eva syāt, prayoge kartrādī- sāmānasya niyamasavāt iti |

bhāṭṭa— tatra kartāraḥ adhvaryvādayaḥ, kālāḥ paurṇa- māsyādayaḥ, deśāḥ samādayaḥ, dravyāṇi vrīhīdīni, guṇāḥ śuklādayaḥ, saṃskārā avaghātādayaḥ tattadākye śrutāḥ karma- codanayaiva ākṣepeṇa prāptatvācca vidhīyante, ato na te karmavidhibhirnimena prayujyante ityāśaṅkā''bhāse prāpte, yāvadākṣepeṇa aniyatāḥ prāpyante, tāvat vacanena niyamaphalakavidhikaraṇāt niyamameva prayojakatvam |
niyama- vidhiprakāraśca sarvo'pi anāgatāvekṣaṇanyāyena, kaustubhe ca mantrādhikaraṇe evaṃ pradarśitaḥ |
vṛ. 2|4|11-7. kartṛnāmadheyāni karmāṇi yāvanti śrūyante, tāvanto varītavyāḥ (kartāraḥ ṛtvijaḥ) midhyante |
ke. kartṛprādhānye (yajeta ityatra ) kāryābhāvāt na sādhanākāṅkṣayā bhavitavyam |
nahi bhavati pācakaḥ kena kimarthe kathamiti |
(bhāvaprādhānye tu bhavati, kena kimarthe kathamiti ) bhā. 1|1|4|24, kartṛbhedaḥ |
aṅgapradhānānām abhau sautrāmaṇyāṃ (ca) dakṣiṇābhedāt anyakartṛttvaṃ vijñāyate ‘vaḍavā dakṣiṇā’ iti |
varuṇapraghāseṣu dakṣiṇottaravihārayoḥ kiṃ kartāro bhinnāḥ, uta tantramiti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
yathā ubhayo- vihārayoḥ pūrvādhikaraṇe aṅgāni bhinnānītyuktam, tathā kartṛbhedo'pi syāt |
ubhayorvihārayoḥ na sarva eva kartāro bhinnāḥ |
hotā tāvat svasthānasthitaḥ eva san yājyā'nuvākyā anubruvan adhvaryumiva pratiprasthātāramapi saṃprohayitumalam |
brahmā'pi ubhayorapi vihārayordikṣitaḥ sthitaḥ san kṛtā- kṛtāni avekṣya anujñāṃ dāsyati |
samavāyāt ‘cāturmāsyānāṃ yajñakratūnāṃ pañca ṛtvijaḥ’ iti vacanena pañcānāmeva saṃbandhāt |
adhvaryorapi tantratve tu catvāra eva syuḥ, na pañca |
‘pravayasamukhaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ dadāti’ iti varuṇapraghāseṣu ubhayavihārārthaṃ dakṣiṇaikamuktam, tat liṅgam ekakartṛkatvaṃ darśayati |
‘atarvaicanyaḥ pādo hotṛrmevati, bahirvedyanyaḥ’ iti hotuḥ vedyā saṃyogaḥ śrūyate |
sa ca ekena hotrā na śakyaḥ; phale dakṣiṇottarayordevyoḥ |
deśamātratvāt ‘anta- rvedyanyaḥ’ ityādinā deśamātraṃ vidhīyate, tasmin deśe hotrā svātantryam, yatra asya ekaḥ pādaḥ antarvedi bhavet bahirvedi anyaḥ |
na mātra hotuḥ pādo vedeḥ vedyorvā upa- kārakatvenopadidyate |
ekasya ca hotuḥ dvau pādau bhavataḥ eva |
na ca vedidvaye'pi hotrā hotṛbhyāṃ vā sthātavyam |
rājasūye somāpauṣṇādi- trike āgnāvaiṣṇavādintrike ca dakṣiṇābhedāt kartṛbhedaḥ; kartṛbhedācca trikayoraṅgabhedaḥ |
dīrghaḥ kartā na saṃtardananimittaṃ tathā saṃsthā api, abhidhṛmayāmasāmobhayāraṇe saṃtardanaprayojane arthavādake, kartṛdairdhya iva saṃsthāsvapi aviśeṣeṇārthavādayogasāmyāt |
yathā kartā nopalakṣyate ‘hotṛpītasya, adhvaryupītasya’ iti, evaṃ abhiprītasya ityevam anuvaṣaṭkāradevatā'pi nopalakṣyitavyā |
bhā. kartṛvikalpaḥ : eko dvau bahavo vā ahīnena yajeran iti |
bāla. pṛ. 163, kartṛvidhiḥ : arthavādaḥ ‘eṣā vā anāhitāgnerāhutiryathaitarhyate’ |
( 6|8|1 adhikaraṇe ) pṛ. 55, kartṛvidhirūpaḥ : arthavādaḥ ‘iti ha smāha baṭurvāvirbhiḥ : mādhān eva mahaṃ pacata’ iti |
( 6|7|2 adhikaraṇe ) pṛ. 56, kartṛvyāpārasāmānyarūpaiva cāsau bhāvanā, tameva viśeṣataḥ paryupasthāpayati |
vā. 3|4|4|13 pṛ. 917, kartṛsaṃskāraśca sarvāntaraṅgo bhakṣaṇaṃ nāma |
arthasaraṇena kṛtārthatāṃ niṣedhayojanaṃ mūlasmaraṇāt anādarāt bhram iti (kecit ) tadayuktam |
tatra yadi abhīdhyate, tataḥ śrutatvāt prayojanākāṅkṣaṇī bhāvanā prakaraṇagamyakratvarthatvavacanena puruṣārthā bhavati |
atha nāmidhyate, tataḥ śrutivirodhābhāvāt prakaraṇena ṛtvarthatā (bhavati ) |
nanu satyapi kartṛbhidhāne bhāvanāpradhānatvāt ākhyātena tāvat upādīyamānasya śrauto'pi saṃbandhaḥ prakaraṇānuguṇatvāt aviruddho naiva ṛtvarthatāṃ bādhate |
virodhino hi tulyakakṣau saṃbandhau parasparaṃ bādheyātām, na guṇapradhānabhūtau |
tadyathā ‘daśā- pavitreṇa grahaṃ saṃmārṣṭi’ ityatra daśāpavitropasarjanasya saṃmāgasya grahaṃ prati upādīyamānasya naivamāśaṅkā bhavati ‘kiṃ daśāpavitreṇa saṃdhavyatām, uta graheṇa’ iti |
atrāpi guṇabhūtakartṛkāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ kratuṃ prati upādīyamānāyā na kaścit virodhaḥ |
yadi tu ākhyātena kartuḥ prādhānyamucyeta tataḥ prakaraṇagamyena kratuprādhānyena virodhaḥ syāt |
yadi vā karturiva kratorapi guṇatvaṃ syāt, tata ubhayoḥ śeṣayoḥ śeṣisama- vāyavirodho lakṣyate |
ataḥ śrutyā kartṛguṇabhāvāt, prakaraṇena ca kratoḥ prādhānyāt, nānā- viṣayatvena asamavāyādavirodhaḥ |
' yadyapi prathamaṃ sādhakamapekṣamāṇā kriyā kartāraṃ guṇatvena gṛhṇāti, tathāpi tasyāḥ prayojanākāṅkṣā- velāyāmapi kartaiva saṃnihitaḥ |
tayośca ekaśabdopāttayoḥ para- sparasaṃbandhe nirvartamānaṃ viprakarṣān yāgasaṃbandho na gṛhyate |
na ca sāmavāyikatve ( saṃnidhyopakārakatve ) saṃbhavati ārādupakārakatvakalpanā |

tathā 'agnīṣomīyasya vapayā pracarya agnīṣomīyaṃ paśupuroḍāśa- manunirvapati' ityatra sati taddhitena devatopasarjanatvo- pādāne yāgasya prayojanākāṅkṣāyāṃ satyām agnīṣomī- yasyaiva saṃnihitayoḥ saṃskāryatvaṃ vijñāyate, iti na paśoḥ ( paśupuroḍāśāge paśyāgasya ityarthaḥ ) ārādupakāraka- tvena ( saṃskāryatvam ) kalpyate |
nahi pūrvaṃ guṇatvam, uttareṇa prādhānyena virudhyate |
avaśyambhāvintyāṃ prayo- janakalpanāyāṃ kasya cit prādhānyam, evamatrāpi iti |
athavā ākhyātena kartā kevalamabhidhīyate, guṇa- pradhānavāvastu arthāt yatheṣṭaṃ yathāyogyaṃ bhaviṣyatīti |
tena ubhayoḥ kriyātroḥ apekṣāsaṃnidhiyogyataiḥ anyonyaṃ guṇapradhānabhāvau upapadyate |
' nahi asya ausargikasya nyāyasya saraṇasya vā apavādabhūtaṃ nyāyāntaraṃ smaraṇāttaraṃ copalabhyate |
' tathā ca padavekapuṃsatvādiṣu samānapadopādānalakṣaṇaśruti- saṃnnaveṣu vākyena kriyārthatvena avadhāryamāṇe vakṣyate 'na śrutibhūte vākyārtho neti' ( nāstīti iti mūle. bhā. 4|1|5|
tena atrāpi śakyaṃ vaktum ' na śrutibhūte prakaraṇārtho neti ' |
tadiha yadi kartṛparamākhyātam, tataḥ sutarāṃ guṇatvamabhihitaṃ bhavati |
yaśca yat karoti, sa tasyaikāntena guṇabhūtaḥ, tena asyānupapannaṃ śeṣitvena prādhānyam |
( dvitīya parihāraṃ dūṣayati - ) yat uktam ' abhidhīyate kevalaṃ pratyayena kartā, guṇapradhānabhāvastu arthāt bhaviṣyati' iti ( vā. 902|9 ) |
tatrāpi yadi vastu- mātratvena kartā abhidhīyate, tataḥ audāsīnyāvasthānāt yatheṣṭam aṅgāṅkibhāvaṃ pratipadyate |
sa tu kartṛrūpatvena guṇātmanaiva abhidhīyate iti nāsti audāsīnyāva- sthānam |
( 'yadyapyādau guṇatvena' iti ślokoktam ādyaṃ parihāraṃ dūṣayati - ) yadapi uktam ' guṇatvenābhihito- 'pi dvitīyayā ākāṅkṣayā punaḥ prādhānyaṃ pratipadyate ' iti, tadapi śrutivirodhāyuktam |
ākhyātena hi śrutyaiva guṇaparyāyātmanā kartṛtvamabhihitam, tata paścāt vyāvartyateḥ śrutirodha āpadyeta |
na ca tatkalpanāntareṇa ānarthakyaprasaktiḥ, yataḥ evaṃ kalpyate, prakaraṇena prayojanasaṃbhavasiddheḥ |
yathaiva ca anabhihite kartari niṣpratidvaṃdvaṃ prakaraṇena viniyogāya paryāptaṃ bhavati, tathā evaṃrūpeṇābhihite'pi avirodhaḥ |
na ca eka eva pratyayaḥ sakṛduccaritaḥ śaknoti guṇapradhānatve yugapadabhi- dhātum |

tatra ekasmin āśrīyamāṇe yadi prādhānyamabhī- yate, tataḥ kriyāguṇatvalakṣaṇaṃ kartṛtvamullujya tayā āpya- mānatvena karmatvaprasaṅgāt tatraiva lakārocyateḥ yagātmane- padādikaraṇāt anyarūpa eva śabdaḥ syāt ( karmaṇi lakārocyatau yagātmanepadasaṃprasāraṇasīyuṭkaraṇāt ' udyeta ' ityanurūpaḥ śabdaḥ syāt, na tu ' vadet ' ityevarūpaḥ |
athocyeta, sarvaiḥ kartā kiñcit prayojanamuddiśya kriyāyāṃ na pravartate |
tataśca dravyātmakameva kartṛtvaṃ sādhaka- rūpaṃ kriyāphalasvāmirūpaṃ ceti |
ubhayatvenābhihite sati ākāṅkṣādvayaṃ prasṛtaṃ kriyāto nirvartayiṣyate iti |
svāmitvaṃ tu tataḥ paścāt pramāṇā- ntaragocaraḥ |
' yadyapi svāmitvena vinā kartṛtvaṃ nopapadyate, tathāpi pramāṇāntaralabhye tasmin ākhyātaḥ anudghāṭyāṃśamātramabhidhīyate |
tathā ca svāmitvapratipāda- nārthaḥ tatratatra sarvakarmādisādhanāḥ prayuktāḥ |
ataśca ( ityevārthaḥ ) etadevam, tathāhi ' acetane'pi kāṣṭhādau kartṛtva- mabhidhīyate |
( parihārasūtradvayamupa- saṃharati - ) tassāt naiva puruṣārthatā yukteti |
parihartā tṛtīyaṃ parihāraṃ samādhātum ' tatraitat prasajyeta ' ( vā. pṛ. 903|9 ) ityādirtikoktaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ pariharati - ) atrābhidhīyate |
yadyapi śrutyā śeṣatvaṃ nāmihitam, tathāpi yadeva tadi- śeṣatvenopasarjanatvam, tadeva śeṣatvamapi āpādayati |
tena hi tāvat tādarthyam abhidhānātmakamupāyameva, kevalamanuṣṭhāne'pi tadevāṅgīkartavyam |
rājapuruṣādiṣvapi śabdārthavṛttyā rājādīnāṃ guṇatvameva prāptam, pramāṇā- ntaravaśena tu viparītaṃ kalpyate |
yaśca vastuto'pi tatra rājño guṇatvāṃśaḥ, tamevopāya śabdaḥ pravartate |
katham ? ' viprān puruṣaṃ rājā guṇatvaṃ tāvacchati |
svāmitvaṃ bhajate paścāt, vivakṣā tu yathāruci |
' tatra yadā rāja- viśiṣṭaḥ puruṣo vivakṣitaḥ, tadā śabdārthānuguṇāt ekāntena vastugatamapi upakārakatvaṃ vivakṣitavyam |
punaḥ upakāryatvaṃ vivakṣyate, tadā tasya viśeṣalakṣaṇa- patteḥ rājājñātvena upakārakabhūtāḥ puruṣāḥ viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavanti, iti puruṣarājaśabda eva prayoktavyaḥ |
prayoga- dravyasya vidyamānasya tāvat nyastyadhetau arthadvaye saṃbhavati, kimiti vakṣyamāṇakriyayopapekṣayā vivakṣā- bhedamātreṇa kliṣṭāṃ vyavasthāmāśriṣyāmahai |
tena bhūta nimittamālasya śabde prayujyamāne rājapuruṣaḥ ityatra upakārātkṛtaṃ śeṣatvameva vivakṣitamiti gamyate |
yatrāpi gogarbhadāsādisvāmini atyantāvidyamānameva śeṣatvam , tatrāpi upakārakatvasaṃbhavāt upacaritamiti draṣṭavyam |
athāpi evamādīnāṃ mukhyatvasiddhayartham upa- kārakatvameva upasarjanatvam, na śeṣatvam, tathāpi śeṣasya evaṃphalavattvāt etat pratyāsannataram, na śeṣiṇaḥ iti śeṣatvapratipatyarthameva vijñāyate |
pācakādāvapi sarvatra tatkṛtatvasattvāt upakārakatvasadbhāvāt kriyāṇāmupa- sarjanatvam, na nirvaryatvena avasthānāt prādhānyam |
nanu evaṃ sati ‘prokṣitāmyāmulkhalamusalābhyām’ itya- trāpi prokṣaṇasya dravyārthatvaṃ prāpnoti |
kathaṃ nāma virudhyate ? yadā anyadeva tantra yuktālam, anyacca tādarthyam |
avasthite hi dravyārthatve karmaprayukte hi dharmeḥ kim anantarakāryena hantinā piṣiṇā ca prayujyatām, uta vyavahitenāpūrveṇeti |
yo'pi ca tādarthyavicārastatra, so'pi evameva ulūkhalamusalāpari- tyāgenaiva draṣṭavyaḥ kiṃ yat tayorhantipiṣitādhanatvaṃ tadartha- metat prokṣaṇam, uta yatpūrvasādhanatvaṃ tadarthamiti |
’ kṛdantāmihitāni kārakāṇi tirohitatvāt na śaknuyurapi nāmāthatvena kriyām grahītum, supaḍitantāni tu āvirbhūtatvāt śaknuvanti |
yattu padavekatvādidaṃ na dhātvarthāṃ apetātadarthyaṃcano ṛtvarthatvena virudhyate iti, tanno- cyate ‘kārakeṇa gṛhītatvādekatvādeḥ kriyā'rthatā |
kārakopasarjanabhūtasya dravyasya prayāsasattrimātreṇa saṃkhyā- dayaḥ saṃbhaveyuḥ; te tu atyantaprasādhanabhūtena kārakeṇa apahṛtya kriyāyai nīyante |
na tvevaṃ dhātvarthānāṃ kena cit balavattareṇa pramāṇena krārthatvamavagamyate , yena kartṛtvaśeṣatā bādhyate |
yattu kartṛtvasya guṇātmakatvāt prādhānyābhidhāne sati sutarāṃ guṇaṃ prāpnotīti, tadasat |
yadyapi anuṣṭhātṛmātramakaṃ kartṛtvam , tathāpi tat buddhipūrvakāriṇāṃ phalasaṃkalpenamiśram |
vidhiyuktākṣatāḥ sarvāḥ kriyāḥ, pratiṣedhānāmpi vidhi- pratyayasaṃbandhādhīnatvāt |
tena avaśyamanuṣṭhātṛtvena ucyamānaḥ puruṣaḥ kimapi mamaiṣā kriyā sākṣāt pāraṃparyeṇa vā upakariṣyati ityadhyavasyati |
sākṣādupakārake na saṃbhavati, na pāraṃparyekārakatvanā labhyate |
na ca saṃskārānahaḥ kartā, ṛtuphaladhāratvena saṃprayojanatvāt |
kastasyopakāra iti cet, sarvathā tāvat sāmānyanopakāramātramavadhāri- tam |
yadyapi na prādhānyāṃśaḥ kartṛtvavacanena anabhihitaḥ, tatra cānantargataḥ, tathāpi tadanyathā'nupapattayeva pratyayāvi- tatvāt saṃbhavate |
yathā svargakāmādiśabdena puruṣaviśeṣa- vacanena anukramapi svargasya sādhyatvaṃ kalpayiṣyate, tathā svāmilamapi buddhipūrvakāriṇaḥ puruṣasya phalalipsayaiva kartṛtvapratītyā pratipadyate |
tatra yathaiva devatāyāḥ karmaṇā abhiprayamāṇāyāḥ prādhānyaṃ yāgasādhanatvapratipatyarthameva jñāyate , na prādhānyasvarūpaparyavasāyitvena, tathaiva guṇatvaṃ draṣṭavyam |
bhāvanāyāṃ tu śeṣasya dhātvarthaḥ ki na te guṇāḥ |
yasyāpi kartā pratyayārthaḥ, tenāpi avaśyaṃ pratītivaśāt bhāvanā'bhyupa- gantavyā |
tatropasaṃhāriṣyate, tataḥ śāstrārthatvamathavaśāt pramāṇī- sa tu bhāvanāyāṃ vyāpṛtaḥ |
sarvameva śāstram, yadā śrutyarthaḥ karmaṇi themevāṅgīkaroti |
na ca ubhayātmakatvaṃ vipratiṣiddham, nopayujyate, tadā lakṣaṇāthamātmānaṃ prāpayati |
yadi dhātvarthameva prati guṇatvameva ca iha bhāvanā upayujyate |
na ca yugapat śrutilakṣaṇā- kalpyeta, tatḥ sakṛdupādāne vipratiṣiddhamiva syāt |
tasmāt yathaiva ‘pūrvo dhāvati , iha tu bhāvanāṃ prati guṇatvam, dhātvarthe (dhātvarthe ityukte saṃbandhatvāt aparo gamyamāno'pi na kāryeṇa tu ) prādhānyam ityavirodhaḥ |
svabhāvaśca ubhayā- saṃgrahyate, tathaiva anyapare'pi śabdabalāt saṃbandhī kartā tmakaṃ vastu |
yadi tathaiva śabda upadyate, kiṃ tatra viprati- gamyate eva kevalam ityavadhāraṇāt nopayogitvena gṛhyate |
ṣiddham ? athavā ekaṃ śabdāt, ekaṃ sāmarthyāt itya- yā cāsau pratītiḥ, sā guṇatvenāpi upayuktā , iti na virodhaḥ |
sarvathā asti tāvat kartuḥ prādhānyaprasaktiḥ, punaḥ prādhānyakalpanāmāpi karoti |
tadā ca bhāvanā kartāram iti puruṣārtho dhātvarthaḥ prāpnoti |
ayaṃ cāparo viśeṣaḥ, ātmasiddhayartham ananyāsaṃbhavamātreṇa upasarjanīkṛtameva ‘kriyā'ntareṇa saṃbandhaḥ pācakādeḥ pratīyate |
tatra gamyate , na pradhānabhūtam, iti niṣpramāṇikaiva prādhānya- śabdādarthamātreṇa bhavedvātuviśeṣaṇam |
nahi taṃ pradhānabhūtaṃ bhāvanā gamayituṃ vastvarthānām ubhayaprakāra
api ca naiva kartrā pratyayārthe: karma vā ityācāryā āhu:|
nanu kartari karmaṇi ca lakāra: śrūyate|
nāsau kartari karmaṇi vā śrūyate, kintu ekasmin ekavacanam, dvayo- rdvivacanam, bahuṣu bahuvacanam, iti tatra aparaṃ vacanam|
tatra evamabhisambandha: kriyate ekasmin kartari, dvayo: kartro:, bahuṣu kartṛṣu iti|
kathaṃ tarhi ? kartari ekasmin ekavacanaṃ kartṛrekatve ityartha:|
evaṃ varṇyamāne laukikanyāyānugata: sūtrārtho varṇito bhavati, sūtrākṣarāṇi ca nyāyānugatāni bhavanti|
āgamo'pi cāyameva 'yadā ekatvādayo vibhaktyarthā:; tadā karmadayo viśeṣaṇatvena ' iti|
nanu etadapyasti 'yadā karmādayo vibhaktyarthā:, tadā ekatvādayo viśeṣa- ṇatvena ' iti|
arthaprāptā hi karmādaya:; tena bhavanti śabdasāmidheyabhūtā:; na tu ekatvādaya: arthāta prāpnuvanti, tena te śabdārthabhūtā:|
tasmāt yadyapi viśeṣaṇamekatvādaya:; tathāpi viśeṣaṇamevābhidhīyate, yathā 'hiraṇyamālina: kratvija: pracaranti ' iti hiraṇyamālinaṃ viśeṣaṇatvena (pratīyate), tathāpi tadeva vidhīyate|
tasmāt karture katvaṃ śabdārtho na kartā (pṛ. 130)|
yā tu tebhya: pratīti:; sā saṃyogā ntarato bhavet |
' sarvatraiva tāvat śabdāducca- ritāt aneko'rtho gamyate|
na ca tāvatā sarva: evā- bhidheyo bhavati, tadbhāvabhāvitattvānupapattivattvāt vācakaśakti kalpyanāyā:|
sa nāma artha: abhidhīyate, yatra śabdasya vācakaśakti: kalpyate|
kva cāsau adṛṣṭā satī kalpyate ? yatra tatkalpanāntareṇa pratītiprayogau nāvakalpete|
yatra tu anyaviṣayayaiva śakyā akalpi- tayā tayā anyatrāpi tau sidhyata:, tatrāpulabdhyā śakya- bhāva: pratīyate yathā ākṛtiśabdānāṃ vyaktau, siṃhādi- śabdānāṃ ca mānavakādau|
tadiha pañcāśadiśabdāccaraṇāt iyanto'rthā gamyante bhāvanā-dhātvartha-kartṛ-tatsakhyā- puruṣa-upagraha-kālaviśeṣā:|
teṣāṃ tu ka: śabda:, ko'rthāt iti vibhāgo na jñāyate|
lakṣaṇe caitāvata 'yo'rthāt gamyate sa śabdārtha:' iti|
bhāvanāyāstāvata na śabdavyatiriktaṃ pratyayakaṃ paśyāma:, tatra kālādīnāṃ vyabhicāritvāt, saṃbhavanti hi vinā'pi bhāvanayā kālasaṃkhyādaya:|
kartṛtvāttvabhyāṃ avyabhicārāt gamyate iti cenna, kudantavat aprādhānyapratītiprasaṅgāt|
yadi kartrā dhātvarthena ca bhāvanā gamyeta, tata: pācakādi- śabdeṣviva tirohitasvarūpamā gamyeta, prādhānyapratyayāttu śabdārthatvavyasanam|
na ca tayā kālādaya: pratipādyante, kālāntarasaṃkhyā'ntaratvātpuruṣopagrahāntareṣvapi dṛṣṭa- tvāt|
yādṛśaśca guṇabhūta: kartā atrā- vagamyate, na tādṛśena vinā bhāvanā upapadyate ityārthā- patyā anumānena vā śaktā gamayitum|
kārakāntare'pi saṃbandhena vyabhicārāt aśakteti cenna, anyasaṃbandhamātrā- tmakavyabhicārānabhyupagamāt|
dvidhā hi eka: saṃbandha anekena saṃbadhyate, kaścit saṃbandhanyataraṃ parityajan, kaścit pūrvāparityāgena|
tatra ya: parityajya anyatrānyatra vartate, sa vyabhicārādagamako bhavati yathā ūrdhvaṃ sthāṇupuruṣayo:|
na ca tatra anyasaṃbandha: kathaṃ vyabhi- cārasya|
yastu anyatrāpi vartamāna: pūrvāvagatasaṃbandhaparyavasānenaiva vartate yathā śiśapālatvaṃ vṛkṣatvapārthivatvavadityeṣu, na tasya anaukāntikatvam, sarveṣu pralāyanaśaktyavighātāt|
bhāvanā ca kārakeṣu vartamānā na vikalpyarūpeṇa vartate, kiṃ tarhi sarveṣu yugapat|
na cedaśa vyabhicāritvamucyate, anyatrāpi vṛttau pūrvāparityāgāt|
yatrāpi nāma akarmakatvāt saṃpradānā- pādānayorbāhyataratvāt apratītayā vyabhicāra āśa- ṅkyate, tatrāpi teṣāmeva, na tu kartu: kadā cit|
nahi ka cit karturahitā kā cit kriyā vidyate, tanmūlatvāt kriyāpravṛtte:|
yāvat itarāṇi vyabhicaranti, tāvat kevala- kartṛprayāyanasāmarthyamasyā: sphuṭataraṃ vyajyate|
eva ca eṣo'rtha: (bhāvanāyā: kārakāntaravyabhicāra- rūpa: ) saṃkhyāsaṃbandhe (ghaṭanīye) kartu: asādhāraṇatā- siddhayartham|

asitaddhitvāttu karaṇāpekṣaṇāt, calana- patanādiṣu ca ādhāranāśavaṇāt, akarmakeṣu karmā- bhāvāt, āsanasthānavacanādiṣu saṃpradānāpādānātvāt kartaiva sarvabhāvanāsu ekāntasaṃnihita:, iti asādhāraṇatvena tiruvācyayā saṃkhyayā saṃbhanasyate|
kartṛviśiṣṭā ceha saṃkhyā gamyate, na kārakāntaragatā, iti sarveṣāṃ pratyakṣam|
tatra yadi kaścit vadet 'samāne sarvakārakāṇāṃ gamya- mānatve kasmāt kartṛva saṃkhyāsaṃbandha:, na karaṇādibhirapi iti, sa vaktavyo yathaiva bhavata: iti|
sa cet brūyāt 'mama kartā saṃkhyā ca ekena śabdena upāttau parasparaṃ niyabhyete iti, tena anabhidheyebhyo bāhyebhyo niyabhyatā saṃkhyā kartaryaiva vartitavye ' iti|

tatra evaṃ pratyavastheyam, 'atha samāne kārakatve kiṃ kāraṇaṃ bhavata:, kartaivā- bhidhīyate, na kārakāntarāṇi ' iti, tatra avaśyaṃ phalāvagamyā śabdaśaktireva śaraṇaṃ pratipattavyā, yata: tadviṣayā buddhirutpadyate|
sā ca asatpakṣe- 'pi aviśiṣṭā ' yata: kartṛgatāṃ saṃkhyāṃ pratīma: kevalāmata:|
' 'samāne bhāvanā kārakopasthāne ka: śaktiniyame hetu: ' iti cet, 'ukte yatsava samāne kārakatve kartṛbhidhāne śaktiniyame hetu: ' iti|
na ca śakya: paryanuyujyante, yathākāryaṃ vyavasthā anugantavyā: ityuktam (śakya: sarvabhāvanā ityādinā 2|1|15 pṛ. 378)|
apica bhavatā kartṛbhidhāne śakti: kalpayitvā bhūya: tatasaṃkhyā'bhidhāne śakti: kalpayiṣyate|
nanu eka- pratyayopādānādeva tatsiddhe: na kalpanā'ntaramāśriṣyate, kuta: ? khalu anekaśakti kalpanā vinā niyama: sidhyati ?|
avaśyaṃ hi etadapi kalpanīyam, yat samāne saṃkhyā- bhākte abhihitasyaiva saṃkhyāmāha, na anabhihitasya|
śaktyā hi vinā etadeva viparītamā ucyeta ' yataśca abhidhīyate kartā, tata evāsya na vaktavyā saṃkhyā yat anabhihitānāmātāvatā saṃvibhāga: kuta: ? ' iti|
na ca abhihitaṃ kevalaṃ vyavasthākāraṇaṃ bhavati, tenaiva pratyayena
yadi tu ayogyatāt tadsaṃbandho'bhidhīyate, tat gamya- māneṣu kārakāntareṣvapi aviśiṣṭam|
ayogyet 'asti teṣāṃ saṃkhyāsaṃbandhayogyatvam, yena śabdāntaramihitā saṃndhyate ' iti, tata bhāvanā''diṣvapi bhāvanā''siddhi- śabdābhihiteṣu samānam|
tatra etadevamapyupagantavyam, ' tādṛśena śabdena: mihitā saṃkhyā bhāvanā''dayo vā na parasparaṃ saṃbandhuṃ śaknuvanti ' iti, tacca tulyam, etadabhi- hitāyā: kārakāntarasaṃbandhāyogyatvāt|
nanu ca ākhyātābhihitasaṃkhyāyogatvaṃ karmaṇo dṛṣṭam, iti tasya saṃbandha: prāpnoti yathā ' pacyate odana: ' iti|
kuta: ? ' yathaiva ka tiduktā''pi karmo'nyatra na vakṣyati |
' yo hi manyate ' karmaṇa: ka cit tiṅamihitasaṃkhyā''haṃ dṛṣṭam, ato'nyāpi tena bhavitavyam ' iti, tasya ka cit tiṅamihitatva- darśanāt sarvatrābhidheyatvamapi syāt|
atha tat kathañcit vyatiṣṭhate, tata: saṃkhyā''pi tathaiva vyavasthāsyate, itya- codhyametat|
tatra etat syāt, ' kartṛviśiṣṭā saṃkhyā abhidhīyamānā na śakyā kārtamānabhidhāya vaktum ' iti, ucyate ' viśiṣṭagrahaṇaṃ neṣṭamagṛhītaviśeṣaṇam|
yadi nāma anabhihitamapi viśeṣaṇaṃ kena cidanvena pratyāyamānaṃ viśeṣaṇapratyayopādānāya paryāptaṃ bhavati, kiṃ tatra abhidhānānu rodhena|
asti ceha bhāvanayaiva pratyāyayasya kartu: viśeṣaṇatvaśakti:; iti nābhidhānamapekṣate|
sarvatra viśiṣṭapratyayeṣu caitadavasthitam ' na cendyena śiṣṭā: ' (1|4|19) iti|
viśiṣṭapratyaye jāte viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayoḥ kiṃ śabdenopāttaṃ kimanyena iti parīkṣāyāṃ yatrayatra viśeṣyamanyataḥ sidhyati tatra viśeṣaṇe śabdavyāpāraḥ, yatra viśeṣaṇamanyato labhyate tatra viśeṣye |
sarvatra ca viśiṣṭapratyayādeva arthāpattyā ekasya dvayorvā avayavayoḥ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayoḥ vyāpāraḥ śabde kalpyate |
sā ca anyathā'nupapattirūpatvāt ananyalabhye viṣaye bhavati |
tadiha viśeṣaṇabhūtaṃ viśeṣya- bhūtaṃ vā ekatvaṃ tāvat nānyato labhyate, yena anabhidheyaṃ kalpyeta |
yadi hi kartā tat pratipādayituṃ śaknuyāt, tataḥ ākṛtinyāyena sa evābhidheyaḥ |
itarastu yatkiñcat gamyamānamityādhīyate, tasya tu vyabhicāreṇa aśaktatvāt ephalamapi abhidheyamevāśrayaṇīyam |
tataśca tatra saṃcaritāyāmāmabhidhānaśaktau gamyamānalakṣaṇaḥ spaṣṭaḥ kartā satyapi viśeṣaṇatve nāmidheyaḥ saṃpadyate |
yadā tu ekatva- meva viśeṣaṇam, tadāpi avaśyaṃ tadeva prathamataramabhi- ghātavyam |
taccet abhihitam, kṣīṇaśaktiḥ śabdaḥ kartor- manyataḥ sidhyatamapekṣate |
sidhyati cāsau bhāvanātaḥ, iti nāmidhānaśakti kalpaneheturbhavati |
yut anyā- nyapi kārakāṇi pratīyante, na taiḥ pratītairapratītau kaści- dupakāraḥ anupakāro vā bhavati |
sarvathā tāvat yaḥ prārthitaḥ kartā, sa pratītaḥ |
yadi tu anyadapi pratīyate, kiṃ no bādhyate |
tena hi apratītena vayaṃ bādhyamahe, nābhyadhikapratyayena |
pratīyamānapi tu karaṇādīni śabda- śaktivaśāt kartrabhilāṣiṇyā saṃkhyayā na gṛhyante |
nahi tayā yat tat pratītam, tattat grahītavyam |
sarvatra hi pratīta- peśayogyavādvi graheṇa kāryaṃ bhavati |
tadatra ubhayasidhena saṃkhyāyāḥ kartṛgāmitvena kārakāntarāṇi anapekṣitatvāt ayogyavādvaca saṃnihitānvayi na saṃbandhaṃ pratipadyate |
na ca teṣāmapi tiṅabhihitasaṃkhyā'bhidhātve vidyate, sarvatra suyamihitasaṃkhyāparicchedatvāt |
na caiṣā saṃkhyā sāmānya- rūpeṇa pratītā satī saṃbandhyantaramapekṣate |
kathito hi padāvaktrayorviśeṣaḥ paurvāparyanimātrāt (vākyādhi- karaṇe ślokā. 355-57) |
tattu yāvadevahyavārthaḥ pratītaḥ, tāvadeva 'kā'pi bhāvanā kartā ca kaścit bhaviṣyati' ityavadhāryate |
tataśca pūrvatarapratīte kartari saṃkhyā kenailaiva abhidhīyamānā viśeṣaṇatvaṃ viśeṣyatvaṃ vā pratipadyate |
' satyapi kāraka saṃbandhaviśeṣe bhāvanā pūrve tāvat kartāramapekṣate gṛhṇāti ca tadadhīnatvāditarakārakasamava- dhānasya |
kartṛvyāpārasāmānyarūpeṇa cāsau tameva viśeṣataḥ paryavasthāpayati, kārakāntarāṇi tu dhātvarthasaṃbandhitvāt, sarvajaghanyatikartavyatātmakavyāpāranibandhanatvādvā bahiraṅga- tarāṇi bhavanti |
na ca kiñcit kāraṇamasti, yena prāthamyaprādhānyopasthitakartṛkatvena kārakāntarāṇi saṃkhyā gacchet |
apica yasya kārakasya avāntaravyāpāraṃ dhātuḥ prādhānyamāha, sa kartā iti |
vyākaraṇe'pi kārakā- ntarāṇi kartārameva āvirbhūtakathaṃ jñāpayanti, tena sa eva saṃkhyāṃ saṃvadhyate, abhihitatvacca viśeṣarūpeṇa pratīyate |
kārakāntareṣu tādṛgaryābhāvāt anādareṇa sadapi gamya- mānatvaṃ asadivā pratibhāti, paramārthanirīkṣaṇavelāyāṃ tu avinābhāvāt tāvadapi bhāvanā tulyavadupasthāpyante, iti nānyatammānāhatāni |
nanu evaṃ sati (pūrvatarapratīti- prādhānyamyāṃ kartuḥ tiṅupāttasaṃkhyā'nyatve aṅgīkriyamāṇe sati) 'odanaḥ pacyatāṃ tvayā' ityādiṣu karmasaṃkhyā- 'bhidhānaṃ na prāpnoti |
mā bhūt tasyaiva kartṛttvamabhidheyaṃ na bhāvanā |
' nātra odanavyāparo dhātunā prādhānyenopādyate, yataḥ karmaṇo viśeṣapratītasya saṃkhyā ucyate |
mā bhūt tasyaiva kartṛlakṣaṇapratyāt karmatvamutsṛjya kartṛtvam |
tena tathāpi (tayā'pi) na viśeṣarūpeṇa karmaṇaḥ paryyupasthānam |
avaśyaṃ ca puṃruṣavyāpāra eva prādhānyena vaktavyaḥ, anyathā hi paryāyāpāre asya niyoga eva na bhavet |
ākhyātapadena ca akalpitaṃ kartṛtvaṃ padāntaropāttasyāpi nāvibhavet |
tadvyāpāreṇa vā anabhibhūta- vyāpāre karma tena anāpyamānatvāt karmatvaṃ hitvā āvirbhūtavyāpāratā kartṛtvameva pratipadyeta iti svasaṃdhyayāgena kartṛsaṃkhyayaiva saṃcapyate |
pacatiśabdadeva pacyateityevamābhihitā'pi saṃkhyā anabhibhūtatvāt kartureva prāpnoti, na karma iti |
' tat yadi mama karmopanna- lakāre'pi kartureva saṃkhyā prāpnoti, tatrāpi tarhi tatra kartṛbhidhānena bhavitavyam |
atha tatra tava kathaṃcit kartu- ranibhidhānam, tadat mamāpi taskhaṇḍā'nabhidhānam, ityadoṣaḥ |
tadetat avaśyamāvyāmyām evaṃ parihartavyam, 'sarvatraiva tāvat īpsitatamatvāt vastulakṣaṇaṃ kārakā- ntarebhyaḥ karmaṇaḥ prādhānyam, bhāvyaśena ca tadyāpārasya bhāvanā'ntargatalam |

tatra yadā tat prādhānyam ākhyā- tenaiva darśayāma iti vidhyate, tadā satyapi kartuḥ śabdā- rtharūpeṇa liṅgātābhyām abhidhīyamānapradhānabhūtasāmānya- viśeṣarūpavyāpāre, tāvatā ca kartṛtvalāme aparasya vastu- lakṣaṇasya prādhānyasya vivakṣitatvāt karmaṇaḥ tatsaṃkhyāyāṃ vā lakārotpattiḥ |

yadā tu khalu tat vidyamānamapi avivakṣitatvāt dhātuviśeṣatvena vā naiva tadasti ityavagamyate, śabdārtharūpādhānyamātre (ca) vivakṣā bhavati, tadā supā karmaprādhānyābhivyaktimaṅgīkṛtya kartari tatsaṃkhyāyāṃ vā lakāra utpadyate |
kārakādīnāṃ tu na vastulakṣaṇā, nāpi śabdalakṣaṇā prādhānyavivakṣā astīti nityameva bhāśabdanopādeyatvam |

yadā evaṃvidhaṃ śabdasāmarthyamavagamyate yathā 'ayaṃ kartureva saṃkhyāṃ śaknoti vaktum, ayaṃ karmaṇa eva' iti, tadā antareṇāpi bhāvanāpyaparaṃ saiva saṃkhyā ananya- viṣayatvena abhihitatvāt kartāramupādāste, tadyathā śoṇa- śabdaḥ anyena anupātte'pi advaita tadgataṃ guṇaṃ vadan ātmanaiva aśvatvamapi gamayati |
tathā sati anenaiva nyāyena sarve gavādyo'pi anabhidheyāḥ prāpnuvanti |
sa evābhihitaḥ paścād gavādīn jñāpa- yiṣyati |
' etāvatī cet śabdaśaktiḥ kalpitā tad- meveṣā guṇaṃ bravīti, kiṃ tataḥ paraṃ śakyatarkakalpanā, pūrvayaiva vyavahāropapatteḥ |
ayaṃ tu evamādiṣu ekaśabdo- pāttatvena saṃbandhanīyamo na śabdaśaktivaśeṇa, tataḥ kartṛ- saṃkhyādiṣvapi tadeva (supā kevalasaṃkhyā'bhidhānam) abhyu- pagantavyam iti anabhidheyatvān |
dṛṣṭā hi na ka cid buddhigṛhītaviśeṣaṇā |
' kathaṃ hi aśvatve anucyamāne tadavacchinnaratvapratyayo jāyeta, raktatvaviśiṣṭe hasau |
guṇe (guṇinamaśvaṃ ) gamayiṣyati iti neca, gavādiṣu vyabhicārāt |
aikā- ntikaṃ hi gamakaṃ bhavati, na raktatvamaśvatvavyabhicāri |
dravyamātraṃ tu aikāntikātvāt gamayet, na tadiśeṣam |

tasādubhayorapi aśvatvaraktatvayoḥ anyonyavyabhicāri- tvena agamakatvāt vastvantaropasthāpitāntaragrahaṇā- saṃbhavācca śoṇaśabdābhidheyatvamanupagantavyam, nahi tatra vastvantarasādhāraṇyena aśvatvameva aikāntikaṃ kena cit gamitam |
kartuḥ punaḥ aikāntikaṃ bhāvanāyā upādānaṃ viśeṣarūpeṇa ca ityuktam |
athavā astu śoṇaśabdena aśvatvaikaikātmyasamavāyaguṇāmātrābhidhānam (tathāpi na tad- dṛṣṭāntena saṃkhyāyāḥ kartṛgamaktā yuktā ) |
kathamatra- gataviśeṣaṇā viśeṣye buddhiḥ : iti cet, ucyate |
guṇa- jātyantaraṃ tvetad daivāt tatsaṃgatiṃ gatam |
' yadi hi raktatvamātramayaṃ brūyāt tato'śvatvena viśeṣaṇamākṣeta śakyatanvāt, yena taَدaikātmyamatrāpyatra raktatvaṃ vadet |
eṣa tu yathaiva sattāguṇatvayoravācakaḥ, tathā raktatvamatikramya śoṇatvaṃ nāma raktāvāntarajātiṃ vadati |
sā ca aśvatvena vidyate, na gavādiṣu, ityaśvatvaṃ pratīyate, na raktatvāt saṃśayo bhavati |
kīdṛśaṃ punastat gavādirekatvātirekena śoṇatvam, yat aśveṣu samavetam, anyatra cāsamavetamiti, ucyate |
ka cittasya viśeṣeṇa, ka cit sāmānyatā''bhidhā |
' sarvajātiṣu tāvat svavyaktimātrā- nusāriṇaḥ : kṛṣṇaśuklaraktatvādayo vilakṣaṇāḥ pratyakṣamupa- labhyante |
tatra ka cit sato viśeṣasya vācakaḥ śabdo
nāsti iti pramāṇāntaragamyaviśeṣamaṅgīkṛtya sāmānya- mātreṇābhidheyatvam, ka cittu punaḥ śoṇādiviśeṣaśabda- sadbhāvāt viśeṣarūpeṇābhidhānam |
tathā ka citta apabhraṃśena kaścit viśeṣaḥ pratideśamamīyate yathā 'rohaṇikā gauḥ' |
na kadā cit aśvānāṃ śāṭyāṃ vā raktaguṇāyāmevamabhidhānaṃ bhavati |

tasmāt jātyantarāṇyeva śoṇatva-karkatva-gauravādīni aśva- manuṣyādisaṃbandhīni abhīyamānāni teṣvapi pratyayamā- dadhāti (aśvatvaikāryasamavāyiśuklāntarajātiḥ karka- tvam, manuṣyatvaikāryasamavāyiśuklāntarajātiḥ gaura- tvam |
evaṃ paṅkatvaikāryasamavāyiśuklāntarajātiḥ puṇḍarīkatvam, raktāvāntarajātiḥ kokanadatvam ityādi ādiśabdābhyāmuktam) |
yathā golaṃ sāsnādimasu iti na vācyatvamāśaṅkyam |
etainaiva kumāra-karabha- kalabha-kiśora-vatsa-barkarādayo viśiṣṭajātisaṃbaddhavayo- viśeṣavacanatvena manuṣyoddiṣṭasyaśyādīnāṃ grahaṇe satyapi avācakā iti vyākhyātam |

(manuṣyatvaikāryasamavāyinī bālyāvāntarajātiḥ kumāratvam, utkṛṣṭatvaikāryasamavāyinī karabhatvam, hastitvaikāryasamavāyinī kalabhatvam, aśvatvai- kāryasamavāyinī kiśoratvam, gotvaikāryasamavāyinī vatsa- tvam, ajatvaikāryasamavāyinī barkaratvam) |
atha yaduktaṃ gavādivyapi tadvatsaṃkhyādimātrābhi- dhānādeva jātiviśeṣasiddheḥ anabhidheyaṃ pratyasyeti, tatra brūmaḥ |
' yadi hi śoṇatvādivat gavāśvagatānāmeka- tvādīnāmapi pratyakṣeṇa viśeṣo lakṣyeta, tata evaṃ kalpyeta |

yadi ca yathā śoṇaprātipadikam avibhaktāvayavaṃ guṇāśra- tayorvācakamāpadyamānam anekaśaktirūpatāmabhyāt anyataravācitvenādhyavasīyamānam aśvatvasya vyabhicāri- tvena agamakatvāt vyabhicāriguṇavacanatvenādhāritam, evaṃ gotvasaṃkhyāyorapi samānaśabdābhidhānabhājaḥ anya- tarasyāvyabhicāritayā vācakatvamavadhāryeta, na tu tadasti |
saṃkhyāyāstāvat sarvatra paricchedātmakatvāt na kaścit bhedo dṛśyate |
na ca tāvāneva śabdaḥ ubhayorvācakatvena saṃbhāvyate, anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ prātipadikena jātyabhi- dhānāt, vibhaktyā ca saṃkhyā'bhidhānāt |
yadi tatrāneka śabdasya śakyatvenāvaṃ na kalpyeta, tataḥ anyatarasya anartha- katvameva bhavet |
na ca saṃkhyāsaṃkhyeyayoḥ anyabhi- cāritvam, yena anyataradavagamyamānam itarasya gamakaṃ syāt |
tathāhi 'paricchedo gavādīnāṃ na kathā vinna saṃkhyayā |
na ka citta na saṃkhyeye saṃkhyā saiva pravartate |
' nanu ca liṅgaṃ prātipadikenaivopagamyate prati- jāti vilakṣaṇam anyabhicāritvena pravartamānaṃ śoṇatvā- ditulyaṃ syāt |
tathā yatrāpi ṭābādi- saṃbandhāt ṅī pratīyate |

' yadyapi ṭābādayaḥ strīliṅgasya dyotakātvāt na medena vācakā bhavanti, pūrvasyaiva ca śakyatvāntaramāvirbhavanti, tathāhi ṭābādibhyo yat śabdarūpam, tasya apratītāvasthe liṅgena jāti prati śaktiḥ kalpitā na paścāt apanetuṃ śakyā |
tathā yatra vibhaktisaṃbandhāt puṃsatvaṃ napuṃsakatvaṃ cābhivyajyate, tatrāpi evameva jātyabhidhānaṃ yojyam |

yatra tu prāgeva vibhakteḥ, tanniṣṭau vā satyāṃ śabdādeva prātipadikāt anyataraliṅgapratyayo bhavati yathā hastī nā devadattaḥ śrīḥ sarit toyaṃ vāri iti, tatra tathātvamyupagame'pi na kiñci- diruddham |
athavā vinā'pi śabdavibhāgena arthapratīto upācyamānāyāṃ sarvasattveṣvena vibhāgena prathamataṃ jāti pratipadyate |
(vā. pṛ. 121) kiñca 'vyaktidharmaśca puṃstvādiḥ prāk tato na pratīyate |
na ca jātā- vabujhāyāṃ vyaktiḥ kaścit pratīyate |
' tena kāmaṃ liṅgameva jātigamyaṃ bhavet, na jātirliṅgagabhyā |
nityaṃ copasarjanībhūtameva etat (liṅgam) gamyamānaṃ nārhati prādhānyena pratīyamānāyā jāterabhidheyatvaṃ vārayitum |
sā ca yatra liṅgaṃ na vyabhicariṣyati, tatra gamayiṣyatyapi |
yatrāpi (ace- tane) vyabhicāre sati anyataḥ pratīyate, tatra tadeva gamakaṃ tadanugṛhītā vā jātiḥ prātipadike veti yatheṣṭaṃ kalpyate |
pañcatyādiśabdeṣvapi yadi saṃkhyā sarvakārakāntara- nyāvatsvarūpā kartṛmātrānusāriṇī śoṇavat upalabhyate, tataḥ tayā nāma kartā gamyatām, tāvatā'pi anabhidheyo bhavatyeva |
yadā tu pūrvoktena nyāyena saṃkhyābhedo na labhyate, prativastu ca anantānyekatvādijātyantarāṇi na śakyante kalpayitum, tadā bhāvanādhātvarthanyāyameva (kartuḥ) upādānamādattavyam |
' yadi śoṇasyāpi kaścidanyaḥ aśvamupanayet, naivāsau svayaṃ klidyeta |
saṃkhyāyāśca bhāvanādhātvarthau upanetārī iti na svamayāsyati |
bhāvanopasthāne cokte viśeṣaḥ (vā. pṛ. 914|16) (bhāṣyaṃ vyākhyātumāha -) tasmāt anabhidheyasya kartuḥ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣaṇopapatteḥ apramāṇamabhidhānaśaktikalpana- mityavagacchāmaḥ |

evaṃ nyāyenāvadhārite kaścit āgamavirodhaṃ darśa- yannāha (bhāṣyaṃ) 'prakṛtipratyayau pratyayārthe saha brūtaḥ ityācāryopadeśāttā kartā śabdārthaḥ, karma ca ityavagamyate' iti, 'laḥ karmaṇicitsūtreṇa (pā. 3|4|69) ca- śabdāt karterīti ca |
' nanu sūtratathaiva āgama- virodhe darśite prakṛtipratyayau pratyayārtham ityetatsaṃbaddham |
vā. pṛ. 902) kartuḥ prādhānyamapi pūrva- pakṣavādinā darśitavyam |
tadetat abhidhānaṃ prādhānyaṃ ca ubhayamapi smṛtisiddha darśayati |
yassāt prakṛtipratyayau saha brūtaḥ pratyayārthaśca kartā karma ca syate, tasmāt kriyāviśiṣṭayostayoḥ abhidhānāt asyaiva śrutiprakaraṇa- virodha iti |
tatra 'laḥ karmaṇi ca' (bhāve cākarma- kebhyaḥ pā. 0 3|4|69 lakārāḥ sakarmakebhyaḥ karmaṇi kartari ca syuḥ, akarmakebhyaḥ bhāve kartari ca) ityatra tāvat ekāntena abhidheyatvena kartṛkarmopādānam |
na ca śabdasaṃniveśe kartā paratrāvasthitaḥ saṃbhavati, ataḥ 'ānarthakyāt tadbhedeṣu' iti śabde kārye vijñāyate |
tatra eṣo'rthaḥ (kartari śap ityasya -) kartṛvācini sārvadhātuke pratyaye paratra avasthite iti |
sarvathā tāvat pratyayārthaḥ kartā ityuktam ācāryaiḥ (vyākaraṇācāryaiḥ) |
anyathā'nu- papattyā hi vyavahārat sa gamyate |
' tatra nāma āgamavirodho yuktaḥ udbhāvayitum, yatra nyāyāgamī samānaviṣayau bhavataḥ |
iha tu nyāyasya anya eva viṣayaḥ 'kiṃ vācyaṃ kiṃ gamyamānam' iti, anya eva vyākaraṇa- smṛteḥ : 'ekārthayuktānāṃ sādhuḥ ko'pabhraṃśaḥ' iti |
na ca anyaviṣayena anyaviṣayasya durbalasyāpi bādho yuktaḥ, kimuta vācyagamyamānaviṣayatvena pratyayameva sarva- khasaṃbedasya |
tena yadyapi 'kartā śabdārthaḥ' ityevamācāryā vadeyuḥ, tathāpi saviprapannādyantena nādartavyāḥ bhaveyuḥ |
' yadi śāstraikadeśālocanena tadviruddhamyupagacchatā śāstravirodha udbhāvyate, tataḥ 'surā na pātavyā' ityasyāpi ekadeśena pānaṃ vihitamakurvan śāstraviruddhaṃ kuryāt |
tathā bhinnavākyeṣu 'yāvajjīvamagnihotraṃ juhoti' ityādimātrāpekṣayā dīkṣito'pi aśuddham ityevamāha |
vyākaraṇe'pi 'miderguṇaḥ' ityetānmātre hṛdayemāne 'midaḥ' ityatra guṇākaraṇaṃ śāstraviruddhaṃ syāt |
tatra hi ekaikasmin pade prāyeṇa aṣṭādhyāyī vyāpriyate |
tena 'laḥ karmaṇi ca' ityatraikadeśāntara- paripūrṇasya yo'rthaḥ, tena saha virodhaḥ parihartavyaḥ |

iha ca etāvatā pratyayavidhiḥ paripūryate 'pratyayaḥ, paraśca, āyudāttaśca, anudāttau suppitau, dhātoḥ, tatropapadaṃ saptamīstham, kudatiha, vā'sarūpo'striyām, vartamāne laṭ, kartari kṛt, laḥ karmaṇi ca bhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ, lasya, tibādayaḥ ( tiptsjhi ityādi sarvaṃ sūtram ), anudāttaṅita ātmanepadam, śeṣāt kartari parasmaipadam, yuṣmadasmadupapadādiṣu madhyamādayaḥ, tiṅastrīṇi trīṇi prathamamadhyamottamāḥ, tānyekavacanadvivacanabahuvacanā- nyekaśaḥ, bahuṣu bahuvacanam, dvayekayordvivacanaikavacane iti |
parāṇi ca saṃjñāparibhāṣā''dirūpeṇa lopāgamavarṇa- vikārādisāstrāṇi sarvāṇi ekaṃ vākyam |
ekavākyatā ca sati viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāve bhavati, anyathā |
so'pi ca sāmānādhikaraṇyena vā bhavati samānavibhaktyantānām, vaiyadhikaraṇyena vā kriyākārakūpaḥ śeṣaśeṣīrūpaśca |

tadiha anaupayikatvāt avayavāntarāpyupekṣya 'ladeśāḥ kartari karmaṇi ca bhavanti, ekasminnekavacanam, dvayordvivacanam, bahuṣu bahuvacanam' ityeṣāṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ sāmānādhi- karaṇyavaiyadhikaraṇyapravṛttiśca cintyate |
tatra tāvat nahudaikaśabdāḥ saṃkhyāvacanāḥ tānnibhadhāya saṃkhyāye vṛttyasaṃbhavāt ityākṛtyadhikaraṇe sthāpitam |
pātañjale'pi ca 'keṣu bahuṣu' iti praśnapūrvakamupakramya tatra doṣānabhidhāya saṃkhyāvacanatvamabhidhāya, bahutve dvitvaikatvayoḥ iti vivaraṇāt |
'kathamanantareṇa bhāvapratyayaṃ bhāvapradhāno bhavati nirdeśaḥ' iti pṛṣṭe, bhavati yadā prathama eva guṇaḥ : svaprādhānyena vivakṣyate iti kṛyuktam |
' yatra guṇaḥ prathamameva svapradhāno vivakṣitaḥ, tatrānutpādyaiva bhāvapratyayam vinā ca sāmānādhikaraṇyam, saṃruddho bhavati 'paṭasya śuklaḥ' iti |
vibhaktyarthaḥ, nārthaḥ anabhihitādhikāreṇa' iti tu pātañjalamūle pāṭhaḥ |
ke.) 'nanu etadapyasti, yadā karmadayo vibhaktyarthaḥ, tadā ekatvādayo viśeṣaṇatvena' iti |
etat pūrva- pakṣavacanatvāt anupapannanīyaṃ sat abhyupetavādeno- panyastam |

etaduktaṃ bhavati, yadā'pi karmādayo viśeṣya- bhūtāḥ prādhānyena vibhaktyarthāścintyante, tadā'pi eka- tvādaya eva viśeṣaṇatvenāvāsthatāḥ santaḥ abhidhīyante, anabhihitānināṃ viśeṣaṇatvānupapatteḥ, viśeṣaśca cānyata eva siddheḥ |
bhavati hi īdṛśāmavasthāyām upasarjanaparatvaṃ vidheḥ yathā lohitoṣṇīṣādiṣu |
yadā'pi te prayojanaṃ tadarthena vibhaktiḥ prayujyate ityarthaḥ |

yadā ubhayorvacanayoḥ utsṛṣṭayoḥ (anirdiṭaviṣayaviśeṣayorityarthaḥ) yathā- saṃbhavaṃ niveśāt ekaṃ tiṅviṣayaṃ yat pūrvamudāhṛtam, aparaṃ tu subviṣayaṃ bhaviṣyati, tatra karmādīnāṃ vibhaktyartha- syābhyupagamāt |
nanu ca samānatvāt bahuvacanādāśākhasa aikarūpye sati yathaiva tiṅāṃ karmādiviśeṣasaṃkhyā'bhi- dhānāt na kārakābhidhānaṃ jātam, tathaiva subāmapi prāpnoti |
tataśca 'yat karaṇābhidhānyā vibhaktyā saṃyujya nirdiṣṭaṃ' (bhā. 3|1|6|12 pṛ. 679), 'tadāgame hi tad dṛśyate tasya jñānam' (sū. 4|1|155) ityādiṣvahāravirodhaḥ syāt |
ekampi śāstraṃ prayojanavaśāt saṃbandhabhedena bhidyamānam anyathā ca viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvapratipatteḥ tiṅsu viśeṣatvena saṃkhyāṃ ca vakṣyati, supnu viśeṣaṇatveneti |
(svatane āha-) atha etenāparitoṣaḥ, tato'nyatho- cyate (vā. pṛ. 927) 'śāstre yadyapi naiteṣāmabhidheya- tvāśritam |
' śāstre hi kāryavaśena abhidheyasyāpi abhidheyatvaṃ pāribhāṣikamāśrīyate |
na ca tavātā loke tathaiva prasajyate |
na ca karmādayaḥ anabhidheyā eva ityetat śāstre abhihitam, kiṃ tarhi ? ekāntābhidheye- katvādi viśeṣaṇaṃ tāvat (karmādayaḥ) bhavanti ityetat vyākhyātameva |
tat yatra na śāstreṇa, na nyāyena abhidheyatvaprāptiḥ, tatrānabhidheyā vijñāyante |
yatra punaḥ śāstroktā viśeṣaṇa- tāmanabhidhīyamānāḥ pratipattuṃ na śakyanti, tatra nyāya- labhyām ananyagatitvāt abhidheyatāmapi pratipadyante |
arthapattyā vā śāstreṇāpi abhidheyatvā uktā bhavi- ṣyanti |
tatra tiṅkṣu bhāvanopasthānāt viśeṣaṇatvasiddheḥ, nāvaśyam abhidheyatvamaṅgīkartavyam |

suṣṭhu punaḥ prātipadi- kārthanāmakelādīnāṃ ca ākārakeṣu kārakāntareṣu ca vyabhi- cārāt anyatarapratipādanaśaktau vihitāyām, anyasya ca bhāvanāyāstathādyaiḥ gamakasyānabhidhānāt na kiñcidupa- sthāpakam iti svayaṃ kārakamanabhidhāya tadviśiṣṭa- saṃkhyā'bhidhānānupapatteḥ kārakam abhidheyaṃ bhavati |
nanu ca kevalakārakaprayogabhāvāt avaśya- mabhyākhyātāpadābhihitabhāvanāpanītānāmeva kārakāṇāṃ tiṅvidhatva saṃkhyāsaṃbandhaḥ avakalpiṣyate |
(parihartā āha-) kathamavakalpate, yadā vākye svaniyatakrameṣu kadā cidākhyātāśabdāt prathamaprayuktena subantena 'vṛkṣam' iti kārakapratyayo janyamāno nābhidhānamantareṇa sidhyati |
(sa eva śaṅkate-) nanu tatrāpi kriyāsaṃbandhāt prāk kārakatvānupapattestāvat kārakavikamaktyā notpattavyam, yāvat kriyāsaṃbandho nopadarśitaḥ |

śrotā punaḥ yaḥ prathamameva vṛkṣamiti śṛṇoti, na tena kriyā tatsaṃbandho vā anyataḥ pūrvamevadhāritaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? śabdamātrāt kārakaṃ pratipadya anumānenārthapattyā vā vaktṛā pūrvataraṃ kalpitāṃ kriyāṃ pratipadyate |
kutaḥ ? 'kriyayā kārakaṃ gamyaṃ kārakeṇa kriyā tathā |
' dvayoḥ saṃbandhinoḥ avaśyamekasya itara- nirapekṣaṃ pratītitamūlamabhyupagantavyam, tadiha yadi kriyāgamyaṃ kārakam, tataḥ kriyā kena pratyāyyate iti vaktavyam |
nāpi prāti- padikārtho gamakaḥ vinā'pi kriyāyā upapatteḥ |
athocyeta, na jātu cit kaścit niṣkriyaḥ saṃbhavati, ataḥ astitiṣṭhatyādikā cit ekāntena ākṣitā kriyā bhaviṣyati |
athavā 'astibhaṃvantīparaḥ prathama- puruṣaḥ aprayujyamāno'pyasti iti gamyate' (mahā- bhāṣyaṃ 2|3|46) ityevaṃ sakriyatvāt kārakākṣepaḥ setsyati iti (netaretarāśrayatvam) |
' sāmānyena chātra asyādikriyā kā cit prātipadikārthena ākṣipyeta, na cāsau sarvakārakākṣepe samarthā, iti karmādīnāmanyat prāpakaṃ mṛgyam |
na ca vibhaktiḥ kriyāṃ bravīti, yathā karma ākṣipyeta |
na ca saṃkhyā kriyā- kārakaviśeṣakṣepasamarthā ityuktam |
ato na kāraka- pratītiṃ muktvā anyā kriyāḥ pratyāyakam asti |
tatra yadi kārakasyāpi kriyā pratyāyyate, tataḥ sphuṭataram itaretarāśrayeṇa ubhayorapi nirmūlamāpadyate |
yadā tarhi kriyāpadapūrvakaṃ kārakapadaṃ prayujyate, tadā tatsaṃbandha- yogyāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ pūrvatarapratītatvena kārakapratyāyana- sāmarthyāt vibhaktibhiḥ saṃkhyāmātramabhidhīyate |
satyameva- mapi prāpsyat, yadi nityam ākhyātopakramāpye vākyāni prāyokṣyanta, teṣāṃ tu aniyamenaiva prayogaḥ sarvadā sthitaḥ 'gāṃ paśya, padya gām' ceti |
yadā hi subantapūrvayogāpekṣayā kalpitā vācaka- śaktiḥ, tadā kimaso prayogāntare apanetuṃ śakyate |
atho- cyeta ākhyātpūrvaprayogavāde vibhakteḥ śaktyabhāve atradhārite avaśyambhāvi caikarūpye atyantaśaktyaiva bhavatviti, tadyuktam |
asayāstu phalaṃ tasyāḥ prārthitaṃ durlabhaṃ bhavet ||
' sarvatraiva yasya- kasyacit kāryasya sadasadvādadarśanāt viddhasada- sadvāvātmakatvānvayagame sati aikarūpyaṃ parigṛhyate |
tatsadbhāvaḥ parigrahītamaḥ, satāmapi pratibandhāt kāraṇāttarābhāvāt anyato vā siddheḥ kāryārambhā- virodhāt |
asataśca kāryavelāyāṃ daivarapi aprāpteḥ animittakāryopādapasaṅgāt ityuktaṃ saṃcananityatve (saṃvandhākṣepaparihāre ślovā. 33) |
tasmāt kalpitā vācakaśaktiḥ nāmapūrve tāvat prayoge vyāparīṣyate |
lubdhātmakatvāt śrotṛtve sati anumānadhiyā nirākurvatī kāryamārapsyate |
(tatra na śāstreṇa ityādinopapāditāṃ nyāyāt vyavasthāmupasaṃharati-) ataśca siddhāḥ supāṃ karmādayo'rthāḥ |
tiṅāṃ tu niyatapaurvāparyāt ekāntena dhālarthabhāvanābhyāmupasthāpayitavyoḥḥ kartṛkarmaṇoḥ paścāt saṃkhyā avagamyate iti na kadā cidapi kārake viśeṣaṇe vācakaśaktyalpanā'vasaraḥ |
bhāṣyam-- (pṛ. 930-31, 35) nanu kartṛ- rekātva ekavacanam, kartṛdvitvāt dvivacanam, kartṛbahutvāt bahuvacanam |
tena nūnaṃ kartā śabdārthaḥ iti gamyate |
ekavacananirdeśe kartṛkatvaṃ gamyate, dvivacana- nirdeśe kartṛdvitvam, bahuvacananirdeśe kartṛbahutvam |
yathā ākṛtitracane śabde dvivacane dravyamedo'vagamyate ekavacane dvaikatvam evamihāpi draṣṭavyam |
vā-- (pṛ. 930) athātra kaścit anumāna- kuśala āha-- 'nanu kartṛdvitvāt dvivacanam, kartṛdvaikatvāt dvivacanam, kartṛbahutvāt bahuvacanam |
ko'bhiprāyaḥ ? kartṛviśeṣaprayāyanārthaṃ yaḥ śabda ucyate devadattādiḥ, tena saha pañcādīnāṃ prayujyamānānāṃ tadanu-
tena yadi hi devadattādayaḥ sāmānyataḥ pacati- śabdenābhihitāḥ, tatastaiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ labhyate |
tatsametameva hi ekatvādi lakṣayituṃ śakyate, nānya- samavāyi |
tatra etat syāt, adhiśrayaṇādayo'pi devadattasametāḥ tasya pāktvenocyante iti |
satyamucyate, na tu taddvāraṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhavati |

gottāruṇatvā- dīni hi viśeṣye svātmānurūparūpotpādanāt mattvelopā- medopacāranimittā pratipadya śabdaṃ pravartayanti ( prathamā- bahuvacanametat ) sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ kārayanti, na tvevam adhiśrayaṇādirūpāpo devadatto gamyate, yena amedo- pacāramatublopau syātām |
ato yathā daṇḍādiśabdāḥ devadattādisāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na pratipadyante ' daṇḍo deva- dattaḥ ' iti |
yathā vā ' adhiśrayaṇādayaḥ pāko vā devadattaḥ ' iti prayogo na bhavati, tathā ' pacati devadattaḥ ' ityapi na syāt |
( anumānaṃ tu ' pacati- śabdaḥ kartṛvācī devadattādikartṛpadābhedavartitvāt paktṛ- śabdavat ' ' pacyateśabdaḥ karmavācī odanādirmatpadā- bhedavartitvāt paktṛśabdavat ' iti ) |
abhedavartitvaṃ hi tatpadasāmānādhikaraṇyam asaṃdigdhavācakasya kṛdanteṣu ' paktā devadattaḥ ' ' paca odanaḥ ' ityādiṣu dṛṣṭam |
yatra ca kartṛkarmavacanatvaṃ nāsti, tatra sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yathā pākādiśabde |
tathaiva vācakatvaṃ syād dṛṣṭāntau tāvihāpi ca ||
' ' pacati devadattaḥ, pacato devadattasyadattī, pacanti devadattadattaviṣṇu- mitrādayaḥ ' iti yaiva kartṛvācini devadattādiśabde saṃkhyā, saiva ākhyāte'pi dṛśyate |
yatra cāsau dṛśyate, sa vācako dṛṣṭo yathā ' paktā devadattaḥ, paktārau ityādi |
tathā karmaṇyapi ' pacyate odanaḥ, pacyate odanākī ' ' paca odanaḥ, pacau śākaudanau ' ityādiṣu pakṣadṛṣṭānto- dāharaṇādi vakṣyantīti |

( tathā ca prayogo ' pacati- śabdaḥ kartṛvacanaḥ ' kartṛgatasaṃkhyāviśeṣaṇatvenārtā paktā devadatta iti vākyasyapaktṛśabdavat ' iti, ' pacyateśabdaḥ karmavacanaḥ karmagatasaṃkhyāviśeṣaṇatvenārtā pakka odana iti vākyasyapakkaśabdavat ' iti ca ) |
' itaśca vācakaḥ, yena anabhihitādhikāravihitakārakavibhaktipratibandho dṛśyate ' pacati devadattaḥ ' ' pacyate odanaḥ ' iti |
yadi hi vācakatvaṃ na syāt, tataḥ ' anabhihite ' ( pā0 2|3| 1 ) , ' karmaṇi dvitīyā ' ( pā0 2 ) , ' kartṛkaraṇayo- stṛtīyā ' ( pā0 2|3|18 ) iti ca vibhaktiprāptirna kena cit pratibadhyeta |
yathā ' pacyate devadattena ' ' paca- tyodanam ' iti |
yatastu khalu pratibandhaḥ; tenāvagamyate paktṛpakṣasādhamyeṇaiva vācakatvam |
sādharmyādanyatve vaidharmyam, tadevaṃ darśayitavyam ' yatra ca vācakatvaṃ nāsti, tatra kārakavibhaktipratibandho'pi nāsti, yathā pacyate devadattena, pacyateodanam ' iti |

' ( pacatipacyateśabdaḥ kartṛ- karmaṇorvācakaḥ kartṛkarmaviśeṣabodhakatvāt, yat yadviśeṣa- bodhakaṃ tat tadbodhakaṃ yathā śrotraṃ śabdaviśeṣākāra- [ viśeṣasya akārasya ] bodhakam iti prayogaḥ ) yadi pacatiśabdādibhiḥ kartṛkarmaṇī nocyetām, kathaṃ tadviśeṣaḥ saṃkhyā abhidhīyate |
' tat nāmidhatte ' taddhi- śeṣamamidhatte ' iti hi vipratiṣiddhametat |
nahi śrotraṃ śabdasāmānyāgamyam tadviśeṣam akāraṃ gamayati |
na ca śabdasya abhidhātustathā'nyadarthaṃ bodhakatvaṃ bhavati |
bhāvanayā hi gamyamānatve artha eva bodhakaḥ syāt śabdaḥ |
tasmādapi vācakatvam ( vā. pṛ. 132 ) kiñca ' viśe- ṣaṇaiśca saṃbandhaādisucyate kartṛkarmaṇī |
' itaścābhidhīyate, viśe- ṣaṇaiḥ saṃbadhyamānatvāt ' iha śobhanaḥ pacati ' ' śobhanaḥ pacyate ' |
dṛṣṭaṃ yathā, śobhanaḥ paktā, ramaṇīyaḥ pakkaḥ ' iti |
yatra tu abhidheyatvaṃ nāsti, tatra viśeṣaṇasaṃbandho'pi na dṛṣṭaḥ yathā ' śobhanamāste ' iti |
na ca gamyamānasya viśeṣaṇasaṃbandhe yathā dhūmaśabdādrevagatasya na jvalanā- dibhiḥ saṃbandha iti |
tadetat sarvam ' nanu kartṛkarmavā- dekavacanam ' ityādineva ( bhā. pṛ. 130 paṃ. 1 ) darśitatvāt bhāṣyakāreṇa na prapañcitam |
yat tāvaduktaṃ ' vācakaḥ pacatyādiśabdaḥ kartṛkarmaṇoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyāt ' iti, tatra yadi vācakaśaktyā astitvamanumīyate, tataḥ pūrvoktena arthāpatti- bhaṅgena sarvapramāṇānupapatteḥ |
anumānavirodhaśca nābhitā kartṛkarmaṇoḥ pacatyādiśabdaḥ, tadantānvinābhūtā- rthābhidhāyitvāt ) |
( kartṛkarmāvinābhūtabhāvanāyāmi- dhāyitvāt ityarthaḥ ) yo yadantānvinābhūtābhidhāyī, sa tasya na vācakaḥ yathā śiśapāśabdo vṛkṣatvaniyata- śiśapātvasya ( vācako, na vṛkṣatvasya ) |
tathā kartṛkarmaṇī nābhidheye tiṅā, tadabhidheyāparityāgāt tadvāpārāt vinā'pi ca pratīyamānatvāt, dravyatvavat, tasminneva śiśapāśabde vṛkṣatvāt |
tiṅaśabdasya avācakatvam ākhyātātvāt āsyate ityādiṣat, ityevamapi śakyaṃ vaktum |
nanu ' accandraḥ śaśī ' iti etat laukikaviruddhamanu- mānam, naiṣa doṣaḥ |
yadi vayaṃ pratyākhyatvaṃ pratyāyakatvaṃ vā nihumahe, tato lokaviruddhaṃ brūyāma |
vācyavācaka- śaktipratiṣedhastu ayaṃ kriyate, na ca tena lokaprasiddhi- virodhaḥ, pratyayotpādāmātreṇa kṛtārthasya ( vā. pṛ. 133 ) lokasya abhidheyagamyatvocityasyarūpatathyavivikṣā- nādarāt |
( gavādi śabdānām abhidheyā jātiḥ, gamyā vyaktiḥ, upasargāṇāṃ dyotyaḥ gamanādirarthaḥ, yoga- rūḍhānāṃ viṣayaḥ padmatvādiriti catuṣṭayam ) |
yadi tu lokaprasiddhaṃ pratyāyyapratyāyakatvamātraṃ sādhyeta, tataḥ prāguktena bhāvanādvārapatīyamabhyupagamāt siddhabhāvanam |
kutaḥ ? ' loko yadanyataḥ siddham, nābhiveyaṃ tadicchati |

' śeṣā api pratijñādoṣāḥ pūrvoktena mārgeṇa ( śrotrā. śabda- nityatvādhikaraṇakramāgata 318 ) varṇasphoṭajātyādi- śabdavikalpatayā śaktidvayākārakatvena vyatirekā- vyatirekapraśnaṃ ca vaiyākaraṇaṃ prati yojayitavyāḥ |
tathā sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ śrautaṃ lākṣaṇikaṃ vā heturucyate ? śrautaṃ tāvat ubhayorapisiddham |
kasmāt, asmākaṃ bhāvanā- mātrābhidhānāt, tava śaktimātrakārakatvābhyupagamāt |
devadattādiśabdo hi dravyavacano na śakti brūyāt |
kārakaṃ ca abhidadhat pratyayaḥ śaktimātreṇa abhidadhyāt na dravyarūpeṇa, tasyākārakatvāt |
yasyāpi hi dravyaṃ kārakam, tenāpi śaktiviśeṣaṇatvena avyadhamabhyupagantavyā tadrahitadravyavyāpārāsaṃbhavāt |
itaśca ākṛtyadhikaraṇāt śakteravābhidhānam, iti dravyaśabdena saha sāmānā- dhikaraṇyanupapattiḥ |
śaktivacanastu naiva ākhyātasamabhi- vyāhṛtaḥ kaścit śabdo'sti, yena saha śrautaṃ sāmānā- dhikaraṇyaṃ syāt |
yasya tu ( śaktyana- bhyupagantṛṇaiṣo'pi ) dravyaṃ kārakam, tasya yat dravyaṃ kena cit kārakāmnā avadhāritam, tasya jātivat tatrānapāyāt yāvatsvadravyaṃ kārakāntaravivakṣā prāpnoti |
śaktipakṣe'pi aviśiṣṭamitāṃ tāsām āvirbhāvatirobhāvavivakṣāvalena tathātathā'bhi- dhānāt |
dravyasya tu ekātmakatvāt apekṣākāraṇarahitasya na vivakṣā'ntaraṃ prāpnoti |
' yathaiva pākādiśabdeṣu dravyaprādhānyāt sattvarūpapratyayo bhavati, evaṃ suptiṅante- ṣvapi syāt |
tataśca yathaiteṣveva ' pācakaṃ brūhi ' ' pācakena kṛtam ' ' pācakāya dehi ' iti kārakāntara- yogo bhavati, evam ' pacatyodanam ' ityādiṣvapi
tassāt śaktimaddvayakārakapakṣe'pi avaśyaṃ niṣkṛṣya śaktimātraṃ sutiṣṭhyām abhidheyameṣṭavyam|
tathā sati hi 'āvirbhūtakyā śaktyā dravyamamatvaśa- kṛtam|
' tena kārakāntarāyogo liṅgasaṃkhyārahitatvaṃ ca dravyapradhāna- katvalakṣaṇatvena siddham|
(śrautaviśiṣṭasya sāmānā- dhikaraṇyasya hetutāyāḥ ubhayāsiddhatāmupasaṃharati- ) tataśca avasthitaṃ śrutisāmānādhikaraṇyasya ubhayorasiddha- tvam|
atha lakṣaṇyā sāmānādhikaraṇyam aśeṣitaṃ vā hetuḥ; tataḥ 'siṃho mānavakaḥ' ityādiṣu antareṇāpi vācyavācakabhāvaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ dṛṣṭam, ityanaikānti- katā|

(śrautatvaviśeṣaṇapakṣe eva hetoḥ sādhyā- viśiṣṭalakṣaṇapratiṣṭhāpyaikadeśatvena anyatrāsiddhatvaṃ vaktumārabhate -) yacca śrautaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyam, tasya ko'rthaḥ? 1 samānamadhikaraṇam iti samānaṃ vācya- mityarthaḥ|
( siddhāntī - ) yadi evam, tataḥ sarvadaiva tiṣṭhamihitayā saṃkhyayā kātra nātikramitavyaḥ |
( śaṅkate ) kathaṃ tarhi ' sthālī pacati ' iti prayogaḥ |
kiṃ punaratra yuktam, kiṃ kutaścit kāraṇāt kartāramatikrampa adhikaraṇaṃ saṃkhyayā āśritam, athavā tatsaṃkhyā'haṃ kartṛtvameva sthālyāṃ vivakṣyate iti ( vicāre ) kartṛtvavivakṣā yukteti manyāmehe |
kutaḥ ? ' na mukhyātikrame kiñcit dṛśyate kāraṇā- ntaram |
mukhyatvasya vivakṣā tu yatheṣṭaṃ nanu yujyate |
' sarvatraiva arthadvaye saṃbhavati anyatararūpa- vivakṣā yuktā |
saṃbhavati ca sarvakāraṇāṃ svavyāpārā- pekṣayā kartṛtvam iti purastāt pratipāditam ( vākyādhi- karaṇe ślo. 66 ityādinā ) |
nahi pradhānakriyāgataṃ kārakavaikyaṃ svavyāpāraviṣayāt kartṛtvādinā upapadyate |
tasmāt tadeva vivakṣitam iti nyāyyam, na kārakāntara- saṃkhyā'bhidhānamiti |
evaṃ ca sati yat karmasaṃkhyā'pi ka
ki punarasya prayojanam, yadā na lokavedyoste tathopalabhyate |
yadapi ca tatra nāsti prayojanam, kśāstre tu asti, kathaṃ nāma anamihitā- dhikāraṇa kāraprayoge tayoramihitatvāśrayaṇāt paryudāsaḥ syāditi |

( mukhyatvāmyupagamena paryudāsopapattimupapādi- tāmupasaṃharati- ) tasmāt yadyapi paramārthato nāmidhīyate, tathāpi amihitavadāśrayaṇāt anamihitādhikāravihite vibhaktī na lakṣyate iti paricchataḥ kārakavibhaktiprasaṅgaḥ |
( caturthaprayogasthaṃ 'tadviśeṣaṇabodhakatvāt' iti hetum anaikāntikatvena dūṣayati- ) yattu tadviśeṣaṇābhidhānā- diti ( pṛ. 13120 ), tat śiśapādiśabdairanaikā- ntikam |
śiśapāśabdo hi na tāvat vṛkṣatvapārthivatva- dravyatvasattāprameyatvānām abhidhāyakaḥ, atha ca tadviśeṣameva viśiṣāmamidhatte |
tena yathā asya sāmānya- manamidhāya viśeṣābhidhānaśaktirna virudhyate, yathā ca cakṣuṣaḥ
saṃnipatyopakārakaṃ tu trividhaṃ dṛṣṭārtham adṛṣṭārtham ubhayārthaṃ ca āśrayakarma- khyam |
dṛṣṭārthamapi dvividhaṃ bhānyupayogasaṃskārārthe bhūto- payogasaṃskārārthe ceti |
tatra dṛṣṭārtha bhānyupayogadravyasaṃskārārthe saṃnipatyopakārakaṃ dvividham, sākṣāt viniyuktasaṃskārārtham, sākṣādviniyuktasya yadupa- kārakam, tatsaṃskārārthe ceti |
ata eva 'vatsasyaiva viniyuktadohā- ṅgadravyopakārakatvā 'vatsamālabheta' ityatra ālabhasaṃskārārthatvam iti paśusomādhikaraṇe (2|1|6) bhavadevaḥ |
(bhūtopayogadravyasaṃskārārthe dṛṣṭārthe saṃnipatyo- pakārakaṃ-) pratipattistu trividhā pradhānottarakāla tatpūrva- kāla tatsamakāla ca |
pradhānasamakālā yathā āgneya- codanayā vihite yāge 'caturavattaṃ juhoti' iti homa- rūpā pratipattiḥ |
homo hi 'vaṣaṭkṛte juhoti' iti vidhānāt vaṣaṭkāroccāraṇottarakṣaṇe adhvaryuṇā kartavyaḥ |
tasminneva ca kṣaṇe yāgasvarupārṇayena vaṣaṭkāreṇa sārito yāgo yajamānenānuṣṭheyaḥ |
bhūtābhyu- payogomayadevatāsaṃskārakastu paśupuroḍāśākhyaḥ āśrayi- karmamevedha vakṣyate |
adṛṣṭārthe saṃnipatyopakārakaṃ yat, tadapi pratipatticadeva trividham |
na ceyaṃ pratipattiḥ, homena pratipāditasya ākīrṇakaratānāṃvi- pratipatyantarānapekṣatvāt |
bhānyupayogadravyasaṃskārārthamapi dvividhaṃ sākṣādviniyuktasaṃskārārthe sākṣādviniyuktasya yadupakārakam, tatsaṃskārārthe ceti |
dvitīyaṃ yathā khalevālyāṃ sthāṇāhūtiḥ jupīyātradhanasādhusaṃskāradvārā yūpasaṃskārārtha |
dṛṣṭādṛṣṭobhayārtham āśrayakarmakāryaṃ yat, tadapi trividhaṃ kiñcit dravyaprakṣepā- śena dṛṣṭārtham, devatoddeśārena tu adṛṣṭārtham |
yathā sviṣṭakṛdyāgaḥ agreḥ sviṣṭakṛtaḥ ka cidanyatrāviniyogāt |
kiñcidevatoddeśārena dṛṣṭārthe dravyaprakṣepāśena tu adṛṣṭārthe yathā uttamaḥ prayājaḥ |
tatra hi 'svāhā'miṃ svāhā somam' ityādiājyānmantraliṅgāt krameṇa pratyabhijñāyamānā ājyabhāgādiṣu yakṣyamāṇā eva devatāḥ saṃskāryāḥ |
paśupuroḍāśāgo'pi eva- meveti daśame 'paśāvapīti cet' ityadhikaraṇe (10|1|9) pratipāditam |

kiñcidāśrayakarma devato- ddeśonāpi dṛṣṭārthe dravyaprakṣepāśenāpi, dravyatyāgāṃśenaiva tu kevalaṃ adṛṣṭārtham iti āśrayakarmatā labhate yathā 'sūktavākena prastaraṃ praharati' iti prastarapraharaṇaṃ sūkta- vākaprakāśiteṣṭadevatākalpanāt taduddeśenāpi dṛṣṭārtham |
punarapi vaidikaṃ karma caturvidham utpatti-prāpti-vikṛti- saṃskṛtyarthatvena |
tatrādyaṃ yathā 'praṇītābhiḥ saṃyoti' iti saṃyavanaṃ puroḍāśapiṇḍotpatyarthe yāgāda ca svargādya- tyartham |
dvitīyaṃ yathā 'payo dogdhi' iti ughaḥsya- syaiva hi dugdhasya prāpyatyarthaṃ dohanam |
punarapi vaidikaṃ karma caturvidhaṃ prakṛtivikṛtirubhayā- tmakamanubhayātmakaṃ ca |
aṣṭame hyetaduktaṃ darśapūrṇa- māsayoḥ agnīṣomīyo vikṛtiḥ, tasya ca savanīyapaśavaḥ, teṣāṃ caikādaśināḥ sutyākālasāmyāt, teṣāṃ ca prājā-
punarapi vaidikaṃ karma dvividhaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ ca |
naimittikamapi dvividhaṃ niyatanimittakam aniyatanimi- ttakaṃ ca |
aniyatanimittakampi dvividhaṃ doṣanirghātā- rtham adoṣanirghātārthe ca |
tatra niyatanimittakaṃ yathā 'yāvajjīvamagnihotraṃ juhoti', 'vasantasavante jyotiṣā yajeta' iti |
tatrādyaṃ yāvajjīvādhikaraṇe (2|4|1) pratipāditam, dvitīyaṃ tu paṣṭhe 'somavicāprajamaṇavākyena saṃyogāt' (6|1|1|12) ityadhikaraṇe pratipāditam |

aniyatanimittakaṃ doṣanirghātārthe yathā 'yo'māvāsyāṃ paurṇamāsīṃ vā'tipātayedyame pathikṛte'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirva- pet' iti, 'yo'māvāsyāṃ paurṇamāsīṃ vā'tipātayeda- vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet' iti ca |
doṣanirghātārtha- tvādeva ekārthatvādinayorvikalpo dvādaśe 'prāyaścitteṣu caikatvāt' ityadhikaraṇe (12|3|16) vakṣyate |
aniyatam adoṣanirghātārthe yathā dvādaśe eva 'samu- cayastvadoṣanirghātārtheṣu' iti pūrvāpavādādye'dhikaraṇe (12|3|17) pratipāditam 'minne juhoti' ityādi |
kāmyamapi karma trividham aihikaphalaṃ āmuṣmika- phalakam aniyataphalakaṃ ca |
tatrādyaṃ yathā 'kārīryā vṛṣṭikāmo yajeta' : 'śyenenābhicaran yajeta' iti, jāteṣṭiśca puttrādiphālikā |
upasthitasyārthe hi dṛṣṭeḥ sarvaiḥ kāmyate, nānupāsthitā aihikasryā'pi, kimuta janmāntarīyasyārthā |
evamabhicāro'pi upasthitaśatro- reva kāmyate, nānupāsthitasya aihikasyāpi, kimuta janmā- ntarīyasya |
evaṃ pūtatvādyapi yo yadā jāyate putrastasyaiva kāmyate, na kālāntaratastasya aihikasyāpi, kimuta janmāntarīyasyeti |
nahi svargaḥ kasyasulabhāmako mānuṣaśarīreṇa sulabhaḥ; lobhyabhogādyai dharmādharmobhayānvena anubhavituṃ śakya iti |
aniyataphalaṃ yathā 'citrayā yajeta paśu- kāmaḥ' ityādi |
paśvādi hi phalaṃ aihikāmuṣmikatvenā- niyataṃ caturthe yogasiddhayadhikaraṇe (4|1|11) prati- pāditam |
nivṛttirūpamapi karma dvividhaṃ kṛtyathe puruṣārthe ca |
dvitīyaṃ yathā 'na hiṃsyāt sarvā bhūtāni' iti |
pravṛtti- nivṛtyātmakatayā ubhayatvaṃ paryudāsākhyaṃ yat, tadapi dvividhaṃ kṛtyathe puruṣārthe ca |
tatrādyaṃ yathā 'yajatiṣu yeyajā- mahaṃ karoti nānuyājeṣu' iti, 'nārṣeyaṃ vṛṇīte, na hotāraṃ vṛṇīte' iti ca |
karma na ākhyātavācyam, kintu arthāt gamyate |
mā. 4|4|13 pṛ. 913-940. karma na bhidyate dravyabhede'pi tadevaidaṃ calanaṃ yajanam, ityādiprabhavāt kriyākyapatti pratinidhyupādāne'pi na kṣatiḥ |
athavā mā'stu vyaklibhedaḥ, śabdāntarādipramāṇakaiḥ āgneyādi- jātaya eva bhidyante |
karma prakāntaṃ vītāyāmapi phalecchāyāṃ prāpte'pi vā phale avaśyaṃ samāpanīyam iti 'prakramāttu niya- myeta' (6|1|3|14) ityuktam |
su. pṛ. 749. karma loke arthalakṣaṇaṃ bhavati, na śabdalakṣaṇam |
yathā arthastathā kriyate na yathā śabdaḥ |
sā gītiḥ kiṃ ṛcaḥ prati pradhānabhūtā, uta guṇabhūtā iti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
'rayaṃtaraṃ gāyati', 'bṛhat gāyati' ityatra pradhānakarmaṇo vidheḥ lakṣaṇaṃ svarūpaṃ dṛśyate dvitīyā vibhaktiḥ |
sā gītiśca na pradhānabhūtā kintu guṇabhūtā |
nanu yat prati gītiḥ guṇabhūtā, tat kiṃ syāt ? āha |
athavā ṛk dravyaṃ yasya sāmnaḥ tat ṛgdravyaṃ syāt |
dhānaḥ taṇḍulāḥ ājyam iti, evamihāpi dravyam ṛk |
tasya guṇabhūtā gītiḥ, iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
sāmasvarūpaṃ yā gītiḥ sā ṛcaḥ prati pradhānabhūtā iti pūrvapakṣa uktaḥ |
tatra ṛgāśrite sāmni pradhānabhūte svīkṛte'pi āśrayāta ṛgdravyāta vyatirekaḥ dravyāntare ṛgantare yoneḥ sakāśāt uttarāyām ṛci pradeśaśca saṃbandhaśca apratiṣiddhaḥ na viruddhaḥ |
su. pṛ. 557. karmaṇa: ekasya nahi anekayā devatayā anekayā ( vā ) anuvākyayā kāryamasti |
vi. 6|3|5. karmeṇa: nirapekṣasya saṃyogavibhāgau phalam, abhighātāpekṣasya ca vegārāvya: saṃskāra:, tathā ava- yavasaṃyogapekṣasya avayavadravyamapi iti vadanti |
su. pṛ. 843, karmaṇa: pūrvāparībhūtaniścayasvarūpatvāt nityatvaṃ na saṃbhavati iti kūṭasthanityatābhāve'pi nityavidhiviṣayatvena pravāhanityatvam |
pṛ. 116. karmeṇa: pṛṣṭhaśabda: syāt tathābhūta- deśāt |

' yathaiva hi ekadeśāvasthitān vṛkṣān ālocya vanamiti samudāyabuddhirbhavati, evam ekakālyukakarmasamudāyanāmadheyabuddhiḥ |
pṛ. 480, \ nahi upastikāvye asti karmaṇāṃ prakaraṇam, phalasaṃbandhottarakālatvena kathambhāvātmakasya prakaraṇasya prayogavākyādhīnaprasūtatvāt |
2|2|5|15, \ karmaṇi aguṇotpattau tatraiva guṇaḥ, saguṇotpattau tu prakārāntareṇa cāvidhīyamānānekaguṇasaṃgatau sarvāṃnta- ratvam iti |
2|1|1|25 pṛ. 539, \ karmaṇi adhikāraḥ aviduṣaḥ asamarthasya ca nāsti |
4|4|1|5 pṛ. 485. \ karmaṇi adhikāraḥ nāsti anyapadyavā- deśaktasya |
6|1|3. \ karmaṇi apagacche saṃskārāpāyāt amayo laukikāḥ saṃpadyante |
saṃkarṣa. 3|2|9. \ karmaṇi api kārakasmṛteḥ kārakatvenaiva kriyā'nvayaḥ |
cici. pṛ. 435. \ karmaṇi avihite guṇavidhāna- manarthakam |
oṃ karmaṇyārambhabhāvatvāt kṛṣivat pratārambhaṃ phalāti syuḥ |
kāmpye karmaṇi pratārambham ārambhaāramme iti pratārambham |
ārambhabhāvatvāt ārambhena karmaprayoge phalaṃ bhāvyate janyate |
kṛṣivat catuṣpadyamaivaiḥ kṛperāvṛttau yathā phalāvṛttirbhavati tadvat |
sarveṣāṃ kāmyānāṃ karmaṇāṃ punaḥpunarapi kāryatvāt anuṣṭheyatvāt viśeṣaḥ adhikāraḥ adhikaḥ phalasaṃbandhaḥ upapadyate |
kāmyaṃ karma sakṛdeva kartavyaṃ syāt sakṛdvidhāne sakrakaraṇe ca codanāyāḥ kṛtārthatvāt kartuśca adhvat ekasmin prayoge yathā ajñāni sakṛdeva kriyante, nāmyasanne tadvat |
loke śabdārthaḥ śabdasya arthaḥ tathaiva bhavati |
adhiyā saṃprayoge yathākāmaṃ pratīyateāśruti- tvād, vidhivu vacanāni syuḥ |
arthenaḥ karmaṇaśca saṃprayoge saṃcanne sati yathākāmī yathākāmabuddhiḥ pratīyate anuṣṭhāne |
yadi ca niyamena sakṛdeva kartavyaṃ bhavet, tataḥ 'teṣāṃ ye prathamaṃ yajeran teṣāṃ gauratirāmaḥ, ye dvitīyaṃ teṣāmāyuḥ,' ityādīni gadyāni vidhiṣu vacanāni nirarthakāni syuḥ |
athavā kāmyakarmavidhāyakāni vacanāni vidhiṣu syuḥ karma vidhāya kṛtārthāni, sakṛttve asakṛttve vā udāsīnāni |
ajñānāṃ pradhānānāṃ ca upadeśakaḥ eka eva śabdaḥ apekṣayā sarvapyajñāni gṛhṇāti |
loke karma arthalakṣaṇam arthena prayojanānusāreṇa lakṣyate |
kāryavaśāt sakṛdyuktaḥ asakṛdāharati, sakṛdā- harati nāharati vā |
prakṛte tu śabdalakṣaṇe karmaṇi yathā- śabdārthe pravṛttiryuktā |
tasmāt kāmye karmaṇi phalabhūyārthī asakṛt pravartata iti siddhāntaḥ |
\ 'karmaṇyārambhabhāvatvāt ityadhikaraṇe' 'sakṛt syāt kṛtārthatvāt' iti guṇasūtre kṛtayāgasya ātmana eva phalam iti kalpanā uddāya nirākariṣyate |
kṛ. 2|1|2|3. \ karmaṇi upakrānte tadasamāmya nahi karmāntaramārabdhuṃ yuktaṃ vacanābhāve |
saṃkarṣa. 3|1|7. \ karmaṇi ekena (adhikaraṇena dravyena vā) avaccheda na anyat saṃbhavati |
vā. 2|1|5|16 pṛ. 507. \ karmaṇi ekasmin ekārthānāṃ guṇānāṃ vikalpaḥ yathā brīhiyavayoḥ |
bhā. 12|3|4|10-15, \ karmaṇi ekasmin bhinnakāryāṇāṃ guṇānāṃ samuccayaḥ |
12|3|12, \ karmaṇi guṇabhūtā devatā yājyā'nu- vākyādyena karmasiddhayarthamupalakṣyate |
bāla. pṛ. 44. \ karmaṇi tṛtīyā kārakavibhaktirūpā viniyoktrī śrutiḥ |
yathā 'yavāgavā juhoti' 'pitrā pitaraṃ vā saṃjā- nīte' |
pṛ. 44, \ karmaṇi caturthī kārakavibhaktirūpā viniyoktrī śrutiḥ |
pṛ. 44. \ karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī kārakavibhaktirūpā viniyoktrī śrutiḥ yathā 'jagataḥ kartā', 'citramagopena gavāṃ dohaḥ' 'dharmajijñāsā' 'brahmajijñāsā' |
yo hi avidvān nāsau adhikṛtaḥ, sāmarthyābhāvāt |

mīmā. \ karmaṇi yasya vaidikasya vidhavantasya liṅgaṃ kiñcit śabdagatamarthagataṃ vā vaikṛtyāṃ karmacodanāyāṃ tadguṇavākye vā dṛśyate, tatra sa vidhavantaḥ syāt |
\ 'karmaṇi vyudyate prajñā svasthe ko vā na paṇḍitaḥ' iti nyāyaḥ |
svasthe prakṛtasthe jane ko vā janaḥ paṇḍito na, sarva eva pāṇḍityaṃ darśayatītibhāvaviṣaye'sya pracāra iti |
\ karmasu utsargaṃ svayaṃ kuryāt śeṣamanyaḥ kuryāt |
vi. 3|1|8. \ karmasu deveṣu udayagayanaṃ pūrvapakṣaḥ ahaḥ puṇyāhaḥ kālaḥ |
6|3|124, \ karmakarāḥ karma kurvāṇāḥ pādikamapi ahaḥ labhante, phalaluptaṃ naiva jñāyate |

bhāṣṭa. 3|7|8. \ karmakartari ākhyāte kartṛvādeḥ bhāvanāyāmevā- nvayaḥ |

viśeteraiva ṛtviktvaṃ tathāpi 'samadaśa ṛtvijaḥ' iti nusāreṇa śaknyaiva kṛterupādānāt |
iti cet anvayaḥ iti vyaktaṃ kaustubhe |
jyotiṣṭome adhvaryuḥ pratiprasthātā neṣṭā unnetā, brahmā |

kutaḥ ? vāko grāvastut, udgātā prastotā pratihartā subrahmaṇyaḥ, |
'saumyasyādhvarasya satadaśa sadasyaḥ iti saptadaśa, camasādhvaryavaśca daśa, śamitā upa- |
ṛtvijaḥ' iti vākyasya prāk paścāt vā sarve sapta- gātāraḥ somavikrayī ceti bhūyāṃsaḥ puruṣāḥ |
viṃśatisaṃkhyākāḥ nādhikṛtāḥ noktāḥ, yānadhikṛtya 'sata- bhyāmanye yāgānuṣṭhāne upayuktaḥ jñātāḥ pūrvagranthāt |
saṃkhyā kīrtyate tatra aparāyāṃ saṃkhyāyāmāvayulaya- śabdo bhāvārthake yatpratyaye cā''tmanepadaṃ buddhau ca |
na ceha tathā, tasmānnāya- karaṇāt sarveṣāmṛtviktvam |
iti samāse vibhaktilopasyaivābhāvāt na tasya saṃbandhā- bhidhāyakatvasaṃbhavaḥ |
na caivaṃ sati ṣaṣṭhīsamāsocchedaḥ, padadvayasyāpi samānādhikaraṇatayā karmadhārayaprasaṅgāt iti vācyam |
yatra luke vinaiva sāmānādhikaraṇyam, tatra karmadhārayaḥ ityupagamāt |
na caivamapi rājapuruṣa ityatra rājā cāsau puruṣaśceti vigrahaḥ syāt |
rājaśabdena rājasaṃbandhinaḥ puruṣasya pratipādanāt rājñaḥ puruṣa iti vigraho na syāt |
samāse ṣaṣṭhyabhāvāt samāsāntabhūtasya ca vigrahavākye prayogāyogāt iti vācyam |
kathaṃ tarhi rājñaḥ puruṣa iti vyākhyātaro'pi vigṛhyate iti cet |
tat siddhaṃ ṣaṣṭhīsamāse niṣādaśabdasya lakṣaṇā''pātāt karmadhāraya eva samāsaḥ |
ato niṣādaḥ eva sthapatiḥ adhikriyate iti |
yatra ṣaṣṭhyarthalakṣaṇayā vinaiva sāmānādhi- karaṇyam, tatra karmadhārayaḥ |
yatra tu ṣaṣṭhyarthalakṣaṇayā sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ tatra ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ |
