na ca mantrālapatvam, daṇḍakalitavadāvṛttisaṃbhavāt karmabhyū- stavādhikaraṇanyāyena ( 10|1|25|8-84 ) svasthānavibhraṣṭairvā saṃkhyāpūraṇasaṃbhavāt |

'āgneyo- 'ṣṭākapālo hiraṇyaṃ dakṣiṇā, aindra ekādaśakapāla ṛṣabhau dakṣiṇā, vaiśvadevaścaḥ piśāṅgī ṣaṣṭhīhī dakṣiṇā, maitrā- varuṇyāmiṣkā vaśā dakṣiṇā, bārhaspatyaścaraḥ śitipṛṣṭho dakṣiṇā' iti dakṣiṇābhedāt, dakṣiṇāyāśca kartranyatārtha- tvāt kartṛḥvādhiṣṭhānadravyasye'pi prayogābhūtakartṛbheda- dvārā pratiyāgaṃ prayogamedāvagatiḥ |
su. pṛ. 912, karmabhedaḥ na 'āśrayatvena gṛhṇāti yo guṇaḥ prakṛtāṃ kriyām |
vā. 2|1|12|17 pṛ. 553, karmabhedaḥ na utpattivākye dravyaviśeṣānuktau |
vi. 2|1|10 karmabhedaḥ na 'tathā na micyate karma kāṭhakādisamākhyāyā |
maṇi. pṛ. 6, karmabhedaḥ śabdāntarāt 'yajati, juhoti, dadāti' iti yāgahomadānāṃ bhedaḥ |
vi. 2|1|2, abhyāsāt 'samidho yajati, tanūnapātaṃ yajati, iḍo yajati, barhi- ryajati, svāhākāraṃ yajati' iti yajatipadābhyāsāt prayājānāṃ pañcānāṃ bhedaḥ |
2|1|2, 'evaṃ vidvān paurṇamāsī yajate' 'ya evaṃ vidvānmāvāsyāṃ yajate' iti prakaraṇabhedāt yāgabhedaḥ |
3|1|6, 'athaiṣa jyotiḥ, athaiṣa viśvajyotiḥ, athaiṣa sarvajyotiḥ' iti tāṇḍyavākyasye saṃjñābhedāt karmabhedaḥ |
'prājāpatyaṃ mano'grahaṃ gṛhṇāti' iti daśamamahaḥ aṅgīkṛtya grahacodaneṣā, gṛhṇāti iti saṃskāravidhānāt |
( tasmāt mānaso grahaḥ ) mī. ko. 173 daśamamāho guṇasya vidhiḥ syāt, nāharantaracodanā |
bhā. 10|6|13|18 karmabhede pratikarma mantra āvartanīyaḥ yathā āmanahomādau |
karmamadhye na kamantaram ‘apa vā etadyajñasya kiñcate yadanyasya tantraṃ vitate anyasya tantraṃ pratāyate’ iti kramabhede doṣaśravaṇāt |
‘abhidhānaṃ ca karmavat’ pradhāna-karmaṇa iva nābhidhānaṃ bhavati dvitīyāsayogena ‘pradagaṃ śaṃsati’ ‘niṣkevalaṃ śaṃsati’ iti |
satre ṛtvijā-meva yajamānatvāt yathā varaṇarūpaṃ karma na prāpnoti, evaṃ gavādivadānamapi na prāpnoti svasaṃpradānaphalyasaṅgeḥ |
tathā ‘na chātra gaurdīyate, na vāsaḥ’ ityādiḥ pratiṣedho'pi na prāpnoti |
jyotiṣṭome vapanādisaṃskārāḥ yājamānāḥ syuḥ ‘keśaśmaśru vapate, dato dhāvate’ iti saṃskāraphalasya yajamānagāmittvena yajamāna-pradhānatvāt |
karmavat yathā pradhānakarmāṇi puruṣāśrāni yajamānasya bhavanti tadvat |
yathā vapanādibhyo'nye padārthāḥ yasmin vede āmrātāḥ tatsamārakhyatena puruṣeṇa kriyate, tathā jyotiṣṭome vapanādisaṃskārā adhvaryuṇā kartavyāḥ adhvaryuṇā kartavyāḥ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
3|8|2|3. karmavidhīnām adhyayanasiddhaviśopajīvitvameva, na tu svayaṃ vidhāprayojakatvam |
nanu dehānāṃ pārthivatvamātraiḥ ṛgveda-dīnāṃ vyāpakapārthivatvanivṛtyā vyāpyadehatvanivṛtyāpyamāt nāmabhiḥ (vedānāṃ) adhiṣṭhānaṃ yuktam ityādiśakya āha— deheti |
pṛthivīparamāṇvādīnāṃ dehaprakṛtibhūtānāṃ dehārambhairvicityāt dehānāṃ bhinnāḥ prakārāḥ |
tataśca śuddhāyāḥ pṛthivyāḥ ka cit dehaprakṛtibhāvāt bāhulyasya ca bhūtāntareṣvapi bhāvāt dehatvasya pārthivatvena vyāptirasiddhā iti parihārāśayaḥ |
su. pṛ. 1009. karmaśabdāḥ bhavanti ke cit, na māvārthaḥ |
ke cid bhāvāthīḥ, na karmaśabdāḥ yathā bhavanaṃ bhāvo bhūtiḥ iti |
bhā. 2|1|1 pṛ. 386. karmaśabdaṃ laukikāḥ kārye'rthe prayuñjate |
bṛhatī. pṛ. 27. karmaśeṣasya uktvākye pratiṣedhavidhānena prati-saṃvatsaraṃ bhinnānām eva uṣṇamānāyanam |
mā. 11|2|1|134-56, karmaśeṣatvapakṣe dravyasaṃskāraḥ prayojanavān, anarthakastu puṣadhamaṃ |
3|4|8|123. karmaśeṣabhūtāthaisaṃskārakatvasaṃbhave karmopa-kāritvāt mantrāḥ prayoktavyāḥ, nānyathā (dvitīyasūkta-vādhikaraṇādhyāyasya svarūpamidam ) |
bhā. 3|4|15|26. karmasaṃskārapakṣe hūyamānasaṃskārapakṣe vā tadbhedāt medo bhavet (sarvapṛṣṭheṣṭhī sviṣṭakṛdisya ṣaṭsu indreṣu ) |
bhā. 10|6|12|133. karmasiddhi vinā prayogaparicchedāsiddheḥ prayoga-paricchede sādhite karmaṃ sādhitam |
su. pṛ. 856. karmasvarūpatena dravyadevatākriyam avadhārya yajurvede sakalamāmanāyate |
vedāntare tu kriyāmātraṃ saṃkīrya stotraśastrādīni paṭhyante |
maṇi. pṛ. 414. karmākhyātesthale saṃkhyāyā anvayaḥ : ‘saṃkhyāyā api tibādyuktāyāḥ’ iti vindo draṣṭavyaḥ |
ke. 1|2|131-53 (vi). karmādayaḥ arthaprāptāḥ, te na bhavanti śabdasya abhidheyabhūtāḥ |
bhā. 3|4|14|3 pṛ. 927, karmā-disaṃnipātaḥ mantrāṃntena ādhāre darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ |

‘yadyat phalabhūtaṃ tattat utpattimatonantaram’ iti sāmānyataḥ tantvādi saṃbo-gādi ca avayavini saṃbandarśana sati deśāntaraprāptiṃ kādācitkī phalabhūtām avadhārya utpattimataḥ prāgbhāvi kiñcidanumīyate |
na ca dravyameva upacitamat iti śakyāvagamam |
na ca dṛṣṭaviru-dhanumānam avirodhini saṃbhavati iti yuktam, tasmāt dravyātireki karma anumīyate |
nanu nāmumeyaṃ karma, kintu rūpidravyasamaveta-cākṣuṣameva, ‘gacchatyayam’ iti pratīteḥ indriyavyāpārāyat-tvāt |
tathā ca tantrāntare sūtram ‘saṃkhyāḥ parimāṇāni pṛthaktvaṃ saṃyogavibhāgī paratvāparatve karma ca rūpidravya-samavāyāccākṣuṣāṇi’ (kaṇādasūtra 4|1|11) iti |
ākāśasya atīndriyatvāt tena saha saṃyogasya vāyuvanaspatiyogavat apratyakṣatvāt liṅga-bhāvāt patatsu patatriṣu ‘patati’ iti buddhineṃ syāt |
ayocyate, vihāyasi vitataistaraṇakiraṇaiḥ saha saṃyoga-vibhāgī pratyakṣī liṅgamiti, tanna |
sāndrāndhakāre niśīthe jhaṭiti taḍiti sphurantyau calatīti pratīteḥ |
api ca saṃyogavibhāgī gamye gantari ca staḥ |
tābhyāṃ cet karma anumeyam, gantarau tadbuddhiḥ gambe'pi syāt |
tataśca saṃyogādupaste karmaṇi vartamānāvābhāso na syāt |
vighuti tu medhāvayava-saṃyogavibhāgaliṅgānumitā calanakriyā iti nānuppattiḥ |
na cedaṃ viparītamāpādayituṃ śakyate gamyakriyaiva gantari phalaṃ prastutamiti uttara-deśasaṃyogasya gantari kriyā'ntarāṇāmasapatteḥ |
deva-dattagatā tu kriyā pūrvapradeśena vibhāgam uttaradeśena saṃyogaṃ cārabhate ityupapannam |
tasmāt kriyākṣaṇāṃ saṃtānanimittaḥ eva ‘ayaṃ calati’ iti vartamānatā'vasāyaḥ |
tena kṣaṇā-ntare naṣṭe'pi kṣaṇāntare anāgate'pi prārabdhāparisamāpta-tvāt ekaphalavacchinnasya kriyāsaṃtānasya vartamānatā nānuppannā |
saṃbhavāti ca phaloddeśena uttarakṣaṇaparamparāgataḥ eṣā pratītiḥ |
kriyā pūrvāparībhūtā lakṣyate vartate tā !!’ iti (ślovā. sphoṭavāde 79) |
saṃyogaḥ saṃyoginyeva kārya-mārabhate yathā avayavinam avayavasaṃyogaḥ |
saṃyoga-vibhāgī ca kevalamāśrayasamavetau, anāśraye'pi deśe samavāyāt |
na ca tatra ayaṃ niyamo dṛṣṭaḥ ‘svāśraya-meva phalamārabhate’ iti, tasyāpūrvatvāt |
taduktam 'nahi te pratyakṣāḥ' iti (bhā. pṛ. 77 paṃ. 3) |
kimarthaṃ tarhi 'deva- dattasya gatipūrvikā deśāntaraprāptimupalabhyāditye'pi gatismaraṇam' ityuktam ? (bhā. pṛ. 37 paṃ 1) deva- datte'pi anyametvāt |
devadatte tāvat ātmasaṃyogātirekiṇi anumite tasāmānyāt āditye- 'pi gatirevānumīyate |
etaduktaṃ bhavati, sarvatra cetane vā acetane vā gatireva deśāntare prāptau nimittamiti |
bhā. 12| 2|5|63-66. \ karmāntaram aveṣṭeḥ 'yadi brāhmaṇaḥ' ityādinā vi
tatra hastau praveśaya adhvaryuryaja- mānamāha 'kimatra' iti |
vā- 'nyapadeśādityevām' ( 3|8|5|14 ) ityatra brāhmaṇagatamudāhṛtam iha tu prastāvavaśena mantragatam |
taddhi kleśena kalpyamānaṃ kadā cit ubhayorna śakyate kalpayitum ityāśaṅkā syāt |
atha kasmāt nobhāveva prayujyāte , yadā ekenāpi prayujyamāna: śakkotyeva ubhayāmi phalaṃ prakāśayituṃ tadā siddhe'ye na kiñcidbhayakartṛkatvena prayojanamasti ityadhurṇiyama: |
śā-vi-bhāṭṭeṣu maṇḍana-śaṃkarayośca 'karmāthe tu' 'nyapadeśācca' iti adhikaraṇadvayaṃ svīkṛtam |
vi- 'mā mā saṃtāmamityetat kasmin , svāmini pūrvavat |
, ādhvaryavaṃ tu tat tena svāmikarmopa- yogata: |

bhāṭṭa- yatra tu 'mā mā saṃtāsam' ityādī itikaraṇaviniyukte ca asaṃtāpanādirūpaṃ phalam ṛtvig- gāmine'pi ṛtuvirodhisaṃtāpanivartakatvā tadupayogi tatra 'yajamānasya sā' iti ṣaṣṭhyā: paraṃparayā'pi upapatte: liṅgānurodhāt ṛtvigāmyaiva |
ikāra: prakṛti:, yakāro vikṛti: iti upadiśanti pāṇinādaya: |
asya śabdasya kartṛbhūmnā uccārayitṛbāhulyena vṛddhi: mahattvaṃ dṛśyate |
tatra praśnottarakāle darśanaṃ śabdasya anityatve gṛhyate ca samam |
śabdānityatvasādhakasya pūrvapakṣokta dvitīyasya heto- nirāsārthe siddhāntasūtram |
viṣayaṃ śabdaṃ prati abhivyañjakasya śrotrāde: anāgamāt āgamābhāvāt saṃcandhabhāvāt sataḥ vidyamānasyaiva nityasya śabdasya adarśanaṃ aśravaṇaṃ yuktam |
śabdānityatvasādhakasya pūrvapakṣokta tṛtīyasya heto- nirāsārthe siddhāntasūtram |
param anyat kāraṇaṃ yaduktaṃ karotiśabdāt iti, tat na śabdasya, kintu śabda- prayogasya |
'śabdaṃ mā kārṣī:' śabdaprayogaṃ mā kārṣī: ityartha: |
tathā ca karotiśabdo'pi prayogaviṣayakatvāt na śabdasya anityatvaṃ sādhayati |
'sattvāntare ca yaugapadyāt' iti pūrvapakṣasūtroktaheto- nirāsārtham idaṃ siddhāntasūtram |
āditya eko'pi san yathā nānādeśeṣu nānājanairyugapadupalabhyate, tathā nityasya ekasyāpi śabdasya nānādeśeṣu yaugapadyaṃ syādupalabhyata: |
tasmāt nānādeśeṣu yaugapadyena upalabhyate'pi na śabdasya anityatvaṃ medo vā sidhyati |
prakṛtivikṛtyośca iti daśamasūtroktaṃ śabdānityatvahetuṃ nirākaroti siddhāntī |
ata eva 'iko yaṇaci' ( pā0 6|1|77 ) iti ika: uccāraṇa- prasaṅge yaṇ uccārya: |
aci pare ityeva nyācakṣate vaiyā- karaṇā: |
'vṛddhiñca kartṛbhūmnā'sya' iti suproktaṃ śabdānityatva- hetuṃ nirākaroti siddhāntī |
parā parastāduktā yā nāda dhvane: vṛddhi: sā na śabdavṛddhi: kintu nādavṛddhi:, dhvanibhi: śabdo mahān iti bhrama: |
nādavṛddhi: śabde āropitā na śabdavikāratvena sādhayituṃ śaknoti |
nahi uccāritasya śabdasya nāśe anyasmāt artha- pratīti: saṃbhavati |
parārthatvāt śabdo na naśyati, nitya: śabda: iti jñāyate |
aṣṭakṛtva: gośabda uccarita: iti vadanti, na tu aṣṭau
tathā ca śabde saṃkhyāyā abhāvāt śabdabhedo nāsti|
tacca nityatvaṃ vinā na ghaṭate iti nityaḥ śabdaḥ|
paṭādiṣu tantuviogāt tantuvināśācca kāraṇāt anityatvaṃ jñāyate|
nahi gakārādiḥ śabdaḥ sāvayavaḥ yena avayavanāśādinā vinaṣṭaḥ syāt|
tathāca śabdasya vāyukāraṇakatvapakṣe kāraṇībhūtavāyavīyavayava- saṃyogasya prātyakṣikaprakhyāyā abhāvāt na vāyukāraṇa- katvaṃ śabdasya iti na anityatvam|
yogyasya śrotrendriyapratyakṣaviṣayasya śabdasya vāyuvikāratve pratyakṣāyā abhāvāt śrotrendriyajñānaviṣayatvasya abhāva- prasaṅgāt na tasya vāyavīyatvaṃ tasmāt nityatvam ityarthaḥ|
śabde vāyavayavasaṃyogasya anupalabdheḥ na vāyukāraṇakaḥ śabdaḥ|
yogyānāṃ vāyavayavayānāṃ prakhyāyāḥ upalabdheḥ abhāvāt ityarthaḥ|
nanu vāyuṃ pratyakṣaḥ kintu tadīya eva sparśaḥ sparśanapratyakṣaḥ|
'vāyuṃ spṛśāmi' iti pratīyatayā pratyakṣatvāt sparśamātropalambhasyāpi saṃbhavāt|
na ca śabde anu- dbhūtasparśakalpanāyāṃ doṣa iti vācyam|
liṅgaṃ ca evaṃ bhavati 'vācā virūpanityā' iti|
anyaparaṃ idaṃ vākyaṃ vāco nityatām anuvadati|
vigataṃ rūpaṃ yasyāḥ iti karturahitā ityarthaḥ|
'karmake tatra darśanāt' ityadhikaraṇe (1|1| 6|16-23) vedaprāmāṇyasiddhayarthaṃ śabdanityatvam ākṣipya samādhīyate|
'gharṣabhirhaḥ karṣati' ityatra ṣaḍḍhalopādānasāmarthyāt karṣateḥ prayojakakartṛtvaṃ yathā, tathā 'yo'śvaṃ pratigṛhṇāti' ityasyāpi prayogasya nirvāhaḥ|
'na kallakṣaṃ bhakṣa- yitavyam, na laśunam, na gṛñjanaṃ ca' iti|
tatra saṃdehaḥ kimvejātīyakaṃ phalakāmena na bhakṣayitavyam, niṣkāmena ādyam, athavā niyogato varjayitavyameveti|
kutaḥ 1 niyamo hi ayamyucyate, idaṃ na bhakṣayitavyamiti|
evamukte dvayāpatti, yadi vā abhakṣaṇaṃ kartavyamiti, yadi vā bhakṣaṇaṃ na kartavyamiti|
yadi nañviśiṣṭaṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ kartavyamityabhyupagamyate, tataḥ abhakṣaṇaṃ śrutvā tabhyo vidadhāti|
atha nañarthaḥ kartavyaḥ tato vākyena vidhānam|
akurvato na phalaṃ na doṣaḥ, evamihāpi|
anyaddhi karma bhakṣaṇaṃ pratiṣidhyamānam, anyadakarma mānasaḥ saṃkalpa iti|
dup-- (pūrvapakṣamāha- 'na kallakṣaṃ bhakṣayitavyam' iti) tvanmatena pratiṣedho'yam, mama tu paryudāsa eva|
katham ? 'na kallakṣaṃ bhakṣayitavyam' iti upalakṣaṇatayā (pada-) śrutyā bhakṣyateḥ kartavyatāṃ tayo vidadhāti|
(ca śabdaḥ tuśabdārthe nakārastu iti) tasmāt (dhātvarthāviruddhāta kartavyatāvanavanāt) prayucyataḥ (nañ) anyena (śabdena) saṃcadhyamānaḥ: paryadāsaḥ (eva) bhavati|
(kenāsya tarhi saṃbandhaḥ iti vivekumāha-) tatra nārthaṃ kallakṣena (bhavyahitenāpi) saṃbadhyate|
kiṃ kāraṇam ? asamāmtvāt [asamastatvāt iti mudrita pāṭhaḥ] : suba- ntayoḥ : namāse sati paryudāso bhavati, na asamāse|
ataḥ (asamastatvāt) tasmāt (kallakṣaśabdāt) paryudastaḥ (prayucyataḥ bhakṣyati iti-) dhātunā saṃbadhyate|

tatra suvantatvātsamāso nāsti (na prasajyate ityarthaḥ) tasmāt (naño bhakṣyatinā saṃbandhāt, tadviśiṣṭasya ca bhakṣyateḥ vidhinā saṃbandhāt) abhakṣaṇaṃ kallakṣādiviśiṣṭaṃ (vidhinirjanayena svarga-) phalārthinā kartavyam|
tatra yadi ayam (nañ) svārthe- vṛttaḥ (sañ bhāvanā) saṃbadhyeta, tato bhāvanāvaiparītyena (virodhena) vartata (tadviruddhanivṛttipratipādanāt)|
tasmāt (svārthavṛttī) bhāvanāvirodhāt svārthe hitvā lakṣaṇāvṛttaḥ saṃbadhyate|
na ca kevalaḥ (nañ) lakṣaṇāṃ pratipatuṃ śaknoti|
tataḥ (arthaviśeṣalakṣaṇāsiddhayartham) dhātunā saṃbadhyate tenaiva nyāyena ('samāsābhāvāt na kallakṣasaṃbandhaḥ' iti uktena nyāyena) arthabhāvanā- mī. ko. 178
virodhāt tasyāḥ pratyutaḥ (nañ) anantareṇa dhātunā saṃbadhyate|
tasmāt abhakṣaṇaṃ nāma mānaso vyāpāraḥ (saṃkalpasya: phalārthinā) anuṣṭheyaḥ|
(kriyāṃ kurvan prathamaṃ tāvat saṃkalpaṃ karoti, taduttarakālaṃ tasyāṃ pravartate|
sparśanādikriyā (tu) viprakṛṣṭā, mānasastu saṃkalpaḥ (sarvakriyāsādhāraṇatvāt) anantaraḥ (sannikṛṣṭaḥ), ataḥ tameva (saṃkalpaṃ paryudāsavṛttiḥ nañ) āti- ṣṭhati|
evaṃ coditatvāt nāntarīyaḥ saṃkalpaḥ kriyācodanāyām (varjanacodanāyām) avinā- bhūtaḥ|

pūrvasmin pakṣe tu bhakṣyatinaye śrutyārthī bhakṣaṇasaṃkalpe sāmānyarūpe pratipādite nañā śrutiprati- pāditabhakṣaṇayudāsena sa eva saṃkalpo na lakṣyate ityevaṃ vidhiviśeṣarūpeṇa pratipādyate iti vivekaḥ|
punarapi prathamapakṣameva upasaṃkramāha-) yathā abrāhmaṇa- mānaya iti nañśabdena brāhmaṇajātereva abhāvaḥ kriyate, puruṣajāteḥ (ārthikyāḥ) nāmāva ucyate|
tasmāt yatra puruṣārthaṃ vidyate (kṣatriyādau) brāhmaṇatvaṃ paryudastam, sa ānīyate, evamihāpi nakāreṇa bhakṣaṇaṃ paryudastam (śrautam)|
yastu mānaso vyāpāraḥ (saṃkalpasyāpyaḥ sarvakriyāsu) anujñayataḥ, saḥ antaraṅgatvān (aparyudasta- tvācca) kartavyatāvanavanena saṃbadhyate|
yathā nodyantamādi- tyam īṣeta iti (atra saṃkalpavidhiḥ; evamatrāpi)|
iyāṃstu viśeṣaḥ, tatra (prajāpativrateṣu) śatrupratyayāt (hetoḥ) nodyantamityanena nimittamamīyate|
śāstrāṇāṃ svārthavattvena puruṣārtho vidhīyate, tayorasamatvāttvāt tādarthyaṃ viṣayatikramaḥ|
yuktaṃ yat prajāpativrateṣu śāstrāṇām arthavattvena puruṣārtho vidhīyate|
kathaṃ punaḥ prajāpatiteṣu niyamaḥ kartavyatayā cocyate iti ? ucyate |
vratam iti ca mānasaṃ kartuṃ ucyate 'idaṃ na kariṣyāmi' iti yaḥ saṃkalpaḥ |
katamat tat vratam ? 'noyantamādityamīkṣeta' iti, yathā tadīkṣaṇaṃ na bhavati, tathā mānaso vyāpāraḥ kartavyaḥ, tasya ca pālanam |
tatra ca etānyeva prakṛtya ucyate 'etāvatā hainasaḥ ayukto bhavati' iti, etāvatā kṛtena ayuktaḥ enasā (pāpena) bhavati iti |
iha kriyā pratiṣidhyate, na akriyā upadiśyate |
iha punaḥ ādityaṃ paśyan nātikrāmati vidhim |
yaḥ taṃ niyamaṃ karoti, sa phalena saṃvadhyate
pativrateṣu lakṣaṇā'ṅgīkāre'pi prakṛte lakṣaṇāyāṃ pramāṇā- bhāvāt pradhānānyatvasāmyābhyāttaivena nañaḥ abhāvavācakasya pratiyogitāsaṃsargeṇa bhāvanāyāmeva svakārakaviśiṣṭāyā- manvayaḥ |
puruṣe bhāvanā'nutpattā- vapi pratyayena tasyā eva bodhanena anyathātvābhāvāt |
ata eva niṣedhatve labdhaibhūtavyāpārasya na vidhi- vākye iva prayojyatvasaṃbandhena bhāvanā'nvayaḥ |
api tu nañastātparyagrāhakasya satrāt svaprayojyābhāvapratiyogi- tveneti tasya nivartanā rūpatvasiddhiḥ |
kalañjabhakṣaṇabhāvanā nivartanāviṣayaḥ iti tu mūlānusāreṇaivaḥ nañtrahitasya liḍādernirvartanāyāṃ lakṣaṇāsvīkārāt |
svaprayojyatve ca pravṛttabhāve pravṛttiviṣayasya aniṣṭasādhanatvajñānaṃ vinā anupapattiriti tasya pratyayāyajanakatvaṃ kalpyate |
ata eva ca pratyayāyasambandhībhūtasyānuṣṭheyasya bhakṣaṇasya rāgata eva jñātatvāt tadanuṣṭhāne sati prayojyatva- patterna tadaṃse tanniṣedhāṃśe vā adhyayanavidhisiddhajñānā- pekṣā'pi |
yattu atra nivartanāpakārakathanaṃ prakārāntareṇa tannaratne kṛtam, tat arthādadhikaraṇe kaustubhe eva nirastam |

' bhāṣyakārādibhiḥ prajāpativratasya ṛtvarthatvamā- śaṅkya paryudāsatvamaṅgīkṛtya puruṣārthatvamaṅgīkṛtam, tadapi kalañjabhakṣaṇapratiṣedha-hiraṇyadharmādhyāyena ṛtvarthatva- śaṅkā''nupapattepekṣitam |
' ṛtavo hi svasaṃbandhino vidhipratiṣedhau apekṣamāṇāḥ tadatikrame sati viguṇā bhavanti |
ye puruṣagatā vidhipratiṣedhāḥ, te ṛtvantaragatā iva asya sadasyandyayor- viśiṣṭāḥ |
nahi teṣu guṇabuddhirupapannā, yenātikrame vaiguṇyabuddhiḥ syāt |

ke. kalau adharmabhūyiṣṭhāḥ sarve bhaviṣyanti alpīyasā- 'pi dharmeṇa bhūyānabhyudayo bhaviṣyati ityādibhaviṣya- tkathanasya prayojanaṃ yugasvabhāvinibandhasya dharmādharmānuṣṭhāna- vaicitryasya phalapākavaicitryasya ca jñānam |
yathobhiriḥ, tayorapi kulāya- yaśe adhikāraḥ rājapurohitayoḥ |
mā. 6|6|12-19, kalpaḥ yeṣāṃ vaiśamitraṇa samānaḥ; teṣāmeva satre'- dhikāraḥ |
6|6|12-19, kalpāḥ ( pakṣāḥ ) yatra bahavaḥ śrūyante, teṣāṃ kaścicchuḥ, kaścit guruḥ |
tatra guroḥ kalpasya anuṣṭhānānāmasāmyāt tadanuṣṭhānāta phalabhūyastvamanumīyate |
yathā, ' ekā deyā, ṣaḍ deyāḥ; dvādaśa deyāḥ; caturviṃśatideyāḥ' iti |
kalpasya (vedāṅgasya) śālā'ntarasaṃbandhidhivyupa- saṃhāradvārā nyāyalabhyātparyanirṇayadvārā ca vedopa- kārakatvam |
kalpanaṃ ca tadviruddhapratyakṣaśruto vākyaśeṣo nirupādhi ityādimetam aktādhikaraṇārthanirṇaye ( 1|4|13 ) |

yathaiva āsapralayāt ' idamita paṭhyate' iti kathitam uccāritaṃ ca śiṣyāḥ pratipadyante, tathaiva sūtrakāravacanānya adhyāpakavacana- sthānīyāni sānurūpavedavākyasamarpaṇāmātraṃ kṛtvā nivṛtta- vyāpārāṇi, iti na tātvādidhvanipreraṇavat pauruṣeya- tvena paribhavitavyāni |
' vā. 1|3|14 pṛ. 187, kalpa- sūtrāṇām ' tasmād varṣasahasre'pi yasya na jñāyate'- vadhiḥ |

kalpasūtrāṇāṃ brāhmaṇārthā- nuvādakatā avasthīyate, ' hotṛvaṣaṭkāre carmā nīyante udgātṛbrāhmaṇe yajamānasya ' iti bhakṣaṇāthai nayanamuktvā kenādau bhakṣyaṇīyam ityeṣāyām ' teṣāṃ hotā'gre bhakṣayet' iti pratijñāya ' tasya vaṣaṭkārānyatvāt ' ityādibhiḥ ' vaṣaṭkartuḥ prathamabhakṣaḥ ' ityādibrāhmaṇoktairhetubhirvyākhyāna- darśanāt |

tathā ' prāsya ghṛtaṃ saṃset yatha ha vā idamato vā rayo vā'vakto vartate evaṃ haivākto vartate' ityādibhiḥ ghṛtaprāśanādiviśeṣabhūtairbrāhmaṇaiḥ ' nācā mediti vijñāyate, devarayo vā yad hotā, nākṣamadriḥ kalpānīti' ityādi- vākyaiḥ |
kalpasūtreṣu arthavādādimiśraṇā- 'ntaraviprakīrṇa-nyāyalabhyavidhupasaṃhāraham arthanirūpaṇaṃ yat, tat pramāṇamaṅgīkṛtam |
lokavyavahārapūrvakā vā cit ṛtvigādibhirvyavahārāḥ sulabhārthahetvatvena āśritāḥ |
vā. 1|3|12 pṛ. 167, kalpasūtreṣu kṛtvyapuruṣārthaṅga- pradhānapratipādanaṃ prayojanam, vedaśca mūlam |
arthavādamantra- miśrāṇāṃ vidhīnāmupasaṃhāro vivikīkaraṇaṃ śāstrāntaravipra- kīrṇānāmekatra saṃniveśaḥ |
ye tu kalpasūtreṣu ṛtvigādīnām ' ko yajaḥ ' ityādi- praśnottarādivyavahārāḥ teṣāmanuṣṭhānasaukaryādimūlaṃ prayo- janam |
kalpa- kārā nibadhnanti sarva eva vikalpitān |

( kalpasūtrasya ) ṣaḍviṃśabrāhmaṇe jarābodhīyayajñāyajñīyoḥ prāyaṇīyā''gniṣṭomasāmyaika- lipi vidhānena sākṣāt visaṃvādadarśanāt, apicā nānāgotrāḥ syuḥ ' ityādiḥ ( kalpasya ) tanūnapātkṣā- śaṃsakalpāyavaiguṇyāya ' samānakalpanāmeva satre'dhikāraḥ ' iti vedotthena nyāyena visaṃvādadarśanāt kalpasūtrāṇāṃ vedādeva anutatvāvagatiḥ |
māśakama, hāstikam, kauṇḍinyakamityeva lakṣaṇakāni kiṃ pramāṇa- mapramāṇaṃ veti saṃdigdhāni |
kiṃ prāptam ? prayogasya śāstraṃ pramāṇam evaṃjātīyakamiti brūmaḥ |
ye eva hi vede mantrāste eva vede iṣṭakāstā eveha |
pratyakṣataḥ prāmāṇyamanavagata- miti yadi ucyeta, pramāṇāntareṇa vacanena avagatamiti na doṣaḥ |

tatra sakala- pratyakṣavat apratipāyaṛtuprayogopanibandhanāt antarhita- viprakīrṇameyeprāyaśrutismṛtigranthanebhyo mahāneva kalpasūtrāṇāṃ viśeṣo'sti na tattadantāyāṃ vyavasthāyā prāmāṇyaṃ vijñāyante |
pūrvapakṣe, na taduktaṃ kalpa- sūtreṇa śakyate ||
' smṛtadhikaraṇe (1|3|1) cāprāmāṇyaṃ mūlānupapattyā pūrvapakṣe abhidhāya anumitaśruti- mūlatvena prāmāṇyaṃ sthāpitam |
etāni ca na trodā- hṛtāni pūrvapakṣahetvasaṃbhavāt |
' yadi dharme prati smṛtīnāṃ prāmāṇyamabhyu- gamyate tathā sati ' tāsāmapi hi vedatve tairvā tulyapramāṇatā |
' mantrabrāhmaṇayorveda iti nāmadheyaṃ ṣaḍaṅge'ke iti aṅgānyapi vedaśabdavācyāni smaryante |
yathā ' utpādād tathāgatānāmanutpādād sthitavaiṣāṃ dharmanityatā ' iti |
kāmaṃ na praviśeda grāmaṃ vārito daṇḍapāṇibhiḥ |
' evametāni calyāryapi vicāranāni ekāmārgapatitāni kalpasūtravicāreṇa gataprāyāṇi bhaviṣyantīti manvānena tadupanyāsamātrameva kriyate |
prayogaśāstraṃ tāvat āha sma tallakṣaṇa- yam ||
' nanu na pauruṣeyatvādeṣāmetadubhayamanupapannam, ' naiteṣāṃ pauruṣeyatvaṃ bhaviṣyati hi vedavat |
' yathaiva kaṭhadiproktāḥ śālāḥ kāṭhakādisamākhyā abhīyante iti akṛtrimāḥ sthāpitāḥ; tathaiva vedasamāmnātamāśakādi- samākhyātagranthaniyatā'pi praletyatā |
yathā sāmasūktā- nām idamasya ārṣam idamasya iti satyāmapi tanni- chāyāṃ samākhyāyāṃ na nityatvapratighātaḥ |
tathāhi, ' na tāvadupaniḥ kaścit smaryate kalpasūtrakṛt |
kartṛtvaṃ yatsvīṇāṃ tu tat sarvaṃ mantrakṛtsamam ||
' yathā ' śaiśavaṃ bhavati, śiśurvā aṅgiraso mantrakṛtāṃ mantrakṛdāsīt ' ityatra mantrakṛcchabdaḥ prayoktari prayuktaḥ; evaṃ tattyasya kalpasya sūtrasya vā prayokkāraḥ tatkāritvena nyapadyante |

brahmayajña- vidhāne ca ' evaṃ vidvān svādhyāyamadhayīta ' ityuktvā tatpadye ' yahno'dhīte yadyajūṃṣi yassāmāni yadbrāhmaṇāni yaditihāsapurāṇāni yatkalpān ' iti tajjapyamānatvena vidhānāt ārṣatvameva vijñāyate |
aruṇa- parāśaraśākhātrāṇām ca kalpakalpatvāt sarvayāśakaiśca svaśākhādyātiriktakalpasūtrāropaṇasattvabalatvā- dhyayanāt kalpagranthānāṃ ca itarasamāmnāyātītatvat ṛtuviniyogāśrayaṇāt tulyatvam |

' lāṭyāyanasūtrakārābhyāmapi ca dṛḍhakalpaprāmāṇyāpekṣayā idaṃ māśakamapekṣya ' tatratyakṣa- vihitaṃ ca ārṣakalpena, tatrānumānaṃ na vidyate ' iti brāhmaṇavihitādapi ārṣakalpavihitagarīyastvamaṅgīkṛtyo- ktam |
kātyāyanena ca kṛtākṣaṇasūtrapraṇayanaprakrame'mi- hitaṃ yajñaviṣayabrāhmaṇagatastotravidhivivākyaśeṣe ' yathāmāśakaṃ tanprāmāṇyaṃ kariṣyate, na tannirapekṣaśuddhabrāhmaṇa- prāmāṇyāt ' iti |

tathā ca prāyaṇīyā'gniṣṭomasāgni yajñaśrīyane saha vaikalpakam ' jarābodhīyamagniṣṭomasama kāryam ' iti pañcaviṃśabrāhmaṇe amitamapi māśakānuvṛttyā kātyāyanena ārmevīyagāyatratṛtīyatvena ' jarā sāt ' iti likhitam (jarā jarābodhīyam, sāttu ārmevīyagāyatrāt param ityarthaḥ) |
ārmevīyagāyatrīgatagāyānantarasānno hi tena samiti saṃjñā kṛtā |
tasmācca paratvena padaka- deśaprayogena jarābodhīyamuktam, deśabdena ca jyotiṣṭomi- kāgniṣṭomasamasaṃjñabhūtaṃ yajñaśrīyameva agniṣṭomasama- tvena niyatam |
yadi ca kalpāt brāhmaṇamatiriktaṃ kātyā- yano'maṃsyata tataḥ pratyakṣabrāhmaṇaṣṭaṃ vikalpamevāvakṣyat |
ajñānāṃ ca praṇetāra ācāryā ṛṣayo matāḥ ||
' yānyapi aprayathitapuruṣavacanāni pramāṇāntarasaṃgatāyāni bhavanti, tānyapi satyatvena avadhāryante, kiñca punaḥ satyavācāṃ vacanāni |
' satyavācāṃ ca vākyāni vaidikaiḥ saṃgatāni ca |
' apica ' vedāhate'pi kurvanti kalpaiḥ karmāṇi yājñikāḥ |
na tu kalpai- rvinā ke cinmantrabrāhmaṇamātrakāt ||
' tulyaṃ ca sāmpradāyikaṃ svādhyāyayajñavidhivacanaṃ prāk darśitaṃ kalpa- grahaṇāt |

jijñāsā'the tattaddeśabhāgacihnalekhyani ghaṭikāyāṃ kumbhamārgāyāṃ niścitya tattaddeśabhāgaparīkṣākāle tānyā- kṛṣpa ākṛṣyalekhyacihnitaṃ paṭhanti adhyetāro'nuyuñjate iti ghaṭikāmārgavartino'nuyogāḥ iti) |
' kiñca ' karmaṇāṃ brāhmaṇātproktānāṃ yathā mantrāḥ prakāśakāḥ |
vedaṃ hi kalpa- yitavyaiḥ punastathāpi nityata |
na tat kṛtakatāṃ labdhvā labhate nityamūlatām ||
vedārthe ca vijñāto vedārthe: mādhyeyat phalam |
na hyatena smṛtaṃ karma sidhya- tīyavadhāraṇāt ||
yujyate hi mati: kartuṃ na mūlāntarakalpanā ||
tenārthāṃ dharmaśāstrāṇāṃ na vā dharmopa- yogitā |
na ca saṃdihyate buddhirna viparyayate kacit ||
vā-- ' evaṃ prāpte vadāmo'tra tannāsanniyamā- diti |
pareṇa saha keṣāṃ cid vākovākyāni jalpatām ||
tanmātre'pi ca bhūyiṣṭhā micchanti: satya- vāditam ||

yādṛśatāhamīmāṃsakairāpi atīndriyaviṣayapuruṣavacana- prāmāṇyanirākaraṇāt apauruṣeyatvādhyavasāyanirākaraṇa- doṣaśāstranirapavādaprāmāṇyasiddhi pratihantumaśakyāṃ manya- mānā nissarībhūtā bālānuraṇavākyasadṛśai: svavākyai: nyavaliṣyamānahṛdayā: santo'pi pravīṇabuddhetvacanajālā: kanyāvaraṇārthagatamūlarvargotrapraśnottaravat |
buddhivoṣyaṃ trayādanyat saṃskṛte kṣaṇikaṃ ca tat ||
' tathā śabde'pi buddherniyamāt nābhinyakkirde'pi doṣāt ityevamādibhi: sarvadā padārthasambandha nityatvapratipādanāt tadiparitam āgama nityatvam abhyupagamyamānaṃ lokopa- hāsāspadamātrameva bhavet |
paṭaṃ kartuṃ samīheta, sa hanyād vyoma muṣṭibhi: ||
( dāśami: kāṣṭhai: upakalpite ) hetvābhāsāpranirdainthe tasmistad veśma duṣkaram ||
tat yasya śabdārthasaṃbandhānāmanityatvam, tasya tadāśrayavyavahāra- nityatvaṃ kimādhāraṃ bhaviṣyatītipada: saṃpādam |
tenānityaśabdavādinām āgama- nityatvānupapatte: atīndriyaviṣayasya vākyasya prayoga- śāstratvābhāvāt nāsanniyamādityucyate |
' mama vi hi bhikkhave kamma vacchasī save ' |
tathā ' ukkhitte lodagmi uvuve athiya kāraṇam, paḍaṇe ṇatthi kāraṇam, anubhave kāraṇam, ime sakkaḍā dhammā, saṃbhavanti sākāraṇā, akāraṇā viṇassanti |
aṇuppattikāraṇam-anutpatti- ( mama vi-mama api, hi, bhikkhave-bhikṣo:, kamma-karma, vacchasī-varttate, save-sarvam |
' vedeṣu hi tāvadeva padārthasaṃbandhātātmaka- tvādihelāmāsai: kṛtakatvabhrāntirbhavati |
' yā taddi- ravasthānād vedarūpaṃ na dṛśyate |
kimālocya ka vā dṛṣṭvā cāku praticchandamī- dṛśam |
racayet puruṣo vākyaṃ kiṃ codiya prayo- janam ||
agne: purohitatvaṃ ca ka dṛṣṭaṃ yena kīrtyate |
na jātyā devatvaṃ hi ka cidasti vyavasthitam |
avidyātaguṇānāṃ ca kalpate stavanaṃ na tu ||
vāyuśabdena bahuvacanāntena mātṛviryogayamāna ekaiko vasto'midhīyate iti naitat buddhipūrvakakāriṇā cintitaṃ śakyam |
' ko nāma buddhipūrvakārī puruṣa: athīmidhānaparāṇāṃ ṛgakṣarāṇāṃ lokevyākaraṇadiṣu anavagatapūrvameva agne ityasya padasya akāramokāreṇa vikuryāt |
ko mūḍho buddhipūrvo vā niyamyāt kalpa- yiṣyati |
kiñcideva tu tadvākyaṃ sadṛśaṃ laukikena yat |
evaṃ ca tatra adhyetāro'dhyāpayitāraḥ pārśvasthā vā vedapadavākyatadartharūpāṇi ālocayanti, tadā khasaṃvadevameva apauruṣeyatvamapyavasyanti |
tāvatā tu bāhyatārkikāṇāṃ pratīyamānā nopayate iti tattvapratipādanakṣamavedotthā- pitanyāyopanibandhanatvāt mīmāṃsakaiḥ kevalaṃ yaśa eva pītam |
śākyādigrantheṣu punaryadapi kiñcit sādhuśabdamātreṇa avinaṣṭabuddhyā prayuktam, tatrāpi prasaṅgisiddhisupayatā-
'tasmād dvayaṃ vācā vadati satyaṃ cānṛtaṃ ca, pāpmanā hyeṣā viddhā' |
( vā-su-ya-ku-pāṭho'yam ) bhāṣyam-- yaccoktaṃ satyāvāmetāni vacanānīti, tanna |
ācāryavacanaṃ hi bhavati 'pūrvapakṣe sarvāsu tithiṣu amāvāsyā' iti, saṃnihitaṃ ca śāstram 'paurṇamāsyāṃ paurṇa- māsyā yajeta' 'amāvāsyāyāmamāvāsyā yajeta' iti |
ataḥ 'sarvo'parapakṣaḥ pūrṇamāsasya' iti kalpasūtramidaṃ middhiṃ nirvapanti-kurvanti ṛtvijaḥ, etasya yajamānasya |
pratyakṣaśrutivirodhāt aprāmāṇye kathamudāhṛtaṃ bhāṣya- upakrāntaṃ yajño vicchidyate-triguṇaḥ syāt |
kātyāyanasūtre sarvaparodāśānāṃ caturthakaraṇavacanam 'āgneyaṃ vihitaḥ, tamu amaye pathiṣkṛte kuryāt, tena pathiṣkṛta- |
caturthaṃ karoti' iti pratyakṣaśrutivirodhāt 'śeṣastu guṇena panthānam-kālatikramataḥ pracyāutaṃ svargasya panthānaṃ |
guṇasaṃyuktaḥ sādhāraṇaḥ pratīyate' iti tṛtīyapādīyā- punaravaiti-prāpnoti |
iha upāsanāsu pradhānaṃ phalabhājā sākṣādeva kartavyam iti prāgeva darśanāt virodho'sti |
parimala. 3|1|134-45 brasū. yatra hi guṇā- nurodhino'pi pradhānasya na bādhaḥ tatraiva kāṃsyabhojinyāyaḥ |
ku. 1|4|1920, aktāḥ śarkarā upadadhāti tejo ghṛtam' ghṛtaniyame hi na viśyuddeśo viruddho arthavādo'pya- nugṛhyate |
ataḥ kāṃsyabhojinyāyena viśyuddeśasya pradhāna- syāpi guṇabhūtārthatvādānusāreṇa ghṛte saṃkocaḥ |
ākhyātasya utpattiprayogayodāsīnatayā nāmnā prasiddhāgnihotrapratyabhiśāne utpatteḥ pratirodhāt kāṃsya- bhojinyāyenāpi ākhyātasya prayogavidhaparatā sidhyati |

ābharaṇaṃ. 3|1|1425 brasū. utpattividhe- maṃtreṇa vinā aparyavasāne'pi prayogavacanāt mantrasya nityagrahaṇān, anena mantreṇa prakāśitaṃ paśumālabheta itye- mumyorekavākyatāparyavasānāt mantrānurodhe'pi vidhivākya- virodhābhāvāt kāṃsyabhojinyāyena vidheyachāgaviṣayatvam |
kāmaśrutiḥ sarvāṅgopasaṃhārasamartha- 'pi upapannaiva tatrāvirodhāt kāṃsyabhojinyāyena tadanu- rodhena agniṣṭutiḥ |
kāmipadaṃ hi kāmopādhinā pratipuṣṭhavatsvividhirodhena samaye niyamya- mānamapi na virudhyeta kāṃsyabhojinyāyena |
tathayā upādhyāyaḥ pradhāno nityaṃ tattvātprabhojī, śiṣyastu apradhānaḥ kāṃsyapātre eva bhuṅkte |

tatra pravṛttilaghavāt ekasmin pātre upādātye yadi pradhānopādhyāyānurodhāt yatkiñcit pātramupādīyeta śiṣyasya bhojanaṃ na saṃpadyeta, kāṃsyapātre tu upādīyamāne nāniyatapātrabhojana upā- dhyāyasya bhojanavirodhaḥ |
tenāvirodhena pradhānamapi guṇānu- rodhāt niyamyate eva iti tadanurodhena aṅgavidhivādho aṅgavidhipravṛttiḥ iti |
guṇānurodhena ka cit pradhānanayanam iti kāṃsya- bhojinyāyena sūcyate |

dadhyupasecanasya iṣyamāṇatvenāgatasya bhojyavyañjanātha- tvenaidhamānatayā ' ṣāṣṭhikān payasā bhuñjīta ' iti vyañjanārthapayaḥsāhacaryeṇāvadhāraṇārthāt bhojanaprayuktatvena tadabhāve'nuṣṭhānāsiddheḥ kāṃsyabhojinyāyena upasecana- niyamāt śālibhojananiyamāvate |
' dhāryaṃ gataśrāya āhavanīyaḥ ' iti sarvakarmārpaṇa dhāraṇena ākṣitam uddharaṇaṃ kāṃsyabhojinyāyena agni- hotropakārakatvā mantrakamevākṣiṣyate |
prakaraṇānugrahe vākyasyātyantatvābhāvāt kāṃsyabhoji- nyāyena atra prakaraṇānugraha eva yuktaḥ ityādi nirastam |
pradhānatvādeva ca guṇa- dravyābhyām ( āruṣyaikahāyanībhyām ) dravyāntaraguṇā- ntarākṣepaṃ kathaṃ niruṇaddhi |
kāṃsyabhojinyāyena vā amukyo'pi aniyamaṃ vārayet, kimuta mukhya eva san |

brahmagataphaladātṛtva- pradhānatvayoḥ karmasviva ādityopāsane'pi saṃbhavāt kāṃsyabhojinyāyena laukikanyāyānugṛhītatvamamuk ( utkṛṣṭa- dṛṣṭirhi nikṛṣṭe'dhyavasthitatayā yadā dṛṣṭaḥ iti laukiko nyāyaḥ |
) kalpataruḥ 4|1|45 brasū., yajña- mānagamitā phalasya sākṣātkartṛkatve parikrītātvikartṛkatve ca upāsīnānāṃ saṃbhavati |
tataḥ sā kāṃsyabhoji- nyāyena liṅgadarśanamanugrahītuṃ parikriyadvārake kartṛtva- māśrayati |
3|4|134-45 brasū. viśyuddeśā- jhale'pi upakramate'rthavādena dhātuviṣayatve'vadhārite viśuddeśasya viṣayāvadhāraṇe vyāpārābhāvāt kāṃsyabhoji- nyāyena arthavādānurodhavṛttivirodhāmāśaṅkaya... |
sāmano gulle'pi tadanusāreṇa'pi tuca- śāstrasyopapatteḥ atyantānupapadyamānaguṇānusāreṇa kāṃsya- bhojinyāyena tūcaśāstravarṇanameva yuktam iti saṃśaya- viśeṣadoṣaparihārārthe samāstveva gamanam |
somāpauṣṇau caro yadi pūṣānurodhena māgatataramapi kāṃsyabhojinyāyena piṣyeta, ekasyāmeva sthālyāṃ pacyeta, tarhi māgatasakarāt anyadīyāmāge'nyasmai dīyamāne vaiguṇya- māpadyeta |
hīnayamanavidheḥ samāna- jātīyadharmāsthale śāstrā''ntarāyogāt nidhanāntarasyāvṛtti- phalakatve'pi hīnapranidhanamuktavijātīyadharmāsthale tasya bṛhadrathatyāgācciphalatvamapi kāṃsyabhojinyāyena na
ata eva yatra na kāṃsyabhojinyāyaḥ yathā kārīryādau, tatra na tasya vyudharyatā vyāvartyate |
ayaṃ nyāyo''dhulopamā- laṅkāramīmāṃsāyāṃ dharmopamānavācakaluptopamodāharaṇe 'yattyā melanaṃ tatra lābho me yaśca tadate |
'abhavat kiṃ bravīmi te' iti vā pāṭhaḥ |
iti padyaṃ prayuktādataḥ apyadīkṣitaiḥ kuvalayānande ihāvāto |
veṇīsaṃhāranāṭake tu, 'phalanti kākatālīyaṃ tebhyaḥ prājñā na cintyati' ityatra aniṣṭā- vāsau udāhṛtaḥ |
tena kākāgamanamiva tāla- patanamiva kākatālimiti 'samāsācca taddhitāt' ( 5|1|106 ) iti jñāpakādityarthe samāsaḥ |
ityarthe samāsābhāve taddhitādityanena ivārthaviṣayasamāsānuvādasya anupapannatvāt tajjñāpakatvamiti |

ubhayatra kākagamanatālapatanayo- rūpameyaṃ krameṇa svasya ciddhamanaṃ tatraiva rahasi tanyā avasthānam, tena ca kākatālsamavetakriyāparayoḥ kāka- tālapadayoḥ ivārthasamāsena svasya tathāsamāgamaḥ kāka- tālasamāgamasadṛśa iti phalatīti |
tādṛśasamāsānantaraṃ ca kākatālimiva kākatālīyamiti dvitīyasminnarthe 'samā- sācca taddhitāt' iti sūtreṇa 'ive pratikṛtau' ( 5|1|116 ) ityadhikārasthena chaḥ pratyayaḥ |
tathā ca patanadalitaṃ tālaphalaṃ yathā kākenopabhuktam, evaṃ rahodarśanaṃkṣumitahṛdayā tathā svenopabhukte tadarthaḥ |
ayaṃ nyāyaḥ 'samāsācca taddhitāt' iti sūtramahābhāṣye- 'pi vyākhyāta |
yadyapi 'samāsācca taddhitāt' iti sūtreṇa ivārtha- viṣayāt samāsāt ivārthena chapratyayena niṣpāditaḥ kākatā- līyaśabdaḥ upamādvayamarthaḥ |

tathā ca kākatālayoriva yāha- cchiko dasyudevadattayoḥ samāgamaḥ ityekāsamāthopamā, tadānīmeva pattā tālena kākasyaiva dasyunā devadattasya vadhaḥ kṛtaḥ ityanyā taddhitārthopamā ceti yatropamādvayaṃ tatraivāsya śabdasya saṃpūrṇārthatā, tathāpi yāhacchikasamāgamamātre'pi asya pracuraḥ prayogo dṛśyate |
yathā ṛtumatīnāṃ yoṣitāṃ kāsāṃ cit kasmiścit garbhadhāraṇaṃ ityādi |
yathā 'kākebhyo dadhi rakṣyatām' ityukte kākapadaṃ dadhyupaghātakamātallakṣakam, evaṃ yatra tātparyavaśenetarārthaparatvaṃ tatrāsya pravṛttiḥ |
tathā cāha, ' kākebhyo rakṣyatāmamiti bālo'pi coditaḥ |
kākasya dantāḥ santi na vā, teṣāṃ saukyaṃ na veti vicāro yathā niṣphalaḥ, evaṃ yatra tatrāsya pravṛttiḥ |
gardabhe kati romāṇi vyarthā tu vicāraṇā |
kākanilayanam anamidhīyamānamapi devadattagṛha- śabdasya syārthamidadhat cihnabhūtāṃ pratipadyate |
' kākaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pikaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ ko bhedaḥ pikakākayoḥ |
prāpte vasantasamaye kākaḥ kākaḥ pikaḥ pikaḥ |
'kākamāṃsaṃ śunocchiṣṭaṃ svahapaṃ tadapi durlabham' iti nyāyaḥ|
kākasyaikameva cakṣurindriyaṃ golakadvaye'pi cākṣupapratyakṣopajanane hi upakārakaṃ bhavatīti|
'na veti vibhāṣā' (1|1|44) iti sūtrasthaḥ itiśabdaḥ kākākṣigolakanyāyenābhyāṃ saṃvadhyate|
neti niṣedhaḥ, veti vikalpaḥ, vibhāṣāyāḥ saṃjñīyate|
kiñcoktaṃ munīśvaraiḥ 'avirodhisukhe buddhiḥ svānande ca gamāgamī|
kāśīkhaṇḍaḥ. rāmānaṃdaḥ. 5133, 'rasālayaṃ rasāle-stauraukaiḥ śokāharaṇam' iti mūlam|
kākākṣinyāyena tacchabdasya ubhaya saṃvandhāt taiḥ aśokaiḥ śokarahitaḥ śokāharaṇaṃ brahmaloke (saptamasūtrasya) samāptiḥ|
anantarasūtre vipratipatyu-pāttavirodhābhāvokteḥ anugapujyamānatvāt, iha ca prakārāntavirodhābhāvasya avaśyavaktavyatvāt upayogasadbhāve'-'pi ca kākākṣivat anuṣṭheya tantreṇa vobhayasaṃvandhāt|
vā. 1|3|17 pṛ. 198. 'māturniṣṭe rajjisa, prattāsu bhaginīṣu ca|
' (nāradaḥ 1413 gha. ko. kāṃ. pṛ. 1152) atra 'prattāsu bhaginīṣu ca' iti kākākṣivat rajoramaṇa-nivṛttaviśeṣaṇam|
ityatrāharamayaḥ 42. nakāraśca abhidheya- bhāvanoktibhyāṃ dvābhyāmpi kākākṣivat saṃvadhyate|
anena sudhāgranthena 'prādhānyenātra ('odanaḥ pacyatāṃ tvayā' iti vākye) nopāttā dhātunā odanakriyā|
mā bhūt tasyaiva kartṛtva-mabhidheyaṃ na bhāvanā|
' iti vārtikaśloke (pṛ. 917) caturthacaraṇe 'na' iti śabdaḥ 'abhidheyaṃ' iti padena ca saṃvadhyate iti pratipāditaṃ dṛṣṭāntena|
'varāṭakānāṃ daśakadvayaṃ yat sā tu kākiṇī' iti|
pathena vivṛto'yam, yathā- 'bhidyante bhrātaro dārāḥ pitaraḥ suhṛdastathā|
kathamabhūtāḥ ekāsinadhāḥ eke ekāprāṇāste ca te āsinadhā atipriyāścetyarthaḥ|
yathā maṇikācayoḥ parīkṣā-kāle evāyaṃ kāco'yaṃ maṇiriti niścīyate, evaṃ yatra vivakṣā, tatrāyaṃ pravartate|
uktaṃ ca- 'maṇirluṭhati pādeṣu kācaḥ śirasi dhāryate|
kākṣikādinā'pi anyena aślenāpi dadhyabhāve payo ghanīkriyate|
kāṭhakam agnihotraṃ yena śrutaṃ nāsau kadā cit taittirīyake śṛṇoti|
(śṛṇvapi vā svaśāstrasyaiva prati-pannatvāt taittirīyakepratipattavyamevaitat iti kalpayitvā na punaḥśrutiṃ manyate|
tacca rūpādyabhedāt etat karma, na śālā-bhede'pi karma bhidyate|
' yadyapi kāṭhakāderjāteḥ nitya-tvāt nityavyākhyā, tathāpi pravacananimittaiyaṃ syaṃte|
3|3|1 pṛ. 804, 'tathā na bhidyate karme (parasmaipadāt) minuyāt iti adhvaryuḥ|
evamapi prakṛtena arthinā saha ekavākyatā yajamāne kāmayamāne minuyāt iti|
kāṭhinyaṃ nāma na guṇāntaram, apitu avayavānām aviralaḥ saṃyogaḥ|
tatra dakṣiṇata ārabhya udagapavargān madhyamāsu sthūṇāsu audumbarī yajamānasaṃmitā, itarā audumbarīsaṃmitāḥ |
tāsāṃ paścāt purastācca yāḥ sthūṇāḥ, tāḥ paryantasthūṇāḥ |
tāsu nāmi- dadhyaḥ iti niye pramāṇam |
vṛddhikāmasya tu audumbarī- mapi nīcaiḥ kṛtvā sado mātamyam |
atra samākhyāyāḥ vacanānuguṇāt na bādhaḥ iti pratyavasthānāt saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu kāmo'pi tathā yājamāna eva arthena kratuphalena yajamānasya nityasaṃyogāt, tadarthe nityaguṇasya prayojyatve tatra parakīyakāmyaguṇānavakāśāt iti |
adhvaryoḥ svāmino vā, SS yo vākyānmātu, sāducyate |
pratīyatā'to vākya- cāpe tapovat svāmino''stu tat |

bhāṭṭa-- ye guṇajanyāḥ kāmāḥ 'yadi kāmayeta varṣukaḥ parjanyaḥ syāditi nīcaiḥ sado minuyāt' ityādayaḥ te mānādyāśrayasya tāvat ādhvaryavatvāt tatsāmānādhikaraṇyācca kāmayateḥ tatsamānakartṛkatvapratīteḥ adhvaryuniṣṭhā eva |
ata eva yatra 'drendriyakāmasya' ityādivaiyadhikaraṇyam, tatra yajamānagāmitmeva, praiṣā- khyasya homasyādhvaryavatvāt |
iti prāpte, 'minuyāt' iti jitaḥ parasmaipadanirdeśāt adhvaryubhinnakartṛkatvāvagateḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyagrādhena yajamānameva |
yatrāpi 'yo vṛddhikāmaḥ sa saubharena stuvīta' ityādau na parasmaipadam, tatrāpi na udāttagāmitm, ṛtvikmānānugraheṇa yajamāna- phalasādhanībhūtaguṇavāgāditānupapatteḥ |
atastatra sāmānā- dhikaraṇyamātrameva ca prayojakakartṛtvābhiprāyeṇaiva vyākhye- yam |
ata eva yatra na nityaguṇavādhaḥ, vādhe'pi vā sākṣādeva vacanam, tatra svāmibhinnagāmitme'pi na kṣatiḥ; yathā 'ātmane vā yajamānāya vā yaṃ kāmaṃ kāmayate tamudgāyet' iti |
atra pṛthagyajamānapadaśravaṇāt vā- śabdaśravaṇācca ātmanepadena udāttatvocyate |
'tam' ityanenomaya- niṣṭhaṃ vaikalpikaṃ kāmaṃ parāmṛśya udgeyatvavidhānācca na vākyabhedaḥ |
'gāyateśca' 'gāyanti yaṃ sāmagāḥ' ityādī arthābhidhāne'pi prayogācca kāmarūpasyasya udgeyatvavighātaḥ |
anusamayaḥ paścāt saṃgatiḥ ; 'iṇ gatau' iti dhātuniṣpannatvāt anusamayaśabdaḥ |
tataśca eṣa paśoḥ kutsnopakāraṇādipadārthavarge kṛtvā parasya tathā kartavya- mityarthaḥ |
ekaikasya pradhānasya saṃnipatyopakārakāṇḍaṃ kṛtvā itarasya kartavyam ityevaṃ kāṇḍānusamayaḥ |
aneka- sahasrāśvapratigrahe tantrānuṣṭhānam iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
yāvataḥ ityanena aśveyattā ucyate, tāvataḥ iti puroḍāśeyattā |
ekatra nimittavattā, aparaṃ naimittike- yattā, vāruṇān iti devatāsaṃbandho vidhīyate, katarena atra (eṣām) sāhityam (vidhīyate) ? |
) yathā prayājānuyājānām (ekakratuprakārayojanānāmapi) na tantreṇa itikartavyatā (kintu prayājaprayogaṃ sāṅgaṃ samāpya anuyājaprayogaḥ) evamihāpi |
(yeṣāṃ tu prayājānuyājānāṃ tantreṇa itikartavyatā' iti pāṭhaḥ, nan na paṭhyate, teṣāmayamarthaḥ, itikartavyatāśabdena
ṛtupakāra ucyate, yathā prayājādīnāṃ bhinnaprayogāṇāmapi eka eva ṛtuprakāraḥ prayojanaṃ bhavati, evamihāpi |
devatā hi anena ucyate (na tatra bahutvaṃ vivakṣitam |
kiñca vāruṇān ityatra-) bahutvaṃ śrūyamāṇaṃ (vivakṣitaṃ sat) yāgabhedaṃ kuryāt, yathā prāpnuyān iti |
tatra eka- smin aśvapratigrahe bahavo vāruṇāḥ prāpnuvanti (na caitadiham) |
punarapi naivārita sāhityam (iti na cāyaparihāro ubhāvi upapattī iti) |

soma-- atra bhāṣye kāraṇādabhyāvṛttiḥ iti sūtraṃ bahuṣu puroḍāśeṣu yathā kāṇḍānusamayaḥ evamihāpi iti pūrva- paśoktadṛṣṭāntavaiṣamyakathanārthatvena vyākhyāya bahuṣu puro- ḍāśeṣu api uktanyāyena padārthānusamayaṃ prāpya pradhāna- lopaprasaṅgāt kāṇḍānusamayaḥ iti adhikaraṇāntaraparatayā'pi vyākhyātam |

yadyapi aśvadāne nimitte catuṣkapalā- dvirvidhīyate, tatra yāvataḥ iti vivakṣyate'pyolabdhabhūta- nimittasyatāpratipādanenaiva naimittikeyattāḥ avagatatvāt avagataviṣayatayā 'satrādudavasāya pṛṣṭaśamanīyena yajeran' ityatra bahutvavat catuṣkalatvasya avivakṣitatvāt avivakṣitatvācca ekasmin dvayoḥ vā aśveyatte datteṣu tāvatsaṃkhyā vāruṇeṣṭiḥ kartavyā iti vākyārthaḥ |
tathā ca sāhityasya avivakṣitatvāt na sahaprayogaḥ, kintu bhedena iti kāṇḍapadārthānusamayaprasaṅgeḥ idamuyuktam |
tathāpi sāhityaviṣayakaṃ vacanāntaramasti iti tantratvale samarthitam |
vi-- 'pratigrahe tu bahaśve pūrvanyāyo'sti vā na vā |
' bhāṭṭa-- yatra tu pradhānavirodhaḥ, yathā aśvapratigrahe'yāṃ śate vā sahasre vā aśvadāne tāvatpuroḍāśeṣu śrūyamāṇe yadi sarveṣāmadhiśrayaṇaṃ kṛtvā udāsanaṃ kriyata, daheran |

yattu atra vārtike nimittagatasya yāvattvasya avi- vakṣitatvāt naimittakagatasya ca tāvattvavadādeḥ pṛṣṭha- śamanīyanyāyena (10|2|13) anuvādyagatatvena aviva- kṣitatvāt sāhityasyobhayatratvābhāvena anekaiṣvapi aśva- dāneṣu pratyekaprayogeṇaiva vāruṇeṣṭikartavyatvāvagateḥ |
'satrādudavasāya pṛṣṭaśamanīyena yajeran' ityatra hi udavasānasamayānukartṛkatvabalena pṛṣṭhaśamanīye bahutvādeḥ prāptatvāt yuktā sāhityavivakṣā |
prakṛte tu nimittasama- saṃkhyākatvasya tāvacchabdārthasya naimittikaviśeṣaṇatayā aprāptasya vidheyatvāt yuktameva anekanimittatve'pi naimittikāsāhityam |
tāvacchabdābhāve hi yugapadekanimitta- saṃnipāte tantreṇa naimittikī iṣṭiriṣyate iti yukta eva tāvacchabdārthavidhiḥ |
yatrāpi hi puruṣārthatayā na kratvantaḥpātitvaṃ yathā yugapadekacaṇḍalādisparśādau anekagrahadāhādau ca, tatrāpi naimittikasya sakṛdanuṣṭhānam, kintu ṛtuprayogamaghyavartitadaśvadāne |

ataśca āgneyā- dimede'pi prayājādyaṣṭatantravat yugapadekapālamedane homatantratvavacca vāruṇeṣṭeḥ tantratvaprasaktau nimittasamasaṃkhyā- katvavidhānena tantratvapratītāvāpi ekaprayogavidhipari- gṛhītatvena sāhityapratīteḥ yuktameva udāharaṇatvam |
tatra ca ārādupakārakeṣu bahudhā prasaṅga eva |
ka cideva tu pradhāna- virodhe kāṇḍānusamayam |
puroḍāśamātre tu nimittasamasaṃkhyākatvaṃ prājāpatyavat iti draṣṭavyam |
vi. 2|4|2, kāṇḍaṃ nāma sāma vikṛtiviśeṣaśca prākṛtaḥ sāmno bādhakam |
kasyāpatyaṃ gotram ityasminnarthe 'gargādibhyo yañ' (pā0 4|1| 105) iti yajaṃ kṛtvā kātyāsya yañ ityasminnarthe 'yañiñośca' (pā0 4|1|109) iti phakpratyaye tasya ca āyanādeśasūtra (pā0 7|1|2) āyanādeśe
kute kātyāyanasya idamityasminnarthe 'ghuṭdācchaḥ' (pā0 4|1|144) iti chapratyaye tasya iyādeśe 'phakphiño-ranyatarasyām' (pā0 4|1|91) iti phakpratyayasya lukpakṣe kātyaḥ iti|
yakārākārāt parataḥ chapratyayaprāptau 'āpatyasya ca taddhite'nāti' (pā0 6|4|159) iti ākārādirvarjite taddhite pare apatyavācinaḥ yakārasya lopāt kātīyam iti rūpasiddhiḥ|
nitye hi asya naśabdasya yuṣmanta-śabdena samāsaḥ iti vārtikakāro bhagavān manyate saḥ|
tadyathā, kaścinkāntāre samupa-sthite sārthamupagacchate, sa yadā niṣkāntakāntaro bhavati, tadā sārthaṃ jahātīti|
tathāhi, 'saṃbandhamanuvartate' iti mahābhāṣyasthasaṃbandhamiti pratīkamādāya saṃbadhyate iti saṃva-dham, kameṇi ghañ, napuṃsakasābhidheyatvāt napuṃsakanirdeśaḥ|
ādeyagrahaṇāsaṃbaddhaṃ vṛddhigrahaṇām 'adeṅ guṇaḥ' (pā0 1|1|2) ityanuvartate, tena adeṅsmin saṃbadhyate|
iha tu anuvṛttamādaiccau jahāti kāntārottaraṇāya sārthasyeva tyāgopādāne iti|
'kāmaṃ hute saṃcaret, paścāddhi sa gataḥ' (homottaram agnīnāṃ madhyena kāmaṃ gacchet|
hi yasmāt saḥ āhavanīyaḥ paścāt gārhapatye gataḥ iti)|
'yaḥ kāmayeta parjanyaḥ' iti nīceḥ sado minuyāt' ityādiḥ|
bhā. 3|8|15|13-14. kāmaḥ vā nimittaṃ vā yado-tyadhate, tadā tannodito yāgaḥ kartavyaḥ|
tadyathā 'uśīnaravat madeṣu yathāḥ santi na santi iti, mātṛvat akṣāḥ santi na santi iti' iti mahābhāṣyam (6|1|34)|
tatra upamāne sattā asattā vā prasiddhā upameye pratipādyate iti yathāsaṃbhavaṃ vākyaśeṣaparikalpane kāmacāraḥ iti kaiyaṭaḥ|
nahi kaścit buddhipūrvakaṃ evaṃ kāmayate 'svargaṃ ātmānaṃ labhatām' iti|
vasantādiśrutibhiḥ prāptena ādhānā-kṣepasamarthāḥ iti āhitāgnīneva adhikurvanti|
kāmasaṃyoge jyotiṣṭome āśvinādergṛhya aindrāvāyavāt prāk pratikarṣaḥ kartavyaḥ|

kāmasaṃyoge 'aindra-vāyavāgrān gṛhṇīyāt yaḥ kāmayeta yathāpūrvaṃ prajāḥ kalperan' iti yatra kāmena aindrāvāyava saṃyogaḥ, tatra āditaḥḥ sarvāditaḥ aṃśorapi prāk pratikarṣaḥ syāt 'yaḥ kāmayeta' ityādirvacanāt|
kāmasaṃyoge'pi aindrāvāyavasya rahasya na sarvāditaḥ pratikarṣaḥ|
kintu taddeśānāṃ dhārādeśānāmeva agrasaṃyogāt agratāsaṃbandhatvāt tadyuktaṃ dhārā'gratāyuktaṃ kāmaśāstraṃ phalasya śāsanaṃ syāt|
nityasaṃyo-gāt atra kāmasaṃyoge'pi saṃyogaprayuktanyāyena nityasaṃyo-gāt aindrāvāyavasya dhārāgrahātpratayaiva kāmyatvaṃ nityatvaṃ ca saṃyogabhedena sesyati|
tasmāt kāmasaṃyoge'pi svakrama-sthasya grahaṇam, na sarvāditaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ|
atra agratā na vidhīyate, kintu tadanuvādena graha eva vidhīyate iti jñeyam|
yathā nāyakaguṇa-gaṇaśravaṇaprayuddhānānurāgā ca kana kāminī madanavihvala virahakleśamasahamānā madanalelā''valagnamanastvā niveda-nāni vidhatte|
tasmin avalokite'pi tadavalokanaṃ tadīyaguṇaparāmarśābhāve jana-sādhāraṇaṃ prāpte hṛdayaṃgamabhāvaṃ na labhate|
yadā tu pūrva-vacanāt tadīyaguṇaparāmarśaṃ karoti, tadā takṣaṇameva pūrṇabhāvamyeti|
evaṃ svātmani viśveśadharāmanā bhāsa-māne'pi tannirmāsanaṃ tadīyaguṇaparāmarśavirahasamaye pūrṇabhāvaṃ na saṃpādayati|
yadā tu guruvacanādinā sarva-jñatvasarvakartṛtvādilakṣaṇaparameśvaraparāmarśo jāyate, tadā tatkṣaṇameva pūrṇormitālābhaḥ iti|
sa. da. saṃ. pratya-bhiśādarśane dhvanito'yaṃ nyāyaḥ|
kāmādhikāre niyogo yāgasya kartavyatāṃ na vadati, phalata eva kartavyatāsiddheḥ|
kāmādhikāreṣu kāmyamānaphalasiddhiparyantatvāt śāstrasya na niyoga eva khasiddhayarthe puruṣaṃ prayuṅkte|
'plākṣaṃ prasravaṇaṃ prāpya agnaye kāmāya aṣṭakapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvapanti, tasyāmaśāṃ puruṣaṃ ca dhenukaṃ datvā prati yamunābhavabhayamayanti' iti sārasvate satre kāmeṣṭi-ruktā|
tatra ca aśvāṃ dhenukaṃ puruṣaṃ ca dhenukam, aśva-jātīyāṃ manuṣyajātīyāṃ ca dhenukaṃ dhayantīm arbhakāya dugdhadātrīṃ datvā iti ṛjvimbho dānamuktam|
iyaṃ kāme-ṣṭiñca sārasvatsatreṣu, satre ca dānaṃ nāstītyuktam ' tathāpi dānaśabdāt datvā iti dānavācakaśabdāt idaṃ parikrayārthameva syāt|
udavasīne karmaṇi yathā parikrayārtha-meva dānamityuktaṃ tadvat iti|
sārasvate satre vihitāyāṃ kāmeṣṭau 'tasyāmaśāṃ puruṣaṃ ca dhenukaṃ datvā' iti vacanaṃ bhavati|
kāmeṣṭeśca satramadhyapatitatvena satra-tvāt satrānnāt na tatra parikrayaḥ saṃbhavati|
vacanabalāt tu aśvajātīyāyā manuṣyajātīyāyā dhayanyāḥ dānaṃ dharmamātraṃ kartavyam ahyardham iti siddhāntaḥ|
kāmeṣṭau sārasvatsatratāyāṃ turaga-manuṣya-go-jātīyānāṃ dānamahyardhaṃ na tvānyatam|
hīṣ, ūrk, ū iti nidhanaviśeṣaniyamavidhiḥ phala-bhedena|
kāmanā ca viṣayasaundaryajñānāt svata evotpadyate, na tu vidhiśravaṇāt saṃpadyate|
vi. 2|1|12. kāmanā dvividhā sādhye sādhane ca|
sādhye ca mukhyā kāmanā, sādhane tu nāntarīyakau, sādhanena vinā sādhyāsaṃbhavāt|
tasmāt sādhane yā kāmanā sā gauṇī|
mā. 11|1|4|20-26. kāminaṃ hi adhikṛtya sāṅgatya yāgasya vacanam|
vi. 6|3|2. kāminaḥ svayaṃ phalasādhanāvacchinnabhāvanā- kāritvam śāstraphalaṃ prayoktari ' (3|7|8|18) ityuktam|
bhā. 10|6|4| 45-46. kāmināṃ svataḥ phale pravṛttatvāt tadarthitayaiva karmaṇi pravṛtteḥ ' na hiṃsyāt ' iti pratiṣedhāvirodhaḥ|
kāmyaṃ karma ārabdham, madhye kāme nivṛtte vā labdhe'pi vā samāpanīyameva, nindāprāyaścittayoḥ śravaṇāt|
vi. 6|3|3. kāmyaṃ karma kṛtvā''lopetaṃ kartuṃ yadā śaknuyāt, tadaiva kuryāt|
6|3|2. kāmyaṃ karme citrā''di sakṛdeva kartavyamiti niyamaḥ|
yaḥ svargaṣkādīn bhūyobhūyaḥ kāmyate, tena prayogāvṛttiḥ kartavyā|
4|3|2. kāmyaṃ nityāt naimittikācca balavat ' āsannapuruṣārtha- tvād viprakṛṣṭaphalatvāt|
balavattvaṃ śīghrakāritvāt kāmyaṃ naimittikādapi ' vā. 3|6|1|10 pṛ. 1033. kāmyaṃ nityāt prabalaṃ kāmasya śīghraṃ pravartakatvāt|
vi. 12|1|13. kāmyaṃ nityasya bādhakam agnicayane kāmyena vahyantareṇa utkhasya bādho yathā|
liṅgādeva agneḥ prakṛtyāśrayatvamapi prāpnoti puruṣārthasamā- satteḥ; kāmyaṃ nityasya bādhakam iti nyāyena phalārthatayā balavatastasya uttaravedibādhakatvāt|
' puruṣārthasamāsatteḥ kāmyaṃ nityasya bādhakam ' iti ' naimittike tu prakṛtau tadvikāraḥ saṃprayogaviśeṣāt ' (3|6|1|10) iti tṛtīyādhikaraṇavakṣyamāṇanyāyo'yam|
' puruṣasiddhayartho hi sarvaḥ prayāsa iti taprayāsacaṃ vastu balīyo bhavati|
' (vā. pṛ. 352) kāmyasya nityabādhakatve ayameva mukhyo nyāyaḥ; ' aviśeṣeṇa yacchāstram ' (10|8|8|16) iti daśādhikaraṇa- nyāyenāpi kāmyaṃ nityasya bādhakam|
su. pṛ. 488. kāmyaṃ nityasya bādhakam iti nyāyena kāmaprayoge camasasya (praṇayane) anaṅgatvam|
murāri. pṛ. 1184. kāmyaṃ nīcaiḥ sado mānamityādi asthiyajñe na kartavyam|
aniyata- phalakam ' citrayā yajeta paśukāmaḥ ' ityādi|
kāmyāni tu na vidhyante kāmājñānād yathetarasyānuccamānāni|
asthiyajñe ' yadi kāmayeta varṣeta parjanya iti nīcaiḥ sado minuyāt ' ityevamādīni kāmyāni na vidhyante, na kartavyāni|
yadā hi yajamānoktyā takāmasya jñānaṃ syāt tadā ṛtvijastat kuryuḥ|
astvāṃ tu kāmāsaṃbhavāt ṛtvijāṃ yajamānakāmasya ajñānāt tat kathaṃ kriyate|
yathā itarasya jīvato'pi yajamānasya kāmyāni tena anuccamānāni ṛtvibhiḥ kartuṃ na śakyante|
kāmyaḥ guṇaḥ nityamaye vikaroti, tat indriya- kāmādhikaraṇa-(2|1|1) godohanādhikaraṇā-(3|6|3) kāmyaḥ guṇaḥ 1441 kāmye karmaṇi
vā. 3|6|1|43 pṛ. 1067, kāmyaḥ guṇaḥ bhinnaprayojano'pi avāntarakāryatvāt virodhaguṇāttarajñānamithyātvāvadhāraṇasamarthaḥ|
kāmyaḥ guṇaḥ śrūyamāṇo nityamatha vikṛtya niviśate|
yathā godohaṇaguṇo nityaṃ camasasādhanakam apāṃ praṇayanaṃ vikṛtya niviśate, eva- mukhyaguṇe niyāmakamiṣṭo'sya saṃkhyāṃ vikṛtya''ntaravaṃ gamayati|
vi. 3|6|16. kāmyaḥ puruṣārthaḥ adhi- kārividhiḥ karmaphalasaṃbandhaparaḥ ' darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svarga- kāmo yajeta ' ityādi|
kāmyo vā naimittiko vā nityamartha vikṛtya niviśate|
iti nyāyāt anityādhikaraṇena niviśa- mānamapi na nityamaniyatayati|
bhāmatī. 3|4|132 ba. sū. kāmyo vā yathā adhvaryave mudrodanabhojanaṃ nivātatathyā ceti nityaṃ śayyāsanaṃ bhojanaṃ ca vikaroti|

yathā svargārtho'gniprayogo nityaprayogaṃ vikṛtya prayoga- syobhayatrāviśeṣān nityavidheḥ prayojakatvaṃ bādhitvā niviśate, yathā vā phalacamasaprayogo nityaṃ somaprayogaṃ vikṛtya niviśate kāmyanaimittikābhyāṃ nityakāryasiddheḥ|
kalpataruḥ. 3|4|8|32 na. sū. ' ucyate yo guṇaḥ kāmyaḥ kavyarthena na gṛhyate|

kavyarthe karma gṛhṇāti sa eva svārthasiddhaye ' vā 3|6|1|10 pṛ. 1035. kāmyāḥ sāmidhenīkṛtyāḥ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ ' ekaviṃśatimanu- brūyāt pratiṣṭhākāmasya ', ' ekaviṃśatimanubrūyāt anna- kāmasya ', ' javiṃśatimanubrūyāt brahmavarcasakāmasya ' ' drāviṃśatimanubrūyāt pratiṣṭhākāmasya ', ' ṣaḍviṃśatimanu- brūyāt paśukāmasya ' ityevamādayaḥ tatra yāvaduktamabhyasya ( ādyantyoḥ virāgutti kṛtvā ) avaśiṣṭānāmā- gamane saṃkhyā pūrayitavyā|
bhā. 10|1|8|26-33. kāmyena agnihotraprayogeṇa nityasya agnihotra- prayogasya prasaṅgasiddhiḥ|
bāla. pṛ. 132, kāmyena nityasya aṅgaprasavo yathā pratiṣṭhā''rthasya ekaviṃśatyanu-
pṛ. 149. ' kāmyena nityasya bādhaḥ ' iti ' uvāyāṃ kāmyanityasamuccayaḥ ' (12|4|17-25) ityadhi- karaṇasya nyāyaḥ|
ke. kāmyena naimittyasya aṅga- prasaṅgo yathā pratiṣṭhā''rthasya ekaviṃśatyanuvacanasya aṅgena ekaviṃśativena vaiśyanaimittikasya sāmadasyasya|
pṛ. 132. kāmyasya agreḥ ( agnicayane vṛkṣāgrādijanyasya ) āhavanīyābhāvaḥ|
su. pṛ. 488. kāmyasya karmaṇaḥ yāvadicchamabhyāsaḥ: sakṛd vā bahukṛtvo vā|
bhā. 11|1|4|24, kāmyasya dharmā na nityasya bhavitumarhanti|
6|3|15. kāmyānāṃ karmaṇām anuṣṭhāne pāṭhakramo na niyāmakaḥ, ekayogābhāvena parasparamākāṅkṣāyā abhāvāt|
tasmāt kāmo vā nimittaṃ vā yat yadupayate, tadā tatrodito yāgaḥ kartavyaḥ|
vi. 5|3|12. kāmyānāṃ karmaṇām asati pratibandhe aihikaṃ phalam|
yadi tu prakānte kasmiṃścit guṇakāmalpe dravyanāśo sati pratinidhiṣyate, tatastasya avaśyaṃ samāpanīyatvāt vikāreṇa pratinidhinā tulyaṃ samāpanam|
vā. 3|6|1|140. kāmyānāṃ prārabdhānāṃ nityakarmaṇāṃ ca śrutadvayāpacāre pratinidhinā samāpanam|
kāmye karmaṇi nityaḥ svargo yathā yajñāṅge ṛtvartheḥ|
' saurye caruṃ nirvaped brahmavarcasakāmaḥ ' ityādī kāmye karmaṇi viśvajit nityaḥ svargaḥ syāt|
yathā kāṣṭhādyāhṛtau pratiṣṭhitaḥ ucyate ' bhavatā śākamapi āhartavyam ' iti|
tatra kāṣṭhāni avaśyamāhriyante, labdhe śāke so'pi āhriyate tadvat|
kāmasya praṇayet' ityatra apāṃ praṇayanarūpe yajñāṅge ṛtvarthaḥ |
adhyete ityarthaḥ upakāraḥ, kratoḥ arthaḥ ṛtvarthaḥ kratupakāraḥ, sa nitya eva godohanasyāpi nityaṃ prayojanaṃ paśulābhe'pi anvācayena, evaṃ prakṛte'pi |
phalecchārūpe karmānuṣṭhānasya kāraṇe vīte avāse nivṛtte vā satyapi karmasamāptiniyamo dṛśyate |
tatra kāmye phale labdhe'pi svargarūpanityaphala- lābhārthaḥ karmasamāptiniyama upapadyate nānyathā |
kārīryā vṛṣṭikāāmeṣṭyām ' yadi varṣeta tāvatyeva juhuyāt, yadi na varṣeta śrobhṛte juhuyāt' ityuktam |
kāmye karmaṇi svargaḥ na nityaḥ, kintu kāmaḥ eva nityaḥ |
kāmyate iti kāmaḥ amukakāmaḥ iti śabdenoktaṃ phalamityarthaḥ |
ānumāniko'sya svargakāmena eka- vākyabhāvaḥ, pratyastat kāmavacanena |
tasmāt kāma eva phalam, na svargaḥ |
godohanādau aṅge guṇatvāt guṇatvena vidhānāt yuktaṃ ṛtvarthatvam |
saurye carau tu na tathā vidhānam |
sauryacarvādāva kāmye karmaṇi svargo nityaṃ phalam, kāmyaṃ tu phalam anvācayena iti pūrvapakṣe 'vīte ca kāraṇe niyamāt' iti sūtreṇa yo heturuktaḥ, tannirakaraṇārthe sūtramidam |
vīte ca anuṣṭhānasya kāraṇe yo niyamaḥ uktaḥ, sa tadarthaṃ tasyai prayojanāya |
upakramya aparisamāpayataḥ tadanantarameva śiṣṭā vigrahayeyuḥ: 'prākramiko'yaṃ kāpuruṣaḥ' iti vadantaḥ |
tasmāt kāmyānāṃ kāma eva phalam, na svargo'pi |
ke. kāmye karmaṇi śrutameva phalaṃ grāhyam, na svargaḥ kalpanīyaḥ |
vi. 4|3|9, kāmye karmaṇi śrutasya dravyasyāpacāre drvyāntareṇāpi tat karma anuṣṭhātavyameva |
ḍup. 6|3|111. kāmye pravartanā''kṣiptasādhanatvaṃ pradhānaṃśe eva, na tu sāṅge |
bhāṭṭa. 6|3|1 pṛ. 250. kāmye āghādāhyatau agnī āghānādayaḥ saṃskārā- lucyante |
aindrāgnaudadhisaṃgrahaṇeṣu kāmyeṣu karmasu nityeṣviva katipayāṅgarahitaiṣapi evaṃ phalavattā syāt |
nityādica viguṇā- dapi kāmyāt phalaṃ syāditi pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
asaṃyogāt naivaṃ syāt, vidheḥ śabdapramāṇa- tvāt |
kāmyaṃ karma viguṇamapi niyavat phalavat iti pūrvapakṣaṃ sūtreṇa prāptaṃ tuśabdena nirasyan siddhāntamāha |
evaṃ viguṇasya kāmyakarmaṇaḥ phalavattā na syāt |
vidheḥ vidhīyamānasya sāṅgasyaiva pradhānasya phalavattāyāḥ śabdapramāṇatvāt |
śabdena hi pramāṇena sāṅgameva phalavat iti vijñāyate |
vidheḥ vidhānasya phalasya samastagopetapradhānaprayogasya phalavākyapramāṇatvāt sarvāṅgopasaṃhārasamarthasya kāmyeṣvadhikāraḥ |
kāmyaṃ karma sāṅgameva kṛtaṃ phalavat iti siddhānte hetvantaraparaṃ sūtram |
nitye karmaṇi pradhānasya akaraṇe pratyavāya ucyate, naivaṃ kāmye pradhānasya akarmaṇi akaraṇe pratyavāyaḥ śrūyate |
akameṇyapi apratya- vāyāt pratyavāyābhāvāt na kāmyaṃ nityatvam |
mā. 6|3|18-9. kāmyāḥ iṣṭayo gopyā iti tāsu pradhānaṃ upāṃśu- tvam |
vi. 8|2|20. kāmyāsu iṣṭiṣu upāṃśutvaṃ pradhānaiva saṃbadhyamānam aṅgābhyācoditam iti vakṣyate (3|8|9|15-16) |
vā. 2|1|4|2 pṛ. 414. kāmyāsu vikṛtiṣu upadiṣṭadravyadevatā''- dibhiḥ prākṛtadravyadevatā''dīnāṃ bādhaḥ |
'āgneyamāṣṭā- kapālaṃ nirvaped rukmaḥ' 'agnīṣomīyamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet syāmākaṃ brahmavarcasakāmaḥ' 'aindrāgnamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet prajākāmaḥ' iti |
tatraiteṣu yāgeṣu ayamarthaḥ sāṃśayikaḥ kiṃ prākṛtaṃ dravyadevataṃ nivartate, uta na nivartate iti, sarvāsābhevajātīyānāṃ codanānāmupamānāṃ dravya- devatenaiva sahotpattiḥ |
tasāda- gṛhīte dravyadevate codakena, vidhineva prāpte |
dravyadevataṃ prati nirākāṅkṣe yāge avaśiṣṭānyaṅgāni codakaḥ prāpa- yiṣyatīti |
aya yaduktam (10|1|9|130) agrahaṇāt grahaṇamiti, tadiha siddham |
bhāṣyam- iti cet padvasi, vidhinā prāptavāda- śiṣāni codakaḥ prāpayiṣyatīti |
satyaṃ codaka- prāptaṃ pratyakṣaśrutyā na pratiṣṭhitaṃ dravyadevatama, kintu parārthe tad, yāganirvṛttaye |
sa ca yāga ekenaiva dravyeṇa ekayā devatayā nirvartanīyaḥ śrūyate 'āgneyamāṣṭākapālaṃ nirva- ped rukmaḥ' |
tasmin sahāyāpekṣe kalpa- māne nirdeśo bādhyate |
atha tena nirvartitai codakaprāptasya na kiñcidasti prayojanamiti tat śrutamipi siddhatvāt prayojanasya na kariṣyate |
soma- pūrvatra bhūtastathaiva niyatatve'pi iha śrutasya codakaprāptasya ca vikalpaḥ ityudhiteḥ |
sūtrā- rthastu- sarvāsāṃ dravyadevatāviguṇayukteṣvodanānāṃ codake dravyaviṣaye apavṛtte sati vaikṛtadravyādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ syāt upadeśārthatvāya iti |
nivartate vā, na prātevikalpo vā samuccayaḥ |
kintu asya viṣayaḥ śiṣṭa eva ityanvayaḥ |

bhāṭṭa- vaikṛtaṃ syāmādidravyaṃ suryādidevatā kriyā- 'ntarasādhanaṃ ca śarādi prākṛtasthānāpannadravyadevatā- kuśādeḥ nivartakaṃ na veti saṃdehe, ubhayopi pramāṇasiddha- tvāt, kalpye'pi atideśasya prajāyādipaviṣaye āva- śyakatvena kuśādiviṣayatvāvaśyambhāvāt, durbalapramāṇa- prāpitasyāpi ca prabalapramāṇaprāpitenāpi atyantābā- yogāt ubhayorapi tulyabalatvena vikalpaḥ |
nahi pratyakṣaṃ bhinno'tideśaḥ kathamavākāṅkṣiṇyā vikṛtyā lāghavena prakṛtidityevamākārakasya ekasyaiva atideśasya kalpa- nāt |

iti prāpte, upakārapṛṣṭhabhāvena padārthānāmatideśāt yadupakāra- janakībhūtaḥ padārtho vikṛtau ānātaḥ, tadupakārajanakī- bhūtaprākṛtapadārthatirikkapadārthameva vikṛtatvādideśāt kuśādipadārthasya ākāṅkṣā'bhāve atideśaviṣayatvasyaiva akalpanāt kuśānāṃ naiva prāmāṇikatvam |
ata eva vastutaḥ aprāptasya kaśādeśviśeṣārthatve sati prāpaka- śāstrasya ādhvanīyādiśāstravat klṛptatvena kuśādi- viṣayatvabhramāt prāptatvād vyavahāraḥ |
ataḥ siddhaḥ pratyāmānāt śarādibhiḥ kuśādīnāṃ bādhaḥ |
siddha eva ca bādhaḥ pūrve tatratatra vyavahṛta iti dhyeyam |
vi. 6|1|2. kāmyakarmārambhottaraṃ vītāyāṃ svargādiphalecchāyāṃ tatphalasaṃbhavat nityakarmavat pāpakṣaya evātra phalam |
soma— dīkṣitadharmāṇām itihādīkṣādīkṣākṣaṇa- nimittāntaryaniyame'pi pāṭhikṛtādīnāṃ naimittikānāṃ na nimittāntaryaniyamaḥ iti pratyavakṣānāt saṃgatiḥ |

bhāṭṭa— kāmyānām uddītyādīnām, naimitta- kānāṃ ca medanādīnāṃ samidādideva pāṭhakramāt krame prāpte, upāyapravṛttivacchinnaṃ prati phalecchāyāḥ kāraṇatvāt naimittikānuṣṭhānasya ca nimittādhīnatvāt tadanurodhenaiva kramāgataḥ na pāṭhasya niyāmakaḥ |
vastu- tastu yatraikaprayogavidhiparigrahaḥ anekeṣām, tatraiva kramā- pekṣāyāṃ pāṭhādīnāṃ niyāmakanā, na tu yatra bhinnaprayoga- vidhiparigrahaḥ |
ata eva tādṛśasthale pāṭhaḥ pārāyaṇādau upayujyate |
' kāyasya ekakapālasya varuṇapraghāsagatasya yat sārtha- vādavidhikāṇḍam, tasya sākamedhīyekakapāle atideśaḥ |
anyathā ca ekatvādeḥ kārakadvārā kriyāṅga- tvenopayogāpatteḥ saṃkhyaiva kārakaviśeṣaṇam |
na ceha lakṣaṇakriyā upāttā, tāmanapātāmapekṣya ayaṃ saṃbandhaḥ pratyetavyaḥ iti vipra- kṛṣyate |
yathā rājaḥ puruṣa iti rājapuruṣayoḥ saṃbandhaḥ ekasyāṃ dānakriyāyām ubhayoḥ dātṛpratigrahītṛtvābhāvāt tayā dānakriyāyā prayujyate, tadgataṃ sarvo'pi saṃbandhaḥ kriyā- prayuktaḥ |
uktaṃ ca ' na kriyāgarbhasaṃbandhate saṃbandhaṃ ka cit ' iti |
tena yatra tṛtīyā itthaṃbhūtalakṣaṇe syāt, tadā tṛtīyā ( sūtrāvakena prastaraṃ praharati ) sūtrāvakasya prastarasya ca lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvaḥ pratyāyyaḥ |
sa ca lakṣaṇakriyāprayuktaḥ, lakṣaṇakriyā vinā lakṣaṇalakṣaṇa- bhāvasyāsaṃbhavāt |
evaṃ ca lakṣaṇakriyā kathañcit hṛdayamāgamatya jñāpyajñāpakabhāvātmako lakṣya- lakṣaṇabhāvaḥ pratyetavyaḥ iti tatpratītiḥ vilambena jāyate |
kārakabhāvena saṃbandhastu śabdopāttakriyāyāḥ sākṣādeva saṃbhavati iti kriyāntarānapekṣatvāt kriyākārakasaṃbandhaḥ śīghraṃ pratīyate |
kartari tṛtīyā, yathā 'brāhmaṇena niṣkāraṇaḥ ṣaḍaṅgo vedo- 'dhyeyo jñeyaśca' |
karmaṇi tṛtīyā, yathā 'yavāgvā juhoti' 'pitrā pitaraṃ vā saṃjñānīte' |
karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī, yathā 'jagataḥ kartā' 'citramagopena gavāṃ dohaḥ' |
karaṇe ṣaṣṭhī, yathā 'śatasya dīvyati' 'śatasya prati- dīvyati' |
'agnaye haviṣya haviṣyo pāya medasaḥ preṣya-anubrūhi' 'ājyasya yajate' |
saṃpradāne ṣaṣṭhī, yathā 'godhā kālakā dāvāgdhāte vanaspatīnām' |
adhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhī, yathā 'pañcakṛtvo dvivā aho mukte' |
asyārthayorapi viniyoktrī supa- tiṅ-śrutistu svoktānāmeva arthānāṃ viniyoktrī |
kārakaśrutiḥ taddhitaśruterbalīyasī iti 'ainyā gārhapatyam' ityatra mantrasya gārhapatyatvameva, nendrāgnatvam |
kau. ( tātparyam ) 3|1|14 pṛ. 351, kārakaśrutiḥ padaśrutyapekṣayā durbalā upa- jīvaktvāt 'somena yajeta' ityādi |
3|1|14 pṛ. 351, kārakaśrutyorvirodhe sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvādinā balābalaṃ draṣṭavyam, 'āgneyaṃ caturdhā karoti' 'puroḍāśaṃ caturdhā karoti' ityatra yathā |
kāraṇatve vidheyapāramedo bhavati ekakāraka- nivandhanaṃ tu arthasahasramapi ekaprayatnasādhyam |
na ca balīyaḥ kāraṇaṃ śakyate bādhitum |
yena vinā yatra saṃbhavati, tat tasya kāraṇam |
pauṇḍarīkādau yatra yāge bhūyasāmnāṃ pratigraho bhavati, tatra pratyayapratigrahaṃ catuṣpālo vāruṇaḥ puroḍāśaḥ prāyaścittatayā kartavyo bhavati |
tatra bhūyaḥsu puroḍāśeṣu tantreṇa kṛteṣu kapālapānādihavirbhāvāsanāntānāṃ
dharmāṇāṃ kāṇḍānusamayameva anuṣṭhānaṃ kartavyaṃ na padārthāṃnusamayena |
tasmāt tatra kāraṇāt bhasmībhāvaprasaṅga- rūpāt puroḍāśeṣu abhyāvṛttiḥ amitaḥ āvṛttiḥ |
tasmāt bahu- puroḍāśāsthale kāṇḍānusamaya eva, na padārthāṃnusamayaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
kāraṇe kāryavadupacāraḥ taṇḍule devavarṣavat ( devo varṣati taṇḍulān iti taṇḍulaśabdo dṛṣṭau upacaryate ) |
iti nyāyena jaḍaduḥkhātmakasya prapañcasya prajñānandātmakasya brahmaṇaḥ pariṇāmatvaṃ nopapadyate |
śrīkara. 2|1|10 brasū. kāraṇaguṇāḥ hi kāryaguṇārambhakāḥ iti nyāyaḥ, tena jñānānandātmakeśeropādānatve jagatastaddharmā- tmakatvaṃ syāt iti cet |
kāraṇaguṇāḥ svasamānajātīyakāryaguṇārambhakā ityekārakena nyāyarūpaṃ vadanti vaiśeṣikāḥ |
yathā śuklebhyastantubhyaḥ śuklasya vastrasya prasavādviāt tadapi yathārthanāñca, tathā cetanasya brahmaṇo jagatkāraṇatve'pyupagamyamāne kārye jagadyapi caitanyamata eva vadanti |
'harideva jagajjagadeva hari- riti hi jaganni bhinnatanuḥ |
iti yasya matiḥ satataṃ sarati sa naro bhavasāgaramuttarati |
ke cit samavāyikāraṇānāśe kāryanāśo yathā tantunāśe paṭanāśa iti vadanti |
pare tu asamavāyikāraṇāśe'pi kāryanāśo yathā tantuyoganāśe paṭanāśaḥ iti vadanti |
yadi yasya kāraṇabhūtaṃ dṛṣṭam, siddhe dṛṣṭānte tadyet sādhye pakṣe'pi kāraṇabhūtam ityavagamyate, bhavati tat tasya sādhakam |
yatra jñāyate kāraṇabhūtamiti, na tat tatsadṛśamapi sādhakam |
śrīkara. 1|1|3 brasū. kāraṇānuvidhāyi kāryam iti nyāyaḥ |

smṛtī- rācārāṃśrcapalampatya mūlaśrutiṣu anumīyamānānāṃ kāraṇānu- vidhāyikāryanyāyena avaśyapulyamānakāryānurūpakāraṇā- numānerbhavitavyam iti bhāvanānāmaviśeṣyavacchedyatyāga- dānahomopāsādicātvādhiviśeṣasargādiphalakārakairatavya- tāvidhayastathāvadantāmatavyāḥ |
uktā- vasthāyāṃ liṅgaśarīrasadbhāve 'kāraṇābhāve kāryābhāvaḥ' iti nyāyena talliṅgaśarīropādānakāraṇaparūpāpavidhyā- sthitirityā sūcitā |
nanu evaṃ ( śaktivat ) kāraṇatā- 'pi atiriktā syāt |
ata eva na kāryavyāpakatvam, vyāpteḥ anantapadārthadharma- tayā gauravāt |
tasya ana- nyāsiddhaniyatapūrvavartitvarūpatayā tadabhijñavyadharmāttara- kalpane mānābhāvāt |
tadde taddāsabhasa hetutvavāraṇāya ananyathā- mī. ko. 182
tacca kāraṇaṃ dvividhaṃ svarūpayogyaṃ phalopahitaṃ ceti |
ata eva nityasya svarūpayogyasya phalākṣaya- mabhāvanīyamḥ iti prasiddhaḥ |
evaṃ ca klaptakāryapūrvakāla- deśasaṃbandhasyaiva kāraṇatayā nāklaptakāraṇarūpapadārthāntara- tatrābhāvatvāccādikalapanam |
prayojakatvaṃ ca anvayavyati- rekavattve sati niyatapūrvavṛttitvamātram iti dik |
(Symbol) kārīrī iṣṭiḥ, ekamapi sat dṛṣṭādiphalaṃ yadā- yadā kāmyate, tadā tadā punaḥ prayujyate |
6|2|3- nanu kārīrīṃ kṛtāyāmapi kimiti kadā cit vṛṣṭirna jāyate, taśāha - phalati |
yadi na sarve tat kadā cit tadaiva dhruvamaparamabhuktaṃ karma śāstrīyamāste |
vṛṣṭi- virudaphalena śāstrapratiṣedhe kena cit prabalena karmaṇā janmāntarā'nuṣṭhitena pratibandhaḥ tadā kalpyate |
na prati- bandhādasādhayataḥ sādhanatvahāniḥ iti na śāstraprāmāṇyam |
ślovā. citrākṣepaparihāre, ratnākaraśca. kārīrīṃyadeḥ kāmyasya karmaṇo'bhyāsena phalabhūyastvam |
amṛtatvaṃ gacchati iti- gamanopādānāt kāryamemṛtatvam, na kaivalyam kāryo iti nyāyāt |
(Symbol) kāryaṃ hi kāraṇamavagamayati, na punaḥ kāryāntaramapi |
bṛhatī. pṛ. 219, kārye hi kāraṇamastītyetāvati jñānamupādayati na punaḥ tadvā anyadā |
(Symbol) kāryāṇi sarvāṇi sūkṣmātmanā kāraṇe satyeva iti satkāryavādino matam, na khamatam |
nahi hṛdayādarśananirastaḥ kāraṇāvasthāyāṃ kāryecchadaḥ śakyo'- bhyupagantum |
yathā ghaṭādirūpakāryaṃ kulālādirūpakāraṇasya saṃpratyayo bhavatīti spaṣṭam |
bṛhatī. pṛ. 23, kārye arthe vedasya prāmāṇyam |

(Symbol) kāryaṃ jñāte'dhikāraḥ syāt ityanena nyāyena prayogavidhiyaprayojyasamastāṅgādharaṇapūrvakatvena adhikāra- vidhereva prayogavidhayanurodhavṛttistvasya nyāyatvāt samakṣā- dharmopetaṃ yaḥ śaknuyāt
tadyathā- kaścit ca cidupadiśati 'prācīnaṃ grāmādāgrāḥ' iti, tasya sarvatrāpranuddhiḥ prasaktā |
tataḥ paścādāha ye kṣīriṇo'varohavantaḥ pṛthuparṇāste nyagrodhāḥ' iti |
sa tatra āmrabuddhyā nyagrodhabuddhiṃ prati- padyate |
sa tataḥ paśyati buddhyā, āmrādicāpakakṣumāṇāṃ nyagrodhāṃśca ādhīyamānān |
nityā eva ca hi asmin viṣaye āmrāḥ, nityāśca nyagrodhāḥ, buddhisya viparī- gamyate ityevaṃ prakṛte'pyūhanīyam |
sāhasī. 606. kāryavelāyām asataḥ devairapi aprāptiḥ, ani- mittakāryotpādamasaṅgāt ityuktaṃ saṃbandhanīyatve |
taṃ bhavata viśeṣaniścayaḥ, phalāṃni santi' iti kāryapadahitavākyaprayoge yādṛcchikaḥ etāvattaiva śabdārthalanviyaḥ kāryavyabhicāraśca siddhaḥ |
idaṃ ca harṣahetunumānamātram, harṣahetumātraṃ ca na deva yādṛcchikasaṃ pravṛttiḥ pratyakṣāvagatalokadā yathā 'putraste jātaḥ' iti vākyasyārthaḥ |
śabdāt kārya- rūpaharṣaviśeṣaḥ eva, yāvadviśeṣaniścayaśca na śakyate |
buddhirnāsti, tathāpi vyutpattiḥ śabdahetukatvambham, so'pi harṣahetunā bahunāṃ sambhavāt |

atha yadyapi bahūnāṃ kam arthāntarānvitaparatvakalpanāyāpi kāryaparatvasiddheḥ priyārthānāṃ sambhāvanā'sti, tathāpi putrajananaviśeṣasya ityeva kāryarūpaviśeṣe śaktigauravamiti, tadapi na, dṛṣṭatvāt pāriśeṣyaniścaya iti |
naivam, tatraiva bahūnāṃ pravṛtteḥ kāryanvitatvena kāryanvitatve eva kalpanaṃ yuktam, na harṣahetūnāṃ dṛṣṭatvāt |
yathā putrajananaṃ harṣahetustathā sulabha- tu arthāntarānvite |

prasavāḥ priyāyāḥ, pitāmahādīn prati ṛṇāpākaraṇam, asmākaṃ tu kāryamātre śaktiralekhaviṣayā, tava tu arthā- tathā putrābhyo narakāt trāyate iti putraḥ ato narakāt ntrānvite mahāviṣaye śaktirasti, yathā vahnireti niyate trāṇam, avandhyātvaṃ cetyevamādīnāṃ bahūnāṃ dṛṣṭatvātra dāhyārthe na dravyamātre śaktiḥ, evaṃ kāryaparatvadvāreṇa para- viśeṣāvadhāraṇam |
kiñca vartamāna eva harṣahetuḥ harṣo- sparānvayo'pi vyutpannaḥ, iti na pratipadādhikāranirṇayaḥ |
tpādaka iti niyamo nāsti, atītādīnāmapi smṛtidvāreṇa na ca lokavākyavat parasparānvayaparaṃ vedāntānāmabhyu- harṣahetutvena kasmin dṛṣṭatvāt |
nanu siddhārthyapadeśeṣu laukikeṣu mukhyā- sarvasvārpaṇamittaṃ sarvasaṃnyāsaṃ sambhavet vikasitamukhasya ryābhāvatvāditābhidhānaṃ na syāt |
satyaṃ tatra vaktrabhi- dṛśyate, tatra vartamāno'pi suvarṇādilābho na harṣahetuḥ |

prāyadāveryānniścayaḥ, nānvitābhidhānāt, saṃketapadebhya yaduktam, bahuśaḥ putrajanane sati evaṃvidhavākya- iva siddhārthe'pi vyutpatteravibhaktyarthānāṃ vyutpatti- prayogāt putrajananaviśeṣatvāt iti, tadvidamadam, rasteya |
tathā 'asya śabdasya ayamarthaḥ' ityapyasti, bahūnāṃ harṣahetūnāṃ sambhavāt yadā''dau niścayaḥ, tadā prayogā- tathā praśnaprativacanādiṣvapi |
tatra padayā vyutpattiḥ ādyā ntare'pi tatsambhavādiniścaya eva |
yadi prayogāntare kāryaviṣayaiveti siddhaṃ kāryaṃ eva vyutpattiriti |
pravi. niścayaheturasti, sa ca prathamameva vaktavyaḥ |

bhā. yadyapi prathamaṃ kārya eva vyutpattiḥ : tathāpyuttarakālaṃ bahuśaḥ 10|6|12|174. kāryasiddhayarthaṃ hi kāraṇaṃ kalpyate, siddhe'pi prayogadarśanāt ubhayānugate arthamātre śakti- na punaḥ kāryavināya |
bṛhattī. pṛ. 54. kāryānu- yukteti, tadyuktam, gaṅgāśabdasya nadīviśeṣavācakatve sāreṇa ṛtvijāṃ saṃkhyāviśeṣaniyamaḥ |
niścita uttarakāle tīrādiṣu bahuśaḥ prayogadarśanāt ubhayā- 21-24. kāryanusāriṇā kāraṇena mādhyam iti nugate arthāntare śaktilpanāprasaṅgāt |
parimalaḥ 2|2|741 ṇādisutyā prayogopapatterna śaktilpaneti cet, atrāpi tra. sū. kāryontaradarśanāt kāraṇātyakalpanā tarhi lakṣaṇā siddhārthyaprayogeṇa kalpyatāmiti tulya- nyāyyaiva |
gopade tu ānantyavyabhicārābhyāṃ vyaktau kalpanā- etasyāpi jñānabhedaprāptiḥ |
su. pṛ. 894. yadyapi pravṛttāveva vyutpattiḥ, tathāpi kāryajñānaniyamo kāryanvitaḥ evārthaḥ : sarvaśabdabhidheyaḥ |
kāryatvama- nāsti, yathā vṛddhādīn prati vinodādhamaiḥ, 'navāstīre pūrvatvāt pravṛttinivṛttyoḥ, pravṛttinivṛttyātmakatvācca
vyavahāraśca, vṛddhavyavahāre eva ca śabdānāṃ svārthe viṣayatvāt pradhānadvārā ajñeṣu prāpnoti, iti pradhānasya vyutpatteḥ |
ṛju. pṛ. 16. svakālasaṃpadādagrāhya ajñeṣu yathāsaṃbhavaṃ saṃpādyamāno na kāryapattiḥ pañcadhā |
sāhityasaṃpatti viguṇoti-asyai- pañciḥ sā pañcadhā pramāṇapañcakaprameyatvāt |
su. pṛ. 180.) anumānena śabdena anumitādanumitānumānalabdha- vā. 1|3|13 pṛ. 200. kālaḥ |
bāla. pṛ. 129-130. kāryapattiḥ amāvāsyā nānyeti, ā amāvāsyāyāḥ paurṇamāsī' pratipādyate |
vāstavī sā dvividhā iti gṛhakāravacanasya satyapi darśapūrṇamāsaviṣayatve pratyakṣānumānābhyām |

śabdāt, prati- 'skālāduttaraḥ kālo gauṇaḥ pūrvasya karmaṇaḥ' iti bedhena svaśabdānumānam, saṃsthayā pratiṣedhānumānam, prati- vacanāntarānurodhāt gauṇakālaviṣayatvavyavasthārthaṃ : na mukhya- bedhācca śabdaḥ |
kau. 1|2|6|14 śabdāt ; pratiṣedhānumitasambandhāt, abhāve vidhayanu- pṛ. 95. kālaḥ iti loke viprakarṣa ucyate |
asya udāhara- karṣaḥ kālasya viprakarṣaḥ ityarthaḥ :) |
vā. 1|2|14. ṇādivistaraḥ 'ūhaḥ sthānirmāṇaṃ pratilihau' iti tridhau kālaḥ : iṣṭeḥ |
vā. 9|2|139. kāryapattipramāṇāni somena vā yajeta so'māvāsyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vā yajeta' |
pratyakṣavidhiḥ, abhāvavidhiḥ, bhā. 1|2|12|15. kāla eka eva āgneyādīnāṃ vikāraḥ, svaśabdaḥ, niṣedhānuvādaśceti |

su. pūrvādvālakālaḥ 'pūrvāhṇe vai devānām' ityādi śruti- pṛ. 145. kāryapaṇaṃ śuddhaṃ sādhyasādhukāryapaṇamadhyāt gamya iti nirvivādam |
itarau tu prayogavidhinā sarvāṅga- tatparīkṣibhiḥ vivektuṃ śakyate |
vā. 1|3|4|9 sahitaprayogānuṣṭhāpane ekasmin kṣaṇe asambhavāt pṛ. 220. sāhityanirvārhārthamāsthitatvāt prayogavidhivigamyau |
kālaḥ : aṅgapradhānayorvacanena bhinno'pi, 4|5. kālaḥ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ 'paurṇamāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyā 'pūrvedyuramāvāsyāyāṃ vediṃ karoti' iti |
vi. 11 112. kālaḥ : aṅgāntarāt balīyān kramāt caliṣṭhaḥ |
yadā paurṇamāsī amā- 'kālasya ca pūrvādhikaraṇatayā aṅgāntarādapi balīyasaḥ vāsyā ca ahanneva khaṇḍā satī samāpyate tadā pūrvayyāgaḥ kramāt balīyastaratvāt |
saṃkarṣe. 3|2|1, 'pi ca prayogāṅgaṃ sarvānte so'pi padyate |
sārtaiḥ saha tathāpi āvartanāt parato rātrī vā yadi saṃdhiḥ, sopa- sa sāhityamāśutvaṃ vā prapadyate |
(nanu yadyapi pradhāna- vāsāhyaṃ paurṇamāsī, tasmāttvādhānaṃ paredyurāgaḥ |
ātra- sāhityaṃ śaidhyaṃ ca sārtaiḥ saha yādṛśaṃ saṃbhavati, tādṛśā- taine tataḥ pūrve vā yadi saṃdhiḥ, tadā pūrvā upavāsāhyaṃ ṅgīkaraṇāt avirodhaḥ, tathāpi pūrvādvādikālatikramo saṃdhidine yāgaḥ |
1|3|12, paredyurapi na rātrau kintu bhūyiṣṭhāṅgānuṣṭhāne durvāra eva ityāśaṅkayāha-) |
3|13. kālaḥ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ 'yāvajjīvaṃ svayaṃ pradhānasya sarvāṅgasahitasya yaḥ |
(pradhānasyaiva sākṣāt vihitaḥ deśaḥ phalaṃ nimittaṃ saṃskāryam iti anupādeyapañcakam |
sa ca prayogāṅgatvāt, prayogasya ca sāṅgapradhāna- bāla, 88. kālaḥ na guṇāḥ, nimittaṃ hyetat |
nañsamabhivyāhāre tu tatkā- līnābhāvapratiyogilasaṃbandhena sākṣādeva vā tathāmeva |

nanu nāḍikāmūhūrtapraharādi- pratyayānāṃ paratvāpara-yaugapadyāyogāpadya-cirakṣipatva- viśiṣṭapadārthapratyayānāṃ ca kālakṛtatvena aṅgīkṛtānāṃ vibhaktatvāt ākāśavadvibhaktena kāladravyeṇa karaṇāśakte:; sūryādigatikriyāvacchedadāt vibhaktasya kālasya vibhakta- pratyayahetutvamyupagame tu sūryādigatikriyāmeva nama:- ṣṭhitamabhāgātilaṅghanaphala: sūryādigatikriyāpracaya: nāḍikā, nabhaścihnasamabhāgātilaṅghanaphala: muhūrta:, nabho- 'ṣṭamabhāgātilaṅghanaphala: prahara:; ityevaṃ nāḍikādipratyaya- hetulopapatte:, pratiyogipadārthāpekṣayā bahulpatamasūryādi- gatilakṣaṇā- (gatikṣaṇā-) vacchedayo:; paratvāparatva- viśiṣṭapadārthapratyayahetutvopapatte:; ekamakṣaṇāvacchedyo: yogapadyāyogapadyaviśiṣṭapadārthapratyayahetutvopapatte:, uttpatyā- dibhāvikārāntargatagrahalpasūryādigatilakṣaṇāvacchedayo: cirakṣipatvaviśiṣṭapadārthapratyayahetutvopapatte:, kriyāvyati- riktakālābhāvāt jīvanakriyāyā eva kālatvāvagati: |
sūryādigatyā: gati- kriyāyā: yuvasthavirādipadārthasaṃbandhāvena tadavacchedaka- tvāyogāt |
kālasya tu sarvagatatvāt sarvahaksūryādi- sametakriyā'vacchedatvavibhāgāsya yuvasthavirādipadārtho- vacchedakatvopapatte: yuvasthavirādiṣu parāparādipratyayai: kriyā'tiriktakālānumānāt |
padārthāsaṃbaddhāyā: kriyāyā: teṣu parādipratyayahetutvā- yogāt kālasya anumeyeṣvapi kriyāvyatirekasiddhi: ityapi vadanti |

parāparādipratyayānāṃ hi sārva- trikatvāt sarvagatatve'pekṣave'pi ākāśadareva anyata: siddhāt kālavat svarūpeṇa abhinnādapi sahakāribhedā- pāditavilakṣaṇasāmarthyāt upapatte: na kālakalpakatvaṃ bhavati |
pratyakṣatve tu 'sūryedayo vartate' iti kriyā- viśeṣodayapratyayavilakṣaṇā |

'bhṛta: sūryodaya: bhaviṣyati vā' iti bhūtabhaviṣyatkālāvacchidodyatta- grāhiṇi pratyaye vartamānatvāpratīveśa na 'vartate' iti buddhe: sattā''lambanaṃ śakyanīyam, 'dyo bhūta:' 'atha nakṣyati' 'śvo bhaviṣyati' 'atha notyacyate' iti pradhvaṃsaprāgabhāvāgrahinānupavibhadalakṣaṇasya bhūtabhavi- ṣyadbuddhayo: pradhvaṃsaprāgabhāvāvalambanānupapatte: bhūtabhaviṣya- tkālāvacchinnasattā''lambanaṃ dhātuparyāyālocanayā bhāsamānaṃ nāpahartuṃ śakyam |
kālānavacchede ca sūryodayādisadasatayo: ākāśaśaśaviṣāṇavat sarvadā sadasattvapatte: kādācitkapratītivirodha: |
svataśca kālasya ekarūpatve'pi upādhibhedāt bhūtabhaviṣyadarthatāntavyapa- deśopapatti: |
ekaphalāvacchinnā: hi kriyākṣaṇā: yāvantaṃ kālaṃ vyāpyuvanti, tāvān kāle vartamānatvena vyapadiśyate |

kriyākṣaṇānāṃ ca ayogapadye'pi ekaphaloddeśena anuṣṭhīya- mānānām ādyakṣaṇādārabhya phalopapattiparyantaṃ kriyaikya- vyapadeśāt vidyamānakriyā'vacchedopādhikaṃ kālasya varta- mānatvam, vinaṣṭakriyā'vacchedopādhikaṃ bhūtatvam, bhāvi- kriyā'vacchedopādhikaṃ bhaviṣyatvam upapannam |
sūryādi- kriyā'vacchedakasya ca kālasya akṣipyamādikriyā avacchedakatvyupagamāt nānyonyāśrayāpatti: |

ataśca sūryādikriyāṇāmapi bhūtabhaviṣyadvartamānakālavacchedatvāt kriyāvyatiriktasya ākāśadiyatiriktasya ca kālasya pratyakṣakālavādamate vilakṣaṇapratītibalādeva siddhe: teṣāṃ tāvata parājaya: anāśakya eva |
anumeyakakāla- vādino'pi tu ākāśadiyatiriktāsiddhāvapi kriyāta: tāvat vyatirekasiddhe: aśakyā: parājetum |
gaṇanā'- paraparyāyasaṃkhyānavācitvena smṛtāt kālyate: dhāto: ghañi kṛte kālaśabdavyutpatti: |
su. pu. 970-71. kāla: paśo: amīṣomapraṇayanāt anantaram |
śaṅkhā na paṭṭa:; tasminnapi sa eva kāla: |
'vatsairāmāvāsyāyāṃ vratamupanayati' 'purā vatsānāmapā- karta: ' iti vatsāpākaraṇakāla: ṛtārthe nirdiṣṭaye iti pūrvādhikaraṇe siddhāntitam |
ya: saṃnāyyaṃ karoti, tasya sa kāla: syāt |
talliṅga- saṃyogāt tasya saṃnāyyasya vatsāpākaraṇaṃ liṅgam |
tādṛśena liṅgena saṃyogāt saṃnayata: saṃnayata: pakṣe eva sa kāla: syāt, na asaṃnayataḥ saṃnāyyamakurvata: iti pūrva: pakṣa: |
pūrvapakṣa sūtreṇa prāptaṃ vāśabdena nirākṛtya siddhānta- māha |
ubhayo: saṃnayataḥ asaṃnayataḥ atha kāla: pratī- yeta |
na vatsāpākaraṇena vrate kiñcidādhīyate, kālena tu prayojanam |
idaṃ parārthatvāt iti hetupadaṃ sūtragatameva syāt iti bhāṣyasyāratvāt jñāyate |
kāpi pustake sūtrāṃśalenā- gamābhāvāt nāsmābhirapi sūtre praveśitam |
asaṃnayato'pi, yasyāpi na saṃnāyyaṃ tasyāpi, vatsāpākaraṇābhāve'pi vatsāpākaraṇakāle'sti |
kālena ca na: prayojanaṃ na vatsāpākaraṇe |
tasmānna saṃnayataḥ eva vratam, kintu asaṃnayato'pi |
kāla: sāṃnāyyavikārāṇāṃ somāt prāgūrdhvamiti na niyata: |
bhā. 1|3|17 pṛ. 200. sūkṣma: kāle'sti tatra na: |
santamapi kālameda atisaukṣmyāt alakṣyatāṃ padamapatraśatamite iva yogapadyabhrama: |
na yāvajjīvakāla: prakṛte: śeṣabhūta:; kartṛkarmausau ityuktam 'kartṛvā śrutisaṃyogāt' iti (2|4|12) |
mā. 12|1|120. saṃbandhabhedasacce- 'pi vartamānakāla: sarvatra kṛtāveva anveti iti na kāpi tasya viśeṣāntarakalpanā |
ata: siddhaṃ sarvatra vartamānakālasya kṛtāvevānvaya iti |
rahasya. pṛ. 41,42. kālau dvau somasya darśapūrṇamāsayo: prāgurdhvaṃ vā |
5|4|16, bhāṣyakāra: 'upasadbhiścharitvā' iti tallakṣitakālameva anupādeyarūpaṃ medahetutvena darśayati |
su. pu. 722. kālasya anupādeyatvena nimittatvāt tadanugraheṇa praṇayanavādha: |
su. pṛ. 175. kālasya api nimittatveva anupādeyatvāt |
vā. 2|4| 11 pṛ. 624. kālasya api ṣaḍinadriyavedyatvam 'idānīṃ spṛśāmi' 'idānīṃ paśyāmi', ityādi- pratīte: |
dhārāvāhikaṃ ca tattakṣaṇaviśiṣṭaghaṭāde: pūrvapūrva- jñānāgṛhītasyaiva uttarottarajñānaviṣayatvam |
na ca kāla: atisūkṣmatvāt kathaṃ pratyakṣagrāhya iti vācyam |
jñāna- dhārāyāmuparatāyām 'kimatra ghaṭo'vasthita:' iti pṛṣṭa: san kathayati 'asmin kṣaṇe mayopalabdha:' iti, 'prātārabhyaiva etāvantaṃ kālaṃ mayopalabdha: ' iti ca |
'śatapatrapatraśataṃ mayā sūcyā yugapat bhinnam' iti tu sthūlakālaviṣayakam |
yadyapi kālasya karmodbhūtā avagamyate, tathāpi sakṛdeva vedite karma prastūyate |
bhā. 6|1|123-24, kālasya niyamavidhiḥ 'paurṇa-māsyāṃ paurṇamāsyā yajeta' ityādiḥ, na anuvādaḥ |
4|1|123-24, kālasya vatsabarhipulakṣitasya darśa-pūrṇamāsayoretārtha vidhānam 'barhiṣā pūrṇamāse vratamupaiti, vatsaramāvāsyāyām' iti |
6|1|123-40. kālasya ṣaḍindriyajanyapratyakṣaviṣayatvaṃ brāhmaviṣaya-saṃbandhitvena 'idānīṃ ghaṭo jñātaḥ' ityādyanubhavam |
maṇi. pṛ. 170, kālasya ṣaḍindriyavedyatvaṃ pūrvakṣaṇaviśiṣṭa-ghaṭasya viṣayīkaraṇam |
pṛ. 13. kālasya saṃbandhaḥ 'paurṇamāsyāṃ yajeta' ityādinā vidhīyate, na karmā-ntaram |
ṣaṭtriṃśadrātre śrūyate 'ṣaḍahā bhavanti catvāro bhavanti' iti |
kimatra vidhīyate, kiṃ dvādaśāhikānāmahāṃ pravṛttiḥ, uta ṣaḍahasyeti |
catvāra: ṣaḍahā: iti tāvat kālasya abhyāsa: śrūyate |
asmin kālābhyāse'pi janaka satrāvat dvādaśāhikānāṃ nānā ahrāṃ pravṛtti: syāt iti bādarirācārya āha sma |
ṣaḍahaśabdena ekekenāhanā nirvatyāni pada saulyāni karmāṇi ucyante |
teṣāṃ ca ṣaṇṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ bheda: karmabheda: gamyate, catvāra: ṣaḍahā iti saṃkhyāyā: pṛthakttvaniveśatvāt |
ṣaṭtriṃśadrātre catvāra: ṣaḍahā bhavanti iti na dvādaśāhikānāṃ ahrāṃ pravṛttiḥ, kintu jaiminirācārya: tadā vṛtti tasya prajñātasya pṛṣṭhasyaiva ṣaḍa
tassāt pramandassa kīṭādhipateḥ yat vedaḥ dhanam, tadasmākaṃ naivāśālaṃ nagaram ābhar |
athavā asmān prati tat vimuhi dhārya poṣaya ca (vā) itye- tat |
tame dhune payoniṣedhena niṣpadyate yat śiṣṭam, tat dharmaśabdenocyate |
'bhṛñ bharaṇe' iti bhauvādikasya sṛjo dhātvantareṇārthakathanaṃ vyākhyānārtham |
'dubhṛñ dhāraṇapoṣaṇayoḥ' iti jauhotyā- dikasya bhṛjo rūpaṃ vimuhi iti darśitam |
yajamānastāvat prārthayitā, indraśca prārthyamānaḥ sarvadā asti |
kīraṭāḥ nāma yadyapi janapadāḥ; tathāpi nityāḥ |
tacca sarvam ajñajñabhūtam, teṣāṃ karmaṇi apravṛtteḥ |
sudhā- pramandannaivāśālavyoḥ rājanagaraviśeṣasaṃjñatve sati anityasaṃyogāpatteḥ anyathā vyākhyānam |
X 'kiñcit vastu śvata eva vilakṣaṇam' iti nyāyena prapañcasya sadasadrūpatvopatteḥ |
yatra kvaśakya eva vidhīyamānasya kimaṃśapūraṇaṃ padāntareṇopanīyate yathā 'yuvaṃ hi svaḥ svarpatī' iti pratipran vidhīyamānaṃ vākyena dviyajamānena ṛjunā saṃbadhyate, tatra prakaraṇādyo yuktaḥ |
yathā ca dvādaśo- pasattvasya vidhīyamānasya kimaṃśapūraṇam adhīnaśabdaḥ karoti |
X kimu jñānasya duṣkaram iti nyāyaḥ |
kiñcamavahanti iti vinā'pi taṇḍulaiḥ prayogo dṛśyate avahanteḥ |
te hi nāstikāḥ kiṃ ṛtunā iti vadantaḥ na kiṃcit karma anutiṣṭhanti vā |
yathā 'kīṭako bhramaraṃ dhyāyan bhramaratvāya kalpate' evaṃ kīṭo bhramareṇa gṛhīta- stanmayā tamidhyāyaṃ tatsvarūpatāmeti, tathā hariharau premṇā'nyonyamabhidhyānādanyonyātmakatāṃ prāptāvitirthaḥ |

yathā nadīpravāhapatitāḥ kīṭā āvartadāvartānmaramāśu vrajanto duḥkhitāḥ santaḥ satkarma- paripākāt (pūrvo) rjanapuṇyakarmaparipākān) kṛpālunā kena cit puruṣaviśeṣeṇoddhṛtā nadīpravāhārdribhiḥ māritāḥ santaḥ tīrarucchāyyāṃ prāpya sukhaṃ yathā bhavanti tathā viśrāmyanti, tathaivāśu svakṛtakarmajanyaphalabhogāya manuṣyādiyoniṣu janmano janma vrajanto jīvāḥ saṃsārā-

nadagdhā duḥkhaṃ labhamānāḥ pūrvopārjitapuṇyakarmapari- pākādeva tatpradarśaneḥ pratyābhimukhabrahmacāriācāryā- sadguroḥ sakāśādupadeśaṃ tattvamasyādivākyārthajanya- jñānarūpamavāpya mokṣasukhaṃ prāpnuvantīti |
X 'kukarma sarvaṃ sarvasya phalayātmani sarvadā' iti nyāyaḥ |
kukkuṭaśca kukkuṭī ca kukkuṭī, śukraśca śukrī ca śukarī, evaṃ kṣīmaṃ vasānaśca vasānā ca vasānau |
kukkuṭāvāhanaṃ mithunaṃ kariṣyāmaḥ ityādipirūpasya arthakaraṇasāpekṣatvāt vilambaināvagatiḥ |
ādau laghurapi paścāt dīpo bhavati, tadatu sañjanamaitrī |
yathā kukkuṭadhvanihrasva- dīrghaplutabhedena krameṇa vardhate, tathā sādhumaitrī |
kukkuṭa- ite ukāre ekadinamātramavaśiṣṭeḥ akārādayo noktā iti sūtre śabdandeśvare iti |
ayaṃ svacchandaṃ kṛtvā tadanu tanmuktamevighātakakarmakaraṇaviṣaye pravartate |
yathā hastī snānaṃ kṛtvā jalāśayadādvirnirgamya svaśuṇḍā- daṇḍena dhūli nijaśarīraṃṣṭhopari kṣipati malinīkarotīti yāvat |
kuṭhārādīnāṃ chedanādau karaṇatvāt udyamanādau ca karmatvāt minnaviṣayatvena avirodhaḥ |

yathā kuṇḍadhāro hi kaścidyakṣo dhanārthe svaviṣayakopāsanaṃ kṛtavataḥ kasya citpatyakṣībhūya dhanādirūpapuruṣārthamalpaṃ mantrāntena saha devasaṃmati prāpya, devatāḥ prārthya, tapramādena jñānānuṣṭhāna- bhājanaṃ kṛtvā taṃ mokṣagāminamaroditi bhārate prasiddhaḥ |
sampādena mokṣopāyanānuṣṭhānādirodhirajastamonirāsārthamabhivṛddhi- dvārā cirāya mokṣaṃ saṃpādayantīti rāmānujīyā iti |
kuṇḍapāyināmayanam iti ka cit, kauṇḍa- pāyināmayanam iti ca ka cit vyapadiśyate |
ke. kuṇḍapāyināmayanam, 'māsamagnihotraṃ juhvati' ityā- ramya yāvat 'daśarātro mahāvratam udayanīyo'tirātraḥ' iti |
kuṇḍapāyināmayane paśau ādhvaryavam 'pariviraṃsi0' iti yūpaparigrahāṇamantre hotā paṭhet, 'yuvā suvāsāḥ 0' iti kriyamāṇapari- grahāṇānuvādena hotraṃ mantraṃ kaścit hotṛpuruṣaḥ paṭhet |
śrapaṇaṃ cāgnihotrasya śālāmulīye na syāt, prājahitasya vidyamānatvāt |
ādhyam- kuṇḍapāyināmayane agnihotre cintyate kiṃ tadīyasya dravyasya śālāmulīye śrapaṇam
tvāt upadeśataḥ prāptaḥ prājahitaḥ codakaprāptaṃ śālā- |
kāryāntare pravṛttatve'pi etatkāryasya pṛthagananuṣṭheyatvena mukhīyaṃ bādhate iti |
na ca bhāgadharmatvena pradhānāśritatvāt śālāmukhīyesya aśrutatvāt prakṛtitaḥ prāpyamāṇasya sahaiva prājahitena |
prābalyam, pradhānāśritasyāpi aheṣṭu kalpyatvena āśrita- prāpteḥ |
pāyināmayane pradhānatvena prakaraṇāntarādhikaraṇavārtike nanu kuṇḍapāyināmayanagatāgnihotre na codanāliṅgāti- |
vastustu nāyaṃ bhāgadharmaḥ, padārthavat deśena anyataḥ śrapaṇaprāptiḥ, tasya darvihomatvena apūrva- |
bhāgasyāpi svavākye śrutatvābhāvāt, yogyatā sākṣā- tvāt |
ataśca apūrvamāsāgnihotre paraiḥ nāmnā atideśo nāsti iti kṛtvācintyā |
vastutastu na kauṇḍa- adhikaraṇasya pravartitatvena nāmnā śrapaṇaprāptisaṃbhavāt |
api tasmāt prakṛtitaḥ prāpyamāṇasya saha prājahitena prāpteḥ |
mukhīyesya prakṛtau prakṛtāparvasaṃbandhigārhapatye eva vini- nāmnā atideśa eva nāsti iti kṛtvācintyā adhikaraṇaṃ |
tadatideśaprayatno pramāṇābhāvāt svātideśena prājahita- prāpyabhāvena 'kutra śrapaṇam' iti vicārasyaivānupapatteḥ |
