ata evātra mukhyaśravaṇābhāvāt nānye śravaṇadharmāḥ kāryāḥ |
api tu abhisaṃyogabhūtaḥ eva, 'pradhānaṃ nīyamānaṃ hi' iti nyāyeneti dhyeyam |
' prājāpatyaṃ caruṃ nirvapet ghṛte śatakṛṣṇalamāyu- ṣkāmaḥ ' iti śrūyate |
tatra kṛṣṇaleṣu apākaḥ pāko na syāt |
arthalopāt pākajanyasya vikalpasya arthasya prayojanasya lopāt asaṃbhavāt |
śatakṛṣṇale carau pākaḥ syāt ' ghṛte śrapayati ' iti pratyakṣeṇa vacanena śiṣṭatvāt vihitatvāt |
pradānavat yathā kṛṣṇamṛgajihvāparimitāṃ suvarṇaśakalānām anadanīyānāmapi vacanāt pradānaṃ bhavati tadatra |
tatra ca ' niravadhyantaḥ ( dantaiḥ pīḍāma- kurvantaḥ ) casrucupākāraṃ bhakṣyanti' iti |
bhāṣyam-- kṛṣṇalacarau saṃdehaḥ ye prakṛtau upastaraṇāmighāraṇe ' yadupastṛṇāti, abhighārayati, amṛtāhutimevaināṃ karoti ' iti, te upastaraṇāmighāraṇe kṛṣṇalacarau kartavye, neti |
' yadupastṛṇāti abhighārayati, amṛtāhutimevaināṃ karoti ' iti, amṛtena upamimānaḥ svādubhāvayati tayordarśayati |
na svādutā'rthaiḥ prakṛtau śrutaḥ svāduḥ kartavyaḥ iti |
akarma vā caturbhirāmivacanāt, saha pūrṇa puna- rabhyuttvattvam |
kutaḥ ? caturbhirāmivacanāt ' catvāri kṛṣṇa- lān yacchati ' iti |
tathā ca āmiṣavacanaṃ bhavati, ' catvāri kṛṣṇalānavyacati, caturavattasyāpye ' iti |
saha punaḥ upastaraṇāmighāraṇābhyāṃ pūrṇaṃ caturavattameva syāt |
mukhyā- vadānasya hi prakṛtau parimāṇamuktam ' aṅguṣṭhaparvamātraṃ devatānāmavadyati ' iti |
sa catuḥsaṃkhyayā anvabhūyate ' catvāri kṛṣṇalānavyacati ' iti |
na yāni catvāryavadānāni, tāni kṛṣṇalaparimāṇāni bhavantīti |
hiraṇyaparimāṇavacanaḥ eṣa kṛṣṇalaśabdaḥ, nā'sya parimāṇaṃ vaditumutsahete |
parimāṇaṃ yat prākṛtam, tasya kārye vartamānaṃ tat nivartayet |
yathā ' idaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ śākāmime śālayaḥ devadatto bhojyatām, devadattavat yaddastailena iti |
tailaṃ hi bhojane snehena upakaroti, tat snehanārthe prākṛtaṃ nivartayitumṛtam, na śakaṃ dadhi codanaṃ vā |
evamihāpi parimāṇaṃ mukhyāvadānaṃ parimimīte, na dravyaṃ nivartayet |
bhāṣyam-- caturṇāṃ ca ekaikāvadānatāṃ darśayati ' catvāri kṛṣṇalāni ekamavadānam ' iti |
bhāṣyam-- atha yaduktam āmiṣavacanaṃ bhavatīti, catuḥsaṃkhyāsaṃstutireṣā |
evaṃ catuḥsaṃkhyāyāḥ māhātmyam, yat ekasmin avadāne catvāri avadānāni bhavanti iti |
yathā ' yad vaiśvadevaḥ prātaḥsavanaṃ gṛhyate, prātaḥ- savane vā ( vai ) etad vaiśvadevaṃ saṃsthāpayati ' iti vaiśvadevasaṃstutiḥ, nānyasavananivṛttiḥ |
nahi vidyamānayoḥ upastaraṇāmighāraṇayoḥ tadāsicyatena kaścit saṃstvo'sti |
yadi avidyamānam āpadyati ityucyate, tato guṇavān ityucyate, tatra saṃstūyate |
atha vidyamānam āpadyati iti, anarthako bhavati ityuktaṃ bhavati, na saṃstvaḥ |
bhāṣyam-- tuśabdaḥ ' ātivacanāt nivṛttiḥ : upa- staraṇāmighāraṇayoḥ ' ityetat nivartayati |
yathā bhavān brūte, ātivacanāt liṅgāt nivṛttiḥ : etayoreti, evam ekāvadānavacanāt liṅgāt anivṛttiḥ : etayoḥ : iti liṅgavikalpaḥ |
liṅgavikalpaśca na ekāntataḥ nivṛttim ātivacanaṃ kartumarhati |
āti- vacane bādhite sati caturṣu kṛṣṇaleṣu sarvāvadānavikāreṣu abhyāso'narthakaḥ syāt ' catvāri catvāri kṛṣṇalān- vadyati samṛddhaye ' iti |
bhāṣyam-- atha matam, etanmamāpi sviṣṭakṛta- mapeyabhyāso bhavatīti |
( etat sūtradvayaṃ prāyaḥ sarvatraikaivena mudritaṃ nyāyyaṃ ca |
tatkālaṃ tu asmadīye mīmāṃsādarśane atraiva sūtre ṭippaṇyāṃ draṣṭavyam |
kutaḥ ? saṃsargaḥ : luci puroḍāśānāṃ sūkṣmāṇāṃ mā bhūditi
upastaraṇena suk liptīkriyate, abhighāraṇena haviḥ suci asaṃsṛktaṃ kṛtsnaṃ yathā agno patediti |
na tu viśadasya kṛṣṇalasya suci saṃyogo bhavati, yannimittam upa- staraṇamabhighāraṇaṃ ca snehārthe suvarṇasya kriyate |
tasmāt prākṛtasya prayojanasya nivṛttatvāt kṛṣṇaleṣu upastaraṇā- bhighāraṇe nivartitumahartaḥ |
soma— chutārthe śrapaṇamapi yadā kartavyam, tadā kiṃ vaktavyamasādhayoḥ upastaraṇābhighāraṇayoḥ ityuktānāt saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu- upastaraṇābhighāraṇayoḥ svādi- māryatvāt anuṣṭhāna syāt iti |
vi— 'upastarābhighārau stasteṣu no vā, dvayaṃ bhavet |
' bhāṭṭa— tatraiva upastarābhighāraṇe kārye na veti prakṛtau adṛṣṭārthatvāt kārye eva |
na ca 'upastṛṇā- bhighārayatyamutāhutimevaināṃ karoti' iti vākyaśeṣeṇa anayoḥ svādimārthatvātgateḥ kṛṣṇalānāṃ ca anadanīyatvena tadabhāvālopa iti vācyam |
yadyapi ca prakṛtau eṣāṃ nādṛṣṭārthatā kalpyate, kintu caturvattasaṃpattyarthataiva, tathāpi kṛṣṇalacarau alopaḥ |

na ca tathāpi 'catvāriccatvāri kṛṣṇalānya- vadyati caturvattatsāpyai' iti vacanena atradānānuvādena kṛṣṇalatṛṣkṛvidhanāt, tena ca caturvattasaṃpattyanuvādāt, prakṛtau avadyetyutkṣaṇānāpyavadyateḥ upastarābhighāraṇa- sādhanībhūtāsyetya bādhaḥ iti vācyam |
na ca svikṛdabhiprāyeṇānuvādaḥ, pramāṇabhāvāt, havīrūpakṛṣṇalacatuṣkṛvidhanāt asadṛṣṭa- dharvamātratvātpannasyāpi saṃbhavena pradhānamātre'pi vīpsā- papatteśca |
caturvattasaṃpattyanuvādastu kṛṣṇalatṛṣkṛdyavadāna- syāpi caturvattasaṃpadākatvam upastarābhighāraṇasāhāyyena astīti naiva lipte |
atha caturvattasaṃpattyarthatvā- dapi kartavya eva upastarābhighāraṇe |
nahi tayoḥ prakṛtau sūkṣmāṇāṃ puroḍāśāyavānāṃ suci saṃsargāpatteḥ āhavanīyapākāsaṃbhavena tadvādhārthatvāt, kṛṣṇaleṣu ca tadyasaṃsyabhāvāt lopaḥ iti vācyam |

tathātve upa- staraṇamabhighāraṇayoḥ anyatareṇāpi tasiddhā vā vikalpyapatteḥ, dhānāvā''dau saṃsargaprasaktyā tadanāpatteśca, prakṛtau caturvattasaṃpatyarthatvābhāve vapā''dau pañcāvadānādisiddhayartha- mabhighāraṇasya buddhayanāpatteśca |
iti prāpte, dṛṣṭārthatvāya asaṃsargaḥ eva tayoḥ prayojanam, na tu caturvattasaṃpattiḥ, tasya prakṛtau avahitatvāt |
'caturvattaṃ juhoti' ityatra avacchedena prakṣepo vidhīyate, catuḥpadaṃ tu upastaraṇā- camiprāyeṇānuvādaḥ, itarā viśiṣṭede vākyabhedāt gauravācca |
ataśca caturvattasya uddeśyatvenaiva aprasiddhau vidheyatvena sutarāṃ prasiddhaḥ na tatsaṃpatyarthā upastarābhi- ghāraṇayoḥ |
ataḥ asaṃsargamātrārthatvāt akaraṇaṃ kṛṣṇa- leṣu tayoriti mūlānuyāyinaḥ |
ata eva uddeśyatvānyā''nupapattyā caturva- dānasya vidhikalpanā |
ata eva vapāyāṃ sakṛdavadāna- vidhāne'pi prākṛtasya caturvattasya prāpteḥ 'yadyapi caturvattī' iti nirdeśaḥ saṃgacchate |
itarathā asaṃsagārthe sakṛdeva upastarābhighāraṇaprāpteḥ vyavacchiti nirdeśapatteḥ |
ataḥ upastarābhighāraṇayoḥ prakṛtau asaṃsargavat catuḥsaṃkhyā- saṃpattirapi prayojanam |
tatra tu etāvān viśeṣaḥ, asaṃsargasyaiva mukhyaprayojanatā vaitulyavat dṛṣṭārthatvāt, catuḥsaṃkhyā tatsattve eva |
ataśca yathaiva nāvaghātādayo vaitulyābhāve niyamāṣṭena prayujyate api tu tatsaṃbhave eva, tathā asaṃsargasyaivaprayojanasattve eva catuḥsaṃkhyāsaṃpatte upastarābhighāraṇe pratyaye, nānyathā |
ataśca kṛṣṇaleṣu niyamādṛṣṭārtham avaghātākaraṇavat catuḥsaṃkhyāsaṃpattye nopastarābhighāraṇakaraṇam |
evaṃ kevaladhānā''diyage'pi savanīyahaviḥṣu tatsaṃpattipradatvatākatvāt puroḍāśācārye tadanuṣṭhānam |
vapādyadādau tu katipayāvayanasaṃsargasyaiva saṃbhāvitatvāt tannivṛttyarthe tadāvaśyakatve pañcāvadānasaṃpattyai tadbuddhirapi kalpasṛkārādisaṃmatā saṃgacchate |
prakṛte tu saṃsargasya asaṃbhāvitatvāt prayuta upastarābhighāraṇe eva tatsaṃbhāvanāvicchittayoḥ |
prakṛtau vyādeśa āmnātaḥ 'idaṃ brahmaṇaḥ, idaṃ hotṛḥ, idamadhvaryoḥ, idamagnīdhaḥ |
sa iha kartavyo na kartavya iti saṃśayaḥ |
codakaprāptyā kartavya iti yasya buddhiḥ syāt, tasya nivṛttyarthe sūtram |
sa vibhāgamantareṇa na sidhyatīti vibhāgo bahusaṃbandhāya kriyate |
iha tu 'sarve brahmaṇa pariharati' iti ekasmai sarvaśaḥ |
kriyamāṇo'pi na prākṛtārthaḥ syāt, adṛṣṭārtha- meva kriyeta |
soma— yadi apanayamātraṃ vidhāya vacanasya cari- tārthatvāt na kālabādhaḥ, tarhi vyādeśo'pi na bādhaḥ ityutthiteḥ |
sūtrārthastu- ekārthatvāt 'idamasmai' ityevaṃrūpo vibhāgo na kartavyaḥ iti |
' bhāṭṭa— prakṛtau puroḍāśasya caturdhākaraṇaṃ barhiṣakaraṇaṃ ca vidhāya 'idaṃ brahmaṇaḥ, idaṃ hotṛḥ, idamadhvaryoḥ, idama- gnīdhaḥ |
' iti vyapadeśa āmnātaḥ, sa kṛṣṇaleṣu sarvasyaiva brahmaṇa bhakṣaṇīyatvāt kartavyaḥ |
nahi hotrādisaṃba- ndhābhāve 'idaṃ hotṛḥ' ityādipyadeśo yujyate |
na caivaṃ caturdhākaraṇasyāpi prayojanābhāvaḥ, sarvapariharaṇīya- deśena sahattvavidhānādeva tadāvaśyakatvāt |
yadi tu tattatkālakartavyabhakṣapariharaṇīyāmātre sahattvavihitamiti vibhāvyate, tadā mā''disu sūtrārasthā''dapi |
barhiṣakaraṇaṃ tu sūkṣmatvāt kṛṣṇalānāṃ caturthākaraṇacarakālābhāvācca nivartate ityanyadetat |
bhāṣyam— tatraiva śrūyate, 'ekadhā brahmaṇa pari- harati' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kimetat sahatvam, uta sakṛttvamiti |
kiṃ prāptam ? sakṛttvaṃ vā, sahatvaṃ vā, aniyama iti |
tathayā, yaḥ sakṛd gāḥ prāpayati, sa ekadhā prāpayatītyucyate |
evaṃ brahmabhakṣasya atrabhakṣasyāpi parihāraḥ kṛto bhavi- ṣyati |
itarasmin pakṣe kasya cidbrahmabhakṣasya parihāro na kriyate |
te iha codakena vihṛtā eva prāptāḥ |
nanu vācanika iha bhakṣaḥ aprākṛtaḥ, na prākṛtā vihṛtāḥ prāpnu- mantīti |
puruṣasaṃskārārthatvena na prāpnuvanti, dravyasaṃskārārthatvena tu prāpnuvantīti |
yadi prāpnuvanti, kimarthaṃ tarhi vacanamiti ? bhakṣopāyavidhānārtham |

ḍu— 'nanu vācanika iha bhakṣaḥ aprākṛtaḥ, na prākṛtā vihṛtāḥ (bhinnakālīnāḥ) prāpnuvanti' iti, ko'bhiprāyaḥ asya (bhāṣya-) granthasya ? (pūrvādhikaraṇe prītyarthā aprāpti prākṛtānāmuktvā kathamivānī prāpya- bhidhānam iti bhāvaḥ |
uttaram -) naite kartuṃskārārthāḥ (bhakṣāḥ) saḥ (kartā) atra guṇabhūtaḥ, pradhānabhūtā bhakṣāḥ |
kathaṃ (prāśitram ihām iti) dvitīyānto bhakṣaḥ (kriyā prati -)
pradhānabhūtaḥ m, kartā (tu) kriyāyāṃ guṇabhūta upādīyate adhvaryuta |
kṛṣṇam (hi) dravyam udaramakṣepeṇa saṃskriyate, na tu kartuḥ kṛṣṇasya saṃskāraḥ (nahi etāvatā tasya sāmarthyaṃ janyate) |
satyam, uktam (tu) dravyasya kṛṣṇasya saṃskāro na kartuḥ |
apica some (tikta- kaḍuke) atyantameva saṃskāro nāsti (pūtīkāna- mipreledam, na mukhyaṃ somam) |
apica (jāyatāṃ nāma karturapi saṃskāraḥ, tathāpi) kṛtaprayojanaṃ dravyaṃ pratipattimekṣate |
tasya yadi kartu- saṃskāro'pi (niyama -) prayojanaṃ (anuṣinipādi) bhavati, tathāpi sati avirohaḥ eva |
tasmāt prati- payryāḥ prākṛtā bhakṣāḥ kṛṣṇalasyeti prāpnuvanti iti teṣāṃ sahatvavidhānamupapannam |
kathaṃ tarhi pūrvādhikaraṇam, tatrāha -) yā cāsau (pūrvā) catuḥsūtrī sā anena nyāyena (viruddhā) pratyālayeyaiva (kṛtvācintayā) |
soma-- pūrvaṃ yathā vacanabalāt bhakṣaṇam, eva- mihāpi vacanasya sādhāraṇyāt talladanādityam : ityudhiteḥ saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu - brahmabhakṣāṇāṃ prakṛtau vihita- tvāt bhinnakālatvāt teṣām 'ekadhā' ityanena iha sahopahāro vidhīyate iti |
bhāṭṭa-- kṛṣṇalacaraiva 'ekadhā brahmaṇa upaharati' iti śrutam |

tatraikadhāśabdasya ekaprayatnasādhyatvāttve sakṛttve ekakālakatvāttve sahatve ca loke prayogāt kima- nena vidhīyate iti cintāyām, prakṛtau iḍāprāśitra- caturdhākaraṇaśakyavākakālabhakṣāṇāṃ madhye sakṛtvidhānāt ādyasyaiva karaṇam, itareṣāṃ nivṛttiḥ |
ityaniyeme prāpte, yata evāyaṃ vidhiḥ sādhāraṇaḥ, ata eva atideśena haviḥsaṃskārakatayā prāptānāṃ bhakṣāṇāṃ bādhe pramāṇābhāvāt sahatvameva sarveṣāṃ vidhīyate |
atra ca tattaccheṣabhakṣaṇārthānāṃ tattaddvārāṇā- meva uddeśena sāhitvaṃ vidhīyate, bhakṣaṇe nānākālītatvasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt |
brahmasaṃbandhaśca vakṣyamāṇatvena anuvāda iti na viśiṣṭadeśaḥ |
' kṛṣṇalacarau bhakṣaṇaṃ na bādhaḥ, succupākāreṇa tatsaṃbhavāt |
teṣu saṃśayaḥ : kṛṣṇalacarau te bhakṣāḥ : uta neti |
prītyarthe hi prakṛtau te kṛtāḥ, sāmarthyaṃ janayiṣyanti |
dup-- 'bhakṣāṇāṃ tu' ityādikeyaṃ catuḥsūtrī kartusaṃskārā bhakṣā ityetamarthe pratipādayati |
tasmāt (codakena) aprāpto bhakṣo vacanād vidhīyate hiraṇyasya |
(caturdhākaraṇānte tu 'yā'sau catuḥsūtrī (14-17), sā anena nyāyena viruddhā pratyākhyāyaiva' iti dupaṭīkāyāmuktam |
'niravadyanto bhakṣyanti', 'cuccupākāraṃ bhakṣyanti' iti prāpte bhakṣe bhakṣopāyaṃ vidhāsyati śabda iti |
itarathā makṣopāyaṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ ca vikṛtau vida- dhyāt, tatra vākyaṃ miyeta |
bhāṣyam-- na tvetadasti, prāpyate bhakṣāḥ iti, arthalopādeśāṃ nivṛttiḥ |
yattu bhakṣaṇe viśeṣavacanaṃ bhava- tīti, vacanādetat ājyasya bhaviṣyati |
niravadyanto bhakṣyanti ājyamiti, cuccupākāraṃ bhakṣyanti ājya- miti |
nirdhānaṃ cuccupākāraṃ cārthaprāptaṃ bhakṣyamāṇasya anudyate iti na vākyabhedaḥ |
vacanaṃ vā hiraṇyasya, pradānavadājyasya guṇabhūta- tvāt |
bhāṣyam-- satyam, vacanametat hiraṇyasya, na tu ājyasya |
kutaḥ ? bhakṣyanti ityetāvat śrūyate, na idaṃ vā tad vā iti |
tatra yat nirdiṣṭaṃ prakṛtam, tasya tena saṃbandho bhavati |
katham ? 'prājāpatyaṃ caruṃ nirvapeta' ite śatakṛṣṇalam' iti |
śatakṛṣṇalaśca atra kārya- saṃbandhāccucyate, tadviśeṣaṇārthena ghṛtam, na svanirdeśa- yaina |
tasmāt carudeva śabdāntareḥ saṃbadhyate, na ghṛtam |
tadyathā 'epa daṇḍaḥ iṣṭakākūṭe tiṣṭhati, prahara anena' iti, 'daṇḍena' iti gamyate, na 'iṣṭakākūṭena' iti |
evimāhi namaḥ bhakṣaṇavacane saṃbadhyate, na ghṛtam |
yathā teṣāmeva kṛṣṇalānām anadanīyānāṃ pradānaṃ kriyate, evamatrāpi draṣṭavyamiti |
soma-- yathā upastarābhidhāraṇayordvāralopāt anuñjanām, tathā bhakṣāṇāmapi tusirūpadvāralopāt anuñjanām ityudhiteḥ saṃgatiḥ |
vi-- 'makṣo nāstyatra vā teṣu, nāsti prītera- bhāvataḥ |
' iṣṭadaṇḍabhakṣaṇe tadasvīkāre ca yaḥ śabdaviśeṣaḥ, tasyā- nukaraṇaṃ cuccuyā iti |
śeṣapratipatyarthe'pi ca prayājaśeṣapanayena (4|1|4), kartuḥ kariṣyamāṇakarmaṇi balādhānārthā api, ityuktaṃ paṣṭhe (6|4|3) |
tatra ca pratipatteḥ prayojaka satvāt kṛṣṇaleṣu kartavyā eva te |
yadā tu kṛtvācintayā śuddhakartṛprītyarthalam, tadā te tatra bhavanti na vā iti cintāyām, kṛṣṇalānāmanadanīya- tvena prītyartho'pyājyavadalopādvādhaḥ |

na ca 'hiraṇyasya niravadyanto bhakṣyanti cuccupākāram' iti vacanena pratiprasavaḥ, yogyatā atra ājyasyaiva hiraṇyādhārasya bhakṣaṇavidhānāt 'hiraṇyasya niravadyantaḥ' ityasya hiraṇyaṃ tyaktvā ityarthāt |
yadā tu bhāṣyānusārāt 'hiraṇyasya' iti na paṭhyate tadā ājyasyaiva niravadyantaḥ dantāsaṃyogaḥ |
ata eva 'cuccupākāram' ityapi anuvādaḥ, ājyabhakṣaṇe tadāvaśyakatvāt |
ataśca aprāptamidaṃ bhakṣaṇam ārādupakārakam avi- karaṇībhūtajyāpratipattirvā, iti na tatra prākṛtabhakṣadharmāḥ kāryāḥ |
iti prāpte, pradhānavyānyasyābhyati hiraṇya- syaiva bhakṣaṇam, na tu ājyasya 'niravadyantaḥ' ityasya dantena pīdanakurvantaḥ ityarthāt |
sa ca cuccupā- kāratvaviśiṣṭasya pradhānavyānyāropeṇa pañcamavidhi- prakārasyāpi aṅgīkārāt |
vastutastu svasaṃskṛta- jyāprāyeṇa cuccupākāratvasyāpi anuvāda eva |
ataśca peṣaṇanyāyena (3|1|3) kāryā eva bhakṣadharmā bhakṣaśca |
kṛtvācintodghāṭane tu prāptabhakṣānuvādena danta- saṃyoga eva niṣidhyate iti vivekaḥ |
bhāṣyam-- kṛṣṇalacarau yugapadpadhataḥ sarve bhakṣāḥ brahmaṇā taccheṣakāle eva bhakṣaṇīyāḥ |
bhāṣyam-- tatraiva saṃdehaḥ samadhigate śeṣapanaye kimekasmin kāle sarve bhakṣa bhakṣayitavyāḥ, uta svasmin- svasmin kāle iti |
ato yat bhakṣaṇāya parihṛtam, tat anantaraṃ bhakṣayitavyameva |
jñā-- ( kṛṣṇalacarau ) kiṃ yugapadupehatānāṃ yugapadbhakṣaṇam, uta prakṛtivat nānākālaṃ bhakṣaṇam ( iti saṃśaye ) 'bhakṣārthau hyupahāro'to bhakṣo'pi yuga- padbhavet |
vi-- 'yugapat svatkāle vā tat sarvaṃ bhakṣaye- dayam |
bhaṭṭa-- sarveṣāṃ śeṣāṇāṃ yugapadupāsaṃhatānāṃ yugapadeva brahmaṇā bhakṣaṇam, uta tattatprākṛtakāle iti cintāyām, parihārasya bhakṣyārthatvāt tatraiva anena sahāntareṇa vidhīyate |
itarathā sarvatvasyāpi parihāramātre vidhānāpatteḥ puruṣāntarāṇāmapi bhakṣyāpattiḥ |

iti prāpte, sarvatvasya parihāramātre vidhau adṛṣṭārthatvātteṣu makṣe puruṣāntara- nivartakatvam, sahatvasya tu parihāramātre vidhāvapi adṛṣṭārtha- tvābhāvāt yugapat sarvaṃ brahmaṇe parihṛtya tattatkāle tena bhakṣaṇopapatteḥ na bhakṣca prākṛtakālabādhaḥ |
' ❀ kṛṣṇalacarau sarve śeṣabhakṣāḥ purupāntarebhyo- upanīya brahmaṇe pariharaṇīyāḥ |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ brahmabhakṣāṇāmeva eṣa parihāraḥ, uta puruṣebhyaḥ śeṣabhakṣaṇasya iti |

kathaṃ brahmabhakṣāṇāṃ parihāraḥ, kathaṃ vā śeṣabhakṣaṇam iti ? yadi brahmaṇe pariharatītyanyat sarvamiti vidhīyate, tato brahmaṇe sarvamiti vā anyat pariharatīti vidhīyate, tato brahmabhakṣāṇāṃ parihāraḥ |
atha sarvamiti lakṣayitvā brahmaṇe pariharatīti vidhīyate, pariharatīti vā lakṣayitvā sarve brahmaṇe iti, tataḥ śeṣabhakṣaṇyaḥ kiṃ prāptam ? sarvatvaṃ brahmabhakṣāṇāṃ syāt |
kutaḥ ? brahmaṇe pariharatīti prāptameva, na vidhīyate |
tatra kasya cidbhāgasya parihāraḥ prātaḥ, kasya cicca prātaḥ |
yasya ca na prāptaḥ, tasya parihāro vidhīyate |
yadi evamucyeta 'yat brahmaṇe pariharati, tat sarvam' iti, sarvameva hi tat vidhānam anarthakaṃ syāt |
atha 'yat brahmaṇe, tat sarvaṃ pariharati' iti, viśeṣasya anirdeśāt na brahmaśabdo viśeṣaṇam |
atha 'yat brahmaṇe sarvam, tat pariharati' iti, evamapi viśeṣyo naiva nirdiṣṭaḥ syāt |
'yat sarvam, tat pariharati' iti naivaṃ vacanamarhati |
tasmāt 'sarve brahmaṇe pariharati' iti brahmasambandhaḥ sarvasya vidhīyate caroḥ |

dup-- ( yaduktaṃ 'sarvaṃ vidhīyate' iti tatrāha -) yadi ( tāvat kevalaḥ ) brahmaśabdo'nuvādaḥ, sarvamiti vidhīyate ( yat brahmaṇe, tat sarvam iti ), tathā sati na jñāyate kiṃ ( tat ) sarvam ( yat ) vidhīyate |
atha yadi brahmaparihāraśabdo'nudyate ( yat brahmaṇe pariharati iti ), tathāpi sarvamiti na vidhīyate ( prāptatvāt ) |
yadā ( hi ) kasya cit bhāgasya parihāraḥ prātaḥ, kasya cicca, tadā vidhānamupapadyate |
sarveṣāṃ tu ( brahmabhāgānāṃ tena bhakṣayitavyatvāt ) prāpta eva parihāraḥ |

athāpi 'brahmaṇe sarvam' ( iti brahmapadaṃ sarvapadaṃ ca ) anyatra parihāraḥ ( vidhī- yate, yat brahmaṇe sarvam, tat pariharati iti ) tathāpi prathamapakṣo'pi doṣaḥ, sa tṛtīyo'pi ( pakṣe'smin prasajyate ) |
tasmāt siddhānte brahmapadaṃ vidhīyate ( na sarvapadam, nāpi pariharatipadam |
soma-- pūrveṇa yathāvacanaṃ codanāvirodhena nītam, evamihāpi ityukteḥ saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu-- teṣāṃ brahmabhakṣāṇāṃ sarvatvaṃ vidheyaṃ syāt, adhikārāt svarūpaṃ teṣāṃ codakataḥ prāptatvāt |
' bhaṭṭa-- tatraiva ( śatakṛṣṇalacarau ) 'sarve brahmaṇe pariharati' iti śrutam |
tadanena brahmabhāgasya sarvasya pariharaṇīyavidhāne, tasya vā pariharaṇīyasya sarvatvavidhāne viśeṣo'pekṣātaḥ vākyavaiyarthyācca sarvo- deśena brahmasambandho vidhīyate |
ata eva pūrvavākye parihārasya karmā- pekṣāyāṃ kṛṣṇalaśeṣasya pūrvakṛtasya prādhānyenopasthitasya anvitatvāt tatparihāra evāvaśyaḥ, na tu anyāhyādi- parihāraḥ |
athavā pariharaṇe'śenaiva brahmasambandhaḥ prakṛti- prāpteḥ pūrve vidhīyate |
tatphalaṃ cāvacchedakāvacchedena brahmasambandhavidhānāt brahmabhāgasya tatsambandhaprāptāvapi puruṣā- ntaramāgasya tatsambandhasiddhiḥ, sarvatvaṃ cānūdyate |
' ❀ kṛṣṇaviṣāṇāyā kaṇḍyanaṃ dvādaśāhai prathamāhe dīkṣāmārabhya uttamāhe dakṣiṇāyanaparyantam |
jyotiṣṭome mādhyaṃdine savane dakṣiṇādottaraṃ cātvāle prāsanam |
4|2|16, ❀ kṛṣṇaviṣāṇāyāḥ prāsanaṃ dvādaśāho ahargaṇe ananye evāhani, na prathame madhye vā |
utpattau yena saṃyuktaṃ vadarthaṃ tacchudvihetutvāt, tasyārthāntaragamane śeṣatvāt pratipattiḥ syāt |
viṣāṇāyāḥ kaṇḍyanaṃ prāsanaṃ cobhayamapi prayojakamiti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
ekaniṣṭhatveḥ sarvaṃ samaṃ syāditi uttaraḥ pakṣaḥ |
kaṇḍya- yane tṛtīyānirdeśāt viṣāṇāyā guṇabhāvaḥ, prāsane ca dvitīyānirdeśādadhanyatra ca kṛtārthatvāt prādhānyamiti |
śā-- 'kṛṣṇaviṣāṇāyā kaṇḍyate' iti vidhāya śrūyate 'cātvāle kṛṣṇaviṣāṇāṃ prāsyati' iti |
tatra saṃśayaḥ kiṃ cātvāle prāsanam arthakaṃ, uta pratipattiriti |
' soma-- arthakarmatvapratipattivicārasamāpyanantaraṃ pratipattereva asaṃbhāvitatvāt katham arthakarmatvaprati- pattivicāraḥ |
yadyapi agniprādhikaraṇe'pi pratipattivicāraḥ kriyate, tathāpi somalitanayasya arthakarmatve'pi arthābhidhānakarmatayā prayojakābhāvāt prakṛtyaparyantatvāt samāpta eva |

idaṃ sūtraṃ pūrvādhikaraṇe daṇḍapradānaṃ kṛṣṇaviṣāṇāprāsana- vat pratipattiḥ syāt iti pūrvapakṣe dṛṣṭāntīkṛtaprāsana- vaiṣamyatayā vyākhyāya kalantaḥ pātisakalakaṇḍyanasya viṣāṇākāryatayā prāsanamantaramapi kaṇḍyanasadbhāvena viṣāṇāyāḥ kṛtārthatvāt na prāsanaṃ pratipattiḥ |
iti pūrvapakṣaṃ kṛtvā dvitīyāsaṃyogāt prāsanaṃ pratipattiḥ |
na ca tāvatā viṣāṇāsaṃskāra eva prāsanamastu, na tu pratipattiḥ iti vācyam |
tathātve prāsanāt pūrvabhāviṣu kaṇḍyaneṣu kevalaviṣāṇāyāḥ viniyogaḥ, tadanantarabhāviṣu tu prāsana- saṃskṛtāyāḥ, iti 'viṣāṇāyā kaṇḍyate' iti vidhivairūpya-
itivat cātvālesaṃskāraḥ prāsanamastu, dvitīyā ca anī- |
ṇādiḥ taṇḍulanirvṛttyantaḥ eka padārthaḥ iti ayamasya |
sūtrāthastu- upapattisamaye yat yena saṃyuktam, tat |
ānupūrvye pāṭhakṛtaṃ sahatve sati upapadyate, padārthānāṃ |
ka niṣedhasyama ityapekṣā asyaiva iti pratipattiniyama- |
avaghātakālīnatadaṅgajādi- mantrāṇām adṛṣṭavidhayā upakārakatvena avayavatvānā- patteśca |
kiñca satyapi avayavatve kṛṣṇajināstaraṇadīnāṃ vihitatvena prayogavidhyupasaṃgraheṇa sāhityalāghaveḥ pratyekānusamayaḥ kiṃ na syāt |
evaṃ dravyadānasyāpi homavat haviḥsaṃskārakatvāt peṣaṇavaghātanyāyena (3|1|13) pratyekānusamayaḥ kiṃ na syāt |

satyapi kṛṣṇajināstaraṇadīnāṃ svatantravidhidhidheyatve aṅgatvena prayogavidhiprayojyatve vā avaghātādyaṅgatvena taddvāreṇa prayojyatvāvagamāt tadanusamayenaiva anusamayaḥ; iti na pratyekamanusamayaḥ; pratyekaṃ sāhityalāghaveḥ |
evaṃ parāvapaṇādiprakṣālaninayanantānāmapi taṇḍula- rūpāghātaphalopayogitā avaghātārthatvāt na pṛthak- dāryatā |
ata eva adṛṣṭārthamapi tadaṅgaṃ na pṛthakpadārthaḥ |
evamupastaraṇaderapi suci asaṃsargadvārā homārthatvāt na svātantryeṇa prayojyatā, iti na pṛthaganusamayaḥ |
dravyadānasya ca haviḥsaṃskārasyāpi avacchedena homavidhānāt lāghavena avacchetomasyaiva prayojyatvam |
ata eva padārthatvaṃ māna svātantryeṇa prayogavidhiviṣayatvam |
padārtha- vayavatvena samatānāṃ hi kṛṣṇajināstaraṇadīnāṃ na ava- ghātādiniṣṭhaprayuktiviṣayatvajñānaṃ vinā prayuktiviṣayatvaṃ jñāyate |

avaghātādīnāṃ tu nānyaniṣṭhaprayuktiviṣayatva- jñānottarakālatvaniyataṃ tajjñānam, prayogavidhinā aṅga- pradhānobhayaviśiṣṭabhāvanāprayuktijñāpanena aṅgaprayukterapi pradhānaprayukteranyathā'nupapattiprasūtatvāt |
ataśca yagyuktyanyathā'nupapattisattvenaiva yagyuktyaviṣayatvajñānam, sa tataḥ padārthāntaramiti siddham |
bhā. 5|2|7|13, kṛṣṇajinā- staraṇadiṇḍulaprakṣālaninayanantena anusamayaḥ; nānā- bījeṣu |
5|2|7|13-15. kṛṣṇadimīhibhiḥ somāraudrādau vihitaiḥ prākṛta- yavādīnāṃ bādhaḥ |
tataśca adhvarakalpā- yām āgneyavikāratvād ityasyaivacanavāpaḥ pūrvam, tataḥ upāṃśuyājājyavikārasārasvatajyānivāpaḥ |
na ca klṛpte upadyamāne kalpyaḥ śakyaḥ kalpayitum |
mā. 3|8|166, na ca klṛptamujjhitvā kalpanīyasaṃbandho nyāyaḥ |

rahasya. pṛ. 11. klṛpte sāmānyanvayaprakṛtamantravidhau viśeṣānvayavidhimātreṇa āgneyīvat vyarthatvopapatteḥ sāmānyaviśeṣānvayakalpanā SSpādakam āgneyī- mātragrahaṇaṃ na yuktam' ilanenaiva nyāyena prakṛta- mātragrahaṇarūpaviśeṣasiddhiḥ |
su. pṛ. 1123. klṛptayā rūḍhyā yogo bādhyate yathā rathakāraḥ iti |
( rathakāraśabdena rūḍhyā jātiviśeṣa grahaṇam, na tu 'rathaṃ karoti' iti yogena vaivarṇyasya iti ) bāla. pṛ. 144. klṛptayāṃ satyāṃ śrutiḥ kalpayituṃ na śakyate |
vā. 3|8|822 pṛ. 779. klṛptakalpanānyāyaḥ ( klṛptaṃ kalpyād balīyaḥ ) |
yadyapi pikenāmādipade mlecchaprasiddheḥ samudāyaprasiddhirūpā klṛptā ca, nigamadiprasiddhisu ava- yavaprasiddhirūpā kalpyā ca |
ataśca rathakārādhikaraṇanyāyena klṛptakalpanānyayena ca mlecchaprasiddhereva balīyastvaṃ bhavet |
tathāpi nigamadivāvaiyarthyāpatteḥ ānarthakyapratihata- nyāyena mlecchaprasiddhereva daurbalyamapyupagantuṃ yuktam |
parākramaḥ 26|2. klṛptajātivācitvena saṃskāranimittatvaṃ bādhyate yathā vahi~rājyapuroḍāśādau |
bāla. pṛ. 145. klṛptayogaṃ parityajya kalpyadravyāśrayogāt amīvairuṇī sviṣṭakṛcchandahitau vaktavyau |
bi. 10|4| 19. klṛptayogena saṃskāranimittatvaṃ bādhyate yathā prokṣaṇīśabde |
bāla. pṛ. 145, klṛptalakṣaṇayā aklṛptā lakṣaṇā bādhyate yathā 'ṛgbhiḥ prātardivi deva īyate |
' ityatra ṛgādiśabdānāṃ vedaparā lakṣaṇā klṛptā, 'uccairṛcā kriyate' ityatra ṛgādiśabdā eva vedaparāḥ, vedapadaṃ na ṛgādilakṣaṇam, tallakṣaṇāyāḥ aklṛptatvāt iti |
su. pṛ. 1200, klṛpto- pakārakatvena prākṛtānāmaṅgānāṃ nirākāṅkṣīkaraṇasāmarthye gṛhamedhīyādhikaraṇe vakṣyate |
ānu- mānikebhyaḥ prāktebhyaḥ prāk pratyakṣatvāt vaikṛtā- jñaprāpteḥ barhirlunāti ityādivā śrutvā prākṛtairvairhi- rudadeśena lavanavidhānāt sarvārthatvam, iti pūrvapakṣayitvā klṛptopakāraḥ |
iti nyāyena ānumānikatve'pi klṛptopa- kāratvāt prākṛtasaṃskāravidhau apūrvasya anudeśaḥ iti nirākṛtam |
su. 3|7 pṛ. 79. klṛptopakārajñāsaṃbhave kalpanāgauravāpāda- kāklṛptopakārāṅgānāṃ nākāṅkṣā iti nyāyaḥ 'nirdeśāttū' ( 3|8|16|13 ) ityadhikaraṇasya svarūpabhūtaḥ |
bhāṣyam-- vājapeye śrūyate 'klṛptīryajamānaṃ vācayati' 'ujjitīryajamānaṃ vācayati' iti |
atra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ jñaśca ajñaśca sarvo vācayitavyaḥ, uta jñaḥ eveti |
yo hi avidvān nāsau adhikṛtaḥ, sāmarthyābhāvāt |
nanu prayogakāle śikṣitā prayokṣyate, sāmarthyāt adhikriyateti |
kutaḥ ? anārabhya karmāṇi vedādhyayanaṃ śrūyate 'tasmāt svādhyāyo'dhyetavyaḥ' iti |
sati etasmin vacane 'agnihotraṃ juhuyāt' ityevamādibhiḥ vedo'dhyetavyaḥ iti etaduktaṃ bhavati iti na śakyate kalpayitum |
tatra homamātre codite vedādhyāyī śaktaḥ iti adhikriyate, nāvidvān |
kiyatā punaḥ vidite vidvān adhikriyate iti ? yāvatā vidite śakto bhavati yathoktaṃ kratum abhinivartayituṃ tāvat yo veda, sa tena kratunā adhikriyate |
nanu 'vedamadhīyīta' iti vacanāt kṛtsno vedaḥ adhyetavyaḥ iti bhavati, na vedādhyayane adhikriyate iti |
tatra anyasmin kratau kartavye anyakratujñānaṃ na dṛṣṭāya bhavati |
sarve kratavaḥ kathaṃ jñāyeran pṛthakpṛthak iti kṛtsnasya vedasya adhyayanaṃ śrūyate |
tena asvapadārthasya karmaṇi nāsti, kathamasau vācyeta |
tasmāt sādhu abhīdhīyate jñaḥ eva vācayitavyaḥ iti |
vā -- yatra 'yajamānaṃ vācayati' iti śrūyate, tatra avidvānpi ṛtvijāṃ śakyo vācayitum iti aniyamaḥ |
athavā vidvān svayameva brūyāt, tatra prayojakavyāpāryaivaṃ bhavet |
yadi kāmaśrutiparigṛhītaṃ vedādhyayanaṃ bhavet, tataḥ prayogakāle- 'pi adhyāpyeta, tasya ādhānavat anārabhya vidhīyate 'tasmāt svādhyāyo'dhyetavyaḥ' iti |
tathā sati ca arthāpyabhāvāt siddhamevedaṃ sarvakarmāṇi abhivat gṛhṇanti, na śikṣaṇaṃ prayujyate |
na ca śikṣito vedo bhavati ( atra aśikṣito vedo bhavati iti pāṭho yukto bhāti tathāpi

sudhāyām 'viśiṣṭānupūvīkasya akṣaraśauvaitvena klṛptyā- dimantrāṇām śikṣitasya vedatvābhāvāt vedātmakatvāmeva ca mantrāṇāṃ svādhyāyavidhisāmarthyāt karmāṅgatvamāvateḥ' iti avataraṇāt yathāmudrita eva pāṭhaḥ samīcīnaḥ- ke. ) |
tasmāt prāk karmaṇo ye mantrāḥ paṭhitāḥ, te aṅgatvaṃ pratipadyante iti nāviduṣaḥ adhikāro'tra |
śakyate ca tatrāpi praiṣāt prayojakavyāpārasya arthavattā, satyamāpi śaktau aprayukto na brūyāt iti |
tacca prayo- jakatvaṃ dehā bhavati, yadi vā śabdaśaḥ samarpyate, athavā 'brīhi' ityamidhīyate, iti yatheṣṭaṃ karma |
'kiyatā punaḥ viditena' ( iti bhāṣyaṃ ), vaiśeṣikādayaḥ svaśāstreṇāpi anadhigatena anadhikāraṃ vadanti iti spaṣṭanirūpaṇārthaṃ pṛcchati |
( vaiśeṣike 'athāto dharme vyākhyāsyāmaḥ' 1:1 iti svaśāstrasya dharmavyākhyārtha- syoktvā svaśāstrādhīno dharmādhikāra uktaḥ |
tatra vidvattāyāḥ śaktyupapādanadvāreṇa pratyakṣeṇaiva upakāritvāt 'yāvatā viditena' ityāha ( bhāṣyakāraḥ ) |

yadyapi svādhyāyagrahaṇe sakalo vedaḥ parigṛhītaḥ, tathāpi darśapūrṇamāsau kurvāṇasya jyotiṣṭomamantrabrāhmaṇaṃ na ka- vidupuyujyate iti amadapi nādhikāraṃ vyāvarttayati, iṣṭi- vedenaiva yogyatāyāḥ siddhatvāt |
yat asau sakalaḥ paṭhyate, tad nitya- kāmya- naimittikānāṃ karmaṇāṃ yathoppannakālatvāt na jñāyate 'katarat kadā kariṣyate' iti |
tatra kadā cit yat na paṭhitaṃ taphalaprārthanānimittaṃ vā asyopajāyate, tatra tadavidvatvāt ( tasya vidvān tadvidvān, na tadvidvān tada- vidvān, tasya bhāvaḥ tadvidvatvam, tasmāt iti vigrahaḥ |
tadānīṃ vā adhīyatasya vratanimamavadadhyayanāsaṃbhavāt, karmamiśra viśiṣṭakiyo- pāttavedanirākāṅkṣaiḥ tādṛśasya agrahaṇāt vaiguṇyaprasaṅgaḥ |
kāmaśrutyaparigrahāt sarvaiḥ anārabhyavādavidhīto vedaḥ apekṣitaḥ, ityavaśyaṃ brahmacaryakāle eva samasto vedo'- dhyetavyaḥ |
yadi tu kaścit aśakto nādhīte sakalam, agnihotradarśapūrṇamāsamātram ( tu ) kathañcit adhigacchati, na tasya tatra anadhikāraḥ |

pṛ. 131, kratvarthe pravṛttinivṛttyamarūpaṃ vaidikaṃ karma yathā 'yajatiṣu yeyajāmahaṃ karoti nānuyājeṣu' iti |
'nārvaidhaṃ vṛṇīte na hotāraṃ vṛṇīte' iti pṛ. 86. kratvarthe śyena kārayitavyaṃ śukrānbārambhādi, sarvasmire yajamāne dvidhā gati gate'pi |
vi. 4|1|2, kratvarthaḥ cakṣuṣoḥ saṃskāraḥ añjanaṃ jyotiṣṭome, na phalaprayuktaḥ |
bhā. 12|1|4|129. kratvarthaḥ samuccayaḥ nyāyagamyaḥ, vācanikaḥ; aicchikaśca pratyekaṃ pañcadaśavidhaḥ |
bhā. 4|1|2|2 varṇakaṃ 1, kratvarthān padārthān prayogavacanaḥ prāpayati |
5|1|10|7. kratvarthena grahaṇe devatāḥ saṃyuktāḥ, tā yāgamilapanti, yāgo'pi devatā'milādhī |
ṭupa. 8|1|3|2. kratvarthānām anuṣṭhānam asthisthasya mṛtādhikāraka- tvapakṣe |
bhā 10|2|1|159. kratvarthānāṃ kratuniṣṭhā- danavyatirekeṇa phalākāṅkṣayā abhāvaḥ |
vi. 4|1|1. kratvarthānāṃ naimittikānāṃ nimittāvṛttau āvṛttiḥ yathā bhedanasakandanāyāvṛttau prāyaścittā- vṛttiḥ |
bhāṣyam - 'mine juhoti' 'skanne juhoti' iti darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ śrūyate |
sakṛt mine skanne ca hutvā kṛtārthaḥ; uta minemine, skanneskanne ceti |
yaḥ pūrvatra pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ, sa iha pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
śā-- yuktaṃ puruṣārtheṣu naimittikepu nimittāvṛttau āvṛttiriti |
tatra hi (agnihotrādau) pratyāvṛtti phalam anyadanyacca niṣpadyate |
kratvartheṣu tu medanahomādiṣu kratupakārasyaiva sādhyatvāt sakṛtkṛtenaiva tatsiddheḥ |
ekasmin prayoge medanādyattāvapi na homāvṛttiḥ iti viśeṣaṃ manvānasyottaram, eṣāmapi nimittāvṛttau āvṛttiriti |

ekasmin prayoge medanānte yadi tāvat homāt pūrvaṃ tadanekatā, tadā ayamamānaviśeṣatvāt aśvapratigraheṣṭivacca tāvacchandābhāvāt tantreṇaiva homakaraṇe- 'pi, homottaraṃ tadanekatave naimittikāvṛttiḥ syādeva |
na ca tatra kratunajyāpavaupteḥ pūrvaṃ homajanyādṛṣṭasya sattvāt tenaiva prasaṅgasiddhayāśaṅkā, tathāmye nimitte sati naimitta- kākaraṇe nimittavyāghātāt |
ata eva nimittābhāve homābhāve'pi kratukārasiddheḥ; tatastacce tadanuṣṭhānena, tadādyutta ādyuttyeti bodhyam |
bhāṭṭa. 4|1|2 pṛ. 82 paṃ. 23, 24. kratvarthatvaṃ payovratā- dīnāṃ jyotiṣṭome, 'payovrataṃ brāhmaṇasya, yavāgū rājanyasya, āmiṣā vaiśyasya' iti |
bhāṭṭa. 4|1|2 pṛ. 82. kratvarthatve hi sati anta- reṇāpi kāmapadopabandhaṃ tadupakārakameva etadartham iti vijñāyate |
vā. 3|6|16|43 pṛ. 1067. kratvarthatva- vyavahāraḥ kratupakārakatva- meṇāpi asmin śāstre
su. pṛ. 1395. kratvarthe naimittikānāṃ nimittāvṛttau āvṛttiḥ (iti śīrṣakam) |
tatra athātaḥ śabdo prathamādhyāye prathamasūtre varṇitau |
ṭupa - tṛtīyena avaghṛte śeṣatve kaḥ kratvarthaḥ, kaḥ puruṣārthaḥ iti viśeṣaḥ cintyate pūrvam avaghṛte sāmānye |
yathā mamamena sāmānyātideśe siddhe ahamena viśeṣātideśaḥ cintyate |
athavā 'athai samavaiṣamyam' (4|1|8|22) iti (upakramya) prayojakaprayojyakatvaṃ yat, tat atādhāraṇaṃ cintyate |
bhāṣyakāraśca idameva abhiprāya āha (arthe samavaiṣamyam iti sūtre) 'ati- krāntaḥ tṛtīyaviṣayaḥ' iti |
pañcame ca (prathame sūtre) asādhāraṇyaiva evaṃ vyapadeśye 'prayojakāprayojakatvalakṣaṇaṃ vṛttam' iti |

soma - kratvarthatve kratuprayuktatvam, puruṣārthatve tanpra- yuktatvam, ekatvādeḥ yathājñatvam, sthidṛ- kṛdādau tyāgāṃśe apūrvasyaiva tadapyukatvam, niyamavidhau sati daśādernidhamena samadeśādiprayuktatvam, apāpaśloka- śravaṇādīnāṃ phalavidhitve parṇamayatvādīnāṃ phalaprayuktatvam arthavāde tu kratuprayuktatvam, viśvajidādīnāṃ aphalatve prayuktatve durlabhaṃ phalavattve tanprayuktatvam, darśapūrṇamāsā- myāmiṣṭvā ityamya kālādhatve somasya na darśapūrṇamāsa- prayuktatvam, sautrā maṇyādāveḥ abhyañjanatve tatayuktatvam, anumalyādīnāṃ videvanadīnāṃ ca samaprādhānye sarveṣāṃ phalameva prayojakaṃ videvanadīnāmajñatve kratuprayuktatvam ityādi- rūpeṇa sarvasmin adhyāye prayuktitveva cintitā |
yadā prāyeṇa puruṣārthaḥ prayojakaḥ iti puruṣārthaśabdena prayojako lakṣyate, kratvarthaśabdena ca tatpratipakṣavācakena aprayojako lakṣyate iti sūtrayojanā |
prābhākarāstu upādānādyaṃ śrutyādibhiritike śeṣatve pramāṇāntaramasti ityavagamāt upādānākhyapramāṇagamyaṃ śeṣatva- prayukti- adhikāra-utpattyākhyaṃ caturthyadhyāyaḥ iti vadanti |
vi - 'cintā na kāryā kāryā vā kratvarthapuruṣārthayoḥ |
' 1 varṇakaṃ 1. bhāṭṭa - evaṃ siddhe śeṣinirūpite śeṣatve prayojakarūpitaṃ prayojyatvamidānīṃ nirūpyate |

atra ca yadyapi na prayojyatvācchedena tannirūpaṇaṃ prati śeṣatvanirūpaṇasya hetutvam, nimittādyanabhāve'pi naimittikasya tatraprayojyatvena aṅgatve vyāpakatvasya puroḍāśakalpatve; tuṣṭopavāpaṃ prati kārakātvena aṅgatva- sattve'pi tatprayojyatvābhāvena vyāpyatvāpi abhāvāt |

ato na avacchedakatvacchedena hetuhetumadbhāva, tathāpi ka cit dadhyāyanadiniprayogādyutpannanirūpaṇe tannipraśeṣatva- nirūpaṇasya upayogāt sāmānyādhikaraṇyena tannirūpaṇaṃ prati aṅgatvanirūpaṇasya hetutvāt saṅgatyupapattiḥ |
atra prayojyatvaṃ ka cin kratvarthapuruṣārthavicāradāreṇa, ka cidvidanadvāreṇa nirūpyate, ka citsākṣādeveti prayojyatva-
kratvarthapuruṣārthatvaṃ tu tṛtīyasiddhamapi udāharaṇaviśeṣaniṣṭhatayā prayojyasiddhayarthe vicāryate iti vivekaḥ |
yasmin prītiḥ puruṣasya, tasya lisā'rtha- lakṣaṇaḥ, 'vibhaktatvāt |
bhāṣyam- aya kilakṣaṇaḥ kratvarthaḥ, kilakṣaṇaḥ puruṣārthaḥ iti lakṣaṇaṃ vācyam |
tathāhi laghīyasī pratipattiḥ, pṛṣṭhākoṭina upadeśe garīyasī |
(bhūmiṃgatānā- manekeṣāṃ dravyāṇāṃ pratyekaṃ sparśana pradarśanaṃ karttavye pṛṣṭasya ākoṭaḥ kuṭīlīkaraṇaṃ karttavyaṃ bhavati, iti gauravam |
yasmin prītiḥ puruṣasya, yasmin kṛte padārthe puruṣasya prītirbhavati, sa puruṣārthaḥ padārthaḥ |
tasya lipsā arthena bhavati, na śāstreṇa |
avibhakto hi puruṣārthaḥ prītyoḥ : prītisādhanaḥ, sa puruṣārthaḥ |
puruṣārthe lakṣite tadviparīta: kratvartha iti kratvarthasya lakṣaṇaṃ siddham |
dup- ( bhāṣyamākṣipatti-) yasmin kṛte padārthe puruṣasya prītirutpadyate (svargādilakṣaṇā), sa puruṣārthaḥ padārthaḥ : (darśapūrṇamāsādiḥ |
kimukaṃ bhavati ? yadi lipsā'rthena anuṣṭhāna- mucyate, tat ayuktam |
nahi kratvarthāni vidhinā balāt puruṣaḥ pravartate |
kintu puruṣārthe karaṇam icchataḥ, na niyogataḥ |
kratvarthe tu anicchāto niyogataḥ ! tena karaṇamabhipretya uktam, 'tasya lipsā arthalakṣaṇā' iti |
duḥkhakārakatvāt kathaṃ yāgaḥ puruṣārthaḥ ? sādhyena avinābhāvāt sādhanasya puruṣārthatā uktā |
kratvarthaniṣedheṣu ca uktavidhayā kratvaiguṇyaparihārodeśena nivṛttavidheyatvāt nānyathā |
'nātirātre' ityādau ca ṛtusādguṇyasya aṅgāntarajanye- 'pi ṣoḍaśigrahaṇābhāva prati uddeśyatvāvidhātāt sā |
' 2. kratvarthapuruṣārthobhayarūpaṃ pravṛttitparūpaṃ vaidikaṃ karma yathā adhyayanam ādhānaṃ ca |
bāla. pṛ. 81. kratvarthalakṣaṇamuktam 'asaṃyutaṃ prakaraṇāt' (3|1|4) ityanena śrutyādibhirvedasaṃyutaṃ phalavatā ca ṛtunā prakaraṇe gṛhyate, tatra kratvartham iti |
pu. 5|1|1|1 pṛ. 1287. kratvarthavikalpabhedāḥ : nyāyagamyāḥ vācanikāśca 'vikalpabhedanirūpaṇam' iti vindo bālamīmāṃsāprakāśe draṣṭavyāḥ |
vi. 5|1|1 varṇakaṃ 2. kramaḥ na kaścit pāṭhādiniyamitaḥ kāmānyaṃ naimitti- kānāṃ ca karmaṇāmanuṣṭhāne |
yathā 'vedaṃ kṛtvā vediṃ karoti' ityatra vedakaraṇapratiyogikamānantaryaṃ vedi- karaṇavṛtti |
atra ca darśapūrṇamāsatvasyāpi somāṅga- tvāt tad-vyāvṛttyartham avyavahita iti viśeṣaṇam |
tatra darśapūrṇamāsapūrvakālikatvamātraṃ kvāprāptyartham ; na tu avyavahitatvaṃ'pi |
na ca somavidhestadapekṣā, yena anyathāne eva tat paryavasyet, somavidheḥ bhinnaprayoga- vidhirvidheyadarśapūrṇamāsapratiyogikakramasāpekṣatvāt |
ata- satra uttarakālatvameva vidheyam, na kramaḥ |

kramaśca sarvatra uttarapadārthāṅgaṃ tatraiva 'kāhaṃ kartavyaḥ' ityapekṣāt, na tu pūrvapadārthāṅgam 'maduttaraṃ kaḥ padārthaḥ kartavyaḥ' ityapekṣāyāḥ kramaviśeṣaṇaṃ darśapūrṇamāsādireva pūrvakālatayā |
etena ubhayapārthārtharūpo'pi kramaḥ padārthadvayāhagam iti keṣāṃ ciduktam apāstam, pramāṇābhāvāt |
'tattatpadārthānantaraṃ tat tattathā' ityevam anekapadārtha- vṛttipaurvāparyasamudāyalakṣitatvena kramaḥ |
iti mūloktaḥ pakṣaḥ aśābdatvāt vikṛtī ca cit ekapadārthalope tāvatpadārthavṛttipaurvāparyasamudāyasya asambhavāt, nyukta- meṇā'nuṣṭhāne'pi vaiguṇyānāpatteḥ upekṣitaḥ |
tatra śrautaḥ kramaḥ : prāti- sikavidhinā vidhīyate |
vastutastu śrautakramasthale kannā''dinā abhyate : utpannasya vākyena viniyogaḥ |
kramantare tu arthādinā utpannasya prakaraṇādisiddhaśrutyā viniyogaḥ |
yujyate ca kramasyāpi dravyaguṇādivat padārthaviśeṣaṇatvena vidhānam |
bhāṭṭa. 5|1|1 pṛ. 153. kramaḥ nāma vitativiśeṣaḥ : paurvāparyarūpo vā |
tatra ca ṣaṭ pramāṇāni śruti-artha-pāṭha-sthāna-mukhya- pravṛttyākhyāni |
tatra 'vedaṃ kṛtvā vediṃ karoti' iti kevalakramaparam, vedikaraṇādeḥ vacanāntareṇa vihitatvāt |
iti tu kramaviśiṣṭapadārthaparam, ekaprasaratābhaṅgabhayena makṣānuvādena kramamātrasya vidhātumaśakyatvāt |
seyaṃ śrutiḥ : itarapramāṇapekṣā balavatī, teṣāṃ vacanakalanādvārā kramapramāṇatvāt |
ata eva āśvinasya pāṭhakramāt tṛtīyasthāne grahaṇamapamaktau 'āśvino daśamo gṛhyate' iti vacanāt daśamasthāne grahaṇamityuktam |
yatra tu prayo- janavaśene nirṇayaḥ, sa ārthaḥ kramaḥ |
atra hi yatrāgnyāḥ : homāryatvena tāpākaḥ prayojanavaśene pūrvamanuṣṭhīyate |
nahi homānantaraṃ kriyamāṇasya kiñcit dṛṣṭaṃ prayojanamasti |
yena hi krameṇa vākyāni paṭhitāni tenaiva krameṇādhītāni artha- pratyayaṃ janayanti, yathā'rthapratyayaṃ ca padārthānāmanuṣṭhānāt |
tatra āgneyāgnīṣomayora ( puroḍāśayoḥ ) tattadyājyā'nu- vākyākramāt yaḥ kramaḥ āśrīyete, sa mantrapāṭhān |
sa cāyaṃ mantrapāṭho brāhmaṇapāṭhād balavān, anuṣṭhāne brāhmaṇavākyāpekṣayā mantravākyasya antaraṅgatvāt |
brāhmaṇa- vākyaṃ hi prayogāt bahireva 'idamevaṃ kartavyam' ityeva- manubodhya kṛtārtham, iti na punaḥ prayogakāle nyāyyite |
mantrāḥ punaḥ ananyaprayojanāḥ prayogasametārthasmārakāḥ iti vakṣyāmaḥ |
tena anuṣṭhānakramasya svarūpākramādhīna- tvāt, tatkramasya ca mantrakramādhīnatvāt antaraṅgo mantra- pāṭhaḥ itarasmāt atibalavān |
ata eva āgneyāgnī- ṣomayorayoḥ : brāhmaṇapāṭhāt ādau agnīṣomīyasthānaṃ pañcā- dāgneyānuṣṭhānam ityevaṃ kramaṃ bādhitvā ādau āgneyānuṣṭhānaṃ paścāt agnīṣomīya ityevaṃ kramaḥ ityu- ktam |
prajājānām 'samidho yajati' 'tanūnapātaṃ yajati' ityevaṃ vidhāyakavākyakramāt yaḥ kramaḥ, sa brāhmaṇapāṭha- kramaḥ |
atra ca yadyapi brāhmaṇavākyāni artha vidhāya kṛtārthāni, tathāpi prajājānāṃ smārakāntarasyābhāvāt tānyeva smārakatavena svīkriyante |
tathā ca yena krameṇa tāni adhītāni tenaiva krameṇa arthasmaraṇaṃ janayanti, iti yuktaṃ tenaiva krameṇa teṣāmanuṣṭhānamiti |
kiñca yathārtha- smārakā mantrena sannaye yathā tūṣṇīṃvihiteṣu karmasu, teṣāṃ kramo brāhmaṇapāṭhakramāt, tatra teṣāmeva prayogasama- vetārthasmāra-katvāt |
prajājādāharaṇaṃ tu kṛtvācintayā, tatra brāhmaṇavākyānāṃ prayogamavetārthasmārakatvābhāvāt |
yathā āhuḥ arthavādacaraṇe vārtikakārāḥ 'prajājādivākyāni artha mamarthaṃ caritāryāni svarūpasparśa satyapi prayojakatāṃ na pratipadyante' iti |
tasmāt samantrakakarmaṇāṃ pāṭhakramo mantrapāṭhāt, amantrakakramastu brāhmaṇapāṭhakramādeva iti |
prakṛtau nānādeśānāṃ padārthānāṃ vikṛtau vacanā- dekasmin deśe anuṣṭhāne kartavye yasya deśe anuṣṭhīyante, tasya prathamamanuṣṭhānam, itarayośca paścāt, ayaṃ yaḥ kramaḥ sa sthānakramaḥ |
yasya hi deśe yo'nuṣṭhīyate, tatpūrvatanaṃ padārthe kṛte sa eva prathamamupasthito bhavati, iti yuktaṃ tasya prathamamanuṣṭhānam |

ata eva sādyaske agnīṣomīyasavaniyānubandhānāṃ savanīyadeśe sahānuṣṭhāne kartavye ādau savanīyaporanuṣṭhānam, tasmin deśe āśvinagrahaṇāt anantaraṃ savanīyasyaiva prathamamupasthiteḥ, itarayostu paścāt |
prakṛtau 'āśvinaṃ grahaṃ gṛhītvā, vibhrutā yūyaṃ parivīya, āgneyaṃ savanīyaṃ paśumupākaroti' ityāśvinagrahaṇāt anantaraṃ tasya vihitatvāt |
tathā ca sādyaske'pi āśvinagrahaṇe kṛte savanīya eva etaupasthito bhavati, iti yuktaṃ tasya sthānāt prathamamanuṣṭhānam, itarayośca paścāt |
pradhānakrameṇa yaḥ aṅgānāṃ krama āśrīyate, sa mukhyakramaḥ |

yena hi krameṇa pradhānāni kriyante, tenaiva cet krameṇa teṣā- maṅgāni anuṣṭhīyante, tadā sarveṣāṃ samānaṃ svapradhānaiḥ tulyaṃ vyavadhānaṃ bhavati, vyutkrameṇa tu anuṣṭhāne keṣāṃ cidaṅgānāṃ svaiḥ pradhānaiḥ atyantambyavadhānam, anyeṣāma atyantaṃ vyavadhānaṃ syāt, taccāyuktam, prayogavidhivagatasāhitya- bādhāpatteḥ |
ata eva prayājaśeṣeṇa ādau āgneyaviṣaḥ abhighāraṇam, paścādaindrasya dadhnaḥ, āgneyayāgendrayāgayoḥ pautraparyāt |
ataśca ādau āgneyahavirbhighāraṇam, tataḥ aindrasya haviṣaḥ, tataḥ āgneyayāgaḥ, tataśca aindro yāgaḥ ityevaṃ kramo mukhyakramāt siddho bhavati |
ato yuktaḥ prayājaśeṣābhi- ghāraṇasya mukhyakramāt kramaḥ iti |
pāṭha- kramastu nirapekṣasvādhyāyapāṭhakramamātrasāpekṣatayā na tathā (vilambitapratipattiḥ ) iti balavān |
ata eva āgneya- upāṃśuyāja- agnīṣomīyāṇāṃ krameṇa anuṣṭhīya- mānānāmapi upāṃśuyājājyanivāpaḥ mukhyakramāt na pūrva- manuṣṭhīyate tasya durbalatvāt, pāṭhakramāt paścādanuṣṭhīyate
sa cāyaṃ mukhyakramaḥ pravṛttikramāt bala- vān |
pravṛttikrame hi āśrīyāmāṇe bahūnāṃmajñānāṃ pradhāna- viprakarṣo bhavati |
tadyathā darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ ādau āgneyānuṣṭhānam, tataḥ sāṃnāyyam |

tatra yadi pravṛttikramamāśritya taddharmāḥ sarve pūrvamanuṣṭhīyeran, tataḥ āgneyadharmāḥ, tataḥ āgneyānuṣṭhānam, tataḥ sāṃnā- yyānuṣṭhānam, tadā taddharmāṇāṃ svapradhānena saha dvābhyām āgneyadharmatadanuṣṭhānābhyāṃ viprakarṣaḥ syāt |

yadā tu sāṃnāyyadharmāṇāṃ keṣāṃ cit pūrvamanuṣṭhāna'pi anye sarve mukhyakramamāśritya āgneyadharmānāntaram anuṣṭhīyante, tadā sarveṣām āgneyadharmasāṃnāyyadharmāṇām ekenaiva vijātīyena vyavadhānaṃ bhavati, āgneyadharmāṇāṃ svapradhānena saha āgneyānuṣṭhānena vyavadhānāt iti na viprakarṣaḥ |
sahaprayujyamāneṣu pradhāneṣu saṃnipātānāmaṅgānām āvṛttyā anuṣṭhāne kartavye dvitīyādipārthānāṃ prathamānu- ṣṭhitapadārthakramāt yaḥ kramaḥ, sa pravṛttikramaḥ |
prājāpatyāḥ hi 'vaiśvadevī kṛtvā prājāpatyaiścaranti' iti vākyena tṛtīyādeśāt seti- kartavyatākāḥ ekakālatvena vihitāḥ |
atasteṣāṃ tada- ṅgānāṃ ca upakāraṇaniyojanaprabhṛtīnāṃ sāhityaṃ saṃpadanī- yam |
ataḥ prājāpatyeṣu eka padārthe (upakaraṇaṃ) sarvatrā- nuṣṭhāya dvitīyaḥ padārtho'nuṣṭheyaḥ |
tatra prathamapadārthānuṣṭhānaṃ kasmāccit paśoḥ (icchayā) ārabhya kartavyam |
dvitīyastu padārthaḥ, yena krameṇa prathama'nuṣṭhitaḥ, tenaiva krameṇa anuṣṭheyaḥ |
tat siddhaṃ prathamānuṣṭhitapadārthakramāt yo dvitīyapadārthakramaḥ sa pravṛttikrama iti |
( atra sarvo grantho na gṛhītaḥ kintu madhyamyamyupayukta- meveti dhyeyam |
) mīnyā. pṛ. 224-235. kramaḥ padārthānāṃ guṇabhūto bhavati |

bhā. 7|1|2|1 pṛ. 1524. kramaḥ bhinnaprayogatāmānāpi karmamantrāṇāṃ upakārakatvārakāṇāṃ brāhmaṇādyaiḥ karmabhiḥ mantra- saṃhitā'dhīteṣu mantreṣu upakārakatvena, mantraiśca karmasu upa- kāryatvena, ālocyamāneṣu ādita ārabhya ālocanāt ādyagranthadeśādhītayoḥ karmamantrayoḥ anyonyam, dvitīyadeśādhītayośca anyonyam, ityevaṃ krameṇa buddhau viparivṛtteḥ sarvasvasaṃvedatvena apahavāyogāt pāṭhasādeśyadheyataḥ krama'sti |
śrutiliṅgavākyaprakaraṇavat kramaśca, kramo'pi aṅgāṅgi- bhāve pramāṇaṃ bhavati |
ka cit deśaḥ sthānam ubhayoḥ samānaṃ bhavati |
ka cit ubhayorapi ekasmin deśe pāṭho bhavati |
yathā darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ anumantraṇamantrāṭhe 'agneraham' iti prathamaḥ paṭhyate, 'dadhirasi' iti dvitīyaḥ paṭhyate |
tenaiva krameṇa prathamam āgneyayāgaḥ, tata upāṃśuyājaḥ iti niyamaḥ |
tena ca 'eco'yavāyāvaḥ' iti ekārasya sthāne ay, okārasya av, aikārasya āy, aukārasya āv ityādeśā bhavanti avi pare tathaivāyaṃ sthānakramaḥ |
kaṇikā. pṛ. 421. kramaḥ sādeya-sthānāparaparyāyo dvividhaḥ anuṣṭhānasādeyaṃ pāṭhasādeyañceti |
yatra phalavat ekaṃ samāmnātam, svalāntare ca anaārabhya- vidhayā aphalamāradāpakārakam |
tasyobhayorapi vacana- dayāta svatantraikakālakartavyatā, tatra tasyāphalasya phalava- daṅgatvam anuṣṭhānasādeyāt iti |
tacca phalavato darvi- homatvena apūrvatve ubhayākāṅkṣyā, vikṛtitve tu anya- tarākāṅkṣyeti |
yatra vimicchaphalakānakepradhānānāṃ brāhmaṇe, mantre ca tenaiva krameṇa japādimantroccāraṇavidhānam, tatra tatadvidhānāṃ pāṭhakrameṇaiva tattatpradhānavidhyāsthāpakatvāt
krama: hi ānantarya 1506 krameṇa vā niyamyeta
atrāpi pūrvatat darvīhomādirūpatve ubhayākāṅkṣā, vikṛtirūpatve tu anyatarākāṅkṣā |
upahomānāṃ vikṛtitvañca saṃnidhipāṭhāt, teṣāṃ pramāṇāntareṇa aviniyogāt |
ubhayākāṅkṣā saṃnivirviniyojakatve tu yadyapi naivodāharaṇaṃ saṃbhavati, tathāpi tasya apūrvaviśeṣopasthāpanādinā tadupayogitvāt viniyojakatvavyavahāraḥ |
sa ca viśeṣasaṃbandhe kāraṇam iti samadhigatam |
satyaṃ kāraṇam, na tu balī- yastā pramāṇena yatra viśyate |
bhā. 10|6|127-28. anekasya āmnāyamānasya saṃnidhiviśeṣāmnāyamātraṃ hi kramaḥ |
3|1|14 pṛ. 855. upakaraṇādīnāṃ pāṭha- krameṇaiva aupavasathyāditve deśyadeśe anuṣṭhānāva
pūrve tu ka cittadicāraḥ prāsaṅgikaḥ iti pādāntaratva- mānantaryaṃ ca |
tatra śrutyarthayorvirodha eva na saṃbhavati, yathāśrutyeva prayojanasa kalpanīyatvāt |
taduktam ( tannarane ) ' śrutyarthayorvirodheṣu naiva ka cana saṃbhavī |
sūtrārthastu- prayojanaśrutibhyāṃ pāṭhakramasya bādhaḥ, śrauta- kramasya śrutyā pratyakṣaśruteṇa kalpanīyapāṭhakramāt viśeṣa- satvāt sarvasya prayojanārthatvācceti |
vi-- 'āśvino daśamaḥ pāko yavāgā aicchikaḥ kramaḥ |
, pāṭhāt kramaḥ kalpanīyaḥ pratyakṣa śruteḥ kramaḥ |
' bhāṭṭa-- tadevaṃ nirūpitaiṣu kramapramāṇeṣūttarottarasya dvaibalyaṃ prāgevāsmānirnirūpitam |
śruti- virodhe pāṭhasya daurbalyaṃ yathā ' āśvino daśamo gṛhyate, taṃ tṛtīyaṃ juhoti' iti |
atra pāṭhāt 'aindravāyavaṃ gṛhṇāti, maitrāvaruṇaṃ gṛhṇāti, āśvinaṃ gṛhṇāti' ityevaṃvidhāt āśvinagrahaṇasya tṛtīyasthāne prāpta daśamaśrutyā daśamasthāne anuṣṭhānam |
'taṃ tṛtīyam' iti tu pāṭhaprāptānuvāda eva, pravṛtteḥ pāṭhena bādhāta |
pāṭhakramaḥ śrutikrameṇa arthakrameṇa na bādhate na vā iti vicāre kramasa pramāṇatvādi viśeṣataḥ sarveṣāṃ tulyatvatayā na bādhate iti pūrvapakṣe prāpte, siddhāntamāha |
kramasya pāṭhakramasya kopaḥ bādhaḥ, arthaśabdābhyām arthena śrutyā ca bhavati |
śrutiviśeṣāt 'āśvino daśamo gṛhyate, taṃ tṛtīyaṃ juhoti' iti atra pratyakṣa śrutireva kramamāha |
agnihotrahomaḥ pūrve paṭhyate, yavāgūpraṣaṇaṃ paścāt paṭhyate, tatra yavāgūpraṣaṇasya pradhānārthatvāt pāṭhakramo bādhyate |
vi. 5|1|1 varṇakaṃ 2. oṃ kramaniyamalakṣaṇaṃ pañcame'dhyāye ucyate |
pravṛtti- kāṇḍamukhyakramāstu atideśaviṣayā api pradhānabhūtāḥ padārthāḥ |
tasya pratipradhānamanuṣṭhānaṃ kurvataḥ kramaḥ siddha eva |
yathā prayā- jānugamantrādīnāṃ nānāśākhā''ntarasamāmnātānāṃ 'vasantama- mṛtūnāṃ prīṇāmi' ityādīnām 'eko mama' ityevamādīnāṃ ca |
maṇi. pṛ. 13. oṃ kramavantaḥ ye ārabdhavyāḥ, te prathamādupakramitavyāḥ |
oṃ kramavatvām ekadeśāgraheṣu ādyo- pādānam anyalopaśca |

bhā. 3|1|124-25. oṃ kramaviparyayasanimittaṃ prāyaścittaṃ kāmaṃ bhavet ( amīṣomīye paśo puroḍāśe ca ) na ( tu ajñānām ) āvṛttiḥ prāyaścittaṃ tarhi kartavyam ? kriyate 'ayāśāmre; iti sarvaprāyaścittaṃ juhoti |
yatra kramasya pūrvāpara- viśeṣeviparyāso vyatyayo bhavati, tatrāyamavataratīti |
sāhasī. 410. oṃ kramaviśeṣo vākyena gamyate satre dīkṣāṇām |
vi. 5|1|1 varṇakaṃ 3. oṃ kramaviṣaye prayogavidhiḥ prabalaḥ, sarvatra kramaklṛpteḥ prayogavidhyadhīnatvāt iti cet, padārthaprāpyadhīnatvāt prayogavidheḥ tatrāpyeṣodhādhīnatvāt |
oṃ kramasamākhyayoḥ krame vedaklṛptameva aṅgāṅgino- deśasāmānyānimittaṃ parasparaparyavasthānam |
sarvatra hi kena cit abhipradeśena saṃbandho''vakalpate |
na ca samākhyāna- vataḥ kiṃ cit deśasāmānyaṃ vedaklṛptam upalabhāmahe, yena saṃbandhāmimukhyasaṃbhavaḥ |
bhāṣyam -- atha kiṃ etāvantyeva viniyogakāra- ṇāni ? netyucyate |
kramavatām ānupūrvyeṇa upadiśyamānānāṃ yasya paryāye yaṃ dharmamāmananti, tasya taṃ prati ākāṅkṣā anumīyate |
ānupūrvyavatāṃ yāgānām anumantraṇe āmnāteṣu upāṃśu- yājasya krame 'dadhirnāmā'si' iti ( mantraḥ ) samāmnātaḥ |
tasya ākāṅkṣāmupādya, tena ekavākyatāṃ yātvā tatraiva viniyogamarhati iti |
tathā ca aindrāmaṃ karmaṃ viyātasajātasya ( yasya sajātāḥ bāndhavāḥ, viyātasya virodhe gatāḥ, tasya ) asti bhrātṛvyavataḥ |
tasya yājyā'nuvākyā- yugalamapi āmnātāye aindrāmam 'indrāgnī rocanā divaḥ, pra carṣaṇibhyaḥ' ityekam, aparam 'indrāgnī navatiṃ puraḥ, śyada vṛtram' iti |
tatra liṅgāt viniyoge siddhe viśeṣaviniyogo bhavati pūrvaṃ yugala pūrvasya aindrāmasya, uttarasyottarasya iti |
vā-- pūrvadeva kramasamākhyayorapi ajñānādibhiḥ upanyāsaḥ kartavyaḥ |
' vinā''pi anuṣṭhānadeśasāmyena yāvati pradeśe brāhmaṇe pradhānaṃ paṭhyate, tāvatyeva mantraḥ |
tathośca aṅgāṅgeyapekṣāvelāyāṃ yathāsaṃkhyanyāyena samānadeśatvāt buddhau saṃnidhānaṃ bhavati |
prathamasya hi pradhānasya mantramavicchinnaṃ avaśyaṃ mantrasāmnāyam ādita ārabhya ālocayati |
tataśca prathama eva mantraḥ prathamaṃ hṛdayamāgacchati |
naca asyātikrame heturasti, iti sa eva gṛhyate |
tathā mantrasya śeṣiṇamapekṣamāṇasya ana- yaiva prakriyāyā ādyena śeṣiṇā saha saṃbandho bhavati |
tataśca tannirākāṅkṣatayā dvitīyadīnāmapi evameva dvitīyādibhireva yogena bhavitavyam |
tatra āgneyādyanu- mantraṇānāṃ āgneyādiliṅgāt tenāpi vyavasthā sidhyati iti anyakaliṅgam upāṃśuyājakramādītam 'dadhi- rnāmā'si' ityudāharati |
nanu nāsya prakaraṇāt sarvārthatvaṃ vijñāyate, tacca balīyaḥ |
śakyaṃ tu vaktum anugrāhyam eva kramaḥ prakaraṇapratyayaviruddhatvāt iti |
śeṣasya hi sarvā- rthatvaṃ pratipradhānatvāpteḥ prakaraṇagataṃ na śakyaṃ bādhitum |
tatra etāvadattaraṃ bhavati ye'nye śeṣinaḥ : āgne- yādayaḥ, te vispaṣṭaliṅgaiḥ kramaprakaraṇavadbhiḥ mantrāntaḥ avaruddhatvāt nainamapekṣante |
na ca vikalpaḥ, aspaṣṭa- liṅgatvena vaiṣamyāt |
satyapi ca aṣṭārthatve nirapekṣaṇāṃ gatyantare sati samuccayānāśraya- ṇāt |
āgneyādibhiḥ kṛtārthaiḥ upekṣitaḥ san agatyā punaḥ tenyeva bhavet |
na ca īdṛśaṃ santaṃ prakaraṇaṃ viniyoktuṃ kṣamam |
ayaṃ tu atiśabdeḥ yuṣmadarthaviṣayatvāt saṃnihitam abhimukhaṃ vā abhidhatte, nānyam |
upāṃśuyājasya saṃni- hitaḥ abhimukhaśca iti abhidhānasāmarthyaṃ kramāt upāṃśu- yājaviṣayaṃ vijñāyate |
tataśca liṅgena prakaraṇaṃ bādhyate eva ityeṣaḥ |
soma-- sūtrārthastu- krama viniyoge pramāṇaṃ deśasāmānyāt tasmāt ākāṅkṣādikrameṇa viniyoga- saṃbhavāt iti |
prakriyāvat kramo mānaṃ yathā- saṃkhyaṃ tato'ṅgatā |
' ( kramaṃ vibhajati- ) ' kramaḥ samānadeśatvam, pāṭhādarthācca, pāṭhataḥ |
ka cit ākāṅkṣāvira- hāt yathā vikṛtyupahomādiviṣaye klṛptopakāraprākṛtāṅgai- reva nirākāṅkṣatvāt |
atra ca ekavākyopapattīhiyāgādi- saṃnidherapi tathālyāpatteḥ vākyārthasyaivakramam |
trayamapi idaṃ dvividham ubhayākāṅkṣā anyatarākāṅkṣayā ca iti |
saṃnidhestu sānāyyapātraśundhanavidhisaṃnidhau samāmnātasya ' śundhadhvam ' iti mantrasya tadaṅgatvam |
yadyapi caiṣāṃ liṅgādipramāṇāntareṇaiva viniyogāt, kramādīnāṃ ca ki cidapūrvasādhanatvalakṣaṇā- tātparyagrāhakatvamātrānnāṅgatve prāmāṇyam |
tathāpi ṣaḍvidhasyāpi kramasya asaṃkīrṇodāharaṇāni kaustubho- rāṃtyā ūhanīyāni |
atra ṣaḍvidhe'pi krame ārādupa- kārakasthale tāvat itikartavyatā''kāṅkṣāḥ kalpanīya- tvāt prakaraṇakalpakatvam |

mantrādiparasparanirapekṣopakāraka- sthale'pi mantrādeḥ svarūpeṇa yāgajanakatve'pi tanni- yamādṛṣṭopahitasya tadajanakatvāt karaṇaniṣṭhayogyatājanakatva- rūpetikartavyatā''tmakaprakaraṇakalpanā āvaśyakyeva |

ṣaḍvidhe tu krame ubhayā- kāṅkṣā''lakṣaṇatvāt anyatarākāṅkṣā''lakṣaṇasya, tatrāpi pāṭha- kramāt anuṣṭhānasādeyasya vidhisaṃnidhānasya puraḥsphūrti- katvāt, tayostu madhye saṃnidhānasya prābalyam, ekagrantha- sthatvādi, ityādi kaustubhe draṣṭavyam |
' ' śundhadhvaṃ daivyāya karmaṇe ' yathā cātra mahāvi- kārākhyagauṇaprakaraṇeṇa samākhyāṃ saṃnidhiṃ ca bādhitvā na sarvasaṃbandhanidhāpātrāñcham, tathā kramādhikaraṇe eva vyutpāditam |
' darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ yājamānānāṃ prayājādyanu ' iti cintyaṃ draṣṭavyam |
kramonnayanaṃ ca sarveṣu padārtheṣu āmnāteṣu pāṭhātpaṭhāmiḥ saṃpadyate |
vā. 3|1|6|12 pṛ. 698. krayaḥ somasya niyo jyotiṣṭome svayaṃ somavato'pi |
bhā. 6|8|7|26-27. nahi vidhīya- mānānvayaḥ krayaḥ guṇena saṃdhyamānaṃ dravyaṃ viśinaṣṭi iti uktam aruṇā'dhikaraṇe ( 3|1|6 ) |
vā. 3|1|7|14 pṛ. 715. krayau dvau ekaḥ arthahetukaḥ, anyaḥ śabdakṛtaḥ |
tatra śabdakṛtaḥ prākū kratuprayatneḥ yajñasādhano- pājenakāle somavikrayīṇā saha saṃvādaḥ |
bhāṭṭa. 3|1|6. kraye eva aruṇimā niveśyati na sarvasmin prakaraṇe |
bhā. 11|2|13|15. krayaprayuktaṃ somakrayanīyanam, na tu padāpaṃprayuktaṃ jyotiṣṭome |
vā. 3|1|2|13 pṛ. 752. krayasamuccayaparam ' daśabhiḥ krīṇāti ' iti vacanam |
bhā. 3|6|15|40, krayārtha somasya sādyaske vihitena traivārṣikapuṃgavena prākṛtasarvakrayadravyasya bādhaḥ |
krayarṇaṃ surāyāḥ sautrāmaṇyām ' sīsena krīṇāt krayyā ' |
ajayā krīṇāti ' ' hiraṇyena krīṇāti ' ityādinā ukteṣu krayaṇeṣu somakrayaṇeṣu daśasu dravyeṣu vikalpaḥ syāt |
prayoge krayaṇasya prayoge vikreturanamanaṃ kartavyam, tatra dravyāṇāṃ samavāyāt sama- vāyasya āvaśyakatvāt |
daśadravyāṇi tu 1 ekahāyanī goḥ, 2 hiraṇyam, 3 ajā, 4 dhenuḥ, 5 tadvatsaḥ, 6 ṛṣabhaḥ, 7 anaḍdvān, 8-9 mithunau gāvau, 10 vāsaśca iti |
' taṃ vai daśabhiḥ krīṇāti, daśākṣarā virāṭ virājameva prāpnoti ' iti krayānuvādaḥ somakrayadravyāṇāṃ samuccayaṃ darśayati |
ke. krayaṇeṣu tu vikalpaḥ syādekārthatvāt ' ityadhi- karaṇe somakraye gavādīnāṃ nyāyena samuccayaḥ sādhitaḥ |
bāla. pṛ. 166. krayaṇe tu vikalpaḥ syādekārthatvāt ( krayaṇeṣu vikalpaḥ iti su-pāṭhaḥ ) iti sūtreṇa somakrayasādhanānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ vikalpaḥḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ |
tatra hi krayasādhaneṣu ajā''didravyeṣu vikalpaḥ syāt iti pūrvapakṣayitvā somakrayasya anuṣṭhāne dravyāṇāṃ samavāyasyo- papatteḥ samuccaya eva |
kāryapradhānatvāt padārthānāṃ saukarya- mālocya dravyavidhīnāṃ sāpekṣakalpanāt samuccayaḥ iti siddhāntayiṣyate |
ku. 3|1|6|12 pṛ. 266. kriyate devadattena, kriyate svayameva iti vā prayoge upasarjanabhūtaprayojakavyāpāraḥ prayojyavyāpāraḥ vivakṣyate |
vā. 2|1|1|1 pṛ. 378. kriyamāṇatā nāma saṃkalpadeḥ kārakapracalanāt prabhṛti ā samāpteḥ |
vā. 3|8|1|22 pṛ. 1125. kriyamāṇānuvādī mantraḥ, hotuḥ yūpaparimāṇe ' yuvā suvāsaḥ ' iti |
bhā. 3|8|1|22 pṛ. 1124, kriyamāṇānuvādino mantrāḥ adhvaryuṇā kriyamāṇa- manuvadanti ' añjanti tvāmadhvare devayantaḥ ' iti yathā |
12|1|16|13, kriyamāṇānuvādino mantrāḥ evaṃ kartavyamiti pratyayaṃ kurvanti, karaṇamantrāstu karomi ityevam |
smaraṇāthasya ca mantrasya ātmanāsamarthāt smāritaṃ kṛtam adṛṣṭārthāya bhavati |
bṛhatī. pṛ. 243. kriyā anujñeyā pratītā satī kārakāṇi pratyāyayati ityavagatametat |
bhā. 4|4|13 pṛ. 923. kriyā- 'pi jātyādivat devadattādimede'pi ' calati yajati darśapūrṇamāsānutiṣṭhati ' ityevaṃ ekabuddhivedanīyā na bhedaṃ pratipadyate |
nahi atyantābhinnaṃ dravyāt kriyāyāḥ, yena tadadṛṣṭaṃ medaḥ syāt |
soma--yatra tu na śabdāntarādibhedakramanāmasti, tatra prathamimākhyāḥ kriyā- vyatirekaiva, medapratyayastu kartrādibhedalambhanaḥ |
astu vā sarvatrailokyavartitakarma- mātrasya ekavyaktikatvāt āgneyādīmīyayorekatvam |
kriyā'pi na vinā kaiścit sādhyate kārakaḥ ka cit |
śṛṇu. pṛ. 173. 'kriyā dhātvarthamātraṃ syāt' na tu parispanda eva |
ślovā. āramavāde 75. kriyā na ca khasamavāyinyeva kevalā, calanātmakaṃ vā sarvatreṣyate |
vā. 3|1|6|12 pṛ. 693. kriyā na dhātvarthaḥ mīmāṃsakamate |
'māvārthadhikaraṇoktarītyā dhātvarthasya kriyāvābhāvāt... khamate dhātvarthasya kriyā-svābhāvena kārakaviśeṣaṇakakṣepakāyogāt |
soma. 3|4|8. kriyā na pratyakṣā, kintu vibhāgottarasaṃyogā-bhyāmanumeyā |
atastathātve mahattvasya na hetutā iti ke-cit |
maṇi. pṛ. 21. kriyā yatra punaḥ svaviśeṣaṇā-viśiṣṭā vidhīyate, vākyantaraprāptasya kriyā'ntarasya viśeṣaṇam, tatrāvaśyavartanīyo vidhipratyayaḥ |
dravyāntareṇa nīvārādinā kṛtasya karmaṇaḥ brīhādidravyakāt darśāpūrṇamāsādeyānmāt medāpatteḥ na pratiniyamyapādanaṃ yuktam iti pratipādanārthaṃ pūrvapakṣasūtramidam |
su. pṛ. 343. kriyāyāṃ yatraiva dravyādīni prati pradhānatvam, tatraiva taddedanimittapūrvabhedasiddheḥ |
maṇi. pṛ. 54. kriyāyāṃ vidhīyamānānāṃ kārakāṇi udbhūtaśaktīni bhavanti |
avidhīyamānāyāṃ tu kriyāyāṃ kārakāṇi anudbhūtaśaktīni bhavanti |
vā. 10|1|13|64, kriyāsu yāsu phalaṃ pratyakṣato (vākyāt) 'vagamyate tāḥ phalavatyaḥ, nāśrutaphalā vaidikyaḥ |
6|1|1|12 pṛ. 1408. kriyākārakayoḥ śaktirūpa eva ca saṃbandhaḥ iti karaṇavibhaktyantargatatvāt, pratyārthasya ca prādhānyāt prātipadikopasarjanaḥ saṃbandha eva phalatha vidhīyate |
vā. 2|1|1|12 pṛ. 551. kriyākārakatvadamyāḥ yathā śabdāḥ, tathā tadanvayāntargataḥ śeṣatoṣibhāvo'pi śābda eva |
'na ca yāvacchabdaḥ kālavacanaḥ ka cit prasiddhaḥ, kriyāmeva tu samāptiparyantatvena (yāvajjīvaṃ) viśinaṣṭi |
kriyākālyorabhedāt na lakṣaṇeti cet, atra vaiśeṣikaparājaya parihārāyoga- syāttham |
apica satyapi kriyāṇāṃ kālatve kā cit vyavasthā vidyate |
maṇi. pṛ. 22. kriyākṣaṇānāṃ saṃtānanimitta eva 'ayaṃ calati' iti vartamānatā''śrayaḥ |
tatra tāvat gacchati devadatte saṃyogavibhāgā- tiriktaṃ gamanākhyaṃ vastu nendriyeṇopalabhyate |
nanu pratyakṣaiva kriyā, vitrādādhyāsitam gamanādijñānam indriyajam indriyabhāvabhāvāt rūpādipratītivat |
katham ? aindriyakatva- laiṅgikatvayoḥ kena viśeṣeṇa laiṅgikatvāsvīkāra iti cet, asteva viśeṣaḥ |
laiṅgikatve'pi śaktikalpanami- ścitamiti cet, sāmānyena vyāptasya vyāpakatve klapta- śaktitvāt |
indriyasya tu sāmānye na śaktiḥ, ka cit saṃyuktasya ghaṭādergrahaṇam, ka cit ca saṃyuktasya gola- kādeḥ, paramāṇvādeśca agrahaṇam, saṃyuktasamavāyāccuṣā rūpādigrahaṇam, na rasādīnām |
ato yatra pratīti- statrendriyasya śaktiriti prativiṣayamindriyasya śakti- kalpanayā laiṅgikatvenāpi upapatteḥ aindriyakatvakalpana- manyāyyam |
kiṃ tarhi kriyā'numāne liṅgam ? vibhāgapūrvakaḥ saṃyogaḥ |
tathāhi, yadyat kadācit tattadāgantukat- jāyamānaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yathā tantusaṃyogeyaḥ paṭaḥ, ayamapyā- gantukatvānniti |
kārye yatra sama- vaiti, tat samavāyikāraṇam |
asamavāyikāraṇaṃ ca kārye- kāryasamavāyi, kāraṇakāryasamavāyi vā |
tathā coktaṃ prakaraṇa- pañjikāyām, 'yatra eva hi piṇḍasyodayaḥ samavāyi- kāraṇāt, tata eva tasya jātisamānāṃ'pi saṃpadyate' iti |
samavāyikāraṇasamavāyikāraṇakṣaṇaṃ ca samavāya- vyatirekaviṣayam, ato nānyaikāntikam |
nanu vimā- pūrvakasayogasyaivābhāvātpa ityatra dṛṣṭānte tatrāpi karmā- numānaṃ syāt |
yat kāryam tat kāraṇamiti vyāptiḥ, na punaryatra kāryaṃ tatra kāraṇamiti |
kiñca svadeśavibhāgapūrvasaṃyogasyaiva liṅgatvam, sthāṇī tu tada- bhāvāt na karmānumānamiti |
kiñca liṅgacce sthite'pi pūrvakarmaṇaiva vibhāgasaṃyogopapattau karmāntarānuda- vācya, 'na calati' iti pratyayaprasaṅgaḥ |
vibhāgat prayatnavadātmanaḥ śarīrasaṃyogādeva vibhāga- saṃyogayorupapattī kimantargūḍhanā karmaṇā ? pratyakṣatve tu yathādarśanaṃ karmāṅgīkāre'pi na doṣaḥ |
naivam, saṃyogo hi svāśraye svāśrayasamavete vā kāryamārabhate iti niyatam |

yathā tantusaṃyoge svāśrayeṣu tantuṣu paṭam, patracāśrayasaṃyoge'pi svāśrayasamavete avayavini mahattvam, tanturīsaṃyogestu svāśraye turyām, svāśraya- samavete ca paṭe paṭuttarīsaṃyogam, ataḥ svāśrayāsvāśra- yayoḥ śarīradeśayorvibhāgasaṃyogau saṃyogahetuko na bhavataḥ |
ata ātmaśarīrasaṃyogāt svāśraye śarīre karmotpadyate, tato vibhāgasaṃyogāviti na karmavicchedaḥ |

nanu yathā svāśraye kāryakarasya saṃyogasya svāśrayasamavete'pi kārya- karatvamahaṅgīkṛtam, tathaiva astrāśraye'pi kāryakaratva- maṅgīkṛtyām, svāśrayasamavete'pi hetvantaraṃ vā kalpyatām, kimarthavaiśasena ? naivam, anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ hi svāśraye svāśrayasamavete ca hetutvam, tatrānyadarśanā- pekṣā anyatarasya nāsti |
ātmaśarīrasaṃyogasya vibhāga- saṃyogahetutve nāstyanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ hetutvam, vyati- rekābhāvāt |
ātmaśarīrasaṃyoge satyeva kāryasyodayāt yadyapi siddho'nvayaḥ, tathāpi ātmaśarīrasaṃyogasya sarvadā satvāt nāsti tadabhāve kāryahāniḥ |
ataśca buddhyādīnāmātmakāraṇatvavat anvayavyatirekāvasitakārya- kāraṇabhāvadṛṣṭāntena tatsamavetakāryatvādiyādihetunā anumānena kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ, iti prativaktavyam |
ato'- nvayavyatirekāpekṣatvādanumānasya, anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ ca svāśraye svāśrayasamavete vā kāryarambhasya avagata- tvāt, tadanusāreṇānumātavyam, na astrāśraye iti |
svāśrayasvāśrayasamavetedāharaṇayoranyonyāpekṣā nāsti, tuhyapramāṇagamyatvāt, ataḥ saṃyogasya svāśrayasama- vete vā kāryarambhakatvaṃ nāstyeti karmānumeyam |
arthendriyasaṃyogasya ātmani jñānajanakatvāt svāśraye iti niyamo nāstīti cenna, asamavāyikāraṇaprayuktatvāt asya niyamasya |
asamavāyikāraṇasyāpi tatraiva vyabhicāraḥ, veṇudalavibhāga- samavāyikāraṇe khalvibhāgāpatteḥ ekatvena ca khādeḥ
kriyāyāśca deśavibhāgasaṃyogayostatheti cet, evaṃ hi asamavāyikāraṇasaṃyogaprayuktaḥ |
tarhi tantudvayasaṃyogasya asamavāyikāraṇabhūtasya bahutantu- vyāpipaṭahetutvāt vyabhicāra iti cenna, tatrāpi vibhāga- dvāreṇa utpādakatvāt |
tathāhi, tantudvayasaṃyogaḥ prathame svāśraye tantudvaye paṭabhāgamutpādayati, utpanna paṭabhāgena tantvantarasya saṃyogāt svāśraye paṭabhāgāntaram ityevamuttara- trāpyūhyam |
athavā yāvatāṃ saṃyogānāmekasmin kārye asamavāyikāraṇatvam, tāvantameva svāśrayādi- vyāptiḥ |
ata ekakāryatve'pi mahāpaṭasya na vyabhi- cāraḥ |
athavā yatraikasmin kārye ekasyaiva asamavāyi- kāraṇatvam, tatraiveyaṃ vyāptiḥ |
nanu yadā prayatnavadātma- śarīrasaṃyogāt śarīre vibhāgasaṃyogotpattiḥ, tadā prayatna- vadātmadeśasaṃyogāt deśe'pīti na tadatiriktakarmānu- ṣṭhānam |
ata ekasminneva kārye prayatnavadātmaśarīrasaṃyogasya prayatnavadātmadeśasaṃyogasya ca hetutvāt nāmnāśarīra- gasya vā astrāśraye deśe kāryakaratvam, ātmadeśasaṃyo- gasyāpi svāśraye śarīre iti |
kiñca ātmadeśa- saṃyogasyāpi hetṛtvaṃ na klaptam, kalpanīyam, tadare karmakalpanām |
ataḥ karmaiva śarīre anumeyam, tato vibhāgasaṃyogāviti sarvamupapannam |
su. pṛ. 751. kriyā'pacāre na kriyā'ntaraṃ pratinidhidhyāt |
maṇi. pṛ. 112. kriyāpratiniyamavidhiḥ yathā 'yadi yaja- mānaḥ praveset prajāpatervibhrānnama lokaḥ' iti dhruvāyāṃ yajamānamāgamanadhāya samidhayajuṣā saha juhuyāt' ityā- pastambaḥ |
tathā āhitāmiprāptapittaḥ 'dakṣiṇe haste juhvamāsā- dayati' ityādyāyāḥ pratinidhiḥ patitāhitāgniprāpteṣu anyā smaryate 'pātrāṇi tu dadhedemau yajamāne vṛthā mṛte' iti |
yathā vā dvijāmāve śrāddhābhojanasya dharmabhedaṣu agnī gave apsu vā iti devalāḥ |
