pṛ. 12, 'krītarājakaḥ bhojyānnaḥ' ayaṃ pratiprasavasvarūpaḥ iti smṛtidharme pramāṇaṃ neveti saṃdeha 'tasmādamīpomīye saṃsthite yajamānasya gṛhe'sthityam' iti śrutvā viruddhatvāna pramāṇam iti siddhāntaḥ |
vā. 1|3|13 pṛ. 184. tasmādīkṣitasya krītarājakasya bhojyaṃ bhavati |
na ca tasyā- pramāṇatve kiñcidapi kāraṇam |
pṛ. 199, ninditatvāna saṃbhavadvojyatvāntareṇāpi lokayātrādi- vaśena bhoktavyam |
vi. 10|4|11. kṣiptakāṣṭhādhyānaniṣedhādivat āhitāgniteṣu agniṣu kartavyam, na tatra pavamāneṣṭyapekṣā |
bhā. 5|3|1|29-25. kṣomā- dayaḥ paśavavyavāḥ vede coditāḥ santaḥ adhyadhvaryādibhiḥ svayamajñāyamānārthatvāt ye nityaṃ prāṇidhavābhiyuktāḥ, tebhya evāvadhārya viniyujyante |
yattu 'kāñnī' ityādī apavādamyadviṣaye'pi aṇū bhavati 'kacidapavāda- viṣaye'pi' iti nyāyāditi, tatra 'aṇū karmaṇi ca' iti sūtrasyamābhyavirodhāt |
tatra hi anaḥ punarvacanam apavādaviṣaye anivṛttyartham 'godāyo vrajati' ityādyukte śaiṣikeṇa bodhyaḥ |
spaṣṭā ceyaṃ 'dāmahāyanāntācca' iti sūtre 'auto'masoḥ' iti sūtre ca bhāṣye |
(ne'vadhi kṛti ' ityataḥ anuvartamānasyānya 'ārṣadhātu kasyetyatra) - nañaḥ nivṛttistu 'kacide- kadeśo'pyanuvartate' iti nyāyena siddhā |
śekhara, pṛ.93. kva cit karmaviśeṣe 'ṛcā stuvate' 'sāmnā stuvate' iti śrutam |
vi. 9|2|8 varṇaka 1, kva cit karmaviśeṣe (viṣuvati) śrūyate 'ayaṃ sahasramānavaḥ' ityetayā 'āhavanīyamupatiṣṭhate' iti asaṃhasraveti ṛcā pragīyaiva upasthānam, na tu gānavikalpaḥ |
kṣaṇikatve hi siddhe bhāvānāmeva tadvedapi, na tvetadasti |
asya sādhanaṃ pratyakṣamanumānaṃ vā bhavet, pramāṇāntarābhāvāt |
tatra na tāvat pratyakṣaṃ laukikaṃ nīlādivarti kṣaṇikatāṃ gocarayati |
nanu na nīlādanyat kṣaṇikatvaṃ nāma vastu sat |
na ca kṣaṇikatvasya nīla- sādhyāyā arthakriyāyāḥ bhinnā samastyarthakriyā, yā khalu kṣaṇabhaṅgabhedenāvatiṣṭheta |
kṣaṇikatvaṃ pītādivattrīyasādhya- yaiva cedarthakriyā tat tattvato nīlādicyate |
na bhidyate cennūnaṃ nīlamādinā pratyakṣaiṇa kṣaṇikatvaṃ gṛhītam, tada- vyatirekāt |
sa ca nīlamiti, na tu kṣaṇikatvamiti |
mānāntarāttu kṣaṇikatvasya tadasiddhau pratyakṣasiddhabhinnaṃ pralāpaḥ; tatra tasyāsādhanājanaka- tvāt |
avasāyā'nanugatavyāpārasya pratyakṣasya pravṛtti- viṣayaṃ prati prāmāṇyānupapannāt |
tadyathā nīlākāramālocanaṃ nīle paricchindat tadamātraṃ vyavacchinadat tadamātrāvyabhicāriṇaḥ pītādīnapi vyavacchinatti |
tata asatamātrāvacchinnaṃ nīlaṃ paricchindat samayavartitā''mavamapyasya vyavacchindat tadabhāvāvibhāvāvinī tatpūrvāparasamayavartitāmapyasya vyava- cchinatti |
tathā ca nīlatadarthakriyā''rthino na ka cideva niyamena pravartan |
kṣaṇabhaṅgavāda: tattvalandanaṃ ca 1518 kṣaṇabhaṅgavāda: tattvalandanaṃ ca
khalu atadātmānamapi gocarayati, davīyasī tvasya khasamamagocaratā|
khasaṃvedanābhyupagame'pi ātmā'nātma- prakāśamātraṃ nātmānaṃ samayena ātmanā vā, nīlaṃ samayena vā ghaṭayet |
na caikasya kramavadanekasaṃbandho viruddhate iti nivediṣyate |
tat siddhaṃ pratyakṣaṃ kṣaṇavivekāpratibhāsamānāt na indriyaviṣayaviṣayatā mānasasya kiñcidindriyaviṣayagrāhitvameveti |
nanu mā nāma kṣaṇabheda: pratibhāsatām, tadamedastat kutaḥ ityata āha- 'amedapratibhāsanāta' (vivi.) so'yaṃ sphaṭika: iti pratyabhijñaiva sthāpayati sphaṭi- kam |
nanviyaṃ na sphaṭikasya pūrvāparakṣaṇavyāptalakṣaṇaṃ sthiratvaṃ gocarayitumarhati |
kṣaṇabhaṅgavāda: tattvakhaṇḍanaṃ ca 1520 kṣaṇabhaṅgavāda: tattvakhaṇḍanaṃ ca
dvayoranyataraniṣedhe anyataravyavasthānemiti prakārāntarā- bhāvāt bhāvānāmanyakriyā kramākramābhyāṃ vyāptā, tau ca sthirāt vyāvarttamānau arthakriyāmapi vyāvarttayato vṛkṣateva śiṃśapātvam |
tathāhi, na tāvat krameṇa arthakriyāsaṃbhavaḥ, svenaiva hi rūpeṇa bhāvā arthakriyāsuyujyamānā dṛśyante |
yato yat yatkāryā- nyavyatirekānuvihitabhāvābhāvaṃ tat tatkāryaprasavasamartham, rūpaṃ ca teṣāṃ kāryeṇa anuṣṭhānavyatirekam iti tadeva samartham |
tacca dvitīyādiṣva kṣaṇe prathame'pi kṣaṇe saditi dvitīyādikṣaṇajaṃ kāryakalāpaṃ prathame eva kṣaṇe janayet, samarthasya kṣepādyogāditi nākṣaṇikasya kramavad vyāpārasaṃbandhaḥ |
kimasya sahakāriṇaḥ kiñcit upakāramādadhāti na vā ? ādadhānā api bhāvādicchamabhinne vā ? tatra bhinnopa- kārādhāne bhāvarūpe satyapi alabhyajanane satyapyasmin anupalabdherupasthitaḥ |
tata eva copakāryasyo paccerbhāvasya atatkāritva- prasaṅgaḥ |
abhinnopakārabhāve bhāvaḥ evā- bhidhīyeta, na ca sā prakṛ siddhaḥ śakya āghātum |
anupakārakatve vā sahakāriṇo bhāvena nāpekṣyeran ityu- ktyadhamāmeva bījamaṅkuraṃ janayet, anapekṣasya kṣepā- yogāt |
yadi manyeta anupakārakā api bhavanti sahakāriṇaḥ, yasyāttaiḥ saha- bhāvaḥ karoti |
na ca nāpekṣyante, tairvinā kāryasya anupatteriti |
svarūpeṇa caiva kāryajananako bhāvaḥ, kasmāccaitānantareṇa janayati ? tebhyaḥ prāgapi rūpasadbhā- vāt |
sahakāriṇūpeṇa vā janakāve te eva janakāḥ, na bhāvāḥ |
anyarūpeṇa vā anyasya janakāve gaganalana- syāpi sattvena sahyavahāragocaratvaprasaṅgaḥ |
na cobhayabhāvā- mānānuvidhānāt arthakriyābhāvābhāvayoḥ, ekaikasācca vyabhicārāt, asmādubhayādhīnajanmeti sāṃpratam |
caramabhāvini sati hetau upacitti kāryotpatteradaśya- mmāvamiyamena vyabhicārābhāvāt |
na ca svakāraṇāt kati- payakālakalāvilambena kāryajananasvabhāvo bhāvo jātaḥ |
kiṃ katipayakālavilambe asya vilambanakāritāsvabhāvo nivṛtto na vā, nivṛttaścet kathaṃ svabhāvo na nivṛttaḥ ? svabhāvānivṛtteḥ |
ataḥsvabhāvatve vā na vilambate iti jananāntarameva kṛtakṛtyaḥ prasajyeta |
tasmāt yāvatkāryaṃ kimapi prathame kṣaṇe tenākṣaṇakena svenātmanā saṃpāditā, tāvat sarvaṃ dvitīyādikṣaṇe saṃpādyet |
tathā ca saṃpādi- tasya saṃpādanā'nupapatteḥ, tadanyatve dvitīyādikṣaṇasaṃpā- dasya na yogapadyena nikhilārthakriyānivartanam akṣaṇi kasya yujyate |
tadanena paryāyeṇa nākṣaṇikasya kramākramābhyāmtha- kriyākāritā kalpyate iti |
vipakṣe akṣaṇikatve vyāpakābhāvāt tato vyāvarttamānaṃ sattvaṃ kṣaṇikatvena vyāpyate iti pratipannasiddhiḥ |
kṣaṇiko'pi bhāvaḥ arthakriyājananasvabhāvo na vā ? na cedasanneva |
janakasvabhāvaścet, kimasya sahakāribhiḥ ? ityupadamātrameva bījamaṅkuraṃ janayet |
nanupaśo bījakṣaṇaḥ samartho janayatyevāṅkuram, kutaḥ punastyopaciḥ, pūrvasmādīkṣaṇakṣaṇāt |
tarhi taṃsatānapatti- tānāṃ sarveṣāṃ bījātvā'viśeṣān aṅkurajananasāmarthyamiti lakṣaṇamātrameva bījamaṅkuraṃ janayet |
pūrvapūrva- kṣitijīpavanādikṣaṇasamavadhānātjñātaviṣayaccottarottara- kṣaṇaparaṃparālabdhajanmā anyo bījakṣaṇaḥ samarthaḥ samartha- kṣityādikṣaṇasahabhūtaḥ anapekṣa evāṅkuraṃ janayati |
na cāsya kṣityādisahabhuvaḥ tadapekṣasyāpi tairvinā kāryakara- ṇam |
na cāsahakāritā kṣityādīnām, tairaiva saha aṅkurajananāt |
kṣaṇabhaṅgavāda: tattvakhaṇḍanaṃ ca 1521 kṣaṇabhaṅgavāda: tattvakhaṇḍanaṃ ca
teṣāmapi taḥpūrvabhāvitvasya niyamavaśāviśeṣāt, tanmātra- tvādeva ca kāraṇatāyāḥ |
na ca apekṣaṇānāmapi parasparaṃ kāryāntarārambhaṇam, tanmātrasya tebhya upalabdheḥ; nataiva sāmarthyaviyāmāt |
na ca kṛtakaratayā itareṣāmakriyā, sahakriyāyāṃ kṛtamityasaṃbhavāt ; na ca svakāraṇa- valambyaparasparasaṃnidhayaḥ apekṣāvantaḥ śakyamidamekenāpi asmāsu kartumiti kṛtaṃ saṃnidhineti nivartitumīśate |
na ca sahakārikāraṇabhedaḥ kāryabhedahetuḥ, apitu sāmagrībhedaḥ, tasmin sati kāryabhedopalabdheḥ |
parasparasamavadhānaṃ copa- sarpaṇaprayatnebhyaḥ kṣityādīnāmiti na kṣaṇikasya arthakriyā- virodhāt asādhāraṇatā hetoḥ |
na ca sādhyadharmiṇi dṛśyamāne śabdādo vyāptiprasādhanādeva sādhyasiderāsādhanā- 'hetuvacanam |
na khalu sarvopasaṃhāravatī vyāptirhetumātra- viṣayā bhavitumarhati |
śakyaṃ hi śakkirtuṃ pareṇa dṛśya- mānānāṃ sattvam akṣaṇikatvācca vyāvarttitaṃ svaityeva satyamanaikāntikaṃ na kṣaṇikatvāsādhanam iti |
tasmāt yat sat dṛśyamadṛśyaṃ vā, tattve kṣaṇikamiti darśanīyā vyāptiḥ |
nanu etramapi śabdadervivādāspadabhūtā vyāptirdarśana- balādeva siddhā kṣaṇikateti tadavasthameva asādhanā'hvaṃ hetuvacanasya |

asatyapi śaśaviṣāṇādau yat sat dṛśyamadṛśyaṃ vā tattve kṣaṇikamiti yathā sarvasaṃhāravatī vyāptiḥ sidhyati, na ca śaśaviṣāṇādayo bhavanti kṣaṇikāḥ, evamasatyapi vivādāsvīkṛte śabdādau vyāptisiddhāvapi na sidhyati kṣaṇikatā ityavadarthaṃ darśayitavyameva |
teṣāṃ kṣaṇikatvasādhanāya sattvam, iti nāsādhanā'jñatā hetuvaca- nasya |
apica kṛtakā bhāvāḥ svahetubhyaḥ upajāyamānā vinaśvarā jāyante avinaśvarā vā ? vinaśvarāścet udayānantarameva appajyeti siddhaḥ kṣaṇabhaṅgaḥ |
atha avinaśvarāḥ na kadā cidapi naśyeyuḥ |
na jātu svakāraṇādutpannaṃ nīlaṃ pītaṃ bhavati |
na ca hetvantarāt jananamā vināśa eṣā- miti sāṃpratam, vikalyāsahatvāt |
sa hi hetvantareṇa janyamāno vināśo bhāvādbhinno vā |
tasmādabhāvasyāpi samasta- rūpavirahiṇe vikaliyatasya kriyā anupapatteti 'abhāvaṃ karoti' iti karotikriyāyā abhāvena niḥsvabhāvena saṃbandhānupapatteḥ, najā saha saṃbandho bhāvaṃ na karotīti |
yaśca na karoti tasyākārakasya ahetuḥvamiti na vināśahetavaḥ |
kecittu tasmāt svahetorayogekṣaṇa- sthitimarhaṃ bhāvo jātaḥ iti dvitīyakṣaṇe syameva na bhavati, na punaratra hetumapekṣate |
na khalu svakāraṇataḥ svabhāvavyavasthitaṃ nīlamupajāyamānam apītādibhāve hetu- mapekṣate paryyanuyujyate ceti |
api ca kṛtakānāṃ bhāvānāmanavasthyābhāvī vināśaḥ pratīyate, tenāpi śakyā kṣaṇikatā anumātum |
tathāhi, yadyeṣāṃ dhruvabhāvi tatra teṣāṃ hetvantarāpekṣā nāsti yathā rūpādīnāṃ lohemyatve |

dhruvabhāvī ca kṛtakānāṃ bhāvānāṃ vināśa iti viruddhavyāptopalabdhirvināśasya hetvantarā- yattatāṃ pratiṣiddhati, dhruvabhāvitā hi niṣidhyamānahetva- ntarāpekṣatvaviruddhacirapekṣakatvavyāpyā labdhā hetvantarā- pekṣatvamupasthāpayati |
yeye hetvantarāpekṣāḥ, na te dhruva- bhāvinaḥ |
tathā yadi bhāvā api svahetubhyo hetvantaraṃ vināśaṃ pratyapekṣeran tatastasya saṃnidhānaniyamapramāṇābhāvāt kaścit kṛtako'pi na vinaśyet |
tathā ca svayameva na bhavanti bhāvā dvitīye kṣaṇe, iti siddhaḥ kṣaṇabhaṅgaḥ eteṣām |
(khaṇḍayati-) naiva tāvat sattvaṃ kṣaṇikatvasādhana- samartham, kṣaṇikatve vyavasthā'nupapatterasādhāraṇatvāt |
tatredaṃ bhavān pṛṣṭo vyācakṣvam, kimekasādekaṃ kāryamupajāyate utānekam ? evaṃ kimanekādekaṃ kāryamutānekam ? iti |
na tāvadekasmāt, ekakāryeṇa khalu anukatānāmavyatirekaṃ kāraṇaṃ taducyate, yasya kāryotpādāt prāk niyamavān
na ca kāraṇataiva sattā svarūpaṃ nīlāderanubhavāvasitam |
taddhi tenaiva svarūpeṇa svabhāvavyavacchinnaṃ tāsutāsu arthakriyāsṛpayujyate, na punastatttāritā evāsya rūpam |
mā bhūdaparyāyeṇa anekārthakriyākāraṇe rūpabhedaḥ, mā ca bhūdapāpekṣyamasthāpi nirūpaṇam, kāryatvasya sattvasya kṣudrasyaiva nirūpyamāṇatvāt |
kāraṇatve tu sattve yathā kāryatvaṃ bhāvasvabhāvo'pi vastutaḥ kāraṇādhīnanirūpaṇam, tathā kāraṇatvamapi svasaṃbandhākāryamantareṇa aśakyanirūpaṇa- miti sattvaṃ śuddhaṃ na nirūpyate |
tataścopāpekṣyataḥ śuddho vā, nāśe kāryatvasattvamiti vyāhanyeta |
tathā ca yadyasti sarvasaḥ, tathāpi siddhaṃ sadūpa eva bhāvastadbhāvālambana- pratyayatvam anubhūyiṣyati |
atha nāsti, tathāpi svasva- hetuto labdhasvarūpa evāpātaḥ |
na ca prathamataḥ kāryānupalambherasāmarthyam, tathā sati rāsabhāderapi kṣityādisamavadhānāt aṅkurādyutpattiprasaṅgaḥ ityuktam |

nanu janakatvamajanakatvaṃ ca viruddhau dharmau kathamekatra samāviśataḥ ? tathaikatraiva bīje aṅkurajanakatvaṃ tadajanakatvalakṣaṇaṃ ca sthitvādijanakatvaṃ kathamiva viruddhe ? virodhinau cet kathamabhedaḥ ? medaścaitraṃ jagata kiñcit iti nānekamapi syāditi munirupimatamatratā bhāvānāṃ tattvam |
sakṛdupalabhyamāne kāryabhede'pi bījarūpasya janakasya abhedāvagateḥ pratyakṣeṇa abheda iti cenna |
na ca nañaḥ prayogāprayogamātrābhyāṃ virodhāvagatiḥ, atiprasaṅgāt |
na ca bījasyāpi yadaiva janakatvam, tadaivājanakatvam |
na ca janakatvamasya svabhāvaḥ, api tu bījaṃ janakatvaṃ na taditarapratyayasamavadhānaṃ vā sāmarthyaṃ vā dharmabhedaḥ |
na ca na dharma- dharmiṇorabhedaḥ, tasya tato'nyatvāt |
tat siddhamakṣaṇikasyāpi kramākramābhyāṃ artha- kriyākāritopapatteḥ saṃdigdhavyatirekitvāt anaikāntikaṃ sattvamasādhanāṅgaṃ kṣaṇabhaṅguratve bhāvānāmiti |
yaccatva vikalpitam, svabhāvāto bhāvā vinaśvarā avinaśvarā vā jāyante iti, tatrocyate |
na vayaṃ vina- śvaratvamavinaśvaratvaṃ vā jānīmaḥ; kintu svataḥ hetubhyo jāyante, dhvasante na hetvantarebhyaḥ |
nanvāsinnupakṣe'pi bhinnabhūtau kimāyātaṃ bhāvasya ? na kiñcid āyātam |

astu svakāraṇādhīnajanmanā tadabhāvena tatsvarūpavirahalakṣaṇena svasvakṣaṇaśālinā svānurūpaṃ vyavahāraṃ pravartayatā nirastāḥ samastārthakriyāḥ; kiṃ nacchinnam ? na ca dhruvabhāvitā vināśasya hetvanarāpekṣatāmāvahati, asiddhatvādanekā- ntikāvācca |
idaṃ hi bhavān nirūpayatu, kiṃ ghaṭasaṃtānāt saṃvibhāgā kapālasaṃtatiḥ dhruvabhāvinī na vā ? na ceddināśo- 'pi ghaṭasyādhruvabhāvī |
atha dhruvabhāvinī, tasyāmeva vibhāgāsaṃtatau dhruvabhāvināmapi mudgarapekṣiṇāmanaikāntikaṃ dhruvabhāvitvaṃ nānapekṣatvena vyāptimiha hetvantarāpekṣatvaṃ niṣeddhumumahati |
tasmāt kṣaṇikatvasādhanānumānaprati- kṣepāt atrādhitaṃ pratyabhijñānaṃ sthāpayati bhavān iti siddham |
(śā-) nanu sarvabhāvānāṃ kṣaṇikatvāt kathaṃ śabdasya nityatā ? kiṃ punaḥ sarvakṣaṇikatve pramāṇam ? pratyakṣaṃ tāvat kāla- sattāṃ bodhayati, na kālāntaraniṣedhaṃ karoti |
na ca saṃprati kālāntaraṃ dravyam, yena dṛśyā- darśanāt tanniṣedhaḥ syāt, nacānyadapi pramāṇaṃ paśyāmaḥ; svabhāvahetukaṃ pramāṇaṃ sattāmātrānuvidhāviṣayatvāditi |
kathaṃ punaḥ sattāmātrānubhavasiddhiḥ kṣaṇikatvāyāḥ; vipakṣe bādhakapramāṇapravṛtteḥ, kṣaṇikatvavipakṣe hi kṣaṇikatve vyāpakānupalabdhyā bādhyamānā sattā kṣaṇikatvena vyāpya- mānā tadanumāpayati |
kiṃ punaḥ sattāyā vyāpakam, kramākramāviti brūmaḥ |
nahi bhāvaḥ sattāṃ labhate, yo na kācidartha- kriyāmārabhate, yataḥ kṣaṇasyāpi sarve bhāvāḥ kāraṇam |
yadapi kiñcit ajñātamānamapi sattvena saṃbhāvyate, tadapi sarve vijñānaṃ prati ālambanatvāt arthakriyākāri, tadartha- kriyākāritva sattā, tadeva arthakriyākāri, tadeva para- mārthasaditi |
sā ca kramayogapadyābhyāṃ vyāptā, na ca akṣaṇikatve te saṃbhavataḥ |
sthāyī hi padārtho na tāvat arthakriyāḥ sarvāḥ yugapat kartumahati, tathā sati dvitīye kṣaṇe kunyābhāvāt arthakriyākāritvavirahāt alakṣaṇā- patteḥ kṣaṇikatvameva syāt |
nāpi kramaḥ saṃbhavati, sa hi bhāvaḥ sarvārthakriyāsamarthaḥ; kimiti kā cidevatārambhe nānyam, samarthaśca kṣetrāgotrāt |
kiñcitkarāśca yat taiḥ kriyate, tadeva kāryasādhanaṃ syāt, tadanantaraṃ kāryaniṣpatteḥ bhāvaḥ tatkāraṇameva syāt |
nahi āgantuke atiśaye kāryamārabhamāṇo bhāvasya kāraṇatā saṃbhavati bhinnatvāt, abhede vā māno'pi tatkālajanmā kṣaṇika eva syāt |
medābhedau tu viruddhauaiva, tasmānna akṣaṇikasya sattā saṃbhavatīti siddhaṃ sanmātrātnuvidhitvaṃ kṣaṇikatvāyāḥ |
kiñca kṛtakānāṃ bhāvānām avayavambhāvī vināśaḥ, tenāpi kṣaṇikatvaṃ ghaṭādīnām |
tathāhi, yat yeṣāṃ dhruvabhāvi, na tatra teṣāṃ hetvantarāpekṣā |
dhruva- bhāvī ca kṛtakānāṃ vināśaḥ, iti viruddhavyāptopalabdhiḥ |
dhruvabhāvitā hi niṣidhyamānahetvantarāpekṣatvavyāptyā abhyu- ātvādiṣu upalabdhyā kṣaṇapakapanamapekṣatvam usthāpayantī tadviruddhaṃ sāpekṣatvaṃ pratikṣipati |

athavā hetvantarā- pekṣāṇāṃ vāsasi rāgādīnām anubhavavicitryāteḥ tadi- ṣṭaṃ dhruvabhāvitvaṃ vyāpakaviruddhopalabdhyā vināśasya hetva- ntarāpekṣāṃ nivārayati, nirapekṣatvaṃ vināśāḥ svābhāviko janmānantaremeva bhavatīti siddhaḥ kṣaṇabhaṅgaḥ |
tatra dravyanāśā vināśamuddhavā musalaprahārānantaraṃ visadṛśaṃtanadarśanaḥ sadaiva vināśaṃ manyamānā musalaprahāranāśahetutāṃ manyante |
hetvantarajanma ca vināśo na tāvat bhāvādibhyo bhavitumarhati, hetubhedāt |
bhinnatve tu tasmin jāte'pi bhāvāsya pūrvavadupalabdhiḥ syāt paṭajanmani ghaṭavat |
tasmāt svahetuta eva bhāvā- vināśasvabhāvā jāyante iti kṣaṇabhaṅgasiddhiḥ |

kiñca prayatnaśatānāmapi ghaṭādīnāṃ kriyatā'pi kālena ava- yatrakṣayaviśeṣaṇa vināśo dṛśyate vinaiva musalaprahārā- dibhiḥ, so'yam upacitaprabhṛti kiñcitkiñcidanyatvāt- mantareṇa nopapadyate, pratyakṣeṇaiva ca anyātvamiva abhinava- purāṇāvasthayoḥ ajñātadravyocitakālairapi puruṣairupalabhyate |
na ca ekalaiva ghaṭasya nānārūpatvaṃ saṃbhavati, nānā- taikalyavirodhāt, tasmāt kṣaṇamagnyatvaṃ ghaṭādeḥ |
na tāvat arthakriyākāritve sattā, sato hi arthakriyākāritā, na tu saiva sattā |
na ca sarvasya bhāvasya arthakriyākāritāniyamaḥ, atakāriṇo'pi saṃbhavāt |
na ca jñānakāraṇamapi sarvasya niyatam, ajñātamānamapi svarūpasadbhāvānbhavatvāt |
na ca sarveṣāṃ vijñānaṃ prati ālambanahetutā atītānāgatānāṃ bhāvānāṃ saṃbhavati, avidyamānānāṃ hetutvānupapatteḥ |

hetutve ca sarvajñānaniṣṭhatve sarveṣāṃ vyāptatvāt kramāt kṣaṇabhaṅgena ca punaryāpārānupapatteḥ, tallakṣaṇatvācca sattāyāḥ; sarvajñānānantarameva samasta jagataḥ śūnyatāprasaṅgaḥ, iti yatkiñcidetat |
saṃprati ca bhāvānāṃ krameṇa arthakriyā- karaṇatvam, sahakāriṇapekṣayā vilambopapatteḥ |

saha- kāriṇaśca atiśayamāgamyate bhāvāt mināminnaṃ bhinnameva vā kurvantyeva, yathā bījasya kṣitililasaṃyoge atiśayaḥ, tadalābhe sthāyino'pi bījasya prāgaṅkurānārambhaḥ lābhe cārambhaḥ, iti na kadā cidanupapattiḥ |
nanvevaṃ saṃyogasyaiva kāraṇatvaṃ syāt, na tu bījasya |
bījaviśiṣṭasya tu saṃyogasya kāraṇatve viśeṣaṇabhūtasya bījasyāpi kāraṇatvamaṅgīkāryam |
nanu anyakṣaṇaprāptaḥ samartha eva bhāvaḥ anapekṣo janayitum|
nirapekṣo'pi asau sahakāribhirvinā nāstīti tairvinā na karoti|
kusūlasthaṃ hi bījamanyadeva, anyaccedaṃ kṣitisaṃyuktam, yato'ṅkuro jāyate|
yadidam anyakṣaṇaprāptaṃ kṣiti-salilasaṃyukmaṅkurajanakam, tadyadi kṛṣīvalaprayatnavirahāt kusūlasthameva syāt tadā'pi kimaṅkuraṃ janayati?|
omiticet kimarthaṃ tarhi kṛṣīvalasya prekṣāpūrvakakāraṇaḥ prayāsaḥ|
taduddeśyaśca deśakālanām anarthakaḥ syāt, anyakṣaṇaprāptāt vijñānādeva dharmādharmanipekṣyāt svargaparvādisiddheḥ|
tataśca sahakāri-saṃnidhikrameṇa saṃbhavati syātino'pi bhāvasya krameṇa arthakriyākaraṇam, iti vipakṣe bādhakapramāṇābhāvāt aniyatā kṣaṇikatvena sattā nālaṃ tadanumāpayitum|
na ca dhruvabhāvitayā vināśasya hetvantarāpekṣatvam, ghaṭasaṃtāne kapālasaṃtānasya dhruvabhāvino sumalaprahārādihetvantarāpekṣā-darśanāt anaikāntikatvāt|
nanu hetvantareṇa bhāvādinne vināśe jāte, vināśa'pi bhāvasya pūrvadupalabdhiḥ syāt|
kimidaṃ svābhāviko vināśa iti! bhāvasvabhāvādeva vināśo jāyate, na hetvantarādityarthaḥ|
nanu bhāvādapi jñāno vināśo bhāvā-dviśeṣatve tulya eva doṣaḥ, pūrvavadupalabdhiḥ syāditi|
athāsmin eva vināśo bhāvāt tato vināśasya bhrapa-tyakṣatvāt bhāvo'pi pratyakṣaḥ syāt|
athāpi vināśo nāma na kiñcit bhinnamiva na tattvam|
tato jātasya bhāvasya amati vināśe nityameva syāditi susamarthitaḥ kṣaṇabhaṅgaḥ|
tasmāt bhinnenāpi vināśana bhāvenopalabhyādi nibhyate ityakāmena abhyupagantavyam|
yastu prākṣam atryābheda iti, bhavatu, naitāvatā avasthāvano bhāvasya prākṣaṇaṃ vināśena bhavitavyaṃ pramāṇābhāvāt, nānā'vasthānāmapi yugapadekasmin dharmiṇi viruddhānāṃ krameṇa aruddhānāṃ
tataśca nūtanāvasthāḥ krameṇa anubhava purāṇāvasthāṃ prāptasya prayatnarakṣitasyāpi yuktaḥ avayava-viśleṣaṇādināśaḥ|
na ca sattvā dīpadṛṣṭāntāmātreṇa ghaṭāderapi kṣaṇikatvam, mattāyāḥ saṃdigdhavipakṣayatirekāt ahetutvāt, patijñāyāḥ pratyakṣamivāpratyakṣavirodhāt|
anuguṇaṃ hi sāmānyaṃ saṃbhavati, na ca sarvakṣaṇikavādinā-manubuddhaṃ kiñcit saṃbhavati, saṃbhave vā na sarvakṣaṇa-katvam, tasmān sarvabhāvānāṃ kṣaṇikatvam, natarāṃ śabdasya|
kiṃ punasteṣāṃ tatra pramāṇam? na tāvat pratyakṣaṃ kṣaṇikatvāmīṣṭaṃ kṣamate|
syādeṣā manīṣā, na kṣaṇikatā nāma bhāvasvabhāvādbahi-rbhāvinī tena bhāvānubhavadādeva pratyakṣaṃ kṣaṇikatvāmi sākṣātkaroti|
tadidamapi kṣaṇikatā bhāvasya svabhāvabhūtā satī saṃvittimidhironīti tadyati-rekeṇa vyatiṣṭhate, nānyathā|
na ca tathā saṃvidamudīyā-mānām udīkṣāmahe iti|
atha maḥvīran kṣaṇikatā pratyakṣamīkṣitā'pi na niścayapathamavatīrṇā, tenāgṛhītaiva avabhātīti|
yatra hi pratyakṣasya svabhāvato vikalpavirahitaḥ pṛṣṭhābhāvinā savikalpapratyayena vyāpāro'nugamyate, tatra pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇamiti saugatāḥ|
yatra ca dṛṣṭametat iti pratyayo nodīyate, na tatra pratyakṣamiti svataḥ siddhāntadhrāntā-krāntānāṃ vākchātravilasitam|
yadapi kecidūcire, pratyakṣaṃ jñānaṃ kṣaṇikam, svakālakalitavastuviṣayatayā kṣaṇikatāmavagamayatīti|
anumānamapi saṃbandhānumānanibandhanaṃ kṣaṇikatāṃ na pakṣīkartuṃ kṣamate|
kiṃ punastadanumānam? yat sat tat tat kṣaṇikam|
arthakriyā-kāritā hi sattā, nāparā kā cidasti|
te tu nivartamāne sattāmapi nivartayataḥ, vṛkṣatvaṃ śiśapālamiva|
kathaṃ ca kṣaṇikepu kramayogapadhyāmarthakriyāvirahaḥ? iti atrāhaḥ|
akṣuṇṇako hi bhavan kimarthe kriyājanan-svabhāvo bhavet|
tatrāgrimapakṣaparigrahe sarvāsāmarthakriyāṇām ekasminneva kṣaṇe kṛtakatvāt kunaśca ca kāraṇānupapatteḥ, anantarakṣaṇe arthakriyāsāmarthyaśūnyavāda asallakṣaṇavāpatteḥ|
dvitīyavikalpālambane tu kā'pi tato'rtha-kriyā nodīyata iti ityalakṣaṇavāpacireva|
samartho'pi svabhāvato bhāvaḥ sahakārisamavadhānavalena kadā cit karoti tadabhāvācca tadā neti|
sa hi sahakārī kiñcidārabhate vā na vā|
na khalu anupākarakaṃ prati apekṣaḥ arthavatī|
na hyupyamānaḥ anuvadhyamānasvabhāvo bhavati, viruddhadharmādhyāsasya medāpādakatvāt|
na ca taddhyati-rekāvyatirekābhyāmanyaḥ prakāro'sti, parasparaviruddhayoḥ ekatra samavāyapratītivirahāt|
nanu kṣaṇiko'pi mātraḥ kimarthakriyājanasvabhāvaḥ? kiṃ vā neti prācīṃ vika-lyānāṃ.. nāstīti vartate|
anya-kṣaṇaprāptaḥ samartha eva bhāvaḥ kāryamapi ekaimevārabhate|
nirapekṣasya janakatve sahakāritā'pi tasya kīdṛśīti vaktavyam|
yattāvadidamukte vinā'pi sahakāribhiḥ kimiti na karoti, tat tāvat sugatamataṃ kaugalaviraha-vijṛmbhitam|
sahakāribhirvinā kimiti na man-yantena paryanuyoge hetusvabhāvottaraṃ vācyam|
nanu te'pi anyanirapekṣā eva janakāḥ: kimiti na kāryā-ntaramārabhante|
atrāpi vayamanīśāḥ: māvāstu yadārabhante tadārabhantāmiti anumantameva vayaṃ prabhavāmaḥ|
nenāmī janakā api tadeva janayantīti paśyatāmasmākaṃ nāvayavā-bhyupagamāḥ|
bījādīnāṃ hi kṣaṇaparaṃparāpariṇāme na tādṛśāḥ kṣaṇāḥ saṃjāyante |
nanvevamapi parāpareṣu bījādiṣveṇu tadevaida- miti pratyabhijñā nopapadyate |
apica sapratyabhijñapratyakṣa- virodhe kathamanumānamātratvaṃ labhyate iti vācyam |
ye te kṣaṇasattāmātrikabhedasadṛśatāyā dṛṣṭamapi pratyākalitu- manīśasya bhedāgrahaṇanibandhanaḥ abhedagrahaṇavyavahāraḥ pravartate |
pratyabhijñā tu medāgrahaṇe- nāpi upapadyate iti niravadyam |
ata eva ca vṛddhā vadanti 'bhavati vai pratyakṣadapyanumānaṃ balīyaḥ' |
apica kṛtakānāṃ bhāvānām- vaśyambhāvi vinā kāraṇāntarābhāvāt indriyaṃ saṃnihite nyāyite |
tathāhi, yadyeṣā dhruvabhāvinī, tatra teṣāṃ hetvantarāpekṣā nāsti |
dhruvabhāvī ca kṛtakānāṃ vināśaḥ, iti viruddhavyāptopalabdhi- liṅgamanumānaṃ vināśasya hetvantarāpekṣitaḥ pratiṣidhyati |
ye hi hela- ntarāpekṣāste dhruvabhāvino na bhavanti |
ato hetvantarāpekṣatvaviruddhanirapekṣatva- vyāptadhruvabhāvitvasya vā upalabdhiḥ; saivādhruvabhāvitvasyānu- paladhiḥ |
tathā yadi bhāvā api svahetubhyo vināśaṃ pratyapekṣeran, tatastasya hetvantarasya saṃnidhānaniyame pramāṇabhāvāt kaścit kṛto'pi na vinaśyet |
kiṃ kṛtakā bhāvā svahetubhyaḥ samupājāya- mānā vināśrā eva jāyante avinaśvarā vā |
sa hi jāyamāne vināśo bhāvāt anyatirekī vyatirekī vā ? na tāvadvyatirekī, hetubhedāt |
vyatirekiṇi tu jāte bhāvasya prāgvat upalabdhyādiprasaṅgaḥ |
tena tirodhīyate iti kalpanāyāmapi tirodhānaṃ pratyeva vikalpa ityalamatiprasaṅgena |
taccedante parasparasaṃvalite samākalyadeke pratyabhijñāsākhyātaṃ pratyakṣavijñānaṃ kṣaṇa- bhaṅgānumānaṃ niruṇaddhīti |
dve ete vijñāne grahaṇamaraṇarūpe yathārthaṃ tanmātrātre idantāmātre ca vyāpriyamāṇe nālamubhayānusaṃbhavasamaya- vartitām arthasya avabhāsayitumiti, pratītivirodhāt |
yathaiva khalu abhinnadeśakālaṃ vastu ekatayā cakāsti, tathā atrāpi bhinnadeśakālamapi ekatayaiva parisphuratīti |

tena yadyapi kevalā- dindriyāt kevalāt pūrvānubhavasamāsāditajanamo bhāvanā- 'dhimānāt saṃskārāt nedamevavidhaṃ vijñānamudetumarhati, tathāpi tayoranyonyasamavadhānasamāsāditadaśantarayoḥ idaṃ kāryamityācāryāḥ, na cedamapyucitam |
satyapi saṃskārayoge indriyavyāpārādhīna- janmatā asya prathamasamāgamasamayabhāvinaḥ sakalatvādinā- mapyahitatvādānāṃ pratyakṣasaṃmatāt aviśeṣāt |
bādhakakāraṇadoṣa- saṃvedanantaravirahād nedamevānumānaṃ bādhakamiti nimitta- cittamanujayate, parasparaśrayadopasamāsatteḥ |
khalvetad vijñānamabādhitam, tāvadanumānameva nodetuṃ prabhavati, saṃjātavati cānumāne bādhitamidaṃ bhavati iti viśadataramitaretarakāraṇatvam |
nanvevaṃ tarhi kathaṃ jvālādīnāmekatvam avacāritānāmanumānato medasiddhiḥ |
tatra jvālā''diṣu dṛṣṭamagnā, sāmānyaviṣayamanumānaṃ tu viśeṣaviṣayamiti bhinnagocarapracāriṇoḥ |
sa khalu sahakārisamavadhānopahitaviśeṣo bhāvaḥ tātārtha- kriyāṃ krameṇaiva saṃpādayati |
nanu vikalpitaṃ sahakāribhiḥ kiṃ vyatirikta'vyatiriktaṃ viśeṣa ādhīyate iti |
atrāpi ta eva pratiniyāmakam ... yadinā ayamekāntaḥ asmākaṃ minnānyeva sarvavastūni, na minnāni ceti, kintu sarvabhāveṣu medābhedau saṃgiramahe |
sa hi na dadarśa medā- medāveva tāvadekatra na saṃbhavataḥ |
tatra yathaika ākāraḥ pratītaḥ, tathā vilakṣaṇākārapratītirnāsti |
vila- kṣaṇakāre ca pratīyate naikākārapratītireva nāsti (asti) tena minnāminnaviśeṣaāśrayeṇa arthakriyāsamarthanameghaṭa- mānam |
sā ca sādṛśyavaśenaiva medāgrahaṇātibandhanaiveti yuktā atrāpi parīkṣā |
tatra parīkṣamāṇasya arthakriyā'- nuparattyā kṣaṇike nirṇate sahadaśapararā''pattivipralambhaḥ ayamiti niśrīyate |
bhavati ca vimuśato ... hutavahā- diṣnumānaśena jātāyā api pratīterviparyayaḥ |
hutavahādiṣu cauṣṇyapratītirupājātā parīkṣyamāṇā'pi nānyayopapadyate ... iti na viparyayānumānodayaḥ |
tassādalamena nānāṭakarūpapatitena ... darśanenāti- nirvandhena gambhīrataragurudarśanasāgarapāradṛśvānastu saṃprati samādhimabhidadhati |
sambhādiṣu prathamamanu- bhūteṣu punarantarā tirodhānādivaśena vicchinnopalambhepu punaranubhavataḥ sa evāyamiti tāvajjāyate matiḥ |
tatra yadi arthakriyā sthirā'pi kathañcidupāpadyate, tato medāgrahaṇanibandhano'yamamedabhramaḥ iti kimiti kalpyate |
upapadyate ca sthirā'pi sahakāriviśeṣa- jātāgantukakriyā''dirūpaviśeṣabhājanaḥ krameṇārthakriyā |
sa ca viśeṣo vyatirikta eva bhāvāt arthakriyākāriṇam (ṇaḥ) |
na ca sa eva arthakriyākārī, bhāvantvā'ste iti caturaham |
tathā vidhiviśeṣā- līḍhataiva tasya sādhanatā, yadantaramarthakriyodayaḥ, tadvi- śeṣayogitayaiva bhāveṣu sādhanatvavyavahāro laukikānām |
kathaṃ punarasau viśeṣaḥ tasyeti yadyapyasyate, tadāśraya- tayaivānumānāt |
kathaṃ punastadāśrayatvaiva, svahetudarśaneti matvā nivartatāṃ bhavān |
atha kasmāt bhāvasya medo nānumīyate ? pratyabhijñānānu- guṇāditi vadāmaḥ |
yathā ca arthakriyākāritā, tathedamāpi dṛśyate sthāvaro bhāva iti tadanuguṇamanumānamucitam |

tena sthāvare'pi arthakriyāvyāpakakramayogapadyānivṛtte- siddho vyāpakanupalambhā ... tadasiddhena viparyaye bādhakā- bhāvāt asiddhatamāntrātnubandhinī kṣaṇikatā na sattā sādhayitumalamau, anaikāntikatvāditi |
na ca arthakriyā- kāritvaiva sattā, kintu pramāṇasambandhayogyatā |
yaścidapyayamānaṃ anapekṣābhāvā vināśapratītiḥ, tadapi vimṛśyamānaṃ jātupamivābharaṇaṃ viśiryate |
pradhvaṃsā- bhāvo vināśa iti cet, kaḥ punaḥ pradhvaṃsābhāvaḥ |
kṣīre nāstītyemādikā bhāvaviṣayā saṃviditi yadyucyate, tadā amṛtakalāyāmuditā nītiruddharaṇīyā|
kintu dadhirūpamātrāṇubhave eva svayaṃ- prakāśe śabdaprayogamātrame..tasaiva..payaso nāsti|
na ca tāṃ prati payasa eva nirapekṣasya hetutā|
na cedaṃ payo'ntaramupalabhyate iti śakyaṃ vaktum|
na ca vālāḥ, yenaivaṃ- vidhavādāt bhīṣyāmahai|
yantu punaridaṃ svehetubhyo bhāvā- nāmapi naśvarāṇāmupaco hetvantarāyate vināśe vyatirekiṇi jāte'pi pūrvavat bhāvasya upalabdhyādiprasaṅga iti|
upasaṃprāptaṃ hi nimittaṃ yacchāstroktam, 'puroḍāśau kṣāyataḥ' iti |
atha yaduktam, kṣāmeṇa haviṣā samāptirhṛdyate, yadā tadviḥ saṃtiṣṭhate |
yadā'pi anyenāpi haviṣā tat saṃsthāpyate, tadā'pi prāyaścittamiti na doṣaḥ |
bhāṣyam - evaṃ ceducyate, anyena haviṣā yadā saṃsthāpyate iti |
katham ? yadā saṃtiṣṭheta tatkarma, tena haviṣeti vākyaṃ bhidyeta |
anuvādaśca anyahaviṣke'pi karmaṇi saṃsthite prāyaścitta- miti gamyate |
kathaṃ punaḥ haviḥśabdaḥ karmaṇi vartate iti ? talliṅgayogāt |
soma - yadā agniḥ paktvā kapālāṃnāṃ sāmyam, udakasecanādikaṃ ca apekṣitaparimāṇam |

yadā tu paktvā- dikamanevaṃvidham, tadā ka cit bahuḥvaṃśadāhāt antaradanīyatvam, ka cicca ekasyārthasya atyanta- dāhāt ardhāntarasya adanīyatvam, iti sarvatra ekadeśadāhasya adanīyaphalakapākāntarīyakatayā tadvi- lakṣaṇasya ekadeśadāhasya vaktumaśakyāt na nimittatvam |

evaṃ ca tatra madhyapūrvādhamātram atidagdham itastu adanīyapakam, tatrāpi madhyapūrvādhayoḥ avadānadeśa- mātratayā svayaṃ haviṣvābhāvāt puroḍāśasyaiva haviṣṭvāt, tasya ca sadbhāvāt yathāvatkāśe dviravadāya hotavyam |
na ca sarvakṣaṇe tasya haviṣā evābhāvāt 'yadā tadviḥ saṃtiṣṭhate' ityetat kathamupapadyate iti vācyam |
puroḍāśa haviryasya iti bahuvrīhiṇā tadviḥśabdasya yāgaparatvāt yāgasya saṃsthāsaṃjñanvāt |
tathā ca sarvakṣāme'pi 'yasya sarvāṇi havīṃṣi' iti vacanāt ājyena tadvirupalakṣita- yāgasya samāptiḥ saṃbhavati, iti na kaścidoṣaḥ |
vi-- 'kṣāme yāgo dvayoḥ : sarvadāhe vā, pūrvavad dvayoḥ |
' bhāṭṭa - 'yasya puroḍāśau kṣāyatastaṃ yaṃ varuṇo gṛhṇāti, yadā tadviḥ saṃtiṣṭhate atha tadeva havirnirvepat' iti śrutaprāyaścitte sarvapuroḍāśadāhaṇaṃ kṣāmameva nimittam |
na ca avarjanīyakṣāmānatiriktadeśadāhasyaiva nimittatvam, tasyaiva paricchedumaśakyatvāt |

na ca 'tadviḥ saṃtiṣṭhate' iti śravaṇāt avaśiṣṭena haviṣā yāgapratīteḥ ekadeśadāhasyaiva nimittatvam, prayogasamā- sāveva evaṃjātīyaśabdaprayogasya sarvatra darśanena prayoga- samāptaiva lakṣaṇayā prakṛte'pi pratipādanīyatvāt |
'yadvaidyaṃ havirmāṃpaṃceta, anyattadaiva nirvapet' ityāpastamba- vacanāt sarvadāhe prāyaścittam |
'yadi vā'vadānebhyo na prabhavet' ityāpastambena sarvadāhe avadānāparyāptaikadeśadāhe vā punaḥprayogavidhānena tannirvaikadeśadāhe prāyaścittā- nupapatteḥ |
ata eva ekadeśadāhasya pariccheduṃ śakyatve- 'pi etanmūlabhūtaśrutyaiva tatra prāyaścittasaṃbhavaḥ |
tādṛśa- deśadāhe tu prāktananāśādhikaraṇanyāyena ājyena dagdhā- vaśiṣṭena vā prayogasamāptimātram |
evaṃ sarvakṣāme'pi prayogasamāptiḥ ājyena puroḍāśāntarotpatyā vā draṣṭavyā |
' nānyad havirntaraṃ nirvapet paurṇamāsīmeva śrobhūte yajeta' ityanena anvādhānapradhānayormadhye iṣyantara-
iti prāpte, nahi karmaṇyapakrānte tadasmāpya karmāntaramārabdhaṃ yuktam |
ato na prāptameva nityaṃ kāmyaṃ vā karma |
naimittikam eva tu iṣyo nimittāntarabhāvitvāt prasaṅkāsya ayaṃ niṣedhaḥ |
saṃkarṣa. 3|1|7. kṣīraṃ vihāyorucakamastaḥ sauvīraruciman- bhavati iti nyāyaḥ |
yathā suvāminnirmyuktiriti pakṣaṃ parityajya duḥkhanivṛttireva muktiriti svīkāraḥ |
yathā tacchīrena dagdha- jihvaḥ kaścit tataṃ phūkakṛtya pibati, tathā daivāt suhṛ- kārivastunaḥ prāpto aniṣṭavivakṣāyāṃ bodhyo'yamiti |
uktaṃ ca - 'kṣīreṇa dagdhajihvastaṃ phūkakṛtya pāmaraḥ pibati |
yasya kṣīrena bhojanamuditaṃ bhavati, yadi tassa saśarkaraṃ dīyate, na kaścidvirodho bhavati |
ayaṃ yatrā- ''sakāmo'pi svayajanatuṣṭirbuddhīrṣayā kiñciyāceta tadviṣaye pracarati |
yathā kṣīrārṇavanivāsī śrīkṛṣṇo goṣṭhe gopīḥ kṣīraṃ yācate seti śaṃkarajaye |
yathā kṣīrapūrṇe ghaṭe kati cit andvindvaḥ prakṣitāḥ santaḥ kṣīragraheṇaiva gṛhītā bhavanti |
nahi kṣīragrahaṇāt andvindvagrahaṇaṃ pariśiṣyate, evaṃ brahmaṇā tatkāryaśca avyatiriktadeśatvāt gṛhītameva brahmagrahaṇena namo bhavati |
na kṣīrodakanyāyena idamivavijñānaṃ sarvavijñānaṃ samyagvijñānaṃ syāt |
sāvadhāraṇā ceyam 'ekamevā- dvitīyam' iti śrutiḥ kṣīrodakanyāyena nīyamānā pīḍayet |
saṃmiśratvāt jñāyate kiyat kṣīram, kiya- dudakamiti |
kasmin vā avakāśe kṣīram, kasmin vā avakāśe udakamiti |
kiñcāyaṃ nyāyaḥ : 'tasyādita udāttamatahasvam' (pā0 2|1|32) iti sūtramahābhāṣye'pi vistareṇoktaḥ iti |
su. pṛ. 1114, 'kṣute ācāmet' ityādi smṛtiḥ pramāṇam |
vi. 13|4, kṣutādinimittakaṃ viṣṇusmaraṇaṃ padārthamadhye kartavyaṃ bhavati |
su. pṛ. 1199. kṣutaṃ svādutāṃ janayati iti nyāyaḥ |
tīvrāyāṃ kṣudhi kadambamiha svādutayā bhakṣyate ityarthaḥ |
atra kṣudhitārthamaśanam, na tu aśanāyai kṣudhitaḥ |
' vā. 3|1|7|13 pṛ. 702. kṣetriṇaḥ : mātṛreva vā yadi putraḥ syāt tatastayoḥ prasiddhatvāt naiva ( putrajāteḥ ) durjñānatā bhavet |
vā. 1|1|13 pṛ. 802. kṣemasubhikṣo'yamato'hamasmin deśe prativasāmi ( iti vadanti ) tena ataḥśabdo vṛttasthāpadeśako hetvartha iti jñāyate |
bhā. 1|1|1 pṛ. 8. kṣaumādhikaraṇe ( 10|1|15 ) ādhāne na puṃstvavidhānamityuktam |
vākyārtha. pṛ. 20. kha. khaṭvādyau avidyamānameva strītvaṃ ṭāvādipratyaya- darśanena āropyate |
• khananaṃ 'dābhyāṃ khanati' iti vacanasāmarthyāt hyabhidhānasāmarthyaṃ bhavati |
bhā. 1|2|14|2 khananaṃ vedeḥ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ 'devasya tvā savituḥ prasave iti khanati' rājasūye ratnināṃ haviḥṣu maitrābārhaspatye tu na vedikhananam 'svayaṃkṛtā vediḥ' iti tatra vidhānāt |
vi. 10|11|2. khananaṃ uparavasya pratyekaṃ uparava- mantrādhyātjyotiṣṭome |
bhā. 1|1|4|155-57, khanane dvayormantrayoḥ samuccayaḥ agnicayane (ukhā- ''rthyamakhanane 'dābhyāṃ khanati' iti vidhānāt ) |
'nityaṃ na bhavanaṃ yasya, yasya vā nityabhūtatā |
ya eva hi prasavabhavanaḥ, saṃbhā- vitabhavano vā anyena prayujyate, sa eva kriyamāṇatvena avadhāryate, nānyaḥ |
tathā ca na kaścit khapuṣpākāśāṃ vā kurvanpalabhyate |
samāsa vinā khapuṣpaśabdāt saṃsargāpratīteḥ samāsāvacchinnaṃ khapuṣpasaṃrgasya abhyupagantavyam |
pramāṇāntareṇa ca khasya puṣpasya khasaṃsargāpratīteḥ khasya puṣpamasti iti vigrahā- yogāt khasya puṣpa nāsti itivākyārthe samāsāpratīteḥ khapuṣpābhāva eva khapuṣpaśabdasya vācyatvāt mukhyo'rthaḥ |
su. pṛ. 505. khapuṣpādīnāṃ nanu svārthāvinābhūta- guṇābhāvāt gauṇaprayogābhāvaprasaṅgaḥ |
' yattāvat 'khapuṣpa- sthānīyā āmā' 'khapuṣpaṃ bhavasiddhāntaḥ' ityādiḥ prayogaḥ; tatra katarat khapuṣpam anyatva tyā sihatvavada- dhāritam, yadadhyāropyate |
na caitasya loke gauṇatva- pratītirmulyā arthāntarabhāvāt |
'khapuṣpaṃ bhavasiddhāntaḥ' ityādi khapuṣpādīnām ananubhūtapūrvatvāt īdṛśamiti nirūpaṇāśakteḥ siddhāntādau āropasaṃbhavena gauṇatvā- nāpattiḥ |

atha tatra samudāyatvena lapuṣpāderaprasiddhāvapi lapuṣpaśabdasya yaugikatvāt viśvakalitaprasiddhimādāya svādhikaraṇatāsaṃsargeṇa āropitatvādhikaraṇakatvaṃ latādau prasiddhaṃ puṣpaṃ khapuṣpasamāsārthamaṅgīkṛtya tadāropeṇa siddhānte gauṇatā khapuṣpaśabdasya ityucyate, tataḥ khapuṣpaśabdasya āropitasaṃsargarūpārthavṛttitvāt tadāśrayalatāpaṣpe eva khapuṣpaśabdasya gauṇatvāpattiḥ |
ata eva arthalakṣaṇamapi āropa- pitāśrayatvakaraṇatvarūpa latāpaṣpe apratisakam, tasyāpyā- ropisatādhikaraṇatākatvasārthāśrayeṇa gauṇatvopatteḥ |
¤ puṣpādī khasaṃbandhitvādhyāropeṇa cāropitaṃ khapuṣpa- śabdārthamaṅgīkṛtya tadvṛttiguṇānāmasattvādīnāṃ siddhānte sattvācca na 'khapuṣpaṃ bhavasiddhāntaḥ' ityādau avyāptiḥ ( gauṇalakṣaṇasya ) |

( nanu vādinā prativādisiddhāntasya atyantāsattva- khyāpanārtham 'khapuṣpaṃ bhavasiddhāntaḥ' iti yatra prayujyate tatra khapuṣpādīnāmatyantāsattvena mukhyārthaguṇayogasyā- bhāvāt āropitārthatvameva gauṇatvamaṅgīkartavyam iti śaṅkayate - ) kathaṃ tarhi khapuṣpaśavipādīnāṃ śabdānāṃ gauṇatā 'khapuṣpaṃ bhavasiddhāntaḥ' ityādiṣu |
nahi teṣāṃ mukhyamabhidheyamiti, yena sādṛśyāt gauṇatvaṃ syāt |
( āropitārthatvavādinā hi paratra mukhyārthā- ropāt gauṇatvamiṣyate |
tathā ca asatāṃ khapuṣpādīnāṃ paratrāropasaṃbhavāt tanmate'pi idaṃ duṣaṇamityāha - ) yadi eṣāmabhidheyaṃ nāsti, kathaṃ tarhi anyata āropaḥ |
( pratibandhā anuttaratvādāha - ) tena tadrūpameva āropita- maṅgīkartavyam |

yadi ca prāguktaprati- bandīparihārārtham āropitārthatvavādinā paratra mukhyārthī- ropamādāya gauṇatvaṃ neṣyate, kintu āropitārthatvamādāyeṣyate tadā doṣamāha - ) tvapakṣe tu khapuṣpe eva khapuṣpaśabdo gauṇaḥ syāt āropitavacanatvāt |
khapuṣpādīnāmapi mukhyasādṛśya- vivakṣayaiva laukikā gauṇa prayogaṃ prayujyate |
yathā ākāśasya puṣpātmanā śaśamūrdhavartināṃ cāvayavānāṃ viṣāṇānāṃ vikāraḥ atyantāprasiddho niṣpramāṇakaḥ |
( anena granthena ākāśasyaiva sādṛśyapratiyogitvam, tasya tu na svarūpeṇa sādṛśyaprati- yogitvam, kintu puṣpādivāvikāratvam |
tataśca puṣpādi- vikāratvamāsannasya'pi svarūpeṇa sattvāt atyantāsataḥ kathaṃ sādṛśyanirūpakatvam iti śaṅkā nirastā ) |
śā. soma. 1|4|12 pṛ. 85. khapuṣpaśabdasya la-puṣpa- saṃsargātmakatārthatvena khapuṣpe eva gauṇatvopatteḥ |
na ca etasya āropyasya loke gauṇatvaṃ prasiddham, siṃhatvādeḥ āropasya gauṇatvaprasiddheḥ |
• khasya dānaṃ pratigraho vikrayaśca anācāra udī- cyānām |
khasya maitrī ādau gāḍhā'pi krameṇa havati ante ca naśyati yathā, tadvat iti |
uktaṃ ca - 'dhuddhā yuvānaḥ śiśavaḥ kapotāḥ khale yathā yamī yugapat patanti |
tathaiva sarve yugapat padārthāḥ parasparamanvāyino bhavanti ||
atra vṛddhayuvāśiśubhiḥ kapotairitarataracitra- hitakālokānāṃ padārthānāṃ sāmyaṃ bodhyam |
'dadhnā payasā juhoti' iti sarvaireva guṇa- vidhānaṃ prapadyate |
tatra khalepotanyāyena sarvaipāmeva yugapat pravṛtteḥ ekāvacchedābhāvāt |

bhā. 2|1|10. ekasya pradhānasya eka eva phaladhānasāmarthyoddeśyasya upakāraḥ sakṛdeva sopāyamapekṣate, ataśca tathā ekayaiva ākāṅkṣayā khalepotanyāyena yugapat sarvaiṣāmanvayānāṃ pradhānottitvātaikaikavākyatayā'ṅgīkṛtya . |
11|1|2. padārthopasthiteḥ kramikatve'pi kriyāyāṃ khalepotanyāyena yugapadanyāt sarvaipāmeva vidheyasyasamparkatvopapattiḥ |
kau. 3|16|12 pṛ. 163. chatrī vāsasī kuṇḍalī devadatta ityādi tāvatpadārthānāṃ saraṇāt ekadaiva khale- kapotanyāyāt tāvatpadārthānāṃ kriyākramamevā'nvayabodha- rūpaḥ śabdabodho bhavatīti cit |
nyāyamuktāvalī. śabda0 arthena pradhānopakāreṇa khalepotavat yugapat saṃnipatantyenā |
khalevālyāḥ yūpatā vidhīyate, na yūpasya khalevālitā |
tathā avyavahitena bhavatinā saṃvandhāt pratyakṣaṃ vākyam |
bhā. 10|2|3|71, dup - yūpānuvādena khalevālītve vidhīyamāne adṛṣṭārthatā prāpnoti |
khalevālyāḥ yūpakāryaṃ vidhīyamānāyā dṛṣṭameva pañcanapa- kramaṇaṃ prayojanam |
bhāṣyam - khalevālyāmeva saṃśayaḥ kiṃ takṣaṇaṃ joṣaṇamucchrayaṇam ityevamādayaḥ padārthāḥ kartavyāḥ, neti |
khalevālībhūtasya hi yūpakāryaṃ viniyoge kṛte kṛtaḥ śāstrārtho bhavati |
vipratiṣedhaḥ kṛto bhavet, kriyamāṇe takṣṇaḥ khalevālyāḥ |
yat kāṣṭhaṃ khale vāraṇapravṛttam, sā khalevālī |
takṣaṇe kriyamāṇe sā vinaśyet, dvyantaraṃ jāyeta, yajña khale vāraṇaṃ pravṛttam |
vṛkṣāṇāṃ hi joṣaṇam, na tu vikārasya |
soma-- yathāsiddhakhalevālyupādāne'pi takṣaṇādayaḥ kartavyāḥ śakyatvāt ityudhiteḥ saṃgatiḥ |
syurvā no, codakāt syuḥ, no vaiyarthyācca virodhataḥ ||
bhāṭṭa-- yathāsiddhakhalevālyā evopādānāt chedana- nivṛttāvapi takṣaṇādīnāma nivṛttiḥ manvānaṃ prati uttaram |
teṣāṃ hi yadi tāvat ślakṣṇībhāvādi dṛṣṭaṃ prayojanam, tatastasya khalevāraṇa- kriyāprayuktasyaiva sattvena prasaṅgasiddhadhupapatteḥ, na pārthakyena takṣaṇādyanuṣṭhāpakatā |

yadi tu dīkṣākālakartavyapārthānām adṛṣṭarūpayūpatvotpādakatvasya sthāpitatvāt, prakṛte ca khalevāraṇakriyāprayuktakāṣṭhavidhānena chedanāditidharma- bādhasya āvaśyakatvāt, sāmagryabhāvena yūpatvānupapatteḥ |
apūrvameva khalevālyāṃ paśunīyojanam, tadā sutarāṃ takṣaṇā- dīnāṃ dīkṣākālakartavyatādīnāṃ padārthānāmabhāvaḥ |
nilananocchrayaṇayostu adīkṣā- kālīnayoḥ yūpasvarūpābhāve'pi yatra kṣetradeśe khale- vālī tatraiva sādyaskṛvidhānāt prasaṅgasiddhakāryavādevā- bhāvaḥ |
bhāṣyam-- khalevālyāmeva saṃdehaḥ kiṃ maitrāvaruṇa- daṇḍena bhūmeḥ samakriyā, adbhirvasacenaṃ balavadavadhānam añjanam ityevamādayaḥ padārthāḥ kartavyāḥ, uta neti |
yādṛśaḥ khale vāraṇaṃ vartate, tādṛśa eva yūpa- kārye viniyoktavyaḥ |
arthā- bhāve kāryābhāve, yadi khalevālyāḥ taiḥ saṃskāraiḥ kāryaṃ na bhavati, tato yūpaḥmeva teṣāṃ nimittaṃ syāt, khalevālyāṃ na bhaveyuḥ |
iha punarbhūmaiḥ samakriyā, adbhirvasacenena, balavadavadhānane ca kāryamasti dāḍharyam |
śithilā hi sā khale vāraṇena bhavati |
añjanamapi anupaghātakaṃ codakaprāptaṃ kriyamāṇamadhikāya guṇāya syāt, na doṣāya |
soma-- takṣaṇādayaḥ paryūhādināmapi khalevālyāṃ na ityudhiteḥ saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrāthaistu - arthābhāve hi yūpasvarūpādṛṣṭasaṃskārārthatāmādāya khalevālyāṃ nivṛttiḥ syāt, na tu atra arthābhāvaḥ iti |

' dṛṣṭārthāni, yāni ca prokṣaṇādyanyapariṣecanādīni teṣāṃ dīkṣākālakartavyatvābhāvena yūpotpasyarthatvābhāvāt, yūpadārthatvena ca arthalopasyāpi abhāvāt, paśuparvasādhanabhūtapaśuniyojanaprayuktatayā khalevālyāṃ karaṇamiṣṭameva |
khalevālyāṃ prākṛtasya khādiratvasya citraidhau ca taṇḍulānāṃ vrīhiyavāntarajanyatvasya niyamo nāsti ||
vipratiṣedhe tadvacanāt prākṛtaguṇalopaḥ syāt, tena ca karmasaṃyogāt |
bhāṣyam-- sādyasrake śrūyate 'khalevālī yūpo bhavati' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ khādiraśabdena prāpyate sa khale- vālī kartavyaḥ, atha na prāpyate khādirau alādi vā khalevālī syāditi |
tathā citrāyāṃ śrūyate 'dadhi madhu ghṛtaṃ payo dhānā udakaṃ taṇḍulāḥ saṃsṛṣṭaṃ prājāpatyaṃ bhavati' iti |
tatrāpi saṃdehaḥ kiṃ vrīhyaśabdena prāpyante trīhastaṇḍulāḥ kartavyāḥ, uta na prāpyante maihā maihavā vā taṇḍulā upādātavyā iti |
kiṃ tāvat prāptam ? khādiradiḥ khalevālī kartavyā, vaihāstaṇḍulāḥ kartavyāḥ |
teṣāṃ prāptānāṃ khalevālīṃ vidhīyate 'yo yūpaḥ sa khalevālī kartavyaḥ' iti |
śakyate hi yūpaḥ khalevālī kartum, na khalevālī kena cit prakāreṇa yūpo bhavati |
khādiradīnāṃ hi kāṣṭhānāṃ saṃskārairyūpaḥ kriyate chedanādibhiḥ; na tu anye- ṣām |
tatra yūpo bhavatīti yūpakāryaṃ bhavatītyuktaṃ syāt, tathā lakṣaṇāśabdo bhavet |
teṣāṃ tadbhūtānāṃ piṣṭabhāvaṃ pratyāyya devatāsaṃbandhaḥ kriyate |
vipratiṣedhe etasmin, prākṛtasya guṇasya lopaḥ syāt |
khalevālyāḥ yūpatā vidhīyate, na yūpasya khalevālītā |
tathā (sati) avyavahitena bhavatinā saṃbandhāt pratyakṣaṃ vākyam |
khalevālīśabdasya yaḥ khale (valīvardanām ) vāraṇe pravartate, tasya vācakaḥ |
tathābhūtaśca yūpakāryaṃ viniyujyate 'yā khalevālī sa yūpaḥ' iti |
yattu yūpaśabdaḥ kāryalakṣaṇārtha iti, vyavadhānāt lakṣaṇā'pi jyāyasī |
pratyakṣaṃ hi lakṣaṇāyām, parokṣaṃ vyavadhāne vākyam |
tasmāt yajjātīyasya vṛkṣasya khalevālī kṛtā, tajjātī- yasya yūpakāryaṃ viniyoktavyā |
pratyakṣa śrutiḥ tathā codakena bādhitā syāt |
dup-- 'na yūpasya khalevālītvaṃ ( vidhīyate ) tathā avyavahitena bhavatinā saṃbandhāt pratyakṣaṃ vākyam |
itarathā vyavahitena ( bhavatinā ) saṃbandhāt parokṣaṃ syāt' iti ( bhāṣyam ) ayuktamidaṃ ( pūrvapakṣanirā- karaṇam ) |
katham ? śabdadharmo'yam ( kramaḥ ), arthe prati śabdo guṇabhūtaḥ, śabdaṃ prati kramaḥ ( guṇabhūtaḥ ) |
tasmāt vācya eva śabdasya yo'rthaḥ, sa grahītavyaḥ ( pradhānatvāt ) |
tasmāt pūrvapakṣanirākaraṇam ( etat ) ayuktam iti anyathā varṇyate |
yūpānuvādena khale- vālītve vidhīyamāne ( sati ) adṛṣṭārthatā ( vidheḥ ) prāpnoti |
khalevālyāḥ ( tu ) yūpakāryaṃ vidhīyamānāyāḥ dṛṣṭameva ( paśvanapakramam ) prayojanam |
tasmāt ( dṛṣṭārtha- tvāt siddhānte ) yathāśrutameva ( avyavahitasaṃbandhena ) vākyam ( bhavati ) |
kathaṃ tarhi ayam ( bhāṣya - ) granthaḥ ? ( uttaram ) upacayatvena |
( etaduktaṃ bhavati ) ayaṃ cāparo guṇaḥ ( siddhānte labhyate, yaduta ) avyavahitena bhavatinā saṃbandhaḥ iti |
soma-- kimatra prākṛtaṃ khādiradikaṃ pravartate, uta na iti adhikaraṇajñaḥ saṃśayaḥ |
kiṃ yo yūpaḥ sa khale- vālī kartavyaḥ iti vacanavyaktiḥ, uta yā khalevālī sa yūpaḥ iti tadarthaḥ ? saṃśayaḥ |
sūtrāthaistu -- vipratiṣedhe saṃśaye sati prākṛtaguṇasya khādiradyādeḥ nivṛttiḥ syāt tadvacanāt khalevālyāḥ yūpatvavacanāt, taṇḍulānāṃ mī. ko. 193
gāgīyatvavacanāt, tena khalevālyādidravyeṇa niyojanādi- karmasaṃyogāt iti |
' bhāṭṭa- sādhyatke 'khalevālī yūpo bhavati' iti śrutam |

tatrātideśaprāptaṃ khādiratvaṃ nivartate na vā, tathā citraiṣṭhau 'dadhi madhu ghṛtaṃ payo dhānā udakaṃ taṇḍulānta saṃsṛṣṭaṃ prājāpatyam' ityatra taṇḍule vrīhiviniyomo nivartate na veti cintāyām, āyodāharaṇe tāvat na yūpakāryaṃ khalevālī yathā'vasthitā vidhīyate yūpapade kāryalakṣaṇā''- patteḥ |
kintu yūpoddeśena khalevālītvaṃ khale vāraṇakriyārūpaṃ saṃskārakatayā vidhīyate |
na cādṛṣṭārthatvāpatteḥ lakṣaṇā- 'ṅgīkāre'pyadoṣaḥ, niṣādasthapatyadhikaraṇanyāyena tasyā doṣatvāt |
ataśca prakṛtitvat khādirameva yūpaṃ saṃpādya tasya prayogamadhye eva khalevālītvaṃ saṃpādanīyam |
astu vā khalevālyāḥ eva yūpakāryoddeśena vidhiḥ, tathāpi sthānā- patyā itaradharmavat khādiratvasyāpi lābhāt, yaiva vastutaḥ pūrve khādirau khalevālī, saiva grāhyeti |
iti prāpte, na tāvat yūpoddeśena khalevālītvavidhiḥ, tadā hi uddeśya- samarpakaṃ yadi tāvat khalevālīpadameva, tadā ekaprasaratā- bhaṅgaḥ |

yadi tu yūpapadam, tadā suvantayoḥ parasparama- medānvayābhāvāt 'khalevālītvena yūpaṃ bhāvayet' ityevaṃ- vidyaśabdebodhanārthaṃ khalevālīpade khalevālītvasya viśeṣatvapratipatyarthaṃ lakṣaṇā''patteḥ |
na ca 'daṇḍī praipānvāha' itivat tadanāpattiḥ, tatra śabdabodhe daṇḍaviśiṣṭapuruṣasya kartṛtvenānvaye'pi prāptāprāptavivekena daṇḍe eva vidhilopapatteḥ |
prakṛte tu yūpakamekabhāvanāyāṃ khalevālyāstattvenānvayānanupapatteḥ avaśyaṃ khalevālītvasya bhāvanāyāmanvayo vācyaḥ |
tasya ca na viśeṣaṇaprādhānyaṃ vinā siddhiriti lakṣaṇā''
khādir- svādidārasya khuvādeḥ atideśaṃ vinā vikṛtatvāprāpteḥ dviruktatvāpattibhayāt vikṛtyarthatvaṃ khādirtvāderna jātam |

āhavanīyādidārasya tu homasya vikṛtāvi nakṣatre- ṇyādau upadeśāt prāptatvāt tādarthye'pi āhavanīyasya dviruktatvānāpatteḥ khādirtvādi nyāyābhāvāt yūpopāda- kasya cchedasya prakṛtyarthatvāt yūpasya prakṛtyarthatvavat ādhānasya prakṛtyarthatve na kaścideturasti |
su. 3|7 pṛ. 42. ꠵ khādirlābhe tasya takṣaṇādisaṃskārasāmarthye'pi niyojanakāryasāmarthye sati khadira eva grāhyaḥ |
꠵ khādirālābhena kadarayūpe paśuniyojanānantaraṃ khādire labdho'pi nopādeyaḥ prayojanasya jātatvāt |
bhā. 6|3|17|36, ꠵ khādirālāmena pratinidhī kardre saṃskṛte punaḥ khadiralābhe tasya punaḥ takṣaṇādayaḥ kartavyāḥ; saṃskṛte'pi pratinidhissyāt |
vi. 6|3|17. ꠵ khādirādīnāṃ yūpadravyāṇāṃ vikalpaḥ ekakāryārtha- tvāt |
mā. 12|3|14|10-15, ꠵ khādirādīnāṃ vāja- peyādivikṛtau vaikalpikānāṃ prākṛtānām anyatamapunaḥ- śrutau niyamavidhiḥ |
prativarṇaṃ vyañjakadhvanibhedāt bhinnadhvanisaṃnidhijanyatvasya sattve'pi gakāro'yaṃ phakāro- 'yam ityādipratyayametaddarśanam |
su. pṛ. 706. ꠵ gakārādīnāṃ varṇatvaśabdatvaguṇatveṣu satsu drutādibhedasya paropādhivāt gakārādirāpaikatvasiddheḥ gatvādimātraṃ na kalpitam |
sāhastrī. 715. ꠵ gaṅgāṃ praviṣṭā'nekā nadī gaṅgāgrahaṇena gṛhyate iti nyāyaḥ |
ke.) bhūtiḥ pṛ. 298. ꠵ 'gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ' ityādī lakṣaṇaṃ vinā padānta- rānvayasaṃbhavaḥ |
su. pṛ. 793. ꠵ gaṅgāsrotovat ka cit anuvṛttiḥ |
( gaṅgāpravāho vahan mārgasthān sarvā- neva bhūbhāgānārdrayati tadvat ) |
yathā ca 'yatraiṣā meghanīlā calati gaja- ghaṭā rākṣasastatra yāyādetat pāriplavābhyam : dyutituraga- balaṃ dhāryatāṃ rākṣasena |
patīnāṃ rākṣasoṭaṃ nayatu bala- miti prekṣyan maṅgāmāsīt snehayogāt sthitamiha nagare rākṣasānāṃ sahasram |

yathā gajabhuktaṃ hi kapitthaphalaṃ tadudarādabhameva niḥsarati, tacca bhramaṃ sat majjāśūnyaṃ prakṣālitamivābhātīti prasiddham ! tathā ca, yathā niricchrādiktināścāmādisānandaṃ tanmajjā''di kathaṃ niḥsṛtamiti na tarkagocaratāmeti, tathā gatā'pi lakṣmīrnaiva lakṣyate |
uktaṃ ca 'gatā vilakṣyate naiva gajabhuktakapitthavat' iti |
yathā gadulikānāmavīnāṃ gaṇādekā cet kūpe patitā, tadā vāryamāṇā'pi sarvā- sātra patnantīti tathā prakṛte'pi |
sāhastrī. 21. ꠵ gaṇa eva saṃghātadharmaiḥ gamanamanugrahītuṃ samarthaḥ |
śatokthyādiṣu śatrātirātrādiṣu dvādaśāhikāni daśāhāni pravartante ityavagatam |
tāni ca ukthyasaṃsthānāni dvau agni- ṣṭomau |
śatokthyam ityukte ca agniṣṭome ukthyasto- pacayaḥ kartavyaḥ, śatrātirātre ca sarveṣu rātriparyāyeṣvaḥ |
tatra kiṃ dvādaśāhopacayaḥ kivā jyotiṣṭomāt iti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
śatokthyādiṣu gaṇepu āgamanīyānāṃ stotrāṇāmupacayaḥ prakṛtibhūtāt dvādaśāhat kartavyaḥ iti pūrvapakṣaṃ vāśabdo vyāvartayati |
stotrāṇāmupacayaḥ dvādaśāhat na kartavyaḥ, kintu ekāhāt kartavyaḥ |
dvādaśāhe saṃsthāstotrāṇi nāmnātāni iti yatra āmnātāni tato grāhyāṇi |
tāni ca jyotiṣṭomike ukthye atirātre cā- mnātāni, iti tata eva ekāhāt stotrāṇāmupacayaḥ kartavyaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
gaṇaśabdo'tra dvirātrādīnāṃ saṃvatsaraparyantānāṃ aha- rgaṇānāṃ vācakaḥ |
teṣu gaṇepu ahargaṇepu dvādaśāhasya vidhvantaḥ pravartate |
rātriśabdo'pi tathā, iti etat śabdagataṃ liṅgam |
evam 'dvābhyāṃ lomāvatya, dvābhyāṃ māṃsam' ityetadārabhyaḥ dvādaśāhastvaṃ dvādaśāhikaṃ dharmaṃ gavāmayane darśayati |
ke. ꠵ gaṇacodanāyāṃ yasya liṅgaṃ sadāvṛttiḥ pratī- yetāmevat |
tatra kiṃ pṛṣṭhaṣaḍahagatasya prathamābhyāsaḥ abhyāso- 'yaṃ vihitaḥ tasya trivṛttoktatvāt, kiṃvā dvādaśā- hikepu krameṇa caturṣu ahaḥsu codakena prāpteṣu trivṛ- stomakatvaṃ vidhīyate iti saṃśayaḥ |
evaṃvidhāyāṃ gaṇacodanāyāṃ satyāṃ yasya ahaḥ liṅgaṃ syāt, tadāvṛttiḥ pratīyeta |
prakṛte trivṛnti iti trivṛttvaṃ ṣaḍaha- gatasya prathamāhaḥ |
tasmāt tasyaiva iyaṃ caturvāram āvṛttiḥ pratītā bhavati |
āgneyavat yathā 'agnaye pāvakāya' 'agnaye śucaye' iti devataikyāt sāmānyāt āgneyasya vidhyantasyābhyāsaḥ tadvat |
꠵ nānā'hāni vā saṃghātatvāt, pravṛttaliṅgena codanāt |

janakatsatrātre 'tasya catvāri trivṛnti ahāni agniṣṭomamukhāni, viśvajit, mahāvrataṃ ( stotraṃ ) atirātre' iti ahaḥklṛptiḥ satyāpāḍhīye paṭhitā ( 17|8|24 ) agniṣṭomaḥ prathamamahaḥ, tataḥ catvāri trivṛnti ahāni iti pañca, viśvajit ṣaṣṭham, atirātraḥ saptamaṃ tatra ca mahāvrataṃ stotram, iti sapta ahāni |
tatra catvāri ahāni iti saṃghāta eṣa ucyate |
catvāri iti saṃkhyā pṛthaktvāneveśinī ahāṃ pṛthakve eva saṃbhavati |
santi ca satrātre codanayā pravṛttāni dvādaśāhikāni nānā ahāni |
tāni anūdya trivṛttvaṃ vidhātuṃ śakyate, na tu trivṛnti bahūni ahānyanūdya tatra catuḥsaṃkhyā vidhātuṃ yuktā |
tasmāt saṃghātatvāt pravṛtta- liṅgena codanāt janakatsatrātre catvāri ahāni dvādaśā- hikāni nānā ahāni syuḥ |
teṣu ca trivṛttvaṃ vidhīyate iti viśeṣaḥ |
janakatsatrātre 'catvāri trivṛnti ahāni' dvādaśā- hikāni nānā ahāni, na pṛṣṭhaṣaḍahagataprathamābhyāsa- rūpāṇi ityatra, 'catvāri trivṛntyahāni agni- ṣṭomamukhāni' iti anyārthadarśanaṃ bhavati |
mukhameva agniṣṭomaḥ, uttarāṇi catvāri tu agniṣṭomamukhāni |
asmāt anyārthadarśanāt jñāyate tāni catvāri ahāni dvādaśāhikāni iti |

3|4|1|3 pṛ. 940. ' gargo: śataṃ daṇḍayantām ' ityatra samudāye vākya- parisamāpti: |
bhā. 3|1|6|12 pṛ. 697. gargatrirātre ājyadohanāle laukikā- prerupanidhānam |
bhāṣyam -- gargatrirātre ājyadohāni sāmāni prakṛtya śrūyate 'agnimupanidhāya stuvate' iti |
atra viśaya: kiṃ laukiko'gni: upanidheya:, uta vaidika iti |
kuta: ? sarvakarmārtha: utpanno- 'gnī 'yānyahaṃ karmāṇi kariṣye, vaiśvānarasyetyuccai: ' iti |
etasmin viśaye laukikaṃ vaidikamiti laukika: syāt |
laukika: sarvārtha:; na tasya kārye kiñcit nirdiṣṭam |
ato yadyat agninā kartavyaṃ dṛṣṭamadṛṣṭaṃ vā, tattadupādīyamānamaviruddham |
bhāṣyam -- atha yaduktaṃ vaidikaṃ sarvakarmārthamutpannam, tasmāt tadupanidheyamiti |
tasya śāstreṇa kāryaṃ nirdiṣṭam 'yadāhavanīye juhoti ' ityārabhya |
sarvārthatvaṃ cāpāṃ svecche kārye vartamānānāṃ bhaviṣyati |
bhāṣyam -- atha chelyā agnaya: kasmānnapanidhī- yante ? atrocyate itareṣāmapi agnīnāṃ chelyānāṃ tathotyatti: |
prayo- jane datte nirākāṅkṣībhūtā:; anyatra śeṣabhāve eṣāṃ nāsti pramāṇam |
chelyā api (agnaya:) vyāghā- raṇārthamupannā: tenaiva nirākāṅkṣā: nānyatra viniyojyā: |
vyāghāraṇe kṛte apavṛtte karmaṇi laukika:, iti prasaṅgāt upanidhāne saṃbhavati, yo'nya ānīyate tatra prayatna: kartavya iti (sa cāyukta: ) |
soma-- vāsaḥprabhṛtiṣu saṃskṛtavacanatvanirākaraṇa- prasaṅgāt aśiścandasyāpi saṃskṛtavacanatānirakaraṇāt saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu-- laukikaṃ vaidikaṃ vā iti viśaye laukikaṃ syāt |
kutaḥ ? sarvārthatvāt, na tu vaidikam, arthanirdeśāt homādiprayojananirdeśana nirā- kāṅkṣatvāt |
atra (mūle) 'na vaidikamarthanirdeśāt' iti guṇasūtramapi ekīkṛtya likhitam |
(mudrakaistu tathā na mudritamityanyadetat- ke.) vi-- 'vaidiko laukiko vā'nirviśeyaḥ, saṃskṛte- vaṃśāt |
' bhāṭṭa-- gargatrirātre ājyadohāni sāmāni prakṛtya 'agnimupanidhāya stuvīta' iti śrutam |

tatrāgniḥ kiṃ vaidiko laukiko veti cintāyām, yadyapi dvādaśe (12| 2|1|1-7) āhavanīyādīnāṃ yogyatā laukikāpādyarthatvaṃ nirasyate, tathāpi 'yairasyadhikṛtaḥ yāgaḥ śakye prayoktum' iti sāmānyavacanena vaidikakarmamātrārthatvāvateḥ vaidika eva |

iti prāpte, 'āhavanīyaṃ juhoti' ityādiviśeṣa- vacanānāmupalakṣaṇatve pramāṇābhāvāt 'yairasyadhikṛtaḥ' ityasya ca homādimātraviṣayatve'pi sārthakyāt upa- nidhānaviśeṣa laukikābhrahaṇe'pi caritārthatayā āhava- nīyādīnām 'vi vā eṣa indriyeṇa vīryeṇardhyate yasyāhi- tāgnerabhripakṣyāti' iti vacanena niṣiddhasya āyatanāt calanasya ākṣepumaśakyatvāt laukikābhreva grahaṇam |
ata eva śiṣyāmīnāmapi vyādhāraṇamātraprayojana- tvāt agrahaṇam |
yadi paraṃ vyādhāraṇettaraṃ laukikātvā- viśeṣāt upasthitatvāt teṣāmeva grahaṇam ityādyucyeta, tadā astu nāma tat |
