dīkṣāṃ vidhāya 'teṣāmekāhayāṃ krayaḥ saṃpadyate, tena ekāhyāṃ na chambaṭ kurvanti' iti dīkṣātaḥ pracyutāmekāhyāṃ krayeṇa tu gṛhan (krayeṇānugrahan iti citralakarīye śuddhaḥ pāṭhaḥ) mādhyāḥ paurṇamāsyāḥ adhikāraṃ darśayati |
asyāṃ ca mādhyāmaṣṭamyām abhījyamānāyāṃ bhavati mantraḥ 'yāṃ janāḥ pratinandanti rātriṃ dhenumivā- yatīm |
saṃvatsarasya yā patnī sā astu sumaṅgalī ||
prāgādhikaṃ tu, sve ca, pragāthe ca |
kathaṃ pragāthaḥ svaḥ ? vihito hi gavāmayane brahmāsāma prakṛtya, tasmād brahmāsāmnaḥ svaḥ pragāthaḥ |
pragāthaśabdena ca vacanāt svaḥ pragātha ityucyate |
tacca pragāthane yujyate, na tṛca- gāne |
katham ? caturuttaraṃ hi śataṃ te pragāthāḥ |
bhāṣyam— idamāmnāyate ‘pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍaho bṛhadratha- tarasāmā’ iti |
tatra ayamarthaḥ sāṃśayikaḥ kiṃ ahaḥsu dvisāmakaṃ kartavyam, uta keṣu cit ahaḥsu rathaṃtaram, keṣu cit bṛhat iti |
kutaḥ saṃśayaḥ ? yadi ete samaste sāmanī yadi vibhakte, ubhayā pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍaho bṛhadrathaṃtara- sāmā iti śabdaḥ avakalpate |
tatra eṣa vicāraḥ kiṃ dvaṃdvagarbho bahuvrīhirayaṃ bṛhadrathaṃtare sāmanī yasya iti, uta anekapado bahuvrīhiḥ bṛhat asya rathaṃtaraṃ asya iti |
yadi dvaṃdvagarbho bahuvrīhiḥ pratyahaṃ samaste sāmanī, aneka- pade bahuvrīhau vibhakte iti |
tataḥ etat varṇyate dvaṃdvagarbho bahuvrīhiḥ iti |
kutaḥ ? bṛhadrathaṃtaraśabdayoḥ ānantaryāt vṛttipakṣasya āśritatvāt, vṛttipakṣe ca samāsasya nityatvāt |
dvaṃdvaṃ ca svārthāmidhānāt śrutyanugrahaḥ antaraṅgatā ca |
evaṃ cet pratyahaṃ samaste sāmanī bhavetām |
yathā ‘jyogamayāvinaḥ ume kuryāt’, ‘saṃsve ume kuryāt’, ‘apacitavāpi ekāhe bṛhadrathaṃtare kuryāt’ iti |
ḍupa— kiṃ dvaṃdvagarbho bahuvrīhirayam, athavā aneka- padaviśiṣṭaḥ iti (saṃśayaḥ) |
tayoḥ (ānantaryeṇa uccaritatvāt prathamaṃ tāvat āna- ntaryeṇa (dvaṃdvalakṣaṇaḥ) saṃbandhaḥ (bhavati) paścāt aśabdena |
saḥ prāganya- padārthasaṃbandhatvāt (bahiraṅgāt) dvaṃdvasamāso bhavati, paścāt anyapadārthasaṃbandhaḥ |
nanu ‘vibhāṣā’ (pā02|1|11) ityanena (adhikaraṇe) vaikalpikaḥ samāsaḥ syāt (na nityaḥ) |
tatra yadā vākyam (āśritam), tadā anyapadārthasaṃbandha eva (bhavati), na avāntaradvaṃdvaḥ (dvaṃdvanimittaḥ itaretarayogākhyaḥ) |

(tatra vākyaṃ samāśrīyataṃ samāso vā iti-) etasmin dvaite (pratyekasādhanatvaprāpi-) codakasāmarthyāt vākya- meva āśrayāmo na samāsam ityāśaṅkāṃ nirākartum ‘vṛtti- pakṣe ca samāsasya nityatvāt’ (ityanena bhāṣya- kāraḥ-) ninyaṃ samāsaṃ pratipādayati īdṛśe (vākyeṣu) |
katham (nityatvam ? uttaram -) evamāha (kātyā- yanaḥ) ‘dvaṃdvatatpuruṣayottarapade nityasamāsavacanam’ (taddhitārthottarapade sūtre pā0 2|1|51 vārtikam |
yadi pūrve samāsena kriyeta, tathā sati aprayogaḥ (samāsāntasya) prāpnoti (aprayogo'pi kadā cit syādityarthaḥ) |
tasmāt (samāsasya nitya- tvāt) dvaṃdvabhāvinoḥ (yayordvaṃdvaḥ saṃbhavati, tayoḥ) pūrva- padayoḥ avāntarasamāsaḥ (dvaṃdvaḥ) nityaḥ iti |
bhāṣyam— na etadasti aharhaḥ dvisāmaka- miti |
keṣu cidahaḥsu rathaṃtaram, keṣu cit bṛhat, na samaste sāmanī vidhīyate |
kutaḥ ? yadi ubhayorapi pakṣayoḥ : ‘bṛhadrathaṃtarasāmā’ iti śabdaḥ avakalpate, vibhakte sāmanī iti nyāyyam |
kutaḥ ? prakṛtau ekena sāmnā pṛṣṭhaṃ sādhitam, vikṛtāvāpi ekena sādhitavyaṃ codakanānumatam |
tathā ca sati vṛttinimittaṃ rathaṃtaranimittaṃ ca sakalam abhinirvartayiṣyate |
atha bṛhadrathaṃtarasamu- dāyaḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ sādhayati, na bṛhat sādhanam, na rathaṃtaraṃ sādhana- miti tat nimittaṃ na prakalpeta |
na kevalaṃ tannimittaṃ na prakalpate, bṛhatpṛṣṭhā'pi na prakalpate, rathaṃtarapṛṣṭhā'pi |
apica samastaṃ pṛṣṭhamiti upa- caryamāṇe lakṣitam, bṛhat pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati, rathaṃtaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhava- tīti, tat asumudāyābhidhāne liṅgam |
cchadaḥ sāmaśabdena saṃbandhamapekṣamāṇe na rathaṃtaraśabdena saṃbaddhaḥ syāt |
ānantarye ca tulyaṃ rathaṃtaraśabdasya sāma- śabdena |
apica vṛttipakṣe sutarāṃ dvaṃdva- padena asāmarthyam |
na caiva niyogo vṛttipakṣe nityaḥ samāsa iti |
etaccoktameva vibhāge'pi sāmnaḥ : apratiṣiddho bṛhadrathaṃtarasāmaśabda iti |
yathā ‘māsaṃ vratatallāmyāṃ devadatto bhojayitavyaḥ’ ityukte ardhamāsaṃ ghṛtena ardhamāsaṃ tailena, evamapi śabdaḥ ava- kalpate |
ekāhe tu ekatvādeva vibhāgāsaṃbhavāt samaste, ‘jyogamayāvinaḥ ume kuryāt’ iti |
soma— pūrvatra vīkṣaṇasya arthāpratvāt avividheya- tve'pi iha samuccayasya aprāptatvāt viśeṣatvam ityucyate : saṃgatiḥ |
bṛhadrathaṃtaramayasāmave'tra prathame tṛtīye pañcame ca rathaṃtaram, dvitīye caturthe ṣaṣṭhe ca bṛhat iti niyama eva |
sūtrāstha— pṛṣṭhasya bṛhadrathaṃtarasya yugapadvidhau saṃsavagosavādihetukatva ekāsminni sāmadvayaṃ syāditi |

na ca dvaṃdvagarbhabahuvrīhau bṛhadrathaṃtarasya antodāttatvam, anekapadabahuvrīhau tu pūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇa bṛhacchabdākārasya udāttatvam iti svarabhedāt yaḥ samāsaḥ adhyayanasiddha- svarāguṇaḥ, sa eva grāhyaḥ : iti kathyamaṃ vicāra iti vācyam |
vede bahuṣu sthaleṣu svaravyatyayadarśanena svara- mātrān arthanirṇayāsaṃbhavena nyāyata eva arthanirṇayasya vācyatvāt |
bṛhadrathaṃtaraṃ cot bhavet kiṃ cit cha chinnai ||
’ bhāṭṭa— dvādaśāhe rathaṃtarabṛhadravairajākararaivatā- khyaṣaṭsāmayuktāḥ pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍahaḥ samāmnātaḥ |
gavāmayane ca ‘pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍaho bṛhadrathaṃtarasāmā kāryaḥ’ iti śrutam |

nivartakaṃ ca kiṃ samuccitaṃ bṛhadrathaṃtaram, uta ekaikam ? iti cintā- yām, asya dvaṃdvagarbhabahuvrīhitvāt dvaṃddena ca bṛhadrathaṃtaryoḥ parasparasāhityāt : ekaikasmin ahani dvayoḥ saṃsavā- divat samuccayapratīteḥ : samuccimeva nivartakam |
samāsena ca samuccayaviśiṣṭayoreva vidheyapadaviśeṣatvena vidhā- nācca vidheyanekatā uddeśyatānekatā ekaprasaratābhaṅgo vā |
na ca asya śuddhatripadabahuvrīhitayā'pi upapatteḥ : ati- deśaprāptirapekṣāsadhanatvātnurodhena ekaikasmin ahani ekaikasyaiva karaṇapratīterna samuccitornivartakatā iti vācyam |
‘dvaṃdvatatpuruṣayottarapade nityaṃ samāsavacanam’ iti kātyāyanavacanena tripadabahuvrīhau dvaṃdvasyāvaśyakatvāt |
na ca asya yatra dvaṃdvabhāve'nyathātvam, dvaṃdvakaraṇe cānyathā yathā vākyatvapriya iti dvaṃdvakaraṇe |
tathātve samāsāntatvasiddhā tannimittatva-pratyakaraṇena vākyatva- cam iti rūpasiddheḥ |
tatra dvatpatyayayuktapuruṣasyaiva sāhityāt nānyasyeti vaktuṃ dvaṃdvavidhāyakavākyam, apekṣitavidheyatvārthatvāt |
na tu prakṛte ubhayathā'pi rūpaviśeṣeṇa dvaṃdvavidhiprayojanā- bhāvāditi mūrkhatvaṃ yuktamiti vācyam |
prakṛte'pi śuddha- bahuvrīhipakṣe pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvāpatteḥ, dvaṃdvakaraṇe cānto- dāttatvaprāpteḥ svaraviśeṣasyaiva prayojanatvāt |
ato dvaṃdva- syāvaśyakatvāt, tena ca sāhityātite : sahitayoreva nivartakatā |
iti prāpte, dvaṃdvagatasāhityāsya dvaṃdvapakṣe'pyā- 'pi upapatteḥ : atideśaprāptapṛṣṭhatotratanerapekṣyabhāvena tannirūpitatvakalpane pramāṇābhāvena naikaikasminnahani ubhayoḥ samuccayaḥ |
kiñca nātha pūrvaṃ dvaṃdvaṃ kṛtvā paścādvahuvrīhiḥ, tathātve dvipadabahuvrīhīrevāpatta uttarapade asya asaṃ- gatatvātte |
tadyadi bahuvrīhiḥ pūrvam, tatastadanantarameva uttarapade nimitte dvaṃdvo vidhīyeta, nānyathā |
ataśca pūrvaṃ tripadabahuvrīhiṃ kṛtvā paścāt protajanasiddhaye dvaṃdvavidhiḥ |
tena bahuvrīhihelā- yāmanpayapadārthe parasparānvitagaurava bṛhadrathaṃtaryoḥ : anna- yāt, paścādavagamyamānasāhityāsya ca ṣaḍahāpekṣayā- 'pi upapatteḥ : naikasmin dine tayoḥ samuccayaḥ |
ata eva atideśānurodhāt ‘ādye rathaṃtaraṃ dvitīye bṛhat’
ityeva kramāgatateḥ dvadvāvagataḥ kramo'pi alpāntaratvādeva vyākhyeyaḥ |
pṛṣṭhaye rasabhojanamāvṛtte saṃsthitye tryaṃśiśe'hani syāt tadānantaryāt prakṛtivat |
bhāṣyam-- ka cit karmaviśeṣe śrūyate, ' pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍahastryaṃśiśarambhaṇaḥ ' iti |
dvādaśāha vacarna ' saṃsthite pṛṣṭhaye ṣaḍahe madhyāhnaye ghṛtaṃ vā ' iti |
tadidaṃ madhvaśanaṃ ghṛtāśanaṃ ca codakaprāptaṃ sat saṃdihyate kiṃ tryaṃśiśānte kartavyam, uta ṣaḍahante iti |
kiṃ prāptam ? tataḥ sūtreṇaivoktamḥ, pṛṣṭhaye rasabhojanamāvṛtte ṣaḍahe tryaṃśiśe'hani saṃsthite kāryam |
prakṛtau tryaṃśiśāntare rasabhojanaṃ vṛttam, prakṛtivadihāpi kurvāṇe yadi tryaṃśiśāntaraṃ karoti, codakamanuglāti |
atha tu anyasāha''nantaraṃ kuryāt codakaṃ bādheta |
sa ca viśeṣa- saṃbandhe kāraṇamiti samadhigatam |
etaśāntasya ca rasa- bhojanasya tryaṃśiśena saha dṛṣṭamiti |
bhāṣyam-- na caitadasti tryaṃśiśānantaraṃ rasa- bhojanamiti |
kutaḥ ? saṃsthite ṣaḍahe ityucyate, na saṃsthite tryaṃśiśe iti |
ṣaḍahaśca ṣaṭsu ahaḥsu paryavasito bhavati, naikasminnya- kṣiśe ahani |
yaduktaṃ tryaṃśiśānantaryadarśanāt prakṛti- vadihāpi tadānantarya eva bhojanena bhavitavyamiti |
kutaḥ ? tasminnahani tatra dvādaśāhe ṣaḍahaḥ paryavasita iti |
ihāpi yatra paryavasyati, tatra bhojanaṃ bhaviṣyati |
tataḥ ṣaḍahāvasānalakṣite bhojanasya saṃbandhaḥ saṃsthite ṣaḍahe iti, na tryaṃśiśāvasānalakṣite iti |
yattu kramaḥ kāraṇaṃ viśeṣasaṃbandha iti, satyaṃ kāraṇam, na tu balīyasā pramāṇena yatra virudhyate |
iha tu vākyena ṣaḍa- hāvasāne vidhīyate ityuktam |
tassādvākyena viśeṣa- saṃbandhe sati na ānantyamātraṃ kāraṇam |
śā-- siddhāntastu-- ' dvādaśāhāntā hyasya gamyate prakriyāvaśāt |
soma-- pūrvatra codakaprāptavikalpavādhe'pi iha tajjñātakramasya na bādhaḥ ityutthiteḥ saṃgatiḥ |
sūtre- rasa- bhojanaṃ madhvaśanaṃ ghṛtāśanaṃ vā āvṛtteḥ prātilomyenā- nuṣṭhīyamāne ityarthaḥ |
' bhā-- prakṛtau dvādaśāhe ' trivṛt, pañcadaśaḥ, sapta- daśaḥ, ekaviṃśaḥ, tryaṃśiśaḥ ' iti ṣaḍahaḥ śrutaḥ |
tasya gavāmayane pakṣasi prātilomye tryaṃśiśaśca ādyatvam |
prakṛtau ca ' saṃsthite ṣaḍahe madhvaśaye ghṛtaṃ vā ' iti śrutam |
atra ca vikalpaviśiṣṭamadhvaśana- bhāvanāvidhānāt na vākyamedi |
tadidaṃ prakṛtau tryaṃśi- śānte kṛtamapi atra trivṛdante eva kāryam, prakṛtau trya- ṃśiśasyaiva ṣaḍahantatvena tadantatvasya ārthikatvāt |
' saṃsthite ṣaḍahe ' ityanena ṣaḍahāntatvasya vivecitatvāt nahi idam anuṣṭhānasadeyāt tryaṃśiśāṅgam, yena vikṛtau tadante evāpayet, api tu vākyāt vaimṛdha- nyāyena ṣaḍahaṅgam |
ata eva na saṃśāla''mapi śaṅkanīyam, saṃsthāyā uparamarūpāyā anupayogena anudeyatvāt |
ata eva saṃsthāyāḥ kapratyayopāttabhūtakālopalakṣaṇatvam, ' pune jāte ' itivadvā nimittatvameva |
ataśca ivarātinyāyena nimittaviśeṣaṇatayā anvitasyāpi ṣaḍahasya upasthitatvāt vaimṛdhavat padāntarakalpanāyā tadaṅgatvameva |
yattu bhāṣya- kāreṇa prakaraṇāt dvādaśāṅgatvamityuktam, tadaimuhe'pi

yadapi tena madhyasthānasya yāṃ ca yāvatī ca mātrāṃ tṛptijananāt taduttarakarttavyapadārthopakāra- katvapratīteḥ dvādaśāhasañtramityuktam, tadapi tathātve tādṛśchidripadārthamātrājñātvāpatteḥ upekṣitam |
' gavāmayane prathamamahaḥ prāyaṇīyam, dvādaśāhe ca prathamamahaḥ prāyaṇīyam, anayoḥ prakṛtivikṛtibhāvo nāsti, iti na dharmātideśaḥ |
vi. 7|312. gavāmayane prāya- ṇīyātirātre jyotiṣṭomokta vidhvantaḥ |
ṭup. 7|4|1319. gavāmayane mahāvratākhye upanayane ahani ' panya upagāyanti ' |
tatra upagātupanībhiḥ prākṛtānāmupa- gātṛṇāṃ na bādhaḥ |
vi. 10|4|16, gavāmayane ye trayaḥ svarasāmānaḥ, teṣāṃ dharmāḥ, aṣṭarātre yo antimo svarasāmānau, tatrāti- diśyante |
7|3|10. gavāmayane vijātīyaṣaḍahavyavadhānena pṛṣṭhaya- ṣaḍahāvṛttau madhvaśanāderapi āvṛttiḥ ||
bhāṣyam-- gavāmayane śrūyate ' catvāro'bhillavāḥ ṣaḍahāḥ pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍahaḥ sa dvitīyaḥ, sa tṛtīyaḥ, sa caturthaḥ, sa pañcamaḥ ' (iti) |
tatraitat codakena prāptam ' saṃsthite pṛṣṭhaye ṣaḍahe madhvaśaye ghṛtaṃ vā ' iti |
tatra saṃdihyate kiṃ pratimāsāvartate rasabhojanam, uta sarvānte sakṛdeva kāryamiti |
sarvānte hi asau ṣaḍahagatāt vyāpārāt uparamate, na prāk |
arvāk asau kṛtvā''pi ṣaḍahaṃ punaḥ ṣaḍahāya pravartate eva |
na cāsau ṣaḍahaḥ saṃsthito bhavati, yadi punaḥ tadarthe pravartate eva |
sarvānte tu na punaḥ pravartate iti |
āvṛttiḥ rasabhojanasya syāt, na sakṛt kriyā |
tasmin āvartamāne saṃsthā nimittam āvartate, āyata āvartate |
yaduktaṃ sarvānte hi asau ṣaḍahāt uparato bhavati, na prāk, kṛtvā''pi asau punaḥ tadarthe prayatnate eveti, atrābhidhīyate |
yadyapi asau punaḥ pravartate, tathāpi taṃ parisamāpya punarabhate |
punaśca parisamāpyati, na yathā āvṛtte ṣaḍahe |
tena uttarakriyā''ntaravyavadhānāt pṛṣṭhayagato vyāpāraḥ paryavasitaḥ, iti gṛhyate viśeṣaḥ |
na ca tasmin aparyavasite kriyā''ntaraṃ śakyaṃ kartum |
ubhayaprakāraśca antāḥ kriyāyāḥ, kṛtvā audāsīnyam, kriyā''ntaravyavadhānaṃ cetyuktameva |
tasmin āvartamāne saṃsthānimittaṃ bhojanamapi āvartate iti |
śā-- yatra gavāmayanādau abhillavādibhirvyavatasya pṛṣṭhayaṣaḍahasyābhyāsaḥ, tatra nimittabhūtasaṃsthā''vṛtteḥ naimittikasya madhvaśanādyāvṛttiḥ |
vi-- ' sarvānte pratimāsaṃ vā pṛṣṭhayante madhubhojanam, sarvānte pūrvvavat, maivaṃ saṃsthitānāṃ pṛthaktvataḥ |
' bhā-- yatra gavāmayanādau ṣaḍahasyārambhairvihitaḥ pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍahaḥ, tatra āyaṣaḍahottaramapi vyāpārāntarakaraṇena taduddeśyakavyāpāroparāmasatvāt madhvaśanasyāpi āvṛttiḥ |
atrābhillavaṣaḍahasyāpi dvādaśāhikaṣaḍahavikāratvāt tatrāpi madhvaśanasyāpi tena vyavadhānoktiḥ paryathasārayecchintyā |
sā ca kramayuktānām agraviśeṣopetainānāṃ nānānāmahā codakaprāptānāṃ tathaivatānuṣṭhāne punaḥpunaścodakena tathaiva prāptaḥ daṇḍakalitavadāvṛttiḥ iti pūrvvapakṣaḥ |
prathamabhāgagateṣu ahaḥsu aindravāyavāgratvam, dvitīyabhāgagateṣu śukrāgratvam, tṛtīyabhāgagateṣu āgrayaṇāgratvam, punarapyevam iti krameṇānuṣṭhānaṃ kartavyamiti bhāṣyasaṃmataḥ siddhāntaḥ |
pūrvasya pakṣasyaḥ navadhā vibhāgaṃ kṛtvā viṃśatitulyātmake ekaikasmin bhāge ekaikāgratā iti sthānaviddhaddhiḥ iti vārtikānusārī siddhāntaḥ |

gavāmayanāddeṣu jyotirādiṣu ahaḥsu nāmnā ekāharūpajyotirādidhameṣu codakāt dvādaśāhadhameṣu prāpteṣu codakabalīyastvāt dvādaśāhadharmāḥ kāryāḥ, nāmadhalīyastvādā ekāhādharmāḥ iti saṃdigdhe, pratyekaṃ phala- sādhanatvābhāvena nāmavatpratyātmikadharmānākāṅkṣatvāt, aviruddhādhikadharmātideśakte ca nāmopapatteḥ, dvādaśā- hikadaśādoṣasattvaikavihāradarśanasāmyā ca liṅgābhyāṃ codakānugraheṇa dvādaśāhikadharmātideśe prāpte, phala- vākye sādhanabhūtānāmahāṃ sāhityāvagame'pi upacitatvācca pratyekameva sādhanatvāvagamāt dharmākāṅkṣopapatteḥ, nāmnāṃ ca pratyakṣatvena ānumānikāt yāgatvāccoditadharmāgaṃ- tvāccanekalaliṅgāpekṣatvāt codakāt balīyastvāt, jyotirā- dināmnāṃ ca yāgavācitvena adhikadharmātideśaktvā- yogāt, ekāharūpajyotirādidharmātideśaḥ siddhāntaḥ: sasamānye (7|4|3) adhikaraṇe |
gavāmayanādau pṛṣṭhaṣaḍahavṛttau sarvaṣaḍahante sakṛdeva madhvaśanam, na tu pratiṣaḍahantam ||
abhyāse ca tadabhyāsaḥ, karmaṇaḥ punaḥ prayogāt |
tatra etat codakena prāpyate 'saṃsthite pṛṣṭhye ṣaḍahe madhu āśayet ghṛtaṃ vā' iti |
tat saṃdigdhe kiṃ ṣaḍahāvṛttyā āvarteta bhojanam, uta ṣaḍahante sakṛdeva kriyeta iti |
kiṃ prāptam ? ṣaḍahāvṛttau satyām āvarteta bhojanam |
tadāvṛttyā yadapi tatsaṃbaddham, tadapi āvarteta yathā stotrāstrādi ṣaḍahasaṃbaddhamāvarteta, evaṃ ṣaḍahasaṃbandhi bhojanamapi āvarteta iti |
bhāṣyam— na caitadasti yaduktam 'ṣaḍahāvṛttyā bhojanamapi āvarteta' iti |
na punaḥ ṣaḍahaṃ kurvāṇaḥ ṣaḍahagatatvāt vyāpārata uparata ityucyate |
na ca anuparato kartuḥ ṣaḍahaḥ saṃtiṣṭhate |
saṃsthā hi kriyāṃ prati audāsīnyaṃ vyāpārāntarakaraṇaṃ vā pūrvasmāt karmaṇaḥ |
na ca punaḥ ṣaḍahaṃ kurvāṇaḥ audāsīnyaṃ majate, na vā vyāpārāntaraṃ karoti, tasyaiva karmaṇaḥ āvṛtti karoti |
aparyavasite ca saṃsthā'bhāvāt aśrutameva prāśanam iti na kriyate |
yaduktam 'yathā anye ṣaḍahadharmāḥ stotrāstrādayaḥ āvartyante, tadvat prāśana- mapi āvarteta' iti, naitat yuktam |
te hi ahaḥsaṃbaddhāḥ, teṣāmāhaḥsaṃbandhi āvṛttiḥ, iti stotrādīnāmāvṛttiḥ iti yuktam |
iha tu avasānasaṃyogena bhojanasya codanā ityukto hetuḥ |
apica yadyetat bhojanaṃ ṣaḍahāhaṃ bhavet, tataḥ pradhānāvṛttyā āvarteta |
eteṣāṃ ceha na kiñcit kāraṇaṃ paśyāmaḥ |
prakaraṇaṃ tāvat dvādaśā- hasya, na ṣaḍahasya |
vākyasaṃyogo'pi 'saṃsthite ṣaḍahe' iti ṣaḍahasya saṃsthāyāṃ bhojanamācaṣṭe |
saṃsthitaśca ṣaḍaho bhavati, yadi asya na kiñcidaparamaṅgaṃ pariśiṣyate |
kāmaṃ yathā ca yāvatyā ca tarpaṇamātrayā kartuṃ yāni parastāt karmāṇi vartante, teṣāṃ samarthopajananeopakuryāt, nātivṛttasya ṣaḍahasyeti |
yānyapi kramādīni kāraṇāni, tānyapi pramāṇāntarasaṃbandhamupādāya viśeṣasaṃbandhe kāraṇāni bhavanti, na kevalāni |
tasmāt ṣaḍahasānalakṣite kāle puruṣāṇāṃ bhojanakriyā vidhīyate ityato na āvarteta bhojanamiti |
śā — (rasabhojanasya ṣaḍaha-) aṅgatvanirākaraṇaṃ tu bhāṣye atiśayoktimiti nātivādartavyam |
sūtrātsthesu— 'āvṛtte pṛṣṭhyamupayanti' iti yatra ṣaḍa- hābhyāsaḥ, tatra madhvaśanasyābhyāsaḥ syāt, karmaṇaḥ, punaḥ prayogāt iti |
vi— 'abhyāse ṣaḍahe yuktimabhyasyet kiṃ na vā, 'grimaḥ |
' bhāṭṭa— yatra 'āvṛttaṃ ṣaḍahamupayanti' ityādau nairantaryeṇa ṣaḍahāvṛttiḥ śrutā, tatra sarvānte eva madhvaśanam, ṣaḍahasaṃsthāyāḥ ṣaḍahaviṣayakavyāpāreāparamatvāt |
nahi atra prayogasamāptiḥ taduttarakālamātraṃ vā saṃsthāpadārthaḥ, yena pratiṣaḍahante tatsatvāt āvarteta madhvaśanam |
na ca ṣaḍahe kartavye taduddeśyavyāpāreāparamaḥ saṃbhavati |
( kaśeḍa kaśāda iti koṅkaṇapradeśe tādṛśasya tṛṇaviśeṣasya nāma ) 'anāhutivai jartilā gavīdhukāśca' |
vi. 10|8|4. gavyam iti gavāmayanaṃ brūmaḥ gosaṃbandhāt 'gāvo vā etat satramāsata' iti |
'gāvo vā etat satramāsata' iti gavāmayanasya satrasya gosaṃbandhāt |
tadādiṣu iti tat gavyaṃ satram ādiḥ yeṣāṃ tāni tadādīni ādityānāmayanam ityādīni satrāni |
tadādiṣu ādityānā- mayanam ityādiṣu satreṣu gavyasya gavāmayanasya vidhvantaḥ syāt, saṃvatsarasāmānyāt |
'panaya upagāyanti' iti māhātrikaṃ dharmaṃ saṃvatsarasatre darśayati, 'ṛtvija upagāyanti' iti ca saṃvatsarasatre |
dvitīyaṃ sāmnaḥ parva apūrvasya gāyaterabhidheyaṃ prasiddham |
bhā. 3|5|8|26. gānam, upagānam, kāṇḍavīṇābhiḥ patnīnāmupagānam, dundubhigānam, śārīragānam, tantrī- gānam |
tatsāhāyyam upagānaṃ nāma ṛtvijaḥ hośabdena yajamānaśca ośabdena kurvanti |
śārīragānaṃ śarīrarāvayavaiḥ kaṇṭhādibhiḥ gāyakaiḥ kṛtaṃ gānam |
ke. gānam ekatrike ṛtau ekasyā eva ṛcaḥ triṃśatsena dhruve |
mā. 10|5|13|10-11, gānam ekatrike ṛtau mādhyandinapavamānastotre ādye eva nikhile tṛce |
10|9|2|7-9. gānaṃ jyotiṣṭome yajñāyajñīye girāpadyakṣanāpane irāde kartavyam |
atijagatoṣu iti bahuvacanaṃ tu prathamāyā atijagatyāḥ |
bhā. 9|2|5|21-24 varṇaka 2, gānaṃ pratyacaṃ parisamāptaṃ kartavyaṃ tṛce kartavyamapi 9|2|13|20, gānaṃ vṛhadrathaṃtareyoḥ syotyuttaraprāyaṇatvena saṃpādikatukumoreva jyotiṣṭome |
9|2|16|25-28 varṇaka 4, gānaṃ mahāvrate śrūyate 'panaya upagāyanti, piccholābhirupagāyanti, kāṇḍavīṇābhirupagāyanti, āpāṭālikābhirupagāyanti' iti |
sāmnoḥ bṛhatīvihārapaṅktyoreva prathanamena saṃpādite ‘svādiṣṭhayā madiṣṭhayā’ iti gāyatre tṛce geyam |
9|2|16 varṇakaṃ 2, 9|2|16 varṇakaṃ 2. ekā anuṣṭup tato gāyatrīdvayam iti tisṛṇāṃ prathanamena saṃpādite ānuṣṭubhe tṛce kāryam |
9|2|121-22, gānaṃ svayonāveva, na rayaṃtarādiyonau kaṇvarathaṃtarasya vaiśyastome pṛṣṭhastotra-sādhanatayā vihitasya |
sarvathā'pi bṛhaspatisve prākṛ- tīnāṃ triṣṭujjagatīnāmakṣarālopena kṛtvā gāyatryo niṣpāda- nīyāḥ saṃkhyāyāṃ ca gāyatrīśabdaḥ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
bṛhaspatisve 'gāyatryetadaharbhavati' iti gāyatrī- śabdaḥ saṃkhyāvācaka iti pūrvapakṣaṃ vāśabdo vyāvartayati |
na saṃkhyāyāmayaṃ gāyatrīśabdaḥ kintu guṇāt caturviṃśati- saṃkhyārūpāt bhinno'yaṃ dravyaśabdaḥ caturviṃśatyakṣarayuktasya ṛgdravyasya vācakaḥ syāt |
na hi 'asmākaṃ caturviṃśatigātraḥ' iti vaktavye 'asmākaṃ gāyatrī gātraḥ' iti kaścit bravīti |
gāyatrīśabdaḥ ṛgdravyavācakaḥ iti siddhānte hetya- ntaramāha |
gāyatrīśabdasya ṛgdravye samanvayaḥ vācakatvena sambandhaḥ gotvavat |
gamadhātorniṣpanno gośabdaḥ gamana- nimitto'pi sāmānyadravyābhidhāne sākṣāllakṣaṇatveva samanveti tadvat |
saṃkhyāyāḥ caturviṃśati- saṃkhyāyāḥ vācakaḥ śabdaḥ asti, nāsyā apareṇa gāyatrī- śabdenārthaḥ |
śabdaḥ asyā asti iti śabdavatī saṃkhyā, tasyā bhāvaḥ śabdavattvaṃ tasmāt iti vigrahaḥ |

itarasya pūrvasūtroktāyāḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ itarasya bhinnasya ṛgdravyasya aśrutitvāt gāyatrīśabdabhinnaśabdaśrutitvāt, tasyāpi ca saṃvyavahārārthe saṃjñāśabdasya kasya cidāvaśyakatvāt gāyatrīśabdaḥ sārthaka bhavati |
athavā prakṛtau agniṣṭome gāyatryaḥ prayujyante tābhyo'dhikāḥ gāyatryo bṛhaspatisve apekṣyante |
parantu itarasya adhikasya ṛksamūhasya aśrutitvāt vidhāyakaśruterabhāvāt kuto grāhyā iti vicāre tā ṛgvedadeva grāhyāḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
bṛhaspatisve triṣṭujjagatīnāmakṣarālopena gāyatrī- niṣpādane agniṣṭomadṛṣṭānta uktaḥ |

agniṣṭomaśabdasya kasmiṃścit dravyāntare aniveśāt prayogābhāvāt śatāgniṣṭome dvādaśāhikānāmahām ukthya- lopamantareṇa agniṣṭomatā na sambhavati iti agniṣṭoma- padam ukthyalopaviśiṣṭamukthyastotrāṇāṃ lopena viśiṣṭaṃ yajñīyastotrānāṃ yat karma, tadācaṣṭaṃ syāt iti yuktam |
śatāgniṣṭome ukthya- stotrāṇām aśākhallakṣaṇatvāt aśākhallakṣaṇatvābhāvāt śāstrīyatvābhāvāt agniṣṭomakṣāntena vāghaḥ |
bṛhaspati- sve tu 'gāyatryetadaharbhavati' iti śāstralakṣaṇā eva gāyatryaḥ |
tatassām ānumānikabhīḥ triṣṭujjagatībhirne bādho bhavitumarhati, aśākhallakṣaṇatvāt triṣṭujjagatīnām |
'taṃ nityavaca pṛthak satīṣu' iti sūtre yaduktaṃ saṃkhyāyāṃ gāyatrīśabdo dṛṣṭaḥ iti tatparihārārthamāha siddhāntī |
chandoviśeṣaviśiṣṭāyāḥ ṛcaḥ utpatti eva nāmadheyaṃ gāyatrīśabdaḥ |
utpattyā nāmadheyaḥ yāḥ utpatti- nāmadheyā, tādṛśatvāt gāyatryāḥ sakāśāt pṛthaksatīṣu triṣṭujjagatīṣu gāyatrīśabdo bhaktyā gauṇyā vṛttyā stutyarthaḥ syāt |
gāyatrīdyapraśaṃsārtham 'ye hi dve gāyatryau saikā jagatī' iti |
vacanāt gāyatrīśabdaḥ saṃkhyāvācakaḥ syāt iti pūrva- pakṣī śaṅkate |
tisraḥ anuṣṭubhaśca catasro gāyatryaḥ kartuṃ na śakyāḥ |
tasmāt tatra saṃkhyāyāṃ gāyatrīśabdaḥ iti cet |
'catasro gāyatrīḥ karoti' iti ihaiva ekatra saṃkhyā''rtho gāyatrīśabdaḥ, nānyatra, ka cideva saṃkhyāvācakatvasya darśanāt |
atra ka cit pustake 'yāvaduktamityaivekatra saṃkhyārtho nānyatra ka ciddarśanāt' ityetāvat sūtrameva |
ka cittu 'yāvadarthamityaivekatra saṃkhyārtho nānyatra ka ciddarśanāt' iti sūtram |
bhāṣye tu 'yāvaduktam ihaivaikatra saṃkhyārtho nānyatra ka ciddarśanāt' ityeva sūkṣmam, avaśiṣṭaṃ tu vyākhyā iti vibhāgaḥ kṛtaḥ |
apūrve ca vikalpaḥ syād yadi saṃkhyāvidhā- nam |

bṛhaspatisve 'gāyatryetadaharbhavati' iti gāyatrī- śabdena yadi saṃkhyāyāḥ vidhānaṃ syāt, tadā apūrve prakṛtiśrutye svataḥ prakṛtibhūte darśapūrṇamāse 'ājuhotā duvasyatāti prayacchatye, vṛṇīdhvaṃ havyavāhanam' ityasyāḥ gāyatryāḥ yatkiñcidgatānāṃ ca caturviṃśatyakṣarāṇāṃ vikalpaḥ syāt |
bṛhaspatisve 'gāyatryetadaharbhavati' iti gāyatrī- śabde saṃkhyāvācakatve svīkṛte darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ sāmidhenīnāṃ paridhānīnāyāṃ vikalpaḥ prasajyeteti siddhāntinā ukte pūrva- pakṣī āha |
tatra prayogasya ṛgguṇatvāt na vikalpo bhaviṣyati iti |
tasmāttatra 'ājuhotā duvasyata' iti gāyatryā ṛcaiva paridhānamiti |
ṛk guṇo yāsāṃ sāmidhenīnāṃ tā ṛguṇāḥ |
yadi darśapau sāmidhenīnām ṛg- guṇatvāt na ṛco vikalpaḥ prāpnoti, tarhi pūrvavati pūrvā prakṛtiḥ |
yasyāsti saḥ pūrvavān bṛhaspatisvaḥ jyoti- ṣṭomasya vikṛtibhūtaḥ, tasmin pūrvavati tathā darśādi- sāmidhenīvat ṛgguṇatvaṃ syāt |
bṛhaspatisve 'gāyatra- metadaharbhavati' iti gāyatrīśabdaḥ ṛgvācaka eva syāt |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ : 'ājuhotā duva- syata' iti gāyatryā sāmidhenīḥ paridadhāti |
tatra sarvatra kṛtsnāyām ājuhotāyāṃ guṇāveśaḥ guṇasya catu- rviṃśatisaṃkhyāyāḥ āveśaḥ niveśo bhavati, nāyavave |
tena ṛgguṇatvaṃ ca saṃkhyā ca ubhe anugṛhīte bhavataḥ |
bṛhaspatisve tu yā ṛcaḥ codakena prāptāḥ, tāsāṃ triṣṭu- jjagatīnāmeva avayave saṃkhyā niviṣṭā |
prakṛtigāyatrītu upādīyamānāsu tu ubhaya- manugṛhyeta tasmāt prakṛtigāyatrīnāmāgamaḥ syāt |
ahāṇāṃ vā camasānāṃ vā anyeṣāṃ vā padārthānāṃ caturviṃśatisaṃkhyā gṛhyatām |
tasmāt guṇasya caturviṃśatisaṃkhyāyāḥ āveśaḥ sarvatra grahādiṣvapi prāpnoti iti |
bṛhaspatisve 'gāyatryetadaharbhavati' iti gāyatrīśabdaḥ yadyapi saṃkhyāvācakaḥ, tathāpi akṣara- gatāyāmeva saṃkhyāyāṃ niṣpannaḥ prasiddhaḥ |
niṣpannasya ca grahaṇāt na grahāṇāṃ camasādīnāṃ vā saṃkhyā gāyatryaśabdena grahītuṃ śakyate |
tasmāt ṛggatāyāmeva akṣarāṇāṃ saṃkhyā gāyatrīśabdo bravīti |
bṛhaspatisve 'gāyatrametadaharbhavati' iti gāyatrīśabdaḥ akṣarasaṃkhyāyāmeva yathā prasiddhaḥ ; tathā ihāpi syāt, ihaiva kaścaiva prasiddho nānyasmin catu- rviṃśatyakṣare gaye vā |
yadi vā'viśeṣaye niyamaḥ prakṛtyupabandhanā- cchareṣvapi prasiddhaḥ syāt |
bṛhaspatisve 'gāyatrametadaharbhavati' iti gāyatrī- śabdaḥ yathā ṛkṣu prasiddhaḥ, tathāpi codakena prākṛtyaḥ gāyatrītriṣṭupjagatyaḥ prāpitāḥ |
tatra triṣṭupjagatyīnāma- kṣarālopaṃ kṛttvaiva gāyatryo niṣpādanīyāḥ |
evaṃ sati prākṛtaśca vaikṛtaśca vidhiḥ anugṛhīto bhaviṣyati iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |

aviśeṣe viśayābhāve gāyatrīśabdasya atra saṃśayābhāve'pi, yadi prakṛtyā upannatvāt, prakṛtyā niyamitatvāt, codita- tvāt, codakena prāptatvāt niyamaḥ syāt agāyātryāmā- 'śaramayaṃ barhirbhavati' ityatra śareṣu prasiddhaḥ śaraśabdo'pi kuśeṣu barhirvena kalpayitavyaḥ syāt |
nanu agāyātryāmāpi gāyatrīśabdasya prayogo dṛṣṭaḥ 'ye dve gāyatryau saikā jagatī' iti |
gāyatrīśabdasya agāyātryāmāpi prayogo dṛśyate iti pūrvapakṣeṇaḥ śaṅkāyāḥ siddhāntī āha |
yadi akṣaragatāṃ caturviṃśatisaṃkhyāṃ gāyatrīśabdasya prayogo dṛśyate, tathā śareṣu prasiddhasya śaraśabdasyāpi kuśeṣu prayogo dṛśyate |
tathā śaraśabdavat itarasmin api gāyatrīśabdasyāpi jagatyāṃ gauṇaḥ prayogaḥ syāt |
siddhāntī adhikaraṇārthamupasaṃharan pūrvapakṣaṃ nirasya arthāt siddhāntaṃ sūcayati |
bṛhaspatisve codakena yāḥ triṣṭupjagatyaḥ prāptāḥ tāsāmekadeśe caturviṃśatyakṣarācchinne artheḥ samāpto na bhavati |
evamekadeśe arthasya asamāptatvāt tāsāṃ triṣṭupjagatyānāmekadeśe catu- rviṃśatyakṣarātmake gāyatrīśabdasya prayogo na syāt |
tasmāt bṛhaspatisve 'gāyatrametadaharbhavati' iti uktā gāyatryaḥ apekṣitasaṃkhyāpūraṇārtham utpattigāyatrīnāmeva dāśatayībhyaḥ āgamaḥ kartavyaḥ |
'gāyatram' iti upadeśena triṣṭupjagatyānāṃ kodakasya bādhaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
ke. gāyatrīdvayamuttaram anuṣṭup ca prathamā, tāsāṃ prayatnena saṃpādite anuṣṭubhe tye dyāvāścāgnīvasāgnī- ganīm |
bhā. 12|6|25-28 varṇakaṃ 3, gāyatrīśabdaḥ bṛhattuṣṭupṣu eva āgamamānāṃ sāmnāṃ niveśaḥ |
vivṛddhastomakeṣu ṛtuṣu mādhyādinābhavapavamānayoḥ, na tu anye tuce |
yatra tu vidhiḥ 'tisro'nuṣṭubhaścatasro gāyatrīḥ karoti' iti tatra saṃkhyāyāṃ gāyatrīśabdaḥ |
āghāne brāhmīdani araṇī saṃtāpya mathitvā sarveṇa mathitaṃ gārhapatyaḥ eva ādheyaḥ, na tu sarve agnayaḥ |
jyotiṣṭome ca mahāvedimadhyantare prācīnavaṃśaśālāyāḥ āhavanīyo'pi gārhapatya eva saṃpadyate tasya 'śālāmukhīyāḥ' iti nāma |
prācīna- vaṃśasya prāktano gārhapatyaśca prājahitaḥ nāma |
saṃkarṣa. 3|1|7, gārhapatyādeva āha- vanīyaḥ ādheyaḥ āghāne, na tu laukikāt |
3|2|2, gārhapatyādeva dakṣiṇāgnerādhānam, na tu dakṣiṇa- digāddhatvāt laukikāt |
3|2|4, gārhapatyādeva prati- karma āhavanīyasya samudraṇam, na tu araṇībhyām |
bhā. 12|1|6|12. gārhapatyasya sadā pradīpanaṃ araṇīrvā sadā dhāraṇopāyaḥ |
saṃkarṣa. 3|1|6. gārhapatye patnīsaṃyājān juhoti' atra homa- viśeṣamanuya gārhapatyo vihitaḥ |
vi. 10|8|8. gārhapatye śrapaṇaṃ śrutam, sa eva prayukte vidyate, aprayukte ca prasaṅgaḥ syāt' iti (yaḥ) |
sa eva nyāyaḥ atrāpi (kuṇḍapāyināmayane agnihotra- śrapaṇe) |
mā. 12|1|6|13. gārhapatye havīṃṣi śrapayati ' iti gārhapatyasya karmasu upayogaḥ |
mā. 12|1|11-7. gārhapatyāhavayārya- pacanayoḥ darśapūrṇamāsādo pradhānakarmādhikaraṇatvābhāva- nyāteḥ |
bhā. 12|1|15, gārhapatyāhavanīyanyā- haryapacanādibhyo vinā etāni (agnihotradarśapūrṇamāsā- dīni) karmāṇi na sidhyanti |
2|3|14. gārhapatyopasthāne 'niveśenaḥ saṃgamanaḥ' iti mantro vacanāt viniyoktavyaḥ, na tu liṅgāt indropa- sthāne |
bhā. 3|2|13-4. gāvī goṇī gopolatikā ityādayaḥ śabdāḥ gośabdasyāpabhraṃśāḥ na pramāṇam |
bhā. 1|3|8|24-29, gāvyādigośabdasya : sāsnādimānavagamyate anurūpa hi gāvyādigośabdasya |
'na girāgireti brūyāt' 'airaṃ kṛtvādegeyam' ityatra girāpadaniṣedhapuraḥsaram irāpade vihite sati niṣiddhasya nityanivṛttiḥ |
aprāptvāt irāpadamana vidhīyate, tena vihitena pāṭhaprāpte girāpade bādhite sa bādho 'na girā' iti pratiṣedhena athyate |
vi. 1|4|2. girāpadaṃ pratiṣidhya irāpadaṃ vidhīyate, tatra irāpadasya girāpadakāryaṃ
girāpadamāmnātam, tadatā sāmnā jyotiṣṭomaḥ sādhayitavyaḥ ityetadapi avagamyate, irāpadena sādhayitavyamityetadapi |
samānārthe te dve pade, ekamapi stutyartham aparamapi |
tasmāt vikalpaḥ syāt irāpadaṃ girāpadaṃ veti |
dup-- (dvitīyapāde 'sāmapradeśe' (12|1|32) ityārabhya sāmohaṃ pratipādayiṣyati, idānīṃ tadupodghātaṃ cintayati-) yajñāyajñīyaṃ prakṛtya 'airaṃ kṛlodreyam' iti (iyantaṃ bhāṣyadeva) |
'airaṃ kṛtvā udyem' iti irāpadena utpattiḥ kevalaṃ kriyate (na viniyogaḥ) |
[ irāpadena irāpadānā- patyā ityarthakaraṇena paṅktiryojayituṃ śakyate, tathāpi ' irāpadasthānena (vākyena) utpattiḥ kelavam' iti pāṭhaḥ pūrvottaragranthasarasā samīcīna iti bhāti |

nahi irāpadasthānāpattiḥ atra, kintu irāpadasya girāpadasthānā- pattiḥ atroktā ] upacyuttarakāla ca prayojanaṃ prati sākāṅkṣasya yajñāyajñīyasya (yajñāyajñīya stuvīta ityanena) prayogavacanena aṅgatā vidhīyate, girāpadasyāpi (yajñā- yajñīyasya prayogavacanenaiva aṅgatā) |
athavā, yadyapi irāpadam (airaṃ kṛtvā iti-) anena vākyena vidhīyate stotrā- ṅgatvena (na tu pramāṇāntareṇa), tathāpi na anutpannaṃ śrutiḥ śaknoti nirvartayitum, iti arthāt utpattiḥ apekṣitavyā |
tasmāt ekatra (irāpade ) utpattiḥ apekṣitavyā, aparatra (girāpade) viniyogaḥ (ape- kṣitavyaḥ) |
girā- pade sāmnāmmātram, na kartavyatā vidhīyate |
tasmin upadiśyamāne girā- padapi upadiṣṭaṃ bhavati |
śrutiviśeṣeṇa irāpadamupadiṣṭam etaṃ kṛttveti, sāmānyena girāpadam |
na tu anyathā sāma kṛtaṃ bhavatīti arthāpattyā girāpadasya kartavyatā kalpyate |
atha yaḥ sāmānyenopa- diṣṭaḥ tasya ko viṣayaḥ ? taducyate |
dup-- yaduktaṃ 'airaṃ kṛlodreyam' ityanena utpattiḥ, ( kevalā kriyate ), yajñāyajñīyaprayogavacanena ( tu ) śrutisādhanatvamiti, tatra |
yadi evaṃ śrūyeta 'airaṃ bhavati' iti, tadā utpattiḥ |
iha tu airaṃ kṛtvā airamaninivartya udyemiti śrutyaiva asya sādhanatā vidhīyate |
yajñāyajñīyena tu anyathā'nupapattyā girāpadasya śrutisādhanatā vidhīyate |
yadapi aparasukam irāpadā- dapi arthādutpattirapekṣitveti, ucyate |
yaducyate śabdasya tatra nāsti vyāpāraḥ, iha tu (girā- pade ) śabdenaiva kasmiścit kāryaviśeṣo vidhātavyaḥ |
tatra girāpadasya (kāryaviśeṣaviniyojakaḥ klaptaḥ ) śabdo na vidyate |
( sa hi na śruto nāpi kalpayituṃ śakyate pratyakṣaśrutena, irāpadenaiva stotrasya nirākāṅkṣa- tvāt |
( itarat girā- padaṃ sāmadṛśyavat ' iti na tasya dṛṣṭāntena dāṣṭantikaḥ |
katham ? ' saptadaśa sāmidhenīranubrūyāt ' ityārabhya śrūyate, ' pañcadaśānanubrūyāt ' iti darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ |
tatra kāsu cidvikṛtiṣu (paśumitravindā''diṣu) sāmadṛśyaṃ punaḥ pacyate |
girāpadaṃ punaḥ na kasya cidvikṛtī, yena irāpadaṃ bādhyeta |
apica irāpadaṃ klṛptopakāraṃ vikṛtau codakena prāpyate |
yathā prakṛtau sāmadṛśyaṃ pāśvadasyena bādhyate, evaṃ girāpadamirāpadeneti tadbādhitam ( etāvatā dṛṣṭāntaḥ ) |
yāsu vikṛtiṣu pramāṇaṃ bhavati, tāsu bhavi- ṣyati |
athavā vinā'pi stutisādhanatvena pramāṇāntareṇa bhavati kāsu cit vikṛtiṣu girāpadam |
yatra hi agniṣṭomastotrāśvanena yajña- yajñīyaṃ prayujyate, tatraiva klṛptopakāreṇa irāpadena girāpadaṃ bādhyate |
tatraiva tasya prakṛtau upadeśāt nānyatra prāpti- riti |
śā-- sāmnāmidānīm (12|1|9 sāmapradeśe vikāraḥ ityetassāt prāk ) ūhamāripyamāṇaḥ |
tāni hi akṣarāntareṣu sāmnāmnātāni akṣarāntareṣu uhyante |
tatra iha girāpadaiḥ irāpade sthānāpatyā prāptiṃ vaktuṃ sthānāpattimeva cintayati |
soma-- yathā agniṣṭuvacanasya meṣamprāptiḥ, eva- mirāpade girāpadetarāptau girāpadasyānāpatyā tanmāsim uttarādhikaraṇe pratipādayitumiha tadupayogitayā sthānā- pattirvicāryate iti saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu--jyotiṣṭomā- dhikāre āmnātāt girāpadāt anyat irāpadaṃ pratyakṣa- vacanavihitatvāt nityaṃ girāpadavikāraḥ |
' irā- girā anayorvikalpo vā syāt, uta irā eva syāt iti saṃśayaḥ |
'āyīrā yīrā' iti gātavyam, na tu 'gāyīrā yīrā' iti siddhāntaḥ |
bhāṭṭa-- mantrohaprasaṅgāt sāmantrāṃ vicārayitu- mupodghātaḥ ārabhyate |
jyotiṣṭome agniṣṭomastotrāvāntara- prakaraṇe śrutam 'na girāgiriti brūyāt, airaṃ kṛlodreyam' iti |
tatra girāpadagīteḥ irāpade ūhaḥ iti vakṣyate |
sa ca irāpadasya girāpadasthānāpatti vinā neti neti sā'pi vakṣyate |
tatraiha sā kiṃ niyatā sthānāpattiḥ, uta aniyateti cintyate |

tatra yadyapi tāvat na 'airaṃ kṛlodreyam' ityatra irāpadaviśiṣṭodghānantarasya stotrādyatā ārādu- pakārakatvādinā vidhiḥ, agniṣṭomastotrāṅgabhūtayajñā- yajñīyanāpekṣayā gāntaratve pramāṇābhāvāt, 'na girā girā' iti niṣedhavānuvādānupapatteśca |
ata eva na gānodeśena irāpadavidhiḥ; tathātve irāpadasya stobhākṣara- vidhayā gānāṅgatve'pi tatsaṃskārasya girāpadasya bādhe pramāṇābhāvena niṣedhavānuvādānupapatteḥ |
ato niṣedhānu- vādatvena irāpadamātraṃ guṇamidhānātmakotvarūpe girāpada- kāryaṃ vidhīyate |
saṃbhavati ca irāpadasya girāpadakāryakāri- tvam, tadarthābhidhānāt |

yathaiva hi iṣkartāramiti padaṃ (ṛsaṃ. 10|140|5 ) mahābhāṣyakāreṇa nakāralopena niṣkartāramityasyārthe vyākhyātam, ( 'sanyaloḥ' 6|1|9 iti pāṇinīsūtre chāndasavarṇāṃlopodāharaṇeṇu 'iṣkartāramadharasya niṣkartāramasya iti' |
tathaiva gakāralope irāpadasyāpi girāpadārthe vyākhyānaṃ nānupapannam |

tataśca yadyapi pratyakṣavidhinā irāpadasyotpattiḥ stotrāṅgatvaṃ ca, girāpadasya tu pāṭhotpattiḥ kramācca stotrāṅgatvam, 'yajñāyajñīyena stuvīta' iti sāmanityatvā''nupapattyā vā ākṣiptaṃ sāmno hi ṛgakṣarābhivyaktidvāreva stotrāṅgatva- teti ṛgakṣarāṇāmapi tadklaptisiddhiḥ - ubhayathā-'pi girāpadasya tādṛkpadantarasādhāraṇamapi durbalameva |
tathāpi girāpadakāryaṃ irāpadaṃ vidhīyamānaṃ takāryasya girāpadasya siddhimupajīvatīti upajīvyaviśeṣātparyeṇa girāpadasya nityaṃ bādhaḥ, apitu 'na tau payau karoti' itivat vikalpa eva |
iti prāpte, na tāvadatra girāpadakāryasyetyeva śrutam, apitu niṣedhānuvāda-
tena ca yathaiva tatkāryasya sādhanasākāṅkṣatvāt girāpadasya ca kāryasākāṅkṣatvāt tatkāryajanakatvaṃ kalpyate, tathā tadalenaiva girāpada- syāpi agniṣṭomātpūrvasādhanakalpanāprativandho'pi |
ata eva kāryasyāpi uddeśyatā na girāpadasyetyanena, apidha agniṣṭomātpūrvasādhanabhūtavijātīyaguṇābhidhānatvenaiva |

ata eva pāṭho'pi girāpadasya yatra 'yajñāyajñīyaṃ pucche gāyati' iti cayane yajñāyajñīyaṃ sāma vihitam, tatra tasya dṛṣṭaviṣayā pucchā- bhidhānakaṛgakṣarābhivyaktijanakatvenaiva upayogāt, tatra ca girāpadavidhyābhāvena girāpadasyaivābhānaviddhasya viniyogāt sārthakaḥ |

ataḥ siddhaṃ niṣedhānuvādabalena girāpadāṭhādeḥ agniṣṭomāttrājñatayā girāpadaviniyoja- katvābhāvāt girāpadasya 'airaṃ kṛllodreyam' iti pratyakṣa- vidhinā viśiṣṭa vihitasya niyatameva tadvākyatvaṃ tatkāryāpāttvaśceti |

yattu atra tantraratnaśākhadīptikayoḥ uddānamudiśya irāpadavidhirityuktam, tat stomavidhayā gānāntve gānasaṃkāryaguṇābhidhānakaraṇagirāpadavākyatvā- nupapatteḥ uttarorapi ca gānātideśe tadaṅgastomāti- deśavat atideśāpatteḥ upekṣitam |

yadapi kaiścit gānasaṃkāryarāpadasya stomājñatayā vidhiḥ, abhibhavasaṃskṛta- pūtīkānāmiṣa yāgasādhanatayā tadadeva saṃbhavatvātka- syāpi gānasya śīghrapravṛttyā punarvidhānaṃ girāpadasya gāna- saṃncadhavāraṇārthamityuktam, tadapi gānavāraṇe'pi girā- padavaraṇānāpatteḥ asya prakṛtagānasaṃncadhe'pi girāpadamātra- gānavāraṇe tadviṣedhānuvādasyaiva śaraṇīkaraṇīyatayā tata eva ubhayavāraṇe gānavidhivaiyarthyādupekṣitam |
tasmādasya irāpadamātravidhāyakatvam, udreyamiti sthānātprāptā- nuvādaḥ, ityeva tattvam |
' 26. girāpadadhamā: irāpade bhaveyuḥ jyotiṣṭome yajñā- yajñīya |
girāpadasthānāpane irāpade gānaṃ kartavyaṃ jyotiṣṭome yajñāyajñīyai |
bhāṣyam -- jyotiṣṭome yajñāyajñīyaṃ prakṛtya āmananti 'na girāgiriti brūyāt, yad girāgiriti brūyāt ātmānameva tad udgātodreyet, airaṃ kṛlvā udreyam' iti |
jyotiṣṭome girāpada sthāne irāpadaṃ kartavyamiti samadhigatam |
idānīmidaṃ saṃdigdhaṃ kiṃ pragītam irāpadaṃ kartavyam, uta apragītamiti |
kiṃ prāptam ? girāpadāt anyasmin śabde śrayamāṇe brūmaḥ apragītam irāpadaṃ kartavyamiti |
sarve hi yat yathābhūta- mupadiśyate, tat tathābhūtamupayoktavyam |
nanu naiva tat apragītamucyate, taddhitaśabdena ayaṃ nirdeśaḥ kriyate |
yadyapi cāsti svaraviśeṣaḥ, anye tu gītavikārāḥ āībhāvādayo na nirdiśyante |
girāpadavarṇānāṃ ca saṅkā- rikā gītiḥ, sā tāneva varṇān saṃskaroti, tairaiva varṇaiḥ prayujyate, irāpadavarṇaiḥ na prayujyate, girāpadavarṇasvarūpa- yuphtvāt gīteḥ |
nanu ca 'airam' iti vikāre taddhita utpannaḥ |
( ucyate ) nātra vikāre taddhita utpannaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? svārtha eva |
yāvadeva uktam 'irāṃ kṛtvā udreyam' ( iti ) tāvat airam iti |
yadi ca pragītāt taddhita utpadyate, tathā sati 'vṛddhaṃ tālavyaṃ prathamasvaraṃ vā' kṛtvā ikārasya āyībhāvaḥ syāt |
vṛddham' iti chandosūtreṇa gītidaśāyāṃ yat trimātrā- tmakatayā vṛddhaṃ tālavyam, tat āyī bhavati ityarthakena) |
tatra 'vṛddhācchaḥ' ( pā0 4|2|120 ) iti chaḥ ( īya ) bhavati |
yatsthāne vā taddhitaḥ syāt, padānyatvapradhāna- syāt |
yasya padasya sthāne irāpadaṃ prayujyate, tasya padasya vā gītiḥ, sā irāpade syāt |
padānyatvapradhānaṃ hi idaṃ vākyam, girāpadasya sthāne irāpadaṃ bhavatīti |
evaṃ hi śrūyate irāpadasya vikāraṃ kṛtvā udreyamiti |
tatra anena prakāreṇa irāpadaṃ vidhīyate, nānyaṃ pragāṇāt irāpadasya vikāraṃ brūyāt, na girāpadasya ityetat taddhitana ucyate |
nātra gītasya irāpada vikāraḥ taddhitaśabdena avyavasīyate |
paścāt taddhito vikāraṃ brūyāt iti atho anudyate eva |
yaḥ prakṛtyarthaḥ irāpadasya iti, sa vidhīyate |
tena padānyatvaparam etat vacanam, na gītyananvayaparam |
ḍup -- girāpade kartavyā gītiḥ ( girāpade yā gītiḥ, sā irāpade kartavyā ityarthaḥ ) |
kutaḥ ? stotrā- pūrvaprayuktā hi gītiḥ, na varṇasvarūpamuktā |
nanu vikāra- taddhito'yam, na svārthikaḥ, anarthakyaprasaṅgāt |
( 1 ) yadā irā- padagītivikāre taddhito'yam anūdya irāpadaṃ vidhīyate, ( 2 ) athavā irāpadamanūdya gītiḥ ( vidhīyate ) |
( 3 ) athavā ubhayam ( gītimirāpadaṃ ca vidhīyate 'gītam irāpadaṃ kartavyam' iti ) |
prathamapakṣaṃ nirasyati - ) tatra irāpadasya na lokavedayoḥ gītiḥ prasiddhā |
( dvitīyapakṣaṃ duṣayati - ) irā ( padamapi ) aprasiddhatvādeva na śakyā anuvaditum |
apica yadi irāpadanūdya gītirvidhīyate, girāpadasya nivṛttirna prāpnoti |
apica girāpade niṣiddhe aniyamena tasthāne varṇāḥ prāpnuvanti, nāvaśyāmirāpadam |
( tṛtīyaṃ nirasyati - ) atha ubhayaṃ pragītam, irāpadaṃ ca ( iti ) tathā vākya- bhedaḥ |
tasmāt ( 'airam' iti pade - ) airaiva prātipadikaṃ vidhīyate |
tacca vidhīyamānaṃ girāpadasya vā gītiḥ, tāṃ kāryāpatyā labhate |
'udreyam āirā vā dākṣāsā' iti irāgānaṃ darśayati |
bhāṣyam -- iti cet paśyasi, gānadarśanam etadava- tīti |
vacanaṃ bhaviṣyati 'udreyam āirā vā dākṣāsā' iti |
tathā irāpadasya arthavādo bhavati, na gīte |
kiṃ bhavati prayojanaṃ cintāyāḥ, nātra kaścidviśeṣaḥ |
anyasmin etacchabde prayojanamasti, 'na preti brūyāt, praprīti brūyāt' |
yadi pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ prapadaṃ vā vaktavyam, praprīpadaṃ vā |
ḍup -- ( yadyapi anvayahitottaraṃ vārtikam ānandā- śramīye 55 sūtre eva mudritam, tathāpi vastutaḥ 58 sūtramevedam |
prapa-praprī ityādiprayojanasya 58 sūtrabhāṣye eva pratipādanena prayojanavārtikasyāpi tatraiva lekhanī-
ata eva assāmi: 58 sūtre eva likhyate iti jñeyam |
) ' yadi pūrvapakṣa: prapadyaṃ pramī- padaṃ vā prayoktavyam |
yadi siddhānta: prapīdameva prayo- ktavyam ' ( iti kiñcit pāṭhabhedena bhāṣyam |
tasmāt pūrvādhikaraṇasya prayojanamidam ' āmnātādantya ' ityasya prapadyaṃ prapīdaṃ vā pūrvapakṣe, siddhānte prapīdameva ' iti |
' apragāṇāt ' ityasya prayojanam ( tu ) apragītam irāpadaṃ pūrvapakṣe, siddhānte tu pragītaṃ prayoktavyam |
yat punaridam ' nātra kaścit viśeṣa: , anyasmin tatsadśe prayojanamiti ' iti idam ' vacanamiti cet ' ityasya sūtrasya ( 57-58 ) prayojanam |
irāpade vacanāt pragāṇam, yadi vā sthānāpatyā, sarvathā irāpadaṃ pragītaṃ prayoktavyam |
prapīde tu na vācanikaṃ pramāṇa- masti |
tatra ( irāpade ) yadi vacanena gānaṃ prāpyate, prapīdādīnāṃ tu vacanābhāvāt apragītatvā syāt |
śa - niyamitarāpadam iti sthite kiṃ tat apragītaṃ prayoktavyam, uta pragītamiti saṃśaya: |
( tathā ca prāptāvasarasya vicāra: iti avasarasaṃgati: |
) tatra ' na pragāṇaṃ bhavet, kasmādapragītasya codanāt |
tatra kṛṣṭhaprathamadvitīyatṛtīya: utkṣepiṇa: āyāmā- dāruṇyādibhi: utkṣepakārakairlakṣitavyam |
caturtha- mandrātisvāryau: svarā avakṣepiṇa: anvavasargamārgādibhi: avakṣepiṇamātvāt |
tathā ca tṛtīyanāmakamadhyamasvarāt dvitīya: utkṣipta:, dvitīyata: prathama: utkṣiptatara:, kṛṣṭha: utkṣiptatama: |
ataśca utkṣiptasya dvitīyanāmakrasya udāttatvāt utkṣipta- tasya udāttatvaṃ paryavasyati |
tathā ' kṛṣṭhaṃ vṛddhau vṛddhi: pluta: ' iti trimātrabhūtānāṃ varṇānāṃ paryāyasaṃjñā: iti kṛṣṭhasūtravyākhyātubhiruktam |

tathā ca tālavyam ukta- lakṣaṇaprathamasvaraṃ ca vṛddhaṃ bhavati plutaṃ prāpnoti iti irāpade ikārasya tālavyatvāt uhagāne ' yonivat svarā: ' iti sūtreṇa atideśāt irāpadaprathamasvarasyāpyā prathama- svaratvācca plutalakṣaṇavṛddhau satyām ' vṛddhaṃ tālavyamāyī bhavati ' iti vacanāntareṇa āyībhāve āyīśabdasya ' vṛddhiyrcāmādādid vṛddham ' ( pā0 1|1|73 ) iti vṛddhatvāt ' vṛddhāccha: ' ( pā0 4|2|114 ) iti chapratyaye tasya āneyīsūtreṇa ( pā0 7|1|2 ) aiyādeśe āyīrīyam iti prasajyate |
vastutastu pragītāt taddhitotpattiśca svārthike ayi ācīr prasajyate ityevātra āpādanaṃ yuktam |
17. vi - ' irāpadaṃ na geyaṃ syād geyaṃ vā, gītanukti: |
na geyam, gītyamānasya sthāne pātāt pragīyate |
' vimuktādimyo'ṇ ' ( pā0 5|1|61 ) iti sūtreṇa aṇ- pratyaye'pi ' matau cha: sūtranāmato: ' ( pā0 5|1|69 ) iti sūtrāt sāmānuvṛtte: airaṃ sāma ityevaṃ bhavati, sāmatvaṃ ca gītīsādhamyam |
yadā tu ' tasya vikāra: ' ( pā0 4|3|124 ) ityasminnarthe aṇpratyaya:, tadānīm irāyā vikāra: iti vigrahe yathoktaṃ gānaṃ labhyate |
bhāṭṭa - tat irāpadam apragītaṃ prayoktavyaṃ veti saṃdehe airamiti apragītaśravaṇāt apragītam |
yadi hi ayaṃ svārthe taddhita:, tadā irāṃ kṛtvā ityarthāvagamāt irāpada- mātravidhi: spaṣṭa eva |

nahi pragīterāpadāt ayaṃ taddhita:, tathātve ikārasya tālavyatvāt gītadaśāyāṃ ca vṛddhatvā- patte: ' tālavyamāyī yad vṛddham ' iti chandogasūtreṇa gītadaśāyāṃ yat trimātramātraṃ vṛddhaṃ tālavyam, tat āyī bhavatītyarthena āyīvidhānāt ākārāditvena gītadaśāyāṃ ' vṛddhāccha: ' iti pāṇinisūtreṇa chapratyayotpattau āyīrīyam iti rūpapatte: |

evāyaṃ taddhita:, vikāraśca irāpadasya pragāṇarūpe dharme eveti cet, tathātve'pi pragāṇarūpadharmāṅgīkāre viśiṣṭa- vidhigauravāpatte: apragāṇarūpasya girāpadavācakatvasya vā dharmasya taddhitārthatvamaṅgīkṛtya taddhitasya anuvādopapatte: |
na ca apragīterāpadamātrāvidhāne ' udeyam ' ityanuvādā- nupapatti:, tasya airaṃ kṛtvā akṣarāntare udeyam ityeva- maryāṅgīkāreṇa anuvādopapatte: |
na ca prakārāntareṇa gīte: aprāptāvapi girāpadavācyatvāt tanprāpti:, irāpadasya agniṣṭomastotrādhvanabhāvena irāpadasya tatkāryatvapattau pramāṇābhāvāt |
ata eva uhagranthe ' āīrā- āīrā cā dākṣāsā ' iti gānānāmapi apramāṇameva |
na ca etasya śrutimūlakatvāt nyāyasyaiva aprāmāṇyam, ūhagranthasamākhyayā asya tarkamūlatvena śrutimūlatvā- bhāvāt |
ata eva santyāvirodhe asya aprāmāṇya- meva |
yattu tanmaraṇadigranthatvāt asya gītyāmnānasya vedakathanamam, tat vaidikānāṃ ūhagranthe pāṭhāt anādaraṇīyam |
iti prāpte, satyam, irāpada- svarūpasya vidhi: na tu pragāṇasya, tathāpi pragāṇābhāvasyāpi abhidheyatvāt kāryapathā gīterapi prāptirna virudhyate |
tathāhi, yadyapi na irāpadasya stotrāpūrve upayoga:, tathāpi guṇābhidhānarūpasya kāryasya girāpadairāpadyo: ekatvāt yuktastathā dharmalābha: |

yadyapi ca guṇābhidhānasvarūpārthā dharmā:, tathāpi guṇābhidhāna- janyasya apūrvasya etasyaiva agniṣṭomastotre cayanādau copayogāt, dharmāṇāṃ ca gītyādīnāṃ girāpadakāryaguṇā- bhidhānajanyāvāntarapūrvaprayuktatvasya dīkṣaṇīyātrāṅganiyama- nyāyena aṅgīkārātu cayanāpūrvasādhanībhūtagirāpadāntara- kāryāpanne agniṣṭomastotrāpūrvasādhanībhūtakāryajanake irāpade yuktaiva taddharmaprāpti: |
mā'stu vā avāntarakārya- bhedamīṅgīkṛtya kāryāpattiḥ; tathāpi girāpadabādhakatvā tasthānāpatti: tāvadasye irāpadasya |
ataśca irāpadasya prakaraṇāt stotrāttve avagate gītirūpadharmāṅgābhyāṃ bādhakatvalakṣaṇānapatyā upasthitasya girāpadasya dharmati- deśe na kiñcidvādhakam asti |
vastutastu, yathaiva ' yajñiyajñiyaṃ pṛcche gāyati ' iti vacanena yajña- yajñiyasya cayane upayoga:, tathaiva ' yajñāśayena stuvīta ' iti vacanena agniṣṭomastotre'pi |

ataśca tadgatagīrya- śasya yāvat cayane svāśrayagirāpadopayogakalpanādvārā cayanopayogakalpanām, tāvat tattvameva agniṣṭoma- stotrāṅgabhūtagirāpadadhārakatvakalpanā stotropayogo'pi iti upadeśenaiva tanmātrenaṃ girāpadagīte: irāpade atideśa: |

yadyapi ca agniṣṭomastotre'pi ārdhike purastāduparidhāt girāpadasyāpi upayogāt tatsthānāpatti: irāpadasya agni- ṣṭomastotrāvacanatvasya samānatvātvādiśaṅkyeta, tathāpi ārcikodrīyayo: avāntarakāryabhedāt amede'pi vā apragītasya girāpadasya ārcike pāṭhāt girāpadagīte: girāpadadvārā cayanādāveva upayogena agniṣṭomastotre upayogābhāvāt tarkāryāpatyā atideśena taddhīta: irāpade atideśa: ūho vā, apitu uparītyā upadeśenaiva |

tattvaṃ tu ' airaṃ kulodreyam ' ityatra na irāpadakṣarāṇi vidhīyante, girāpadayuktepāṭhe'pi tatsatvāt, apitu niṣedhānuvādatvāt gakāraparisaṃkhyāmātraṃ vidhīphalam, ataśca gīte: ' gāirāgātrā cā dākṣāsā ' ityevaṃ- vidhāya girāpadavṛttitvena samatāyā vastuta: irākṣaradharma- tvāt gakārasattve iva tadasadapyeva svāśrayavṛttitvākṣate: na girāpadagīte: irāpade svatantra: upadeśaḥ, na vā ati- deśa: ūho vā |
yatra tu ' na preti brūyāt, praprīti brūyāt ' ityādī akārabādhena ikāravidhi:, tatra pūrvoktavidhayā svatantropadeśo gīte: |
yatra kṛte'pi bahvāyāsāsādhye karmaṇi, tucchaphalopalabdhi: tatrāyaṃ pravartate iti |
tathā coktaṃ pañcatantre ' svana- khāgravilai: siṃha: pāṣāṇaśakalakulam |
prāpnoti nalabhabhraṃ vā phalaṃ vā mūṣako bhavet |
su. pṛ. 855. gīti: stotrāpūrvaprayuktā, na varṇasvarūpaprayuktā|

su. pṛ. 861. gītiṣu sāmarūpā ṛca: na pradhāna- bhūtā:; kintu guṇabhūtā:|
balīyasve sati dravyadānaṃ tena saha bādhavikalpasamuccayān na pratipadyate iti 'guṇaśca' ityevaṃ karmāntaraṃ kalpayet |
3|4|14|41 pṛ. 979. na caivamapi guṇāt medaḥ syāt 'guṇaśāstrapūrvasaṃyoge' ityadhikaraṇe guṇāpi karma- bhedakatāyāḥ vakṣyamāṇatvāditi vācyam |
cāturmāsyeṣu vaiśvadevaparvaṇi 'tase payasi dadhyānayati sā vaiśvadevyāmikṣā vājibhyo vājinam' ityāmnāyate |
atra kiṃ āikṣāguṇake karmaṇi vājinaguṇasya vidhiḥ, uta vājinaguṇakaṃ karmāntaraṃ vidhīyate iti vicāre siddhāntamāha |
apūrvasaṃyoge apūrveṇa apakṛtena devatā'bhidhānena saṃyoge sati guṇo'pi karma minatti |
āikṣāvākye taddhitena viśeṣāṃ devānāṃ devatātvam, vājinavākye caturthyā vājinām |
ekatra āikṣā saha ekavākya- tvam, patra vājinena |
tasmāt āikṣāvākye viśeṣāṃ devānāṃ devatātvam, na vājinavākye |
cāturmāsyeṣu vaiśvadeva parvaṇi samāmananti 'tase payasi dadhyānayati sā vaiśvadevyāmikṣā, vājibhyo vājinam' iti |
tatra saṃdihyate kim āikṣāguṇake karmaṇi vājinaṃ guṇa- vidhiḥ, uta tasmāt vājinaguṇakaṃ karmāntaramiti |
pūrva saṃjñānibandhanakarmabhedaṃ nirūpya idānīṃ guṇaprakaraṇabhyāṃ mede vaktavye vastutvāt guṇanibandhana eva karmabhedaḥ pratipādyate |
na cāsau devatā- tvena prasiddhaḥ, nākasadādeva devatātvāt |
na ca 'vasantāya kapiñjalānālabhate' itivat aśvasyāpi devatātvamiti vācyam |
iha tu avayavaśaktyādvāreṇa viśve devā eva vājinasaṃbandhe santi |
anantaravākye ca teṣāmeva āikṣāvattvā āikṣā- stīti nyupyadhvavājindābhidheyatvāt pūrva-(vākyānumite) yāge viśvadevadevatāke vājināmātraṃ vidhīyate iti |
viśve devāḥ pratīyante tacca karmeha vājinam |
na ca utpattiśiṣṭāmikṣāguṇavaruddhatvena niśākāṅkṣatvāt na vākyānaropāttavājinaguṇasaṃbandha iti vācyam |

nanu 'aruṇayā piṅgākṣyaika- hāyinyā somaṃ krīṇāti' ityatra niṣkṛṣṭasya krayasya krīṇātipadena āgnāyatvāt 'vāsasā krīṇāti' ityādi- ṣvapi krīṇātipadena niṣkṛṣṭakrayānuvādāt tatra yuktaṃ vāsaḥ- prabhṛtīnāṃ vidhānam |
iha tu vākyadvaye'pi yajipadābhāvāt kathaṃ niṣkṛṣyāgapratipādakatvamasti |

tathā 'vājibhyo vājinam' ityatrāpi dravyadevatāpratipādakakarmakāraka- saṃpradānakārakayoḥ saṃbandhasya yāgakriyāmantareṇa asaṃbhavāt yāgakalpanā''vasye vājipadya āikṣāgāmīyaviśeṣa- devatāparatvāt āikṣāgatyeva dravyadevatāsaṃbandhopapattau tatratipādakameva śrutāthapatyā vājipadaṃ kalpyate |
etāvānayaṃ viśeṣaḥ, pūrvasmin vākye aprakṛtatvāt dravyadevatāviśiṣṭayāga eva vidhīyate |
vājinavākye tu devatāyāḥ prāk asya prāptatvāt kalpitayajipadena niṣkṛ- yāgamanasya yāgamātraṃ vidhīyate iti |
kintu niṣkṛṣṭā- vādasāmye'pi ayamatra viśeṣaḥ, bhinnatitaprayojanatvāt krayeṇa dravyāṇāṃ samuccaya eva, iha tu upakāryatvāt āikṣāvājinayorvikalpa eva |
na ca 'vāruṇyā niṣkāsena tuṣaiśvāvamavanti' itivat tulyakālatve- 'pi samuccaya iti vaktavyam |
tulyakāryāṇāmapi eka- vākyopādānena parasparasāpekṣatvaṃ viśeṣaśca kāraka- samuccitānāṃ bhavatu samuccayaḥ |
iha tu uktanyāyena vaiśvadeva- vākye dravyadevatāviśiṣṭayāgavidhānam, na vājinavākye tadanuvādena vājinamātravidhānamiti vākyabhede siddhe bhinnavākyavihitayostulyakāryayoḥ nīhayavayorvikalpa eveti |
nanu devatāsaṃrva-dvārako hi dravyasya yāga- saṃbandhaḥ |
syādeva hi yadi vaiśvadeva- padena āikṣāsaṃbandhaḥ pratīyate |

vaiśvadevapadāt sāmānyena dravyasaṃbandhe'vagate viśeṣamātram āikṣāpadāt pratīyate, tarhi vājibhya ityādi caturthītaḥ sāmānyena pradeyadravyāvagatau vājinapadāt viśeṣāvagama iti nāsti vākyagamye kaścidviśeṣa iti |
na ca 'vidhi' śabdasya mantratve bhāvaḥ syāt' (10|4|1|23) ityanena nyāyena vājinānuvādena vājinadevatāpādāna- miti vācyam |
āikṣāgāmīyadevatāyāśca viśvadevaśabdā- bhihitatvāt viśvadevadevatvena upāttasya vājinasya iti |
na caivaṃ devatā'nyeṣepi 'aindraṃ dadhyāmāvāsyā- yām' itivat karmabheda iti vācyam |
yatastatra nira- pekṣavākyadvayena indrasaṃbandhavagamāt dadhipayodravyakayāgamedo yuktaḥ |
iha tu vājipadena āikṣāsaṃbandhapūrvaparyāgīya- viśvadevasaṃbandhapratipādanāt karmabheda iti |
bhavedevaṃ yadi śrautotpattiśiṣṭā- miṣāvaruddhe karmaṇi vājinaguṇavidhiḥ upapadyate |
tathāhi, na tāvat vājinasya pūrvasmin karmaṇi samuccayena vidhānaṃ saṃbhavati, bhinnavākyopāttatve'pi kāryayoḥ samu- ccayābhāvasyoktatvāt |
nanu āikṣāsaṃbandho- 'pi vākrīya ityuktam, syādevaṃ yadi viśve devā devatā syeti sarvanāmapadena dravyamātramuccīyate |
vājibhya ityatra na prātipadikena vibhaktyā vā havirdevayamabhihitam |
nāpi tasyaiva devatā'nyatvam, kintu vājinapadasami- vyāhāralatvāt vākyagamyameveti |
taduktam 'na prāti- padikenoktaṃ na vibhaktyā haviḥ svataḥ |
na cāsya devatāyoga iti vākyāt pratīyate |
nanu 'vāruṇyā niṣkāsena tuṣaiśvāvamava- yanti' ityatra śrautāmikṣāsaṃbandhe'pi varuṇyasya prakārāntare- ṇāpi niṣkāsatuṣasaṃbandhe dṛṣṭa eva, tadadṛṣṭāpi vājibhyo vājinasaṃbandho bhaviṣyatīti |
tatrāpyavaśyaṃ kalpanīyo niṣkāsatuṣayoḥ devatāsaṃbandhe saṃnihitadevatā- parityāge kāraṇābhāvāt atathā āśritam |
kiñca utpattiśiṣṭāmikṣāvaruddhasya utpattiśiṣṭavājinasaṃbandhaḥ eva nāstīti kathaṃ vikalpaḥ ? iti |
kaḥ punarutpattiśiṣṭaguṇāvarodho nāma virodha- prakāraḥ ? tatrocyate, pratipattivirodha evāyam |
na cotpattau guṇa- viśiṣṭe karmaṇi avarodhe tatsamānakāryaguṇānākāṅkṣā samastīti notpattiśiṣṭānyaḥ |
yatra tu kāryabhedaḥ, tatrotpattiśiṣṭe'pi dravyāntare utpannaśiṣṭānāpi dravyāṇāṃ saṃbandho bhavatyeva |
tena utpattiśiṣṭe'pyavaruddhe kraye utpannaśiṣṭānāmapi vāsaḥprabhṛtīnāṃ kāryabhedena ākāṅkṣā- saṃbhavāt samuccayo yukta eveti vaiṣamyam |
kiñca vāji- śabdo hi 'ruḍhiryogamapaharati' iti nyāyena aśvamedha pratipādayati, na ca viśvān devān |
na ca nākasadādeva devatātvam, kintu yā yasya haviṣa uddiśyatayā coyate, sā tasya devateti śārdūlavasantādivat aśvasyāpi devatātva- maviruddham |
bhavatu vā yaugiko vājinaśabdaḥ; tathāpi kathaṃ devatāprasaṅgaḥ ? āikṣāyāge hi teṣāṃ svarūpeṇa devatātvam, vājine tu vājayogāccittena |
vājapeyayāgānādareṇa nirmitti- dhikyena lakṣaṇāyāṃ lakṣaṇaiva doṣaḥ |
tena sarvathā śrauto- tpattiśiṣṭāmikṣāvaruddhe karmaṇi praveśalabhyamānaṃ vāji- devatākaṃ vājinadravyakaṃ karmāntarameva kalpayatīti siddham |
(vā. pṛ. 532) guṇaśāstraṃ vivakṣito bhedakaḥ pūrvakarma- saṃbandhānarhaḥ apūrvakarmasaṃbandhācca |
taduktaṃ bṛhaṭṭīkāyām 'na śaknoti ca saṃbadhuṃ guṇaḥ pūrveṇa karmaṇā |
apūrva- karmasaṃbandhaṃ vo vā''heti sa bhedakaḥ ||
atra pūrvakamasaṃyogārhasya guṇasya prāpte anekaguṇa- vidhānāsaṃbhavāt bhedakatvaṃ paurṇamāsyādhikaraṇe eva prapa- ñcitatvānneha prapañcitamiti |
sūtraṃ tu— guṇaśca karma- bhedakaḥ, apūrvakarmasaṃyoge vākyayoḥ samatvāt paraspara- nirapekṣatvādityarthaḥ |
rathaṃtarasāmādi: guṇa: kamantaraṃ prayojayet, ṛtusaṃyogāt ṛtunā jyotiṣṭomāt kratvantare rathaṃtarasāmādiguṇavatā saṃyogāt prakṛtakarmaṇā ca saṃyogāsaṃbhavāt |
saṃyogasya rathaṃtarādi saṃyogasya aśeṣabhūtatvāt śeṣabhūtatvābhāvāt ṛtuviśeṣaṇatvābhāvāt |
jyotiṣṭome rathaṃtaraṃ sāma na kevalamasti kintu gāyatrasāmadevyādisāmāntarasahita- meva, iti sāmānyarūpeṇa rathaṃtarasāmā iti padagamyaṃ viśeṣaṇatvaṃ rathaṃtarasyānupapannam |
rathaṃtarasāmā bṛhatsāmā iti na jyotiṣṭomāt kratvantaraṃ vidhīyate |
kiṃtu jyoti- ṣṭomasya guṇavidhānaṃ grahātāviśeṣa ucyate yadi rathaṃtarasāmā aindravāyavāgrā, bṛhatsāmatve śukrāgrā ityādi |

tathā sāmidhenīvicchedī āgamyamānānāṃ sarvāsāṃ sāmi- dhyamānavatīṃ samiddhavatīṃ cāntarā niveśaḥ iti pūrvapakṣa- muktvā ' yā eva dhyāyāśabditāḥ tāsāmeva niveśaḥ nānyavāsām, āgantūnāmante niveśaḥ ' iti siddhānta- muktvā tacchidramadayucyate 'uṣṇikakubhorante darśanāt' ( 5|1|3|6 ) iti |
tathā ' darśanācca viśeṣasya tathā'- bhyudaye ' ( 10|1|13|5 ) ityatra abhyudayaśabdena abhyudayasādhanabhūto dvādaśāho lakṣitaḥ |
guṇakalpanāyā vidhiyathā 'sṛṣṭirupadadhāti ' ' prāṇa- bhṛta upadadhāti ' iti |
atra sṛṣṭiśabde prāṇabhṛcchabde ca gauṇī kalpanā |
'somaṃ te krīṇāmi' ityādeśca uhena pravṛttiḥ ' phalāni te krīṇāmi ' iti |
'godohena praṇayet paśukāmas' 'upāsamai gāyatā naraḥ iti āmakāmāya pratipadaṃ kuryāt ' ityādayo guṇa- kāmāḥ |
pravṛttiḥ kasya ityākāṅkṣāyāṃ guṇakāmānāmapi ṣaṣṭhyantena vipariṇāmaḥ |
guṇakāmeṣu guṇakāmārthe paśvādyarthe guṇakāmātānāṃ godohādīnāṃ prakṛtagatānāṃ sauryā- divikṛtau pravṛttiḥ syāt |
āśritatvāt godohādeḥ praṇayanādyāśritatvāt, praṇayādeśca prakṛtitvata vikṛtā- vapi sattvāt |
godohena ca pravṛtte tadāśritaḥ kāmo'pi pravartitumahati |
yathā 'khādiraṃ vīryakāmasya yūpaṃ kuryāt ' iti vīryaphalakṛtsa khādirasya pravṛttiḥ; tadvat |
tasmāt guṇakāmātānāṃ vikṛtau pravṛttiḥ; iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
guṇakāmātānāṃ na sauryādau pravṛttiḥ, kintu nivṛttiḥ, pravṛttirna syādityarthaḥ |
tasmāt vikṛtau guṇa- kāmā na pravarteran |
pūrvapakṣe 'khādiraṃ vīryakāmasya yūpaṃ kuryāt ' iti dṛṣṭānta uktaḥ |
evaṃ ca khādirasya atadvikāra- tvāt ṛtvarthatvāt tasmin vīryaphalasya pravṛttiḥ syāt iti yuktam |
tasmāt guṇakāmātānāṃ vikṛtau na pravṛttiḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
guṇakāmātānāṃ āṣṭamika- nyāyena praṇayanavat laukikavacanasya āśritatvānnyavattve cayane apūrvārthatvavivakṣā |
