mīnyā. pṛ. 72. guṇakriyoyoḥ aicchikaḥ puruṣārthaḥ samuccayaḥ |
vatsa- jānvākāravedasa sāmidhenyaikaviṃśatyanuvacanasya ca paśu- pratiṣṭhobhayakāmanāyāṃ samuccayaḥ |
bāla. pṛ. 176, guṇakriyayoḥ nyāyagamyaḥ ṛtvarthaḥ samuccayaḥ yathā 'lohitoṣṇīṣā lohitavasanā ṛtvijaḥ pracaranti ' |
pṛ. 167, guṇa- kriyayoḥ nyāyagamyaḥ puruṣārthaḥ samuccayaḥ yathā 'jyoti- ṣṭomena svargakāmo yajeta ' iti |
ekatvaṃ yāgasya phala- bhāvanāyāṃ samuccaya vidhīyate |
pṛ. 170, guṇa- kriyayoḥ vācanikaḥ ṛtvarthaḥ samuccayaḥ |
saurapurāṇe 'vividhaṃ pāyasaṃ dadyāt bhakṣyāṇi vividhāni ca |
bhā. 3|8|1|13-14. guṇatadabhāvayoḥ nyāyagamyo vikalpaḥ ṛtvarthaḥ yathā dārśikavedimāne ' nyāyamātrī paścāt syāt ' ityāhura : ' nātra mātrā'sti ' iti ca śatapathe |
gakārādīnāṃ varṇatvaśabdatvaguṇatveṣu satsu dutādimesya paropādhitvāt gakārādirūpatvasiddhe-
2|1|2|2 pṛ. 471, guṇatvaṃ pradhānāśrayitvam 1|2|17|4 pṛ. 718. guṇatvaṃ viśeṣaṇatvam, na śeṣatvam |
ratnākaraḥ. ślovā. anumāne 3. guṇatvena pratītasyāpi prayo- janākāṅkṣāyāṃ prādhānyamiṣyate yathā paśupuroḍāśādau devatā'deḥ |
bhāṭṭa. 3|4|8 pṛ. 318. oṃ guṇatvācca vedena na vyavasthā syāt |
tadittham - udgātṛvede śyenayāgaprakaraṇe 'lohitoṣṇīṣā lohitavasanā ṛtvijaḥ pracaranti' iti śrūyate |
adhvaryu- vede ca vājapeyaprakaraṇe 'hiraṇyamālinaḥ ṛtvijaḥ pracaranti' iti |

tatra audgātrasāmayā udgātṛṇāmeva lohitoṣṇīṣatā syāt, na sarveṣāmṛtvijām, evamā- dhvaryavasamākhyayā adhvaryuṇāmeva hiraṇyamālādhāritvaṃ syāt, na sarveṣāmiti samākhyayā utsūtre pūrvapakṣe prāpte, sūtreṇa siddhāntayati |

guṇatvāt lohitoṣṇīṣasya hiraṇya- mālāyāśca ṛtvigguṇatvāt 'ṛtvijaḥ pracaranti' iti ṛtvipadasya ca bādhāyogāt vedena audgātram ādhvaryavam iti samākhyārūpeṇa vyavasthā na syāt udgātṛmātradharmatā adhvaryumātradharmatā ca na syāt, kintu sarveṣāmeva ṣoḍaśānāmṛtvijāṃ lohitoṣṇīṣatā hiraṇya- mālitvaṃ ca dharmaḥ syāt |
ke. guṇatvācca ityanena nyāyena ādhvaryavādisamāravyānāṃ guṇabhūteṣveva kartṛṣu vyāpāreṇa pradhānabhūtakartṛrūpatvavini- yojakatvāt |
su. 3|7 pṛ. 51. guṇatve viniyoktrī śeṣaṣaṣṭhī yathā 'ājyasyeva nāvupāṃśu paurṇamāsyāṃ yajan' |
bāla. pṛ. 45. guṇatvaprādhānye ekasya karmaṇo na yukte |
' 1|4|2|3 pṛ. 331, guṇadharmaiḥ atikramitavyaḥ ( na pradhānadharmaḥ ) avaśyaṃ kartavye anyataradharmātikrame |
guṇanimitto medābhedavicāraḥ ataḥ paraṃ (2|2| 123 ārabhya ) prāk prakaraṇabhedāt (2|3|124) vartavyate |
vā. 2|1|23 pṛ. 531. guṇaniṣedhaḥ puruṣādho yathā 'śuktaṃ na bhakṣayet' iti |
bāla. pṛ. 31, guṇaniṣedhaḥ pratyakṣaḥ yathā rajasvalā- mateṣu 'na kharvena pātreṇa pibet' iti |
pṛ. 32, guṇaniṣedhaḥ pratyakṣaḥ yathā pūrvapakṣe ādhāne 'apari- mitaṃ deyam' |
bruvatā saṃpradeyāt vinā tadanupapatteḥ sāmānyapekṣe sati vājinepadanidhanāne viśeṣamātrapratīteḥ |
api- ca bhavatu nāma taddhitaśruteḥ dravyamātrasaṃbandhaḥ, tatra dravya- mātraṃ vājine'pi aviśiṣṭamiti na virudhyate, viśeṣyostu āmiṣvājineyoḥ virodhaḥ |
' viśve devā devatā asyāḥ iti hi na sarva- nāmnā dravyasāmānyamabhidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi ? saṃnihito viśeṣaḥ, sa eva vyavahārakṣamaḥ, na anirūpita dravya- mātram |
ataḥ prātipadikena yo'rthaḥ upāttaḥ, sa pramāṇā- ntaragamyasya dravyaviśeṣasya devatā, ityetat taddhitena śrūyyata ucyate |

tataśca antarṇītasaṃbandhadevatopasarjana- dravyaviśeṣapratyaye padāntaranirapekṣeṇa taddhitāntena padena nivartite kaḥ punarasau viśeṣaḥ, yasya taddhitena devatā uktā ityanveṣaṇāyām ayamiti āmiṣvādena upanīyate |
tatra yadā tāvat prāgeva viśiṣṭapratyayāt saṃbandhaḥ abhi- hitaḥ, tadā na lakṣamāṇo bhavati |
athāpi prakṛti- pratyayayoḥ svārthavattayoraiva nairantaryāt antarāle saṃbandhaḥ avagamyamāno bhavati, tathāpi atra ekapadatvāt padadvayasaṃnidhigamyāt balīyān vijñāyamānaḥ śrautaḥ ityu- cyate |
tatra pūrvaḥ śrautaḥ, uttaro vākyalakṣaṇaḥ iti viśeṣaḥ |
ataśca naivātra nīlotpala- divat arthadvāraṃ vaiśvadevyāmiṣvāśabdayoḥ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣa- pyatvam, kiṃ tarhi ' āmiṣvā devatāyuktāṃ vadatye- vaiṣa taddhitaḥ |
' naivātra taddhitāntena eko'rthaḥ abhihitaḥ āmiṣvāpadena anyaḥ paścāt tayorviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatā, taddhitāntavācyasya prathamapratīteḥ |
kiṃ tarhi ? taddhitā- ntasya anupayuktānabhidhānasyaiveha pratītimātram upa- padena viṣayadānamātraṃ kriyate |
tena āmiṣvāpadasaṃnidhi- balāt vaiśvadevīśabdaḥ eva tāmabhidhatte |
na cedānīm āmiṣvāpadasya anuvādakatvam, tena vinā taddhitāntasya
na ca vākyārthatvam, taddhitānta- padārthasya pṛthak aprasiddheḥ |
nahi dvau svatantrau padārthau agṛhītvā vākyārthaḥ pratīyate |
tena abhidheyopanayamātra- kāritvāt na taddhitabhūteḥ āmiṣvāpadena arthaviprakarṣaḥ kriyate |
tena yaiva āmiṣvā, saiva devatāsaṃbandhaṃ yāsyati ityevamuktā satī vaiśvadevīśabdena ucyate |
itaratra tu ( vājine ) 'na prātipadikenaṃ na vibhaktyā haviḥ svataḥ |
na vā'sya devatāyoga iti vākyāt pratīyate |
' vājimyaḥ iti tu nātra prātipadikena vibhaktyā vā ubhābhyāṃ vā dravyasāmānyaviśeṣatvadharmānām anyatama- mapi abhidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi ? prātipadikaiḥ saṃpra- dānam ityetāvanamātramityuktam |
tatra na kathañcit dravyasaṃbandhaḥ pade antargataḥ, iti avaśyaṃ vākyenaiva vājinapadasāmīpyāt pratyāyitavyaḥ |

' ' sā'sya devatā ' ( pā0 4|2|24 ) iti aspapadārthaṃ ( asya iti padasya arthe ) devatā- taddhito vidhīyate, na tu evam 'tat saṃpradānamasya ' caturthī vidhīyate, yena asyapadārtho'pi upādīyeta, kiṃ tarhi saṃpradānamātrameva tadabhidheyatvenoktam, tathā ca pratī- yate |
tena tu anyathā'nupapadyamānena saṃpradeyaviṣayam ākāṅkṣāmātraṃ kevalamupasthāpyate |
na caitāvatā abhi- dheyatvaṃ bhavati, sarvavākyārthānāṃ padārthalyaprasaṅgāt |
ākāṅkṣayā tu etāvat kriyate, yena padāntaroccāraṇe sati saṃbandho jāyate |
tena yadyapi caturthyarthā devatātvamuktam, tathāpi dravyasaṃbandho vākyenaiva |
tatra cāsmākaṃ vivādaḥ, iti durbalo vājinasaṃbandhaḥ |
kiñca ' śrutyarthaḥ saṃnikṛṣṭatvaṃ vākyārthau vipra- kṛṣṭatā |
uttarārdhena tu aṣṭaprakāraṃ saṃnikarṣaviprakarṣā- bhidhānaṃ pratijñātam ) sarvaprakāram āmiṣvā saṃbandhasya saṃnikarṣalakṣaṇaṃ śrautatvam, vājinasaṃbandhe ca viprakarṣāt vākyīyatvam |

( āmiṣvāyāṃ sāmānyato devatā'nyā- bhidhānam, na vājinasya iti prathamaṃ prakāramāha - ) tad yathā, yadyapi tāvat dravyaviśeṣasya taddhito na brūyāt devatātvam, tathāpi sāmānyasya tāvat bravīti, na caturthyantena sāmānyamapi ucyate iti viśeṣaḥ |
vaiśva- devī iti hi śrīpratyayena samānapadatenaiva klībatvaṃ kimapi saṃnihitamityavācyate |
na ca vājinasya strītvaṃ saṃnidhirvā asti ityanāśrayam |
( dadātikalpanā- kalpanarūpaṃ dvitīyaṃ prakāramāha - ) apica ' vājibhyo vājinaṃ kuryāditi naivāsti saṃgatiḥ |
' kartavyatā- vacanam āmiṣvākye'pi adhyāhārāt prayogavacanadāhā lambyamiti na paryanuyujyate |
' vājibhyo vājinam ' iti tu dadātimanadhyāhṛtya na śakyaḥ saṃbandhaḥ pratyetuṃ yathā ' vaiśvadevī āmiṣvā ' iti |
na ca vājibhyaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ṣaṣṭhyā vā padayāmaḥ |
na ca vājibhyaḥ iti kārakabhaktiḥ kriyāpadat anyena saṃbadhyate, na ceha tadupāttam |
tatra adhyāhārakalpanāt eko viprakarṣaḥ, tripadasaṃbandhagauravāt aparaḥ |
itaratrāpi yaji- kalpanāt aśeṣa iti cet na, tasya saṃbandhottara kālānumeyatvāt |
vaiśvadevyāmiṣvā iti hi niṣpanne saṃbandhe yajiḥ anumīyate, na taddhīnā saṃbandha- pratītiḥ |
tava tu parasvatvāpādanasaṃbhavāt sa ca bhavi- ṣyati arthasaṃbandhārtham, āditaśca dravyadevatākavākya- tvasiddhaye dadātiḥ iti viśeṣaḥ |
kalpite ca dadātī kārakayoḥ parasparasaṃbandhatvāt tena tāvat saha saṃbandhaḥ, tataḥ ekārthatvāt parasparaniyamaḥ iti viprakṛṣṭatā |
na tu āmiṣvāyāṃ taddhit kiñcit iti saṃnikarṣaḥ |
( sāmānādhikaraṇyavaidhakaraṇalakṣaṇaṃ tṛtīyaṃ prakāramāha - ) satyāpi ca vājivājinayoḥ sākṣātsaṃbandhe vaidhikaraṇyat viprakṛṣṭatvam |
vaiśvadevī āmiṣvā iti tu sāmānādhi- karaṇāt saṃnikṛṣṭatā |
tathā ca vakṣyati ( 3|1|6|12 ityatra mādhyam ) ' samarthatarāṇi hi samānavibhaktīni bhavanti, durbale viviktiḥ ' iti |
( śrutalakṣaṇā- ''tmakaṃ caturthaṃ prakāramāha - ) kiñca ' saṃpradānatvamātraṃ ca caturthī vājināṃ vadet |
na ca saṃpradānasyaiva devatātvam, mā bhūt ' hiraṇyamātreyāya dadāti ' ityatra ātreyo devatā |
yadi ca devatā saṃpradānaṃ syāt, tato yāgadānayorameda eva syāt |
pratigrahe vyāpṛtaṃ ca kārakaṃ saṃpradānaṃ bhavati |
tena avaśyaṃ yaḥ saṃpradānatvāt prāgbhāvī taduddeśaḥ ( tasyāḥ devatāyāḥ uddeśaḥ ), sa caturthyā lakṣayitavyaḥ |
yadvā parasvatvāpādana- saṃbandhottarakālabhāvi aiśvaryam, tādātmyaprasiddhedevatā- tvasya |
yadyapi anirākaraṇātmakasaṃpradānameva devatā ityabhyupagamaḥ, tathāpi sāmānyena vyabhicāraviśeṣalakṣa- ṇāt viprakṛṣṭatvam |
( saṃdigdhatvātsaṃdigdhalakṣaṇaṃ pañcamaṃ prakāramāha - ) apica ' caturthīpañcamīrūpasaṃdehāt viprakṛṣṭatā |
' vājibhyaḥ iti rūpasāmānyāt prasaktaṃ sat yāvat pañcamītvamapanīya caturthītvaṃ sādhyate, tāvat mativiśeṣaḥ |
' śabdasaṃdeho mayā upa- nyastaḥ, tvayā arthasaṃdehaḥ |
arthaḥ punaḥ yogyatvāt itarāsaṃbhavena devatā- tmako nirṇeyate |
bhavatsu nirṇīte'pi śabde caturthyarthā- neruktvāt upapadakāraka lakṣaṇasaṃdehāt asyaiva viprakarṣaḥ |
( ityayupañcādiṣṭa- tvalakṣaṇaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ prakāramāha - ) kiñca ' āmiṣvātyeya- mānena karmaṇā saha yujyate |
' yathā ca utpattiśiṣṭasya balīyastvam , na ca kriyāmātraṃ niṣkṛṣya guṇāntaraṃ vidhātuṃ śakyate, tathoktaṃ citrā'dhikaraṇe vaiśvadevādhikaraṇe ca |
' vājinaṃ hi vinā yāgena vājibhirna saṃvadhyate, iti kaścit yāgamapekṣate |

tatra yat ābhikṣāyāgasyaiva tadapi aṅgam iti kalpyate tatprakaraṇāt, tataśca yadyapi vākyenaiva ābhikṣāyāge viśve devā vidhīyante, tathāpi anyanirapekṣavihitātvāt ābhikṣāyāḥ prakaraṇāpekṣavākyavihitāt vājināt balīyastvaṃ bhavet iti viśeṣaḥ |
prakaraṇānapekṣayāgasaṃbandhe ca anyeṣāmiha apratīteḥ apūrvayāgaḥ saṃvandhī bhavati iti bhedaḥ |
na ca evamādīnāmanupāttapuruṣavyāpārāṇām ananumite yāge vākyānatarāpekṣā asti, ityuktamāmeyādiṣu (1|4|6|9) |
(rūḍhiyaugikatvalakṣaṇaṃ saptamaṃ prakāramāha -) ' viśve devāśca rūḍhayaiva saṃvadhyante payasayā |
' vājinaḥ iti hi avayavaprasiddhyā viśve devāḥ pratyāyyante |
vākyārthavacca avayavārthau samuccitya saṃvandhaṃ kalpayitvā sā bhavantī (avayava- prasiddheḥ ) śrutimātranipātalabhyāyāḥ samudāyaprasiddheḥ durbalā bhavati, iti durbalataraḥ saṃyogo vājinasya |
' devatātvaṃ nāma yasyaiva śabdenoktaṃ tasyaiva yogyasya ayogasya vā bhavati iti na jātinimittam, yenāyaṃ vājinaśabdo balāt anyatra nīyeta |
ataśca vājinaśabdaḥ ajñānāṃ devatātvaṃ vadan vinā kāryeṇa durbalā avayava- prasiddhyā viśvadeveṣu kalpyate iti viprakarṣaḥ |
' satya- pyavayavārthe ca vājinasyā'pi (vājinī anyā ) devatā |
sarve hi agnyādayaḥ puroḍāśādibhiranaiḥ vājino vijñāyante |
tatra ābhikṣāyāṃ tāvat annaśabdaḥ prayuktaḥ, na puroḍāśādau ityekaḥ kleśaḥ |
punarapi ca ābhikṣā- mātragrahaṇe sati vaiśvadevyā ābhikṣādyaiva taddtāṃ grahaṇam, ityaparaḥ |
tataśca sva rasena śrutiḥ anyatrāpi vartamānā satī prakaraṇena viśeṣe sthāpayitavyā na ca tatra kiñcinnimitta- masti, guṇabhāvenopādīyamānatvāt devatāyāḥ |
satkāryatve ca ' brīhīna prokṣati ' ityādiṣviva kathamapyapūrvasādhana- lakṣaṇayāṃ prākṛtagrahaṇaṃ bhavet, na cātra tadasti vinā'pi tena krameṇa : prayojanavaccopapatteḥ |
kāmaṃ vājinasyaiva pratipattiḥ saṃskāro bhavet, na devatāyāḥ |
atha viśva- deveṣu sarvaiḥ saṃgṛhītā bhaviṣyanti iti teṣāṃ grahaṇam, tadayuktam, sarvasaṃgrahasya apramāṇakatvāt |
na ca triṣu avadhāraṇajñānamiti cet, na |
sākāṅkṣa ca devatā dravyeṇa saṃvadhyeta sā cātra vājinaśabdena dravyavatī eva upādīyamānā nirā- kāṅkṣatayā pratyāyitā iti na dravyāntarasaṃvandhaṃ kṣamate |
kiñca ' śrutyaiva samavāyitvaṃ devatānāṃ svaka- rmasu |
' yadi hi vājināye'pi viśve devā eva devatātvena abhyupagamyante, tato'vaśyaṃ nigamasthāneṣu viśvadevaśrutireva uccāraṇīyā |
sā cātra vidhiṃśabde anuccāritatvāt aśakyā labdhum |
tatra evaṃ kleśena labhyeta, vāji- śabdaḥ kiñciddhatte vadati, so'pi rūpāmadhāyāt viśva- devaśabdaṃ lakṣayati, tato'sau vājinatayaiva ācāryā- māṇatvena vidhīyate iti kleśāḥ |
tatrāpi ca arthena śabdalakṣaṇayāmāviśeṣāt ' sarve devāḥ ' ' niḥśeṣā devāḥ ' ityādayaḥ sarve prāpnuvanti, iti viśva- devaśabdo durlabhaḥ |
na ca anyaśabdoccāraṇe teṣāṃ devatātvaṃ bhavati ' vidhiśabdasya mantratve bhāvaḥ ' (10|4|1|21 23) iti vakṣyati |
vājinaśabde eva atra puruṣaḥ śāstreṇa pravartitaḥ iti taduccāraṇenaiva vājinasya devatā saṃpādanīyā |
tataśca yadyapi viśvadevārtha eva iha vāji-
śabdena uccyamāno devatā bhavati, itaratra viśvadevaśabdena, tathāpi mahendranyāyena ( 2|1|5|13 ) viniyogabhedāt vispaṣṭaṃ devatāpṛthaktvam iti aparo'yaṃ dravyadevatāsaṃbandho vijñāyate |
na ca prāpte karmaṇi anekāryaguṇavidhānaṃ saṃbhavati |
bhāṣyam - atha yadupavarṇitaṃ yathā ' agnihotraṃ juhoti ' ityukte ' dadhnā juhoti ' ityevamādayo guṇa- vidhayaḥ iti, tatrocyate |
yuktaṃ yat tatra guṇavidhānam, na tatra aprakṛtena kena cit guṇena saṃgrahaḥ, prakṛtena tu asti yāgena |
śā - ' vājenābhikṣāyā yogād viśve devā hi vājinaḥ |
' tasmāt ubhayostulyatvalāt pūrvasminneva karmaṇi vikalpaḥ samuccayo vā |
iti prāpte, abhīyate ' ābhikṣāyā balīyastvamutpattau codanāt śruteḥ |
utpanne vājinaṃ vākyāt, tena tada durbalaṃ matam |
' tasmāt ābhikṣāśabde pūrvakarmaṇi asaṃniveśāt vājinaguṇāt karmabhedaḥ iti |
soma - saṃjñā'nantaraṃ saṃnihitāt karmaṇo medakatva- sāmānyāt guṇasyaiva vyutpādanaṃ yuktam iti saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu - apūrvasaṃyoge pūrvakarmaṇi niveśasaṃbhave guṇo'pi bhedakaḥ |
pūrvakarmaniveśabhāvāt ubhayorāpi vākyayoḥ samatvāt mitho'napekṣātvāt anuvādakatayā ekasya vākyasyetarapekṣayā pūrvakarmaniveśaḥ syāt na tviha iti bhāvaḥ |
vi - ' guṇaḥ karmāntaraṃ vā syād vājibhyo vājinaṃ siti |
bhāṭṭa - ' vaiśvadevyābhikṣā ' ityatra dravyadevatāviśiṣṭe yāge vihite tadanuvādena ' vājibhyo vājinam ' ityatra na guṇamātravidhiḥ |
na ca yājam annam ābhikṣārūpaṃ vidyate yeṣāmiti vyutpatyā viśvān devān tadviśiṣṭayāgaṃ vā uddiśya vājinamātrasya samuccayena vikalpena vā vidhi- rastviti vācyam |
etena ābhikṣā'nuniṣpannavājinasaṃbandhaprāptyā vājinapadam ābhikṣāyāganāmadheyamaṅgīkṛtya taduddeśena vājidevatāvidhirityāpattirastam |
kiñca, ābhikṣāyāḥ pārthiko devatāsaṃbandhaḥ; padaśrutyā, vājinasya tu vākyeneti daurbalyam |
taddhitasya hi devatātvaviśiṣṭe dravyaviśeṣe śaktiḥ; ābhikṣāpadaṃ ca tātparyagrāhakamiti prājñaḥ |
ābhikṣā''dau dravye devatātve ca bhinnā śaktiḥ, nirūpakatvaṃ tu saṃsargaḥ |
devatātve eva vā śaktiḥ, dravye lakṣaṇā |

'prakṛtipratyayau pratyayārthe saha brūtastayoḥ pratyayārthaḥ prādhānyena' iti smṛteḥ pratyayārthena bhāvanāyāḥ prādhānyāt phalavākyavihitaśuddhabhāvanā'nuvādena somādivākyaiḥ anā- hataparvāparyeḥ yugapat sarvadhātvarthavidhānāt na guṇanyāyo- 'sti |
'aindravāyavam' ityatra taddhitārthadravyabhedatvāt prakṛtyarthadevatābhedāt śabdāntaranyāyena guṇanyāyena vā suprasiddha eva |
nanu ekadhātvarthānuraktāyāṃ bhāvanāyāṃ dhātvantarārthānavakāśāt guṇanyāyenaiva bhāvanābhedasiddheḥ pūrvapakṣasaṃbhavāt bhāvanā- bhedābhedasaṃdeho na yuktaḥ ityāśaṅkya |
na ca 'daśabhiḥ krīṇāti' iti vacanameva niveśatātparya- grāhakam, tasya krayasamuccayaparatvenāpi upapattau guṇa- nyāyasiddhabhedāpavādakatvāyogyāt |
nanu jyotiṣṭomavākye'pi yāgānuraktabhāvanāpratīteḥ dhātvarthāntarānurāgāyogāt guṇanyāyātikramo nāsti ityāśaṅkya |
phalavākye svargoddeśena śuddhabhāvanāvidhīkāre tadanuvādena somādivākyairguṇa- viśiṣṭārthatve'bhyupagame sarvaiṣāṃmupaśliṣṭatvena guṇa- nyāyanavatarāt (pūrvapakṣe) |

phalavākye śuddhabhāvanāvidhāne avagate somādivākyasyatipratyayasya pratyekaṃ tāmnucya tatkaraṇatayā somādiviśiṣṭārthatvavidhānāpatteḥ, sarveṣāṃ cotpanna- śiṣṭatvena guṇanyāyābhāvāt bhedakapramāṇābhāvena bhāva- naikatvasiddhiḥ (pūrvapakṣe uktam) |
na caivaṃ ekatraiva grahaṇasya anekasaṃkhryakatvenopa- pattāvapi utpattiśiṣṭadevatā''varaṇe devatā''ntaraniveśa- nupapatteḥ guṇābhedopapattiriti vācyam |
grahaṇe devatāsaṃyogānaṃ adṛṣṭārthatvena ekakāryatve pramāṇābhāvena guṇanyāyāviṣayatvāt |

guṇādhikaraṇe "nanu yathā 'vājibhyo vājinam' ityatra svavākyagatena vājiṃśabdena āmiṣākhyāṃ lakṣayitvā vidhīyamānasya vājinasya prakaraṇāpekṣā'bhāvāt tannimittadvailyābhāvena utpattiśiṣṭābhikṣā''varuddhasyāpi yāgasya vidhīyamānadravyā- ntarākāṅkṣāvaśena 'ākāṅkṣotthāpanāt tasminneva yāge vājinasya niveśopapattiḥ" iti pūrvapakṣayiṣyate |
guṇādhikaraṇe hi utpannaśiṣṭo guṇaḥ utpattiśiṣṭavatpade yāge vājinasyopaniveśalamānaḥ karma bhinatti iti vakṣyate |

nanu utpatti- śiṣṭābhikṣāvacchede yāge vājinasyotpannaśiṣṭasya vidhānā- yogena bhedakatvaṃ guṇādhikaraṇe vakṣyate (iti cenna) 'vaiśvadevyābhikṣā vājibhyo vājinam' iti taddhita- caturthīkṛtaṃ balāvalaṃ tatra vakṣyate, notpannatyupaśiṣṭakṛta- miti |
pūrvakarmaṇi vidheyatvālmā- dapi 'guṇāśrayapūrvasaṃyoge' iti guṇādhikaraṇanyāyena yāgāntaravidhiparameva paryagnikṛtavākyam (paryagnikṛtaṃ pātanīvatamutsṛjanti), iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
guṇādhikaraṇapūrvapakṣe vājam āmiṣākhyamannaṃ yeṣāṃ viśeṣāṃ devānāṃ te vājinaḥ; viśve devāḥ! tebhyo vājinam ityāṅgīkāreṇaiva utpattiśiṣṭaprābalyaśaṅkā nirastā |
siddhānte ca vājinaśabdasya rūḍhatvopapādanena pratyabhijñāpakā- bhāva evopapannasya |
viśve devāḥ pratīyante, tacca karmaha vājinam' iti (vā) |
ke. na ca guṇādhikaraṇa- pūrvapakṣanyāyena utpannaśiṣṭasyāpi devatā''ntarasya vidhāno- papattiriti vācyam |
ke. guṇapadārthaḥ anekadravyāśritaḥ yathā saṃyogaviyoga- ditvādisaṃkhyātmakaḥ anekadravyāśritaḥ, rūpādiḥ eka-
guṇapratinidhi- niyamavidhirarthā- 'yadi kṛṣṇārvārna na vindeta atho lohitasāraṅgaḥ syāt' iti śatapathe |
'dadhnā juhoti' ityevamādīni karmāṇi vikalpaparijihī- rṣayā avakalpyante |
tadeva tu karma 'juhoti' iti śabdavadagamyate, na karmāntaram |
vā- aguṇe tu karmaśabde iti pratyudāharaṇasūtram |
tasmin guṇavidhiḥ śakya iti karma na bhidyate |
' soma-- ekaikasādvāt ekaikasya guṇasyopasthityā sarveṣāṃ yugapatpadyamānatvāt yasya prathamamanyaḥ; tadavacchede pūrvanyāyena anyānyāsaṃbhavāt karmāntaratvam ityuthānāt saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu- (pūrvādhikaraṇa- pratyudāharaṇasūtrapakṣe) 'agnihotraṃ juhoti' iti guṇa- rahite karmaṇi utpannaṃ dadhyādivākyaiḥ guṇavidhiḥ saṃbhavati, na tu saguṇaśrutābhikṣāvākye iti |
ādhārāgnihotrādhikaraṇe guṇakarmasaṃnidhau saguṇaśrutiḥ guṇavidhānārthā ityuktvāt idamadhikaraṇamarthavat |
na ca yatra nirguṇasaṃnidhau ekameva saguṇavākyam, tatra ādhārā- gnihotrādhikaraṇoktiḥ sāvakāśā |
prakṛte tu saguṇa- vākyānāṃ bahutvāt sarveṣāmekakarmaṇye vikalpāpattyā karmāntaratvaśaṅkāṃ tannirākaraṇārthatvāt na vaiyarthamiti vācyam |
nirguṇasaṃnidhau śrutānāṃ bahūnāmapi saguṇa- vākyānāṃ guṇāmātravidhāyakatvasya tatraiva vaktavyatvāt, anyathā ādhārāgnihotravākyayoḥ samudāyānuvādapūrva- pakṣasya nirākartumaśakyatvāt |
' bhāṭṭa-- yatra tu notpattau guṇaśravaṇaṃ yathā 'abhi- hotraṃ juhoti' iti, tatra tadanuvādena 'dadhnā juhoti' 'payasā juhoti' ityādibhiḥ sarvaireva guṇavidhānaṃ vikalpena |
(guṇapradhānayoḥ vidhyanuvādayoḥ uddeśyopādeyośca ekatra na saṃbhavaḥ ityarthaḥ) |
maṇi. pṛ. 7. guṇaphalasaṃbandhaparaḥ kāmyaḥ puruṣārthādhikāravidhiḥ 'dadhnendriyakāmasya juhuyāt' iti |
yaśca yasya nirvaryamānasyopakaroti, sa tasya guṇabhūtaḥ |
yasmiṃśca āśrīyamāṇe padārthaḥ eva na saṃpadyate, sa sa guṇabhūtaḥ |
bhā 5|1|2|2, yaḥ svabhā- vato guṇabhūto'rthaḥ nāsau ākhyātaśabdābhidhānena pradhāna- bhūto bhavati |
nahi yadekatra guṇabhūtaṃ dṛṣṭam, tenāpyatra prādhānyaṃ vācikamapi na pratipattavyam iti kiñcit pramāṇam |
guṇabhūte- 'pi dvitīyā bhavati yathā 'saktūn juhoti' - 'māṣaṃ juhoti' 'ekakapālaṃ juhoti' iti |
bhā. 2|4|1|11, guṇabhūtā devatā karmaṇi yājyānuvākyādyena karma- siddhadharthapalakṣyate |
guṇabhūtadevatā- vidhiḥ mantraḥ 'samidho'ma ājyasya vyantu' iti |
bāla. pṛ. 63, guṇabhūtadravyavidhiḥ mantraḥ 'praitu hotṛṣamastaḥ pra brahmaṇaḥ, prodgātṛṇāṃ pra yajamānasya' iti |
su. pṛ. 809. guṇamātrāvidhau lāghavam, guṇaviśiṣṭājñavidhau tu gauravam |
tāni uccairnīyāni, sāmavedagatatvāt sāmnām, sāmavedasvaraśca 'uccaiḥ sāmnā' iti uccaistvāt |
iti pūrvapakṣe utsūtre prāpte siddhāntamāha - guṇaḥ, mukhyaṃ pradhānaṃ tayoḥ vidhāyakavedaprayukte vyatikrame sati mukhyena pradhānānusāraṇa vedasaṃyogaḥ |
ādhānārthe vāravantīyādisāmi anuṣṭheyaḥ iti bhāṣyānusārī panthāḥ |
vārtikānusārī tu guṇaḥ utpattividhiḥ, mukhyaḥ viniyogavidhiḥ |
tayorvyatikrame vāravantīyā-disāmnaḥ sāmavede pāṭhāt utpattividhiḥ; yajurvede tu 'vāravantīyaṃ gāyati' ityādiḥ viniyogavidhiḥ |
tasmāt mukhyena viniyogavedānusāreṇa vedasaṃyogaḥ vedaniścayana-svarasaṃyogaḥ svīkāryaḥ |

aṅgapradhānayoḥ bhinnavedavihitarūpe vyatikrame, aṅge svarūpanivandhanadharmāvarodhena pradhānasvara-prāptasya dharmasya bādhalakṣaṇaḥ atikramaṇaḥ kāryaḥ; pradhānadvāradharmānurodhena vā svarūpanibandhanasya iti saṃdehaḥ pradhānadvāraguṇārthatvāt aṅgapradhānuṣṭhānasya pradhānadvāradharmā-nurodhena svarūpanivandhanadharmavyatikramasya nyāyatvāt pradhānadvāraḥ prayogavedasaṃyogaḥ kriyate ityevaṃ sūtravyākhyā |
su. pṛ. 1107. guṇamukhyavyatikrame ityatra vyākhyātaṃ yathā aṅgāni pradhānavedavyapadeśaṃ labhante iti |
tatra sāmagāmānamanti 'ya evaṃ vidvān vāravantīyaṃ gāyati' 'ya evaṃ vidvān yajñāyajñīyaṃ gāyati' 'ya evaṃ vidvān vāmadevaṃ gāyati' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kimādhāne sāmagānamuccaiḥ, uta upāṃśu iti |
kutaḥ ? sāmavedena etat kriyate yat vāravantīyādi |
guṇānurodhena vā mukhyaṃ vyatikrameta mukhyānurodhena vā guṇam iti guṇo vyatikramitavyo nyāyyaḥ, mukhyānugrahetyarthaḥ |
guṇasyānuṣṭhāne mukhyaḥ saguṇaḥ kathaṃ syāt iti guṇe pravartate |
guṇapravṛttyā cenmu-khyasya guṇahānirbhavati guṇapravṛttau phalameva nāvāsaṃ bhavati |
atha pradhānaṃ saguṇaṃ kariṣyāmi iti guṇe pravartamāno guṇasya guṇaṃ vinipātayati nāsya svārtho hīyate |
guṇaśca sāmagānam, pradhāna-sa guṇadharmamuccaistvaṃ sāmavedikaṃ bādhate |

vā-- idānīṃ yatra vedāntarīyasya pradhānasya vedānta-rīyamaṅgaṃ bhavati, tatra aṅgasya vedadharmaḥ katamaḥ kartavyaḥ iti saṃdehaḥ, prāpyātmakatvāt vyapadeśadharmāṇām, yasya yatra samāmnānam, tadīya dharmaḥ syāt |
yatra syāt tatra vijñeyaṃ guṇadharmasya bādha-nam' |
yadi tu ātmīyadharmānurodhena pradhānaṃ viguṇaṃ kuryāt, tato'sya yadyaivaṃ pravṛttiḥ, tadeva hīyeta |
tatsvarūpe saguṇe jāte yadyapi aṅgaṃ viguṇameva, tathāpi tatra guṇatvasya akiñcitkaritvāt na kaściddoṣaḥ |
nanu yāvanmātrādhānasya yajurvedavihitaṃ tanmātrasyaiva upāṃśutvamiyamagāt naiva sāmagānasya prāpnoti |
pradhānamātraṃ ca ajñānāntarāṇi ca yājurvedikāni, tena teṣāṃ kevalamupāṃśutvamiti |
vakṣyati hi 'aṅgāni tu vidhānatvāt pradhānenopadiṣṭayante' iti (11|1|2|16) |
tasmāt pradhānaprayogavacana-parigṛhītatvāt anyatrāpi utsannānāmaṅgānāṃ yatra pradhānam, tatraiva vidhiḥ |
evaṃ tarhi svayameva ajñānāṃ yājurvedikatvāt upāṃśutvaṃ na guṇapradhānadharmavirodhadvāram |
yacca sāmagānamupāṃśutvam, tat aṅgavartitvāt uccai-svena tulyam |
naitat tatra vartamānaṃ pradhānasyeti śakyaṃ vaditum |
nahi tadā pradhānamupāṃśu na kṛtaṃ syāt |
pūrveṇaiva sarvavyāpinā upāṃśuvidhinā prāptatvāt dīkṣaṇī- yā''disattvapraśaṃsārthaiḥ nityānuvāda eva |
abhīṣomīye tu savanavibhāgasareṇaiva 'mandrā ājyabhāgāntam' ityādi- prākṛtasvarapratiprasavaḥ |
savanavibhāgastulyaṃ vā sāṅgaṃ prayogaṃ tredhā vibhajya mandramadhyamoccoccāraṇasaṃpādanaṃ kāryam |
satyākālasavanīyādīnāmapi evaṃ svare prāpte, prātaḥsavananāntargatatvāt yathāsavanameva svarā bhavanti |
nanu savanaśabdānāṃ somayāgāvayavavacanatvāt dīkṣaṇīyā''dyaṅgavat tadadhīyasvaratvātprāptiḥ iti cet, na |
vāravantīyasyāpi yajurvede ‘vāravantīyaṃ gāyati’ iti viniyogavidheḥ āmnānāt |
ataḥ evaṃ cintanīyam, yatra vedāntare utpattiḥ vedāntare ca viniyogaḥ, tatra vāravantīyādau kaḥ svaraḥ iti cintāyām, utpatteḥ pūrvabhāvitvāt asaṃjātaviroṣi- tvena tannibandhana eva svaro balīyān |
ataśca ṛcā ṛgvedena kriyate upāyātte iti (uccairṛcā kriyate iti-) śrūyate |

iti prāpte, āmnānānmātraṃ mantrasya prayojanāvagamane prayojyatvānavagateḥ svarānapekṣatvāt viniyogottarakālameva svarasaṃbandhāt, ‘kriyate’ ityasya prayujyate ityarthāgateḥ, prayogasya ca viniyogādhīnatvena viniyogasyaiva avyahitapūrvapuraḥsphūrtikatvāt |
tasmāt viniyoganibandhana eva svaraḥ asati bādhake anuṣṭheyaḥ ityāha |

’ ṛgvedādisamākhyānāmapi pradhānadvārā adheṣva- pravṛtteḥ guṇamukhyavyatikramaṇayāyaḥ (3|1|2|9) nirviṣayaḥ syāt ityāśaṅkya tāsāṃ pradhānaṣvapi vini- yojakatvāvirodhāt prayogavācikriyeteśabdavyapadeśācca uccaistvadīnāṃ prayogavedadharmatvāvagatervaiṣamyamāha |
su. 3|7 pṛ. 51. mandrādisavarakāṇām sarveṣāṃ jyotiṣṭomājñānāmapi guṇamukhyavyatikramanyāyena pratisaṃvaṃ sāṅge prayoge bhedā vibhajya ... |

su. 1|179. vedadvayavihiteṣu aṅgeṣu nānāvedasvare prāpte guṇamukhya- vyatikramanyāyena yājurvedikapradhānadharmaḥ upāṃśutvaṃ prāpnoti, tato vācanikaḥ svaraḥ bhavati ‘mandrā ādyabhāgāt’, paraṃ madhyamayā, uttamayā anujyādi iti |
vā. 3|1|2|9 pṛ. 811. guṇamukhyavyatikramanyāyāt pradhānadvarai apūrvaṃ'ṅge tadedasvaratvābhopapatteḥ |
su. pṛ. 1181. guṇamukhyavyatikramanyāyasya svarūpam ‘guṇena hi mukhye'nusartavyaḥ’ iti |
‘pradhānaśabdā- guṇyārthatvāt aṅgadharmā'nuṣṭhānasya pradhānadharmā'nuparodhena svarūpaniścayadharmasya vyatikramaḥ kāryaḥ’ iti |
yatha syāt tatra vijñeyaṃ guṇadharmasya bādhanam ||
su. pṛ. 1184. guṇamukhyādhikaraṇena ( tassiddhayadhikaraṇasya ) gatārthatvaṃ nirastam |
gauṇavṛtti- saṃbhavamātrasya tatra ( guṇamukhyādhikaraṇe ) pratipāditatve'pi lakṣaṇayā'gauṇatvasyoktatvena tadanādaratvāt |

ke. arthavādaguṇasya yathāśrutatvasya vidhisadāguṇyartha- tvābhāve'pi arthavādasya vidhisadāguṇyarthatvasadbhāvāt 'guṇalope ca mukhyasya kriyā syāt' ityanena nyāyena nirvāpeṇābhirohaṇakṛtavidhyādyatha vidhinā arthavādādbhāva- gamāt pūrvaparoccāraṇakṛtaviśeṣayogāmāśaṅkaya arthāva- dhāraṇāt prāk vidhyarthadāvayogo'pradhānatvānnagateḥ guṇa- lopanyāyāviṣayatvam |
paurṇamāsyāṃ yathāśaktiprayoge prasrārābhāve'pi guṇalope cetanyāyena śākhāpraharaṇam |

bhāṭṭa. 6|1|13, yatra tu (pati- patnyoḥ ) anyatararoganivṛttyarthameva darśanādiprayogaḥ, tatra itarasya patnītvābhāve'pi 'guṇalope ca' iti nyāyena parikriyādyāpattetarakartṛkajyāvekṣye'pi na sarvatra tathā kalpanāyāṃ pramāṇamasti |
6|1|4, somābhāve somamāna- susadṛśam, pūtīkatvāvacchinnasaṃrgatya somāvayavatvena 'guṇalope ca' iti nyāyena bahuratasomāvayavānāmeva anugrāhyatvāt |
6|1|13 yadi yajamānasya bhraṣṭāvasaraṃ kriyāyāṃ viguṇaṃ bhavatīti, tadapi 'guṇalope ca mukhyasya' ityanena viruddham |
vā. 3|5|18|46 yadā niyoja- nādikāryārthāprayogaḥ mukhyaḥ, tatkṣaṇādā sakalakāryayogasya pratinidhiḥ, tadā mukhyasyaivopādānam, saṃskārāṇāṃ tu 'guṇalope ca mukhyasya' iti nyāyena lope'pi na doṣaḥ |

bhāṭṭa. 6|1|19, loke pūrvaṃ kiñcidvadavatāṃ yavānāṃ bharjanottaraṃ punaradhate kṛte eva dhānātvaprasiddheḥ prayojanā- nurodhena prākṛtakramaṃ bādhitvā'pi 'guṇalope ca mukhyasya' iti nyāyena bharjanottaramapi prākṛtaḥ sadharmako'vaghātaḥ kartavya eva |
yūpacchedādikaṃ tu 'guṇalope- 'pi mukhyasya kriyā syāt' iti nyāyāt kāryameva |

1|1|31, madhye bharjitavattaṇḍulānāṃ piṣṭe eva saktutvaprasiddheḥ bharjanottarameva peṣaṇam, prākṛtakramabādhe- 'pi haviḥsaṃpattyarthaṃ peṣaṇasya guṇalopādhikaraṇanyāyenaiva bharjanottaraṃ karaṇopapattiḥ |
10|2|133 guṇavacanaḥ kaścit saṃsṛṣṭaguṇavacano bhavati dravyeṇa yathā śuklaḥ paṭa iti |
kaścit niṣkṛṣṭaguṇavacanaḥ yathā śauklyaṃ paṭasya iti |
dup. 9|4|112 guṇa- vacanaḥ śabdaḥ stutinirvartanāyau dṛṣṭamaye kariṣyati |
bhā. 2|1|124, nahi kevalaguṇavacanaḥ śabdaḥ śaknoti dravyamabhidhātum |
3|1|612 pṛ. 686. ye'pi tāvat svapradhānaguṇavacanāḥ te'pi kathayituṃ liṅga- saṃkhyābhyāṃ yujyante, kiṃ punarye dravyaprādhānyam |
vā. 3|1|612 pṛ. 685. guṇavacanasyāpi strīliṅgatā bhavati yathā karuṇā buddhiḥ |
bhā. 2|1|122. guṇavacanānāmāśrayato liṅga- vacane iti, kiṃ tarhi guṇamuktvā yo dravye vartate |
vā. 3|1|612 pṛ. 682. guṇavacanānāmāśrayato liṅga- vacanāni bhavanti, na dravyavacanānām āśritaguṇavacanena yathā 'viśve devā devatā' iti |
bhā. 10|3|14|57, guṇavacanānāṃ śabdānāmāśrayato liṅgavacanāni bhavanti aviśeṣyamāṇānām api vyaktau yadavaśyaṃ prāptaṃ liṅgam tadāśrayabhūtaṃ guṇasya bhavati |
yathā śuklaḥ pumān, śuklā strī, śuklaṃ napuṃsakam |
śukla ekaḥ, śuklo dvau, śuklā bahavaḥ iti |

9|1| 10|133 pṛ. 1675. guṇavacanānām ityādī āśraya- liṅgaliṅgasaṃkhyāvāci padaprayogajībhūtaguṇavacanaśabdārthastu svaśakyārthaviśeṣakatvaviśeṣyakatvalakṣaṇārthānvayayogi yatkara- tathā vyaktyanvayavyayaikaṃ padam, tadrūpaḥ |
atra yogyānta- mātravivakṣayām 'ajāyāḥ śuklaḥ' ityādāvapi ṭātrādyā- pattiḥ, tasya tadā lakṣakatvābhāve'pi araṇyakhaṇḍavat yogyatvasya sattvāt |
ata eva tatra āśrayagataliṅgābhāve 'guṇe śuklādayaḥ puṃsi' (amaraḥ 1|6|17) ityanuśāsanena puṃsiṅgemeva sādhutvārthaṃ niyamyate |

mahābhāṣye 'viśeṣaṇānāṃ jātāteḥ' (pā0 1|2|52) iti sūtraṃ yathāśrutaṃ pratyākhyāya viśeṣaṇaśabdasya guṇātvābhiprāyeṇa 'guṇavacanānām (śabdānām) āśrayatau liṅgavacanāni bhavanti' itye- tadarthakatā vyākhyātatvāt (triḥprathamāmānave iti) āśrayato liṅgamupapannam |

yadyapi śābdikaiḥ guṇaviśiṣṭā- bhidhānadaśāyāmeva āśrayato liṅgavacanaprāptirvyahiyate, na tu kevalaguṇābhidhānadaśāyām, tathāpi guṇaśabdānāṃ viśeṣaṇaśabdatvāt guṇaviśiṣṭadravyābhidhāne vacanena vinā- 'pi viśeṣyabhūtārthavācakaśabdāntarasāmānyādhikaraṇyena liṅgavacanaprāptisaṃbhavāt idaṃ sūtraṃ vākyasaṃskārakatve anu- vādakaṃ syāt |
tasmādasya sūtrasya vidhāyakatvasiddhayarthaṃ kevalaguṇābhidhānadaśāyāmapi viśeṣyabhūtāt āśrayato liṅgavacane bhavataḥ ityatrāpi tātparyaṃ vaktavyam |
yadā tu vākyasaṃskāraḥ tadā ayamanuvāda eva |
āśrayaviśeṣasya pūrvameva krame viśeṣaṇānāpi tanniṣṭha- tvāt tadvyatoliṅgasaṃkhyayoḥ siddhatvāt iti) |
bṛhatī. pṛ. 124. guṇa- vacanaśabdaśca dravyavācye vartate vaiyākaraṇānāṃ guṇa- muktaguṇi vartamānātvāt |
nahi vaiyākaraṇānāṃ vaiśe- pikavat guṇāḥ parisaṃkhyāyante |
su. pṛ. 1487. guṇavādaḥ arthavādaḥ pramāṇāntareṇa virodhe sati, ' virodhe guṇavādaḥ syāt' |
bāla. pṛ. 48. guṇavādā hi pramāṇāntarapratipattibalena upajāyante |
bṛhatī. pṛ. 101. guṇavādasya phalaṃ anyatra praśaṃsā |
atra tu guṇa- sārūpādivat pravṛttinimittam (apaśavo vā anye ityādau) |
vā. 3|1|61223-4. guṇavādasūtreṇa arthavādādhikaraṇe (1|2|16-18) 'āpo vā śāntāḥ' iti abhijanastutidāreṇa ava- kānāmeva stutiḥ iti vicistulyā vaiyadhikaraṇyaparihārāt |
parā. 44|2. guṇavādasūtre (guṇavādasūtre 1|2|1 10) tatsiddhisūtrasiddhāyāḥ gauṇyā vṛtteḥ stutyupayoga- mātrakathanāt na paunaruktyam |
kau. 1|4|13|3 pṛ. 269. guṇavidhānaṃ vākyāntarasthena vidhiśabdenāpi bhavati 'indrāya rājñe sukaraḥ' iti yathā |
vi. 2|116. guṇavidhiḥ arthavādaḥ 'sṛṣṭīrupadadhāti' 'yatsṛ- daśekadhā upadadhāti' iti sṛṣṭyadhikaraṇe someśvaraḥ |
bāla. pṛ. 54. guṇavidhistu na gṛhyāt samatvāt |
jyotiṣṭome ātithyeṣṭau 'vaiṣṇavo navakapālo bhavati' iti śrutam |
rājasūye pūrvasmin trisaṃyukte 'vaiṣṇava- trikapālaḥ' iti śrutam |
tatra trisaṃyuktavaiṣṇavaśabdaḥ ātithyāgatavaiṣṇavadharmāṇāṃ grāhakaṃ na veti vicāre siddhāntāmāha |
guṇavidhiḥ rājasūyagatapūrvatrisaṃyuktagatavaiṣṇava- śabdaḥ guṇaṃ viṣṇudevatāsaṃyogaṃ vidadhāti |
sa ātithyā- gatavaiṣṇavadharmān na gṛhyāt samatvāt |
ke. guṇavidhiḥ na āgneya-aindra-vaiśvadevaśabdāḥ, kintu brāhmaṇādistutyarthāḥ : 'āgneyo vai brāhmaṇaḥ, aindro rājanyaḥ, vaiśyo vaiśvadevaḥ' iti |
guṇavidhiḥ mantraḥ 'dadhnaḥ stuṇīta haviḥ suparṇaiḥ' iti |
bāla. pṛ. 64. yatra tasminneva guṇe guṇamuccārya guṇe vidhīyate, tatra bhavati guṇavidhiḥ, yathā 'dadhnā juhoti', 'śaramayaṃ bārhaspatī' iti |
vā. 7|3|822 pṛ. 1558, brīhādayo hi atyantaruḍhāḥ, te svārthamaparityajyantaḥ : sāmānyādhikaraṇya-
1|4|12 pṛ. 325. guṇavidhinā viśiṣṭavidhiḥ bādhyate dadhnā juhotītyādau|
bāla pṛ. 140, guṇavidhitvaṃ nāmadheyatvena bādhyate tatrakhyādiṣu|
pṛ. 145, guṇavidhitvena nāmadheyatvaṃ bādhyate nirūḍhepu somādiṣu|
pṛ. 145. guṇavidhināmadheya- tvayoḥ saṃśaye udbhidādiśabde yāgapadena sāmānyādhikaraṇyaṃ nāmadheyatvanirṇāyakam|
vi. 1|4|2. guṇavidhirūpaḥ arthavādaḥ 'yadadhakāpālo bhavati gāyatryaivenaṃ brahmavarcasena punāti'|
bāla pṛ. 54, guṇavidhirūpaḥ mantraḥ 'ṣaḍviṃśatirasya vaṅkrayaḥ' iti|
su. pṛ. 767. guṇaviṣakaḥ pratinidhi- pratipattiriktaviniyamavidhiḥ pratyakṣavākye 'aruṇā' iti|
bāla pṛ. 24, guṇaviṣakaḥ smṛtyādikalpyaḥ pratiṣedho yathā śrāddhe 'kaṅkāni ca sarvāṇi virasāni tathaiva ca|
ete ca tatsiddhisūtrautaiḥ saha nava gauṇapakṣā draṣṭavyāḥ|
(1) jahatsvārthābhidhāyitvam- svārthaṃ jahāti iti jaha- nmidhāvitvaṃ guṇarūpādhyādisyārthatyāgena guṇarūpe paiṅgalyādau vṛttiḥ gauṇatve kāraṇam|
agnyādi- jāti-paiṅgalyādiguṇasaṃghātaḥ anyadiāśabdāvyaḥ san jātirahitaguṇamātre śabdapravṛttihetutvāt gauṇatvakāraṇam|
agnyādiśabdāvasya aśi- tyādeḥ māṇavakādau agnyādiguṇaśabdena kalpanā gauṇatva- kāraṇam|
māṇavakādyupapada- sahāyasya agnyādiśabdasya paiṅgalyādau ajñākhya- guṇabhūtaupadānadhīnatvāt gauṇatvakāraṇam|

agnimāṇavakaḥ ityādi śabdasya ava- yavārthenapaiṅgalyādiguṇarūpeṇa paiṅgalyādau yā prasiddhiḥ, tasyāḥ bhāvaḥ samudāyāvayavabhūtasya agnyādiśabdasya paiṅga- lyādau samudāyāvayavabhūtatvākhyaguṇavat pravṛttahetutvāt gauṇatvakāraṇam|
paiṅgalyādeḥ agni- māṇavakaḥ ityādivākyārthatvamagnyādiśabdasya paiṅgalyādau vākyāvayavatvasyāsyaguṇavatvāt gauṇatvakāraṇam|
agnyādiśabdasya paiṅgalyādau alpa- śrautaprasiddhatvam ajñākhyaguṇabhūtaupadāpekṣatvapratinimi- ttāt gauṇatvakāraṇam|
yasmin paiṅgalyādau agnyādiśabdasya alpairvaktumiḥ prayogaḥ sa alpaprayogī, tasya bhāvaḥ alpaprayogitā alpaprasiddhatvam gauṇatvakāraṇam|

etān gauṇatvakāraṇa- pakṣān nirasya (bhāṣye) agnyādiśabdāvaccena agni- tvādinā agnyādiguṇasya paiṅgalyādeḥ lakṣaṇā māṇavakādau agnyādiguṇavati abhiśabdapravṛttihetutvāt gauṇaśabda- vācyarūpagauṇatvakāraṇatvena sādhitā|
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ nirvāpamantre 'agnaye juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi' iti paṭhyate|
so'yamagniśabdaḥ vikṛtī nodyate so'pi na karmasamavetavacanaḥ, uta uhitavyaḥ karmasamavetavacano- 'sau, iti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha|
so'yaṃ guṇaśabdaḥ tathā saciādiśabdavat karmasamaveta- vacanaḥ iti vikṛtau nohitavyaḥ|
tathāhi, 'agnaye juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi' ityanena juṣṭasya nirvāpa ucyate|
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ 'dhānyamasi dhinuhi devān iti iṣṭaddhi taṇḍulānāpati' iti śrūyate|
tatra dhānyaśabdaḥ samavetavacano na veti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha|
guṇavacanaḥ dhānyaśabdaḥ atra abhipretaḥ devaprīṇe guṇatvāt|
so'yaṃ guṇaśabdo dhānyaśabdaḥ, tathā na samavetavacanaḥ iti
na taṇḍuleṣu nistuṣeṣu iti asamavetavacanatvaṃ bodhyam|
darśapūrṇamāsayornirvāpamantre 'agnaye juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi' ityatra agniśabdaḥ na asamavetavacanaḥ, samavāyāta|
karmaṇā vidhivahitasyāmeḥ samavāyāta saṃbandhāt saṃbaddha- tvāt|
na ca etena vākyena juṣṭasya nirvāpa ucyate|
abhiruciśca dāsyamānapuroḍāśa- prakṛtidravye nirvāpāt prāgapi agnerasti iti bhūtārthaka- ṛpratyayasya nānupapattiḥ|
ataḥ agniśabdaḥ samavetavacanaḥ auryādivikṛtau uhitavya iti siddhāntaḥ|
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ 'dhānyamasi dhinuhi devān iti iṣṭaddhi taṇḍulānāpati' iti dhānya- śabdo na samavetavacanaḥ vikṛtau nohitavya iti yaduktaṃ tanna|
yathā kodrakeṣu 'śālyo bhujyante' iti satuṣā na bhujyante|
ke. guṇādhikaraṇatvāt; guṇaśeṣādhikaraṇaṃ guṇapratya- dāharaṇādhikaraṇaṃ guṇavirodhanyāyaḥ iti vā, 'aguṇe tu karmaśabde guṇastatra pratīyate' (2|1|10|24) iti sūtram|
su. pṛ. 702. guṇānurodhena padārthaḥ na na kartavyo bhavati|
guṇānurodhena pradhānaparityāgo na yuktaḥ' iti dravyasaṃskāravirodhadhikaraṇanyāyaḥ|
na ca kriyāmātraṃ niṣkṛṣya guṇāntaraṃ vidhātuṃ śakyate ityuktaṃ vaiśvadevādhikaraṇe|
vā. 2|1|123 pṛ. 537, guṇāntarojajananena yajña- mānasya phalagrahaṇayogyatā bhavati|

avaghāte haviṣkṛ- tpanīgatahaviḥsaṃpattihetutvalakṣaṇaguṇayogasaṃbhave'pi āhvā- nāmantraṇavibhaktipaiṣavidhavatlakṣaṇabhāvāt haviṣkṛtpa- dakasya gauṇatāsamarthyasaṃbhave'pi saṃbuddhyākhyānapadayoḥ gauṇasyāpi sāmarthyasya asaṃbhavāt sakalamantraviṣayatvācca vacanasya sakalamantrasamarthya vinā viniyojakatvāśakteḥ mantraviniyogaḥ na saṃbhavati iti sūtrārthaḥ|
haviṣkṛtpāti- padakasya avaghātaprakāśanāsāmarthye'pi ehi ityasya tadeka- vākyatvādāpatteḥ patyāhānāmajñātpakṣe ca 'liṅgavācyoḥ dvayopi anugrahasaṃbhave vākyavādhāpatteḥ|
ekasya pakṣasya anabhyupagamanīyatvāt liṅgenāpi avaghātājñatā na yuktā iti vā sūtrārthaḥ|

jyotiṣṭome makṣānuvāke 'mandrābhibhūtiḥ keturyajñānāṃ vāgū juṣāṇā somasya tṛpyatu, vasubhadracchadasaḥ agniṣṭa matividaḥ; prātaḥsavanasya gāyatracchadasaḥ agniṣṭa indrapītasya madhumata upahūtasyopahūtau makṣagrāmi (taisaṃ. 3|2|12-) iti śrūyate|
tatra 'tṛpyatu' ityanta eko mantraḥ vasubhadracchadasa ityādiḥ 'bhakṣayāmi' ityantaḥ aparaḥ|
tasmāt svārthya bhedena prayoktavyau iti pūrvapakṣe prāpte siddhānta- māha|
guṇābhidhānāt guṇasya vaktṛptirūpasya viśeṣaṇasya prāpte- syasya vā tṛpyatuityantena bhakṣyatvevākyatvā''pattena abhidhānāt|
tayoḥ tṛpyatu, bhakṣayāmi ityantayorvākyayoḥ ekārthayogāt viśiṣṭārthasyopapatteḥ|
mantrādiḥ makṣyāyamantraḥ eko mantraḥ, na dvau|

soma- bhakṣaṇasya ānuṣaṅgikabhakṣaṇayitusaṃskārārthakalpane'pi bhakṣyitusaṃskārasya svargavat phalatvābhāvena utsāhanārthaṃ prakāśanārhatvāt, tatryathaiva tatphalaśrutyarthatve'bhāvāt, tataśca 'ahaṃ bhakṣayati' iti yāvatśrutiniṣedhena anā- śaṅkanīyatayā anuṣṭheyatvāt prakāśanārhatvānupapatteḥ; abhidhānasāmarthyāllakṣaṇasya ānarthakyāpattyā viniyojakatvāt, tadavirodhinā ekavākyatāpagamanasāma- rthyānkena liṅgena mantrādibhakṣaṇe viniyogāt, tṛpyatvanta- vasubhadraṇayoḥ mantrabhāgayoḥ ekasminphalakamakṣārtha- saṃyogāt tarpyatebhakṣaṇaguṇatvena tṛpyamirbhānādavagamāt mantrādiḥ eka eva mantraḥ iti sūtrārthaḥ|
guṇasamudāya eva pṛthivyādi dravyam, nāti- riktam iti cit |
pṛthivyādau pākādinā pūrva- rūpanāśasya uttarapatteśca anubhavasiddhatvāt |
'vāyavyaṃ śvetamālameta' atra śvetaḥ aja eva codaka- prāptaḥ, na tu yaḥ kaścit śvetaḥ paśuḥ |
guṇyamānaṃ na dṛśyate iti pratyakṣaṃ caitat (guṇya- mānaṃ punaḥpunarāvartamānam) |
bhā. 12|4|48. gudānāṃ upayājasādhanānāṃ paśugaṇe samucayaḥ upayājagudasamucaya- nyāyaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ |
bhā. 1|3|11-2. gurungamantavyo''mivādyati- tavyaśca iti sārtaniyame upanītasyādhikāraḥ, nānupa- nītasya |
asya dṛṣṭaprayojanatve'pi vihitatvena nyāyāpūrvajana- tvāt nimittatvācca naimittikāvṛttiḥ kartavyā, na tu icchyā sakṛtsakṛdvā anugamanādikam |
maṇi. pṛ. 18. guroḥ anugamāt prīto gururvyāpayiṣyati |

bhā. 1|3|12 pṛ. 165. gurungu- gamanādeḥ niṣpannavidyairapi anuṣṭhīyamānasya dṛṣṭārthatvā- yogāt avaśyakartavyatā''nyathā'nupapatteḥ akaraṇanimitta- pratyayaparihāryātvāsāyāt, tasya ca ananyapramāṇatvāt veda mūlatvasiddhiḥ |
su. pṛ. 126. gurungamanādeḥ naimittakatvāt akriyāyāṃ pratyayāyaḥ, karaṇe ca na bhavati |
dṛṣṭaṃ ca prīto gururdhyāpayiṣyati ityevamādi niṣpadyate |
gurungamanādīnāṃ nimittāvṛttau āvṛttiḥ !! ācārād gṛhamāṇeṣu tathā syāt, puruṣārtha- tvāt |
bhāṣyam - 'gurungamantavyaḥ abhivādyatiyaśca' vṛddhavavyāḥ pratyuyeyaḥ saṃmantavyaśca' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kimāgate''gate gurau vṛddhavayasi ca yaduktaṃ tat karta- vyam, uta sakṛtkṛte kṛtārthateti |
ācārād gṛhamāṇeṣu tathā syāt puruṣārthatvāt ityadhikaraṇatādeśaḥ |
tatra yaḥ pūrve pakṣaḥ, sa iha pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
sakṛt kṛtvā kṛtārthaḥ; iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
somya -- naimittakatvāt pratyayaparihāra eva gurungamanādīnāṃ vaiṣaṃ phalam, guruprītistu ānuṣaṅgikaṃ phalam |
ata evoktamācāryaiḥ (1|3|12 pṛ. 166) gurungamanādīnāṃ naimittakatvāt akriyāyāṃ bhavati pratyayāyaḥ, karaṇe na bhavati |
dṛṣṭaṃ ca, prīto guruḥ adhyā- payiṣyati ityevamādi niṣpyate |
nyāyasudhāyāṃ ca 'niṣpadyate' iti ānuṣaṅgikatvaṃ darśitam iti vyākhyātam iti dhyeyam |
bhāṭṭa -- ācārapramāṇeṣu gurungamanādau śiṣyānu- gamanādiṣu āvṛttasyaivācārasya darśanāt tanmūlabhūtaśrutau gurungamanādernimittakatvalakṣaṇatvādgateḥ pratinimittamāvṛttiḥ |
na ca ācaritapramāṇācceṣṭeṣṭavicā guruprītyarthatvenāpi upapatternimittatve pramāṇābhāvaḥ guruprīterapāyāntareṇāpi siddheḥ adhītādidhenānuṣṭhānāt niyatānuṣṭhānatvena naimittikatvapratītiḥ |
yattu tantraratne śāstreṇaiva saptamī- śatrupratyayādinā nimittatvāvagatiḥ gurungamanāderityuktam, tacchruti
vi. 10|7|9. gṛhemedhīyaṃ nāma karmā- ntarameva, na tu vikṛtiḥ |
su. pṛ. 939. gṛhemedhīye ājyabhāgau apūrvavidhānāt kartavyau 'agnaye sviṣṭakṛte samavadyati' 'iḍāmupahvayate' iti vidhānāt sviṣṭakṛdakṣī api kartavyaiva |
ānarthakyaparihārāya ubhayatra vihitayoḥ ājyabhāgayoḥ iha abhyudayakāritva- kalpanāyā prakṛtitvat itthaṃ kartavyam ityupadeśādeśābhyāṃ saṃhatya vidhiḥ iti dvitīyaḥ |
ubhayābhyāṃ vidhānasya adṛṣṭārthatvāpatteḥ 'ājyabhāgau yajati yajatāyai' iti ca stutidarśanāt prakṛtagṛhemedhīyastulyamiti tṛtīyaḥ |
ājyabhāgaśabdasya dharmalakṣaṇa'rthatvāpatteḥ karmā- ntaravidheyogāt atideśena ājyabhāgayoḥ prajādādiṣu ca prāpteṣu ājyabhāgapunaḥśravaṇam anyaparisaṃkhyā'rthamiti pañcamaḥ |
codakaprāpteḥ prāthamyāt phalataḥ parisaṃkhyā'nupa- patteḥ tridoṣatvāparihārāt upadiṣṭāyāmapyavajametadiśaḥ iti ṣaṣṭhaḥ |

alaṇḍakaraṇopakārātideśadvāreṇa yugapat sarvapadārthaprāpteḥ tadarjanapakṣasya tṛtīye 'codanā'rthakāryāttu mukhyapratiṣedhāt prakṛtyam' ( 3|6|18 ) ityatra nirākṛtātvāt ājyabhāgayoreva atideśopasaṃhāraḥ iti saptamaḥ |

atideśasya kṛtyapadārthaviśeṣagocaratvena 'sāmānyavidhiraspaṣṭaḥ saṃhiyeta viśeṣataḥ' ityupa- saṃhārāyogyatāt saptamapi pakṣaṃ nirākṛtya klṛptopakāra- prākṛtājyabhāganirākāṅkṣatvena atideśābhāvāt gṛhemedhīyasya apūrvatvajñāpanārthamidaṃ vacanam iti siddhānto vakṣyate daśame ( 10|1|124-33 ) |
su. pṛ. 106. gṛhemedhīye ājyabhāgapunaḥśravaṇasya pari- saṃkhyā'rthatvamiti pañcame pakṣe sviṣṭakṛcchravaṇamapi svasajātīyapratipatyantarāṇāṃ śeṣakāryāṇāṃ nivarta- kamiti prayojanapratipādanam ||
tatropadeyaḥ sama- dhigataḥ apūrvo gṛhemedhīya iti |
tatredaṃ saṃdihyate kimaneṣāṃ śeṣakāryāṇāṃ bhakṣaṇasya ca parisaṃkhyāpaḥ : sviṣṭakṛcchandaḥ, uta neti |
āha, nanu apūrvatvāt gṛhemedhīyasya naiva śeṣabhakṣā vidyante |
yadi parisaṃkhyā bhavet, ājyabhāgābhyāṃ yāgāḥ pari- saṃkhyāyeran, nānye iti |
kiṃ prāptam ? sviṣṭakṛtti śrūyamāṇe parisaṃkhyā syāt bhakṣā- ṇām |
tulyaṃ hi kāraṇaṃ sviṣṭakṛto bhakṣaṇaṃ ca |
tatra vacanādayaṃ śeṣasaṃskāro bhavati nānyaḥ, iti pratiṣiddheran bhakṣāḥ |
bhāṣyam-- yathaiva sviṣṭakṛcchravaṇe anyeṣāṃ śeṣa- kāryāṇāmadarśanamiti śeṣabhakṣā na santi ityucyate |
atha yadarśanamuktam, tat vidhipūrvasya bhakṣaṇa bhaviṣyati |
evaṃ hi āmnāyate 'ayeḍā mevāvadyati, na prāśitramupahvaya ( iḍām ) prāśati' iti, tasya darśanam |
sūtrārthastu-sviṣṭakṛtti śrūyamāṇe bhakṣaṇanivṛttiḥ syāt, ubhayorapi śeṣapratipattisārthakatvena tulyajātīyatvāt iti |
vi-- 'tatraiva ( gṛhemedhīye eva ) parisaṃkhyātve prāśitrādyasti vā na vā |
' bhāṭṭe idamadhikaraṇaṃ navamādhikaraṇe eva ekīkṛtya vyākhyātam |
tatropadeyaḥ samadhigataḥ, ājyabhāgābhyāmeva etannirākāṅkṣam anyā- nyajñānāṃ na gṛhṇāti |
kimeva etatsargaḥ sarvāṇyeva anyānyajñānāṃ na gṛhṇāti ? evaṃ khalu prāpte, ucyate |
ato yasyayasya pratyakṣavacanam, sarveṣu teṣu punargamyate viśeṣaḥ |
soma-- prākṛtāṅgasya punaḥ śrūyamāṇasya apūrvatā''- pādakatvaṃ yaduktam, tat kim ekaikasya, uta sarveṣāmiti viśeṣavicāraṇāt saṃgati |
sūtrārthastu-- ājyabhāgābhyāṃ adhikamapi yāvaduktaṃ sviṣṭakṛdādi syāditi |
vi-- 'tatrānyadaṅgaṃ no kāryaṃ kārya vā, 'nyānapekṣa- ṇāt |
' bhāṭṭe tu etadadhikaraṇaṃ navame evādhikaraṇe vyākhyātam iti tathaiva draṣṭavyam |
'na sāmidhenīrvāha' iti gṛhemedhīye sāmidhenī- niṣedhāt āvāhane'pi na kāryam |
kauṣītake āvāhana- vidhibhyaḥ parataḥ 'atha yat parastāt sāmidhenī japati, vajro vai sāmidhenyaḥ' ( 2|3 ) iti sāmidhenīparāmarśena tadavā- ntaraprakaraṇe pāṭhena tadaṅgatvāvagateḥ |
iti prāpte, ubhayo- bhinnakāryārthatvena 'guṇānāṃ ca parārthatvāt' iti nyāyena parasparaprāptyaṅgabhāve mānābhāvāt parastātpavitravidherutthā- nuvādenāpi upapattau avāntaraprakaraṇādāvāhanabādhaḥ |
vikṛtau prākṛtasya vidhermahaṇāt punaḥśrutirana- rthikā syāt |
bhāṣyam-- cāturmāsyeṣu śrūyate 'marutvo gṛ- hemedhibhyaḥ sarvābhyām ( gavāṃ ) dugdhe sāyamīdanam' iti |

tatra saṃśayaḥ kiṃ codakena prāptayoḥ ājyabhāgayoḥ anuvāda- mātrametat, kiṃvā codakena anena ca dvābhyāmekaṃ karma codyate, kiṃvā arthādādhai grahaṇam, uta adhikayoḥ karmāntarayoḥ utpattiḥ, atha parisaṃkhyā'rtham, athavā ājyabhāgau varjayitvā anyat codakaḥ prāpayati, athavā codakena ājyabhāgau eva prāpyete, codaka eva vā nāsti apūrvau gṛhemedhīyaḥ iti |

kiṃ prāptam ? vikṛtau etasyāṃ prākṛto'jyabhāgayoḥ prāptayo- rjñeyamāṇayoḥ punaḥśravaṇam anarthāntaraṃ syāt anuvāda- mātrameva, sudṛḍha bhūtvā ācārya upadiśati sma, nārthāntara- śaṅkayā kheditavyaṃ manaḥ, jñātametat anuvādamātrametat iti, anyat cintyatāmiti |
katham ? taddhi gamyate, anyacca nāvagamyate iti |
yathā asmin gṛhe ye brāhmaṇāḥ, te ānīyantāṃ devadatto yajñadatto viṣṇumitraḥ iti bhavanti loke anuvādamātrasya vakkāraḥ |
ntareṇa vihite arthe vākyāntareṇa arthavādena kiñcit |
ca sāmarthyaṃ codakena anena ca dvābhyāṃ sahaiva eko'rtha |
tasmāt codakena agnīhau ājyabhāgau gṛhītau iti |
yadi hi pratyakṣamājyabhāgau na gṛhītau syātām, codaka eva tau śaknuyāt grahītum |
pratyakṣa- vacanena codakagrahaṇāccau gaurave kiṃ prayojanamiti |
na tu gauraveṇa yat kṛtam, tat na kṛtaṃ bhavati |
na tu doṣe'pi sati codakaḥ ājyabhāgau gṛhāti |
yaḥ parihāreṇa yathā grāmaṃ gacchati, parihāra- doṣamapi prāpnoti, na tu āgamanamaṃ na bhavati |
ṭup -- pratyakṣaṃ ājyabhāgau (gṛhamedhīye) prāpyete, anyāni (tu) agnīni codakena |
satyam, pratyakṣaṃ (tu) śīghraṃ prāptiḥ, vilambitā codakena |
evaṃ ca karmāntaramapi (parisaṃkhyā na tridoṣā) na bhaviṣyati |
yadi hi codakaḥ pṛthak- pṛthak prākṛtān padārthān apekṣeta tatra ājyabhāgau gṛhītau iti kṛtvā tau nāpekṣeta, anyāśca gṛhṇīyāt |
kintu prākṛtama- pūrvamepekṣate 'yadyat tena, tadat anena' iti |
tasmāt anyairaṅgaiḥ tulyatvāt na codakena agnīhautorajya- bhāgayoḥ grahaṇam iti |
ṭup -- yadi vikṛtiḥ śāstrāṇi apekṣeta padārthān vā, tataḥ ājyabhāgau na prāpayet (pratyakṣamānāt |
na tvevamasti) kiṃ tarhi (vikṛtiḥ) prakāram (yāgataṃ nyāyapariveśaṃ) apekṣate |
sa ca ekaḥ (prakāraḥ, na bahavaḥ) prakārāpekṣāyāṃ pramāṇamasti, na śāstrāpekṣāyām |
(prathamaṃ tāvat) āgneye buddhirbhavati (na padārtheṣu), āgneyenāpi prakāraḥ (svasamavetāḥ upasthāpyante), tān
te ca (prakārāḥ) apekṣitāḥ, śāstrāṇi padārthāśca anapekṣitāni vyavahitāni ca |
bhāṣyam -- (saptamaṃ pakṣamāha - ) atha yadi ucyeta ājyabhāgāveva codakena gṛhītau |
yathā 'sasadaśa sāmidhenyo bhavanti' adhvarakalpā''disu iti vākyaśeṣāt nānyāsu iṣṭiṣu sāsadayam |
yathā śiṃśā- mānaya śṛṅgam iti nānya'''pi vṛkṣa ānīyate, śiṃśāpaiva vṛkṣaśabdena gṛhyate bhavati, evamihāpi codakena ājya- bhāgāveva gṛhītau iti draṣṭavyam |
pṛthak padārthāpekṣāṇi codake sthāt agrahaṇam anyeṣā- maṅgānām |
ṭup -- (yadyapi uttaro granthaḥ ānandāśramīye 'na tulyatvāt' iti sūtrānte evaṃ mudritaḥ, tathāpi tantraratne 'tathā tadgrahaṇe' iti sūtraṃ paṭhitavacca uttaro grantho vyākhyātaḥ |
tasmāt tantraratnānusāraṇa anaiva taṃ ṭuppranthaṃ niveśayāmaḥ |
) (tatraimāśaṅkā mā bhūt ājyabhāgārthe punarvanaṃ codakādeva siddhatvāt |
(pratyakṣyeṇa ājyabhāgasiddheḥ nopa- saṃhāro yuktaḥ iti bhāvaḥ |
bhāṣyam -- (siddhāntabhūtamidaṃ pakṣamāha - ) evaṃ tarhi apūrvo gṛhamedhīyaḥ |
evaṃ grahaṇam 'ājyabhāgau yajati' iti arthavat bhaviṣyati |
pūrvavattve tu anarthakaṃ syāt ājyabhāgābhyāṃ pratyakṣabhūtābhyāṃ gṛhamedhīyo nirākāṅkṣo na codakena anyāni aṅgāni gṛhṇāti |
yasyāṃ tu vikṛtau apūrve kiñcidaṅga- muktam, tena saha ekavākyatvām agatyā prākṛtāni
kutaḥ ? 'kena prakāreṇa kuryāt' iti tasya ākāṅkṣā, 'kiṃ kuryāt' iti |
prakṛtau ca aṅgavattā nāma prakāro vidyateḥ, prayogavacanena ca ākā- dṛśyate |
na ca klṛptāmupaśrutivā kalpanīya- saṃbandho nyāyyaḥ |
tasmāt tatrāpi codakena aṅgāni gṛhyante iti |
gṛhyateṣu ca prākṛteṣu vaikṛtānāmaṅgānāṃ vidhānamanarthakaṃ mā bhūt iti teṣāmaṅgatāṃ kalpayitvā sarvāṅgopasaṃhāriṇā prayogavacanena saṃgrahaḥ kriyate eveti |
upamānapramāṇakaṃ prāpaṇamiti saralo'rthaḥ :) yāvat gṛhamedhīyasyabhāvo naiva gacchati, tāvat pratyakṣābhyāmājyabhāgābhyāṃ gṛhamedhīyaḥ na saṃbadhyate (gṛhamedhīyaḥ |
'yasyāṃ tu vikṛtau' ityādibhāṣyārthamāha - ) yat apūrvamaṅgam, tat klṛpto- pakāraṃ na bhavati |
aklṛptopakāratvāt (ca) kathambhā- vākāṅkṣāṃ na śaknoti pūrayitum |
soma -- pratiprasāturbhājyabhāge'pi ājyabhāgātiriktā- nāmaṅgānāṃ gṛhamedhīye na vācaḥ ityucyateḥ (pratyudāharaṇa-) saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu -- vikṛtyāṃ prākṛtetikartavyatayā grahaṇāt punaḥśrutiruvādamātraṃ syāditi |
parisaṃkhyā'pīyaṃ vikṛtantare nājyabhāgāditi śeṣaparisaṃkhyā vā syāt , ājyabhāgātiriktaprayājādirūpaśeṣaparisaṃkhyā vā ? nobha- yathā, vaidoṣyāpatteḥ |
gṛhamedhīyājyabhāgavidhinā vikṛtantare nairākāṅkṣyā- pāṭanāsaṃbhavena codakaparilopakānupapattī phalataḥ parisaṃkhyā'nupapatteḥ |
nānyaḥ, prāptaparisaṃkhyātve śāstra- prāptasyānyata ābādhayogena 'na tau paśau karoti' itivat vikalpapatteḥ |
klṛptopakārakeṇāpi ājyabhāgamātraṃ gṛha- medhīyasya nairākāṅkṣyāpāṭanāyogena codakaparilopakatayā apūrvatvajñāpanadvārā phalataḥ parisaṃkhyārūpasiddhāntasthāpi anupapatteḥ |
'parye- mikṛtaṃ pātnīvatamutsṛjati' iti pūrvakarmānuvādena guṇa eva vidhīyate |
na ca vidheyābhāvaḥ vṛttyarthamadhikaraṇasyaiva capratyāntārthasya vidheyatvāt, tasya ca gṛha0nyāyena prākṛtasyaiva atideśataḥ pūrvapravṛttyā vidheyatvāt |

bhāṭṭa. 2|3|8. 'tvāṣṭraṃ pātnīvatamālabheta, paryemikṛtaṃ pātnī- vatamutsṛjanti' atra gṛha0nyāyena apūrvatājñāpanadvārā itarāṅgaparisaṃkhyāphalakaḥ paryemikaraṇamātravidhiḥ tadaṅga- kalāpavidhirvā astu |

kī. 2|3|8|9 pṛ. 56, na caivaṃ klṛptopakārāmipunaḥśravaṇāt gṛha0nyāyena abhyantarapari- saṃkhyāphalakatvāpattiḥ, taddihāpi atideśādhīna- prāptikādhvanīyaprāpyapujīyatvatvena atideśabādhakatvānupa- patteḥ dvirāṣṭrādiṣu atideśaprāptāṅgavidhiliṅgasadbhāvācca |
bhavati, tathā sadupadeśo'pi khalajanakṛtaḥ tyājya eveti |
gorapi kṣīraṃ śrṛtau sthitaṃ dugdhameva yathā, tadvat |
'svarūpeṇa dharmasyāpi ahiṃsādeḥ gokṣīranyāyena śakyasaṃbhavatve sati adharmatvaprasaṅgāt' |
gotrabhedāsādisvāmini atyantāvidyamānameva śeṣatvaṃ yatrāpi, tatrāpi upakārakatvasaṃbhavāt upacaritamiti draṣṭavyam |

hetavo'tra trayaḥ pūrvaṃ vyākhyātā eṣa saṃmatāḥ ||
evaṃ siddhe baliyastve niveśaḥ prakṛtau sthitaḥ ||
godohane tathā'- nyārthaṃ na kraturthasya sādhanam ||
nityā samāse, vākye tu sā vivakṣāpekṣate |
' atra samāhasa pṛthak grahaṇaṃ gobhalīyardanyāyena, ekapade ityanenaiva tatsaṃgrahasiddheḥ |
viśeṣaṇaṃ ca gāvo'tra na saṃbandhaḥ kathaṃ cana |
sarvathā tāvat gomacchabdena goviśiṣṭo'rtha ityetadamihite katham anavasthitāstā gāḥ taṃ viśiṣanti iti tāsā- mevaiṣa vyāpāro na śabdasya |
' na hi yena vinā arthātmalābho nāsti tattadabhidhātavyam, kiṃ tarhi, yāvatā vinā viśiṣṭabuddhirnopyate |
sa hi gobhi- rasaṃbaddhaṃ na gomantaṃ vivakṣati |
tena yaṃ yathā'vasthitaṃ śaknuvanti viśeṣum, sa tathā'vasthasye |
saṃbandhau cāsau viśeṣatvaṃ pratipadyate ityārthaṃ saṃbadhyate |
gomayaṃ pāyasam, govikāratvāt saṃmatavat iti anumānaṃ yathā pratyakṣaṃ bādhyate |
'acetanatvena prasi- ddhebhyo gomādibhyaḥ (cetanānāṃ) vṛścikādīnāṃ utpattiḥ dṛśyate, tena upādānopādeyayoḥ atyanta- sādṛśyaṃ nāpekṣyate |
