iti pūrvo- ktābhyaḥ tisṛbhyaḥ aṣṭapakṣībhyaḥ anyāḥ ṣaṭ aṣṭapakṣīḥ vicāryāḥ |
ilāha- ) 'tathā kṛtvā dvayoḥ pūrvaṃ viśe- ṣaṇaviśeṣyatām |
(grahadekatvayoḥ saṃhasta, pratyekaṃ vā saṃmārgānāmḥ iti vivekyāya upādeyatvoddeśyatve api vicāryai ilāha-) tathā 'kimupādeyatā teṣāṃ syādathodiśyamānatā |
saṃmārgaṃ prati saṃhasya pratyekaṃ vā samāgame ||
' (kasmin pakṣe saṃhatyānvayaḥ, kasmin vā pratyekanitya- pekṣāyām-) 'tatra kriyāpradhānatve sāhityaṃ dravya- saṃkhyayoḥ |
sakṛcca tādṛśī kṛtvā kṛtsnāṃ kartṛ kṛtī bhavet ||

(uddeśyatvopādeyatvorapi viśeṣaṇatvavat vicāra- mantareṇa asiddheḥ uddeśyatve tāvat (1) kiṃ graha eva uddeśyaḥ : saṃmārge prati, (2) ekatvameva vā, (3) atha graho vā ekatvaṃ vā, (4) atha grahaśca ekatvaṃ ca, (5) atha grahaikatvayoḥ saṃbandhaḥ, (6) atha samudāyaḥ, (7) atha ekatvaviśiṣṭo grahaḥ, (8) atha graha- viśiṣṭamekatvam, iti viśiṣṭā aṣṭapakṣī vicārya ilāha-) 'tatrāpi tu grahasyaiva saṃmārgaḥ kiṃ vidhīyate |
ekatva- syaiva kim, kiṃvā vikalpena dvayorapi ||
kiṃ vā graha- vā viśiṣṭāṃ saṃkhyāṃ prati vidhīyate ||
(upādeyatve'pi īdṛśaiva aṣṭapakṣī vicāryailāha-) 'kiyāṃ vā pratyupādānaṃ kiṃ grahasyaiva gamyate |
kiṃ samu- citayoḥ, kiṃ vā saṃbandha-samudāyayoḥ |
upā- deyatayā saṃkhyāṃ vidheyāṃ manyate paraḥ ||
saṃmārge vā vidhī- yeta sa tamāpādayiṣyati ||
vākyabhedena tāṃtāṃ tu siddhāntī dūṣa- yiṣyati ||
na tāvat tad grahe śakyaṃ vidhātumapunaḥśruteḥ |
dvau tatrāvarta- nīyau hi syātāṃ grahavidhāyakau ||
vidhāyakaśca naikena vidhinā tau hi sidhyataḥ ||
viddhada dvau hi saṃbandhau yuga- padvā krameṇa vā |
na śakyate vidhātuṃ cede- katvaṃ na grahīṣyate ||
kena cit prakāreṇa vidhi- rasya bhaved yadi |
tādarthya- saṃbandhe ca bhāvanāṃ prati nivṛtte aruṇaikahayanīyāyena paścāttano viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ |
athavā yadā ekatvaṃ svārthatvena graho nopajīvituṃ samarthaḥ ityavadhāritaṃ bhavati, tadā ato tadbhāvanāṃ vākye- nāpi gacchan na nivāryati |
yadā sutarāṃ preyati 'bhāvanā'yai hi sat etat vidhinā gṛhāmāṇaṃ paścādapi tāvat niyamyamānaṃ māṃ paricchetsyati, anyathā tu mayā agṛhītata vidhinā upekṣitaṃ tāvat bhāvanāyāḥ na mama syāt |
tacca grahārthatvaṃ yena prakāreṇa upapadyate, sa darśayiṣyate |
tatra yadi grahaḥ svarūpamātreṇa bhāvanāyāmanupraviśet, tataḥ ekatvaṃ paścāt bhaviṣyat agṛhītata bhāvanāyā bhāvanāgataṃ na syāt, graha- svarūpasya syāt |
ataḥ asau ekatvapuraḥsarameva tasya- mānadeśaṃ vā pṛthakpadopāttatvādeva ātmānaṃ prati- padyate |
' evaṃ ca sati bhāvanāpaviṣṭaṃ taddidhinā'pi saṃspṛśyamānaṃ dravyaguṇayornirṇaye sati grahasya jātaṃ bhavati |
atha śruti- valīyastvāt asya dravyasaṃbandha uccate, tadeva atyanta- viparītam |
prātipadikopāttaṃ hi dravyaṃ samānapadopāttatvena pratyayārthaṃ syāt |
tena grahasya ekatvaṃ ca ubhayagapi kārakībhūtaṃ vibhaktiśrutyaiva bhāvanāyāṃ prakṣipyate iti vidhīyate |
vakṣyati hi 'śabdavattvalabhyate, tadāgame hi tad dṛśyate, tasya jñānaṃ yathā'nyeṣāṃ' (4|1|5|16) iti |
yathaiva daśāpavitreṇa śruto nānyena kriyate, saṃmārgaśca śruto nāvaghātaḥ kriyate, grahasya śruto nāgrahasya kriyate, tathā ekasya śruto
( pūrvapakṣamupasaṃharati - ) tasāt upādīyamānapakṣavādivat eva uddiśyamānasyāpi saṃkhyā vivakṣitā |

( bhāṣye - ) puṃstvadheti prasaṅgāt udāhṛtam, na tu atra liṅgamapi tulyanyāyatvāt saṃkhyāvicāreṇa vicāritaprāyameva ityādahyate, mā bhūt 'liṅgaviśeṣa- nirdeśāt puṃstvamaitiśāyanaḥ' ( 6|1|136 ) ityasya punaruktā |
bhāṣyam - naitadasti, yaduktaṃ grahādiṣu ekatvyeṣu abhī padārthāḥ kartavyā iti |
sarve grahāḥ saṃmārgadharmāḥ, sarvebhyo''gmiḥ tṛtīyāni apacyayāni, puroḍāśamātraṃ ca paryagni kartavyamiti |
kutaḥ ? 1 grahajātyā dravyaṃ lakṣayitvā saṃmārgādi vidhīyate |
tatra na gamyate viśeṣaḥ, ko grahaḥ saṃmārgadharmāḥ ko neti |
nanu ekavacanaṃ śrūyate, tat viśe- dheyati |
ekatvaṃ hi śrayamāṇaṃ grahādiṣu ekatvaṃ brūyāt, na dvitīyādīn pratiṣedheta |
ekatvasya asau vācakaḥ, na dvitīyādeḥ pratiṣedhakaḥ |
tena apratiṣiddhe dvitīyādau sāmānyavacanena prāptaṃ saṃmārgajanādi kimiti na kriyate |
tatra etat syāt, ekavacanamiha śrūyamāṇaṃ prāpte eva ekasmin dravye dvitīyādiṣu ca kimantyat kuryāt anyataḥ : parisaṃkhyāyāḥ |
na cet ekavacanaṃ pari- saṃcakṣīta dvitīyādīn, anarthakameva syāt |
yathā 'aśvābhidhānīmādatte' iti gardabhābhidhānīṃ parisaṃcaṣṭe, evamatrāpi dravyamasīti |

tatra mantrasya abhidhānārthyā yaḥ saṃbandhaḥ, tada- vidhānaparaṃ vacanam 'imāmagṛṇan iti aśvābhidhānīm' iti, na 'anena mantreṇa ādatte' iti, liṅgenaiva ādāne prāptatvāt mantrasya, parisaṃkhyā yuktā |
iha punaḥ : yat ekavacanaṃ dravye śrūyate, tat śrūyamāṇamapi avidhīya- mānatvena na nivartakaṃ bhavitumarhati |
yathā kaścit odanaṃ nirdiṣya brūyāt 'ya enaṃ bhakṣayet kaścit śvā mārjāro
tatra yadi bhakṣaṇaṃ nimittatvena vidhīyate na śmāmārjārasaṃbandhaḥ, tataḥ kāko'pi āgatacchan nivāryate, śrayamāṇe'pi śuni mārjāre vā śmāmārjāra- saṃbandhasya nimittatvena avidhīyamānatvāt |
evami- hāpi ekatvasaṃbandhasya avidhīyamānatvāt śrūyamāṇe'pi ekatve grahamātraṃ saṃmṛjyateti |
na cātra dravyaikatva- saṃbandhavidhāyakaḥ kaścit śabdo'sti |
evaṃ śrutvā svapadāyāṃ vihito bhavati, itarathā vākyena parapadādhau vidhīyeta |
tulyasaṃbhave ca vākyaṃ kramate, na saṃmanvyatāṃ śrutau |
ataḥ avidhīyamānaṃ viśeṣatvena ekatvaṃ na dvitīyādīn pratiṣedhu- marhati |
evaṃ sati na dvitīyādau saṃmārgādi kriyamāṇa- macoditaṃ bhavati, pratiṣiddhaṃ vā |
yathaiva hi tat ekasya śrutamavagamyate, tathā dvitīyāderapi |
ayaṃ ca aparo doṣaḥ na tat ekatvaṃ dravyasya saṃmārgādau vipaye niyamyeta |
nahi saṃmārgādiḥ yasmin dravye ekatvaṃ niyamyeta, tasya viśeṣaṇatvena bhavati |
vidhīyate hi atra saṃmārgādiḥ, na prāpto lakṣaṇatvena dravyasya āmnāyate, nahi yaugapadyena vidhātuṃ śakyate lakṣaṇatvena ca uccārayitum |
na cet viśeṣakaḥ, na dravye ekatvaṃ niyamyate iti śakyamāśritum |
atha ekatvaṃ saṃmārge ucyate, tatrāpi dvayī gatiḥ : syāt, ekatvaṃ pradhānaṃ saṃmārgo vā |
na tāvat ekāvasya saṃmārgaḥ śakyate kartum |
na ca dravye kriyamāṇaḥ ekatvasya upakaroti kena cit prakāreṇa |
na ca ekatvasya upakṛtena kiñcit prayojanamasti, nahi tat guṇabhūtaṃ śrutam |
atha ekatvaṃ saṃmārge prati guṇabhūtamiti, tadapi na |
yadyapi amūrtaṃ kriyā niṣpādyati sādhanaṃ vidhī- pat, tathāpi etat na bhavitumarhati |
nahi atra grahaḥ saṃmārgārthyaḥ, saṃmārgaḥ atra grahaḥ cocyate, sa hi prayojanavān |
yadi grahaḥ saṃmārgasya upakuryāt, tat upakāriṇaḥ upakaroti iti saṃmārgasya upakārakamekaṃ bhavet, na tu etadevam |
nanu pradhānabhūtam api grahādi, saṃmārge niṣpādyatveva, atastat sādhanam, tacca viśeṣitaṃ tat upakariṣyati |
yathā iyārthe dadhani payasi ca praṇītādharmāḥ pāke upakurvanti, paridhānārthe ca paridhī thupadharmā bandhane |
na brūmaḥ atadarthe sādhake na śaknuvanti upakartumiti, kiṃ tarhi ? yadā pradhānabhūtaṃ grahādi lakṣaṇatvena ucyate, na tadā eka- tvasya grahādinā saṃbandhaḥ, na saṃmārgādinā iti |
katham ? yāvadiha lakṣaṇatvena kiñciducyate, saṃvādastatra bhavati, na tu tat vidhīyate vijñānāya |
kimarthaṃ tarhi ucyate ? anyat tasya kiñcit vidhīyate iti |
tadetat grahādi lakṣayitvā, tasya saṃmārgādi vidhīyate |
tat yadi ekatva- saṃbandhaḥ aparo dravye saṃmārgādau vā vidhīyeta, dvayoḥ saṃba- ndhayoḥ vidhānāt bhidyeta vākyam |
athocyate grahādi lakṣayitvā tasya ekatvasaṃbandho vidhīyate, na saṃmārgādi- saṃbandha iti |
tathā ca saṃmārgādīnāmadhyayanaṃ pramādaḥ iti abhyupagataṃ syāt, na caitadevam |
evetat ekatvaṃ grahasya na kiñcit upakāraṃ karoti na saṃmārgasya, evameva sat anūdyate |
tasāt naitat kiñcidapi kartuṃ vivakṣyate iti sarveṣāṃ grahādīnāṃ saṃmārgādi kartavyamiti |
yadi avivakṣita- mekatvam, kathaṃ tarhi ekavacanamucyate, ( sa evāha - ) nanu bahuṣu vivakṣiteṣu bahuvacanena bhavitavyam |
na vayam etat vicārayāmaḥ : ekavacanamuccārayitavyaṃ noccā- rayitavyamiti |
eka- sminneva saṃmārgādi uta sarveṣviti, tacca sarveṣu iti sthāpi- tam |
apica na vibhakteḥ vacanameva ekaṃ prayojanam, kiṃ tarhi kārakasaṃbandho'pi |
kimato yadi evam ? etadato bhavati, prātipadikārthagataṃ hi vibhakteḥ |
tat hi svarūpapakṣeṇa vā bhavet anekatvanirākaraṇena vā |
tatra svarūpapakṣeviśeṣaṇaphalaṃ tāvat sarveṣvapi saṃmṛjyamāneṣu saṃbhavatyeva |
katham ? yo hi bahūn mahān saṃmārṣṭi, saṃmārṣṭi asau ekam |
ataśca grahaṇavacanaṃ prātaḥ eka- vacanena ca apratiṣiddhaḥ kimidaṃ dvitīyādeḥ saṃmārgāṃ na kriyate |
tatra etat syāt prātipadikādeva ekasmin anekasmin grahe saṃmārjanaye prāpte, punaḥ ekavacanaśrutiḥ guṇārthavādatvena asaṃbhavantī parisaṃkhyā bhaviṣyati |
kutaḥ ? 'yatra sāmānyataḥ prāptavyaṃ viśeṣe śrūyate punaḥ |
śuddhadravyaviśeṣaṇatve tu bhāvanā'pi grahamātreṇa saṃbaddhā na saṃkhyayā, saṃkhyā'pi grahamātreṇa saṃbaddhā na bhāvanā|
tatra viśiṣṭavidhinā bhāvanāviśeṣaṇamātrākṣepa- paryavasāyinā na arthāntarakṣepaḥ śakyaḥ kartum|
svarūpā- ntaritatvācca (grahaviśeṣaṇabhūtatvāḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ grahasva- rūpeṇa bhāvanāviśeṣaṇena vyavahitatvāt ityarthaḥ :) sā saṃkhyā naiva paśyati |
'nāpi bhāvanāviśeṣasya (bhāvanāṃ prati viśeṣyabhūtasyāpi grahasya ekatvaṃ viśeṣaṇam itya dhyāhāraḥ :) , mā bhūt punarapi bhāvanāviśeṣatvameva |
nahi bhāvanā (ekatvena) aviśiṣṭaṃ grahaṃ viśeṣuṃ śaknoti|
tasmāt maulikena vidhinā anākāṅkṣa- tvāt na dravyaviśeṣaṇatve saṃbhavati|
tathā satyapi cet vidhirabhyupagamyate tat pratyāvṛttisambandhamantareṇa tadanupapatteḥ vākyabhedaḥ syāt|
abhyupetyāpi tu samāṃgatvenāpi naika- tvamādartavyam, svatantrasya grahasya ekatvasaṃbandhavidhā- nāt|
'nahi vidhīyamānātvaḥ krayaḥ guṇena saṃbadhyamānaṃ dravyaṃ viśinaṣṭi' ityuktam aruṇādhikaraṇe (3|1|6|12 pṛ. 689 'viśeṣaṇaṃ hi prasiddhaṃ bhavati|
na ca vidhīyamānātvaḥ krayaḥ prasiddhaḥ' ityukte vārtike eva|
atha etadekatvaṃ samāṃgabhāvanāyāḥ codyate, tathāpi na guṇatvena, nāpi pradhānatvena saṃbhavati|
tatra prādhānyaṃ tāvat anupapannam amūrtasya saṃskṛtaṃmaśakya- tvāt|
grahasya vā ayamekatvatvena vidhīyate, tasya ca svayameva vihitatvāt punarvidhānārthatvam|
anuṣṭhāna- kāle'pi ca grahasya āmīya evaṃ samāṃgaḥ pratyabhijñāyate iti na ekatvanimittabuddhiḥ syāt|
kathamaruṇātvasya guṇatvamiti cet, ata āha 'krayadravyaparicchedād guṇo'pi guṇa iṣyate|
na tu niṣphalasamāṃgo guṇa iha iṣyate |
mahasya tu niṣphalasamāṃgaṃ prati akṣatvādyogāt na tatparicchedāt ekatvasya samāṃgārhatā yuktā ityarthaḥ|
) yat dravyasya ādau nirvartakatvaṃ prāptaṅgikam, taddvāreṇa ekatvaṃ samāṃgasya upa- kariṣyati|
pradhānabhūto'pi ca grahaḥ guṇabhūtadravyadharme kriyā'ṅgaguṇaparicchedyatvaṃ pratipadyate|
nahi śeṣamāśritaḥ śeṣaḥ; kiṃ tarhi ? upakāriṇamāśritaḥ upakaroti iti sarvatra sthāpayiṣyāmaḥ|
siddhāntavādī tu vastuni upacadyamāne'pi anekārthatve vidhiśabdasya asāmarthyāt vyavahito vā guṇo vā hātyanyo bhavati ityevaṃ ekatvaparityāgaṃ vadati|
(ekatvasya kriyāviśeṣaṇatvapakṣe vivakṣānirāsabhāṣyam ākṣipyati-) na tu etadevam avivakṣitaṃ bhavitumarhati|
samāṃgatvaṃ tu saṃbandho na dvedhā'pi nirā- kṛtaḥ |
' yat tāvaduktam amūrtatvāt saṃskṛtau na śakyate iti, tat prātipadikasyā'pi grahatve tulyam, jātermūrta- tvāt|
athāpi vyaktidvāreṇa asyāḥ saṃskāraḥ, sa saṃkhyāyāmapi tulyaḥ|
aya vyaktau kṛto jātaḥ: kuto bhavati, tathā ekatvasyāpi|
tathā yadi jātirdravya- lakṣaṇārthā, tathā ekatvamapi|
atha jātermūrtatvaṃ dravya- vyatirekaṃ cāśritya sākṣādeva saṃskāra ityucyate, tadapi ekatvasya aviśiṣṭam|
yadyapyuktaṃ na dravye kriya- māṇaḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ kṛto bhavatīti, tadapi tvatpakṣe jāte- raviśiṣṭam|

atha grahaśabdasya vyaktivācitvāt parihāra ucyate, tataḥ ākyadhikaraṇātnyāyo grāhyeta, nahi aneka- deśakālavartijyotiṣṭomaprayogasthagrahavyatiriktatvānubha- 'sti, atha dṛṣṭeṣu graheṣu śabdaprayogo na syāt|
na ca tat grahavādantya saṃbharvati iti tadeva viśeṣaṇatvāt pūrvamabhidheyamāpadyate|
na ca ākāravacanatvaṃ grahaśabdasya pratigraham avayavaparyaniveśya kiñcinyātirekāvayava- tvena bhinnatvāt|
na ca tat sāmānyaṃ dravyāntarebhyo nivṛttaṃ teṣuteṣu cānuvṛttaṃ grahatvāt anyadasti, tasmāt
yattu grahasya kriyamāṇaḥ samāṃgaḥ tadīyatvāvadhāraṇena ekāvaviṣayo vijñāyate iti mandaphalā ca punaḥśrutiriti, tatrābhidhīyate 'ekatvenāpi saṃbandha tāvattveva kriyā yadi|
' ayameva ekatva- saṃbandhatvāt viśeṣaḥ, yat ekasmin kriyate, anyathā hi grahamātrasaṃskāraḥ syāt|
tassāt dravyaguṇayoḥ niyama- siddheḥ asti aruṇāśabdasya ekatvasaṃbandhasya pṛthak prayojanamiti saṃskāratvopapattiḥ|
mandayuktika evāyamabhyupagamaḥ, yat guṇameva āśritatvena guṇena upakartavyamiti |
' asaṃ- baddheṣu kriyamāṇā guṇāḥ kriyā na paricchindyuḥ; iti kriyāsaṃbandhinam āśrayaṇti, na tu tadravyaguṇapavanayoḥ kaścit viśeṣaḥ|
yathā ca kriyāsādhanaṃ kiṃsaṃkhyeyametat bhaviṣyati ityevamapekṣyate, tathaiva pradhāna- mapi kiṃsaṃkhye yaṃ sya mayā (kriyāsādhanena) upa- kartavyamiti, etāvacca saṃbandhe kāraṇam|
na ca sādhanagato- 'sau tathāgataṃ upakurvatyāḥ : kiñcidravyaṃ kuryāt' iti|
yaja- mānasaṃskārāṇāṃ ca yāgaguṇabhūtakrayasaṃjñātirekena phala- pratigrahayogayapuṣkaraṇāt bhoktṛtvaṃśāpātināmapi yāgā- ṅgatvaṃ vakṣyate (1|3|6) |
sa evātra nyāyaḥ; iti aviruddhaṃ pradhānāśrayaṇāṃ guṇatvam|
evaṃ sthiteṣu tu yat vidheḥ asāmarthyamityuktam, tat upādīyamāneṣvapi paścādiṣu aviśiṣṭam|
tatrāpi hi dravyadevatāyāgaviśeṣābhāvāvidhire vākaye yadi liṅga- saṃkhyāsaṃbandhaḥ aparaḥ kriyāyāṃ dravye vā vidhīyate, tato vākyaṃ bhidyeta iti śakyaṃ vaditum|
atha tu viśiṣṭa- vidhānāt avākyabhedaḥ, sa samāṃgo'pi aprāptatvāt aviśiṣṭaḥ|
tadiha etāvānena viśeṣaḥ avaśiṣyate; yat grahaḥ uddiyamānaḥ, paśuḥ upādīyamānaḥ, na caitāvatā kiñcit sidhyati, anyathā paśugrahasaṃbandhamātrabhedenāpi vivakṣitāvivakṣitatvasiddhiḥ|
syāt apica asminneva vākye grahamuddiśya samāṃgaṃ vidhīyamāne'pi daśāpavitratade- katvādīnāṃ vivakṣā abhyupagamyate, na ca vākyabhedaḥ, tathā grahatve'pi bhaviṣyati|
yastu padāntaropādānāt viśeṣaṃ brūyāta, tasya sarvatra yaḥ kaścit viśeṣo'sti iti na kit dṛṣṭānto nopamā, tulyanyāyānāṃ viṣayābhāvāt|
' (uddeśyapā- deyorviśeṣaṇavivakṣāyām aviśeṣamupasaṃharati ākṣeptā-) tasmāt grahaikatvamapi vivakṣitam|
asti hi uddiśyamā- nasyāpi grahasya vidhisaṃsparśaḥ, anyathā hi vinā'pi graheṇa samāṃgaṃ kṛte tataḥ śāstrāthau bhavet|
aya prāptatvāt grahasya avidhānamunyate, tadyuktam, samāṃgaṃ prati aprāptatvāt|
atha jyotiṣṭome prāpteḥ: avidhirucyate, sa pathāderapi loke prāptatvāt prāpnoti|
athāsau yāge aprāpto vidhī- yate, tat grahasyāpi aviśiṣṭam|
atha samāṃgasya jyotiṣṭomaprakaraṇāvahirbhāvāt grahavidhānamucyate, tat paśuyāgasyāpi lokāntargatatvāt aviśiṣṭam|
śakyaṃ hi 'yo grahaḥ' itivat 'yaḥ paśuḥ' ityapi vaktum|
uddiśyamānatvāt yā atra grahasya avidhānājñā, sā vidhyanuvādayoḥ: uddiśyamānopādīyamānayośca atyanta- medāt ayuktā|
' tasmāt viśiṣṭasamāṃgavidhā- kṣepāt grahatvavat ekatvasyāpi vidhisaṃsparśa iti arthāt guṇapradhānabhāvaḥ iti ekatvaṃ niṣprayojanatvāt guṇabhūtam, grahaśca prayojanavatvāt pradhānabhūtaḥ|
kiñca 'saha vidhya- vidhī yuktau na caikapadoccarau|
' (karmaṇyutpattī vidhya- viśabde) ekasminneva pade yugapadaccarite mahān- jñānaṃ prati vidhīyate, naikatvam iti vipratiṣiddham|
na ca vibhakti: padāntaram, svātantryeṇa aniyatapūrvapara- tvena ca aprayujyamānatvāt |
ekasminnapi ca ākhyātādi- pratyaye aneko'rtha: pratīyate iti pratyaye padatvamabhyupetam |
) padamiti ca laukika: śabda:, sa yatra lokena prayujyate, yatra ca sartumi: smaryate, na tata: apanetuṃ śakyate |
' tadiha yadi tāvat saṃkhyāparityāgāt vibhakti: parityaktā, tata: karmatvaparityāgo'pi prāpnoti, tataśca grahasya saṃskāryatvaṃ hīyeta |
prayojanavattvāt saṃskāryatvamiti cet, kāraka- vibhaktimantareṇa kriyāsambandhābhāvāt |
nahi avivakti- kasya 'graha' ityetāvata: 'saṃmārṣṭi' ityanena saṃbandha: avaklapyate |
ataśca ākhyātāṃ vibhaktau ekadeśaparityāgābhāvāt saṃkhyāvivakṣā durnibārā, iti aśakya: sarvairmāga: |
nahyekasmin pade yukta: prakṛtau pratyaye'pi vā |
' (ardhe kukkuṭyā: pacyate bhakṣyārtham, ardhe ca sthāpyate prasavārtham iti yathā na yuktaṃ śakyaṃ vā tadat ityartha: |
' yadā hi grahekatvodeśena saṃmāgau vidhīyate, tadā udviśyamanayo: parasparasaṃbandhabhāvāt pratyekaṃ vākyaparisamāptistata eko vākyabheda: |
upādeyanātvāt puna: sarvaviśiṣṭa- bhāvanāprayojanatvāt ekakāryatve sati ājñastvena eka- vākyatvaṃ syāt |
yadi tāvat bhinnatvaikatvayo: niyogavikalpasamuccayādibhi: nimittatvaṃ ucyeta, tata: pratyekaṃ vākyaparimāhata: parasparasaṃbandhābhāva: |
atha ekatvamupādeyatvena pratipādyeta bhinnamupādeyatvena, tato yadyapi guṇatvapradhānatvavirodho nāsti, tathāpi pūrvadeva virodha: |
sā ca upādeyamāneṣu ākāṅkṣā upajāyate, noddiśyamāneṣu |
uddiśyamāne hi prātipadikārthasaṃbandha- mātrāpekṣatvāt na saṃkhyā''kāṅkṣā, pramāṇāntarādeva vijñātārthatvāt |
ato yāgrahaṃ grahādi pramāṇāntare (reṇa) avadhṛtaṃ tādṛśyā saṃmārgādya iti niścityate |
yathā ca nimittadvayena naikasyaiva phalasyākṣepastathā kaustubhe spaṣṭam |
ata eva ca nimittaphalasthale nimittasaṃskārasthale vā eka-karmakatvabhaṅgābhāvācca vākyabhedaḥ |
yathā'tra phalādisahitasya naikabodha-viṣayatā, tathā kaustubhe spaṣṭam |
ataśca tatsāhityaviva-kṣāyāṃ vākyabhedo duṣparihara evetyanyatra vistaraḥ |
nanu tathāpi naikatvādinimittavivakṣā, saṃmārgabhāvanāyāṃ guṇatvena phalavattvopapatteḥ |
na ca evamekatvādau dvitīyāyā karaṇatva-lakṣaṇatvāt grahāṃśe ca prādhānyābhidhānādrūpāpattiḥ, yugapat vṛttidvayavirodhapattiśceti vācyam |
īpsitānīpsita-sādhāraṇakarmatvamātre dvitīyāyāḥ śaktatvena pramāṇāntarāt viśeṣaprāgame''pi aikarūpyeṇa ubhayorapyanvayopapatteḥ |
na caivamapi saṃmārgādibhyastvaikatvasya tadaṅgabhūtagrahadvārakatvā-saṃbhavaḥ, aṅgatvādvākyabhede'pi saṃnidhitāmātreṇa 'agnam' iti mantre svargasyaiva grahasyāpi dvāratvopapatteḥ |
iti cet, guṇabhūtaikavacanānurodhena pratyaye karaṇatvalakṣaṇasvīkārasya yugapadvṛttidvayavirodha-vai rūpyādeśca anyāyatvāt |
ataśca guṇatvasiddhayarthe lakṣaṇā''śrayaṇe pūrvoktadoṣapatterekavacanaṃ bahulalakṣaṇārthe sat sādhutvārtha-manuvādaḥ avivakṣitaḥ |
tathā caivaṃ sati 'aṣṭavarṣe brāhmaṇamupanayīta' ityādī aṣṭavarṣādervivakṣā tathā kaustubhe evopapāditam |
grahagrāhyavākyāḥ yajurveda yena krameṇa vihitāḥ, tenaiva krameṇa sāmavede tadaṅgabhūtāni stotrāṇi brāhmaṇe vihitāni, tenaiva ca krameṇa uttarāgranthe stotrāṇabhūtā ṛcaḥ paṭhitāḥ |
grahaśabdaḥ pūrṇa grahe bhavati, tena na śakyāni nyunāni pātrāṇi grahītum (ukthyādiṣu) |
tatra saṃśayaḥ vaikṛtaiste nivartyante, uta anivṛttiḥ samuccaya iti |
kiṃ prāptam ? pratyakṣaśrutyā vaikṛtāścodakaprāptān prākṛtān nivartayitumarhanti |
asti hi teṣāṃ prakṛtiliṅgena grahaṇasaṃyoga iti |
yadi grahasamuccayaśca guṇo vidhīyate, tataḥ prākṛtā eva grahā guṇavikṛtā bhaveyuḥ |
atha graha-saṃyogena abhraho vidhīyate, tato grahakāryaṃ vartate iti prākṛtaṃ nivartayet |
arka nāma grahaṃ gṛhṇāti, mahimānau nāma grahī gṛhṇāti |
ekārthānāṃ hi vikalpo vā bādho vā bhavati |
yāgaṃ prati saṃhalyakāraṇa ete, na nira-pekṣa ekaika eṣāṃ sādhakaḥ |
nahi eṣāṃ pṛthaktvena yāga-saṃbandhaḥ : arkeṇa yajeta, śukreṇa yajeteti |
tasmāt sarveṣāṃ prākṛtānāṃ vaikṛ-tānāṃ ca saṃgrahakaḥ |
yathā prakṛtau aindravāyavā-grahaṇaṃ coditam, maitrāvaruṇagrahaṇaṃ punaśrūyate |
adṛṣṭatvāt kāryasya, na jñāyate pūrvaḥ uttarasya kāryaṃ bhavatīti |
prayogavacanagraha-ṇācca samuccayaḥ; na kevalaṃ maitrāvaruṇādibhiḥ saha, apakaraṇādhītābhyāmidaṃ vadāmyāmi |
nanu grahaṃ saṃkīrya guṇo vidhīyate aśvamedhe sauvarṇarajatābhyāmiti |
iha tarhi, bārhaspatyaṃ gṛhṇātīti devatāvidhānārthe syāt |
yathā agniṣṭuti 'āgneyā grahā bhavanti' iti devatāvidhānaṃ bhavati, evamekavacananāntenāpi, tasyāvivakṣitatvāt |
yathā grahaṃ saṃmārdhati sarvagrahāṇāṃ saṃmārgo'midhīyate, evamapi sarvagrahāṇāṃ devatā vidhīyate |
'āgneyā grahā bhavanti' iti tu vākyamiva śrutvā |
āgneyattā tatra vākyena śrutivicchedena codyamānā yuktaiva |
yathā prakṛtau anuṃ gṛhṇāti, adābhyaṃ gṛhṇāti iti aprākaraṇikaiḥ samuccīyate, evamihāpi vaikṛtāḥ samuccīyeranniti |
'aindravāyavaṃ gṛhṇāti', 'maitrāvaruṇaṃ gṛhṇāti' ityevādīni vākyāni prakṛtau śrūyante, aindravāyavena yajeta, maitrāvaruṇena yaje-teti |
yadyevaṃ śrūyeta, tadā sati lādirāditve vikalpaḥ syāt, kiṃ tarhi ? indravāyū devatā aseti taddhito devatāṃ dyotayantīti bravīti |
[ etacca abhyupetyāpi dṛṣṭārthatvaṃ gṛhṇāteḥ devatāsaṃyogadṛṣṭārthatvādeva śakyate samu-
taduktam 'śakyate cāgṛhīte'pi yatra ca vidadhasthite : dravye'smin devatoddeśituma-dṛṣṭārthatā vidheḥ ||
' (vā. pṛ. 520) ihāpi ca bhāṣyakāroktam 'vibhāgaśrudṛṣṭārtho devatoddeśa' (bhā. pṛ. 1113) |

tasmāt (acoditatvāt) dvitīyādiṣvapi grahaṇeṣu ayameva nyāyaḥ ( 'adṛṣṭārtho devatāsaṃyogaḥ' iti sati cādṛṣṭārthatve-) na caindravāyavo-'yaṃ maitrāvaruṇakāryaṃ vartate iti pramāṇamasti (yainākyārthi vikalpaḥ syāt) |
tasmāt (devatāsaṃyogasaṃpādādṛṣṭabhedāt) minnānyetāni grahaṇāni (medena kartavyānīti samucceyantīti yāvat) |
tacca (saṃnidhānam) sarveṣām (grahāṇām) aviśiṣṭam (tasmāt samuccayo grahāṇāṃ devatānāṃ ceti) |
vikṛtau tu 'aindravāyavaṃ gṛhṇāti' iti codakena prāptāni saṃnihitāni |
itarāṇyapi (bārhaspatyādīni) āmnānasāmarthyāt (saṃnihitānveva) tena tatrāpi sarvāṇi yugapat gṛhṇāti prayogavacanaḥ-saṃnidhānāviśeṣāt |
nanu bṛhaspatirdevatā codaka-prāpteṣu graheṣu vidhīyate (tena tatra madāntaratvābhāvāt anudāharaṇamiti) |
codyati (-) tasyopasarjanabhūtau daṇḍa iti puruṣo prātatvāt |
(uttaravādī āha -) upasarjanā-rtho'ya na śakyate vidhātum, adravyatvāt |
vigrahavākye yadā 'asya devatā' ityayaṃ saṃbandhaḥ, asyaśabdo devatāviśeṣaṇatvena uccāryate tadā parārthamuccā- raṇam (devatāviśeṣaṇārtham) na svārtham |

yadā (tu) bṛhaspatirasya iti (bṛhaspatiśabdena asya- śabdasya saṃbandhaḥ) tadā svārtham (ātmīyamaye bṛhaspati- viśiṣṭatayā vidhātum) uccāraṇam, na parārtham (viśeṣe- ṣaṇārtham) sakṛduccāraṇe ca svārthavat parārthavaccoccāraṇaṃ vidyate |
yadā tu na (asyaśabdaḥ) devatāviśeṣaṇatvenoccāryate (siddhānte,) tadā (asyaśabdaḥ) pradhānabhūtaḥ (eva, na viśeṣaṇam) |
tadā hi na kevalaṃ bṛhaspatipadaṃ tadartham, api tu) devatāpratipādakam (devatāśabdo'pi) tadartham |
tasmāt dvābhyām (viśeṣaṇābhyām) viśiṣṭasahitau (dravyaṃ) vidhīyate (bṛhaspatidevatyaṃ dravyaṃ kuryāt iti) nopasarjanam |
grahaṇavekṣaṇasamyajarajeṣu bhakṣānuvākaḥ yathā- liṅgaṃ ( vibhajya ) viniyoktavyaḥ |
bhāṣyam-- idamāmnāyate ' āśvināgrān gṛhṇīyāt āmayāvinaḥ; śukāgrān gṛhṇīyāt abhiracarataḥ; manyagrān gṛhṇīyāt abhiracyamāṇasya ' iti |
tataḥ anekasya dravyasya yugapat prāsamasāda- yitvā na śakyaṃ yugapat homārthe kartum |
tasmāt grahaṇaśeṣaḥ sādhanam, iti grahaṇaṃ pratikṛṣyamāṇe avaśyaṃ pratikṛṣyam iti |
bhāṣyam-- liṅgam api dṛśyate yathā sādhanaṃ prati- kṛṣyate iti |
kiṃ liṅgam ? ' dhārayeyuḥ tam, yaṃ kāmāya gṛhṇīyuḥ |
aindravāyavaṃ gṛhītvā sādayet, atha taṃ sāda- yet, yaṃ kāmāya gṛhṇīyuḥ ' iti sādhanasyāpi pratikarṣaṃ darśayati |
sūtrā- rthastu-- sādhanamapi pratikṛṣyate sādhanasya grahaṇasattvāt tadapakarṣe'pi vacanātparyāptatvāt iti |
bhāṭṭa-- dhārāgrahaṇāṃ pūrvapūrvaṃ gṛhītvā khare sādayitvā uttarottarasya grahaṇam, sarveṣu ca gṛhīteṣvāsaditeṣu ca paścāt kālāntareṣu krameṇa pradānamityeṣā nityaklaptiḥ |
kāmāya tu śukrādigrahaṇe'pyapakṛṣyamāṇe na grahaṇamātrasya pratikarṣaḥ, api tu sādhanasyāpi |
pūrvagrahāṇāsādane uttarasya grahaṇamupakārakatvāt sādanābhāve āśrayabhūtāgri- ṇasyagrahaṇānupapatteḥ |
sādhananiyamasya ca etadgrahaṇe uttaragrahaṇasahitatve'pi tasyetyarthaḥ klṛptatayā grahaṇaśeṣa- tvāt satrānte tatkaraṇe tadvādhāpatteḥ |
vastutastu ' gṛhītvā sādayati ' iti grahaṇottaraśruteḥ pāṭhakramābhāvācca na pratikarṣe kiñcit bādhakam |
aniṣṭādhikāriṇāṃ tu śubhābhāgena gatirvā, ' grāmaṃ gacchan 0 ' iti nyāyena svargaprāptimātraṃ vā nāsti iti tṛtīyādhikaraṇe varṇitam |
grāmādāgatānāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ paryamikaraṇe aṣṭa upakāraḥ kriyate |
bhā. 2|4|142 pṛ. 413. yathā grāmādāgatānāṃ śāntyai agnilavaṇadadhyakṣatamayateḥ śirasaḥ upari brāhmaṇaṃ śucideśapratiṣṭhāpanaṃ ca |
grāmakāmaḥ : ' māstaṃ caruṃ nirvapet pṛśnīnāṃ dugdhe prāyaścavam ' |
vi. 4|4|4. ' upāsai gāyatā naraḥ ' iti āmakāmāya pratipadaṃ kuryāt |
¤ grāmabhṛtasya anekasvāmyavyaye'pi anyonyāna- pekṣānekasvāmikatvaṃ naiva yujyate |
ārāvāṇaḥ : ( upalāḥ varavaṃṭe iti bhāṣā ) ava- bhṛthadeśe nīyante |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ somaṃ bhakṣayet, neti |
hāriyojane camasināmadhikāraḥ iti manyamānaḥ ( sūtra- kāraḥ ) evaṃ ha syāha āmnāyate bhakṣa iti |

tatra ' yathācamasamanyāṃścamasino bhakṣayanti, athaitasya hāriyojanasya sarva eva lipsante ' ityetat vacanaṃ kiṃ prakaraṇāt aśeṣaviṣayaṃ sat bhāvastuto- 'pi bhakṣaṃ prāpayati, uta svākyapāttacamasiṣvivatvāt na iti saṃdeha, tenaiva tāvat abhiprāyeṇa na vidyate ityāha |
bhāṣyam-- hāriyojanasya vā bhāvastutaṃ bhakṣayitāraṃ manyāmaha |
athaitasya hāriyojanasya sarva eva lipsante ' iti |
yadā hāriyojanasya sarve lipsante, tadā grāvastadupaiti |
vā-- na śakyaṃ sarvaśabdo vinā kāraṇena prākṛta- kartṛmātravacanaḥ san ekadeśe sthāpayitum |
' cama- sinaḥ anyāścamasān yathācamasaṃ bhakṣayanti ' ityanyatra camasinaḥ eva vadati, ' athaitasya hāriyojanasya sarva eva lipsante ' iti |
' sarva eva ' iti evaśabdaḥ sāmarthyāt sarvān pūrvaprakṛtān apekṣate |
ato manyāmaha ' yathācamasam anyāścamasān camasino bhakṣayanti ' ityanena pūrveṇa ' athaitasya hāriyojanasya ' ityetasya ekavākyatā bhavatīti |
tena camasināṃ saṃni- hitānāmeṣa vibhāgo yathācamasamantra, hāriyojane tu sarve eveti |
' yathācamasamanyān ' iti punaḥśruteḥ na kiñcit prayojanamasti anyadataḥ sarvaśabdaviśeṣaṇatvāt |
ye hi anyatra pratyeka rūpeṇa upāttāḥ, teṣu evakāro bhavati |
naitadasti, camasinaḥ eva hāriyojane lipsante iti |
na punaḥ camasinaḥ iti saṃbandhaḥ śakyate vidhātum |
dvau hi saṃbandhau asmin vākye apūrvau na śakyate vidhātum |
' yathācamasam anyān camasān camasino bhakṣayanti ' ityanuvādaḥ |
camasinaḥ : camasān bhakṣayantyeva, te bhakṣyanto yathācama- meva |
atha etasya hāriyojanasya na kevalaṃ camasinaḥ, sarve eveti |
vadan naikadeśe kalpito bhaviṣyati, na ca dvau saṃbandhau apūrvā ekasmin vākye bhaviṣyataḥ |
katham ? mahābhāgo hi hāriyojanaḥ; yasmāt tatra sarve lipsante |
anyāna camasān ekaikaḥ, na te mahābhāgāḥ, nyūnā hāriyojanāditi |
vā-- na yuktaḥ sarvaśabdaḥ : puruṣamātragāmī san adhi- kāreṇa viśeṣitaḥ punaḥ camasiśabdena prayojanāntarādhi- kena satā viśeṣitam |
yāvadyāvat hi śabdaḥ alpaviṣayī kriyate, tāvattāvat śrutirbādhyate |
te'pi ca alpaviṣayatvena pratipādyante hāriyojanasya mahāviṣayatvena praśaṃsāṃ kartum |
ato hāriyojane sarve eva ityetadeva siddham |
tena teṣāmayaṃ bhakṣo māvastṛtu naiva bhakṣayet |
tena sarveṣu vartate, na saṃkoco'sya yujyate |
bhāṭṭa-- bhakṣe samākhyāṃ pramāṇamuktvā vacanamidānī- mabhidhīyate |
'yathācamasamyāṃścamasino bhakṣa- yanti, athaitasya hāriyojanasya sarve eva lipsante' iti śrutam |
tatra lipsāndena upakramasyārthavādatvāt, lipsāmānagrahaṇe aharthatvātpatteśca lakṣaṇayā bhakṣaṇamabhi- dhīyate |
tacca hāriyojane vakṣyamāṇavidhayā vaṣaṭkāranimittaṃ homābhinimittaṃ ca yadyapi prāptam, tathāpi atra viśeṣoddeśe vākyabhedapatteścamasāntarameva sarvakartṛviśiṣṭaṃ vidhīyate |
athavā hāriyojanāntarātprakaraṇe pāṭhāt tadīyabhakṣānuvādenaiva 'purastādaindravāyavasya bhakṣayati' 'sarvataḥ parihāramāśrinaṃ bhakṣayati' ityādivat guṇamātraṃ vidhīyate |
tadiha sarvapadaṃ kiṃ camasimātraparam, kiṃvā prakṛtasarvārthikaparamiti cintāyām, sarvaśabdasya sarva- nāmatvātupasthitaparāmarśitvāttaḥ, camasināmeva ca pūrva- mupasthitatvāt teṣāmeva grahaṇam |
iti prāpte, camasi- śabdasya anyacamaseṣu ekaikasyaiva camasino bhakṣaṇaṃ nyāyyam, atra tu camasināmeṣāṃ ca sarveṣāmeva tat yuktamityevaṃ stutyālambanenaiva upapatteḥ punaḥ sarvapada- saṃkocatvam |
ataśca paramasvena (jagatītalavartinā sarveṇa) vyavahārāsaṃbhavāt āvaśyakatvena prakaraṇādineva prakṛtakarmamātragrahaṇāpattau punaścamasibhirviśeṣaṇe pramā- ṇābhāvaḥ |
na ca evaṃ patnyā api grahaṇāpattiḥ, meṣī- vadeva puṃliṅgena patnyāḥ grahaṇāpatteḥ |
nahi ṛtvijaḥ eva sarvaśabdena grāhya ityatra anyat kiñcit pramāṇamasti |
tasya somabhakṣo vidyate neveti saṃśaye nāstīti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
prāvastṛtaḥ nāma ṛtvijaḥ bhakṣaḥ somabhakṣaḥ na vidyate |
hāriyojano nāma yaḥ somaḥ, tasmin sarveṣāmeva ṛtvijāṃ saṃyogāt 'athaitasya hāri- yojanasya sarve eva lipsante' iti sarvaśabdena saṃtradhasya uktatvāt prāvastṛto'pi sarvaśabdena ukta eva bhavati |
hāriyojano nāma na svatantraṃ pātram, kintu droṇakalaśa eva |
tatra evaṃ viśeṣaḥ ; paridhipraharaṇānantaram ucchetā droṇakalaśena sarvamya āgrayaṇāpātragataṃ somaṃ gṛhṇāti |
vaṣaṭ- kṛte anuvaṣaṭkṛte ca hutvā harati bhakṣam |
taṃ sarve samaśaḥ prativibhajya juhupākāraṃ dhānā bhakṣayanti iti |
'camasino'nyāṃścamasān yathā- camasaṃ bhakṣayanti athaitasya hāriyojanasya sarve eva lipsante' iti ekamevaitadvākyam |
sarveṣāṃ vidhitvāt 'sarve eva lipsante' iti vākyasya sarvavidhānatvāt |

'camasino'nyāṃścamasān yathācamasaṃ bhakṣayanti, athai- tasya hāriyojanasya sarve eva lipsante' iti vākyasya tu sārasakī yojanā-camasināmeṣāṃ bhakṣaṇameva, te ca bhakṣyanto yathācamasameva ityanuvādaḥ |
athaitasya hāriyojanasya na kevalaṃ camasinaḥ; kintu sarve eva ṛtvijo yajamānaśceti |
mahābhāgo hāri- yojanaḥ, yasmāttatra sarve lipsante, anyāṃstu camasān ekaika eva |
prāvastṛtasahitāḥ sarve eva hāriyojane bhakṣa- yitāraḥ |
grāhyagrahaṇaṃ nāma sādhikārasya vidheḥ prayojana- rūpasya saṃnidhismāntaiḥ svayamaprayojanabhūtaiḥ prayojana- prayojanībhāvena anvitābhidhānam (idaṃ prābhākaroktam) |
soma. 5|2|1 pṛ. 406, grāhakamahaṇākhye anvi- tābhidhāne ākāṅkṣā-yogyatā-saṃnidhānāni prayojanāni, na tu śabdopattatvamepi |
vi. 2|2|1 varṇakaṃ 2. 'ghaṭo bhavati' ityatra ākṣitaprayojakavyāpāraṃ prayojyavyāpāramātraṃ vivakṣyate |
vā. 2|2|1|1. pṛ. 378. apavarake ghaṭo nāsti iti niṣedhaḥ apavarakākhyasya niṣedhāśrayasya niṣedhyaghaṭapradeśāt pradeśāntarasya sadbhāvam niṣedhasya ca ghaṭasya pradeśāntare sadbhāvamapekṣate |
su. pṛ. 507. ghaṭo ānīyetām ityukte dvitīyo ghaṭa evānīyetām nāśādiyaṃthā, tathā ghasānau ityatra dvitīyaḥ pumāneva grāhyaḥ |
pūrvapakṣe ratna. 6|1|4. 'ghaṭaṃ karoti' ityatra abhīdhīyamānakarmaśaktyā ākṣitaprayojyavyāpāro vā svayameva ākṣitaprayojyavyāpāro vā kevalaṃ prayojyavyāpāra eva vivakṣyate |
'ghaṭāyonmīlitaṃ cakṣurnahi paṭaṃ na paśyati' iti nyāyena tatra cāritāthrye'pi kalpitasya agrahaṇe kiṃ mānam ? bhūtiḥ |
asya nyāyasyāpyakṣitimatau bahuśaktimatā saha vigrahavivādāyāmavatāra iti |
yathā ghaṭānāṃ kumbhānāṃ mimaśirāṃ vā adriguṇānāṃ vā viśālatā alpe'pi darpaṇe vilokyate, tathā prakṛte'pi |
ghaṭākāśanyāyena upādhyupayeyoḥ parasparapari- cchedakatve anyatarasyāpi pūrṇatvaṃ na yujyate ata upādhi- rapi adhyakṣa eva |
tathā cādhiṣṭhānādhyastayorvibhramasattākatvāt na parasparaparicchedakatvam, kintu itaretaro- ghāyakatvamevāsti |
sanatsu. nī. 4|3, ghaṭākāśanyāyena eko'pyātmā bhinnāpādhiyogena aneko bhāti |
ghaṭādyo hi pratyabhijñāyamānā api avayava- saṃyogalakṣaṇasya asamavāyikāraṇasya darśanāt anityāḥ,
ṛju. pṛ. 252, ghaṭādayo hi svarūpato nopalabdhiyogāḥ, satāmapi ālokavirahe visphāritalocanairapi adarśanāt |
ālokastu avikala- vyāptendriyasya āsanaḥ san upalabdhiyogara eva |
pṛ. 220. ghaṭādīni dravyāntareṇa gairikādinā raktāni saṃyuktasamavetadvāreṇa aruṇādicchabdaiḥ abhidhīyante |
vā. 316|122 pṛ. 683. ghaṭādipadāni ghaṭatvādi- jātisambandhadvārā kāryānvayānubhavajanakāni iti prābhākarāḥ |

yathā niṣpanna- rūpāṇāṃ ghaṭādīnām 'daśa ghaṭā ānīyantām' ityādī ānayanādikriyā'vacchedāt daśatvavattvaṃ syā'nvayaḥ; eva- miha prayājānāṃ niṣpannarūpāṇām utpatti- riktiā'ntarā'vacchedāt saṃkhyā''nvayānupapattiḥ |
ghaṭatvatvaṃ ghaṭetarābhamevatve sati ghaṭaniṣṭhānyo- nyābhāvapratiyogitā'navacchedakatve sati samavetatvam |
ayaṃ nyāyaḥ, na ca sandhyāvandanatyāgajanyapratyavāyapari- hāranimittakaprāyaścittena kathaṃ brāhmaṇyamupācāmiti vācyam |

yugapat ghaṭapaṭasaṃyuktena indriyeṇa ghaṭapaṭaviṣayaika- jñānotpattāvapi jñānajanyadharmāprakāśasya phalasya āśraya- bhūtaghaṭapaṭamedena medāt ghaṭaprakāśāṃśe ghaṭasyānuraktatvaṃ ghaṭaprakāśāṃśe paṭasya iyamedena ubhayorekajñānānuraktatvaṃ yuktam |
yathā ghaṭaniṣṭho dīpo ghaṭasyodaramātraṃ bhāsayati, tathā prakṛte'pi |
kiṃ kaniṣṭhāḥ kimu jyeṣṭhā ghaṭīyantrasya durjanāḥ |
ayaṃ nyāyaḥ. sa0 da0 saṃ0 pātañjaladarśane''mihitaḥ |
sūryodayamārabhya sārdhaghaṭikāyāṃ ghaṭīyantrita- ghaṭabhramaṇanyāyenaikekasyāṃ nāḍyāṃ bhavati |
evaṃ sati aha- rniśaṃ śvāsapraśvāsayoḥ ṣaṭśatādhikaviṃśatisahasrāṇi jāyante ityanyatra vistaraḥ |
nanvevaṃ prakaraṇājñātāttvadananiṣedhavākyārthakathane anārasyādhīta- hiṃsāniṣedhavākyasya anayā prakriyayā itthamartho bhavati |
tathā ca puruṣārthahiṃsāniṣedha eva vākyārtha iti ṛtvarthahiṃsāyāḥ tadaviṣayatvāt tatra notsargāpavādanyāyapravṛttiḥ |
ata idaṃ ghaṭakuṭyāṃ prabhātam iti cenna |
ghaṭaṭo nadītīrā- disthānam, 'ghāṭa' iti bhāṣāyāṃ prasiddhaḥ |
yathā ghaṭakuṭīsthebhyaḥ karagrāhibhyo mītvā rātrau palāyitānāṃ paṇijāṃ dūre gatvā'pi gatvā'pi yā āntivaśāttatra ghaṭakuṭyāmeva prabhātodayasthā prakṛte'pi |
pravargye tate ghṛte payoniṣepeṇa niṣpadyate yacchiṣṭaṃ tat gharmaśabdenocyate |
yathā ghupaṇena bhakṣite kāṣṭhādau hrāsāt kakārādisadṛśacchidreṣu satsu guṇenākṣarāṇi nirmitāni iti mūlataḥ kalpyate tathā prakṛte'pi |
abuddhipūrvakasya hi prāmāṇyaṃ guṇākṣaranyāyena kacid bhavedpi na sārvatrikaṃ bhavet iti baudaḥ |
parimalaḥ 2|2|842 bra. sū. na caivamapi guṇākṣara- nyāyena vedasamānānupūrvīka vākyasya arthāntaravivakṣayā prayoktāri vyabhicāraḥ |
'ghṛtaṃ devānāṃ mastu pitṛṇām' ityayaṃ dīkṣārthā- bhyaṅgasaṃbandhinavanivṛtteḥ arthavādaḥ |
'ghṛtaṃ prokṣaṇam' iti vihite ghṛte prokṣaṇe 'āpo- devīḥ śuddhāḥ sva' iti prokṣaṇyamantraṇo mantraḥ |
(kṛṣṇalamuguñjā- parimitānu suvarṇakaṇān śatasaṃkhyākān ghṛte prakṣipya gāīpatyādau pravaraṇīkaraṇe catvalaṃ siddhamiti jñeyam |
bhā. 10|2|1|104. 'somāraudraṃ ghṛte caruṃ niṣepet śuklānāṃ trīhīṇāṃ brahmavarcasakāmaḥ' |
10|1|9|27-28. ghṛtecchāḥ upadadhāti' iti ghṛtadravyasyopadhāte ghṛtena saṃbhavāt na tu munmayaḥ; ghṛtecchāḥ |
loke śūnyamanaḥkathāsu śrūyate ghoṭārūḍhasya vismṛto ghoṭaḥ iti |

bhā. 6|1|5|22 pṛ. 166. cādīnāṃ nipāto- pasargāṇāṃ pṛthak padatve'pi kevalaprayogitvena svātantryeṇa arthapratipādakatvābhāvāt padāntarātiśayadyotanāthaitvāva- dhāraṇāt tatsamabhivyāhṛtasya nāmapadasya ākhyātapadasya vā tannirapekṣeṇa svārthasaṃbandhātvāt padāntarānvayānupapatteḥ cādiṣabdopahitayoraiva anvayaḥ |
apiśabdārthevācyau vai kaścit 'kumārāśra na payo labhen' 'kumārā apītyarthaḥ |

tantraratne (10|3|12 adhikaraṇe) 'yathā prakṛteḥ parastādupacāryāmāṇaḥ pratyayaḥ svārthe prakṛtyarthānvitameva abhidhatte, tadat caśabdaḥ yasmāt para uccāryate tadartham atrāntarānvitam uccāritatvāt |
evābhidhatte, iti prakṛtipratyayavat caśabdasyāpi mukhyameva śrutitvam |
anyathā purastādapi uccāryamāṇaḥ svārthe kuryāt' ityuktam |
lokevedayoḥ caśabdasya vyapahitatayā'pi prayogadarśanena purastāt prayoge'pi tadarthapratīteriratvāt |
tathā sati sarveṣāmapi nipātānāṃ śrutatvāpattiḥ; sasaṃ- vandhikaśabdamātrasya śrutatvāpattiśca |
soma. 10|6|11. caśabdastvat samuccayasya na paryāya- vacanaḥ |
dupu. 10|3|14|156. caśabdaḥ tu- śabdasya sthāne 'kiñceha bhavataḥ' itivat gamayitavyaḥ |
vā. 3| 4|11|30 pṛ. 164. caśabdaḥ tacchabdāne iha yathā 'kiñceha bhavati' iti |
caśabdaḥ yasmāt para uccāryate tasya arthāntaraṃ śrutyaivāha, na vākyena |
yadi hi vākyena syāt, purastā- dapi uccāryamāṇaḥ etamarthaṃ kuryāt |
caśabdaḥ samuccayaṃ vadan upasarjanatvena bravīti, na
tasmāt yasyopasarjanaṃ caśabdaḥ, ṣoḍaśa kriyāguṇābhyāṃ saṃśrayate |
ṭupū. 10|3|14|56. caśabdaḥ samuccaya brūte, paraṃtu na prādhānyena |
mīnyā. caśabdaḥ samuccayārtho bhavati, na tu samuccayasya nirdeśakaḥ |
yadi hi nirdiṣṭe kriyāguṇeḥ samuccayaḥ saṃvadhyeta |
‘samuccayaḥ śobhanaḥ, samuccayyo dravyaḥ’ iti yathā bhavati, evam ‘ca śobhanaḥ’ ‘ca dravyaḥ’ iti vā bhavi- ṣyati |
tathā yatheha samuccayayoḥ ṣaṣṭhī bhavati, ghavasadi- rayoḥ samuccaya iti evaṃ dhavaḥ khadiraśca ityabhyāmmavi- pyat, na tu bhavati |
ḍupū. 10|3|14|56. caśabdasya nipātatvena avā- cakatvam ( nipātā dyotakāḥ ) |
soma. 6|1|13. caśabdasya yadyapi padatvaṃ na saṃśrayate, tathāpi prayogāniyamāt anabhidhānācca parastādeva prayujyate |
ratna. 10| 3|14|56. caśabda ucyate itaretarayogaḥ pratīyate, sa tathārthaḥ |
mokṣadharme janakayājñavalkya- saṃvāde ( 11|8|1 ṭīkāyāṃ ) avyaktambhayākṛtamāyā- śabalaṃ hārdākāśaḥ |
iti paryāyāḥ triguṇātmakasya kāraṇasya brahmaṇo vācakāḥ |
tatra viśiṣṭe nikuṣṭaṃ cakranābhinyāyena śritaṃ vastu anyathastham |
‘kimavyaktaṃ paraṃ brahma tataśca parastataḥ kim’ iti pṛṣṭaḥ te tvayā ahamiti |
yathā cakrabhrāntihetau kulāla- vyāpāre nivṛtte'pi bhrāntikṣaye vegāśrayādeva bhavati, tathā prakṛte'pi |

śrūyate hīmau jala- carapakṣidampatī dine saṃdhuktau santau yathecchaṃ nadītīre viharataḥ, sūryāstavelāyāmamyataraḥ uḍḍīya nadyāḥ pare pāre gatvā śabdāyate, ityastadanukūlyoḍḍīya pare pāre yāti, parasthaḥ avatāre āyāti, punaḥ parasthaḥ avāramavārataḥ pāraṃ yātvāyāti caivaṃ rātriparyantaṃ kurutaḥ |
dine punarmīlchato rātrau viyujñāte ityevaṃ viṣayavivakṣāyāmayamavatīti |
cakṣuṣī vā etau yajñasya yadājayamāgau’ iti ājyabhāgayoḥ phalārthavādaḥ, na tu phalavidhiḥ darśapūrṇa- māsayoḥ |
vā. 3|2|1|4 pṛ. 747, cakṣuṣaḥ sāmānyam anityatvamagṛhyato'pi rūpagrahaṇaśaktitvaṃ virupyate |
3|4| 4|13 pṛ. 140. yogyatālakṣaṇasaṃbandhena cakṣuṣo grāha- katvāt cakṣurgrāhakarūpasamānadeśasyāpi etadadhiḥ ayogyatvena agrahaṇaṃ yuktam |
su. pṛ. 772. cakṣorojanaṃ saṃskāraḥ na phalaprayuktaḥ ( dīkṣāyām ) |
cakṣurādeḥ : upanasyāpi svābhāvika rūpagrahaṇasāmarthya naiva vihanyate |
bṛhatī. 194. cakṣurādipadānāṃ saṃsargadravyavācakānāṃ paśugaṇasthādiṣu pagetānāṃ nohaḥ |
bhā. 1|3|10-28. cakṣurādiśabdā na golakavācakāḥ, kintu rūpadarśanasāmarthyapatejomātrādi- vācakāḥ |
home bhūyate 'caturakhattaṃ juhoti' iti, na homārya puro- ḍāśo sonāvye vā |
aṣṭākapālādīnāṃ haviṣvāt 'dvirhaviṣo'vadyati' iti avadāne gṛhīte codanā'ntareṇa tatsaṃskārārthopastaraṇa- midhāraṇegrahaṇāt caturakhattaṃ niṣpannam |
vā. 4|4|6|9 pṛ. 340. yatra punaḥ pradhānadravyāt caturakhattan- mantreṇa na caturakhattaṃ bhavati, tatra pradhānadravyāt catura- vadātavyam |
caturakhattamiha hotavyaṃ na itastato vā caturakhadāttvamiti |
caturakhattacodanayā arthāpasādāne saṃkhyāmātram 'dvirhaviṣaḥ' iti vidhīyate, na dvitvaviśiṣṭamava- dānam |
caturakhattavākye caturakhattānuvādena homavidhiḥ iti pakṣe dvāvadānavākye dvāvadānaviṣayasyamave'pi ca
-111. caturtha caturgṛhītam anuyājārtham itaratra prayājārtham iti siddhaṃ bhavati |
bhāṭṭa. 4|1|10. caturtha adhyāye prayogarūpā vidheravasthā nirūpitā |
kaṇikā. pṛ. 412. caturtha adhyāye prayojakā- prayojakakṣaṇaṃ vṛttam, tatra prasartavyam |
dupū- bhāṣyakāreṇa caturthe'dhyāye prayojakaprayojakakṣaṇaṃ vṛttamityuktam, tadayuktam |
kutaḥ ? kratvarthapuruṣārtha- jijñāsā hi sūtrakāreṇa pratijñātā |
prayojakaprayojakampi pratijñātām ' arthe sama- vaiṣamyam' ( 4|1|8|121 ) ityatra |
itarathā dvādaśāhapadam ( tṛtīyasya aṣṭe caturthasya catvāra iti ) ekaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ syāt |
yāvat ( tantraratnānusāreṇa ) śeṣī nāpadhāyate, na tāva
na dravyaprayojakatvam, abhidhāraṇasya tu prayojakaṃ syāt |
tataśca vājapeye prājāpatyapaḍā'bhidhāraṇārthe prayājaśeṣaṃ dhārayituṃ pātrā'ntaramatyāvaśyakaṃ syāt |
nanu pratipattiridha dhāraṇaṃ prayujyate eva, anyathā vaiguṇyaprasaṅgāt, tasya cānyāvyatvāt |
tadvi evamartham, yadi cit teṣu prayukteṣu tasya yajamānasya pramādasaṃbhave pātrāṇāṃ paridhānīye karmaṇi (anyeṣu) vihitā pratipattirlupyeta tataśca vaiguṇyaṃ syāditi |
yadi pratipattiḥ na dhāraṇasya prayojikā, tataḥ pratipattilopamanāhatya kasya cidekasya pātraiḥ prayogaḥ syāt |
satyamukte śrutavatā, kintu atra prayāja- śeṣasya ṛtupaśuvapā'bhidhāraṇaṇena pratipattiḥ siddhā iti na dhāraṇamarthavat |
‘ pratyābhyāṃ śruvaḥ pūrvasya kartā ’ (pā0 1|4|40) ahapratīpūrvakaśrudhātusamabhivyāhāre dhātvarthapratiṣṭhājanaka- yācanakartuḥ saṃpradānatvam |
‘ anupratigṛṇaśca ’ (pā0 1|4|41) pratyayapūrvaka- gṛṇāteḥ samabhivyāhāre pūrveśanādikartuḥ saṃpradāna- tvam |
‘ adhvaryuḥ hotre'nugṛṇāti pratigṛṇāti ’ (hotā śaṃsati tamadhvaryuḥ protsāhayatītyarthaḥ :) iti dhātulakṣyaprotsā- hanavyāpyamānatvāt |

“ yatra tu dhātvarthakarmavyāpyamānasya asaṃbhavyanya- nānyaḥ, tatra upapadavibhaktiḥ tādarthyādilakṣaṇayā upapadārthe anvayena pradhānakriyāyāmanvayatvāt, ‘ muktaye hariṃ bhajati ’, ‘ bhaktirjñānāya kalpate ’ ityādī |
atra kalpita- prāptikriyā'nvayena śatrumajanādikriyāyāṃ kārakatvena sākṣādanvayāt sādhyatvamātre lakṣaṇikatvācca ” iti vaiyākaraṇāḥ |
anye tu atra caturthyā nopapadavibhakti- tvam, kintu sādhyatvalakṣaṇyā kārakavibhaktitvameva |
ata eva ‘ savaitryameḥ kāmebhyo darśapūrṇamāsau ’ ityādī sādhyatvena bhāvanā'nvayaḥ aṅgīkriyate ityāhuḥ |
pare tu tatrāpi sarvān kāmān ityatra upapadavibhaktitvameva ityāhuḥ |
tat ‘ agnimādhatte ’ ityādī dvitīyāyā api upapada- vibhaktitvapā upekṣaṇīyameva |
evam ‘ vātāya kapilā vidyut ’ ityatra kalpita- jñānakriyā'nvayena ‘ phalebhyo yāti ’ ityādī apratyayamāna- tumunnantakṛtkalpitāharaṇākriyā'nvayena upapadavibhaktiḥ |
‘ tumarthācca bhāvavacanāt ’ (pā0 2|3|116) ‘ yāgāya yāti ’ ityādī kalpitadarśanādikriyā'nvayena upapadavibhaktitvam |
‘ yāgasādhyaṃ yānam ’ ityarthe tu pūrvavat kārakavibhaktitvameva |
‘ janardanāyārghyam ’ itya- trāpi upapadavibhaktitvam, pakṣe kārakatvaṃ ca |
‘ namaḥ svastisvāhāsvadhālaṃvaṣadyogācca ’ (pā0 2|3|16) iti vihitā namaḥpadādiyoge caturthī upapadavibhaktiḥ |
yathā ‘ haraye namaḥ, svayaṃbhuve namaskṛtya ’ harimanukūlayitumityarthaḥ |

ityādiprayogācca sūktaprakāśārthatvaṃ tyajyamānahaviḥ saṃbandhitva- rūpaṃ ca devatatvaṃ dvividhaṃ taditatvāvyam, ‘ sā'sya devatā ’ (pā0 4|2|24) ityanuśāsanena devatā'dhikāre ‘ agnerḍhak ’ (pā0 4|2|133) ityādibhiḥ sūtraiḥ aneka- ḍhagādipratyayavidhānāt |
‘ sā'sya devatā ’ ityatra sūktadvividhoḥ paṭhyatanirdiṣṭatvena viśeṣaṇatvapratītāvāpi uktaprayogeṣu sāmānādhikaraṇyena agnyādipadārthaviśeṣya- tvena pratīyate |
tena taddhitasya devatātvaviśiṣṭāgnyādi- viśiṣṭasūktahavirvācakatve siddhe nāgṛhītaviśeṣaṇanyāyena devatātve śaktiḥ |
evam ‘ agnaye svāhā ’ ityādāvapi svāhāśabdārthahavistyāge agnerviśeṣaṇatvena pratīteḥ : saṃbandhāntaratvābhāvena devatātvenaiva viśeṣaṇatā iti tatra caturthyāḥ śaktiḥ |
nedaṃ vārtikaṃ caturthyā devatātve śaktibodhakam, kintu devatāpratipādakāntaralakṣaṇaṃ sat caturthīmantravarṇādau devatālākṣaṇikatvaparam |
‘ tatra ‘ agni- devatā vāto devatā ’ ityādī agnyādīnāṃ devatātva- prakārakabhānāt ubhayarūpe devatātve śaktiḥ |
‘ sūktaprakā- śyo'gniḥ, dravyatyāgasaṃbandhī vā ’ iti bodhaḥ |
taddhitasya tu haviḥ : agnyādiniṣṭhatvenopāntatvaṃ tyāgādikalpanāt tato durbalatvam |
caturthyāstu tyajyamānadravyoddeśyatva- viśiṣṭapratipattītvarūpasaṃpradānatvavācinyāḥ pratigrahītṛtva- tyāgena ekadeśalakṣaṇayā tato'pi durbalatvam |
‘ viṣṇuṃ yajati ’ ityādī dvitīyāyāstu uddeśyatvamātravācinyāḥ viśiṣṭe lākṣaṇikatvāt durbalatvam |
mantrakarmasaṃbandhajñānā- nupapattikalpyamantraprakāśakadharmasaṃbandhajñānānupapattikalpya- mantraprakāśakadharmasaṃbandhajñānānupapattikalpya - devatātvam iti ( mantrasya ) atyantaṃ durbalatvam |
atra taddhitādiyuktākye devatāvidhiḥ apūrvaḥ iti ke cit |
yāgavidhineva dravyasāmānasyaiva devatāsāmā- nyasyāpi ākṣepāt indrādidevatāviśeṣaniyamaparatayā niyamavidhiḥ ityāhuḥ |
ata eva indrādītiprātipadiko- ttarataddhitana indrāgrirūpaprātipadikārthadvayaniṣṭhamekaṃ dhyā''jya- vṛtti devatātvaṃ pratipādyate |
evaṃ mahendrapadattarataddhitana mahendrasyaiva devatātvam iti tatra na indrasya devatātvamiti |
tena devatāyāḥ prayogasaṃbandhitvam iti prakṛtivikṛtisaṃbandhinigemyapi vaidhapadasiddhiḥ |
‘ caturthī saṃpradāne ’ ( pā0 2|3|13 ) iti sūtrāt saṃpradānārthikā caturthī bhāvanā''nvaye |
tacca ‘ karmaṇā yamabhiprati sa saṃpradānam ’ ( pā0 1|4| 32 ) iti sūtre nirūktam |
dānakriyākarmakārakena yam abhiprati saṃpradāti sa saṃpradānam iti sūtrārthaḥ |
saṃpra- dīyate asmai iti anyarthasaṃjñābalāt dānakriyālābhaḥ |
tathā ca tyajyamānadravyoddeśyatve sati svīkāratvaṃ saṃpra- dānatvam iti nyāyasudhākārādayaḥ |
‘ viprāya gāṃ dadāti ’ ityatra lakṣaṇasamanvayaḥ : sphuṭaḥ |
na ca tatra pramāṇābhāvaḥ; śiṣṭācārasyaiva pramāṇa- tvāt |
ata eva pūrvadalama indrādidevatā- yāmitivākyam, ataḥ svīkarite tatra pratigrahasya navame niṣedhāt |
ata eva tyajyamānadravyoddeśyatvam uktavidha- mindrādirūpe arthe śabde ca |
tyāgakālīnacaturthyantapado- ccāraṇakarmatvarūpaṃ vā devatātvaṃ taddhitavācyaṃ vṛddhabhya- hārāt |
tātve lakṣaṇā iti tasyāḥ tato ( caturthīḥ taddhitāt ) daurbalyamuktvākare |
vikretrādau ca svīkāraste'pi pūrva- dalenaivatyābhāvāt āyadaḻam |
tathocca uttaparaṃparāsaṃbandhena viṣayatāghaṭitasāmānādhikara- ṇyena ca tyāgadārako bhāvanā'nvayaḥ |
evaṃ ca etādṛśa- lakṣaṇākrānte yatrayatra caturthīprayogaḥ tatra sarvatra lakṣaṇe |
vaiyākaraṇavatyāstu — yatkriyākarmasaṃbhavajanyaphalabhāgi- tvena uddeśyaṃ yat, tat tatkriyāsaṃpradānam |

‘ viprāya gāṃ dadāti’ ityatra dānakriyākarmakārakena godravyeṇa yaḥ svatvāravyo viṣayaḥ saṃbandhaḥ, tajanyaṃ phalaṃ sukhādi, tadvā- śitvarūpeṇa uddeśyatvaṃ vipre iti sa dānakriyāsaṃpradānam iti lakṣaṇasamanvayaḥ |
pitṛsvargoddeśena brāhmaṇasaṃpradānaka- dhanadāne pituḥ svargādirūpaphalabhāgitve'pi na saṃpradāna-
vipsite caturthī ityeva ubhayopapatteḥ sūtravaiyarthyam ityā- śayāt |
na caivam adyādipādāpavādaviṣaye- 'pi prayogadvyāpattiḥ; tadaṃśe apratyākhyānasya bhāṣyasiddha- tvāt |
bhāṣyakāro hi adyādīnāṃ na svarūpeṇa apavāda- viṣayatāṃ 'kriyaṃ gacchati' ityatra dvitīyāniyāmanāpatteḥ |

apitu saṃpradātatvena prāpta eva panthāḥ strī ca, tatra 'panthānaṃ gacchati, striyaṃ gacchati' iti dvitīyāniyamaḥ; iti prati- pādayan 'asaṃprāpte karmaṇi dvitīyācaturthyau bhavataḥ' iti vaktavyam' ityāha |
ataḥ siddhaṃ dhātvarthatā'navacchedakaṃ yat kriyāphalam, tadāśrayatvameva evamādisthale vārtikaṃ saṃpradānatvam iti |
na ca 'tādarthye caturthī' ityanena gatārtha- tvam, tumuneva tādarthyāsādhanā cchā uttavā sādhutvāye prathamātikrame kāraṇābhāvena prathamāprāptau caturthīvidhisārtha- kyāt |
na ca śuddhabhāve eva ghañ ṇutvātha tādarthyacaturthya- papatteḥ |
'bhāvavacanāśca' iti sūtrārthyam, kriyārthyāṃ kriyāyāṃ viśeṣavihitena tumunā ghaño bādhāpatteḥ, tadanto- pari tādarthyacaturthyaprasakteḥ |
ataḥ tādarthyārthe ghañāderapi tadarthe vidhāne kṛte prathamācādhārthe caturthīvidhisārthakyāt |
evam 'namaḥsvastisvāhāsvadhā'laṃvaṣadyogācca' (pā0 2|3|16) iti śāstreṇa emiḥ śabdayoge caturthī syāt ityarthakena 'haraye namaḥ' ityādī caturthī |
na ca tādarthyacaturthyena ‘brāhmaṇāya dadhi’ ityādāviva gatārthatvam, namaḥpadyoge ṣaṣṭhīmyācaturthyatvena namanāthakapadantayoge vā caturthī- nyāvartakatvena ca sārthakyāt |
yadā tu namasaḥ dhātvartha- tvam, tadā dhātoḥ saṃsargaghaṭakatvatātparyagrāhakāt kāraka- vibhaktitvena 'devān namaskaroti' ityādau karmārthakā dvitīyā'pi nānupapannā |
prajābhyaḥ svasti, agnaye svāhā, pitṛbhyaḥ svadhā, daityebhyo hariralam |
upalakṣaṇaṃ ca prabhu-samartha-śaktādiśabdānām, ‘tasmai prabhavati’ iti prayogāt |

evam 'manyakarmaṇyanādare vibhāṣā'prāṇiṣu' (pā0 1|3|17) ityanena prāṇivarjite manyateḥ karmaṇi tira- skārarūpānadare vivakṣite caturthī syāt ityarthakena 'na tvāṃ tṛṇāya vā manye' ityatra vaikalpikī caturthī |
tathā ca tṛṇasadṛśakarmeti tatkarmakaṃ jñānam ityarthaḥ |
tvatkarmakajñāne tṛṇasadṛśakarmabheda atra tvayi tṛṇasadṛśabhede paryavasyati |
tatra ca anādaravivakṣāyām 'tvāṃ tṛṇa- sahaśamapi na manye' ityarthaḥ |
atra manye ityupādānāt ‘manye’ ityatra na caturthī |
atra 'aprāṇiṣu ityapanīya nau-kāka- anna-śuka-sṛgālavatsyeṣu iti vācyam |
tena aprāṇiṣve'pi ‘na tvāṃ nāvam ahaṃ vā manye’ ityādau na caturthī |
prāṇiṣve'pi ca 'na tvāṃ śune manye' ityādau bhavatyeva caturthī |
na caivaṃ manyatikarmatvāviśeṣatvāt yuṣmacchabdādapi caturthyāpattiḥ, anādare ityasya karmaviśeṣaṇatvena anā- daravyañjake karmaṇi caturthīvidhivrateḥ tadapabhaṅgāt |
'yadaye ca prajāpataye ca sāyaṃ juhoti' iti caturthyā kevalasyāme- devatātvaprāpikā agnyoritiritimantravarṇaiḥ dyotitatva- viśiṣṭasyāgnerdevatātvāprāpakaḥ |
caturthyantedevatāprādhānyam iti nyāyena karmaṇa eva sarvabhūtoṣikṣitatvahetutvena sarvātiśayatva- manivāyam ityāśaṅkāyām |
vā. 1|3|15 pṛ. 205. caturthīnirdeśe devānāṃ devatātvaṃ vākyena, taddhitanirdeśe śrutvā |
caturtha daśa paurṇamāsāmāhutayo hūyante trayodaśā- māvāsyāyām ' āhavanīyagatavaṣaṭkārāhutipariṇa- mevedam |
pañca prajāpāḥ, dvau ājyabhāgau, sviṣṭakṛt, trayo'nūyājāḥ, pradhānāhutiriti pañcadaśa paurṇamā- syām |
saunāyasya sahānūyājāt pradhānāhutidayaṃ śeṣaṃ samānam iti trayodaśa amāvāsyāyām |
'caturdaśabhirpati' cayane kṛṣṭe deśe grāmyānyarāṇyāni ca bījāni caturdaśabhirnaivapani |
caturdaśyādyupavāsaphale iva agnihotrādiphale'pi janmāntaravāsanodbhavatvāt kāmanāsaṃbhavāt śrādīnām |
caturthakaraṇam āgneyapuroḍāśasyaiva darśapūrṇa- māsayoḥ: 'āgneyaṃ caturthī karoti' |
vi. 3|1|16, catu- rthākaraṇaṃ darśapūrṇamāsayorevāmeyapuroḍāśasya bahūnāmtvijāṃ vibhāgārtham, nirdeśa 'idaṃ brahmaṇaḥ' ityādiḥ bhāgānāma- sāṃkaryārthaḥ |
kṛṣṇaleṣu tu brahrateṣāṃmatvijāṃ vibhāga eva nāsti brahmaṇa eva samarpaṇīyatvanirdeśo'pi nāvaśyakaḥ iti tau na bhavataḥ |
vaiśvadevacarī kāmye śatrukṣayārthe caturthākaraṇe gṛhyate spaṣṭahitaśamyā, mantraśca 'idamahaṃ brahmabhāgaṃ gṛhyāmi, idamahamadhvaryubhāgaṃ gṛhyāmi' ityādiḥ |
'puroḍāśaṃ caturthā karoti', āgneyaṃ caturthī karoti' anayopa- saṃhāraḥ |
bhāṣyam— darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ śrūyate 'idaṃ brahmaṇaḥ, idaṃ hotuḥ, idamadhvaryoḥ, idamamīyaḥ' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kimatvijāṃ vibhāgaḥ parikrayāya, uta bhakṣārthayeti |
ya eva śrutasya utsarge doṣaḥ, sa eva aśrutaparikalpanāyām |
vā— puroḍāśasya caturthākaraṇe 'idaṃ brahmaṇaḥ' ityādinirdeśaḥ śrūyate |
kathaṃ ca tattat brahmādipadyeyaṃ bhavati yadi tebhyo na dīyate, tena dānaṃ vihitam |
tatu kim ṛtvijāṃ yatheṣṭaviniyogārthe parikrayāya āmnāyate, atha bhakṣyamāṇaśeṣapratipatyarthamiti |
nahi atra 'yajamānapadyamā iḍāṃ prāśnanti' itivat dravyaprādhānyaṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ vā śrūyate |
tasmāt dravyāṇāṃ karma- śeṣatvāt karmayutebhyaśca dānāt antareṇāpi parikrayaśruti dakṣiṇādānavat parikrayārthamiti |
bhāṣyam— 'eṣā vai darśapūrṇamāsayordakṣiṇā' iti dakṣiṇāsaṃsthāvacca parikrayārthe manyāmahai |
kathambhāva ? 1 prabhavatā hi śakyaṃ dātum, na aprabhavatā |
kathaṃ na prabhutvam ? 1 saṃkṣipata hi yaja- mānena 'devatāyai etat' iti |
na ca devatāyai saṃkalpa- tena śiṣṭāḥ sveneva vyavaharanti |
atha yaduktaṃ na śrūyate bhakṣayitavyamiti, yāvāṃ śrutasya utsarge doṣaḥ, tāvān aśrutaparikalpanāyāmiti |
tatra bhāgāḥ brahmādīnāmupakuryuḥ, brahmādayo vā bhāgānām |
brahmādibhiḥ bhāgānāmupakurvantiḥ na kiñcit dṛṣṭam, bhāgestu brahmādīnāmupakārakaiḥ śakyate kena cit prakāreṇa dṛṣṭa upakāraḥ kartuṃ bhakṣya- māṇaiḥ |
kaḥ punarapa- kāra iti cet, tṛtānāṃ karmaśeṣaparismāpane sāmarthya bhavatīti |
anyeṣāṃ vyākhyāṃ duṣayitumāha- ) 'brahmādirbhāgānā- mupakurvantiḥ na kiñcit dravyam' ityuktaṃ tad dravyakṣa- ṇasyāpekṣitasya dṛṣṭatvāt |
( atra ānandāśramīye ṭippaṇī 'dṛṣṭaminena kartṛsaṃskāramātrārthatvaṃ na vadati' ityādi- rūpā paddhatiḥ pratīyate bhāti |
vayaṃ tu 'dṛṣṭami- tyuktaṃ vadati' ityasya sthāne 'dṛṣṭamityuktaṃ vadati' iti vārtike pāṭhaṃ kalpayāmaḥ |
ata eva 'dravyakṣaṇasya' ityā- dinā prayukto hetuḥ saṃgacchate, ṭippaṇīpāṭhe tu asaṃgataḥ syāt hetuḥ) |
na ca avaśyaṃ bhakṣaṇena teṣāmupa- kriyate |
sarvatra ca dravyasaṃskārārthaṃ bhakṣasya vakṣyati (12|1|15| 31-32 ityatra |
32 sūtre 'nānyathātvāt' ityatra evamuktaṃ na saḥ : [ śeṣabhakṣaḥ ] vṛttyarthaḥ, nahi alaṃ kṛtye |
satyaṃ bhāgānāṃ pratipattiḥ, tathāpi tu prakṛta- kartavyamasya prayojanāpekṣāvelāyāṃ dṛṣṭe sati ahya- daurbalyāt dṛṣṭaḥ eva kartṛṇāṃ sāmarthyarūpaḥ saṃskāraḥ kalpyate |
gṛhṇapi ca nītvā yāvat bhakṣaṇaṃ na kriyate, tāvat tadupayogāt anupa- kāraḥ |
tena avaśyaṃ sudūramapi gatvā bhakṣaṇe paryavasita- vyam |
tatra prathamātikrame kāraṇābhāvāt yogyatāvaśena ca vyādeśādārabhrāntabhakṣaṇasamāpanasya avaśyaṃ kartavyatvāt brahmādīmeva bhakṣaṇena upakartavyamiti gamyate |
śeṣa- syāpi ca kṣapaṇāpekṣasya bhakṣaṇameva kṣapaṇaṃ yogyatā avadhāyate |
bhāṣyam- aya yat dakṣiṇāsaṃstava iti, nyāyādeśa- sāmānyāt tadaparikriyāyai'pi bhaviṣyati |
vā-- dakṣiṇā iti prātaṣkiopakārāpekṣayā 'brahmaṇaḥ' ityādirnirdeśāva bhaviṣyati |
'svāmī hi dravyadānena pari- krīyaṇīta, na sviyaha |
svāmitvaṃ kasya cid, dattaṃ devatāyai haviryataḥ |
ānayaṃtyave satrājñabhūtā- yevikāre na kartavyam, pratipatyarthave tu kartavyamiti |
bhāṭṭa- āgneyasya puroḍāśasya caturdhākṛtasya 'idaṃ brahmaṇa iheta' ityādimantravarṇakalpito vibhāgarūpo nyāyādeśaḥ śrutaḥ |

sa kiṃ dakṣiṇārūpatayā parikriyārthaḥ san ṛtviksaṃskārārthaḥ, uta bhakṣaṇarūpatayā pratipatyarthaḥ san śeṣasaṃskārārthaḥ iti cintāyām, bhakṣasyāśravaṇāt 'brahmaṇaḥ' ityādipīḍityā ca vāsiṣṭhādivat ( ? ) brahmādīnāṃ svāmitvagatam, tasya ca dānamantareṇa anu- papatteḥ, tasya ca tvatpakṣe'pi puroḍāśe svitkṛdadeva svīkārakalpakalopapatteḥ, somacamasavata ṛtviksaṃskārārthe dakṣiṇādānavidhivirevātra kalpyate |
ata eva 'eṣā vai darśapūrṇamāsayordakṣiṇā' ityapi liṅgamupapadyate |
iti prāpte, sakalasyaiva puroḍāśasya agneye tyaktatvāt anīśro yajamāno na śaknoti anyāstena pari- kretum |
ataḥ tava mate punaḥsvīkāro dānamānatiśceti anekakalpanā |
svikṛti tu tyāgasya śrutvā svīkāra- kalpane'pi na doṣaḥ |
arthe parikalpya apekṣitaśeṣaprati- pattirūpaṃ bhakṣaṇameva brahmādikartṛkaṃ māntravarṇikavidhinā vidhīyate |
avaśyaṃ ca ānatirapi anena bhakṣaṇopayogi- tvena avarjanīyā, na tu gṛhasuvarṇādivat kriyā'ntaropa- yoginī, ayogyatātvāt |
ataśca āvaśyakabhakṣaṇameva saṃbandhaghaṭakatvena kalpyate, na kriyā'ntaraṃ samarpaṇādigaura- vāt |
tena tu gṛhītvā svayamanyadvārā vā bhakṣaṇaṃ saṃpādanīya-
āvaśyakabhakṣaṇasyaiva tarkatarkasya prati- pattilaupapattau kriyā'ntarakalpane gauravāt |
caturdhākaraṇaṃ yathā miśradevatvāta aindre na bhavati, tathā upāṃśuyājājyasya miśradevatvāt noktaṃ |
aindre'pi abhyāse 'indra- pītasya' ityevaṃ samantrakaṃ bhakṣaṇam |

tyāgasya vyāsajyavṛtti- tve'pi pānasya pītapadasthitasvīkārasya vā pratyekavṛtti- tvena sthitatvāt ekena padena vyapadeṣṭuṃ śakyatvāt tyāgasya hutāhutasamudāyaviṣayatvena bhakṣaṇamāṇātāvayava- mātraviṣayatvābhāvāt na pītapadena tyaktalakṣaṇa |
ataḥ caturdhākaraṇaviṣayatvābhāvāt tasyāpi samantrakaṃ bhakṣaṇam iti prāpte |

kau. 3|2|18|139 (40) . caturdhākaraṇanyāyena agnimindhanaprakāśanārthāmicetyanuvacanavat kāmye sāmi- dhenyanuvacane anuprayogavaśāt prayogamadhyāpyamincanā- dhīnatvaṃ karmāntarabhūtasyāpi kāmyasya sāmidhenyanuvacanasya ityuktam |
su. pṛ. 1058. # dvidevatye ca caturdhākaraṇā- dhikaraṇanyāyena kevalasya pūṣṇo devatātvābhāvāt yatra kevalaḥ pūṣā tatraiva peṣaṇam |
bhā. 3|1|15|26-27. caturdhā- karaṇavidhau āgneyaśabdena dvidevatyo na gṛhyate kintu āgneya eva ekadevatyaḥ |

yathā gohiraṇyādirūpaṃ bahudhanaṃ caturdevade deyaṃ bhavatīti kasya cidāturdhavanaṃ śrutvā kaścinmugdho 'vedāścatvāraḥ' ityahaṃ jāne, makhaṃ deyamiti vadan tu lebhe tat, pratyutapahāstaṃ prāta; tathā yaḥ saccidānandarūpaṃ pratyagmicaṃ brahmavetyādida- mātrābhijñastadarthamiṣṭo vā tattvaviccābhimānena taddati- micchati, na sa tāmeti upahasanīyaśca bhavatīti jñeya- miti |
sāṃkhyapātañjaladarśanayośca hānam, hānam heyatvetuḥ, hānopāyaśceti catvāro vyūhāḥ pratipādyā bhavanti |
tatra trividhaṃ duḥkhaṃ heyam, tadatyantanivṛtti- rhānam, prakṛtipuruṣasaṃyogadvārā cāviveko heyahetuḥ, vivekakhyātistu hānopāya iti |
cikitsāśāstre tu rogaḥ, ārogyam, nidānam, bhaiṣajyamiti catvāro vyūhatvena proktā iti |
tathā''nyatrāpi śāstre yathāsaṃbhavaṃ caturvyūha- muhanīyamityevamasya nyāyasyāvatāra iti |
' vi. 3|14. caturhotrā paurṇamāsyā- mabhimṛśet, pañcahotrā'māvāsyāyām' ayaṃ vyavasthāvidhiḥ kartavyaḥ |
bāla. pṛ. 17. caturhotra- pañcahotramantrāmyāmimarśanapūrvaprayuktam, na samudāya- prayukte darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ |
catuṣkapalālānāṃ vāruṇīnāṃ medena prayogaḥ sāhi- tyasyāvivakṣitatvāt na sahaprayogaḥ |
saṃkarṣa. 2|4|15; 'catuṣpathe juhoti, eṣa vā agnīnāṃ ṣaḍviśo nāma, abhrivatve juhoti' |
'catuṣṣiśadjino devacampoḥ' ityādikaṃ aśvamedhe savanīyāśvasya kṛte agrigupreme vikalpena paṭhanīya |
ke. codakaprāptatve'dhomapratiṣedhe, paryudāsādhikaraṇapūrvapakṣanyāyena pratyakṣaśiṣṭamapratiṣedhe ca catuṣṣiśanmantrapratiṣedhanyāyena anivāryaṃ vikalpaḥ |
tathāhi 'kiṃ tena hemagirinā rajatā'driṇā vā yatrāśritāśca taravastattva eva |
manyāmahai malayameva yadāśrayeṇa kaṃkolanimbakuṭajā api candanāḥ syuḥ |
candrātapasya candraprakāśasya yo malaḥ andhakāraḥ, tannyāyena yaḥ pravāsaḥ kiñcitkāśayuktaḥ, tena malinīkṛtaḥ kṛṣṇapakṣaḥ iti akṣarārthaḥḥ) |
yathā sarvadevakāraṇasya rudrasya yā śaktiścandrikānyāyena tadudbodharūpiṇī svādhīnavattve prasiddhā, saiva bhavānīti |
yathā- 'candrajyotsnā-viśadapuline saikate'sminsaravyā vādyūtaṃ cirataramabhūt siddhayunoḥ kayościt |
eko vakti prathamanihataṃ keṭame kaṃsamanyaḥ sa tvaṃ tattvaṃ kathaya bhagavan ko itastatra pūrvam |
camasa iti ādānārthasya cameroṇādike adhikaraṇasādhane aṣan pratyaye kṛte bhraṣṭavelāyāṃ bhūtabhaviṣyaddarśanānāṃ ca cittasaṃnve apekṣyamāṇe bhūtavartamānayordarśanāt bhaviṣyattvamanīyate |
nānyathā hetuścamasaḥ pretu ityetasya anuṣṭhānaṃ śakyate |
'ṛtapeye 'audumbaraḥ somacamasau dakṣiṇā, sa priyāya sagotrāya brahmaṇye deyaḥ' |
camasaḥ camyate bhakṣyate somo'smin pātraviśeṣe saḥ |
camasaḥ praṇayanāśritatvāt praṇayane pravṛtte pravartate vikṛtiṣu |
tatra madhyataḥ kāriṇā hotṛbrahmadrātṛyajamānānāṃ catvāraḥ, maitrāvaruṇa-brāhmaṇācchaṃsi-potṛ-neṣṭṛ-acchāvāka-āgnīdhrāṇāṃ hotṛkāṇāṃ ṣaṭ |
camasāḥ prātaḥsavane śukrāmanthigrahacāre acchāvāka-camasavarje nava savanamukhyāḥ |
jyotiṣṭome ye camasādhvaryavo bhavanti, te kiṃ camasān juhuyuḥ acyuryareva vā camasān juhuyāt iti camasādhvaryukarmajñanāthe vicāre pūrvapakṣasūtramidam |
camasān somacamasān camasādhvaryavaḥ juhuyuḥ; samākhyānāt camasā-dhvaryavaḥ iti nāmadheyāt yaugikāt |
yadi teṣāṃ homa-sahitacamasahomarūpaṃ karma na syāt camasādhvaryūsamākhyā teṣāṃ vyarthā syāt |

atra sudha-camasādhvaryūsamākhyānāt sarveṣu camasa-kāryeṣu camasādhvaryūviniyogapratīteḥ : camasān iti dvitīyoktasya ca karmatvasya vyāpāramātravācakatvena upapatteḥ camasān camasādhvaryavo 'vyāpārayeyuḥ' iti kriyādhyāhāreṇa sūtrārthaḥ iti |
sa nyāyaḥ yasmin tat homakarmma tannyāyam, tasya bhāvaḥ tannyāyatvaṃ tasmāt |
nyāyaśca 'adhvaryūpadārthamadhvaryūḥ kuryāt ādhvaryava homaḥ' iti māṣyoktaḥ |
'sāmānya-samākhyāsāpekṣaviśeṣasamākhyā sāmānyasamākhyāṃ na bādhate' iti nyāyo vā vārttikakāroktaḥ |
tannyāyatvāt adhvaryukarmatvāt homasya' iti kutūhale vyākhyātam |
camase ca camasādhvaryoḥ anyasya darśanāt na camasādhvaryūḥ camasaṃ juhuyāt |
'camasāṃścamasādhvaryave prayacchati, tān sa vaṣaṭkarṇe harati' iti vacanena homottaraṃ camasaṃ camasādhvaryeve prayacchati iti gamyate |
'yo vā adhvaryoḥ svaṃ veda svānaiva bhavati, camaso'sya svam' ityuktam |
camasa'sya svam iti tu bruvan adhvaryoḥ camasena homaṃ darśayati |
tasmāt camasādhvaryo'nyasyaiva adhvaryoḥ camasahomaḥ karma iti gamyate |
jyotiṣṭome camasahomaḥ adhvaryoreva karma na camasādhvaryūṇām iti siddhānte ukte nanu tarhi camasādhvaryavaḥ iti kathaṃ samākhyānaṃ pravartate iti śaṅkāyāmucyate |
aśaktau anyatra karmaṇi vyāpṛtatvāt adhvaryoḥ camasahomasyetaramāve te camasādhvaryavaḥ camasahame kartṛtayā pratīyeran |
ke. camasān makhitān āpyāyitān dakṣiṇasthā-naso'valambe sādayanti jyotiṣṭome |
camasaiḥ : ahaiśca somā yugapad hūyante, teṣu 'ukthaśā yaja somāmas' iti mantraḥ |
kevalagrahakaraṇahome tu 'ukthaśā yaja somasya' iti mantraḥ |
anantaraṃ camasahaste hutaśeṣe punaḥ somāntaramamyunīya devatantarebhyo hotrākā anuvaṣaṭkāre juhvati |
camasānāṃ grahaṇāṃ ca rātri-paryāyeṣu samupa eva |
camaseṣu gṛheṣu ca somasya śeṣo bhavati 'somasyāgne vīhi ityanuṣaṭkaroti' iti codanayā |
camaseṣu tāvat yadyapi brāhmaṇataḥ pratyakṣopadeśo (bhakṣaviṣayaḥ) nopa-labhyate, tathāpi prāpagatayā (praitu hotṛcamasaḥ 0) samākhyāyā anumīyate |
hotṛcamasatvaviśiṣṭaṃ hi dravya-nayanapreṣaṇaṃ na kathañcit upapadyate yadi teṣu hotrādayaḥ somaṃ na carmanti.....tasmāt camitavyaṃ hotrādibhiḥ |
oṃ camaseṣu samākhyānāt saṃyogasya tannimitta- tvāt |
atra tu camasināṃ somabhakṣo'sti na vā iti vicārya asti iti sādhyate |
camasinaḥ nāma yeṣāṃ camasāḥ santi, yaiḥ camyante bhakṣyante camasanāmaka- pātrāḥ; somarasāḥ |
te ca hotā, brahmā, udgātā, yajamānaḥ sadasyaḥ ; maitrāvaruṇaḥ, brāhmaṇācchaṃsī, potā, neṣṭā, acchāvākaḥ; āgnīdhreti (satyāṣāḍhaḥ 8|6|40) teṣāṃ camasināṃ camaseṣu asti bhakṣaḥ |
samākhyānāt hotṛcamasaḥ brahmacamasaḥ udgātṛcamasaḥ ityādiḥ camasānāṃ nāmadheyāt |
nahi camasabhakṣaṇasaṃbandhaṃ vinā camasānāṃ sākṣā samākhyā upapadyate |
tadetaduktaṃ saṃyogasya camaseṣu hotrādisaṃbandhasya tannimittatvāt bhakṣanimittakatvāt iti |
karaṇanyāyena arthasyodiśyamānasyāpi grahādeḥ prāti- padikāmihitasya yathā vivakṣā, evaṃ tadākhyasya liṅga- syāpi |
ratna. 6|1|316. camasādhikaraṇanyāyena vapā'bhyāsāpūrvasādhanatvasya lakṣaṇāt nāṅgeṣu pañcāvadāna- prasaktiḥ |

10|1|8. iṣṭakāsaṃskārāṇām iṣṭakākāryatve'pi dārāśe niyamavidherāvaśyakatayā camasādhikaraṇanyāyena iṣṭakā- svasyāvivakṣābhāvāt durvādyadhiṣṭhā ākṛterabhāvena iṣṭakā- svajāterabhāvāt na teṣu iṣṭakādharmā iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
teṣu saṃdehaḥ kiṃ camasādhvaryavaḥ camasān juhuyuḥ, uta adhvaryuriti |
kasmāt ? camaseṣu ādhvaryavaṃ te kurvanti iti camasādhvaryavaḥ ; tasmāt te juhuyuriti |
vā-- unnayanāsādanahomādi yāvatkiñcit adhvaryoḥ camaseṣu prāpnoti, tat sarvaṃ viśeṣasamākhyānāt camasā- dhvaryubhiḥ kartavyam |
eṣa hi nyāyaḥ, yat 'ādhvaryavapadārtham adhvaryuḥ kuryāt ' ādhvaryavaśca homaḥ |
nanu camasādhvaryavaḥ iti viśeṣasamākhyānāt camasādhvaryavo hoṣyantīti |
camaseṣu ete adhvaryavaḥ bhavanti iti camasā- dhvaryavaḥ |
yadi taiḥ adhvaryurjuhoti, tataḥ taccamasādhvaryabhi- rapi hotavyam |
yadi camasādhvaryavo juhuti nānyaryuḥ ; tadā te na taddhat syuḥ camasādhvaryavaḥ ! tasmāt
daśatvānuvādāt prakṛtau ca daśa śriyante iti vijñāyate |
sūtrātthastu-- daśapeye jyotiṣṭomavikṛtibhūte 'daśadaśa ekaikaṃ camasamprapanti' iti vidhiviśeṣe daśadaśa camasādhvaryavaḥ iti daśatvānuvādāt liṅgāt prakṛtau daśatvaṃ syāditi |
vi-- neyattā'styasti vā teṣām, na niyāmakavarjanāt, camasānāṃ daśatvena camasādhvaryavo daśa |
bhāṭṭa-- te ca daśa ekādaśa vā, na tu trayaḥ; camasānāṃ tātratvāt |
ata eva madhyataḥkāriṇāṃ hotṝṇāṃ caturṇāṃ hotṝṇāṃ ca maitrāvaruṇādīnāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ camasādhvaryava iti vyapadeśo'pi saṃgacchate |
evaṃ ca daśapeye kratau siddhavat 'daśa camasādhvaryavaḥ' ityanuvādo'pi sadasyabhāve'pi saṃgacchate |
bhāṣyam-- vanti jyotiṣṭome camasādhvaryavaḥ 'camasādhvaryūn vṛṇīte' iti |
teṣu saṃdehaḥ kiṃ eṣāmanyatamāḥ, uta etebhyaḥ anye iti |
kiṃ tāvat prāptam ? etāvatāṃ saṃkīrtanāt evāmeva (ṣoḍaśānāmṛtvijām) anyatamāḥ |
kutaḥ ? tairvyapadeśāt, taiḥ parigaṇitaiḥ eṣāṃ vyapadeśo bhavati |
nanu ye eva prakṛtāḥ, te camasādhvaryavo bhaveyuḥ |
kutaḥ ? tairvyapadeśāt madhyataḥkāriṇāṃ camasādhvaryavaḥ, hotṝṇāṃ camasādhvaryavaḥ |
yajamānapurogheyaśca ete anye iti naḥ pratijñātam |
na yajamānane camasādhvaryūn kartuṃ varītamyāḥ, ṛtvigbhiste varītamyā iti |
apica eṣāmupattitve eva medaḥ 'camasādhvaryūn vṛṇīte' iti |
vā-- adhvaryava iti samākhyānāt teṣāṃ camasaṃmbandhāt adhvaryupuruṣā eva camasādhvaryavaḥ |
pṛthakkhaniyatatvāt vyapadeśānāṃ sarveṣā itaraistulyavat pṛthaktvena vyapadeśāt utpattau ca varṇāntarāmmānāt pūrvaineva bhedaḥ |
yadyapi ca yajamānena śriyante, tathāpi tadāśākaratvena triyamāṇatvāt bhavatyeva tadīyatvavyapadeśaḥ |
tat teṣvasaṃbhavāt teṣāṃ tebhyo bhedaṃ kariṣyati ||
soma-- pūrvavat saṃjñayā bhedo na saṃbhavati iti śaṅkā-nirākaraṇārthatvaṃ na gatāthatvam |
brahmātiriktaḥ sadasyo nāstīti prābhākaramataṃ na yuktam |
sūtrātthastu-- camasādhvaryavaśca bhinnāḥ, taiḥ ṛtvigbhiḥ saha 'madhyataḥkāriṇāṃ camasādhvaryavaḥ', 'hotṝṇāṃ camasādhvaryavaḥ' iti medavyapadeśāt iti |
yaugikyā saṃjñayā, maivaṃ ṣaṣṭhyā tebhyo vibheda- nāt |
camasādhvaryūśaṃsatāyāt camaseṣu adhvaryutveva yaugikatvāt-dhvaryupuruṣā eva ete |
iti prāpte, satipi saṃjñayā yaugikatve 'camasādhvaryūn vṛṇīte' iti pṛthakvaraṇāmmānāt varītamyānāṃ camasādhvaryūṇāṃ pūrvainevānyatvam |
evaṃ ca 'madhyataḥkāriṇāṃ camasādhvaryavo hotṝṇāṃ camasādhvaryavaḥ' iti ṛtviksaṃvyapadeśo'pi mede evopapadyate |
bhāṣyam-- teṣveva (camasādhvaryūṣveva) saṃdehaḥ kima-niyamaḥ eko dvau bahavo vā, uta bahavaḥ eveti |
sūtrātthastu 'camasādhvaryūn vṛṇīte' iti utpattau bahutvaśruteḥ bahava eva camasādhvaryavaḥ iti |
vi-- 'tān vṛṇīteti bahutā nāsti vā'sti, yathaikavat |
yadyapi tatroddeśyaviśeṣaṇatvāt bahutvavivakṣā, tathāpi 'svādhyāyo'dhyetavyaḥ' itivat saṃskāravidhinyāyā''nupapattyā viniyogakalpanādaśāyāṃ tadviśeṣopapattiḥ |
anayaiva diśā 'purohitaṃ vṛṇīte', 'adhvaryū vṛṇīte' ityādivāpi ekatvavivakṣā draṣṭavyā |
vastutastu tatratatra viniyoge'pi 'camasādhvaryavaścamasānuyanti', 'adhvaryūḥ puro vibhajate' ityādi bahutvaikatvaśruteḥ tadviśeṣopapattiḥ |
('yaśobhāvāya anugatau aminimlocet') āhavanīyādyuddeśyasvarūpasya prāgavijñātatve avijñātadeya-gatasaṃkhyetyāsāhaveyatvaḥ camasādhvaryubahutvanyāyena vivakṣitatvāt naikāgnyutpādanasāmarthyam |

camasādhvaryubahutvanyāyasvarūpam 'camasādhvaryūn vṛṇīte' ityatra camasādhvaryūṇāṃ kartusaṃbandhasya prāgasiddhatayā camasādhvaryūdeśena varaṇamātrānānupapattyā camasādhvaryūn nāma kartuṃ kṛtvarthatayā upādīyata' iti anenaiva vākyena camasādhvaryuguṇādupattyāt utpattau śrūyamāṇaṃ bahutvam upādeyagatatvāt vivakṣitam iti |
3|1|12, camasitvaṃ na bhakṣaṇe kāraṇam, śrāvastato'pi (hāriyojane) bhakṣaṇa-sattvāt |
yathā dūrīkṛteṣvapi paṭaniṣṭha-campakapuṣpeṣu paṭe upalabhyamāno gandho nirāyaṇaguṇākhyā-yogatvāt svāśrayaṃ dravyaṃ kalpayati, tathā prakṛte'pi |
vi. 11|1|6. cayane lokampaṇāyāḥ mantrasyāvṛttiḥ, mantrārthasya nānātvāt |
bhā. 11|4|12|42. cayane śrūyate 'yajñaśrīyaṃ punce gāyati' iti |
yatra hi agniṣṭomastotrasādhanatvena yaśaśrīyaṃ prayujyate, tatraiva klaptaprakāreṇa irāpadena girāpadaṃ bādhyate |
tatraiva tasya prakṛtau upadeśāt nānyatra prāptiriti |
‘caritavyamato nityaṃ prāyaścittaṃ viśuddhaye’ ayaṃ svāteḥ kṛtyaḥ vidhī |
bāla. pṛ. 40. caruḥ anavasāvitāntārūpabhakaḥ jīvataṇḍulaḥ viśadasiddhaḥ odanaḥ iti yājñikāḥ |
hanya- pāke caruḥ pumān’ iti ca |
‘saurye caruṃ nirvaped brahmavarcasakāmaḥ’ iti caruḥ śrutaḥ |
sa kiṃ kapālavikāro havirvirkāro vā havirvirkāra- tve'pi kiṃ syālīvikāraḥ odanavikāro vā iti vicāre siddhāntamāha |
ijyāsaṃyogāt sauryam iti taddhitana carorijyā'rthaṃ gamyate tasmāt caruḥ haviḥ |
‘saurye caruṃ nirvapet’ iti caruśabdaḥ syālīvācakaḥ syāt prasiddha grahaṇaṃ yasya tādṛśatvāt |
syālyāṃ caruśabdaḥ ā ca himavataḥ ā ca kumāribhyaḥ prayujyamāno dṛṣṭaḥ |
tasmāt caruḥ syālī iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
‘saurye caruṃ nirvapet’ iti caruḥ odanaḥ syāt, na syālī |
‘saurye caruṃ nirvapet’ iti caruśabdaḥ na odana- vācakaḥ |
na ca ekasya padasya dvāvarthau yuktau mahītum |
tathā ca dravyatvaprasaṅgāt caruḥ syālī eva |
‘saurye caruṃ nirvapet’ iti caruḥ havirvirkāraḥ kapāla- vikāro vā iti viśaye saṃśaye kapālavikāraḥ syāt |
syālyāṃ śrapitasya pradeyahavistvena yāgakalpanāyā api upapatteśca |
‘saurye caruṃ nirvapet’ iti caruśabdena pradeyārthatvena vidhau codakaprāptaḥ mukhyaḥ puroḍāśo bādhyate |
śrapaṇārthatvena vidhau tu puroḍāśasya guṇabhūtāni kapālāni bādhyante |
prasaṅge guṇo bādhanīyaḥ na mukhyam iti guṇamukhyaviśeṣasya sattvāt caruśabdena syālī śrapaṇārthatvena vidhīyate iti yuktam |
tasmāt caruśabdārthaḥ syālī kapālavikāraḥ iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
tacchuttau tasya caruśabdasya śrutau śravaṇe'pi anya- syaiva dravyasya ka cit haviṣtvaṃ dṛśyate |
yathā ‘prājāpatyaṃ ghṛte caruṃ nirvapet śatakṛṣṇalam’ iti vidhāya ‘catvāri- catvāri kṛṣṇalānavyavata’ ityuktam |
atra caruśabde śrute'pi kṛṣṇalanāmameva haviṣtvaṃ prasiddham |
evaṃ prakṛte'pi ‘saurye caruṃ nirvapet’ ityatrāpi caruḥ syālī syāt |
tasmāt caruśabdārthaḥ syālī, sā ca kapālavikāraḥ |
‘māsṛtaṃ caruṃ nirvapet pṛśnīnāṃ dugdhe praiyajñaṃ grāma- kāmaḥ’ iti vākye caruśabdārthaḥ syālī tathā priyajñvaḥ haviḥ iti anyaśca anyat haviḥ, tacca carī nāma syālyāṃ niṣpāditaḥ syāt |
‘saurye caruṃ nirvapet’ ityatra caruḥ odana eva syāt, na syālī |
odane'tha ā himavata ā ca kumārībhyaḥ prayuktatvāt |
‘puroḍāśaṃ vai devā asmin loke ādhurvan, caruṇā amuṣmin loke’ iti caroḥ odanasya apūrveṇa vyapadeśo bhavati |
puroḍāśa ṛddhirbhavati caruṇā tu paraloke'pi ṛddhiḥ iti caruḥ śreṣṭhaḥ ityucyate |
puro- ḍāśasthāne yaścaḥ, sa odana eva syāt na syālī |
‘ādityaḥ prāyaṇīyaścarura āditya udayanīyaḥ’ iti vidhāya ‘aditimaudanena’ ityuktvā |
tathā ca idaṃ liṅga- darśanaṃ carurnāma odana evetyatra |
tasmāt sauryaścaruḥ odana eva havirvirkāraḥ, na kapālavikāraḥ, na caruḥ syālī atra |
caruṇāṃ sarvepāmekaḥ, puroḍāśānāmekaḥ iti dvāveva rāśī yugapat kartavyau yatra caruḥ puroḍāśaśca vyatiṣaktāḥ |
tatra ca ‘idaṃmuṣa, idaṃmuṣa’ ityādidevatā devatānirdeśaḥ samuccaya kāryaḥ |

13123. carau etāvanto dharmāḥ - syālīsādanam, prokṣaṇam, ‘ā devayajaṃ vaha’ iti aṅgāranirūhaṇam, ‘dhuvā'si’ ityuddena syālīdhiśrayaṇam, tasyāṃ laukikaṃ jalaṃ taṃ kṛtvā ‘dharmāḥ sva’ ityuddena taṇḍulaprakṣepaḥ, paryagnikaraṇam, ‘ame hanyaṃ rakṣasva’ iti praiṣaḥ, ‘āpyāyatām’ iti abhidhāra- ṇam, ‘śṛta ut snāti’ iti udāsanam, ‘ārdraḥ prasthanuḥ’ iti punarabhidhāraṇam ityādayaḥ pratyetavyāḥ |

atra yajamānasya annaṃ bṛha- spateḥ kathaṃ syāt, yadi na bṛhaspaterdevatā, iti arthāta bṛhaspaterdevatātvāvagateḥ, taittarīyaśākhāyām 'bārhaspatyo bhavati' iti taddhitapadayuktavākyaśeṣaśravaṇāt dravyadevatā- saṃbandhānamitayāgavidhānamevedam |
tasya ca auṣadhadravyaka- tvena āgneyādideśataḥ sviṣṭakṛdādipratipattiprāptau 'caru- mupadhāti' ityanena upadhānaṃ pratipattinvena vidhīyate |

tatra uttaravediḥ pratiṣidhyate 'na vaiśvadeva uttaravedimupa- vapanti, na śunāsīrīye' iti |
asmin praṇayane uttara- vedyām agnidhānaṃ vihitam |
gatyarthavādena etat draṣṭavyaṃ: praṇayanamucyate 'tasmāt dvābhyāmeti' iti |

nanu varuṇapraghāsānāṃ guṇa- vākyaprāptāveva ayaṃ teṣāmeva 'atra' iti vādaḥ syāt |
yadi varuṇa- praghāsānāṃ vādaḥ syāt, tatra pratiṣedhe trīṇyapi parvāṇi utkīrtayet |
ayocceta dvayoḥ parvaṇorvādo bhavatu iti, atra brūmaḥ |
na dvayoḥ parvaṇoḥ prakaraṇam, varuṇapraghāsānāṃ vā |
varuṇapraghāsānāṃ prakaraṇe dvayoḥ parvaṇoḥ utkīrtanaṃ prati- bedhe na syāt |
nanu evamapi arthavādena etat jñātaṃ madhyamayauḥ praṇayanamiti |
asati prayojane anyasmin parisaṃkhyārtha- meva bhavati |
ḍupa-- (atra saumikam ityādibhiḥ caturbhiḥ sūtraiḥ aṣṭamam, prathamottamayoḥ ityādibhiḥ tribhiḥ sūtrairnavam iti adhikaraṇadvayaṃ bhāṣyakārairvyākhyātam |
tat tūyitvā saptabhirapi sūtraiḥ ekamevādhikaraṇaṃ vārtikakārairvyākhyātam |
tadidaṃ vārtikamitam--) prākṛte praṇayane sthite parisaṃkhyā- 'rthaṃ śravaṇam ityevamādīni sūtrāṇi paraspareṇa asaṃmbaddhāni |
katham ? yadā parisaṃkhyā bhavati (dvayoreva madhyamayauḥ praṇayanti iti) tadā (itarayoḥ) dvayoḥ praṇayanābhāvāt āhavanīyābhāvaḥ, āhavanīyābhāvāt yāgābhāvaḥ |
yena dharma-(mātra-) parisaṃkhyāyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ kevalam (adharmakaṃ) praṇayanaṃ (itarayoḥ) kriyate |
katham ? yatra tasminneva vākye guṇinamuccārya guṇe vidhīyate yathā 'dadhnā juhoti' 'śaramayaṃ barhirbhavati' iti, tatra bhavati guṇavidhiḥ |
arthavādo'pi anupapannaḥ (yatra (hi kiñcit) vidhīyate, tatra arthavādaḥ (bhavati) |
praṇayanam (ca) darśapūrṇamāsayorvidhīyate, iha tu avidhanāt kimarthavādena ? |
(atraiva arthavādadūṣaṇa- prastāvāt 'prathamottamayoḥ' iti anantarādhikaraṇapūrvapakṣa- sūtramullaṅghya tadīyaṃ siddhāntasūtraṃ dūṣayati-) 'madhyamayaurvā gatyarthavādāt' (iti (api) anupapannam |
katham ?) varuṇapraghāsākamedhayoḥ vidhīyamāne punaḥśravaṇāt (praṇa- yanavidheyekavākyatayā) upapadyate evāthavādaḥ |
(tathā) 'prathamottamayoḥ praṇayanamuttaravedipratiṣedhāt' iti idamapi (sūtraṃ) prākṛte praṇayane sthite na saṃbadhyate |
ataḥ ) yatra praṇayanam, tatrāgniḥ, tatraiva cottaravediḥ prāpnoti |
(tena sā) yatra (vaiśvadevaśunāsīrīyayoḥ) pratiṣidhyate, tatra agnirvaidyate (prāptipūrvakaṃ hi pratiṣedhaḥ |
tena tayoḥ tasyāḥ prātiranūmīyate) tatraiva ca praṇayanam (anu- mīyate |
uttaravedipratiṣedhena yaḥ pakṣaḥ prathamottamayoriti, tasya mūlābhāvaḥ |
(ataḥ paraṃ tu yat-) 'madhyamayaurvā gatyartha- vādāt' iti (sūtram, tatra arthavādatvadūṣaṇaprastāve dūṣaṇam uktam |
tadeva smārayati-) avidhānāt praṇayanasya arthavādo na ghaṭate |

(tathā 'auttaravediko'- nārabhyavādapratiṣedhaḥ' iti sūtramapi asaṃgatam iti darśayan sūtrārthe bhāṣyamākhyā darśayati-) 'nanu varuṇapraghāsānāṃ guṇavākyaprāptāveva ayaṃ teṣāmeva atra (atra vapanti) iti vādaḥ syāt' (iti bhāṣyam) |

ko'yamarthaḥ ? (atra darśayati-) 'upātra vapanti' iti (avāntaraprakaraṇāt varuṇapraghāsā- nāmeva uttaravediḥ prāptatvāt (lyablope pañcamī uttara- vediprāptiṃ codayitvā) prathamottamayoḥ pratiṣedhānupapattim (coyanirākaraṇatvena bhāṣyam-) āha |
'tatra prati- bedhe trīṇyapi parvāṇi anukīrtyeta' iti |

(iti nirākaraṇabhāṣyaṃ vyācaṣṭe-) yadi avāntaraprakaraṇe varuṇa- praghāsānām (trayāṇāmapi) (parvaṇām) uttaravedimātrā kāryaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ sāmyāt (itareṣāṃ prāpyatvāt sāma- dhyāt prāptasya pratiṣedhaḥ kāryaḥ syāt ityanvayaḥ) |
yatra arthavāda- tvena pratiṣedhaḥ (yathā girādapratiṣedhaḥ : irādaśrutyarthaḥ) tatra tiyānuvādaḥ (pratiṣedho) bhavati |
) tasmāt anārabhyaśravaṇāt cāturmāsyānām (aviśeṣeṇa prāptā) uttaravediḥ prathamottamayoḥ paryudyate |
evaṃ prākṛte praṇayane sūtrāṇi na ghaṭante |
iha hi dvayaḥ pakṣaḥ : (dvayoḥ praṇayanti iti-) kiṃ dārśikaṃ praṇayanaṃ (andyate, kiṃvā) saumikam apūrvaṃ vā (praṇayanadharmakaṃ praṇayanāntaraṃ vidhīyate) iti |
(tatra) dārśikam (evedaṃ iti prathamam) utsṛjya (pūrva-) pakṣaṃ kṛtvā 'praṇayanaṃ tu saumikam' (iti tantraratne pāṭhaḥ |
anaiva dupaṭīkāyāṃ tu 'saumikaṃ tu praṇayanam' iti pāṭhaḥ |
evaṃ tuśabde- arthavān bhavati praṇayanaṃ tu iti |
śā-- prathamottamayoḥ saumikaṃ praṇayanaṃ paryudastottara- vedikaṃ vidhīyate |
vārtikānusāraṃ tu ) 'anāmatvāt vaiyarthyāt saumikaṃ prākṛtaṃ na ca |
bhāṭṭa-- dvitīyādhikaraṇe tu ( bhāṣyamatena ) so'ya- manuvādaḥ prathamottamayoḥ madhyamayorvā iti cintāyām, madhyamaviṣayatve tattatra uttaravediprāpteḥ |
tataśca tatraiva uttaravediprāptau tatraivāyaṃ niṣedhaḥ iti tayoruttara- vedirvikalpaḥ |
'dvābhyāmeti, 'ruta vā etau yasya, yad varuṇapraghāsāḥ sākamedhāśca' iti praṇayārthatvāt tasya anyāyatvāt madhyamaviṣaya evāyamanuvādaḥ, uttaravedyupa- saṃhārāt |
evaṃ ca prathamottamayoḥ uttaravediprāptyabhāvāt tatra tatpratiṣedho nityānuvādaḥ |
etadabhāve hi tadavāntaraprakaraṇe paṭhitāyāḥ uttaravedeḥ tanmātrā'ṅgatvaprasaktau taditereṣu triṣu parvasu nityānu- vādaḥ syāt, na dvayoḥ |
ataḥ dvayornityānuvāda- balāt avāntaraprakaraṇavena mahāprakaraṇatvāt sarvāṅgasya- prasaktau 'dvayoḥ praṇayanti' ityanena madhyamayoḥ |
na ca evamapi prathamottamayoḥ paryudāsa- vaśena avāntaraprakaraṇavādhat madhyamamātraviṣayatvasyāpi uttaravedyupattiviniyogayoḥ siddheḥ : 'dvayoḥ praṇayanti' ityasya vaiyarthyamiti vācyam |
'uttaravedyāmagniṃ nidadhāti' ityanena hi na nidhānānuvādena uttaravedirvidhīyate atiprasaṅgāt |
kintu atideśaprāpteḥ pūrvapravṛttyā uttaravedi- viśiṣṭaprakṛtividhānameva anyadeśena vidhīyate uttaravedi- mātraphalakam |
ataśca aupadeśikapraṇayanavidhyābhāve praṇītā- gnidhāne iva kapālatāpā'gnidhāne'pi tadāpattiḥ |
aupadeśikapraṇayanavidhisattve tu tasyaiva sphūrtikasya deśāpekṣayā'm atideśikavidhivat : pūrvam uttaravedispa- deśavidhānāt, na tāpādyarthāgnidhāne uttaravediprāptyā- pattiḥ |
ata eva aupadeśikapraṇayanavidhisattve'pi ita- rayoḥ ātideśikapraṇayanasattvāt uttaravedāpattiḥ |
vārtikakāramatopapādanaṃ tu evam- saptamiḥ sūtraiḥ triṣaṣṭhakam ekamadhikaraṇam |
tatra prākṛtaṃ saumikaṃ vā praṇayanam iti pūrvapakṣadvayaṃ kṛtvā apūrva praṇayānantaramantra vidhīyate na tu saumikam, tasyānupasthitatvāt |

nāpi prākṛtam, prākṛtapraṇayasya āhavanīyottāpādakatvena āhava- nīyāpādānakatvā'sambhavāt, 'āhavanīyāt drāvayī praṇa- yataḥ' adhvaryuśca pratiprasthātā ca ' iti śākhā'ntaravacane avaśyaṃ prākṛtapraṇayottaram āhavanīyāpādānakapraṇayanā- ntaravidhānā'vagateḥ |

sākamedhe'pi ca bodhāyanādi- kalpasūtrānusāram etasmānārthatayā āhavanīyāpādānaka- praṇayānantaravidhāyakatvidheḥ kalpanena praṇayānantaravidhānā- vagateḥ tadubhayasamānārthakatayā 'dvayoḥ praṇayanti' ityasyāpi āhavanīyāpādānakapraṇayānantaravidhāyakatvasyaiva niścayena prākṛtapraṇayanānuvādakatvānupapatteḥ |
ataḥ prākṛtapraṇaya- nottaram āhavanīyāpādānakaṃ praṇayānantaramapūrva vidhīyate |
tasya ca apekṣito deśa- viśeṣaḥ uttaravediḥ |
tattatpiṣedho'pi nityānuvāda eva bhāṣyakāramate iva avāntaraprakaraṇatvāt iti sarvamanākulam |
yājñikāstu paśuyajñavat saumikameva dharmān anu- tiṣṭhanti |

'bārhadride brāhmaṇasya brahmasāma kuryāt, pārṣudarme rāja- nyasya, rāyovājīya vaiśyasya' iti sāmaviṣayā śrutiḥ |

upanayanottaraṃ vedādhyayanam, tadu- ttaraṃ vedārthajñānam, tataḥ paraṃ vaidikaṃ karma anuṣṭheyam |
śūdrāṇāṃ ca upanayanameva nāstīti kutastvaṃ vaidikaṃ karme |
upanayanaprakaraṇe 'vasante brāhmaṇamupanayīta, grīṣme rājanyam, śaradi vaiśyam' iti trayo varṇā eva nirdiṣṭāḥ |
śūdrasya mā bhūdupa nayanam, tathāpi karmaguṇaṃ vedādhyayanaṃ śūdro'pi yadā arthidhye tadā tasya guṇārthitvāt adhyayanārthitvāt svayamupayeva adhyeṣyate, tena karmasāmarthyaṃ tasya bhaviṣyati |
upanayanarūpaḥ saṃskārasya tadarthatvāt adhyayanārthatvāt 'vasante brāhmaṇam' ityādi brāhmaṇādirūpā puruṣa śrutiḥ śravaṇaṃ vidyāyāṃ nimittameva sidhyati |

vidyāyāḥ vedādhyayanasya anirdeśāt kṛtya- tayā nirdeśasya abhāvāt śūdraḥ pustakanirīkṣaṇādinā upāyāntareṇa vedaṃ labdhvā karmāṇi kariṣyati, na ca vaiguṇyaṃ bhaviṣyati iti kutūhalam |
