tasmāt pradhānārthāyā vediḥ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
pūrvasūtre phala- saṃyogāt iti heturuktaḥ, tad dṛṣṭāntārthaḥ atra caśabdaḥ |
sūtreṇa prāptaṃ pūrvapakṣaṃ tuvandena nirasyan siddhāntamāha |
‘jyotiṣṭomena svargakāmo yajeta' iti yā phalasya śrutiḥ, sā tathuke aṅgayukte pradhāne sati |
tasmāt sāṅkhya phala- vattvāt sarvacikīrṣā aṅgānāṃ pradhānasya ceti sarveṣāṃ cikīrṣā kartumicchā 'iti śakṣyāmahyaṃ kartum' iti vākyena uktā syāt |
atra sudhā- anukṛṣyā pradhānoktā svārthaprati- yogitayā upasthāpitasya aṅgasya tacchabdena parāmarśāt jyotiṣṭomena iti tṛtīyāśrutyā karaṇībhūtasya jyoti-

ṭhomasya phalabhāvanā'nyokteḥ karaṇalasya ca āpekṣika- sādhanatvātithyākhyasādhanatvamalyarūpatvena apakṛṣṭādhakā- jñāpekṣatvāt aṅgasya pradhāne phalaśrutiḥ; tassāt aṅgasya sākṣāt phalānvayatve'pi phalānvayavidhānadvārā phalānvayāt, sarvasya pradhānasya aṅgasya ca cikīrṣā saṃbhavati iti cikīrṣāsaṃyogasya aṅganyāvṛttihetoḥ aṅgai'pi satvāt adhyāvartakatā|
atra cikīrṣāsaṃyogasya parimāṇastulyatve- svena vedeḥ cikīrṣitārthatve prāmāṇyātvāt liṅgamātra- tvāgataiḥ pradhānamātrārthatvapūrvapakṣanirāsārthena tuśabdena prayogāṅgatvāt|
bhāṣyam-- jyotiṣṭome śrūyate 'paṭatriṃśatkramā prācī, caturviṃśatipreṇa, triṃśajjanane iyati śakyāmahaṃ' iti|
tatra saṃdehaḥ kimeśā vedaḥ aṅgapradhānārtha, uta pradhānārtheti? kiṃ tāvat prāptam ? cikīrṣā ca saṃyogāt pradhānārtheti|
yaccikīrṣitam, tasyārthena eṣā śrūyate, śakyāmahaṃ'syāṃ kartumiti|
āha, yadi ajñāni na cikīrṣi- tāni, kimayaṃ kriyante iti|
yadyapi tāni na cikīrṣyante, tathāpi tairacikīrṣitaiḥ anyaccikīrṣyante|
vā-- pūrvaiṇa nyāyena saumikī vediḥ kevalapradhānārthā vijñāyate|
iyati śakyāmahaṃ'syāṃ kartumiti yaccikīrṣitaṃ taduddeśenaiva evamabhidhīyate|
yaduktaṃ pradhānaṃ cikīrṣitaṃ nājñāni, tassāt pradhānasya vediti, tatra|
yadyapi ajñāni na cikīrṣitāni, tathāpi vedyāṃ kartavyāni|
anyathā na sākṣāṃ vedyāṃ kṛtaṃ bhavati|
yo'pi cikīrṣāsaṃyogaḥ, so'pi phalaprāpteḥ prayogādhīnatvāt tadvi- ṣayaḥ eva jñāyate|
evaṃ ca sati agnīṣomīyādivikāreṣu nirūḍhapatvādiṣu kartavyam|

soma-- yathā pradhānamātrasya saphalatvāt phalasiddhayu- payogināṃ vapanādīnāṃ pradhānamātrārthatvam, tathā tata eva hetoḥ pradhānamātrārthasyaiva cikīrṣitatvāt tatasaṃyuktā vedi- rapi tanmātrārthā iti pratyavasthānāt saṃgatiḥ |
' bhāṭṭa-- some paṭatriṃśatkramādiparimāṇāṃ vediṃ nidhāya śrutam 'iyati śakyāmahaṃ'syāṃ kartum' iti|
sā vediryadyapi deśalādaṅgapradhānārthatayā prasajyate, tathāpi dīkṣādīkṣāgnyanyena uktavacanāt pradhānamātrārthā|
'kartum' iti hi tumunā icchāyakena cikīrṣitārthatvapratīteḥ, pradhāna- syaiva cikīrṣitatvāt, ajñānāṃ ca acikīrṣitānām api cikīrṣitapradhānārthatvenaiva anuṣṭhānāt, pradhānamātrārthaiva vediḥ|
(ucyate) yadyapi cikīrṣitārthā vediḥ, tathāpi sāṅgasyaiva phalalābhamṛtvijena cikīrṣitatvāt aṅga- pradhānaiva sā|
ata eva 'śakyāmahaṃ' iti vacanāt kartṛpracāramātrārthatvamaṅgīkṛtya aṅgapradhānārthatvamapi apā- stam|
ataḥ sarvārthā vedeḥ agnīṣomīyādau prākṛta- havirādānādyevedhāvaklṛptam, tadvikṛtau ca atideśaḥ siddho bhavati|
yattu dvādaśa prākṛtavedeḥ prasaṅga iti vakṣyate, tat kartṛpracāramātrārthatvaṃ kṛtvācintayā |
x cikīrṣādhyāyena (3|1|17,9) sāṅgapradhāna- prayogaviṣayatvam (dadhinānām) iti sarvārthatvaprasaktiḥ|
x citiḥ nāma lāṅgelena kṛṣṭe nyāyamātre bhūpradeśe nānāvidhāmiraikābhiḥ pakṣyādyākāreṇa vedinirpyate sā|
tāśca sapurīpāḥ apekṣya dvādaśatvena saṃstave bhaviṣyati |
atulyānumānapi tulyavadanukramaṇaṃ bhavati, yathā 'devā manuṣyāḥ pitaraḥ te'nyata āsan' iti |
pañcabhiḥ sahitā caiṣā pūrayet tāṃ na kevalā ||
sūtrārthastu- paṭṭacitiko'gniḥ pūrvavat dadhigrahavat nityaḥ syāt |
yadvā pūrvavat pañcacititvaṃ, pañca cittaya iva ṣaṣṭhyapi citiḥ nityā syāditi yāvat iti |

' bhāṭṭa-- tatraiva 'yo'gni cittvā na pratiṣṭhitaḥ, pañca pūrvāścitayo bhavanti, atha ṣaṣṭhīṃ citiṃ cinute' iti śrutā ṣaṣṭhī citirapi upakramasattvasamādhinā yacchabdabalena apratiṣṭhāyāḥ nimittatvātge naimittikī eva |
yattupasaṃhāre ṣaṣṭhīmiṣṭa ṣaṇṇāṃ pūraṇārthaḥ pratyayaḥ, so'midhānāpekṣaḥ, na tunṛṣṭānāpekṣaḥ |
pañca cittayaḥ pūrvamabhimatāḥ, idānīmapi ṣaṣṭhī abhimateti iti |
tasmāt agnicayottaram apratiṣṭhāyāṃ nimitte ekaiva citiradṛśyā, cayanāṅgatayā prayogabhedena pratiṣṭhāphalārthe vā vidhīyate |
' ࿋ 'citaṃ ca cittiśca' ityādau na caturthyā vipariṇāmaḥ ||
'iha śrutiḥ svāheha vibhūtiḥ svāhā' ityādayo śrutimantrāḥ |
eṣu prathamāntatvenā homāyeṃ prayogakāle caturthyantatvena vipariṇamitavyāḥ |
'svāhākāreṇa vaṣaṭkāreṇa vā devebhyo'nnaṃ pradīyate' iti śrutyā anupāttasvāhākāreṣu svāhākārasyeva 'namaḥ svasti svāhā' iti smṛtyā caturthyā api adhyāharaṇīyatvāt |
ata eva 'cittāya svāhā' ityādireva śākhā'ntare pāṭhaḥ |
iti prāpte, chinadūmyāderiva aśrutapadasya pañcatva- saṃbhave'pi śrutavibhaktyāḥ parityāge āmnāyasyaiva bhaṅgā- patteḥ |
ata eva 'dhṛtihomena prayujyamāno'mu tathā'ṣṭasu caturthīm' iti sūtrametadadhikaraṇanyāyasiddhārthanirvacanam |
࿋ 'cittāya svāhā cittaye svāhā' ityādibhiḥ śākhā'ntarīyamantraiḥ 'citaṃ ca svāhā' ityādīnāṃ na samuccayaḥ ||
śākhā'ntarīyamantrāṇāṃ vibhaktibhedāt cakārābhāvācca bhinnānupūrvikatayā mantrabhedāt mantrarūpasya yūpāhavanī- yavat alaukikatvāt adṛṣṭārthānāṃ samuccayaḥ |
iti prāpte, mantrāmānalaukikaśabdatve'pi 'jyān juhuyāt' ityanena homakaraṇatvena viniyogāt dṛṣṭārthatayaikakāryāt vikalpaḥ |
'cittastistvā punātu, vākpatistvā punātu, devastvā savitā punātvacchidreṇa pavitreṇa vasoḥ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ' ityatra acchidreṇa ityādiḥ punātudvayena pratyekam anuṣaṅgaḥ kartavyaḥ |
'citramagopena doho gavām' iyaṃ karmeṇeṣaṭhī kārakavibhaktirūpā viniyoktrī śrutiḥ |
(gopabhinnaḥ gāḥ dogdhuṃ na śaknoti, durdohatvāt gavām |
citra iha rājā rājakā idanyake yake sarasvatī- manu |
parjanya iva tatadaddhi vṛṣṭyā sahasramutā dadāt ||
ṛsaṃ. 8|21|18 he rājakāḥ citro nāma rājā sarasvatīdeśe anyasmin yasminkasmin puṇyadeśe sahasraṃ gavāṃmutāni dattavān |
yathā citralakṣaṇa aṅgānāṃ strī dṛśyamānā na subhagāliṅgādiphalaṃ janayituṃ śaknoti, tathā nirahaṃkāratayā tattvavidā kṛtanyapi vihitaniṣiddhāni karmāṇi svaphalajanyedehāntaramārabhaṃ na kṣamante |
sattvit svakṛtakarmaphalena na yujyate iti bhāva iti vadanti |
citragataḥ analo yathā na dahati, tathā jīvanamuktagataḥ saṃsāraḥ taṃ na tāpayati |
uktaṃ ca pañcadaśyāṃ- citradīpe 'yathā citrapaṭe dṛṣṭaṃ hyavasthānaṃ catuṣṭayam |
yathā ghauto ghaṭṭito hi lāñchito rañjitaḥ paṭaḥ |
'mukhaṃ vā etat saṃvatsarasya, yat citrā paurṇamāsī' |
'citrayā yajeta' iti citreṣṭiruktā citraśabdasya yajisāmānādhikaraṇyena yāganāmadheyatvāt |
tatra 'dadhi madhu ghṛtamāpo dhānāstaṇḍulāḥ', tat saṃsṛṣṭaṃ prājāpatyam' iti vistare vākyapāṭhaḥ |
'dadhi madhu ghṛtaṃ payo dhānā udakaṃ taṇḍulāḥ' iti pāṭhaḥ śāstradīpikāyām |
'dadhi madhu payo ghṛtamudakaṃ dhānāstaṇḍulāḥ' iti bhāṭṭe kaustubhe ca |
ke. 'citrayā yajeta' 'trivṛdbahiṣpavamānam' 'pañcadaśāni ājyāni' 'saptadaśāni pṛṣṭhāni' iti citrā-pavamāna- ājya-pṛṣṭha-śabdāḥ karmanāmadheyāni |
atra paśuphalam asati pratibandhe aihikam, sati pratibandhe tu āmuṣmikam |
bhāṣyam-- 'citrayā yajeta paśukāmaḥ' ; 'trivṛd bahiṣpavamānam' 'pañcadaśāni ājyāni' ; 'sapta- daśāni pṛṣṭhāni' ityudāharaṇam |
evaṃ saptadaśāni saptadaśastomakāni ) kiṃ citrāśabdaḥ :pava- mānaśabdaḥ ājyaśabdaḥ pṛṣṭhaśabdaśca guṇavidhayaḥ, uta karmanāmadheyāni iti saṃśayaḥ |
yasmin guṇavidhiḥ nāma- dheyam iti saṃdigdha guṇaḥ apara upadiśyate, pradhānena karmaṇā tasya saṃbandhaḥ, karmanāmadheyamityabhidheyaḥ |
puṃpaśo prāpta iṣṭe paśavaḥ, paśavaḥ phalam, citro guṇaḥ; iti na śakyamekena vākyena vidhā- tum |
citro guṇo vidhīyamānaḥ striyāṃ vidhīyeta, nāsau agnīṣṭomīye |
pañcakāme ca vidhīyeta, so'pi nāmī- ṣṭomīye |
tathā 'pañcadaśāni ājyāni bhavanti' iti ājyeṣu pañcadaśatā |
na ca avihitāni stotreṣu ājyāni bhavanti |
tacca etat ājyāni vidhyāt, vihiteṣu ca pañca- daśatām |
gamyate ca pañcadaśatāyāḥ ājyānāṃ ca saṃbandhaḥ |
atha tu karmanāmadheyam, naipa virodho bhavati |
apica ājyāni stotrāṇi ityanena śabdena lakṣaṇayaiva guṇo vidhīyate |
ataḥ karmaṇāṃ nāmadheyāni vākyāntareḥ 'ājyaiḥ stuvate' 'pṛṣṭhaiḥ stuvate' ityevādibhiḥ vihitānām |
pavamānāttha- mantrakāvāt bahiḥsaṃndhavāt ( saumikavedeḥ bahirdeśasaṃndha- tvāt ) bahiṣpavamānam |
' dadhi madhu payo vṛtaṃ dhānāḥ taṇḍulā udakaṃ tat saṃsṛṣṭaṃ prājāpatyam' iti nānāvidha- dravyatvāt citrā |
atha kasmāt pañcadaśasaṃkhyāviśiṣṭāni ājyāni stotrakarmasu vidhīyante ? viśiṣṭānāṃ vācakasya śabdasyā- bhāvāt |
nanu padyadyamidaṃ vācakaṃ bhaviṣyati ' pañca- daśāni ājyāni' iti viśiṣṭānām, tat ( padyadyaṃ ) eteṣu stotreṣu vidhāsyati |
ubhayasmin vidhāyake parasparaṃ saṃbandho na syāt |
na cātra ekaṃ padaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ prati uddeśakam, stotraṃ prati ( ca ) vidhāyakaṃ bhavitu- marhati |
vā-- idānīmayogikeyu vrīhmādivat lokarūḍhepu jātiguṇaśabdayeṣu cintā |
nahi ānumānikakaraṇatvānu- rodhena pratyakṣaprasiddhyāḥ saṃbhavati iti pūrvādhikaraṇe asiddhiḥ |
nanu ' ājyaiḥ stuvate' ' pṛṣṭhaiḥ stuvate' ' bahiṣpavamānena stuvate' iti utpattivākyatvāt etāni udāhartavyāni |
' sā tu ( utpattiḥ ) nodāhṛtā sūtrakāreṇa ' yasmin guṇopadeyaḥ' iti guṇavākyasya āśrita- tvāt |
aya kimarthaṃ tenaiva tat āśritam ? yatraka- cana pratipādite phalaviśeṣāt |
( svamatena anyathā pariharati-) athavā utpattivākyasya ājyādi- padasya pakṣadvaye'pi sākṣāttvāt ekasyāpi niścayahetu- rnāsti, iti anyataḥ siddhapekṣaṇāt anudāharaṇam |
' yāni ājyāni, taiḥ stuvate' iti ca śrūyate, tatra kānyeva
nāmāni, kathaṃ vā tenābhidhīyante iti sahāpi utpatti- vākyena
( śaṅkate- ) tatra etat syāt, dravya- tvāt ājyādīnāṃ kartavyatāviśeṣamātretikartavyatā'rthinā prakaraṇena na grahaṇamiti |
pradhānadeśatvācca ajñānām ājyādi- masyaiva stotrasamīpe bhavitavyam |
ataśca yathaiva 'agni- mupanidhāya stuvate' ityatra agniḥ sattāmātreṇa upakaroti, evamihāpi iti nirdoṣam |
na ca guṇānāṃ parasparaṃ saṃbandho vidyate |
tatra ekaguṇavidhāne guṇāntarāpekṣā arthāpyabhāve śrautānekavidhivyāpāra- kalpanāyāṃ punaḥpuraścaraṇaṃ pratyayasya kartavyamiti vākya- bhedaḥ syāt |
medāt, karaṇasyāpi paśugatasya prāptatvena avivakṣitayā ubhayaviśiṣṭakārakavidhyayogāt |
ataśca ‘ajo'gnī- yomīyaḥ’ iti prākaraṇikavacanena vihitaprākaraṇikapuṃsavā- varoghe strītvasya vidhyayogāt na guṇavidhiḥ |
ataḥ prakṛtānāmeva yāgānāṃ vicitradravyakatvena lakṣaṇāt citrā- padaṃ nāmadheyam |
na ca utpattivākye eva dravyaviśiṣṭatvotravidhiḥ; ataḥ tu saṃkhyāmātravidhirastviti vācyam |
dhṛtādīnāṃ stotre karaṇatvā'saṃbhavena viśiṣṭavidhyayogāt, pañcadaśānītyā- distutigatasaṃkhyārūpastotratvādidapratyayasya guṇavidhitve anupapatteśca |
ājyotpattivākye ca tatsaṃjakāni catvāri stotrāṇi gamakasahakṛtabahuvacanena tāvattvamāgatam |
ādyayordve'pi dravya- tayoḥ anyayoḥ naudhasadyatayorvacanena vikalpavidhānāt |
yathā cātra taccheṣaṇānāṃ nirāse matāntaradūṣaṇāni ca, tāni kaustubhe dravyāni |
kau. 1|4|16 pṛ. 220. citrā'dhikaraṇe ‘yadi pañcadaśyāni’ iti samāsaḥ syāt tato na vākyabhedo bhavet iti pārthasārathinā uktam |
’ iti kalpitavākye uddeśyasyāhila- vivakṣatāmapi vākyabhedābhāva uktaḥ |
na ca ‘pṛṣṭhaiḥ stuvate’ ityasyotpattivākyatayā citrā'dhikaraṇe vārtikakāriṇodāhṛtatvāt tatra bahutva- mastyeveti vācyam |
soma. 7|3|1. vaiyarthapari- hārāya kaṇvādyantarādīnāṃ svakāryakāritvamityuktaṃ citrā- 'dhikaraṇe kaustubhe |
bhāṭṭa. 10|6|6. pāḍhikepu rathaṃtarādiṣu ṣaṭsu pṛṣṭhaśabdānālyārthitrādavaśena nirūḍhalakṣaṇayāḥ citrā'dhikaraṇe kaustubhe vyavasthāpita- tvāt |
7|2|12. citrā'dhikaraṇorphīlayā āruṇya- kṣīlobhayavṛttikaraṇatvadvayaṃ tṛtīyayocyete, pārthikānvaye ca tadāśrayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyenānvayaḥ |
kau. 3|1|6|2 pṛ. 157. pṛṣṭhe'patiṣṭhe ityatra citrā'dhikaraṇanyāyena stotravacanaḥ pṛṣṭhaśabdaḥ |
bāla. pṛ. 141. ‘iyetenā- micaran’ ityatra nāpi vākyabhedaḥ; yena citrā'dhi- karaṇanyāyapravṛttiḥ śakyeta |
kau. 1|4|15 pṛ. 214. na ca ‘somena yajeta’ ityatra citrā'dhikaraṇapūrvapakṣe iva (1|4|12|3) viśiṣṭakārakavidhiḥ śaṅkituṃ śakyaḥ; vibhaktibhedāt |
ku. 1|2|1|18 pṛ. 30. na ca citrā'syādhikaraṇasyāpi tanmātrākṣepatvā- viśeṣeṇa vinigamanāviraha iti vācyam |
‘citrayā yajeta’ ityudāharaṇāntare tadākṣepakāt citrā'syādhi- karaṇāt udbhidādhikaraṇaviṣayavākye tadākṣepasyābhya- hitatvāt, iti śaṅkāyā apyanavakāśaḥ |
soma. 1|4|6 pṛ. 70 ‘iyetenābhicaran yajeta jyotiṣṭome- sāhanena dyena śatruṣadhaṃ kuryāt ityete vākyabhedā- bhāvāt na citrā'syādhikaraṇanyāyaḥ |

ku. 1|4|15|5. citrā'dīnāṃ aihikaphalatvameva abhyupayantaḥ akṣapādīyāḥ, ‘kimiti tarhi tarkāraṇāṃ sarveṣāmanyatamameva phalaṃ na bhavati iti coyam’ karmavaiguṇyena samādadhate, tanmate iha akṛtakarmaṇāṃ phalaṃ svabhāvādbhavati svīkāryaṃ syāt iyāt ‘sarveṣāṃ karmavaiguṇyāt phalābhāvaṃ vadanti ye |
22. citrā'dīnāṃ phalaṃ kimihaiva janmani, uta iha vā janmāntare vā iti cintane bhartṛmitrādayaḥ ihaiva iti manyante |
citrā'dīnāṃ phalaṃ tāvat kṣīṇaṃ tatraiva janmani |
bāla. pṛ. 7. citraiṣṭau ‘ame gobhineṃ’ ityādibhiḥ puṣṭimanaraiva homāḥ |
citraiṣṭau ‘ayetā āhutīrjuhoti’ iti vidhāya ‘etā vai devatāḥ puṣṭipatayaḥ’ iti śrutam |
iti prāpte, ‘ame gobhineṃ āgahīndrapuṣṭyā juṣasva naḥ’ ityādimantrāṇāmeva krameṇā- jñatvāt puṣṭiliṅgācca nāniyamaḥ |
bhā. 1|3|1| 1-2, 4-8. citraiṣṭau māntravarṇikya eva indrādyo devatāḥ, na tu anyā eva kāścit |
saṃkarṣa. 2|4|5. citraiṣṭidravyāṇām ‘dadhi madhu payo ghṛtaṃ dhānā udakaṃ taṇḍulāḥ tat saṃsṛṣṭaṃ prājāpatyam’ ityeteṣāṃ tulyārthatve- 'pi anyonyasāpekṣatvena vikalpabhāvaḥ |

su. pṛ. 800. ‘athaiṣa jyotiḥ’ ‘etena sahasradakṣiṇena yajeta’ iti etacchabdaparāmṛṣṭānāṃ guṇānāṃ sahasradakṣiṇāyāśca prāptakarmānuvādena vidhāne vākyabhedāpatteḥ citrāyāyena (citrādhikaraṇena 1|4|12|3) nāmadheyatvam |
kau. 1|4| 5|5 pṛ. 217. citrāyāge caturthayajñame haviṣī ‘sārasvatī bhavataḥ’ iti |

’ ityetāvataḥ sūtrāṃśasya ca vṛttikāramatena arthaḥ saṃgṛhyate |

) māṣyam-- nanu pratyakṣādīni anyāni bhavantu nāma pramāṇāni |

kālāntare phalaṃ dāsyati iti cet na |
kutaḥ ? yadā tāvadasau vidyamānā āsīt, tadā phalaṃ na dattavatī, yadā phalamucyate tadā'sau nāsti |
na ca dṛṣṭe kāraṇe sati ahaṣṭaṃ kalpayituṃ śakyate pramāṇābhāvāt |
evaṃ dṛṣṭāpārācca vedasva svargādyapi phalaṃ na bhavatīti manyāmahai |
pātracayanaṃ vidhāya (anyaiṣṭau) ‘sa eṣa yajñayudhī yajamāno'śvamedha svarge loke yāti’ iti pratyakṣaṃ śarīrakaṃ vyapadiśati (nātmānam) |
na ca tat svarge lokaṃ yātīti |
( siddhāntamāha ) ‘autpattikastu śabdasyārthena saṃvandhastasya jñānam’ tuśabdaḥ pakṣaṃ vyāvartayati |
tathā ca codanālakṣaṇaḥ samyak saṃpratyayaḥ iti |
pauruṣeye hi śabde yaḥ pratyayaḥ, tasya mithyābhāva ādhāyakyeta, paramapratyayo hi tadā syāt |
bravīti ityucyate, bodhayati, budhyamānasya nimittaṃ bhavati iti |
na cāsya codanā, 'svāhā na vā' iti sāṃsyikaṃ pratyayamutpādayati |
na ca 'mithyaitat' iti kālāntare deśāntare avasthā'ntare puruṣāntare vā punaḥ anyapade'yapratyayo bhavati |
yo'pi asya pratyayaviparyasaṃ dṛṣṭvā atrāpi viparyasiṣyati ityānumānikaḥ pratyaya upajate, so'pi anena pratyakṣeṇa pratyayena viśvamyamāno bādhyate |
siddhārthatvāt, siddhasya ca pramāṇāntarāpekṣāyāṃ vivādā- bhāvāt |
tadapi svātantryaṃ śakyamānamapi nāsti iti ‘na caiva yāti’ ityanena bhāṣyakāraḥ prakaṭayati |

yadi hi pramāṇāntarapekṣaḥ śabdasya arthena saha vācyavācakabhāvaḥ saṃbandhaḥ syāt, tadā citrā''divākyeṣu liḍādayaḥ pramāṇāntarānubhūtaphala- sādhanatānirvacanāt kāryatāṃ vadanti iti syādeva aprāmāṇyam |
autpattike svābhāvike nirapekṣe ca vācakātve svātantryeṇa arthaparicchedāt prāmāṇyaṃ yuktam) |
nanu ca loke pramāṇāntarāpekṣatvaṃ sarvasya vadanti |
yathā loke'pi autpattikameva abhidhānam, tathā saṃbankṣākṣepaparihāre vakṣyāmaḥ |
(vyavahāre śabdaprayogalakṣaṇe satyaṃ sāpekṣatvam, pramāṇāntareṇa artha pratītya lokeḥ śabda prayujyate yataḥ, na punarabhidhāne sāpekṣatā, arthasya ca arthābhidhānāt |
na ca vyavahāre sāpekṣatā vede doṣamāvahati, apauruṣeya- tvāt |
puruṣo hi pramāṇāntarapratītimepekṣate śabdaṃ prayo- ktum |
yadi pauruṣeyaḥ saṃbandhaḥ syāt, syāt sāpekṣatā |
yadā punaḥ apauruṣeyatvaṃ vakṣyati tadā setsyatyanapekṣatvam) |
atha yaduktaṃ animicaṃ śabdaḥ ’ (bhā. pṛ. 58- 60) iti kimidaṃ coyate |
vidyamānopalambhanatayaiva hi viṣayāntarābhāve darśitaḥ ( ‘citrayā yajeta paśukāmaḥ’ ityādī |
vidyamānopa- lambhanatvāt bhavatyeva iṣṭeḥ paśūnāṃ ca sādhyasādhanabhāvasya pramāṇāntarādvātā |
ataḥ pramāṇāntaragamyameva sādhya- sādhanapūrvakaṃ kāryatvaṃ niyogadeva liḍāderviṣayaḥ, na viṣayā- ntaramiti pūrvaṃ darśitam |
(yau pauruṣeye saṃbandhe sati balādapadyamānaṃ vedānāṃ pauruṣeyatvaṃ sāpekṣatvā- pādakam autpattikasaṃbandhābhidhānena nirastam |
loke tu svātantryadarśanena śabdasya yā pramāṇāntaragocaraviṣayatva- śaṅkā, vā nirākriyate |
autpattike saṃbandhe viṣayāntaraṃ svatantraṃ śabdasya ityevaṃ vivekaḥ |
‘karmakāle phaladarśanāt kālāntare ca karmābhāvāt ’ (bhā. pṛ. 58) iti |
viṣayāntarābhāvāt pramāṇāntaraviṣayatayā ca sāpekṣatvāt tadabhāve ca aprāmāṇyaṃ darśitam (citrā''kṣepe) |
ihāpi tadeva kiṃ punastadupansyate ( 0 dayukta 0 ) pratibhāti |
pramāṇāntarā- viṣayatve hi ‘anenedama’ ityasmin sati niyogaḥ |
na cāminnarthe saṃbhavati niyogadeva niyoga- siddhiḥ |
(idaṃ tat anuktam uktametena bhāṣyeṇa iti saṃbandhaḥ |
yadyapi karmānantaraṃ phalaṃ na sidhyati kālāntare ca nāsti karma, tathāpi niyoga- deva kālāntare phalaṃ bhaviṣyati iti, tadanena- ākṣepa- bhāṣyeṇa-parihiyate |
yasmāt asminnarthe pramāṇāntara- viṣayatvāname saṃbhavati niyogadeva siddhiḥ |
iti na śakyate kalpayitum, niyogasya tadānīmapramāṇatvāt |
niyogo hi pramāṇāntaravedarūpaḥ kathaṃ pramāṇāntarasāpekṣa- śabdaprameyaḥ syāt |
tasmāt karmānantaraṃ phaladarśanāt kālāntare ca karmābhāvāt nāsti pramāṇaṃ paśuphalā iṣṭeḥ iti |
kivā agniśabda- samānādhikaraṇayojananuvādāt na 'nupapattyā agnisaṃjñakāya- vidyāvitaṃ cinotīvākyasya avasīyate |
oṃ cintāmaṇi parilabhya kācamarṇi gṛhṇātīti nyāyaḥ |
yathā yatra brahmavacobhedetuvicāraṃ vihāya anyatra ratiṃ kurvanti , tatrāyaṃ caritārthaḥ |
oṃ juhupākāram iṣmakṣaṇe juhupuṣaśabdapūrvakaṃ rakṣapānaṃ kriyate , tādṛśaṃ śabdaṃ kṛtvā tathā śata- kṛṣṇalacarī śeṣabhakṣaṇaṃ kartavyam ( 'juhupākāram' iti bhāṣye 'juhupuṣākāram' iti bhāṣṭe ) |
oṃ cetanasya yatnahīnasyordhvagatiḥ cetanānantarā- dhīnā iti laukikanyāyena yatnahīnānāṃ gantāṃ gama- yitāro'cirāyadhetanāḥ syuḥ |
citi saṃśāne iti samyagjñānalakṣaṇasaṃjñānavācitayetataścetanaśabda- vācyāḥ prakṛtyaiva eva na mandadhiyaḥ |
oṃ caityavandanādiṣu tu pauruṣeyatvena saraṇam ( tadvidhāyakasya ) |
arthamighānāya hi śabdacodakaḥ pravartate , na pṛthak arthakalpanā- bhayāt |

prayogaviśepa- deśikāve'pi svarūpeṇa mukhyakramasya kalpatvāt , kalpa- nāyāṃ cāpekṣā mūlatvena prayogavidhyupayiāthamikatādeśa- prātipādikakrameṇākāṅkṣāyā ucchedāt ādideśikapāṭha- kramaprāpitakramasyaiva balīyastvam |
artha- parāṇi hi tāni , na svarūpapradhānāni |
bhā. 9|3|16, codakaḥ luptākatrayojanamaṅgaṃ vikṛtau na codyati |
bhā. 3|1|2|15, na ca arthāt kṛtaṃ codakaḥ prāpayati |
5|2|1|8, na ca saṃbhavati codake prayoga- vacanaṃ prati ādartavyam |
3|6|17, codakena yasyāpūrvasya śeṣaḥ pratipādyate , tasya tatkarmakare bhakṣaḥ |
codakena vikṛtau arthaḥ atidiśyate , na śabdo vācakaḥ |
oṃ codakāt nāmadheyaśabdo baḻavattaraḥ iti nyāyaḥ : 'athaṇaṃ cāmihotram' ( 12|1|6|13 ) ityādhikaraṇasiddhaḥ tadvācye sūcitaḥ |
ke. codakāt nāmadheyaśabdo balavattara ityuktam 'na vā kyamidhānāt' ( 7|4|15 ) ityatra |
codakāt prayogavacanaṃ durbalaḥ : codakamāpitāṅgatvatvāt , prātyāmi- kopadeśavidhividhāpitāṅgatvatvāt |
codakāt liṅgakramayoḥ : upadeśapramāṇatvāt ānarthakya- prasaṅgaśca prābalyam |
lakṣaṇena upākartavyamiti pratyakṣa śrutiḥ, abhidhānena upākartavyamiti codakaḥ |
jyotiṣṭome agnīṣomīye , savanīye ca pūrvottarapadārthayoḥ krama eva tadantatvādidatva- niyāmakaḥ |
codakaprāptaṃ hyahakālaṃ vikṛtiṣu 'ya iṣṭyā paśunā0' iti vacanena bādhyate |
codakaprāptasya yasya pratyakṣaśrutena kāryamabhinirvartaye , tat tena nivartya- tām |
codakaprāpta- tvāt pūrvaṃ bārhaspatyasya dharmāḥ; tataḥ sārasvatasya |
sa ca upamitalakṣaṇāprāpaṇe agnī- ṣomīyasa ( paurṇamāsikasya ) yo yāgato vyāpāraḥ, taṃ sādṛśyena ākāṅkṣati |
tatra yadetat agnīṣomīyāga- gatavyāpāraviśeṣaniyamam aṅgalakṣṇasaddham , tadupa- ttiriva utpattiḥ |
tasya ca vyāpārasya yat itareṇa saṃbandha- karaṇam , sā prāptiḥ ( viniyoga ityarthaḥ ) |
codanā iti apūrvaṃ brūmaḥ ( codanā punarārambhaḥ ityanedam ) |
bhā. 2|1|2|5, codanā iti kriyāyāḥ pravartakaṃ vacanamāhuḥ |

codanā dharme pramāṇameva na vā iti saṃśaye śabdasya sarvatra pramāṇatarāpekṣayaiva prāmāṇyadarśanāt codanātmakaśabdasya mūlapramāṇāntarā- bhāvāt tasya api aprāmāṇyāt dharmo niṣpannāka iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
śabdasya pramāṇanirapekṣatvena svataḥ prāmā- ṇyāt dharmaścodanāpramāṇaka eva iti siddhāntaḥ |
idaṃ cāpūrva karmajanyā śaktiyā sūkṣmaṃ phalameva vā |

yacca vṛttantikāraiḥ ārambhate'nityāt an-pratyayamutpādya ārambhyate pravarta- yāti iti ārambhaḥ pravartakaṃ vākyaṃ codanā iti codanā- svarūpakathanārthatayā etatsūtaṃ vyākhyātam , tat prakṛtā- pūrvapratipatyupāyaśabdaghaṭitatvānaupayikatvāt , codanāsvarūpa- kathanārthatve ca asya sūtrasya codanāsūtrānantaraṃ ( 2|1|2 ) kartavyatvāpatteruktam |

'ārambhaḥ śiṣyate' iti bhāṣyeṇa ārambhaprati- pādikāt phalotpādanavācinaḥ 'tatkaroti tadācaṣṭe' ( pā0 dhātupāṭhe curādī gaṇasūtramidam ) iti smṛteḥ ārambha- mācaṣṭe ityasminnarthe ṇicpratyayakaraṇe ac-pratyayakaraṇe ārambhaṃ phalotpādanam ācaṣṭe ityārambhaśabdavyākhyānāt ārambhaḥ codanā , ityārambhaśabdārtho labhyate |
pāyatvameva kāryatvamiti loke samadhigatamiti, tannira- stam |
yadapi loke sarvatanānurūpeṇa kāryāvagamaḥ pravṛttehetuḥ iti asat hi āropyāmihitam, tadapi sākṣāt anyodeśa- prayukkṛmutādyakriyārūpakāryameva |
vede'pi yadi tathābhūta- kāryāvagamaḥ pravṛtteheturmīyate, tadiṣyate eva |
na ca vācyam ' yadanantaraṃ yanniṣpadyate tadeva taduddeśaprayukkṛti- niṣpāyaṃ bhavati, tṛpyuddeśapravṛtakṛteriva bhojanam |
' yato lakṣyavedhakṣaṇedepravṛttā hi kṛtiḥ jyākarṣaṇavimokamātraniṣṭhā, na ca tadanantaraṃ lakṣyavedho niṣpadyate |
tena ca cidannantaram, ka cit nyahitopāyasthāpi loke kāryasya dṛṣṭatvāt anyavahitopāyatvameva kāryatvamiti nāsti dyupattiḥ |
atha tatrāpi lakṣyavedhavyavahitakriyāgaṇasyaiva kāryatvamityucyate, tat kiṃ kruśyādestvena kṛtyupāyatvena vā ? na tāvaduddeśyatvena lakṣyavedhasyaiva uddeśyatvāt |
tena yathā avāntaravyāpāradvāreṇa vyavahitopāyasyāpi lakṣyavedhasya kāryatvam, tathā yāgasyāpi svīkriyatām, kimapūrvakāryasvīkāryasyasaneneti |
bhavatu vā apūrvameva kāryam, tathāpi vidhiśabdābhidheyatvaṃ tasya kutaḥ ? tathāhi, svargakāmapadasamabhivyāhārānyā''nupapattyā avyavahita- kāmyopāyatvarūpe kārye liṅaśabdasya śaktiḥ kalpanīyā |
tathā ca sati arthāpattiviṣayatvāt tasya apūrvatva- dhyāhṛtirnirvāreva |
yaduktam arthāpatteḥ upasthākalpa- mābhram, apūrvapramāṇārthaṃ punarliṅaśabdavācye eva |
vidhiśadādiṣu hi svargasya sarvān prati aviśiṣṭatvena avagatapūrvatā upasthitā tasyākhyābhi- dhāyakaṃ svargakāmapadaṃ vidhiśadākṣapatvena śrutārthāpatyā kalpyate iti yuktam |
atra punaḥ apūrvakāryasya anyataḥ anupasthitatvāt apūrvatvāt arthāpattipramāṇenaiva upasthitivaktavyā |
pramāṇaṃ copasthāpayati, atha ca na tatra pramāṇam iti hāsyāspadameva |
tatra yadi arthāpattiḥ apūrve pramāṇam, tatra liṅe''nu- vādakatvāt aprāmāṇyameva |
arthāpattipramāṇatā anupa- sthite apūrvakārya hi liṅādibhiḥ saha vācyavācaka- saṃbandhānavadhāraṇāt |
‘ pravṛttau vā nivṛttau vā yā śabdaśravaṇe dhīḥ |
sā codaneti sāmānyaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ hṛdaye sthitam |

‘ ślokā. 1|2|2|210-211. ‘ codanā yadyapi kāryamarthaṃ pratipādayati, tathāpi pauruṣeyī codanā prāpnoti, vacanasya svātantryadarśanāt tasya pratyayāntara- sāpekṣatvāt aprāmāṇyamāpadyate ( iti cenna ) |

‘ codanāyāṃ phalāśruteḥ karmamātraṃ vidhīyeta, nahyaśavdaṃ pratīyate |
4|3|5|10 ‘ ‘ tasmāt pitṛmyaḥ pūrvaidhuḥ karoti ‘ iti śrūyate, ‘ yaḥ satrāyāgurate, sa viśvajitātrirātreṇa sarvapṛṣṭhena sarva-
idaṃ pitṛkarma viśvajidyāgo vā kiṃ niṣphalaṃ karmātmamātram, uta saphalamiti saṃśaye pūrvapakṣamāha |
asyāṃ codanāyāṃ vidhivākye phalāśruteḥ phalasya aśravaṇāt karmamātraṃ niṣphalameva karma vidhīyate |
nahi aśabdaṃ śabdena apratipāditaṃ phalaṃ pratīyate pratyetumarhati |
tasmāt phalāśravaṇāt pitṛkarma viśvajicca niṣphalaḥ ‘ sannaiva ‘ vidhīyate |
ssamnānasāmarthyāccodanā'rthena gamyatā- rthānāṃ hyarthavattvena vacanāni pratīyante'rthato hyasamarthānāmanantaryai'pyasambandhastasmācchutyekadeśaḥ saḥ |
tatra karmaṇi phalasya codanā, karoti yajeta iti arthena kartavyatā vacanena gamyate |
parantu loke śrutānāmarthānāṃ arthavattvena upapattistvena kāraṇena vacanāni vyavahitānyāpi adhyāhārādibhiḥ sambandhini pratīyante |
anyathā tu arthataḥ yāni asamarthāni padārthe bodhayituma, teṣāmarthataḥ asamarthānām ānantaryai- 'pi sati asambandhaḥ na saṃbandhaḥ nānyavo bhavati |
‘ devadattasya bhāryā rājaḥ puruṣaḥ ‘ ityatra bhāryāpadasya rājaḥ iti padena ānantaryai satyapi na tayoḥ saṃbandhaḥ kaścit |
tasmāt saḥ dūrastho'pi phalavodhakaḥ śabdaḥ, śrutyekadeśaḥ śrutasya vākyasya ekadeśaḥ iti dhyeyam |
arthataḥ saṃbandhasya dūrasthasyāpi anvayo jñātuṃ śakyate anvayahitasyāpi ca arthataḥ asaṃbaddhasya anvayo jñātuṃ na śakyate |
prakṛte ‘ pitṛbhyaḥ pūrvaidhuḥ karoti ‘ ityādāvapi dūrasthena phalapadena anvaye sati karmaṇaḥ saphalatā sidhyati |

yathā ‘ indrāya rāje sūkaraḥ ‘ iti vākyasya svataḥ ākhyātapade samupalabhye arthaḥ saṃpanno bhavati, evaṃ prakṛtavākyamapi anyataḥ phalapade samupalabhye tena phalarūpeṇa guṇena arthavat sārthakaṃ paripūrṇaṃ bhavet |
tasmāt pitṛkarma viśva- jicca karmaiva saphalemeva vidhīyate |

pratidakṣiṇa vā kartṛsaṃbandhādiṣṭavadaṅgabhūtatvāt, samudāye hi tannirvṛttyā tadekatvādekaśabdopadeśaḥ syāt |
2 ‘ nājñānāṃ tantram, kintu medena, pratidakṣiṇa kartṛ- saṃbandhāt |
dakṣiṇābhedāt kartṛsaṃbandhabhedaḥ, tasmācca prayoga- bhedaḥ, prayogabhedāt aṅgabhedaḥ |
yathā paurṇa- māsakālāni ajñānāni kālabhedāt tu darśapaurṇakurvanti, tadvat |
hi yasmāt tannirvṛttyā ekaphalaniṣādena samu- dāyo bhavati |
ekavacanānte ekena ‘ rājasūyena ‘ iti śabdena sarveṣāṃ pradhānānāmupadeśaḥ syāt |
yathā darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ prayogabhede'pi phalaika- tvāt samudāyaḥ, tadat |
3 ‘ ‘ yat pūrvaṃ trisaṃyuktaṃ vīrajananaṃ tat, yaduttaraṃ paśu-
jananaṃ tat' iti anyārthadarśanaṃ tantramedaṃ darśayati |
sāṅgorhi phalasaṃbandhaḥ; tena sāṅgoḥ pradhānayoḥ paurvāparye jñāyate |
tasmāt rājasūye pṛthagdakṣiṇāyuktānām āmā- vaiṣṇavādīnāṃ bhedena aṅgānuṣṭhānamiti siddhāntaḥ |
ke. codanāgataṃ yat, tadantarṅgaṃ bhavati, bahiraṅgamina- rat |
bhā. 8|2|6|1, codanāgataṃ liṅgaṃ prāpakam, mantragataṃ prāptasya cotakam |
ekapurupapāṭhasya aviśramaṇītvena codanāyāthātmyaniścayātkavāyogāt pāraṃparyāvicchedenaiva niśāyaktvam aṅgīkāryam |
viśeṣataśca viṣayaḥ arthavādāḥ mantrāḥ nāmadheyāni ca pramāṇam |
dharmaṃ pramāṇasya viṣayeḥ pratijñā'yaṃ codanā- sūtram |
taduktam ' codanā copadeśa vidhiśrcākārya- vācinaḥ ' iti |
tatra 'yo dharmaḥ' ityadiśya 'sa codanālakṣaṇaḥ codanāpramāṇakaḥ' iti pramāṇavacana- vyaktiḥ |

tatra codanāpramāṇakatvasya dharmalakṣaṇatvāt niṣedhe'pi ca pravartanāviṣayatvena vidheye nivartanāviṣayatvena codanālakṣaṇatvāt ativyāptiṃ vāra- yitum arthaḥ iti anarthasādhanatvābhāve'pi viśeṣaṇam |
yo dharmaḥ tatra codanaiva pramāṇam ityekaḥ: pratyakṣānumānanudavākyādi- vyāvṛttyarthaḥ |
yo dharmastatra codanā pramāṇameva ityaparaḥ: nāstikābhimatavedaprāmāṇyanirāsārthaḥ |
ko dharmo nāma ityākāṅkṣāyāṃ dharmasya lakṣaṇamucyate |
codanā iti kriyāyāḥ pravartakaṃ vacanam, vidhividhākya- mityarthaḥ |
tathā ca vidhivocitatve sati puruṣārthopayogitvam iti dharmasya lakṣaṇam |
viśe- ṣaṇopādāne bhojanādau ativyāptiḥ; viśeṣyapādāne paraṃparayā aniṣṭahetau śyenādau abhicārakarmaṇi ati- vyāptiḥ; tadubhayanirāsārthe padadvayam |
tathā ca dharmasya lakṣaṇasattvāt tajjñānāyarthe mīmāṃsā kartavyā ityādhikāraṇārthaḥ |
na ca asmin sūtre 'dharmaṃ codanārūpasya vedaśabdasya prāmāṇyam' iti niyamakaraṇāt tryādyādyasya prāmāṇyāṅgīkāre ca tallakṣaṇapattiḥ iti vācyam |

tatrānya- codanāśabdasya 'codaneti kriyāyāḥ pravartakaṃ vākyam' ( bhāṣyam ) 'codanā copadeśaśca vidhiśrcākāryavācinaḥ' ( ślovā pṛ. 211111 ) iti bhāṣyavārtikasvarasāt vidhimātravacanatvena tasmin sūtre īdṛśaniyamakaraṇāt |
ata eva tat sūtraṃ na pramādhyāyārthapratijñāparam, apitu prathamapādānutpādyavidhisāmānyapratijñāparameva iti smṛtya- dhikaraṇe vakṣyāmaḥ |
parantu anyatrāt nyūnameva kiñcittato nādhikaṃ kimapi ) |
niyamo'pi tena īdṛśa eva kriyate 'dharma eva pramāṇaṃ codanā' iti |
yadyapi ca 'codanaiva pramāṇam' ityapi niyamaḥ kriyate, tathāpi 'prādhānyena saiva pramāṇam' ityevaṃparo draṣṭavyaḥ |
sūtrasthaṃ yojanā - codanālakṣaṇaḥ kāryarūpaḥ vedārthaḥ: nendriyādilakṣaṇaḥ : kriyākārakasaṃsargādiḥ |
tatrārtho yo niḥśreyasaphalaḥ sa dharmaḥ, nānarthaḥ: śyenādiniyogaḥ |
ṛju. pṛ. 27. codanālakṣaṇaḥ : arthasvaraḥ : bhā. 1|1|2|2 pṛ. 17, codanālakṣaṇaḥ samyak saṃpratyayaḥ : 1|1|5|6 pṛ. 42. codanālakṣaṇasūtreṇa kārye arthe |
ṛju. pṛ. 37, codanālakṣaṇasūtreṇa codanālakṣaṇaḥ kāryarūpaḥ evārthaḥ; na siddharūpa iti pratijñātam |

yathā 'āgnāvaiṣṇavamekā- daśakapālaṃ nirvapet, sarasvatīmājyasya yajeta, bārhaspatya- śruḥ' ityatra 'tāmyāmetamamīṣomīyamekādaśakapālaṃ pūrṇamāse prāyacchat' iti abhimukhavasāmyam abhimukhatadvitānta- padavattvaṃ ca pañcākṣaratadvitāntapadavattvaṃ ca codanāliṅgam |
evam 'āgnāvaiṣṇavamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapedīkṣamāṇaḥ; āgnāvaiṣṇavamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapetpūrṇamāsāvārasya- mānaḥ' ityatrāpi |
codanāsāmānyāt āgneyadharmāḥ saurye atidiśyante yathā āgneye uktakatum, tathā saurye'pyupa- kartavyam |

'coda- naiva pramāṇam' iti sākṣāddharmapratiikāraṇasya codanā- vākyasya prāmāṇyapratijñāyāṃ tacceṣṭayatā tanmūlatayā ca pramāṇanāmarthavādasmṛtyādīnām arthāt prāmāṇyaṃ pratijñātaṃ bhavati, avadhāraṇavyavacchedastu codanāpekṣā codanāyā- gamā eva |
soma. 1|2|1, codanāsūtraṃ na kṛtsnādhyāyārthapratijñāparaṃ kintu prathamapādādhārthapratijñāparam ( śāstradīpikāmatena ) |
coditaṃ tu pratīyatā 1724 codite tu parārthatvāt

kiñca mlecchasiddhaparimiṣṭe sati draviḍakarṇāṭasiṃhalādideśa- bhedena mlecchabhāṣāvicitratvāt sarveṣveva āryāprasiddheṣveva kadā cit ka cid deśe kenāpi mlecchena ayaṃ śabdaḥ ka nidarthe prayukta iti śaṅkāyā nigamādidhaiyaprasaṅgaḥ |
bhavedevaṃ yadi āryaprasiddhaya- virodhe'pi mlecchaprasiddheḥ pramāṇaṃ na bhavet |
tena naiteṣāṃ padāpabhraṃśarūpatvaṃ saṃbhavati, nāpi anarthakatvam |
na caite āryavyavahāre ka cidarthaviśeṣe prasiddhāḥ pratyabhi- jñāyante |
na ca śabdārthasaṃvyavahāraṇe kaścit āryamlecchayoḥ viśeṣo'sti |

yatra punaḥ āryaiḥ anyatra prayuktaḥ śabdo mlecchaiḥ anyatra prayujyate, tatra āryāṇāṃ śabdārthanirūpaṇeṣu abhiyuktatvāt tadaṃśena mlecchaprasiddheḥ gauṇatvena upapatteḥ bhavatu āryaprasiddhasya mukhyatvena balīyastvam |
na ca atra mlecchaprasiddheḥ gauṇatvaṃ saṃbhavati, mukhyabhṛtyārtha- ntarābhāvāt |
na ca niruktādideśenaiva atra mukhyārtha- nirūpaṇamiti yuktam |
tathāhi, pikaśabdasya tāvat nigamavaśeṇa arthaviśeṣakatvaṃ nāstyeva, tathā sati sandehābhāvāt |
tatra pibati pāti pacati ityanekādyarthasādhāraṇatvāt avayavā- nvayasya niruktavaśenāpi nārthaviśeṣavādhāraṇām |
ato niruktaprasiddhirapi na mlecchaprasiddhivirodhinī, kintu kokilaḥ pibati pāti pacati ityevaṃ mlecchaprasiddhayanusā- reṇaiveti |
yatra punaḥ anviṣyamāṇā'pi mlecchaprasiddhirapi nopalabhyate 'sadhyāsami' ityādipadeṣu, tatra niruktādīnāmeva nirṇāyakatvam |
yā tu abhiyuktaiḥ anviṣyamāṇā'pi anupalabdhārthāntaraprasiddhiḥ, sā kadā cit ka ciddeśe samasti iti śakyamānā dhūmasya agni- sandehe'pi sādhāraṇī ityupeśaṇīyāyeti |
na ca evaṃ sati prasiddhapadagocarasya niruktasya vaiyarthyamiti vaktavyam |
'ṣaḍaṅgo vedo'dhyetavyaḥ' iti vidhivalāt sarvatraiva nigama- niruktavyākaraṇocitapadārthasyaiva anuṣṭhitasya phalāpūrva- sādhanatvamyupagamāt |
sūtraṃ tu- mlecchaprasiddhamapi vede coditaṃ pratīyate pramāṇena virodhābhāvāt iti |
pika-nema-śata-tāmarasaśabdān āryāḥ na kasmina- ścidarthe prayuñjate |
asyaiḥ mlecchaiḥ coditam uktaṃ pikanemādidaśabdānāṃmarthajātaṃ pratīyate |
tasmāt mlecchaprasiddhā pikāḥ kokilaḥ, nemaḥ ardham, tāmarasaṃ padmam, sata iti parimaṇḍala śatacchidraṃ dārumayaṃ pātram |
tulyaśca anyajanapadavāsināmipi dṛṣṭārthatvāt śabda- vyavahāre pramāṇabhāvaḥ |
'iṣopahate'ḍopahatā' ityādi iḍā- nigade 'daivyā ardhyava upahatā upahatā manuṣyā ya imaṃ yajñamānaṃ, ye ca yajñapatiṃ vadhārnan' ityāmnāyate |
tatra yajñapatiśabdaḥ bahuyajamānake karmaṇi ūhitavyo na vā, ki samavetābhidhāyī yajñapatiśabdaḥ, na vā iti vicāre siddhāntamāha |
tuśabdaḥ dhānyaśabdāt pūrvoktāt yajñapati- śabde vailakṣaṇyamāha |
tvāt iḍāstutyarthatvāt avikāraḥ na vikāraḥ na ūhaḥ |

yathā 'śukraṃ yajamāno'nvārabhate' ityatra vidhau satre ekena phenacityajamānena anvārabhya'pi cāritā- rthyam, tathā ekayajamānastutidvārā'pi iḍāstutisaṃbhavaḥ, he iḍe tvayā upahatāḥ santaḥ daivyā mānuṣā adhvaryavaḥ yajñaṃ yajñapatiṃ ca vardhayanti iti |
tataśca yajñapatiśabdaḥ iḍāstāvakatvāt na samavetābhidhāyī vikṛtau nohitavyaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
yadi hi adakapālavākyaṃ juhotivākyena upasaṃhṛtam, tato'nenaiva karmotyattiḥ kriyate |
tataśca āmeyādye 'codite hi' ityevaṃ vākyabhedaḥ prāpnoti |

vidhivatsa yo deśo bhāvanāyaḥ, sa sarveṣāṃ viśeṣaṇānāṃ yatpi samānaḥ, tathāpi bhāvanātaḥ pracalitasa phalālocanahetukatvāt eva ca vidheḥ anekaphalayogāt ekanaiva viśeṣaṇe vidhitvaṃ paryavasitamiti 'codite hi tadarthatvāt' ityatra darśitam |
yathā corāpahārthī minnau, tathā jīveśau minnau iti |
coṣadhaṃ yasya oṣadhadhanarasanādimirniṣpīḍitasya saskāreṇa mukhamārutena raso niṣpīyate tat |

evaṃ hi purāṇakathā--kadā cit kaiścit taskaraistaurānveṣaṇaparaiḥ tapasvato māṇḍavyasya ṛṣeḥ samīpagatān tān caurān prāpya māṇḍavyasametān tān caurān baddhvā rājñe nivedya tadājñayā ṛṣisahitāścaurāḥ śūle samāropitāḥ |
tatasteṣu māṇḍavyaṃ vihāya śocattvā mocayāmāsa rājā prajānāmima pradāyāmāsa |
caulopanayanādisaṃskārāṇāṃ devikānāṃ ca karmaṇāṃ śuklapakṣe'yanapuṇyadināni anuṣṭhānakālaḥ |
'chatriṇo gacchanti' iti ekenāpi chatriyā vahunāṃ chatrilopacāradarśanāt |
evamekenāpi pibatā dvau pibantau ucyate 'ṛtaṃ pibantī' ityatra |
chatriṇo gacchanti ityekena chatriyā sarvai lakṣyante |
bhā. 1|4|123 (6), chatriṇo gacchanti, dhvajino gacchanti iti liṅgaśramāvāt śabda- pravṛttiḥ |
ekathaiva mantrasya prāṇabhṛte- 'pi 'chatriṇo gacchanti' itivat tatsahacaritāḥ sarve mantrāḥ prāṇabhṛcchabdena lakṣyante |
yathā loke chatriṇo yānti prayoge saparivāra rāśi gacchati chatracchatrinudāye chatriśabdo vartate |
tatra hi 'ṛtaṃ pibantī sukṛtasya loke guhāṃ praviṣṭau parame parārdhe |
chāyātopa brahmavido vadanti pañcāgnayo ye ca triṇāciketāḥ |
tatra kimiha buddhijīvī nirdiṣṭau, uta jīvaparamātmānau iti bahudhā samīmāṃsya ṛtaṃ pibanto ityatra jīve pibati aśnādyatīta: paramātmā'pi tatsāhacaryāt chatrinyāyena pibatītyupacaryate ityāyuktam |
ku. 2|3|4|5, arthavādagataghṛtaśabdastu vidhunusāreṇa chatrinyāyena ghṛtā- ghṛtalakṣakaḥ iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
1|4|19|20 āmiṣyāgāye viśeṣapāṃ devānāmijyānyatayā tattvaccaritārthatāṃ sarveṣāṃ chatrinyāyena vaiśvadevatvam |

vi. 1|4|11 ubhayo- bhoktṛtvamekatra (ṛtaṃ pibanto ityatra ), ekasya bhoktṛtva- manyasya cobhoktṛtvamanyana ( dvā suparṇā ityatra ), iti vidyābhedamuktvā chatrinyāyena avirodhāt jīvopādānasya tādātmyapratipādanārthatvācca rūpābhedād vidheyaikyamuttra, tanna chatrinyāyādimirdhaityakasya 'guhā praviṣṭo' ityatra siddha- tvāt |
śrīkara. 1|3|44 nsa. ekastatra karmaphalaṃ pibati mukte netaraḥ, tathāpi pātusaṃnatvāt pibanto ityucyate chatrinyāyena |

kaṭhopa. śāṃbhā. 3|1. cāturmāsyeṣu 'vaiśvadevena yajeta' ityukte āgneyādi- yāgasamudāyasya grahaṇam ityukte na nāmeyādiyāgasamudāyasya kathaṃ vaiśvadevaśabdo nāmadheyaṃ syāt, āmiṣyāgāyām viśvadevadevatvāt iti vācyam |
ku. 1|4|11|14. jyotiṣṭome ca chatrinyāyena pṛṣṭhaśabdaprayogatāt lakṣaṇā saptadaśāni pṛṣṭhāni iti ( jyotiṣṭome ekameva vastutaḥ pṛṣṭham ) |
vā. 7|3|137 phala- vākye ( jyotiṣṭomena svargakāmo yajeta ) yajiḥ prakṛta- sarvadhānyatvopalakṣakaḥ jyotiṣṭomapadaṃ ca chatrinyāyena sarva- nāmadheyamiti prāpte |
idaṃ pauruṣeyamapi ( sa jayati piṅgalanāgaḥ; paiṅgale trilaghum iti tatroktatvāt |
vi. 1|3|7 chandasā samānāsveva tisṛṣu ṛkṣu gānaṃ jyotiṣṭome |
maṇi. pṛ. 5. chandasi tu yathādṛṣṭam ( pāśyādhyāyasthaṃ sūtram |
yāva- darśanaṃ prāmāṇyamabhyupagantavyaṃ chandasi, na darśanamati- kramitavyam |
chandasi yatheṣṭaṃ padānāmanvayo varṇanīyaḥ iti nyāyāt śruterathasya ( ca ) vicāro yuktaḥ |
gāyatrameva chando yasya stotrādau iti bahuvrīhiḥ |
kimayaṃ bhakṣamantraḥ kevalagāyatracchandaska- pradāne bhavati, kiṃvā chando'ntarasahitagāyatracchandaska'pi pradāne iti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
chandaśca 'gāyatracchandasaḥ' ityādi padamapi yatra stotrādau kevalagāyatracchandaskā eva ṛcaḥ, tatraiva yāge sammanveti bṛhaspatisavādī |
devatātvat, yathā kevalandradevatāke eva yāge indrapītasya iti padaṃ sammanvati, nānyadevatāsahitendradevatāke aindrādau, tadvat |
sarveṣu chando'ntarasahitagāyatracchandaske'pi yāgeṣu jyotiṣṭomādau bhakṣamantre 'gāyatracchandasaḥ' 'triṣṭupchandasaḥ' ityādi padaṃ pravartate |
tasmāt sarvatra prātaḥsavanīye mantre gāyatracchandasaḥ iti padam, mādhyandine triṣṭupchandasaḥ iti padaṃ prayokta- vyameva |
yathā anyasahitendradevatya- karmaṇi bhakṣamantro na liṅgena viniyujyate, tathā anya- sahitayā gāyatracchandaska'pi iti prayojanākṣepasūtra- vyākhyā |

yāgamartvāmyadvārā yāgopakāritvāt aindra- pradānamātradvārā'pi ca yāgopakāriloppatteḥ pradānānāṃ medāt somaphalacamasayoriva karmaikye'pi prakṛtivikṛti- tvopapattiṣṭhanirāsārthatvena sarvagāmitvāt iti sūtrā- vayavasya sarvābhyāsagāmitvāt somasya taddharmāṇāṃ ca ityarthaḥ |
' vā. 1|3|6|13 pṛ. 240, chandogaireva gautamagomīyairye dharmasūtrai parigṛhyate |
1|3|7|6 pṛ. 244, chandogapravacanaṃ hi bauddhāgaśabdenāmidhīyate tatpravacanatvaṃ kathaṃ audgā- tram, tatsaṃbandhācca puruṣāḥ pravṛttatvena anuṣṭhātratvena ca udgātāraḥ |
3|5|8|26 pṛ. 1003 chandogasūtra- kṛtā 'tarasapuroḍāśamaṃsarodhāt' iti sūtreṇa ( śākyā- nāmayane ) ajamiśraṇe māṃsasya puroḍāśaniṣpādana- sāmarthyamuktam |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ ekacchandasi some mantraḥ, uta nānācchandasyeti |
yathā anyasahitendra na mantraḥ, evam anekacchandaske some na syāt mantraḥ iti |
atrāpi hi gāyatracchandasaḥ iti saviśeṣaṇasya samāso nāvakalpate |
tatra pūrvadeva tāvat sāpekṣagāyatracchandaḥsādhanake samāsābhāvāt gāyatracchanda- svānupapatteḥ yatra kevalā gāyatrī upayuktā, sa eva mantreṇa abhidhātaḥ nānyaḥ |
vā-- iti prāpte, amidhīyate 'yatra nāmopapadyeta nirapekṣaṃ viśeṣaṇam |
sāpekṣasyāprahastatra na tu yatrāpi nāsti tat |
yadi kevalamidevataḥ prakaraṇe na syāt, tataḥ sāpekṣadevatyo'pi yatheteti |
tadiha kevalandradevatya- sadbhāvāt indrapītatvaṃ sāpekṣadevatyāt nivṛttam, na tu kevalagāyatracchandastvaṃ kasya cidasti |
trayāṇāmapi vedānāṃ ka cit sādhāraṇāśe chando'ntarāṇāṃ avaśyambhāvitātvāt |
ato rayaṃtarasāmatvamiva nānācchandaskāsu eva gāyatra- cchandastvam |
ata eva nityasāpekṣeṣu naitat bhaviṣyati sāpekṣasamarthamiti |
soma-- sūtrārthastu devatātvat chando'pi anya- sāhityena syāditi |
chandobhirapi yukte syā, dādyo mantre tathoktiḥ |
ataśca kevala- meva yatra aindradāne gāyatrīcchando yathā vṛhaspativādī 'gāyatrametadaharbhavati' iti śrutaḥ; tatraivāśauktārthaḥ; na tu jyotiṣṭome niveśaḥ; kevalagāyatrīcchandaskapradānābhāvāt |
na ca sāmānyasaṃbandhabodhakapramāṇābhāvaḥ; indradevatyatva- prātaḥsavanadīnāmantrasya loke abhāvena pariśeṣyadeva vṛha- spatisavanopapattisaṃbhavāt |

iti prāpte, vṛhaspatisave'pi savanamulīye ṛgantarasya paṭhitatvāt 'gāyatrametat' ityādeśca bhūmnā'pi vyākhyānopapatteḥ prakṛtau vikṛtau vā kevalagāyatracchandaskatvābhāvāt, nityāpekṣatvena samāso- papatteḥ prakṛtaudeva niveśaḥ |
vastutastu gāyatryāḥ pratyekameva sādhanatvāt satyapi ṛgantare na samāsabhaṅgaḥ'pi |

' (pā0 śikṣā 52 ) iti svarayukte japādau arthaprakāśanaṃ darśayati |
ata eva japaticodanā- coditatve'pi na sarvanādṛṣṭārthatvaṃ karaṇamantratvāderapi saṃbha- vāt |
stutistu guṇatātparyakamabhidhānam adṛṣṭārthakama- pi śraddhājananādidvārā karmaṇyupayogaḥ |
eteṣāṃ ca kacit sāṅkarya'pi na doṣaḥ, tattadapātteḥ atrāṣṭārtha |

tatra ye tāvadadṛṣṭārtha- prakāśakāḥ japādayaḥ teṣāṃ karaṇamantratvādeva vikalpaḥ, ye tu ananuṣṭheyasamavetaprakāśanārthāḥ, teṣāṃ prakāśakatve'pi śraddhājananādidvārā karmaṇyupayogān adhikataraśraddhā- jananārthaṃ samuccaya eva |
ye tu adṛṣṭārthasametaprakāśa- nārthāḥ, teṣāṃ prajājādideva samuccayaḥ |
na ca ekajapādi- samākhyāyogāt ekakāryatvāgataḥ vikalpaśaṅkā, dṛṣṭārtha- japādau kāryabhedasya āvaśyakatvena sakalajapadhāraṇaika- kāryakalpanā'nupapatteḥ |
yattu dvādaśe japādīnāma- dṛṣṭārthamuktam, tat mantrasādhyārthābhidhānasya ahaṣṭārtha- tvāmiprāyeṇa |

astu vā japādīnāṃ karmasamavetārthābhi- dhāyināmuccāraṇamātrārthatvam, naitāvatā karmasamavetārthā- bhidhāyanāmapi karaṇamantrādīnāṃ dṛṣṭavidhayā upayogasaṃbhave adṛṣṭārthoccāraṇārthatvakalpanā yuktā |
' yena karmaṇeseṃt tatra jayāna juhuyāt ' ' rāṣṭrabhṛto juhoti ' iti ' abhyātānān juhoti ' iti |
tatraite kiṃ sarvakarmaṇāṃ kuṣpādīnāṃ śeṣabhūtāḥ, uta vaidikānamihiśotrādīnāmiti |
kiṃ tāvat prāptam ? sarvakarmaṇāṃ śeṣāḥ, viśeṣaṇamidhānāditi |

pūrvapakṣavādī tatra paśyannapi āhavanīya- saṃyogaṃ homānāṃ prādhānyāt tadaṃśena āhavanīyaprapatteḥ kṛṣisevādanāmapi ṛddhisādhanatvaviśeṣatvāt vākyate ' yena karmaṇā ṛddhimicchet ' ityevamupalakṣaṇaṃ kartuma iti manyamāna āha sarvakarmaṇāṃ śeṣo jayāditi |
tena sevā- dinā'pi ṛddhimicchan āhavanīyaye jayādīn juhuyāt |
na cāhavanīyasya ete na prayojakāḥ, homamātroddeśena āhavanīyavidhānāt |
tena anāhitāgneḥ mā nāma bhūvan, āhitāgninā tu varṇinirūpaṃ laukikamapi karma anutiṣṭhatā kartavyāḥ |
evaṃ ca anāramyavādādasvaraso na bhagno bhaviṣyati |
na ca evamādayaḥ sākṣāt karmasaṃbandhinaḥ prakṛtyarthāḥ syāsanti, kāmaṃ vā punaruktabhayāt vikṛti varjayeyuḥ, kuṣpādiṣu tu na kā cit punaruktatāśaṅkā ityavarṇanameva yuktam |
bhāṣyam-- na caitadasti sarvakarmaṇāṃ karṣaṇādīnāmapi aṅgabhūtā iti |
āhavanīyasaṃyogo bhavati homeṣu ' yadāhavanīye juhoti, tena so'syāgneḥ prīto bhavati ' iti |
na caiṣāṃ gārhapatyo'sti, yataḥ praṇīte āhava- nīyaḥ syāt |
vā-- nyavatiṣṭheran ete homā vaidiketveva, na sarvatra bhaveyuḥ |
na ca kuṣpādibhiḥ sākameṣāṃ syāt tulyadeśatā ||
karṣaṇaṃ hi bhūmau kriyate, rājakule ca sevā |
jayādyaśca homatvāt avihitādhikārāntarāḥ ekāntena āhavanīya kartavyāḥ |
tatra vinā vacanena aṅgapradhānavaideśyam āpadyamānaṃ vaiguṇyaṃ janayet |
asti vaiṣamyo viṣayaḥ, yatra aviguṇā bhavanti |
na ca śāstreṇa abhyanujñātāṃ kṛtaṃ phalaṃ dadāti |
ataḥ saguṇasaṃpadanāyaiva anāhitāgnīnāmaviduṣāmapi abhyanujñāyāṃ ca ete na bhavanti |
nanu kṣetrameva āha- vanīyaṃ nītvā hoṣyate |
sāmīpyāmātraṃ hi tatrānujñayate, na tu samānadeśatvam |
nahi ekaikasmin vidāraṇe āhavanīyaṃ nikṣiptaṃ hotuṃ śakyate |
bhāṣyam-- itaśca paśyāmau vaidikānāṃ śeṣabhūtā iti |
ādhvaryavamiti hi samā- khyāte vede jayādayaḥ samāmnātāḥ santaḥ adhvaryuṇā kariṣyante |
karṣaṇādiṣu adhvaryorabhāvāt anadhvaryuṇā'pi kriyamāṇāḥ samākhyāyāṃ bādheran |
kuṣpādīnāṃ tu ṛtvigbhāvāt bhedena ca jayādīnāṃ varaṇadīnāmanā- mnānāt apūrvatvāt codakena prāptirnāsti |
yadi ca tadarthameva adhvaryurvidyate, tataḥ kartṛbhedo'pi āpadyate |
tena samākhyānāt yo vākya- śeṣaḥ, adhvaryuṇā kartavyam adhvaryurvā yaḥ kartṛtvena śeṣa- bhūtaḥ, sa evamanugṛhīto bhavati iti vyavasthāsiddhiḥ |
tatastāvādeva anāramyadhītānāṃ jayādīnāṃ vākyenaiva karmākhye sthite tadiśeṣaśrūyate |
soma-- 'yadajayan tajayānāṃ jayalam' ityukte: 'cittaṃ ca' ityādimantrakaraṇahomā: jayā:|
sūtrārthastu- ya: prakaraṇadhīto vākyāt karmaśeṣa: sa: aviśeṣāt sarvakarmaṇāṃ śeṣa: iti|
, homa āhvanīyaye syāt kṛṣṇādiṣu na so'sti hi|
13. bhāṭṭa-- anārambhava adhītam 'yena karmeṇaitat tatra jayān juhuyāt' iti|
karmaṇyā: phalādhikyecchayā taṃ jayā- daya: karmāṇi|
tatra ca karmalasya phalābhyantaritatvāt na tāvat juhādivat tadupatiṣṭhati|
na ca laukikasya karmaṇa: kṛṣibhojanāde: dṛṣṭārthatvena adṛṣṭārthajayādigraha- katyāyoga:|
'rohiṇyāṃ kṛṣikarmāṇi kāryet' 'purastāt kṛṣikarmaṇā prājyā kṣetramaryādāyāṃ khāvāpṛthivīṃ baliṃ haret' ityādidat asyāpi nirvighnaparisamāptyarthatvena phalopacayārthatvena vā grahaṇopapatte:|
na ca tathāpi jayāde: āhvanīyasādhyatvāt kṛṣṇādau tadabhāvāt anaṅgatvam, jayādereva homatvena āhvanīyapraṇayanaprayojakatvopapatte:|
na ca pradhānasādeśyāsaṃbhavāt anaṅgatvam, aṅgaguṇa- virodhanyāyena tadasaṃbhave'pi aṅgopapatte:|
vastutastu kṛṣideśārthatayā vidheyatvābhāvena prayogavidhyābhāvāt aṅgapradhānayo: eka- deśatve eva pramāṇabhāva:|
astu vā tat, tathāpi tasya liṅgādirūpapramāṇatvābhāvena vākyasaṃkocatvānupapatte: laukikavaidikasādhāraṇasarvakarmārthatvameva jayādīnām|

iti prāpte, agnibhaidikakarmārthe tasya paramyupāśritapraṇayanopa- jīvitvam, tadanyakarmārthe ca tattvayojakalapanam iti gauravavairuppyādinā kāmaśrutīnāṃ āhitāgnyādimātra- viṣayatvavat (6|1|7) jayādividhinaiva svalāghavārtham agnimatkarmārthatayaiva jayādividhānāt netarakarmārthatvam|

' 15. jayādinvāyenaiva laukike phalakalpanā vaidike na ityevam, vihite'pi agnirahite tatpraṇayādiprayojaka- tvam itaratra na, ityevaṃ ca vairūpyate: vidhivādhavānu- rodhenaiva svasaṃkocaṃ kāmaśrutideva anumanyate, ataśca agnimatkarmasaṃncavyaśabdānameva uddeśyam|
tadapi ca na śeṣitayā, apitu nimittatayaiva|
bhāṭṭa. 3|4|14. jayamantreṣu cittādiśabdānāṃ caturthepāṭhe na kartavya:; kintu yathāsāmnāmeva prayoga:|
te ca na kṛṣṇādiṣu laukikakarmasu, kintu vaidikeṣveva kartavyā:|
vi.2|4|12. jayahomamantrāṇāṃ prayāmāntacaturthyantāpāṭho: samuccayā: iti cenna, kintu vikalpa eva|

su. pṛ. 1138. jarāSSdiśabdānāṃ yadāgamaparibhāṣā lakṣaṇā- grahaṇāt prāk jarāśabdalāghavacchepotthāpakatvena niruktaviśiṣṭarūpopādānatvasya (sākṣādānupūrvyacchinna- mukhyaviśeṣyatāpayojakatvarūpaviśiṣṭarūpopādānatvasya) su- vacatvāt|
(kārale iti bhāṣā ), gavīdhukā: tṛṇaṇḍalā:, iti bhaṭṭabhāskara:|
ke. 'jartilayavāgvā ca juhuyāt gavīdhukāyavāgvā vā juhuyāt, na grāmyān paśūn hinasti nāraṇyān|
ayo khalvāhu: anāhutirve jartilāśca gavīdhukāśra, payasā'gnihotraṃ juhuyāt' iti vidhe:, 'anāhuti: iti ca nindayā niṣedhānumānāt, vidiniṣedhau|
'na cedanyaṃ prakalpayet praklatārthavāda: syādanarthakyāt parasāmarthyāñca' iti|
na cedanyaṃ vidhiṃ prakalpayet, yadi atra pratyakṣo vidhi: saṃnihito na syāt tata: ṣoḍaśigrahaṇavākyavat ekena śiṣṭyā pareṇa pratiṣedha: syāt|
iha tu 'payasā'gnihotraṃ juhuyāt' iti vidhyantarasya praklatātvato taccheṣabhūto'- yamarthavāda: syāt|
anyathā niṣedhaikavākyatvaṃ vinā nindātvānavadhāraṇaṇa anāhutitvakīrtanasya niṣedhakalpaka- tvāsaṃbhavāt ānarthakyāpatte:|
kathañcit kalpitasyāpi vā niṣedhasya ṣoḍaśigrahaṇaniṣedhatvat vikalpārthatvāt tasya cātra paya:prabhṛtidravyantaravidhānatvena siddhe: ānarthakyā- parihārāt|
yavāgūstulinindayo: kathaṃ paya:stulyatvam ityāśaṅkya parasāmarthyāñca ityuktam|
grāmyāraṇyapaśu- hiṃsānāpādakatvena praśastatānāmapi jartilagavīdhukānāṃ paya:prayogāpekṣayā duṣṭatvāt paya: praśastataram iti pareṇa payovidhinā anvaye sāmarthyāt ityartha:|
evaṃ ca eka- vākyatve saṃbhavati anekādṛṣṭānubhavikyamedāpādakavidhi- svāṅgīkaraṇayogyāt juhuyāt iti liṅge'pi stutyartha- tvasiddhi:|
na cedanyaṃ prakalpayet praklatārthavāda: syādā- narthakyāt parasāmarthyāñca |
bhāṣyam--idaṃ samāmnāyate agnihotre 'jartilayavāgvā vā juhuyāt, gavīdhukāyavāgvā vā juhuyāt, na grāmyān paśūn hinasti nāraṇyān|
ayo khalvāhu:, anāhutirve jartilāśca gavīdhukāśra, payasā'gnihotraṃ juhuyāt' iti|
atra saṃdeha: kiṃ 'jartilayavāgvā gavīdhukāyavāgvā vā juhoti' iti vidhi:, 'anāhutirve jartilāśca gavīdhukāśra' iti pratiṣedha:, athavā ubhāveto arthavādau, 'payasā'gnihotraṃ juhoti' iti vidhi: iti|
kiṃ prāptam? 'jartilayavāgvā' iti vidhi:, vidhi- śabdasya pratyakṣatvāt|
jartilayavāgvā gavī- dhukāyavāgvā vā hotavyam, na vā tāmyām, payasā hotavyam iti|
nahi naśabdasya jartilayavāgvā gavīdhukāyavāgvā vā sāmarthyamasti|
āhu- tiśabdena saha samastatvāt kalpyamāne vā sāmarthye saṃbandha eva na syāt ajartilayavāgvā jartilayavāgvā juhoti iti|
bhavedaya pratiṣedhena vikalpa:; na cedanyaṃ vidhiṃ prakalpayet|
'payasā'gnihotraṃ juhoti' ityasya vidhe: praklatā jartilagavīdhuhomavacanam anāhutitvacanamapi arthavādārthe syāt|
anarthako hi bhavati tadā prati- ṣedha:|
yadā hi payasā juhoti, ayathādi tadā anāhuti- jartilā gavīdhukā bhavanti|
atha kathamasau anāhuti:, yā yaje hūyate|
parasāmarthyāt pareṇa ca payasā agnihotraṃ juhoti ityanena vidhinā sāmarthye jartilāvīdhukvidhe: pratiṣedhasya ca bhavati|
katham? jartilayavāgvā juhuyāt gavīdhukāyavāgvā vā iti sākṣāt nindāvacanena etat saṃbadhyate anāhutirve jarti- lāśca gavīdha
yatrā 'vibhaṃ bhakṣayitavyaṃ na kadācit' iti viṣabhakṣaṇasya kartavyatā pratiṣedhasaṃbandhārthe kīlyate, nānu- ṣṭhānaya |
ṭup— [ atra asadīyalikhitāyāḥ, ānandā- śramīyāyāḥ mudritāyāḥ, likhitatantraratnānusāriṇyāśca ṭup‌ṭīkāyāḥ, pāṭhā bhinnā bhavanti aṃśataḥ |
tatrādau tantraratnānusāriṇa ralapūraṇena pāṭho nivedyate ] ( pūrva- pakṣamāha—) caturthe'pi [ adhikaraṇe tṛtīye iva ] nāsti paryudāsāḥ |
( tatra tāvat ) jartilayavāguvā dhruvāt iti saṃbandhena paryudāsābhāvaḥ |
yadi home ( payovidheyaṃ śeṣaḥ ) tato jartilavidhānam anarthakam ( syāt ) |
atha evamucyeta anāhutiḥ kartavyeti, tathā ( sati ) homasyaiva abhāvāt sarvameva ( jartilavidhānaṃ payovidhānaṃ ca ) na ghaṭate |
tasmāt 'jartilayavāguvā juhuyāt' iti ( vidhinā ) vihitā yavāgūḥ anena pratiṣidhyate, niṣidhya ( ca ) payo vidhīyate |
tasmāt ( jartila- yavāgvā payasā vā iti ) vikalpaḥ |
atha yathāllikhitaṃ yathāmudritaṃ ca ṭup‌ṭīkā nivedyate ] caturthe'pi nāsti paryudāsaḥ |
yadi home ( yadi payovidheḥ home—iti mudrite ) payaśca jartilayavāguśca prāpnuyāt ( tathā sati—iti mudrite adhikam ) paryudāsaḥ syāt |
( jartilayavāgvā juhuyāditi, tato jartilavidhāna- manarthakam—ityadhikaṃ likhitam ) |
atha evamucyeta anāhutiḥ kartavyeti [ ityādiḥ śeṣaḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ samānaḥ—tritaye'pi ] atha siddhāntaprāyaḥ maidābhāvāt ralapūraṇena ekathaiva nivedyate ] ucyate |
katha- mityāha—) 'anāhutitvaṃ jartilavā' iti anāhuti- vacanena pratiṣedhasya vikalpamicchasi ( taṃ pūrvavādī ) sa ca 'payasā juhuyāt' ityanenaiva labhyate vikalpo vinā'pi pratiṣedhavacanena |
sarvastu ayam 'payasā juhuyāt' ityasya ( vidhīyamānasya ) vākyaśeṣatvena ( eva ) ghaṭate |
tatra ye devadattasya nindāstutī, na te devadattārthe ( devadattaṃ vidhātuṃ niṣeddhuṃ vā uccāryante ) kiṃ tarhi yajñadattārthe |
soma— jartilāḥ kṛṣṇatilāḥ ( kārale ) gavedhukāḥ tṛṇataṇḍulāḥ |
iti kecit ( vanagodhūmā nāma veṇuyavāḥ syuḥ |

sūtrārthastu— yadi anyat na vidhīyeta, tadānīmeva śiṣṭyā śrūyamāṇo nañ pratiṣedhārthaḥ syāt anvayavyatirekī tu arthavādaḥ tadvidhineva jartilādivikalpasya siddhatvāt vikalpārthe pratiṣedhārthakyāt paradravyāntaravidhānāsa marthe- tvāt stutyā ekārthatvāditi |
vi— 'jartilaiktau caturthāṃ kiṃ vikalpo'tha payaḥ- stutiḥ |
vikalpaḥ pūrvavat, maivaṃ vākyaikyāt payasā saha |

tatra jartilavādhīkayoḥ prathamavākyena vihitayoḥ anāhutiḥ ityanena pratiṣedhaḥ, uta sarvo'yaṃ payohoma- vidheryathādaḥ iti cintāyām, ākhyātabhedaśravaṇena bhinnavākyatvasya pravīteḥ stutilakṣaṇayā ekavākyatva- kalpane pramāṇābhāvāt, prathamavākyadvaye ca spaṣṭavidhiśrava- ṇena jartilavādhīkayavāgvāḥ vidheyatvāvaśyakatvāt, anā- hutiḥ ityanena ca ninditatatapratiṣedhakalpanāt tayorvihita- pratiṣiddhatvāt vikalpaḥ |
iti prāpte, yadyapi ādyo jartilavādhīkayoḥ vidhiḥ syāt, tathāpi anāhutiḥ iti nindayā na svatantra- niṣedhenyanam |
ata eva anāhutiḥ iti nindā nahi nindānyāyena payovidhitvastyarthyaiva |
anayoḥ payopekṣayā nindyatvameva, ataḥ paya eva praśasta- taram iti stutiḥ |
śrūyamāṇo'pi ca vidhiḥ vāśabdena vidhiśaktikaprativantvāt na vidhāyakaḥ |
nahi ayaṃ vāśabdo vikalpavidhāyakaḥ, tasya nyāyādeva siddheḥ |
apitu 'viṣamapi bhakṣayet na tu parān bhuñjīyāḥ' itivat anyavidhānatāparyaka eva |
' 5. jartilayavāgunyāyena ekavākyatālābhārthe pūrvasya vidheḥ arthavādatvaṃ prakalpya ... |
ataḥ caturthe ( purastāt paurṇamāsye dīkṣeran ) ityeva vidhiḥ |

6|1|10. yūpai- kādaśinyām 'yatpakṣasaṃmitāṃ minuyāt kanīyāṃsaṃ yajñakratu- mupeyāt... vedisaṃmitāṃ minoti' ityatra stutipūrvaka- stadvidhirapi na vidhānārthaḥ, apitu jartilayavāgunyāyena yathaikādaśinīṣṭiyupaikyavidhivistṛtyarthaḥ, ekavākyatā- lābhārt |
yathā jalamānīyatāmityukte anoditamapi pātrānayanaṃ jalānayane'ntarbhavatīti, tathā prakṛte'pi |

jāgare gajādimatsu deśeṣu yathātulapabhasra ca svamārthanāṃ jāgaritānāṃ ca jalālokapavananyāyena mūrttatve'pi miyaḥpratighātakatvā- bhāvakalpanopapatteḥ ( jalālokapavanānāṃ parasparapratighāta- katvaṃ yathā nāsti ) |
parimala. 3|2|15-6 brasū. jalāśayata raṅgacandranyāyena eva śuddhaḥ ātmā jīvarūpeṇa bahudhā dṛśyate |
sa hi varuṇagṛhīta ityucyate jalo- dareṇa yo gṛhītaḥ yaśodaraṃ jalavṛddhyā śrayati |
na ca tasya aśraprati- graho laukikaḥ nidānamiti pratijñāyate, na cānena vidhī- yate |
bhā. 3|4|10-129, jalodarākhyo doṣaḥ jalabuddhyā udara- buddhilakṣaṇaḥ |
su. pṛ. 1493. jalodarāgeḥ pūrva- janmani aśradāttuḥ prāyaścittākaraṇe asmin janmani bhavati ( āryikamidam ) |
yathā 'śītasparśavatya āpaḥ,' iti lakṣaṇato jale svābhāvikaṃ śaityaṃ vartate, uṣṇatvaṃ tu tejaḥsaṃyogāditi |
evaṃ cāyaṃ nyāyaḥ anyāsādhāraṇa- dharmasya anyatāropavivakṣāyāṃ pravartate iti bhāvaḥ |
ayaṃ bādhyaṃ pratrādhya svayameva bādhakamiṣṭiviṣayatvāt pravartate |

yathā sapaṅkajale prakṣiptāḥ katakarauṣadhiviśeṣasya 'nirmalī' iti bhāṣāyāṃ prasiddhasya reṇavo rājanti tasmāt sapaṅkajalāt paṅkaṃ vilāpya svayameva vilīyante, tathā tattvajñānaṃ savilā- sājñānaṃ nivartya svayameva nivartate iti |
yathā jalapātrebhyu candraprati- bimbāni candrāt dūrasthāni bhinnāni ca nānāvidhāni dṛśyante |
tathā na śrutiḥ— 'eka eva tu bhūtātmā bhūtebhūte vyavasthitaḥ |

yathā jalaguṇā mādhuryadeva- śaityādayo jalasyopari vātavaśāt taraṅge utpanne sati jalavivartatvena jalaniṣṭhe tasmistaraṅge prāpya taraṅgotsyana- nantaraṃ taraṅgavivartatvena taraṅganiṣṭhe phene'pyanugatāḥ |

jalam, taraṅgaḥ, phenaḥ iti medavyavahāre vidyamāne'pi jaladīnāṃ mādhuryadravyaśaityavyatirekena svarūpābhāvāt teṣāṃ mādhurya- dravyaitātmakatvāt pūrvapūrvadhiṣṭhānasyaiva uttarottaravyāvṛttā- kāraṇa vivartamānatvāt |
uttarottarakāryasya pūrvādhiṣṭhānā- nantyatvaṃ pradarśitaṃ manena nyāyena |
cetanācetanaprapañcasya jalataraṅgabudbudanyāyena tatraivotpattipralayayoḥ śravaṇāt ‘eṣa yoniḥ sarvasya prabhavāpyayau hi bhūtānām’ iti tadanyatvāt sarvasyeti bhāva ityuktamiti|
yathā paṅkaliptā tumbikā nadīsamudrādau majjantī paṅkakṣaye āgatya tiṣṭhati, tathā jīvo dehakṣaye lokādākāro gatvā tiṣṭhati|
ayameva tasya mokṣa iti digambarajainā manyante|
jale prakṣiptasya tailasya yathā jalopari gamanaṃ bhavati, tathā karmabandhamuktasya jīvasya lokākāśāt upari gamanaṃ bhavati, sa eva mokṣaḥ jainamate|
atra yājñavalkyaḥ ‘satyena mā'bhirakṣa tvaṃ varuṇetyabhiśāpa kam|

mitākṣarā- he varuṇe satyena mām abhirakṣa tvam ityanena mantreṇa kam udakam abhiśāpya abhimantya nāmidrodakasthasya nāmi- pramāṇodakasthasya puruṣasya uru gṛhītvā śodhyo jalaṃ praviśet jale nimajjet|
tataḥ kiṃ kartavyam ityata āha- (yājña0) ‘samakālamidaṃ muktamānīyato javī naraḥ|
mitā- (nimajjanāt prāk) triṣu śareṣu mukteṣu eko vegavān (puruṣaḥ) madhyamaśarapātasthānaṃ gatvā tamādāya tathaiva tiṣṭhati|
anyastu puruṣo vegavān śara- mokṣasthāne toraṇamūle tiṣṭhati|

evaṃ sthitayoḥ (tayoḥ) tṛtīyasyāṃ karatālikāyāṃ śodhyo nimajjati, tatsamakālameva toraṇamūlasthito'pi drutataraṃ madhyamaśarapātasthānaṃ gacchati, (tatratyaḥ) śaragrāhī ca tasmin prāpte drutataraṃ toraṇamūlaṃ prāpya antarjalagataṃ yadi na paśyati, tadā (śodhyaḥ) śuddho bhavati iti|
yathā jalakaṇikāpātena ghaṭaḥ kramaśaḥ pūryate, evaṃ vidyānāṃ dharmasya dhanasya ca kramaśaḥ saṃcayo bhavatīti viṣaye'sya pravṛttiriti|
sa hetuḥ sarvavidyānāṃ dharmasya ca dhanasya ca ||
yathā jalasya manthanaṃ vyartham, na navanītapradam, tadapi|
ayaṃ deśakālapātraśraddhā- viśeṣadalamapi mahatsambhavatvaṃ jalamauktikanyāyena prāpnotīti dīnāditi|
