sāhasī. 763. (svātījala- meva mauktikaṃ bhavati) svābhāvikamedanitiḥ amara- kīṭaka-loharasa-jalamauktikādinānāvidhadṛṣṭāntānusāreṇa (iti) jijñāsādhikaraṇe spaṣṭamuktam|
sā hi stanalā'pi kṣīra- magṛhītvā raktameva gṛhṇāti tathā khalaḥ|

anyo- 'pi jalūkānyāyaḥ: bṛhadāraṇyakopaniṣadi uktaḥ ‘tadyathā tṛṇajalāyukā (tṛṇasyaḥ kīṭakaḥ) tṛṇasyāntaṃ gatvā anya- mākramyākramya ātmānamupasaṃharati (tṛṇāntaraṃ gacchati), evameva ayamātmā idaṃ śarīraṃ nihatya anyamākramyākramya (vāsanayā anyaṃ dehaṃ gṛhītvā) ātmānamupasaṃharati’ iti|
etena ahaha- sājālye'pi nityakāmyadarśadile'''pi agrahyamāṇa- viśeṣatayā tantratvameva, na tu kāmyena nityaprasaṅgaḥ; mānābhāvāt |
kāme sati tasyaiva nimittasyāpi prayojaka- tvasya prāmāṇikatvena tadabhāvakalpanāyāṃ pramāṇābhāvāt |
itarathā kāmanyāyāḥ phalotpatti pratyeka kāraṇakalpanena vaiparītyasyāpi vaktuṃ śakyatvāt |
vyaktibhede paraṃ kāmyena godohanādinā nityamamakāryasiddhiḥ prasaṅgeneti tadviṣayo'yaṃ kāmyena nityasiddhiḥ prasaṅgeneti pravādaḥ |
tathāpi ahaha- vaijātyena ka cit prasaṅgaḥ |
smṛtau tu atra 'vipra- daṇḍoyame kṛcchrastatikṛcchro nipāte |
( jāghanyā patnīḥ iti vākyam ) vikṛtau kārye kurvat uktyapyate ityucyate |
bhāṣyam - jāghanī vā patnīsaṃyājānāṃ guṇatvena vidhīyate |
tatra svaśabdena patnīsaṃyājā vihitāḥ, jāghanīsaṃbandhaḥ teṣāmavihitaḥ |
yatra ca saṃbandho vidhīyate, tatra anyatarasyāmya vidhānam, saṃbandho nāntarīyaḥ |
yatrobhau lakṣaṇatvena, tatra svaśabdena saṃbandho vidhīyate |
yatra tu anyataro lakṣaṇatvena, tatraikaṃ lakṣayitvā anyataro vidhīyate |
kathamavagamyate ? patnīsaṃbandhaśca sarvo yāgaḥ kaścideva tu lakṣyate, yasya patnyaḥ sādhanatvena |
atha kasmānna jāghanī lakṣyitvā patnīsaṃyājā vidhīyante ? nāsya apūrvasya yāgasya patnyaḥ śakyante vidhātum |
jāghanyāṃ tu lakṣyamāṇāyāṃ yāge sapnīke vidhīyamāne vākyaṃ bhidyeta |
asti tu atra vihitaḥ sapatnīko yāgaḥ, yaḥ patnīlakṣitavyate |
evaṃ cet darśapūrṇamāsayorvinā jāghanyā viguṇaḥ patnīsaṃyājaḥ syāt |
vā - na vā asya vidhetkarṣa iti |
' sarvatra evaṃvidhe vākye guṇe vidhikriteḥ saṃcara- tītyuktam |
patnīsaṃyājāśca anantaravihitā manasi vartante, iti na vidhātuṃ śakyante |
na ceha sthitena paśugatapatnī- saṃyājanādo yuktaḥ, tadduddhayabhāvāt |
na ca jāghanyāḥ kālāditvat anupādeyatvam, yenemaṃ vidhimākarṣet |
yadi ca kṛtārtho jāghanīṃ pratyutya artha vidhiḥ pravarteta, tathāpi tāvat kadācit prayājaśeṣavat dvitīyā'rthe ( jāghanyā iti ) tṛtīyā iti vyākhyāyeta |
na ca prakaraṇavadvatvāt ete patnīsaṃyājā utkarṣaṃ sahante |
vākyabalī yastvāt iti cenna, vākyasyāpi evamādeḥ adhiṣṭhitāpekṣitvena prakaraṇāt durbalataratvāt |
yadi hi etadeva patnīsaṃyājānāṃ utpattivākyaṃ bhavet, tataḥ prakaraṇāt ācchicyāntā |
ete tu vākyāntarotpattitvāt saṃniveśena yāvatā kālena etena vākyena saṃgṛhyante, tāvatā darśapūrṇamāsābhyāmapi śakyā grahītum |
na ca jāghanyāḥ phalavattvaṃ vijñātam, yena eteṣāṃ prayojanā- kāṅkṣāmapanayet |
ato yāvat ' athau kimarthā ' ityā- lepyate, tāvat phaladarśapūrṇamāsaprasūtena kathamabhāvena aṅgatvāmāpāditāt |
na ca iha apūrvayāgavidhānam, yajimātratvena aśravaṇāt |
tatra yadi jāghanyūdeśena ca karma vidhīyate, patyaśrāsa vidhīyante |
tataḥ anekārthavidhānāt ' eka- śabdārthe parārthavat ' iti verūpyalakṣaṇo vākyabhedaḥ syāt |
nanu evamapi viśiṣṭānuvādāt sutarāṃ vākyaṃ bhidyeta |
yathaiva ' abhigrāmaṃ juhoti ' iti sāmānyaśabde'pi adhi- kārāt prayājaviśeṣo bhavati, tathaiva ' yat saṃyājayanti ' ityetāvataiva adhikṛtāḥ patnīsaṃyājāḥ pratyeṣyante |
bhāṣyam - atha yaduktam ekādeśo jāghanī na paśuṃ prayokṣyate, tasmādutkarṣa iti, tat parihartavyam |
vā - yaduktam ' ekādeśaśrautau vidyamāna- saṃyogāt aprayojakaḥ iti ' tatrocyate |
( yadyapi eka- deśo dravyaṃ yasya yāgasya iti caturthādhikaraṇasyettha- deśadravyaśabdārthaḥ, tathāpi atra jāghanīśabdabodhakatayā svīkriyate iti sudhāyāṃ sūcitam |
tantraratne tu ekādeśa- dravyam iti karmaviśeṣatvena caturthādhikaraṇe napuṃsakaḥ svīkṛtaḥ |
bhāṣyam - na prakṛtau darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ jāghanī śāstreṇocyate |
( asmāt bhāṣyāt ' na prakṛtāva- śāstraniṣpatteḥ ' iti sūtrasya pāṭhaḥ sidhyati |
bhāṣyastho nañ tu aśāstraniṣpatteḥ iti samāsagatasya naño vyākhyā |
) vā - sa nāma aprayojako bhavati, yasya prakṛtagraha- ṇāt vinā artho na jñāyate yathā ' uttarādhārta sviṣṭakṛte samavacati ' iti |
sā ca antareṇāpi paśupādānaṃ paraprayuktapaśujīvanaṃ vā, śakyā upādātum |
' rūpaṃ vā'śeṣabhūtatvāt ' iti yathā yathārthaṃ tathā yenakenacit upādāya śakyā anuṣṭhātum |
na ceyaṃ avayavabhūtā loke na pracarati |
na ca avayavamiyaṃ chāgādeva grahītavyā, jaghanāvayavamātra- tvena śravaṇāt |
agnīṣomīye'pi hṛdayādīnāṃ saṃbhavatveva lokādupādānam, tathā satyapi tu teṣāṃ bhedenaiva jātiviśeṣaḥ utpattiprakārakaśca saṃspanādityataḥ, iti krayācanāśravaṇam |
na tu iha tathā śāstrakṛtā niṣpattiḥ |
tasmāt dāśīpūrṇamāsaikapatnīsaṃyājāṅgatvena ājyena saha vikalpyamānā jāghanī iti siddham |
śā - ( siddhāntaḥ - ) ' jāghanī hi guṇatvena tṛtīyā''ktyā-(jāghanyā iti ) svagamyate |
darśau, tat paśau yuktaṃ jāghanyāḥ samavāyataḥ |
, jāghanī nāma bhāgo'sau darśau samavaiti hi |
bhāṭ - darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ patnīsaṃyājāvāntaraprakaraṇe ' jāghanyā patnīḥ saṃyājayanti ' iti śrutam |

tatra kima- nena vākyena agnīṣomīyadhanuṣipaśuyāgoddeśena patnī- saṃyājā vidhīyante tataścaitasya vidhānasya prakaraṇotkarṣaḥ; uta patnīsaṃyājoddeśena jāghanī dravyatvena vidhīyate, iti cintāyām, jāghanīśabdasya uttarādhārtādiśabdavat ekadeśa- dravyavācitvena jāghanyāḥ paraprayuktatvāt prayojana- vattvāvagamana prayājaśeṣavat uddeśyatvāvagateḥ tṛtīyāyāḥ dvitīyā'rthalakṣaṇamaṅgīkṛtya patnīsaṃyājā etra taduddeśena vidhīyante |

evaṃ ca vākyena prakaraṇa- bādhāt patnīsaṃyājānāṃ paścātvamātrātprakṛtāvāpi ' ājyena patnīḥ saṃyājayanti ' iti vacanasya nirviṣayatvāpatteḥ praka- raṇāvāgotyā tena ca ārādupakārakatvā darśapūrṇamāsā- ṅgatvavāgame'pi anena vacanena saṃnipatyopakārakatvā agnī- pomīyapaśuyāgāṅgatvavā vidhāne'nupapatteḥ |

na ca jāghanyāḥ paraprayuktapaśudhanuṣipatvasya loke'pi saṃbhavatvāt agnī- caritakratusaṃbandhabhāvena kathaṃ yāgīyalopasthitiḥ ?, agnī- pomīyaprakaraṇe śrutena ' jāghanyā patnīḥ saṃyājayanti ' iti vākyāntareṇa prakṛtāpūrvasādhanabhūtajāghanyūdeśena patnī- saṃyājavidhāyakena yāgasaṃbandhopasthitau ' aṃgaṃ gṛhṇāti ' ititvat anāryādhīte'pi asmin ṛtusaṃbandhavāgamo- papatteḥ |

yattu kaiścitdeśādeva patnīsaṃyājānāṃ paśuyāga- saṃbandhavāgamāt prākaraṇikavākyaṃ tadarthakamāntaravidhāyakaṃ pūrvapakṣe ityuktam, tat atideśena patnīsaṃyājānām ārādupakārakatvavidhā paśūyāgasaṃbandhavāgame'pi tātparya- grāhakābhāve anāryādhītavākye jāghanyāstadīyopasthitau pramāṇābhāvāt, atideśena saṃvidhāne prakaraṇāntarāsaṃbhavena karmāntaratvānupapatteśca upekṣitam |
tasmādākyena prakaraṇaṃ bādhitvā idaṃ vidhānamagnīṣomīye utkṛṣyate |
jāghanīśabdasya paśvavayavavācitve'pi uttarādyādiśabdavat sasaṃbandhakatvābhāvāt lokasiddhadṛṣṭyajāghanyā eva ājya- vat patnīsaṃyājojjheśana vidhisaṃbhave tṛtīyāyā lakṣaṇa'ṅgī- karaṇe pramāṇābhāva: |
atideśāt prāptānāṃ patnīsaṃyājānā- ārādupakārakatvāccena paśuprakaraṇasthavākyenaiva saṃni- patyopakārakatvalābhe darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇasthavākyavaiyarthyā- pattiśca |
na ca prāptakarmānuvādena patnīnāmapi vidhāne, devatātvena prāpyatvādāne'pi ca, viśiṣṭadeśe vākyabhedāpattiriti vācyam |
agnī- pomīyaprakaraṇasthavākyaṃ tu vikalpena prāptāyā niyamārthamiti vakṣyate |
na caivaṃ tatra dṛṣṭyajāghanyā eva niyamasaṃbhavena paśununiṣpannāyā grahaṇe pramāṇābhāva:, pratipatyantarābhāvena upasthitāyāstasyāstyāge pramāṇābhāvāditi tatraiva vakṣya- māṇatvāt |
'jāghanyā patnī: saṃyājayanti ājyena vā' iti vihitam |
paśau punaḥ śrutam 'jāghanyā patnī: saṃyājayanti' iti, tat patnī- saṃyājānāṃ jāghanyārthatā'rthe na bhavati aprākṛtakāryā''- patte:; kintu prakṛtito vaikalpikā: prāptāyā jāghanyā: niyamārtham |
tatra ca upāyadeyatvāt jāghanīkatvaṃ vivakṣi- tam |
tatra paśugaṇe pratisaṃskārye saṃskārāvṛtti: iti jāghanīsamuccayanyāyātpravṛtte: yākācit jāghanī upādeyā iti vikalpa: |
idaṃ ca dvādaśe 'dravyavikāraṃ tu pūrvavadartha- karma syāt...' (12|4|16|10) ityadhikaraṇe uktam |
'vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirva- pet putre jāte' iti |
tatra saṃdeha: kiṃ jātamātre, uta kṛte jātakarmaṇi iti |
kṛte hi jātakarmaṇi prāśanaṃ tasya vidhīyate |
yadi prāk jātakarmaṇa: iṣṭi: kriyate, prāśanakālo viprakṛṣyeta, tatrāsya śarīra- dhāraṇaṃ na syāt |
bhāṣyam-- atha yaduktaṃ saṃpāte nimitte hi naimi- ttikena bhavitavyamiti |
soma-- yadarthe putragatatvaṃ phalasyoktaṃ tannirūpaṇāt saṃgati: |
iyamiṣṭi: putrajananānantarameva kāryā, saptamyā jananasya nimittatvāgamane nimittāntaraṃ naimittikaścocitatvāt |
na cātra saptamyā jananottara- kālavidhiriti tantrasāroktaṃ yuktam, 'putre' iti sāmānyādhikaraṇyānupapatte: |
yadyapi putramātraṃ nimittaṃ syāt, tathāpi nimittāntaratvalābhena naimittikasya śaucakālatvenāpi anantarameva kāryam |
na ca snānapānābhāve putramaraṇena śepivirodhāpatti:, jātakarmārhabhūtatvaṃ dhṛtamaghuprāśanapūrvaka- vaiśvānarādikadakṣiṇānaprāśanasya uttarakālatve'pi rāgato
na ca jananā- nantarasya jātakarmaṇyapi āvaśyakatvāt vinigamanāviraha: |
iti prāpte, jātakarmaṇo nālchedapūrvabhāvavidhānāt acchinnatvasya prāśananiṣedhāt iṣṭerjananānantarameva karaṇe maraṇāpatte: śeṣivirodhāpattyā utkarṣa: |
na ca nimittaśrutyanurodhena smārtaniṣedhasya anāhitāgniparatvam, bhūtanimittasthale nimittasya naimittikene bhavitavyam |
jātānantaratā nimittamiti yo bravīti, tena sāmānyavacano viśeṣe lakṣaṇāyā sthāpita: |
tassāt daśā- hottarakālāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāmamāvāsyāyāṃ vā kartavyā |
naimittiko hi pāṭhakrama: itaraṃ pāṭhakramaṃ bādhitvā niviśate iti |
apivādapyeka- deśe syāt iti pakṣe hi vakṣyate |
bhā. 4|3|16|38-39. jāteṣṭi: 'vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet putre jāte' iti vihitā |
vi. 4|3|12, jāteṣṭiā: jātakarmottaraṃ kartavyā, na tu janmana: avyavahitottarakāle jātakarmaṇa: prāk |
4|3|19, jāteṣṭyāḥ phalaṃ putrasyaiva, na tu karturapi pituḥ|
'yasmin jāte nirvapati sa pūtaḥ' iti vākyāt|
bhāṣyam-- 'vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet putre jāte' iti śrūyate|
tatra 'yad aṣṭakapāle bhavati gāya- tryeṇaiva brahmavarcasena punāti' ityevamādayaḥ kapāla- vikalpāḥ śrūyante|
teṣu saṃdehaḥ kim aṣṭakapālayo guṇa- vicayaḥ, uta arthavādā iti|
katham? ye hi pūrvavanto viditaputramarthe abhi- vadanti, te avidhānārthāḥ|
tadetat asya vākyasya samāmnāye sāmarthyam, yat aviditapūrvakāmihānam|
pratyakṣa hi aṣṭānāṃ kapālānāṃ stutiḥ, parokṣā dvādaśānām|
vā-- guṇavidhitvameva vicāryate adhunā kevalaguṇavidhitvameva asti na vā iti vicāryate|
athavā aṣṭakapālatvasya vaiśvānarasāmānyādhikaraṇatvāt dvādaśa- kapālatvasya nāmadheyatvamāsādya guṇavidhiḥ|
tatrāpi nirākṛtya arthavādāt pūrvasiddhaiva upasaṃha- ripyate|

( bhāṣyakārāntarakṛta-akāramaśleṣarahitasūtra- vyākhyānatyāgena akāraśleṣeṇa bhāṣyakṛtaḥ [ śabarā- cāryasya ] vyākhyāne kāraṇaṃ vaktum upanyāsāpūrvakaṃ tat dūṣayati-) tatra pūrvavat vidhānena arthavattvam, apūrvāṇāṃ nāmadheyatvāvadhāraṇāt, 'yadutpattāvapūrvam' iti|
laukikārthāparijñānāt na guṇavidhitvam, evaṃ vaidikakarmā- midhāyitvaṃ sutarāṃ prasiddham, na tu nāmadheyatvamapi na syāt|
satyeva ca sarvatra laukike'rthe sambhavihārādibhiḥ nāmadheyatā uktā|
' yadi hi vaiśvānarayāge aṣṭakadādyaḥ kutaścit prāptā bhaveyuḥ, tataḥ saṃvāddvāreṇa nāmadheyatvam arthavādā vā syāt|
dvādaśatvena ca kapāleṣu paricchidyamāneṣu na aṣṭakādīnāṃ paricchedakatvam ityavidyamānatā|
yadyapi ca yathākathañcit astitvamabhyupagamyate, tathāpi etāvanamātraṃ bhavet 'aṣṭau bhavanti' iti, na tu 'yaṣṭakapālaḥ'|
( tatra ityanuvartamāne 'saṃskṛtaṃ bhakṣāḥ' [ pā0 4|2|16 saptamyantāt aṇ syāt saṃskṛte arthe, yat saṃskṛtaṃ bhakṣāḥ cet te syuḥ|

aṣṭasu kapāleṣu saṃskṛtaḥ aṣṭakapālaḥ puroḍāśaḥ] ityanena aṣṭasu kapāleṣu saṃskṛtam ityasminnarthe saṃkhyāpūraṇasya dviguṇena iṣṭā kapālaprātipadika vihitasya aṇūpratyayasya 'dvigorluga- napatye' [ pā0 4|1|88 dvigornimitte yastaddhitaḥ: ajādi- ranapatyarthaḥ, tasya luk syāt ] iti dviguparataddhita- luksamāreṇa lopāt aṣṭakapālaśabdasiddhiḥ|

( 'taddhitārthottarapadasamāhāre ca' iti taddhitārthe viṣayabhūte diksaṃkhyayoḥ: samānādhikara- ṇyasamāsapravṛtteḥ saṃskārakatvasya upādhitvavādāt dvādaśa- tvaparicchinnānāṃ saṃskārakāṇāṃ aṣṭatvena paricchettuma- śakyatvāt aṣṭakapālaśabdānupapattiḥ) tau ca ( taddhita- samāsau ) sati sāmarthye bhavataḥ|
sāpekṣatvāt dvādaśatvena aṣṭakapālasyaḥ, iti na dvādaśakapālaḥ aṣṭakapālaśabdāmidhānīyaṃ labhate|
tena svarūpasaṃkīrtanasya asattvāt prarocanam atharvada- taramāpadyeta|
yadyapi ca aṣṭakatvastutyā dvādaśatvaṃ stūyate, na tu aṣṭakapālasya dvādaśakapālasya stutiḥ, viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayoḥ atyantabhedāt|
apica asyaiva dvādaśalasya ātmīyā stutiḥ 'jagadyaivāsin' iti|
tasmāt dvādaśatvena saha vikalpamānāḥ guṇavidhaya evaite'pi|
sarve cedaṃ vaikalpikamanekasaṃkhyāviśiṣṭavaiśvānara- vidhānāt ekameva upattivākyam, iti na balābala viśeṣaḥ|
yat daśakapāle bhavati, virājaivāsmin annādyaṃ dadhāti|
yad dvādaśakapāle bhavati jagatyaivāsmin paśūn dadhāti|
yasmin jāte etāmiṣṭiṃ nirvapati, pūta eva sa tejasva- nnāda indriyāvī paśūmān bhavati' iti ekameva utpatti- vākyam) tasmāt 'sāmarthyam' iti ca pūrvaprakṛta- yogyāpekṣatvāt vaiśvadevaparvakāditeyaḥ|
tadīyaṃ hi sāmarthyam asmin samāmnāye'sti, na ca taduktaḥ parihāraḥ|
guṇasya tu vidhānārthaṃ tadguṇāḥ prayoge syuranarthakāḥ, nahi taṃ pratyarthavattā'sti|
guṇasya vidhānārthā ete santaḥ puroḍāśasya kapāleṣu saṃkhyāṃ vidadhuḥ|
dvādaśakapālatā hi yāgasya vākyena, aṣṭakapāladādyaḥ prakaraṇena|
apica aṣṭakatvādyaḥ puroḍāśaṃ ekavākyabhūtāḥ prakaraṇaṃ bādhitvā na yāgasya bhaviṣyanti|
vā-- 'prakṛtāprakṛte yāge tathā dravye'pi vā guṇaḥ|
dravyaṃ guṇavadevaṃ ca na kathañcid vidhīyate||
' prakṛte tāvat dvādaśatvārohaṇāt nāṣṭakavādayo vidhīyante, na ca dūrasthe tadupādānaśabdābhāvāt|
na ca karmāntaraṃ kevalatvādiguṇakaḥ sambhavati, dravyadevatāsaṃyogapratyakṣayāgā-
etena puroḍāśo saṃkhyāvidhiḥ nedhā'pi pratyuktaḥ ( prakṛtayāgasaṃbandhini, dūrasthayāgasaṃbandhini, apūrvayāga- saṃbandhini vā guṇavidhiḥ iti nedhā'pi pratyuktaḥ) |
tatra prakṛte yāge asaṃbandhamāha-) nahi dvādaśakapālapuroḍā- śāvacchedya yāgaḥ puroḍāśāntaraṃ gṛhṇāti|
( dūrasthe asaṃba- ndhamāha-) nāpi anūdite karmaṇi svaśabdena aprakṛte puroḍāśavidhānaṃ phalatsādhanāsaṃyandhaṃ kacidupayujyate|
ata eva viśvajidādivadapi nādyahāreṇa phalaṃ kalpyate|
vibhaktyantarayogitvāt na caitada ( ca śrute ) syādanarthakam ||
yadi hi anuṣaṅgavipariṇāmau antareṇa aṣṭakatvavidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt, tat kiṃ vā na kriyata, tat stutyarthatvena upapannatvarāt nārthakam|
( nedhā'pi puroḍāśavidhānaṃ na saṃbhavatītyupasaṃharati-) tasmāt na puroḍāśavidhānam|
na ca dvādaśakapāle aṣṭakapāladayaḥ puroḍāśāḥ svātmabhirvibhaktā vidyante, aṣṭakadimātra- viśeṣadarśanāt|
te ca aṣṭakatvādayaḥ na yāge, nāpi puroḍāśe vidhīyante ityuktam|
na ca aṣṭakavādīnāṃ dvādaśakapālena ekavākyatayā tava ( na ca ityādibhiruktaḥ ) upapadyate, nānāvidheya- ( nānāvidha- ) prayojanavaśeṇa arthakalā- bhāvāt|
na ca nānāvidhānāṃ vibhajyamānānāṃ sākā- ṅkṣatvaṃ vidyate|
yadi ca ekaṃ vākyaṃ bhavet, tataḥ sarva- viśiṣṭaikabhāvanāvidhānāt na vikalpaḥ syāt|
aṣṭakavā- dīnāṃ ca guṇatvāt na pratyekaṃ vākyaparisamāptyā pṛthagnu- ṣṭhānopapattiḥ|
na ca saṃkhyānāṃ sambhavati, saṃkhyā- ntaropajananena sarvābhāvaprasaṅgāt|
tena etai- rbhinnervākyai: svatantrā vidhīyante ityavadayaṃ bhavatā abhyu- pagantavyam |
tataśca dvādaśalam utpattivākyasiddham, itarāṇi tu vākyāntare: prakaraṇapakṣai: durbalāni santi na saṃbadhyante |
evaṃ tāvat vaiśvānarayāgo balavattaraguṇāvarodhāt na aṣṭatvādin prati icchati |
) te'pi puroḍāśena ekavākyabhūtatvāt naiva vaiśvānarayāgasya prāpnuvanti |
tathā ca aṣṭadaśa: kevalapuroḍāśasaṃbandhe prayoge syu- ranarthakā: |
(evaṃ bhāṣya-vyākhyānena sūtraṃ vyākhyāya svamanyathā nyāyacche-) ayathā kathamatadguṇā: , ityata āha- (sūtram) nahi taṃ yāgam anyāvagrahaṃ prati arthavattā asti iti |
bhāṣyam-- yadā tu aṣṭakapālādiprottenārthaṃ ana- rthikā ityavagatam, tadā lakṣaṇyā dvādaśakapālasya stuti: vaiśvānarayāgaprocanārthā bhaviṣyati |
santi hi dvādaśa- saṃkhyāyāmaṣṭatvādya: saṃkhyāviśeṣā avibhaktā: |
ato dvādaśakapālasya stutyarthena avayavastṛtirupapadyate yathā 'śobhanamasya cakrasya nimittambhāram' 'śobhanamasyā: senāyā: hastyaśvarathapādātam' iti |
bhāṣyam-- iti cet bhavān paśyati arthavādā iti, kāraṇamaṣṭatvādināṃ brahmavarcasādi kasmānna bhavati ? brahmavarcasa- kāmasya aṣṭakapāla: |
kimevaṃ bhaviṣyati ? puroḍāśasya guṇavidhāne'pi ānarthakyaṃ na bhaviṣyati |
na ca lakṣaṇyā dvādaśakapālasya stuti: kalpitā bhaviṣyati |
cet' iti padadvayaṃ bhāṣyakāreṇa apaṭhitamapi dṛṣṭyantare dṛṣṭatvāt vārtikakṛtā paṭhitam |
' (yadyapi atra uttaravākye nañ kāpi na paṭhyate tathāpi arthānusārāt 'iti cejjāvibhāgāt' iti nañghaṭitaṃ sūtraṃ paṭhituṃ yuktam |

' (yadyapi ānandabhamīye etasya ślokasya pūrvādhaṃ tacchedhasūtravivaraṇavena, uttarārdhaṃ ca avibhāgasūtra- vivaraṇārambhakatvena mudritam, tathāpi vārtikamate ekasūtre sati prakṛtaśloko'pi avibhagnatvenaiva svīkartavya: |
(sautram avibhāgapadaṃ sāmīpyārthakatvena vyācaṣṭe-- ) tasāmīpyācca śaknuvanti aṣṭādaśandā: tadekadeśatvamiti kalpyam |
tena etaduktaṃ bhavati 'īdṛśo'yaṃ dvādaśakapālo mahābhāga: , yasmin kriyamāṇe aṣṭakapālā- dayo'pi saṃbhāvitā bhavanti |
te ca aṣṭatvādyo brahmavarca- sādi siddhipraśastā: , tasmāt praśastoḍayam' iti |
yattu asyaiva dvādaśatvasya anyā stutiriti, naiṣa doṣa: |
jāteṣṭinyāya: 1764 jātaputra: kālaṃ jātaputra: kṛṣṇakeśo 1765 jātyādhikaraṇaṃ
sūtrārthastu- pūrvavantaḥ pūrvaprāptimanataḥ: vaiśva- devādi śabdā: khalu guṇavidhānāthā: na bhavanti, asmiṃstu aṣṭakapāladisāmānyāye tatsāmarthya syāt iti |
śrutamaṣṭakapālādi tad guṇe nāma vā stuti: ||
dravya dravyāntare no ced guṇasārthaṃ phale tvasau ||

' 12. bhāṭṭa— 'vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet putre jāte' ityanena yāgaṃ vidhāya 'yaddvādaśakapāle bhavati, gāyatrivyenaṃ brahmavarcasena punāti' ityādinā aṣṭakapāla- navakapāladaśakapālādakapāladaśakapālān anuya 'yasmin jāte etāmiṣṭiṃ nirvapati, pūta eva tejasva- nnāda indriyāvī paśumān bhavati' iti śrutam |
tatra dvādaśatve aṣṭatvādai: prāptatvāt aṣṭakapālasya: vaiśvā- narayāgānāmadheyam ityeka: pakṣa: |
svarūpeṇa prāptāpi paricchedakatvena prāptabhāvāt guṇavidhaya: eva ete |
upakramopa- saṃhāraikyena caikavākyatvapratīte:, na dvādaśapālasyotpatti- śiṣṭatā |
vaiśvānara- vākye tapadamanuvāda eva iti dvitīya: pakṣa: |
brahma- varcasādi rūpaphaloddeśena prakṛtayāgāśritā guṇā eva aṣṭā- kapālādayo vidhīyante iti tṛtīya: |
siddhānte tu saṃbhavatyekavākyatve tadbhedastva anyāyyatvāt prakṛtayāgasyai- veyaṃ sarvā śruti: |
yadddvādaśakapālahavi: aṣṭā- kapālādapi ekaikaphalasādhanam, tatra sarvāvayavopeta- dvādaśakapālasya sarvaphalaprayojakatve ka: saṃdeha iti yāga- śruti: |
aṣṭakapālapadam āgneyākapāle śaktaṃ gauṇyā vṛttyā aṣṭatvāvaśyakapālasyaivāsāhacaryena dvādaśakapāla- vayave gauṇam |
tena ca avayavadvārā avayavī dvādaśa- kapālo lakṣyate |
idaṃ cādhikaraṇam audumbarādhikaraṇanyāyena punaruktamapi śiṣya- śikṣā'rthaṃyuktamiti dhyeyam |
' 12. āhārādyāvaśyakakāryānurodhena sātatyabhāvāvaśya- bhāvāvena jāteṣṭinyāyena prākaraṇikakālopasaṃgrahasyāpi siddhānte iva upapatte: 'māsamagnihotraṃ juhoti' ityatra |

kī. 2|3|11|24 pṛ. 76, dākṣāyaṇayajñe nimitta- śrutyā sātatyanuṣṭhāne pradhakte āhāravihārādivaśena tad- bādhāt jāteṣṭimāsāgnihotrayajñena paurṇamāsyānugrahe'pi sātatyasya atyantatvādāyogyatā puna: punaranupapatti: |

2|3|14 pṛ. 41, 'māsamagnihotraṃ juhoti' ityatra atyantasaṃyogādicidīyāntamāsapadopadiṣṭasātātyurodhena ātideśikakālatvādāt sarvadaiva kartavyatvāpattiriti na vācyam, āhāravihārādyāvaśyakakāryānurodhena sātatya- bhāvāvaśyabhāve jāteṣṭinyāyena ātideśikakālānurodhe- nāpi tatsaṃpādanasya saṃkarṣe vakṣyamāṇatvāt |
2|3|16 pṛ. 205. jātakarmaṇi tātkālikī śuddhi: śāstreṇa darśitā bālakavipattiparihārāya |
vi. 4|3|19, jātakarmo- nantaraṃ stanaprāśanaṃ vihitam, taduttaraṃ jāteṣṭi: kartavyā |
jātaputra: kālaṃ na yauva ca nimitte putrajanmani upasaṃhṛtya daśarātrasya parastāt amāvāsyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vā jāteṣṭiṃ kurvan nātipatati adhikāram |
su. pṛ. 344. jāti: api brāhmaṇatvādi: saptamamanupādeyam |
'āgneyo vai brāhmaṇa: ' 'agnirvai brāhmaṇa: ' 'aindro rājanya: ' 'vaidyo vaiśvadeva: ' iti śrūyate |
guṇaśca jāti: prajāpatermūlāt janma, indrarājanyayośca bāhubhyāṃ janma, viśeṣaṃ devānāṃ vaiśyasya ūrūbhyāṃ janma iti |
ke. jāti: eva mīmāṃsakānāṃ ākṛti: padārtha: |
tena mukhatvena guṇena 'agnirvai brāhmaṇa: ' 'āgneyo brāhmaṇa: ' ityādi: prayoga: |
vi. 1|4|14. jātatvāt: gotvādi: 'piṇḍeṣveva piṇḍeṣu gotvādi- tirnimittaṃ pratīyate |
maṇi. pṛ. 22. jāti: na saṃskāryā amṛtatvāt |
su. pṛ. 1326. sarvagatā na vā iti vicāra: 'ākṛtivāda: ' iti cindau śāstradīpikā- praṣṭake draṣṭavya: |
su. pṛ. 914, jāti: api jātyā- śrayatvaṃ saṃbhavati, ni:sāmānyāni sāmānyādīni iti vaiśeṣikaparibhāṣāyā: pratītivirodhena ayuktātvāt |
pṛ. 351, jāte: siddhatvena, kāmyatayā adhikāri- viśeṣaṇatvāyoga: |
jātistu takṣaṇādiktriyāmi- vyañjyā jātitastasyagoviśeṣavādirūpaphalavyañjyā vā iti taduttarameva śabdaprayoga: |
bhāṭṭa. 7|3|9. jātau eva śakti:, vyaktilambhastu ākṣepāt iti vivecanam 'prāti- padikāthai: ' iti vindau draṣṭavyam |
ka cittasya viśeṣeṇa ka citta sāmā- nyato''bhidhā ||
' sarvajātiṣu tāvat khavyaktimātrā- nucāriṇa: śuklakṛṣṇaraktatvādayo vilakṣaṇā: pratyakṣamupa- labhyante |
tatra kacit sato viśeṣasya vācaka: śabdo nāstīti pramāṇāntaragamyaviśeṣaṇamaṅgīkṛtya sāmānya- māneṇābhidheyatvam |
tathā kacidapabhraṃśena kaścidviśeṣa: pratideśamamidhīyate yathā rauhiṇakā gauriti, na kadā- citśādāyāṃ śāṭayāṃ vā raktaguṇāyām evamabhidhānaṃ bhavati |
tasmādātmāntarāpyena śoṇalakarṇatvagauratvādīni akṣamaṇupyādisaṃcanini abhidhīyamānāni teṣvapi pratyaya- mādadhati |
'āgneyo vai brāhmaṇa: ' ityādaya: arthavādā:, na guṇavidhaya: ||
bhāṣyam- 'āgneyo vai brāhmaṇa: ' 'aindro rājanya: ' 'vaidyo vaiśvadeva: ' ityevamādaya: śrūyante |
tatra kiṃ guṇavidhaya:, arthavādā iti saṃdeha: |
evamapūrvamarthe vidhāsyanti, itarathā arthavādā: santo''narthakā: syu: |
kimekajātīyakatvam ? 'prajāpatirakāmayata prajā: sṛjeyamiti, sa mukhatastrivṛttaminirmita, tamamirdevatā''- nasṛjyata, gāyatrī chanda:, rathaṃtaraṃ sāma, brāhmaṇo manu- ṣyāṇām |
paśūnām, tamātte mukhyā:, mukhato hyasṛ- jyanta |
uraso bāhubhyāṃ pañcadaśaṃ nirmitam, tamindro devatā''nasṛjyata, triṣṭup chanda:, bṛhat sāma, rājanyo
manuṣyāṇām, aviḥ paśūnām, tasmātte vīryavantaḥ, vīryāddhi asūyanta |

ūrumyāṃ madhyataḥ śatadadhaṃ niramīyata, taṃ viśve devā devatā asṛjanta, jagatī chandaḥ, vairūpaṃ sāma, vaiśyo manuṣyāṇām, gāvaḥ paśūnām' evamukte sati ekasmin evaṃjātīyake vijñāte anyo'pi tajjātīyako hṛdayamāgacchati |
tatra āgneyādiśabdānāṃ brāhmaṇādiṣu mukhyatvameva, yenakenacitsambandhena taddhitotpādāt |
nahi yadeva tyajyate tattvaiva kevalaṃ devatāsambandhaḥ, tyakturapi tenaiva sambandhena seva devatā bhavati |
yathā ca vakṣyati 'bhavati puruṣasyāpi yachuḥ sā devatā' (bhā. 5|4|6|19) iti |
ato yatra agnirvai brāhmaṇa ityādiprayogāḥ tadudā- hartavyam |
agnirhi pratīyato mukhaprabhavatvātsāmānyena brāhmaṇā- dīn upasthāpayati |
yadyapi ca tathā vastu nāsti, tathāpi arthavādā- ntare tathoktvāt iha tacchandanimittatā pratipadyate |
śā-- 'agnirvai brāhmaṇaḥ' ityādiṣvapi pūrvavat nāmadheyaṃ guṇaviśiṣṭaṃ ca udbhāvya arthavādatvaṃ sādha- nīyam |
na ca prapa- ñcasya anāditvena sṛṣṭyādyabhāvāt ayamartho na siddha iti vācyam |
anenaivābhiprāyeṇa tadartha- sadbhāve nātyantaṃ yatnaḥ kartavyaḥ |
dvāraṃ tu mukhyatvamātreṇa saṃstave' brāhmaṇasya saṃstave |
14. bhāṭṭa-- 'agnirvai brāhmaṇaḥ' ityatra pūrvadeva agni- śabdo brāhmaṇe gauṇaḥ dvayorapi agnibrāhmaṇayorekabrahmamūla- prabhavatvāt |
tatra sukhajātatvaguṇayogāt gauṇyā vṛttyā brāhmaṇe agniśabda ityarthavattvāt |
ku. 1|2|1|18 pṛ. 31. jātyantareṣu bhedaḥ syāt, pakvivaiṣamyāt |
jātyantareṣu bhinnajātīyeṣu paśuṣu yathā aikāda- śineṣu kumbhīśūlapaśupaṇīnāṃ medaḥ syāt |
avimāṃśāni alpena kālena pacyante, ajamāṃsāni tu tato vilambena |
sautrāmaṇyāṃ go'jāviṣu paśu śūlānāṃ vṛddheḥ ādhikyasya darśanāt 'śūleṣva māsarena cāvayavamapyamyanti' iti bahuvacanāt |
su. pṛ. 1421. jātyāvabhāsīni tāvat (jātināmaguṇakriyā- dravyāṇi) etāni jñānāni utpadyante |
na ca avidya- mānameva ākāraṃ jñānamavagamayati |
tatra vidyamānatā kadācit bahirartharūpa- tayā, kadācit jñānakāratayā |
tatra yadā vijñānaṃ pratyakṣaṃ na bhavati iti sthitam, tadā pariśeṣyāt arthakāratva avaśiṣyate |
tathā ca vidyamānārthakāragrahaṇāt na kalpanāparūpā (iti nirālambanatvadanam) |
su. pṛ. 731. jātiguṇakriyādravyeṣu na sādhāraṇākārā- vamarśo'sti |
ṛju. pṛ. 120. jātigrahaṇe vṛtkṣatvādijātigrahaṇe āloka- indriya-anekapiṇḍānusmṛti-śabdasmaraṇa-vyakti-mahattva -saṃnikarṣa-ākāraviśeṣādayaḥ kāraṇam |
tatra 'pauṇḍarīkāṇi barhīṣi barhiḥ paridhatta vediṃ jāni mā haṃsīrupayā śyānā |
dabhaiḥ stṛṇīta haritaiḥ suvarṇairnikkā ime yajamānasya śrabhe' |
tatra damaiḥ iti jāti- śabdaḥ, haritaiḥ iti naimittiko guṇaśabdaḥ |
imī nohi- tabhyo, uhitavyeti vicāre siddhāntamāha |
jāti- naimittikaṃ jātiśca naimittikaṃ tayoḥ samāhāradvaṃde jātinaimittikaṃ idaṃ śabdadvayaṃ yathāsthānam uhitavyam |
jātiśabdaṃ sta raṇe, naimittikaṃ sta raṇasādhane dravye |

ke. jātinimittakaṃ yathādhikaraṇam ityadhikaraṇe 'maudraṃ caruṃ nirvapecchriye śrīkāmaḥ' iti karmaṇi 'pauṇḍarī- kāṇi barhīṣi bhavanti' iti vihiteṣu puṇḍarīkeṣu prākṛte hārityaguṇaprakāśyake 'dabhaiḥ stṛṇīta haritaiḥ suparṇaiḥ' iti mantre atidiṣṭe haritapadasthāne raktapadamuhitavyam ityuktam |
bāla. pṛ. 64. jātinyāyena agnihomaśabdaḥ saṃlāghavato'pi vyutpattinyāyena jyotiṣṭomeva pracuraprayogatvādidha pārtha- śabda ivā'rjunem |
bhāṭṭa. 1|3|10. jātivyaktyoḥ medābhedavicāraḥ 'ākṛtivādaḥ' iti vindī śāstrīdīpikāpaṭṭake dravyaḥ |

ke. nanu prabhātadaśāśrayoriva jīvabrahmaṇorjātiyoga- mātreṇa gajāśvagavādivat jātivyaktyanyāyena śruti- smṛtiyuktanubhavavyavahāratvāt deśakālabhedābhedaḥ siddhaḥ iti yaduktaṃ tadasaṃsagatam, tatsaṃsādaśāviṣayatvāt |
śrīkara. 1|2|24 brasū. agnihomaśabdasya jātiśaktyanyāyena saṃkhyāvācaka- syāpi vyaktinyāyena svasaṃbandhirūpatvāt jyoti- ṣṭomaparatvam |
kau. 2|3|102 pṛ. 68. jātisaṅkhyāṇāṃ vyaktilakṣaṇārthatvaṃ vyaktyapekṣayā jāteḥ sādhanatvā- yogāt |
tathā ca ajñātāvāpi jātivyavahāro bahulamupalabhyate keṣāṃ ciditi |
tathāhi, na paramāṇuṣu caturvidhe ṣaṣṭhipāvapyate'sañjāvayīyeṣu jātirāśritā abhi- matā, anuvvṛttākārapratyayayogyāt |
minneṣu yadaminnā jātirūpeyate tatra anuvṛttākārabhāvāsinī matirāvarbhavati |
yā'pi caivaṃ paramāṇupratīti matiḥ, sā'pi parimāṇalakṣaṇaguṇa- kāraṇikā mīmāṃsakairpi saṃgīyate |
na ca sthūleṣu dravyeṣu jātiḥ samaveyāt ? teṣāmeva durūpagamatvāt |
na caiva ekaikadravyavyatiriktam sa hi naikaikadravyasamavetaḥ |
anenaiva mārgeṇa tryaṇu- kasya tribhirdvyaṇukairārambhaṇīyasya mahimaguṇaśālinaḥ saṃbhavo nirastaḥ |
apica avayavinaḥ kimavayaveṣu pratyekaṃ kātsnyena śrutisambandhena veti cintanīyam |
na tāvat kātsnyena vṛtcipalabhyamahe, ekaikavayavagatasya tasya apratipatteḥ |
ekaikavayavagate ca kampe rāge vā sakalāvayavinaḥ kamparāgapratītiprasaṅgāt |
tathā avayavāntare ca kampa- rāgavirahe kamparāgavirahasamāsaktiḥ |
avayavī ca kampeta na kampeta, rajyeta na rajyeta ceti viṣamā daśāviśeṣāt |
nudyāt, ekātirikānekābhāve'pi eka eva sadvitīyaḥ āśrayaḥ saṃyogasyeti na doṣaḥ |
nanu dravye eva tayo- tpanne saṃyogavikalpamāvirbhavati, na tu tadatirekī saṃyogo nāma kaścida guṇaviśeṣaḥ |
tanna, pratyabhijñāyate hi dravye anuṣṭupte, kādācitkī ca tayorapareyaṃ daśā dṛśyate, iti bhavatyeva medasiddhiḥ |
ataḥ saṃyogalakṣaṇasādhāraṇaguṇāsamavāyi- kāraṇopagṛhītā avayava eva samavāyikāraṇamavayavina upa- padyante |
yasyāvayavino vṛttikalpe doṣa uktaḥ, so'- pyavayavinaḥ pratīyo kṣitāyāmanupapannaḥ |
vyāptaka evā- vayaveṣu avayavī, naikama jātitvat parisamāptaḥ |

avayavā- ntarepi ca vinā sa tasya ko'pi mahimā, ya eka eva anekāvayavānusyūta iti kiṃ na kalpyate, yadyapi cāvaya- vina ekaikana avṛttiḥ, tathāpi nāṣṭitadoṣaḥ, saṃyoga- sacivā evāvayavā janakāṇava āśrayabhūtā yataḥ, janaka- tathaiva āśrayatvāt |
ata eva saṃyogaḥ sadvitīya āśraya iti na doṣaḥ, na ca sakalāvayavo- palambhāpekṣā tadupalandhvaḥ avayavinaḥ; tebhyo bhinnatvāt |
naicaitāvatā ekāvayavagrahaṇamātre'pi grahaṇaparyantayogo yuktaḥ ? kāryānuguṇatvāt kāraṇakalpanāyāḥ, kāryasiddhayartha hi kāraṇaṃ parikalpyate, na kāryavināśāya |
tena yāvatāma- vayavānāṃ grahaṇe tadupalambhaḥ tāvatāmevāvayavamaḥ tadavagama- ninyadhanamiti darśanabalenābhyupeyate |
pratyekaṃ tu teṣāṃ śakyate eva akhopalambho'pi vaktum, avayavāntarayoginaḥ ava- yavino'pi parigrahe |
itarāvayavavyatirekābhyāṃ hi vastva- ntaratvamavasīyate, avagamyamāno'pi cāvayavī vilakṣaṇo buddhigocaratāmācaratyeva |
avayavī hi svakīyān eko hṛdayamāgacchati, avayavāstu kṣodīyāṃso bhūyāṃsaśca |
sa cāyamavayavī mahattvadrūpavattvācca cākṣuṣaḥ : sparśino vā, pārthivo vā abhbhasīyo vā taijaso vā |
vāyavīyastu maha- tvāt sparśavattvācca sparśena eva |
hyaṇukastu cātubhauti- ko'pi ahattvātpratyakṣa eva ca |
gaganādīnāṃ tu mahatāmapi rūpasparśāvidhuratayā na pratyakṣa- gocaratetyalamativistareṇa |

nanu sakalāvayavasamāśritatvāt avayavinaḥ tirohitairavayavaiḥ saha indriyāsannikarṣe kathama- vayavinā samāgamaḥ ? na cāsaṃgatameva bahirindriyam ava- bodhakamiti pratiṣṭhā yujyate, avayavānāpi asannikṛṣṭe- ndriyadravyatvāpatteriti |
uktottarametat, bhinnatvāva- yavinaḥ avayavāntarasaṃyoge'pi saṃyogayuddheḥ paṭādīrupapanna evendriyasannikarṣo'vayavinaḥ |
tadanayā diśā tāvadupa- pannam āśrayadravyam ākṛteḥ pṛthulam |
nanūkaṃ rūpā- diyatireki dravyaṃ nopalabhyate iti, kimidaṃ paśyatohara- lam, pratīyate hi mahānavayavī rūpādiṣyatirekī |
ata eva japākusumasaṃnidhānātmibhūta rūpamapi sphaṭikadravyaṃ pratyabhijñāyate |
apica darśanasparśābhyāmekārthagrahaṇāt rūpasparśāvyatireki dravyaṃ sphuṭatarapratītaṃ nāpahotumucitam |
vanādiṣu bādhakapratyaya- balena kalpaneyaṃ prasarati dūratayā antarālagrahaṇinyathano- 'yam abhedagrahaṇavyavahāraḥ pravartate iti |
sarpiṣaḥ ; yastu nipuṇadarśī sūkṣmamapi rūpamīkṣituṃ kṣamaḥ; |
nanvevaṃ bahu avadhītam, kinibandhano hi tadānīmāhavanī- |
yādisadhyādhakarmeṣu keṣāṃ cit adhikāro nānyeṣām, kini- |
ke punaste saṃtativiśeṣāḥ ? na te parigaṇayya nirdeṣṭuṃ |
śakyante, kintu lokata eva prasiddhāḥ pratyeyantvāḥ |
⚑ jijñāsāpadaṃ vicāraṃ na lakṣayati, kintu dharmasaṃdehā ityeva |
ayam 'vidū- rāt vyaḥ' 4|3|80 iti sūtramahābhāṣye vyavahṛtaḥ |
nadyasau maṇirvindūrāt prabhavati, kiṃ tārha ? bālavāyākhyarūpata- viśeṣān prabhavati |
evaṃ tarhi 'bālavāyo vidūraṃ ca prakṛtyantarameva vā |
yathā vaṇijo vārāṇasīṃ jitvarīnupācaranti, evaṃ vaiyākaraṇā bālavāyaṃ vidūra ityupācaranti ityuktam |
sarvakhāre kratau prāyaṇīyā''dau yajamāne jīvati sūkta- vāke āyurāśiṣaḥ 'āyurāśāste' iti āyuṣaḥ kāma- nāyāḥ avacanaṃ vacanaṃ na kartavyam, tatra paṭhanīyam |
sarvakhāre tu yajamāno maraṇakāmaḥ na āyuṣkāmaḥ |
sarvakhāre prāyaṇīyā''dau yajamāne jīvati sūkta- vāke 'āyurāśāste' iti āyuṣaḥ āśiṣaḥ vacanaṃ kartavyam |
ārambhe pratyudyamāne yajamānasya diśi gataḥ prārthitavyatā bhavati |
asmāt yathoktāt prāk tu āyu- rāśīḥ bhāginī yuktaiva 'ārbhakālaṃ yāvat jīnyāsam' iti |
bhāgaḥ avasaraḥ asti asyā iti bhāginī |
tasmāt sarvakhāre prāyaṇīyā''dau sūktavāke āyurāśī- rvaktavyā iti siddhāntaḥ |

asthisthe kṛtvācintyoktena 'īhāyāśrābhāvāt sūktavākavat' (10|2|153) iti nyāyena sarvakhāre'pi sarveṣā- meva sūktavākaphalānām kāmyamānatvena avacane prāpte, 'jīvasyavacanam' ityatra āyurmantre arthavādokteḥ itarasūktavākaphalasya kāmyamānasyaiva phalatvamidamiti gamyate |
kaṇikā. pṛ. 364. # jīvanaṃ nimittam aśoṣibhūtaṃ darśādikaṃ svārthe na prayujyate, kintu pādhaśyarūpayodhye prayujyate |
bāla. pṛ. 107. # jīvane sati bhojanavat nityakarma avaśya- manuṣṭheyam |
vi. 6|3|2. ⚑ jīdhito'pi (jīvannapi) na jīvet sa, yadi lokena dūṣyate iti nyāyaḥ |
sāhastrī. 902. ⚑ juṣāṇo agma ājyasya vetu ' 'juṣāṇaḥ soma ājyasya haviṣo vetu' iti ājyabhāgāyādyamantrau |
sā prakṛtau niviśate, vikṛtau tu codakāt |
3|6|1, juhūḥ 'yasya parṇamayī juhūrbhavati na sa pāpaṃ ślokaṃ śṛṇoti' parṇamayītvaṃ ṛtvartham, kratusaṃbandha vākyena, phalaśravaṇaṃ cārthavādaḥ |
juhvamabhimukhayati 'yunajima vācaṃ saha divā sūryeṇa' iti (mantreṇa) |
(haṃsasya mukhamiva mukhaṃ yasyāḥ sā haṃsamukhī, tasyā bhāvo haṃsamukhatvam |
svagadeśe bilaṃ yasyāḥ sā tvagilā apūrvīyatvāt śāstrīyaḥ |
atra apūrvīyatvaṃ kratuviśeṣāntareṇa nāsti, ataḥ pūrṇaḥ praviṣṭaḥ |
vi. 3|6|5. juhvāḥ dravyadānasya agnisaṃghnāpādanādatrā pradhānasādhanatvāt agnyapekṣayā pradhānavipakarṣaḥ ! su. pṛ. 626. juhvā- mājyaṃ caturvāraṃ ājyamagrahāt |
mantraśca 'śukraṃ tvā śukrāṃ dhāmnedhāmne devebhyo yajuṣeyajuṣe gṛhṇāmi ityādiḥ |

satre juhādīnāṃ yajñāpātrāṇāmaprayuktatvāt 'svaire pātraiḥ prayogaḥ kartavyaḥ' iti prayuktatvasya abhāvāt tathā vidherabhāvāt kaiḥ pātraiḥ prayogaḥ kartavyaḥ iti saṃdehe sati yajamāno yathākāmī pratīyeta |
svasya anyasya vā pātraiḥ prayogaḥ syāt |
yathākāmī (icchā) pratīyeta iti pāṭhastu sūtrānusārito gamyate |
yathākāmī bhavet iti tu bhāṣye paṭhitam |
pūrvapakṣaṃ sūtreṇa prāptam apivā itiśabdena viparyastaṃ siddhāntamāha |
sādhāraṇāni 'satsadṛśānāmeva yajamānānāṃ sādhāraṇāni navīnānyeva anyāni pātrāṇi kurvīran satriṇaḥ |
anyatamasya pātrāṇāṃ grahaṇe tu vipratiṣedhaḥ syāt |
yasya pātrāṇi gṛhītāni syuḥ, tasya satramadhye daivānmaraṇe tena saha tāni pātrāṇi daheran |
pātrāṇāmadāhe tu mṛtasya dāho viguṇaḥ syāt iti vipratiṣedhaḥ |
na ca jīvataḥ anyasya pātraiḥ kratunivṛttirastu iti vācyam |
tassāt vipratiṣedhāt śāstrakṛtatvāt sādhāraṇāni pātrāṇi svatantrāṇi kartavyāni |
madhi. pṛ. 102. ⚑ juhoteḥ akarmakatvāt saktūnāṃ dvitīyā karaṇatva- lakṣaṇā ityuktaṃ tantraratne tantrasāranyāyasubodha |

tatra, 'juhotutaḥ paryāvartate' ityādī karmaṇi niṣṭhādarśanena juhoterakarmakatvātsiddheḥ, hoḥ karmaṇi tṛtīyā cakārāt dvitīyā ca syāt ityekena 'tṛtīyā ca hośchandasi' (pā0 2|3|13 juhoteḥ karmaṇi tṛtīyā syāt dvitīyā ca) iti sūtrakāravyavahāreṇa sakarmakatvāt |
su. pṛ. 1527. ⚑ juhoticodanānāmeva darvihoma iti nāmadheyam, homaśabdasya tatra mukhyatvāt, na yajaticodanānām |
darvihomaśabdaḥ svātānāṃ śrautānāṃ ca karmaṇāmami- dhānamityavagatam |
atha kiṃ yajaticodanānāṃ juhoti- codanānāṃ ceti sarveṣāṃ nāmadheyam, kiṃvā juhoticodanā- nāmeveti vicāre siddhāntī āha |
ke. ⚑ juhoticoditānāṃ sarveṣāṃ darvihomākhyatvasya apūrvatvasya ca vakṣyamāṇatvāt |
su. pṛ. 816. ⚑ jṛmbhā jṛmbhikā nāma mukhyadānaphalako nidrā'''sallādhikāraprayukto vāyuvikārabhedaḥ |
paśupuroḍāśe prayājādikaṃ paśvayājāde: prasaṅgāt siddham iti pṛthak na kartavyam, parantu ājyabhāgau paśupuroḍāśe kartavyau iti jaiminerācāryasya matam |
yasya padārthasya svīyasya tantrasya kārye parasya tantram āpadyate, tasya prāpte: paratantrāpatte: svasya svīyasya tantrasya pratiṣedha: syāt yathā pauroḍāśi- kānāṃ pāśukam |
yasya tu na kiñcit parakīya kāryamāpadyate tatra pratiṣedho na yukta: yathā ājyabhāgayo: |
na ca paśau ājyabhāgau vidhyete iti pāśukena tantreṇa siddhi: |
tata: paśupuroḍāśe ājyabhāgau kartavyau iti siddhānta: |
ke. jaimine: paratantrāpatte: svatantrapratiṣedha: syāt (121|2|7) ityādhikaraṇe prayogavacanaśrodakā- pekṣayā durbala: iti vakṣyate |
( 'athāto dharmajijñāsā' ityārabhya 'vidyate vāḍyakālatvād yathā yājyādyairviproṣo yathā yājyāsaṃpreṣa:' ityantai: sūtrai: ) |
jaiminiproktaṃ sūtrajātam (dvādaśādhyāyātmakaṃ) 'codanālakṣaṇo'rtho dharma:' ityārabhya 'anvāhāryaṃ ca darśanāt' ityetadantam |
jaiminīyā: mahāpralayaṃ na svīkurvanti, avāntara- pralayaṃ tu svīkurvanti |
ke. jopaṇaṃ prītipūrvakaṃ yūpīyavṛkṣasya lakṣaṇalakṣitatayā sevyatvaniścaya: |
jaughamārjyaṃ prayājārtham, aupabhṛtaṃ tu prayājānu- yājobhayārtham |
bṛhatī. pṛ. 66. jñātasyaiva māvasya parokṣārtha- jñāpakatvam |
jñāte ca vācanaṃ, nahyavidvān vihito'sti (3|8|8|18) iti nyāya: |
yajamāne kasminamantrayukte satyeva 'klṛptī- ryajamānaṃ vācayati' iti vācanaṃ vihitam |
hi yasmāt avidvān vaidike karmaṇi na vihita: |
ke. ) jñāte - iti nyāyena aviduṣo yājamānavat āśvinye'pi anadhi- kārāt |
vājapeye 'klṛptīryajamānaṃ vācayati', 'ujjītī- ryajamānaṃ vācayati' iti ca śrutam |
'āyuṣyena kalpatām, prāṇe yajñena kalpatām' ityādayo mantrā: klṛptayo nāma |
tatra vāca- yati ityuktvā anadhītasvādhyāyayo yājyādhuṇā karmakāle vācanīya: iti gamyate iti utsṛṣṭe pūrvapakṣe prāpte siddhāntyati |
'pitā gāva: suktā brāhmaṇā:', 'pītapratibaddha- vastām' ityādivat matvarthina acapratyayena prayoga: |
jñāte ca jñāte eva yajamāne sati vācanaṃ mantrāṇāṃ karta- vyam |
yajamānena jñāte eva mantrajāte satyapi vācanaṃ kartavyam |
vācanaṃ ca khaṇḍaśo vā samarpaṇam, 'brūhi' iti abhidhānaṃ veti yatheṣṭam |
atha kasmāt jñāte eva vācanam ? hi yasmāt avidvān anadhītasvādhyāya: karmasu na vihito'sti na adhikṛto bhavati iti |
tasmāt adhīto'pi san adṛṣṭāya vācayitavya iti siddhānta: |
jñātatā ca mānasa- jñānajanyo jñeyaniṣṭha: atiśayaviśeṣa: |
maṇi. pṛ. 16. jñātu: jñānajanyaprākaṭyaphalavattayā jñānakarmatve nāśakabhāva: iti jīṇī: |
dvividhā hi nivṛtti: virodhinā, sāmagrīnivṛtyā ca |
yathā vātena dīpanāśa:; yathā vā tailavalyādināśo dīpanivṛtti: |
su. pṛ. 660. jñānaṃ na pratyakṣam, kintu viṣayajñātatayā anumeyam |
ke. jñānaṃ sarve mithyāviṣayakameveti na kācit pramā iti nirālambanvādinaṃ mataṃ tattvaṇḍanaṃ ca 'nirālambana- vādina:' iti vindī draṣṭavyam |
maṇi. pṛ. 23-24. 'jñānaṃ hi puruṣādhāraṃ tadvedānna virudhyate |
ratnākara:- sāpekṣaṃ jñātatātvam, tadekasyāpi bhinnapuruṣāpekṣayā jñātatvamajñātatvaṃ vā viruddham |
utpadyamānamuttaraṃ jñānaṃ svirasya pūrvajñānasya vācanaiva utpadyate |
na ca kāryajananāvasthaṃ jñānaṃ jñāyate, kintu ativṛtta- janakabhāvam |
ṛju. pṛ. 66. yathā dvādaśaśata- jñānamutpannaṃ pāścātyenaiva naimittikene sarvavedasadānādijñānena bādhyate |
jñānasya asamattve svata:prāmāṇyena doṣābhāve pramātvasya siddhi: |
pṛ. 1082. pradhānā- śritakarmabhedenaiva guṇabhūtasya jñānasya karmaṇa: medo mī. ko. 223 jñānānumeyetā |
atra kecit jñānamumeya- micchanti, teṣāṃ mate jñānasyaivābhāva: prajñayate |
tathāhi, jñānānumānaṃ hi nārthasattāmātreṇa bhavitumarhati, tasya tadavinābhāvanīyamāvāt, yudhiṣṭhirādyarthābhāve'pi jñānaṃ paraṃ vartate eva |
atha arthajñānaṃ liṅgamityucyate, tadapi nopattimātreṇa liṅgam anavabhāsamāne'pi upekṣānupala- yoraviśeṣāt, na hi anavabhāsamānaṃ liṅgamumāpakaṃ bhavati |
na cārthajñānasya jñānāntarādhīnabhavabhāsanam, jñānāntarānavagamāt uktīyatā anavasthāpātāt |
pravi. pṛ. 33. jñānādernirindriyavattuktopasañjīyakāryo bādhakā- 'bhāvāt iti nyāya: |
yathā jñānapākavasānabhūmimalaṃ sthāvarāṇām, tathā tadutkarṣavasānabhūmimiśrasya ityaṅgī- kāryam |
maṇi. pṛ. 17, jñānecchā- pravṛttīnāṃ samānaprakārakatvasamānaviśeṣyakatvena hetuhetu- madbhāva: |
ke. jñānakarmaṇo: samuccayena janakatā, ata: siddho jñāna- karmasamuccaya: |

etāvantaḥ candrādityayogatiparyāyāḥ ekasmin yuge bhavanti ityava- gatayeṣu tadgateṣu saṃvatsarādiṣu 'iha idānīṃ candramāḥ, ihedānīmādityaḥ' ityevaṃ candrādityagativibhāgajñānasya tithyādijñānopayogitvam |

' bhāṭṭa-- yatra ekameva karma anekeṣu vedeṣu śrutam, tatra ka utpattiḥ ka ca tadanuvādena guṇārthe śravaṇamiti jijñāsāyām, yatra aṅgabhāvatvaṃ tatra utpattiḥ sevaka- bāhutvena rājāvasthānanirṇayavat |
tatrāpi daividhye bahiraṅgatve'pi anyabhicārāt devatāyā eva, na tu dravyasyetyādyuktam |
ataśca evaṃvidhanirṇāyakasattve tatrotpattiḥ, anyatra tadanuvādena avirodhiguṇāntara- vidhānam |
evaṃ yatra kaśca cidapi niyāmakasattvābhāvaḥ, tatrāpi abhyāsādedaḥ |
tadatra śākhā'ntaranyāyena satyapi sarvaiṣāmatpattireva kathaṃkramam, tadviddhi ahamevabhedābhāvāt |
ato niyāmakatvena yanai- votpattiḥ, tadedanivandhana eva svara iti siddham |

teṣāṃ trayāṇāmartha eka eva yūpaḥ tantreṇa saṃpādyaḥ |

' pṛṣṭhaye gṛhṇīyāt ' ' ukthye gṛhṇīyāt ' iti punarvacanaṃ tu prakṛtisāmyārtham |
jyotiṣṭome adhiṣavaṇaphalake prakṛtya śrūyate ' dīrghome saṃttvāt pṛṣṭhyai ' iti |
idaṃ saṃtardanaṃ jyotiṣṭomasaṃsthāyu gṛhyate, agnīṣome tu saṃtardanaṃ asaṃta- rdanam iti vikalpaḥ |
vi. 7|7|22, jyotiṣṭome anadhanarūpaṃ tapo yājamānam, vacanaviśeṣapātu ṛtvi- jāmapi |
3|8|14, jyotiṣṭome anārambhīyātānām adābhyādigrahāṇāṃ sakṛdeva prātaḥsadhane anuṣṭhānam |
5|1|6, jyotiṣṭome anubandhyānigadeṣu ukthāśabda eva, vanaspatibhāge ca vanaspatiśabda eva paṭhanīyaḥ |
jyoti- ṣṭome anuyājotkarṣe'pi dākṣiṇāgnikoḥ piṣṭalepaphalī- karaṇahomayornotkarṣaḥ |
jyotiṣṭome anuṣṭubho gāyatryośca prayanayena saṃpādite anuṣṭubhe tu iyāvāśvādhīgavasāmno- rgāyanam |
' pañcacchandā āvāpa ābharmavaḥ pavamānaḥ saptasāmā, gāyatrasaṃhite gāyatre tucce bhavataḥ, iyāvāśvādhīgave anuṣṭubhe, uṣṇihe sappha, kakumi pauṣkalam, kāmavantaṃ jagatīṣu ' iti |
yadetat iyāvā- śvādhīgavaṃca dve sāmanī tayoḥ pūrvā anuṣṭup ' puro- jitī vo andhasaḥ sutāya mādyaviṣṇave |
uttare dve gāyatryau, ' yo dhārayā pāvakyā paripaśyandate sutaḥ |
taṃ durobhamī naraḥ somaṃ viśācyā dhiyā |

tatro'rthaḥ sāṃśayikaḥ; kiṃ anyayoḥ utpatyanuṣṭubhoḥ āgamaṃ kṛtvā samāsu gānaṃ kartavyam athavā yāḍasau pūrvā'nuṣṭup uttare ca gāyatryau, tavoḥ pramathanena tucakramaṃ kṛtvā anuṣṭup-prāraṃ kartavyamiti |
evaṃ hi smaranti ' ānuṣṭubhaḥ pragāthaḥ ' iti |
tacchidṛśyate pañcacchandā āvāpa ābharmavaḥ pava- mānaḥ saptasāmā |
gāyatrasaṃhite gāyatre tucce bhavataḥ; tāḥ ṣaḍ gāyatryaḥ; tisro jagatyo bhavanti |
iyāvāśvādhīgave anuṣṭubhe tayoḥ pūrvā anuṣṭup uttare gāyatryau tatra pramathanena kriyamāṇe dvayoḥ sāmnoḥ ṣaḍanuṣṭubhaḥ, tāścatasro jagatyaḥ; pūrvābhiḥ saha sapta |
uṣṇihe sappha kakumi pauṣka- lam ekamapi ekasāmni aparamapyekasām |
te dve uṣṇihakakubhau, saikā jagato gāyatrīpādaśca |
kāve tisro jagatyaḥ; tābhiḥ saha ekādaśa bhavanti |
ekaviṃśaṃ yaśādyathīyam, tatra pūrvā bṛhatī, uttarā viṣṭārapaṅktiḥ |
ekaviṃśe ca stome kriyamāṇe sapta bṛhatyo bhavanti, caturdaśa kakubhaḥ |
yāḥ sapta bṛhatyaḥ, tāḥ pañca jagatyaḥ |
ekakṣatra jagatīpādaḥ pūrveṇa gāyatrīpādena saha viṃśatilakṣaṇāni |
atha catu- rdaśa kakubhya yā dvādaśa kakubhaḥ; tāḥ sapta jagatyaḥ;
ye dve kakubhau śiṣṭe saikā jagatī gāyatrīpādaḥ, pūrvābhiḥ saha caturviṃśatirjagatyaḥ |
evaṃ pragāthe kriyamāṇe caturviṃśatirjagatyaḥ ekā ca kakup |
atha pragātho na kriyate tataḥ śyāvāśvādīnāṃ upatya- nuṣṭubhorāgamāt yajñayajñīye upastikubhorāgamāt naiṣā saṃkhyā saṃpadyate |
(atra yat anekavāraṃ jagatītvamuktam, tat kevalamakṣara- gaṇanayā kalpanāmātram, na tu tathā paṭhanamiti dhyeyam |
śā-- 'śyāvāśvādīnāṃ anuṣṭume tuce bhavataḥ ' iti tayoḥ pūrvā'nuṣṭup uttare dve gāyatryau, tatrāpi anyayoḥ anuṣṭubhorāgamanaṃ paṭhitānāmeva vā pragāthanena anuṣṭuptrayaṃ saṃpādyamiti vicāraḥ |
liṅgāntarapradarśanāya tu idaṃ vyāsyānāntaram (bhāṣye) nātra kā cit adhikā śaṅkā'sti |
ṛcaiva kuryāt, na tu dāśatayībhyā kayācit |
vi. 3|2| 8. jyotiṣṭome āmīdhramaṇḍapasamarthanaṃ hiraṇyakeśinaḥ ‘atha no agniḥ’ ityanayā ṛcā kurvanti, baudhā- yanāśca ‘agnimūrdhā’ ityanayā |
ke. jyotiṣṭome āmīdhra-sado- havirdhānamaṇḍapopasthāneṣu krameṇa prakṛtā kācit āgneyī aindrī vaiṣṇavī ca ṛk grāhyā |
bhā. 10|2|15|18 varṇakaṃ 1, jyotiṣṭome ājyāni pañcadaśāni iti ājyaśabdaḥ śastraviśeṣāṇāṃ nāmadheyam, na guṇavidhiḥ |
ājyapṛṣṭhādistotraiḥ rathaṃtarasāmadevyādīnāṃ prākṛtānāṃ na bādhaḥ, kintu samuccayaḥ |
nāpyevaṃ vidhīyate, havirdhānam āsāmanuṣya- mānānām upādātavyaṃ saṃcyantīti |
kathaṃ tarhi ? havirdhānaviśeṣasaṃbandho'tra sāmidhenīnāṃ śrūyate, na havirdhānasaṃbandho vidhīyate |
na ca sāmidhenīsaṃstho havi- rdhānasya prāptaḥ, yo viśeṣārthamanudyeta |
kena tarhi havi- rdhānasya saṃbandhaḥ ? pratyakṣaṃ hi arthakarma somasa, na tu sāmidhenīkarme pratyakṣaṃ havirdhānasya |
apareṇa vedimiti heturderśo lakṣitaḥ, sa uttarasya dakṣiṇasya vā havirdhānasya samāptaḥ |
atha evamamisaṃbandhaḥ kasmānna bhavati 'yasmin havirdhāne suvanti, tasya havirdhānasya sāmidhenīsaṃbandhaḥ' iti ? naivaṃ śakyam |
havirdhānasaṃbandhaḥ, havirdhānaviśeṣa- saṃbandhaśca, tatra vākyaṃ bhidyate |
vā-- somadhāraṇena tāvat pratyakṣaṃ naipekṣyaṃ havirdhā- nasya, sāmidhenīnāṃ punaḥ prakṛtāveva asminnidhanārthatvāt kṛtyaṃ prayojanamiti nāsti aṅgakriyāpekṣā |
havirdhāna- viśeṣasaṃndhanapare vākye sāmānyasaṃndhanaścakṣimapi kalpayataḥ āgneyyadhikaraṇokto vākyabhedo yojyaḥ |
viśeṣeṇa sāmānyākṣepāt vākyabhedaṃ pariharataḥ siddhasāmānyasaṃbandhena siddhāntapakṣeṇa arthāpattiśco darśayitavyaḥ |
yathā asāmiḥ nyāya upadiṣṭaḥ somārthe havirdhānamiti |
(sāmidhenyaḥ lakṣaṇayā tatkartā hotā pīyate yasmin iti sāmidhenīdhānam, yathā havi- rdhānam) |
soma-- pūrvavat vākyamedābhāvāt sāmidhenyajñatayā havirdhānaṃ vidheyam ityucyate : saṃgatiḥ |
prayojanam- pūrvapakṣe havirdhānākhye (dakṣiṇe) śakaṭe sthitvā sāmi- dhenyuvacanaṃ kartavyam, siddhānte tu tasmīpadeśe iti |
sūtrārthastu - 'sāmidhenī: tat (tatra) anvāha;' iti vacanāt havirdhānameva yasmin (dakṣiṇe) abhibhavaḥ, tat havirdhānaṃ sāmidhenyaṃ syāt iti |
bhāṭṭa-- some 'uta yat suvanti sāmidhenīsta- danvāhaḥ' iti śrutam |
yat yatra dakṣiṇahavirdhāne abhibhavaḥ, tatra agnīṣomīyādisāmidhenīḥ anubrūyādityarthaḥ |

teṣu saṃdehaḥ kiminiyamaḥ, yadvā tadvā parimāṇa- mupādeyam, uta dvādaśa dīkṣā iti |
kiṃ prāptam ? dīkṣā- parimāṇe yathākāmī syāt |
(asya uttarasūtre ekādhikaraṇatvamaṅgīkṛtya dvādaśapari- māṇatvameva bhāṣyakāraḥ siddhāntitavān |
satya- matra nityadāmnānāṃ hetuḥ, na tu 'dvādaśarātrīdīkṣito bhūrti vanvīta' (dvādaśadineṣu dīkṣāyuktaḥ syāt |
tāni hi nityadāmnātāni prakaraṇe kimiti utkṛṣyante ? tulyapramāṇavatāṃ ca vikalpaḥ |
prakṛtyapekṣaṃ nityatvam (jyotiṣṭome nityadāmnātāni iti kṛtvā nityalamuktam, na prayogāpekṣamityavirodhaḥ |
yadi vikalpyate, katham (tarhi) bhṛtivacanavākyam ? (pari- harati-) āha, utkṛṣyatām |
(sa eva bravīti-) ko vā hetuḥ atra bhavataḥ, yena bahūni utkṛṣyante, ekaṃ notkṛṣyate |
(vastutastu na kasyāpi utkarṣaḥ ityāha-) apica ekādivākyāmyapi prakaraṇāt jyotiṣṭomasya (śeṣabhūtāni) bhṛtivacanavākyamapi (śeṣabhūtam ) |
na ca tulye prakaraṇe anyatamamutkṛṣya (atra ānandāśramīye 'tulyaprakaraṇe anyatamena anyatamamutkṛṣya' iti pāṭhaḥ |
asmadīye likhite 'na ca tulye prakaraṇatvameva anyatamamutkṛṣya' iti |
katham ? bhṛtivacanam (dravyā- rjanam ) tāvat arthaprāptam, nahi tena parikrayaḥ saṃbhavati |
santyeva hi tasya (dīkṣitasya) dvādaśa rātrayaḥ, 'dvādaśa dīkṣāḥ' iti vacanāt |
nityavat dvādaśa rātrayaḥ (eva na ekādaśarātrādayaḥ) ityetadapi naiva (vidhātuṃ śakyam), ekādivākyānarthakyabhayāt |
(dīkṣitaśabde'pi naiva svārthavidhānārthaḥ (ityeva-) dīkṣitaḥ dīkṣā asya saṃjātā, ityetadapi naiva (vidheyam ), saṃjātaiva hi tasya dīkṣā āgnāvaiṣṇavādibhiḥ |
kiṃ tarhi (vidheyam, tadāha-) bhṛtivacanasya upapadasya ca saṃbandho vidhīyate |
(tatrāpi upapadaye sati kasya bhṛtivanena saṃbandho vidhīyate iti cintyam |
) tatra yadi tāvat (yat) bhṛtivanaṃ kuryāt (tat) dvādaśa rātrīḥ' iti (vidhīyate) tatḥ nityānisaṃyogaḥ (prasajyeta), nityavat bhṛtivanam, anityā dvādaśa rātrayaḥ |
atha (ahaḥparyadāsena) rātrāveva bhṛtivanaṃ kasmāt vidhīyate ? ucyate |
vākyaṃ bhidyeta, 'rātriṣu bhṛtivanaṃ kuryāt, tacca dvādaśasu' iti |
atha 'yat rātriṣu bhṛtivacanam, tat dvādaśasu' iti (vidhīyate) tato viśiṣṭānuvādaḥ (doṣaḥ) |
yadi tu anyaḥ pakṣaḥ 'yat bhṛtivanaṃ kuryāt, tat dīkṣitaḥ' iti, tato na (kaścit) doṣaḥ |
vidheyaṃ caitat, taddhi (vananam ) dīkṣitasya na prāpnoti |

iti bhā- ṭippaṇī) dvādaśāhe jyotiṣṭomīyadīkṣāparimāṇe yathā- kāmyaṃ prāptam |

'abhuduṣā' ( iti prātaranuvākaparivānīyā- mantraḥ ) tu kālayāde'pi saṃbandhe 'asmin kāle pracaraṇī- homaḥ' |
yadi asmin ( abhuduṣākāle ) pracaraṇīhomādyo na kriyeran ( abhu- duṣā- ) kālasaṃbandhaḥ ( śrutaḥ ) bādhyeta |
( tena vacanādapi pracaraṇīhomaḥ tadānīṃ kartavyaḥ; na prokṣa- ṇādayaḥ iti siddhāntanupapattiḥ syāt ) ataḥ anyathā varṇyate |
( tato'sau ) yatarasmin pakṣe nāsti, tatra vicāryate |
kim ( nirvā- pānantaram ) pracaraṇīhomādiṣu ( saumikeṣu ) pravartatām, uta proṣaṇādiṣu ( pauroḍāśike ṣu ) iti |
( ato nirupya prokṣaṇādayaḥ kartavyāḥ; tataḥ saumikāḥ iti ) |
aiṣṭikyevāḥ saumikyā mahāvedyā pracārā- thaiyā prasaṅgasiddhiḥ |
12|13, jyotiṣṭome aiṣṭikeṣu hotṛvarṇaṃ saumikavaraṇāt pṛthak kartavyamadṛṣṭārthatvāt |
jyotiṣṭome aucaravedikapraṇayanottaraṃ śālā- mukhīyāḥ gārhapatyaḥ, prājahitaśca ||

iti prāpte, 'āhavanīyāpādānakocaravedya- dhikaraṇapraṇayanena āhavanīyaṃ kuryāt' iti vidhau praṇa- yanāvyavahitapūrvakṣaṇe apādānasyāhavanīyatvānna tathā vyavahārasaṃbhave'pi tajjanakatvena taduttarakṣaṇamārabhya tasya gārhapatyatvameva |
ata eva 'saṃmārṣṭi gārhapatyau' iti prājahitaśālāmukhīyāyoḥ gārhapatyatvena vyapadeśaḥ śrutya- ntare upapannaḥ |
'eṣo'ta ūrdhvaṃ gārhapatyo bhavati' iti iti smṛtiśca |
yattu bhāṣye varṇakāntaram, tat asyevā- dhikaraṇasya punarapi vākyāntareṇa varṇanaṃ siddhāntasūtre pāṭhabhedapradarśakaphalakam |

('kṛṣi susyasāmakṛṣe' iti pāṭha eva āvaśyakaḥ, ānandāśramīyaḥ pāṭhastu sākṣāt paramparayā vā mūlagrantha- vācanapramādāt saṃpannaḥ, mūlagranthe'pi ca likhite kasya- cidarthaviduṣaḥ 'kṛṣiṣu iti rūpamaśuddham, dhatvaṃ kasmānna' iti śaṅkā |
syāma iti satyaśabdasya napuṃsakatvāt aśuddhameva iti tasya niścitiḥ; iti tena pāṭhāntaramā- racitam ) yadā ekasminmantre yugapat kaṇḍūyyate tadā- 'pi sakṛdeva prayojyaḥ, āvṛttiḥ |
bhā. 11|4|16| 48-49. jyotiṣṭome karmārambhe yajamāne svīyaṃ dhanaṃ vedyā vyavasthāpyate 'idaṃ me bhuktyartham, idaṃ me yajñārtham, idaṃ me dakṣiṇā'rtham' iti |
vi. 6|77, jyotiṣṭome kāmyaṃ śukrādikaṃ gṛhītvā 'haste dhārayedyuṣmam, yaṃ kāmaya gṛhītuḥ; aindravāyavaṃ gṛhītvā sādayet' iti |
10|5|21. jyotiṣṭome 'kṛṣṇaviṣāṇā kaṇḍūyati' 'nītāsu dakṣiṇāsu cātvāle kṛṣṇaviṣāṇāṃ prāsyati' |
3|6|16|41-47, jyotiṣṭome 'krīte some maitrāvaruṇāya daṇḍaṃ prayacchati' 'daṇḍī preṣānvaha' atra maitrāvaruṇena daṇḍadhāraṇam arthakarma, na pratipattiḥ |
4|2|16-19. jyotiṣṭome 'gāyatracchandasaḥ' ityādipāda- ghaṭitamantro nānācchandaske aindrapradāne some eva, nānyatra |
chandobhirapi yukte syā, dādyo mantre tathoktiḥ ||
yāni ca gārhapatyakāryāṇi 'drāmyāṃ gārhapatye juhoti' ityādisaumikājñāni, yāni caiṣṭikāni patnīsaṃyājādīni, tāni sarvaṇyapi vikalpenobhayatra kriyeranviśeṣataḥ |
iti prāpte, 'prāṅgamārgi praṇayanti' ityādinā 'tarhi tasya paśuśrapaṇaṃ harecetathainaṃ māginaṃ karoti' ityantena prāja- hitasya paśuśrapaṇaikakāryakatvaśravaṇattadatarāṇi śālāmukhīye eva bhavanti |
bhā. 3|1|12-15, jyotiṣṭome grahaṇām aindravāyavāgratve vihite aindravāyavasya sthāne grahaṇam, na tu upāṃyoḥ pūrvam |

10|5|17-64. jyotiṣṭome grahamātrasya grahaṇapātritvasya somasya payaḥprabhṛtibhirmiśraṇam 'payasā maitrāvaruṇaṃ śrīṇāti, saktubhirmanthinam, dhānābhihāri- yojanam, hiraṇyena śukram, ājyena pālīvatam' iti vihitam |
atra payaḥprabhṛtīnāṃ saṃskārakatvāt krayādayaḥ somadharmāḥ na kartavyāḥ, kintu praṇītā''didharmāḥ |
bhā. 3|5|9|27-30. jyotiṣṭome 'ghṛtaṃ devānām' ityādi śrutam 'nayanītenābhyakte' ityasya vidherarthavādaḥ |
vi. 3|4|7. jyotiṣṭome camasānāṃ na daśāpavitreṇa saṃmārgaḥ |
sa ca daśābhāga- sahita iti śabdo vakti |
bhāṣyam - jyotiṣṭome eva śrūyate 'praitu hotṛ- śramasaḥ, pra brahmaṇaḥ, prodgātṛṇām, pra yajamānasya, pra yantu sadasyānām' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ camasināmasti bhakṣaḥ, neti ! kiṃ prāsam ? neti brūmaḥ |
hotṛcamaso brahmaṇa- śramasa udgātṛcamasa iti samākhyāyā nirdiṣṭaye |
hotā yatra camati camivyati acīdā, sa hotṛcamasaḥ |
yatra hotā na camet na hotṛcamaso bhavet |
yadi cātra hotā na camet, na śakyaṃ bhavet hotṛcamasena praitum |
na ca anyat hotā odanādi camivyati |
apica na taddhotṛdravyam, yajamānasya tat dravyam, hotṛstatra camanaṃ kartavyam |
pavitraṃ hi somaḥ, na tasmin bhakṣite pātraṃ vyāpyate |
tathā saṃjñapahāt attacamapataiva syāt, dravyāntaraṃ syāt |
'yadi rājanyaṃ vaiśyaṃ vā yājayet, sa yadi somaṃ trimakṣayiṣet, nyagrodha- sitamīrāhatya tāḥ saṃpiṣya dadhanmumṛjya tasmai bhakṣaṃ prayacchen somam' iti bhakṣaniṣiddhaṃ darśayati |
saiṣā bhakṣāśaṅkā evaṃ sati upapadyate, yadi camisino'sti bhakṣaḥ |
sa tu samākhyā- ''dideminna upadeśaḥ anusatavyaḥ, na tu śrutaviśeṣa- mātraniṣṭhaḥ |
tatra camaseṣu tāvat yadyapi brāhmaṇagataḥ pratyakṣopadeśo nopalabhyate, tathāpi praipatayā samākhyā anumīyate |
hotṛcamasatvādi viśiṣṭaṃ hi dravyānvanapreṣaṇaṃ na kaścidutpadyate, yadi teṣu hotṛdāvyaḥ somaṃ na camanti |

katham ? camasa iti adanāthasya cameḥ auṇā- dike adhikaraṇasādhane atrapratyaye kṛte praiṣavelāyāṃ bhūtabhaviṣyadarthamānānāṃ kacit saṃbandhe apekṣyamāne bhūta- vartamānayoradarśanāt bhaviṣyattvamanumīyate |
nahi anyathā hotṛcamasaḥ praitu' ityetasya anuṣṭhānaṃ śakyate |
saśeṣaḥ camaso hūyate 'alpaṃ juhoti' iti vacanāt |
na ca anyat odanādidravyaṃ pratīyate, yasya camanāt camasatvamupapadyate |
na ca taccamanasya karmāṅga- bhāvaḥ syāt, tatra prakaraṇaṃ bādhyate, praiṣo'pi ca ukta- dhyet, somacamasasamākhyā ca bādhyate |
yadi ca oda- nādi bhakṣayet, tataḥ ucchiṣṭena pātreṇa punarhomo na kriyate |
śuddhayarthaṃ tatra takṣaṇādyāśrayaṇe, yasya hotṛcamasa- syādavadhāritam, tasya vināśāt dravyāntaraṃ tatsāmākhyaṃ na bhavati, iti samākhyātyadravyāsanakahomavidhānacāt : syāt |
na ca vacanasāma- rthyāt ucchiṣṭena hotṛṃ
somabhakṣe'pi sarvametat tulyamiti cet, naitadevam 'na someno- cchiṣṭhā bhavanti' iti śruteḥ |
bhāṣyamapi anenaiva krameṇa netavyaṃ na yathālikhitam |
yadi ca 'pra yajamānasya' iti samākhyā na somabhakṣaḥ prāpyate, tataḥ phalacamasidhau 'sa yadi somaṃ vibhajyaṣiyet' iti 'na somam' iti pratiṣedha- saṃkīrtanaṃ nāvakalpeta |
tasmāt asti camasināṃ soma- bhakṣa iti |
śā-somayoḥ bhāṭṭe ca idamadhikaraṇaṃ pūrvādhikaraṇe eva antarbhāvitam |
' \ jyotiṣṭome tapaḥ 'hyahaṃ nābhāti nyahaṃ nābhāti' iti yājamānameva |
bhā. 3|8|11-10, \ jyotiṣṭome tātīyyasavanikapuro- ḍāśādiṣu haviṣpadāhānaṃ na kartavyam |
1|2|4| 12-13, \ jyotiṣṭome 'tīrthe snāti' ityuktaṃ tīrthe snānam, ṛtuyuktapuruṣadharmatvāt jyotiṣṭomaprakaraṇe eva niviśate |
hi yasmāt pradhānatve yat kāraṇaṃ phalavattvam, tat sarveṣāṃ yāgānāmaviśiṣṭaṃ samānaṃ yāgatvāt |
guṇānāṃ tatpattivākyena saṃbandhatvāt kāraṇaśruti- stasmāt somaḥ pradhānaṃ syāt |
guṇānām utpattivākyena saṃbandhasya vidyamānatvāt kāraṇaśrutiḥ pūrvapakṣoktakāraṇasya phalasaṃbandhasya bodhikā bhūtiḥ saṃbhavati |
jyotiṣṭomasya phalena saṃbandhāt jyotīrūpāṇāṃ stomaśabditānāṃ guṇānāṃ phalena saṃbandhaḥ |
somayāgā eva pradhānaṃ dīkṣaṇīyā''- dayo yāgāstu aṅgam |
evaṃ 'caturviṃśatimānaṃ hiraṇyaṃ dīkṣaṇīyāyāṃ dadyāt' 'prāyaṇīyāyāṃ dve caturviṃśatimāne' iti ca jyotiṣṭoma- dakṣiṇāyāḥ sakāśāt bhinnā dakṣiṇā dṛśyate, tadapi liṅgaṃ bhavati |

'jyotīṣi vā etāni ya etasya stomāḥ ' ityartha- vāde trivṛdādistomeṣu jyotiṣṭomavyapadeśāt 'grahaṃ vā gṛhītvā camasaṃ votrīya stotramupākaroti' iti ca vicau somayāgasya trivṛdādistomayogavagamāt prasiddhārthena nāmnā yajyartho viśeṣyate iti |
